teaching_sense.en_definition: To be guarded for protection or kept under surveillance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到看守以获得保护，或处于监视之下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun taħt il-ħarsien ta' xi ħadd jew taħt sorveljanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到看守或守卫。
受到监视；被持续观察动向。

collocations.en: The warehouse was guarded during the night.
The suspect was kept under surveillance by the police.

formal.mt: Il-bini ngħass matul il-lejl sabiex it-tagħmir jinżamm sigur.
formal.en: The building was guarded during the night to keep the equipment safe.
formal.zh: 为保障设备安全，这栋建筑在夜间受到看守。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kien hemm xi ħadd jieħu ħsieb il-maħżen ilbieraħ filgħaxija? Pawlu: Iva, il-maħżen ngħass il-lejl kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was someone looking after the warehouse last night? Pawlu: Yes, the warehouse was guarded all night.
colloquial.zh: Maja：昨晚有人看守仓库吗？Pawlu：有，仓库整夜都有人看守。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm xi ħadd jieħu ħsieb il-maħżen ilbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm xi ħadd jieħu ħsieb il-maħżen ilbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.zh: 昨晚有人看守仓库吗？
messages.en: Was someone looking after the warehouse last night?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 有，仓库整夜都有人看守。
messages.en: Yes, the warehouse was guarded all night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ngħass 放进“仓库整夜有人守着”的画面，再换成警方观察嫌疑人，分别记住保护性看守和监视两种语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat enough food to feel full and no longer hungry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃到感到饱足、不再饥饿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol sakemm iħossu mimli u ma jkollux aktar ġuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一直吃到饱足为止。

collocations.en: ate his fill at the meal
ate his fill of bread and cheese

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, it-tifel ngħat u ma talabx aktar ikel.
formal.en: The boy ate his fill at the meal and did not ask for more food.
formal.zh: 男孩这顿饭吃饱了，没有再要食物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark irid aktar għaġin? Lara: Le, ngħat u ma jridx aktar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does Mark want more pasta? Lara: No, he has eaten his fill and does not want any more.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 还要意面吗？Lara：不要了，他已经吃饱，不想再吃了。

messages.speaker: Sara (主人)
messages.zh: Mark 还要意面吗？
messages.en: Does Mark want more pasta?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ngħat u ma jridx aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ngħat u ma jridx aktar.
messages.zh: 不要了，他已经吃饱，不想再吃了。
messages.en: No, he has eaten his fill and does not want any more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人吃完饭，把盘子轻轻推开说“已经饱了”，把 ngħat 与“吃到满足”的终点联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given to someone, as a gift, award, resource, or opportunity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为礼物、奖项、资源或机会等被给予某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tgħaddi għand xi ħadd bħala rigal, premju, għajnuna jew opportunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被给予；被交给某人。

collocations.en: The prize was given to the winner.
The book was given as a gift.
collocations.zh: 这本书被当作礼物送出。

formal.mt: Il-premju ngħata lill-istudent bħala rikonoxximent tax-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The prize was given to the student in recognition of his work.
formal.zh: 该奖项颁给了这名学生，以表彰他的工作成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ktieb li kien hawn? Mark: Ngħata lil Sara bħala rigal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the book that was here? Mark: It was given to Sara as a gift.
colloquial.zh: Maja：原来放在这里的书呢？Mark：当礼物送给 Sara 了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ktieb li kien hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ktieb li kien hawn?
messages.zh: 原来放在这里的书呢？
messages.en: Where is the book that was here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 当礼物送给 Sara 了。
messages.en: It was given to Sara as a gift.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 ngħata 就想象礼物从一双手交到另一双手，注意句子的焦点是“东西被给予”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop bedsores while confined to bed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 卧床期间出现褥疮，即压疮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa feriti fil-ġilda minħabba pressjoni fit-tul waqt li jibqa' fis-sodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现褥疮；因持续受压而生压疮。

collocations.en: developed bedsores after a long time in bed

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi pazjent li ngħatar wara żmien twil fis-sodda.
formal.en: The report describes a patient who developed bedsores after a long time in bed.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一位长期卧床后出现褥疮的患者。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inhu n-nannu? Pawlu: Għadu fis-sodda u ngħatar; l-infermier qed jieħu ħsiebu.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is Grandpa? Pawlu: He is still in bed and has developed bedsores; the nurse is looking after him.
colloquial.zh: Marija：爷爷怎么样？Pawlu：他还在卧床，生了褥疮，护士正在照顾他。

messages.speaker: Marija (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷怎么样？
messages.en: How is Grandpa?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu fis-sodda u ngħatar; l-infermier qed jieħu ħsiebu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu fis-sodda u ngħatar; l-infermier qed jieħu ħsiebu.
messages.zh: 他还在卧床，生了褥疮，护士正在照顾他。
messages.en: He is still in bed and has developed bedsores; the nurse is looking after him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“长期卧床后皮肤出现褥疮”的情境记住本词；朗读 ngħatar 时，把末尾的 r 也读进记忆，避免与 ngħata 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have something placed over it so that it is covered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 上面被放置其他东西，从而被盖住或覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu xi ħaġa fuqu li tgħattih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被盖住；被某物覆盖。

collocations.en: The bread was covered with a cloth.
The equipment was covered with plastic.

formal.mt: It-tagħmir ngħatta bil-plastik sabiex ikun protett mit-trab.
formal.en: The equipment was covered with plastic to protect it from dust.
formal.zh: 设备盖上了塑料布，以防沾上灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-ħobż? Mark: Qiegħed fuq il-mejda; ngħatta b'ċarruta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the bread? Mark: It is on the table; it has been covered with a cloth.
colloquial.zh: Sara：面包在哪里？Mark：在桌上，用一块布盖着。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 面包在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在桌上，用一块布盖着。
messages.en: It is on the table; it has been covered with a cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ngħatta 与“面包上盖了一块布”的画面绑定；书写时特别留意双写 tt，帮助区别相近词形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For ground or soil to be dug or turned over.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指土地或土壤被挖掘、翻动或翻耕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-art jew il-ħamrija titħaffer jew tinqaleb waqt ix-xogħol tar-raba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挖掘；土地被掘开。
被翻动；在土地语境中指土壤被翻耕。

collocations.en: The land was dug with a hoe.
The land was turned over before sowing.
collocations.zh: 土地在播种前进行了翻耕。

formal.mt: Ir-raba' ngħażaq qabel iż-żrigħ biex il-ħamrija tkun lesta għaż-żerriegħa.
formal.en: The land was turned over before sowing so that the soil would be ready for the seeds.
formal.zh: 播种前，土地经过翻耕，使土壤为播种做好准备。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ir-raba' lest għaż-żrigħ? Pawlu: Iva, ngħażaq ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the land ready for sowing? Pawlu: Yes, it was turned over yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Lara：地准备好播种了吗？Pawlu：准备好了，昨天已经翻过了。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场助手)
messages.zh: 地准备好播种了吗？
messages.en: Is the land ready for sowing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 准备好了，昨天已经翻过了。
messages.en: Yes, it was turned over yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锄头把土掘开，再把下层土翻到上面，用同一个农田画面串起 ngħażaq 的“被挖”和“被翻耕”。

gloss_zh: 被纺成线；被选中；被分出或留置

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be spun into thread, chosen from alternatives, or set aside or separated from other things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指纤维被纺成线、某人或某物被选中，或东西被单独留出、与其他东西分开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-suf jinħadem f'ħajt, xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tingħażel minn fost oħrajn, jew xi ħaġa titwarrab jew tinfired mill-bqija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被纺；指羊毛等纤维被纺成线。
被挑选；被选中。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be set aside or separated
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被单独留出或放在一旁；与其余部分分开。

collocations.en: The wool was spun into yarn.
Mark was chosen for the job.
collocations.zh: Mark 被选中担任这份工作。

collocations.en: The grain for sowing was separated from the rest.
collocations.zh: 用于播种的谷物从其余谷物中分了出来。

formal.mt: Fil-wirja, is-suf ngħażel f'ħajt fin quddiem il-viżitaturi.
formal.en: At the exhibition, the wool was spun into fine yarn in front of the visitors.
formal.zh: 展览上，羊毛在参观者面前被纺成了细毛线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ngħażel għall-impjieg? Sara: Mark ngħażel; jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who was chosen for the job? Sara: Mark was chosen; he starts on Monday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份工作选中了谁？Sara：选中了 Mark，他周一开始上班。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这份工作选中了谁？
messages.en: Who was chosen for the job?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 选中了 Mark，他周一开始上班。
messages.en: Mark was chosen; he starts on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ngħażel 配三张独立图片：羊毛变成线、候选人被选中、播种用谷物被分出。靠句中名词判断义项，不强行合并含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be loved and valued deeply, with affection and care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被深深喜爱和珍视，受到疼爱与关怀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun maħbub ħafna u meqjus bħala għażiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被珍爱；受到疼爱和珍视。

collocations.en: The boy was cherished by his grandparents.
collocations.zh: 男孩受到祖父母的疼爱。

collocations.en: The dog was cherished by the whole family.
collocations.zh: 这只狗受到全家人的疼爱。

formal.mt: Matul tfulitu, it-tifel ngħażż min-nanniet tiegħu, li dejjem sabu ħin għalih.
formal.en: Throughout his childhood, the boy was cherished by his grandparents, who always made time for him.
formal.zh: 男孩在整个童年都受到祖父母的疼爱，他们总会抽出时间陪伴他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar il-kelb għand in-nanniet? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna! Ngħażż u lagħbu miegħu kuljum.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the dog get on at the grandparents' house? Mark: Very well! He was cherished, and they played with him every day.
colloquial.zh: Lara：狗狗在祖父母家过得怎么样？Mark：特别好！他们很疼爱它，每天都陪它玩。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗狗在祖父母家过得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the dog get on at the grandparents' house?

messages.speaker: Mark (宠物主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Ngħażż u lagħbu miegħu kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Ngħażż u lagħbu miegħu kuljum.
messages.zh: 特别好！他们很疼爱它，每天都陪它玩。
messages.en: Very well! He was cherished, and they played with him every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象全家围着心爱的狗狗，陪它玩并细心照顾它，把 ngħażż 记成“被放在心上、受到疼爱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be overcome by a feeling or difficulty, or defeated and conquered by an opponent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被情绪或困难压倒，或被对手击败、征服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jiġi megħlub minn sentiment jew diffikultà, jew jitlef quddiem avversarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被情绪、疲劳或困难压倒；被克服。
被征服；被敌方击败并控制。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont storiku, ir-renju ngħeleb mill-għadu wara gwerra twila.
formal.en: According to the historical account, the kingdom was conquered by the enemy after a long war.
formal.zh: 据这份历史记述，该王国在漫长的战争后被敌人征服。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Ngħeleb mill-għeja wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu go to bed so early? Mark: He was overcome by fatigue after work.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么这么早就去睡了？马克：他下班后累得撑不住了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么这么早就去睡了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go to bed so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他下班后累得撑不住了。
messages.en: He was overcome by fatigue after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它联想成“招架不住”：人招架不住疲劳，王国招架不住敌军，分别帮助记住被压倒和被征服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be incited or urged by someone to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人的煽动或怂恿，去做某件事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jiġi mħajjar jew imbuttat minn xi ħadd biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be incited to do sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被煽动、被怂恿去做某事。

collocations.en: was incited to break the rules

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega li ż-żagħżugħ ngħewa minn sħabu biex jagħmel ħsara lill-bini.
formal.en: The report explains that the young man was incited by his friends to damage the building.
formal.zh: 报告说明，这名青年受到朋友们的煽动，去破坏那栋建筑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Leo kiser ir-regoli? Toni: Ngħewa minn sħabu biex jagħmel hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Leo break the rules? Toni: His friends incited him to do it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利奥为什么违反规则？托尼：是朋友们怂恿他这么做的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 利奥为什么违反规则？
messages.en: Why did Leo break the rules?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħewa minn sħabu biex jagħmel hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħewa minn sħabu biex jagħmel hekk.
messages.zh: 是朋友们怂恿他这么做的。
messages.en: His friends incited him to do it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“别人怂恿，他才行动”的小故事记忆；读例句时找出怂恿者，再找出被怂恿去做的事情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a period or experience to be lived through by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某段时期或某种经历被人亲身经历、度过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li perjodu jew esperjenza jgħaddi minnhom xi ħadd fil-ħajja tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指一段时光或一种处境被亲身经历、度过。

collocations.en: a period that was lived through
was lived through with much suffering

formal.mt: Dan il-perjodu ngħex b'ħafna tbatija mill-familji tar-raħal.
formal.en: This period was lived through with much suffering by the village families.
formal.zh: 村里的家庭在许多苦难中度过了这段时期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien dak iż-żmien għall-familja tagħkom? Nannu: Kien żmien diffiċli, imma ngħex b'ħafna tama.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was that time like for your family? Grandfather: It was a difficult time, but we lived through it with much hope.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们家那段日子过得怎么样？爷爷：那段日子很艰难，但我们怀着很大的希望走了过来。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien dak iż-żmien għall-familja tagħkom?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien dak iż-żmien għall-familja tagħkom?
messages.zh: 你们家那段日子过得怎么样？
messages.en: What was that time like for your family?

messages.speaker: Nannu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien żmien diffiċli, imma ngħex b'ħafna tama.
messages.mt_standard: Kien żmien diffiċli, imma ngħex b'ħafna tama.
messages.zh: 那段日子很艰难，但我们怀着很大的希望走了过来。
messages.en: It was a difficult time, but we lived through it with much hope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一段日子画成时间线，人在其中走过；这个词把焦点放在“被人度过的那段时光”上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to introduce an example or suggest a possible case, amount, or choice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引出例子，或提出一种可能的情况、数量或选择，相当于“比如说”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex jiddaħħal eżempju jew tiġi proposta possibbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比如说；举例来说，用来引出一个示例或假设的选择。

formal.mt: L-istudenti jistgħu jagħżlu suġġett lokali, ngħidu aħna, l-istorja tar-raħal tagħhom.
formal.en: Students may choose a local topic, for example, the history of their village.
formal.zh: 学生可以选择一个与本地有关的题目，比如说，自己村庄的历史。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta nistgħu niltaqgħu? Mark: Ngħidu aħna, nhar is-Sibt fl-għaxra?
colloquial.en: Lara: When can we meet? Mark: Say, on Saturday at ten?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们什么时候可以见面？马克：比如说，星期六十点？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候可以见面？
messages.en: When can we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 比如说，星期六十点？
messages.en: Say, on Saturday at ten?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语当作“举例按钮”：说完它，就接一个具体例子，如十分钟、星期六或某个研究题目。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cleaned by scrubbing or made shiny by rubbing and polishing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过用力擦拭而被洗净，或通过摩擦、抛光而变得光亮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wiċċ jew oġġett jitnaddaf jew jitleqq billi jingħorok.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用力擦洗；被刷洗干净。
被擦亮；被磨光或抛光。

collocations.en: was polished until it began to shine

formal.mt: Il-paviment ngħorok bis-sapun u bl-ilma biex jitneħħa l-ħmieġ.
formal.en: The floor was scrubbed with soap and water to remove the dirt.
formal.zh: 地板用肥皂和水擦洗，以清除污垢。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-platt tal-fidda qed jiddi daqshekk? Pawlu: Ngħorok b'ċarruta ratba sakemm beda jleqq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the silver plate shining so much? Pawlu: It was polished with a soft cloth until it began to shine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个银盘怎么这么亮？保罗：它用软布擦过，一直擦到发亮。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-platt tal-fidda qed jiddi daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-platt tal-fidda qed jiddi daqshekk?
messages.zh: 这个银盘怎么这么亮？
messages.en: Why is the silver plate shining so much?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħorok b'ċarruta ratba sakemm beda jleqq.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħorok b'ċarruta ratba sakemm beda jleqq.
messages.zh: 它用软布擦过，一直擦到发亮。
messages.en: It was polished with a soft cloth until it began to shine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住同一个“擦”的动作有两种目标：擦掉污垢就是擦洗，擦出光泽就是擦亮；看上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To please someone or be liked by them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到喜欢或满意；受到某人的喜爱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tagħti gost lil xi ħadd jew tkun togħġbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人喜欢或满意；讨人喜欢。

formal.mt: Il-kunċert ngħoġob ħafna mill-pubbliku minħabba l-programm varjat tiegħu.
formal.en: The concert greatly pleased the public because of its varied programme.
formal.zh: 音乐会因节目丰富多样而深受公众喜爱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar il-film il-ġdid? Toni: Ngħoġob ħafna minn sħabna; kulħadd irid jerġa' jarah.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the new film go down? Toni: Our friends really liked it; everyone wants to see it again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那部新电影反响怎么样？托尼：朋友们都很喜欢，大家都想再看一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那部新电影反响怎么样？
messages.en: How did the new film go down?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħoġob ħafna minn sħabna; kulħadd irid jerġa' jarah.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħoġob ħafna minn sħabna; kulħadd irid jerġa' jarah.
messages.zh: 朋友们都很喜欢，大家都想再看一遍。
messages.en: Our friends really liked it; everyone wants to see it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一场演出结束后观众鼓掌，用“演出使人喜欢，也就是演出受到喜爱”记住这个词的表达方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be fastened with a pin or attached to another item.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被用别针等固定，或被附在另一件物品、文件上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li oġġett jitwaħħal b'labra jew jiġi mehmuż ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用别针固定或别上；被附上、附在另一物件上。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt nhemeż mal-formola qabel ma ntbagħtet l-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The photograph was attached to the form before the application was sent.
formal.zh: 申请寄出之前，照片已附在表格上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu r-ritratt għall-applikazzjoni? Mark: Nhemeż mal-formola; ara l-ewwel paġna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the photograph for the application? Mark: It was attached to the form; look at the first page.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：申请用的照片在哪里？马克：已经附在表格上了，看看第一页。

messages.speaker: Lara (申请人)
messages.zh: 申请用的照片在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the photograph for the application?

messages.speaker: Mark (办事员)
messages.zh: 已经附在表格上了，看看第一页。
messages.en: It was attached to the form; look at the first page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象照片被固定在申请表上，把“附在哪儿”和“用什么固定”一起记，便能串起附上与别上的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be crushed or broken down by repeated pounding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到反复敲击、舂捣而被压碎或捣细。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa titfarrak jew issir irqaq permezz ta' daqqiet ripetuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反复捶打、舂捣；被捣碎。

collocations.en: was pounded until it became powder

formal.mt: Il-bżar nhereż fil-mehrież sakemm sar trab fin.
formal.en: The pepper was pounded in the mortar until it became a fine powder.
formal.zh: 胡椒在研钵里被捣成了细粉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bżar għadu sħiħ? Toni: Le, nhereż fil-mehrież u issa lest għaz-zalza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are the peppercorns still whole? Toni: No, they were pounded in the mortar and are now ready for the sauce.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：胡椒还是整粒的吗？托尼：不是，已经在研钵里捣碎了，现在可以放进酱汁里。

messages.speaker: Maja (厨师)
messages.zh: 胡椒还是整粒的吗？
messages.en: Are the peppercorns still whole?

messages.speaker: Toni (厨房助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nhereż fil-mehrież u issa lest għaz-zalza.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nhereż fil-mehrież u issa lest għaz-zalza.
messages.zh: 不是，已经在研钵里捣碎了，现在可以放进酱汁里。
messages.en: No, they were pounded in the mortar and are now ready for the sauce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象研钵里的胡椒粒被一下下捣成细粉，用“反复敲击后变碎”的画面记住这个被动动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tease someone with words or actions, often to provoke a reaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语或举动逗弄、取笑某人，常为了引起对方反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idejjaq jew jiċċajta ma' xi ħadd bi kliem jew azzjonijiet biex iqanqal reazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗弄；取笑；用言语或举动招惹某人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiċċajta ma' xi ħadd jew idejqu biex iqanqal reazzjoni.

collocations.zh: 开玩笑地逗弄了他的兄弟

formal.mt: Matul il-logħba, Mark nibbex lil sieħbu dwar l-iżball li kien għamel, iżda waqaf meta nduna li kien qed jinkwieta.
formal.en: During the game, Mark teased his teammate about the mistake he had made, but stopped when he noticed that he was becoming upset.
formal.zh: 比赛中，马克拿队友的失误逗弄他，但发现对方开始难过后就停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Ben irrabja ma' Pawlu? Maja: Pawlu nibbex lil Ben dwar ix-xagħar tiegħu, u Ben ma daħakx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Ben get angry with Pawlu? Maja: Pawlu teased Ben about his hair, and Ben didn't laugh.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本为什么生保罗的气？玛雅：保罗拿本的头发逗他，本可没笑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 本为什么生保罗的气？
messages.en: Why did Ben get angry with Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu nibbex lil Ben dwar ix-xagħar tiegħu, u Ben ma daħakx.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu nibbex lil Ben dwar ix-xagħar tiegħu, u Ben ma daħakx.
messages.zh: 保罗拿本的头发逗他，本可没笑。
messages.en: Pawlu teased Ben about his hair, and Ben didn't laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用一句玩笑轻轻招惹朋友，记住 nibbex 是逗弄，具体是否友善要看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something moist or wet by adding liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过添加液体使某物湿润或变湿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa niedja jew imxarrba billi jżidilha likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使稍微湿润；润湿。
弄湿；使沾上液体。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar nidda l-ħamrija bi ftit ilma qabel ma żera' ż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: The gardener moistened the soil with a little water before sowing the seeds.
formal.zh: 园丁在播种前用少量水润湿了土壤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min nidda ċ-ċarruta? Mark: Jien, biex innaddaf il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who wetted the cloth? Mark: I did, to clean the table.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把抹布弄湿了？马克：我，为了擦桌子。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把抹布弄湿了？
messages.en: Who wetted the cloth?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我，为了擦桌子。
messages.en: I did, to clean the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nidda 与给干土添水的动作配对：重点是使东西从干变湿，湿润程度看语境。

gloss_zh: 会产生露水的；易结露的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing dew or causing dew to form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会产生露水或促使露水形成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jipproduċi n-nida jew iwassal biex tifforma n-nida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会产生露水的；能使露水形成的。

formal.mt: Wara lejl niddej, qtar ta' nida kien jidher fuq il-weraq tal-pjanti.
formal.en: After a night that produced dew, drops of dew could be seen on the plants' leaves.
formal.zh: 经过一个结露的夜晚，植物叶片上可以看到露珠。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħaxix imxarrab? Pawlu: Kien lejl niddej; dak l-ilma hu nida.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the grass wet? Pawlu: It was a night that produced dew; that water is dew.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：草怎么湿了？保罗：昨晚结露了，那些水是露水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 草怎么湿了？
messages.en: Why is the grass wet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien lejl niddej; dak l-ilma hu nida.
messages.mt_standard: Kien lejl niddej; dak l-ilma hu nida.
messages.zh: 昨晚结露了，那些水是露水。
messages.en: It was a night that produced dew; that water is dew.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用清晨草尖上的露珠记 niddej：它是形容词，描述会产生露水的夜晚或天气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single drop of dew resting on a surface, such as a leaf.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凝结并停留在叶片等物体表面的一滴露水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qatra nida li tkun fuq wiċċ bħal dak ta' werqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一滴露水

collocations.en: a drop of dew on a leaf

formal.mt: Filgħodu, nidja fuq il-werqa kienet tleqq fid-dawl tax-xemx.
formal.en: In the morning, a drop of dew on the leaf was shining in the sunlight.
formal.zh: 清晨，叶片上的一滴露水在阳光下闪闪发亮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik in-nidja fuq il-werqa! Pawlu: Kemm hi sabiħa! Tidher bħal perla żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that drop of dew on the leaf! Pawlu: How beautiful! It looks like a little pearl.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看叶片上的那滴露水！保罗：真漂亮！看起来像一颗小珍珠。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看叶片上的那滴露水！
messages.en: Look at that drop of dew on the leaf!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi sabiħa! Tidher bħal perla żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi sabiħa! Tidher bħal perla żgħira.
messages.zh: 真漂亮！看起来像一颗小珍珠。
messages.en: How beautiful! It looks like a little pearl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nidja 想成清晨叶尖的一颗小珍珠，记住它指具体的一滴露水。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who feels regret, remorse, or a wish to apologize for something they have done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己做过的事情而感到后悔、内疚或想要道歉的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li jiddispjaċiha għal dak li għamlet u tixtieq titlob skuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真诚悔过的；因自己的过错而深感愧疚的
感到抱歉的；后悔的
懊悔的；因做错事而自责的
心怀歉意的；表示歉疚的

collocations.zh: 为自己说过的话感到后悔
为自己的所作所为感到懊悔

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, Mark qal li kien niedem għal kliemu u talab skuża lill-kollegi.
formal.en: In his letter, Mark said that he was sorry for his words and apologized to his colleagues.
formal.zh: 马克在信中表示，他为自己说过的话感到后悔，并向同事们道歉。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien niedem għal dak li għedtlek ilbieraħ. Skużani. Sara: Grazzi talli tlabt skuża. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm sorry for what I said to you yesterday. Forgive me. Sara: Thank you for apologizing. Let's talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我为昨天对你说的话感到后悔。原谅我吧。萨拉：谢谢你道歉。我们平静地谈谈吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien niedem għal dak li għedtlek ilbieraħ. Skużani.
messages.mt_standard: Jien niedem għal dak li għedtlek ilbieraħ. Skużani.
messages.zh: 我为昨天对你说的话感到后悔。原谅我吧。
messages.en: I'm sorry for what I said to you yesterday. Forgive me.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli tlabt skuża. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli tlabt skuża. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 谢谢你道歉。我们平静地谈谈吧。
messages.en: Thank you for apologizing. Let's talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niedem 和低头道歉的画面联系起来：心里后悔，嘴上说对不起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to become sleepy or fall asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生睡意或进入睡眠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jaqbdu n-ngħas jew jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人入睡；引起睡意

collocations.en: the singing lulled the boy to sleep

formal.mt: Il-kant ħelu tal-omm niegħes lit-tarbija, li raqdet ftit wara.
formal.en: The mother's gentle singing lulled the baby, who fell asleep shortly afterward.
formal.zh: 母亲轻柔的歌声使婴儿产生睡意，没过多久就睡着了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kant tiegħek niegħes lit-tifel. Mark: Mela nkompli nkanta bil-mod sakemm jorqod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Your singing made the boy sleepy. Mark: Then I'll keep singing softly until he falls asleep.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的歌声让孩子有睡意了。马克：那我继续轻轻唱，直到他睡着。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 你的歌声让孩子有睡意了。
messages.en: Your singing made the boy sleepy.

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nkompli nkanta bil-mod sakemm jorqod.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nkompli nkanta bil-mod sakemm jorqod.
messages.zh: 那我继续轻轻唱，直到他睡着。
messages.en: Then I'll keep singing softly until he falls asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象摇篮曲让宝宝眼皮慢慢合上，用这个画面记 niegħes 的“使人入睡”。

gloss_zh: 浪头泛白沫；表现得羞怯不自在

teaching_sense.en_definition: To form white foam on wave crests, or to behave in a sheepish, embarrassed manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指波浪的浪头泛起白色泡沫；也指表现得羞怯、尴尬或不自在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ragħwa bajda fuq il-qċaċet tal-mewġ, jew iġib ruħu b'mod mistħi u imbarazzat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to foam (used of waves, in connection with their white crests)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 泛起白色泡沫，指波浪的白色浪尖

sense_translations.en_definition: to behave in a sheepish manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得羞怯、局促或尴尬不自在

collocations.en: he behaved sheepishly in front of his friends
collocations.zh: 他在朋友面前显得局促不自在

formal.mt: Hekk kif ir-riħ qawwi laħaq il-bajja, il-mewġ niegħeġ u dehret ragħwa bajda fuq il-qċaċet tiegħu.
formal.en: As the strong wind reached the bay, the waves foamed and white froth appeared on their crests.
formal.zh: 强风吹到海湾时，波浪泛起泡沫，浪尖上出现了白色的浮沫。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark niegħeġ meta faħħartu? Pawlu: Għax ma kienx jaf x'jaqbad jgħid quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark act sheepishly when I praised him? Pawlu: Because he didn't know what to say in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我表扬马克时，他怎么显得那么不自在？保罗：因为他不知道当着大家的面该说什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我表扬马克时，他怎么显得那么不自在？
messages.en: Why did Mark act sheepishly when I praised him?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma kienx jaf x'jaqbad jgħid quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma kienx jaf x'jaqbad jgħid quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他不知道当着大家的面该说什么。
messages.en: Because he didn't know what to say in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 niegħeġ 配两幅学习图：海上浪尖起白沫，受表扬的人害羞不自在；分场景记两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to moan or sigh, for example through pain or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人因疼痛、忧伤等原因发出呻吟或叹息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitniehed jew joħroġ ħoss ta' wġigħ jew dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人呻吟或叹息

collocations.en: the pain made the patient moan

formal.mt: L-uġigħ qawwi niehed lill-pazjent waqt li l-infermiera kienet ħdejh.
formal.en: The severe pain made the patient moan while the nurse was beside him.
formal.zh: 护士在病人身旁时，剧烈的疼痛使他发出了呻吟。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'niehed lil Mark hekk? Pawlu: Il-ħsieb tax-xogħol kollu li għad fadallu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What made Mark sigh like that? Pawlu: The thought of all the work he still has left.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：什么让马克这样叹气？保罗：他想到自己还有那么多工作没做完。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 什么让马克这样叹气？
messages.en: What made Mark sigh like that?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħsieb tax-xogħol kollu li għad fadallu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħsieb tax-xogħol kollu li għad fadallu.
messages.zh: 他想到自己还有那么多工作没做完。
messages.en: The thought of all the work he still has left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 niehed 时连起“原因—人—叹息”三个位置：某件事使某个人叹气或呻吟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely dry, with very little or no moisture remaining.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常干燥的，水分已经极少或完全干透的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Niexef ħafna, bi ftit li xejn umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常干燥的；干透的

formal.mt: Wara ġimgħat mingħajr xita, il-ħamrija fil-ġnien kienet niexfa qoxqox.
formal.en: After weeks without rain, the soil in the garden was extremely dry.
formal.zh: 连续数周没有下雨后，花园里的土壤已经干透了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħobż niexef qoxqox. Għandna ieħor? Sara: Iva, hemm ħobż frisk fil-borża.
colloquial.en: Mark: This bread is terribly dry. Do we have any other bread? Sara: Yes, there's fresh bread in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这面包干得厉害。还有别的面包吗？萨拉：有，袋子里有新鲜面包。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħobż niexef qoxqox. Għandna ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħobż niexef qoxqox. Għandna ieħor?
messages.zh: 这面包干得厉害。还有别的面包吗？
messages.en: This bread is terribly dry. Do we have any other bread?

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 有，袋子里有新鲜面包。
messages.en: Yes, there's fresh bread in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niexef qoxqox 整体记成“干到透”：想象面包干硬、土壤缺水的触感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a whining or whimpering sound expressing discomfort, distress, or a desire for attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不适、难过或想引起注意而发出哼唧、呜咽的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ ħoss ta' tnehid jew biki baxx minħabba skumdità, dwejjaq jew xewqa għall-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出哼唧声；哀声叫唤
低声呜咽；发出轻微的抽泣声

formal.mt: Il-ġeru nieħ bil-biża' meta sema' r-ragħad, u sidu qagħad ħdejh biex jikkalmah.
formal.en: The puppy whimpered in fear when it heard the thunder, and its owner stayed beside it to calm it.
formal.zh: 小狗听到雷声后害怕得呜咽起来，主人待在它身旁安抚它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb nieħ ħdejn il-bieb. Trid toħorġu ftit? Pawlu: Iva, nieħdu mixja issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: The dog whined by the door. Do you want to take him out for a bit? Pawlu: Yes, I'll take him for a walk now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：狗在门边哼唧了。你要带它出去一会儿吗？保罗：好，我现在就带它去散步。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb nieħ ħdejn il-bieb. Trid toħorġu ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb nieħ ħdejn il-bieb. Trid toħorġu ftit?
messages.zh: 狗在门边哼唧了。你要带它出去一会儿吗？
messages.en: The dog whined by the door. Do you want to take him out for a bit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (狗主人)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就带它去散步。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take him for a walk now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗守在门边细声哼唧，用声音画面记 nieħ：哼唧、低声呜咽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moving downward or proceeding from a higher position to a lower one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正在向下移动的，或从较高位置往较低位置行进的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun miexi jew qed jinżel minn post ogħla għal post aktar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在下降的；往下走的

formal.mt: Ir-raġel li jidher fir-ritratt huwa nieżel it-taraġ u qed iżomm mal-poġġaman.
formal.en: The man shown in the photograph is going down the stairs and holding the handrail.
formal.zh: 照片中的男子正扶着扶手下楼梯。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark, int nieżel bil-lift? Mark: Iva, nieżel issa. Niltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Mark, are you coming down in the lift? Mark: Yes, I'm coming down now. Let's meet by the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克，你在乘电梯下来吗？马克：对，我现在正下来。我们在门边见。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克，你在乘电梯下来吗？
messages.en: Mark, are you coming down in the lift?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nieżel issa. Niltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieżel issa. Niltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 对，我现在正下来。我们在门边见。
messages.en: Yes, I'm coming down now. Let's meet by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nieżel 配一个向下箭头，再想象人正下楼梯，记住“正在往下”的方向和状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spread out or expand; of dough, to rise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 展开或扩展；用于面团时，指面团膨起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfirex jew jikber fil-volum; meta jingħad għall-għaġina, ifisser li togħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺展开；扩展开来
（指面团）膨起；发起来

collocations.en: the mixture spread across the surface
collocations.zh: 混合物在表面铺展开来

formal.mt: Wara siegħa ta' mistrieħ, l-għaġina nifxet u żdiedet fil-volum.
formal.en: After resting for an hour, the dough rose and increased in volume.
formal.zh: 静置一小时后，面团膨起，体积增大了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-għaġina nifxet sew! Pawlu: Iva, issa nistgħu ndaħħluha fil-forn.
colloquial.en: Lara: The dough has risen nicely! Pawlu: Yes, now we can put it in the oven.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：面团发得真好！保罗：是啊，现在可以放进烤箱了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 面团发得真好！
messages.en: The dough has risen nicely!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，现在可以放进烤箱了。
messages.en: Yes, now we can put it in the oven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把面团慢慢鼓起、向外展开的画面连起来记：这个动词既可表示铺开，也可表示面团膨起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pierce or puncture something by passing through its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿过物体的表面，将其刺穿或扎破。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi minn wiċċ ta' xi ħaġa u jagħmel toqba fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺穿；穿透
扎破；刺出孔洞
穿过某个表面；穿透表层

collocations.en: pierced the paper with a needle

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, l-istudent niffed il-karta b'labra u osserva t-toqba li għamel.
formal.en: During the experiment, the student pierced the paper with a needle and observed the hole he made.
formal.zh: 实验中，学生用针刺穿纸张，并观察自己扎出的孔洞。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex infaqgħet il-bużżieqa? Toni: Ħija niffed il-bużżieqa b'labra.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did the balloon burst? Toni: My brother punctured the balloon with a needle.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：气球怎么爆了？托尼：我兄弟用针把气球扎破了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 气球怎么爆了？
messages.en: Why did the balloon burst?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我兄弟用针把气球扎破了。
messages.en: My brother punctured the balloon with a needle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象针尖从纸的一面穿到另一面：重点是穿过表面，留下孔洞，不只是轻轻碰到。

gloss_zh: 以自己的气息注入；赋予气息

teaching_sense.en_definition: To imbue something with one's own breath.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将自己的气息注入某物，使其带有自己的气息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idaħħal jew jagħti n-nifs tiegħu lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以自己的气息注入某物；将自己的气息赋予某物

collocations.en: imbued the clay figure with his breath
collocations.zh: 将自己的气息注入泥像

collocations.en: gently imbued something with his breath
collocations.zh: 轻轻地将自己的气息注入某物

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħallieq niffes il-figura tat-tafal bin-nifs tiegħu, u l-figura bdiet tiċċaqlaq.
formal.en: In the story, the creator imbued the clay figure with his breath, and the figure began to move.
formal.zh: 故事中，创造者把自己的气息注入泥像，泥像便开始活动起来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif bdiet tiċċaqlaq il-figura fl-istorja? Adam: Il-ħallieq niffes il-figura bin-nifs tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did the figure start moving in the story? Adam: The creator imbued the figure with his breath.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：故事里的塑像是怎么动起来的？亚当：创造者把自己的气息注入了塑像。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的塑像是怎么动起来的？
messages.en: How did the figure start moving in the story?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 创造者把自己的气息注入了塑像。
messages.en: The creator imbued the figure with his breath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事画面记忆：人物向泥像注入自己的气息；把注意力放在气息的给予者与接受物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To knead dough and spread it out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过揉制将面团展开、摊开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem l-għaġina billi jagħġinha u jifrixha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揉制并摊开面团

collocations.en: kneaded and spread out the dough
kneaded and spread dough with his hands
collocations.zh: 用双手揉开并摊开面团

formal.mt: Il-furnar niffex l-għaġina fuq il-mejda sakemm saret ċatta u lesta għall-pass li jmiss.
formal.en: The baker kneaded and spread the dough on the table until it was flat and ready for the next step.
formal.zh: 面包师在桌上揉开并摊开面团，直至面团变平，可以进入下一道工序。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min niffex l-għaġina għall-pizza? Mark: Jien! Issa tista' żżid iz-zalza.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who kneaded and spread out the dough for the pizza? Mark: I did! Now you can add the sauce.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把披萨面团揉开、摊开了？马克：我！现在可以加酱了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把披萨面团揉开、摊开了？
messages.en: Who kneaded and spread out the dough for the pizza?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我！现在可以加酱了。
messages.en: I did! Now you can add the sauce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住双手先揉、再把面团推开的连续动作；与 nifex 的面团自身膨起形成画面对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pierces something or makes holes through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物刺穿或在其上穿孔的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tniffed xi ħaġa jew tagħmel toqob fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺穿某物的人；执行穿孔的人

formal.mt: F'din id-deskrizzjoni tax-xogħol, in-niffied huwa l-ħaddiem li jagħmel it-toqob fil-ġilda qabel il-ħjata.
formal.en: In this description of the work, the piercer is the worker who makes holes in the leather before stitching.
formal.zh: 在这段工序说明中，穿孔者指的是缝制前在皮革上打孔的工人。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu n-niffied fil-grupp tagħna? Ġużeppi: Illum jien; int tista' tkejjel fejn għandhom jiġu t-toqob.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is the piercer in our group? Ġużeppi: Today it's me; you can measure where the holes should go.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们组谁负责穿孔？朱塞佩：今天是我；你可以量一下孔应该打在哪里。

messages.speaker: Marija (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 我们组谁负责穿孔？
messages.en: Who is the piercer in our group?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum jien; int tista' tkejjel fejn għandhom jiġu t-toqob.
messages.mt_standard: Illum jien; int tista' tkejjel fejn għandhom jiġu t-toqob.
messages.zh: 今天是我；你可以量一下孔应该打在哪里。
messages.en: Today it's me; you can measure where the holes should go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到这个名词就想负责打孔的那个人：记忆焦点是动作执行者，而不是孔洞或工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bayonet: a blade designed to be fitted to the end of a rifle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺刀，即设计用于安装在步枪前端的刀刃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xafra magħmula biex titwaħħal mat-tarf ta' xkubetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺刀；可安装在步枪前端的刀刃

collocations.en: a bayonet attached to a rifle

formal.mt: Fil-vetrina tal-mużew hemm xkubetta b'niffieda mwaħħla mat-tarf tagħha.
formal.en: The museum display case contains a rifle with a bayonet attached to its end.
formal.zh: 博物馆的展柜里陈列着一支前端装有刺刀的步枪。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'inhi dik ix-xafra fuq ix-xkubetta? David: Dik niffieda; ara l-isem fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Elena: What is that blade on the rifle? David: That's a bayonet; look at the name on the label.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：步枪上的那片刀刃是什么？戴维：那是刺刀；你看标签上的名称。

messages.speaker: Elena (博物馆参观者)
messages.zh: 步枪上的那片刀刃是什么？
messages.en: What is that blade on the rifle?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik niffieda; ara l-isem fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Dik niffieda; ara l-isem fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 那是刺刀；你看标签上的名称。
messages.en: That's a bayonet; look at the name on the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它固定在博物馆步枪前端的画面里记忆：这里指具体的刺刀，与表示人的 niffied 分开记。

gloss_zh: 易刺穿的；具有穿透性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to pierce a surface or penetrate into something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有刺穿表面或穿入某物倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jtaqqab wiċċ jew jidħol f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易刺穿物体的；具有刺穿倾向的
容易穿入的；具有穿透倾向的

formal.mt: L-għodda għandha tarf niffiedi li jista' jgħaddi minn saff irqiq ta' ġilda.
formal.en: The tool has a piercing tip that can pass through a thin layer of leather.
formal.zh: 这件工具具有容易刺穿物体的尖端，可以穿透一层薄皮革。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan it-tarf jidher niffiedi. Samwel: Iva, jista' jtaqqab il-kartun faċilment.
colloquial.en: Rita: This tip looks capable of piercing. Samwel: Yes, it can easily make a hole in cardboard.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个尖端看起来很容易刺穿东西。萨姆韦尔：是的，它能轻易扎穿硬纸板。

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 这个尖端看起来很容易刺穿东西。
messages.en: This tip looks capable of piercing.

messages.speaker: Samwel (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 是的，它能轻易扎穿硬纸板。
messages.en: Yes, it can easily make a hole in cardboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象尖端还没接触纸板，却已经显出能刺进去的性质：这是形容性质，不是叙述已经刺穿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who spreads cotton out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将棉花铺开、摊展的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tifrex il-qoton.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺开棉花的人；从事棉花摊展工作的人

collocations.en: the work of the cotton spreader

formal.mt: F'din id-deskrizzjoni tal-proċess, in-niffiex jifrex il-qoton f'saff uniformi fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: In this description of the process, the cotton spreader lays the cotton out in an even layer on the table.
formal.zh: 在这段工序说明中，铺棉者把棉花均匀地铺在桌面上。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'jagħmel in-niffiex? Pietru: Jifrex il-qoton; ara kif jagħmel saff uniformi fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does the cotton spreader do? Pietru: He spreads cotton out; look at how he makes an even layer on the table.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：铺棉者是做什么的？彼得：他把棉花铺开；你看，他正在桌上铺出均匀的一层。

messages.speaker: Lina (参观学生)
messages.zh: 铺棉者是做什么的？
messages.en: What does the cotton spreader do?

messages.speaker: Pietru (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jifrex il-qoton; ara kif jagħmel saff uniformi fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Jifrex il-qoton; ara kif jagħmel saff uniformi fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 他把棉花铺开；你看，他正在桌上铺出均匀的一层。
messages.en: He spreads cotton out; look at how he makes an even layer on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人、棉花、摊开这三个画面绑在一起：看到 niffiex，就想到把一团棉花铺成一层的人。

gloss_zh: 有软化作用的；能使棉花、面团等变软的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that makes a material, such as cotton or dough, softer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使材料变软的作用，可用于描述对棉花、面团等产生的软化效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jrattab materjal bħall-qoton jew l-għaġina.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a softening effect (on cotton, dough etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有软化作用的，能使棉花、面团等变软的

collocations.en: a product with a softening effect

formal.mt: Il-prodott għandu effett niffiexi fuq il-qoton u jagħmlu aktar artab.
formal.en: The product has a softening effect on cotton and makes it softer.
formal.zh: 该产品对棉花有软化作用，能使其更加柔软。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tuża dan il-prodott fuq il-qoton? Lara: Għax għandu effett niffiexi u jagħmlu aktar artab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you use this product on cotton? Lara: Because it has a softening effect and makes it softer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把这种产品用在棉花上？拉拉：因为它有软化作用，能让棉花更柔软。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tuża dan il-prodott fuq il-qoton?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tuża dan il-prodott fuq il-qoton?
messages.zh: 你为什么把这种产品用在棉花上？
messages.en: Why do you use this product on cotton?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu effett niffiexi u jagħmlu aktar artab.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu effett niffiexi u jagħmlu aktar artab.
messages.zh: 因为它有软化作用，能让棉花更柔软。
messages.en: Because it has a softening effect and makes it softer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niffiexi 放进“使棉花变软”的画面中记忆：重点是具有软化作用，而不只是材料本身柔软。

gloss_zh: 刺人的人；用挑衅言语刺激别人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pricks someone, or who provokes people with deliberately irritating remarks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用尖物刺人的人；也指通过刺激性或挑衅性言语惹恼别人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tniggeż lil xi ħadd, jew li tipprovoka lin-nies bi kliem li jdejjaqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用尖物刺人的人

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who goads people by saying provocative things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说挑衅性话语来刺激或惹恼别人的人

collocations.en: someone who pricks with a needle
someone who goads others with his words

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jidher bħala niggież li jfittex li jipprovoka lill-oħrajn bil-kummenti tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the character appears as someone who goads others, seeking to provoke them with his remarks.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物是个爱用言语刺激别人的人，总想通过自己的评论挑起别人的情绪。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dejjem jgħid affarijiet biex jirrabjani? Maja: Għax hu niggież; jieħu gost jipprovoka lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does he always say things to make me angry? Maja: Because he is a goader; he enjoys provoking people.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他为什么总说些让我生气的话？玛雅：因为他就是个爱挑衅的人，喜欢刺激别人。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem jgħid affarijiet biex jirrabjani?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem jgħid affarijiet biex jirrabjani?
messages.zh: 他为什么总说些让我生气的话？
messages.en: Why does he always say things to make me angry?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu niggież; jieħu gost jipprovoka lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu niggież; jieħu gost jipprovoka lin-nies.
messages.zh: 因为他就是个爱挑衅的人，喜欢刺激别人。
messages.en: Because he is a goader; he enjoys provoking people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张人物卡记 niggież：一张是拿针刺人的人，一张是说话刺人的人；两义都把注意力放在行为者身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stinging part of a bee; in a separate sense, the belladonna plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜜蜂用来螫刺的螫针；另一个独立义项指颠茄这种植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xewka li biha tniggeż in-naħla; f'tifsira oħra, il-pjanta magħrufa bħala belladonna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜜蜂的螫针
颠茄（植物）

formal.mt: Il-kelma niggieża għandha żewġ tifsiriet distinti: ix-xewka li biha tniggeż in-naħla u l-pjanta magħrufa bħala belladonna.
formal.en: The word niggieża has two distinct meanings: the part with which a bee stings and the plant known as belladonna.
formal.zh: niggieża 一词有两个不同的含义：蜜蜂用来螫刺的螫针，以及称为颠茄的植物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk niggieża tfisser ix-xewka tan-naħla? Sara: Le, f'dan it-test dwar il-pjanti tfisser belladonna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does niggieża mean a bee's sting here? Sara: No, in this text about plants it means belladonna.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 niggieża 是指蜜蜂的螫针吗？萨拉：不是，在这篇关于植物的文章里，它指颠茄。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的 niggieża 是指蜜蜂的螫针吗？
messages.en: Does niggieża mean a bee's sting here?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'dan it-test dwar il-pjanti tfisser belladonna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'dan it-test dwar il-pjanti tfisser belladonna.
messages.zh: 不是，在这篇关于植物的文章里，它指颠茄。
messages.en: No, in this text about plants it means belladonna.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 niggieża 做两张独立图卡：蜜蜂旁画螫针，植物旁写颠茄。靠语境选义，不把两个义项硬编成词源故事。

gloss_zh: 言语尖刻、爱刺激人的；带挑衅意味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to provoke or irritate people through offensive or deliberately challenging speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于用冒犯性、尖刻或挑衅性言语刺激别人的，也可描述具有这种性质的言语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jipprovoka jew idejjaq lin-nies bi kliem offensiv jew provokattiv.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to goad by speaking offensively or provocatively
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于用冒犯或挑衅性言语刺激别人的；言语尖刻、爱挑衅的

collocations.zh: 刺激别人、带挑衅意味的评论

formal.mt: Il-kelliem uża ton niggieżi li pprovoka lill-parteċipanti u għamel id-diskussjoni aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The speaker used a goading tone that provoked the participants and made the discussion more difficult.
formal.zh: 发言者使用了带挑衅意味的语气，激怒了与会者，使讨论更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ħadtha ħażin meta tkellimt? Maja: Għax użajt ton niggieżi; deher li ridt tipprovokani.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you take it badly when I spoke? Maja: Because you used a goading tone; it seemed as though you wanted to provoke me.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我说话时，你为什么不高兴了？玛雅：因为你的语气带着挑衅，听起来像是故意要激怒我。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我说话时，你为什么不高兴了？
messages.en: Why did you take it badly when I spoke?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax użajt ton niggieżi; deher li ridt tipprovokani.
messages.mt_standard: Għax użajt ton niggieżi; deher li ridt tipprovokani.
messages.zh: 因为你的语气带着挑衅，听起来像是故意要激怒我。
messages.en: Because you used a goading tone; it seemed as though you wanted to provoke me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niggieżi 配上“说话像在扎人”的课堂画面，记住它形容挑衅的语气或言语倾向；这是助记比喻，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A horse fly, an insect referred to by this name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马虻，一种称为虻的昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett magħruf bħala niggiżija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马虻；虻。

collocations.en: a horse fly near the horse
a horse fly on the window

formal.mt: L-istudent identifika n-niggiżija fl-istampa u kiteb isimha taħtha.
formal.en: The student identified the horse fly in the picture and wrote its name underneath.
formal.zh: 学生辨认出图中的马虻，并在下面写下它的名称。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm niggiżija fuq it-tieqa. Mark: Iva, qed naraha. Ejja nħalluha hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a horse fly on the window. Mark: Yes, I can see it. Let's leave it there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，窗上有一只马虻。Mark：嗯，我看见了。就让它待在那里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，窗上有一只马虻。
messages.en: Look, there's a horse fly on the window.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed naraha. Ejja nħalluha hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed naraha. Ejja nħalluha hemm.
messages.zh: 嗯，我看见了。就让它待在那里吧。
messages.en: Yes, I can see it. Let's leave it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niggiżija 配上一张马旁有虻的图，整词记作“马虻”，不要把它与表示刺痛的词混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moaning: the making of sounds that express pain or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呻吟；因疼痛或痛苦而发出低沉声音的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' ħsejjes baxxi li jesprimu wġigħ jew tbatija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟；表达疼痛或痛苦的哀吟。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar xena tad-dramm, in-nigħa tal-karattru turi t-tbatija tiegħu.
formal.en: In the final scene of the play, the character's moaning conveys his suffering.
formal.zh: 在戏剧的最后一幕中，角色的呻吟表现出他的痛苦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dik in-nigħa? Mark: Iva, ġejja mit-televixin. Qed jagħtu dramm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that moaning? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the television. A play is on.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到那阵呻吟了吗？Mark：听到了，是电视里传来的。正在播一出戏。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵呻吟了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that moaning?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġejja mit-televixin. Qed jagħtu dramm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġejja mit-televixin. Qed jagħtu dramm.
messages.zh: 听到了，是电视里传来的。正在播一出戏。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the television. A play is on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象戏剧角色痛苦地低声呻吟，把 nigħa 与“听得见的痛苦声音”绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of moaning or keening to express pain or deep grief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出呻吟或悲恸哀号的行为，表达疼痛或深切悲伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' ħsejjes ta' wġigħ jew ta' biki u niket kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟这一行为；因疼痛或痛苦而发声。
悲恸哀号这一行为；因深切悲伤而哭号。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-nigħi tal-mara jesprimi n-niket kbir tagħha.
formal.en: In the story, the woman's keening expresses her deep grief.
formal.zh: 故事中，女子的哀号表达了她深切的悲伤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm tant nigħi f'din ix-xena? Mark: Għax il-karattri qed jesprimu niket kbir.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there so much keening in this scene? Mark: Because the characters are expressing deep grief.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这一幕为什么有这么多哀号声？Mark：因为角色们正在表达深切的悲伤。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant nigħi f'din ix-xena?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant nigħi f'din ix-xena?
messages.zh: 这一幕为什么有这么多哀号声？
messages.en: Why is there so much keening in this scene?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-karattri qed jesprimu niket kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-karattri qed jesprimu niket kbir.
messages.zh: 因为角色们正在表达深切的悲伤。
messages.en: Because the characters are expressing deep grief.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nigħi 放进“疼痛时呻吟、悲恸时哀号”两个场景；本词条按名词记，指这些发声行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A prick, puncture, or sting, including the act or sensation of stinging.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针刺、刺出的孔口或蜇刺，也可指蜇刺的过程或刺痛感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa b'xi ħaġa bil-ponta, toqba żgħira li tħalli, jew uġigħ qasir bħal ta' tingiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻微的一刺；针刺。
刺孔；尖物刺穿形成的小孔。
蜇刺；蜇刺造成的刺痛。
一次蜇刺；一阵火辣辣的刺痛。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel ħass nigża f'subgħu meta mess il-labra.
formal.en: In the story, the boy felt a prick in his finger when he touched the needle.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩碰到针时，感到手指一阵刺痛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħassejt nigża f'subgħajja! Maja: Kienet il-labra? Lara: Iva, messejtha bi żball.
colloquial.en: Lara: I felt a prick in my finger! Maja: Was it the needle? Lara: Yes, I touched it by mistake.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我手指被扎了一下！Maja：是那根针吗？Lara：对，我不小心碰到了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我手指被扎了一下！
messages.en: I felt a prick in my finger!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是那根针吗？
messages.en: Was it the needle?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，我不小心碰到了。
messages.en: Yes, I touched it by mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“针尖一刺、小孔留下、皮肤刺痛”三幅连续画面记 nigża，分别对应动作、结果和感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called niobium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为铌的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku msejjaħ nijobju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铌，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudenta kitbet li l-kampjun kien ta' nijobju.
formal.en: In the report, the student wrote that the sample was niobium.
formal.zh: 学生在报告中写道，该样品是铌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu miktub fuq din it-tikketta? Mark: Nijobju. Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's written on this label? Mark: Niobium. It's the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个标签上写的是什么？Mark：铌。它是一种化学元素的名称。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个标签上写的是什么？
messages.en: What's written on this label?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nijobju. Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Nijobju. Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.zh: 铌。它是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: Niobium. It's the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作“nijobju—niobium—铌”三语标签，想象它贴在元素样品旁，用对应关系记住整词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A turn, corner, or bend where a route changes direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 路线改变方向的转弯处、拐角或弯道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawra, kantuniera jew liwja fejn triq tbiddel id-direzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个转弯；路线方向的转折。
一个拐角；转角处。
一个弯道；弯曲的路段。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi nikba fit-triq qabel il-pont.
formal.en: The map shows a bend in the road before the bridge.
formal.zh: 地图显示，桥前的道路上有一处弯道。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-ħanut? Maja: Wara n-nikba, fuq ix-xellug. Lara: Tajjeb, issa naf fejn immur.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's the shop? Maja: After the turn, on the left. Lara: Great, now I know where to go.
colloquial.zh: Lara：商店在哪里？Maja：过了转弯处，在左边。Lara：好，我现在知道怎么走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (问路者)
messages.zh: 商店在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the shop?

messages.speaker: Maja (路人)
messages.zh: 过了转弯处，在左边。
messages.en: After the turn, on the left.

messages.speaker: Lara (问路者)
messages.zh: 好，我现在知道怎么走了。
messages.en: Great, now I know where to go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在小地图上画一处转弯并标上 nikba，把“转弯、拐角、弯道”集中记在这个位置上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn, take a turn, or change the direction of movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 转弯、沿转弯处行进或改变移动方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idur jew ibiddel id-direzzjoni li jkun miexi fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转弯；转向。
拐弯；沿某个转弯处改变行进方向。
改变方向；改变行进方向。

formal.mt: Ix-xufier nikeb lejn il-lemin wara l-pont u kompla lejn ir-raħal.
formal.en: The driver turned right after the bridge and continued towards the village.
formal.zh: 司机过桥后向右转弯，继续朝村庄驶去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Mark? Lara: Nikeb lejn ix-xellug ħdejn il-ħanut. Maja: Mela se nistennih hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Mark go? Lara: He turned left by the shop. Maja: Then I'll wait for him here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 去哪儿了？Lara：他在商店旁向左转了。Maja：那我就在这里等他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark go?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在商店旁向左转了。
messages.en: He turned left by the shop.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我就在这里等他。
messages.en: Then I'll wait for him here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的箭头正在转向，用 nikeb 记动作；再用 nikba 标转弯的位置，练习区分动词与名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called nickel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为镍的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku msejjaħ nikil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镍，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: L-għalliem poġġa tikketta bl-isem nikil ħdejn il-kampjun.
formal.en: The teacher placed a label bearing the name nickel beside the sample.
formal.zh: 老师在样品旁放了一张写有“镍”的标签。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kampjun hu ta' nikil? Mark: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta. Lara: Se nikteb l-isem fin-noti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this sample nickel? Mark: Yes, that's what the label says. Lara: I'll write the name in my notes.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份样品是镍吗？Mark：对，标签上是这么写的。Lara：我把这个名称记到笔记里。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这份样品是镍吗？
messages.en: Is this sample nickel?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 对，标签上是这么写的。
messages.en: Yes, that's what the label says.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我把这个名称记到笔记里。
messages.en: I'll write the name in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nikil、nickel、镍写在同一张元素卡上，通过两种外语词形的相似处记住中文对应词“镍”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something turn or move in a different direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物转动，或使其改变原来的行进方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel xi ħaġa ddur jew tibdel id-direzzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使转动；使转向。
使改变方向。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, nikkeb il-karru lejn ix-xellug u żommu 'l bogħod mill-ħajt.
formal.en: During the exercise, make the cart turn left and keep it away from the wall.
formal.zh: 练习时，让手推车向左转，并使它与墙壁保持距离。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-karru sejjer dritt lejn il-ħajt! Lara: Nikkeb il-karru lejn ix-xellug; hemm aktar spazju.
colloquial.en: Mark: The cart is heading straight for the wall! Lara: Make the cart turn left; there is more space there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：手推车正直冲墙壁！拉拉：让车向左转，那边空间更大。

messages.speaker: Mark (搬运同伴)
messages.zh: 手推车正直冲墙壁！
messages.en: The cart is heading straight for the wall!

messages.speaker: Lara (搬运同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nikkeb il-karru lejn ix-xellug; hemm aktar spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Nikkeb il-karru lejn ix-xellug; hemm aktar spazju.
messages.zh: 让车向左转，那边空间更大。
messages.en: Make the cart turn left; there is more space there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你推着小车改变方向，把 nikkeb 与“让它转过去”的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who loiters, spending time lingering instead of moving on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逗留闲逛、迟迟不离开或不继续行动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titlajja' u ddum f'post minflok tkompli fi triqtha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲逛、逗留或磨蹭不走的人。

collocations.en: a person loitering in the street
a person lingering by the door

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-nikkier iqatta' sigħat ħdejn il-bieb tal-ħanut mingħajr ma jidħol jew jitlaq.
formal.en: In the story, the loiterer spends hours by the shop door without entering or leaving.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个闲逛者在商店门旁待了几个小时，既不进去，也不离开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed insejħulu nikkier? Pawlu: Għax ilu siegħa ħdejn il-bieb u għadu ma telaqx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we calling him a loiterer? Pawlu: Because he has been by the door for an hour and still has not left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么叫他闲逛者？保罗：因为他在门旁待了一个小时，到现在还没走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么叫他闲逛者？
messages.en: Why are we calling him a loiterer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilu siegħa ħdejn il-bieb u għadu ma telaqx.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilu siegħa ħdejn il-bieb u għadu ma telaqx.
messages.zh: 因为他在门旁待了一个小时，到现在还没走。
messages.en: Because he has been by the door for an hour and still has not left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nikkier 想成门边迟迟不走的人；先记住这是“人”的名词，再记闲逛逗留的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to be slow in acting or completing things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事或行动往往偏慢、容易磨蹭的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jdum biex jaġixxi jew ilesti xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 往往行动缓慢的；容易磨蹭的。

collocations.en: a worker who tends to be slow
a boy who tends to dawdle

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni huwa nikkieri: idum biex jibda kull biċċa xogħol u spiss jasal tard.
formal.en: The main character tends to dawdle: he takes a long time to start each task and often arrives late.
formal.zh: 主角做事磨蹭：每项工作都要拖很久才开始，而且经常迟到。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu għadu ma lestiex? Mark: Le, huwa nikkieri; dejjem idum biex jilbes.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Pawlu still not ready? Mark: No, he tends to dawdle; he always takes a long time to get dressed.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗还没准备好吗？马克：还没有，他做事磨蹭，穿衣服总要花很久。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还没准备好吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still not ready?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa nikkieri; dejjem idum biex jilbes.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa nikkieri; dejjem idum biex jilbes.
messages.zh: 还没有，他做事磨蹭，穿衣服总要花很久。
messages.en: No, he tends to dawdle; he always takes a long time to get dressed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他做事总慢半拍”记 nikkieri；它描述人的缓慢倾向，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 加点或标点的人；使人悲伤的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who adds dots or punctuation; in another sense, a person who causes sorrow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给文字或图形加点、加标点的人；另一义指使别人悲伤的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed tikek jew sinjali tal-punteġġjatura; f'tifsira oħra, persuna li ġġib in-niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加点或添加标点符号的人。
使人悲伤、给人带来忧伤的人。

collocations.en: a person who punctuates the text
a person who brings sorrow to the family

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju editorjali, in-nikkiet iżid il-punti u l-virgoli fit-test qabel il-qari finali.
formal.en: In this editing exercise, the person responsible for punctuation adds full stops and commas to the text before the final reading.
formal.zh: 在这项编辑练习中，负责加标点的人在最后通读之前给文本添加句号和逗号。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru jissejjaħ nikkiet? Lara: Għax bi kliemu jġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jitnikket.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the character called a bringer of sorrow? Lara: Because his words make other people sad.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么把这个角色叫作使人悲伤的人？拉拉：因为他的话会让别人难过。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 为什么把这个角色叫作使人悲伤的人？
messages.en: Why is the character called a bringer of sorrow?

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bi kliemu jġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jitnikket.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bi kliemu jġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jitnikket.
messages.zh: 因为他的话会让别人难过。
messages.en: Because his words make other people sad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nikkiet 配两幅人物图：一人给文章加标点，一人说话使人伤心；依语境分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 能加点或标点的；容易使人悲伤的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to add dots or punctuation; in another sense, inclined to cause sorrow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有加点或添加标点能力的；另一义指容易使人悲伤的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li kapaċi jqiegħed tikek jew sinjali tal-punteġġjatura; f'tifsira oħra, li għandu tendenza jġib in-niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够加点或添加标点符号的。
容易使人悲伤的；倾向于带来忧伤的。

collocations.en: a worker able to add dots or punctuation
collocations.zh: 能够加点或标点的工作人员

collocations.en: words that tend to cause sorrow

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-ħaddiem huwa deskritt bħala nikkieti għax kapaċi jżid is-sinjali tal-punteġġjatura meħtieġa.
formal.en: In this exercise, the worker is described as able to punctuate because he can add the necessary punctuation marks.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，这名工作人员被描述为能够添加标点，因为他能补上所需的标点符号。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-kliem nikkieti wisq għal messaġġ ta' għeluq snin. Maja: Naqbel; ejja niktbu xi ħaġa aktar ferrieħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: These words are too sorrowful for a birthday message. Maja: I agree; let's write something more cheerful.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些话太令人伤感了，不适合生日祝福。玛雅：我同意，我们写些更欢快的话吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kliem nikkieti wisq għal messaġġ ta' għeluq snin.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kliem nikkieti wisq għal messaġġ ta' għeluq snin.
messages.zh: 这些话太令人伤感了，不适合生日祝福。
messages.en: These words are too sorrowful for a birthday message.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel; ejja niktbu xi ħaġa aktar ferrieħa.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel; ejja niktbu xi ħaġa aktar ferrieħa.
messages.zh: 我同意，我们写些更欢快的话吧。
messages.en: I agree; let's write something more cheerful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nikkieti 放进两个描述框：“能加标点的”和“容易惹人伤心的”，记住它表达性质或能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name equivalent to the English name Nicholas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男子名字“尼古拉”，对应英语名字 Nicholas。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem maskili li jikkorrispondi għall-isem Ingliż Nicholas.

sense_translations.en_definition: a male given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek], equivalent to English Nicholas
sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自西西里语的男子名；其来源依次可追溯至拉丁语和古希腊语，对应英语名字 Nicholas。

formal.mt: Għażiż Nikola, nistednuk tattendi l-laqgħa li se ssir nhar il-Ġimgħa fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: Dear Nikola, we invite you to attend the meeting to be held on Friday at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 亲爱的尼古拉，我们邀请你参加星期五上午九点举行的会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jismu l-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek? Lara: Jismu Nikola; se niltaqgħu miegħu wara l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is your new friend's name? Lara: His name is Nikola; we are meeting him after lunch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的新朋友叫什么名字？拉拉：他叫尼古拉，我们午饭后会见他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的新朋友叫什么名字？
messages.en: What is your new friend's name?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Nikola; se niltaqgħu miegħu wara l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Nikola; se niltaqgħu miegħu wara l-ikel.
messages.zh: 他叫尼古拉，我们午饭后会见他。
messages.en: His name is Nikola; we are meeting him after lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友的姓名牌写着 Nikola，下方标注“尼古拉／Nicholas”；用介绍姓名的场景记住大写形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nicosia, the capital city of Cyprus and Northern Cyprus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尼科西亚，塞浦路斯及北塞浦路斯的首都。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-belt kapitali ta' Ċipru u ta' Ċipru ta' Fuq.

sense_translations.en_definition: Nicosia (the capital city of Cyprus and Northern Cyprus)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尼科西亚（塞浦路斯及北塞浦路斯的首都）。

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi mixja fiċ-ċentru ta' Nikosija u laqgħa mal-organizzaturi.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a walk in the centre of Nicosia and a meeting with the organisers.
formal.zh: 访问日程包括在尼科西亚市中心步行参观，以及与组织者会面。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn se noqogħdu waqt il-vjaġġ? Lara: F'Nikosija, qrib iċ-ċentru, biex inkunu nistgħu nimxu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where are we staying during the trip? Lara: In Nicosia, near the centre, so that we can get around on foot.
colloquial.zh: 马克：旅行期间我们住在哪里？拉拉：住在尼科西亚，靠近市中心，这样就能步行出行。

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.zh: 旅行期间我们住在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we staying during the trip?

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: F'Nikosija, qrib iċ-ċentru, biex inkunu nistgħu nimxu.
messages.mt_standard: F'Nikosija, qrib iċ-ċentru, biex inkunu nistgħu nimxu.
messages.zh: 住在尼科西亚，靠近市中心，这样就能步行出行。
messages.en: In Nicosia, near the centre, so that we can get around on foot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Nikosija 写在旅行地图的城市标记旁，与“尼科西亚／Nicosia”并排记忆，再练一句“住在尼科西亚”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small dot or point marked on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面上标出或出现的一个小点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka żgħira f'għamla ta' punt fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个点；小圆点。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tat-tpinġija, poġġi nikta sewda fiċ-ċentru tal-karta u pinġi ċirku madwarha.
formal.en: In the drawing exercise, place a black dot in the centre of the paper and draw a circle around it.
formal.zh: 在绘画练习中，在纸中央点一个黑点，再围绕它画一个圆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik in-nikta fuq il-karta? Mark: Hija marka tal-linka; il-pinna messet il-karta bi żball.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that dot on the paper? Mark: It is an ink mark; the pen touched the paper by mistake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：纸上的那个点是什么？马克：是墨水印，笔不小心碰到了纸。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 纸上的那个点是什么？
messages.en: What is that dot on the paper?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija marka tal-linka; il-pinna messet il-karta bi żball.
messages.mt_standard: Hija marka tal-linka; il-pinna messet il-karta bi żball.
messages.zh: 是墨水印，笔不小心碰到了纸。
messages.en: It is an ink mark; the pen touched the paper by mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在单词 nikta 旁边亲手点一个小黑点，把词形与纸上的“一个点”直接联系起来。

gloss_zh: 表示祝愿或诅咒的感叹词

teaching_sense.en_definition: An interjection expressing a wish for someone, either benevolent or hostile, according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达对某人祝愿的感叹词；具体是善意祝福还是恶意诅咒，要结合上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Interjezzjoni li tesprimi xewqa tajba jew ħażina għal xi ħadd, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感叹词，用于表达下列愿望或情绪：
表达希望别人遭遇不幸的恶意愿望；诅咒。
表达希望别人顺利、幸福的善意祝愿。

collocations.en: 'nirra' as an expression of good wishes
collocations.zh: 用 nirra 表达善意祝愿

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, l-interjezzjoni 'nirra' għandha tiġi interpretata skont il-kuntest, għax tista' tesprimi xewqa tajba jew ħażina.
formal.en: In analysing the dialogue, the interjection 'nirra' should be interpreted according to context, because it can express either a good or an ill wish.
formal.zh: 分析这段对话时，应结合上下文理解感叹词 nirra，因为它既可能表达祝福，也可能表达恶意愿望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'nirra' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Hawn tesprimi xewqa tajba, iżda f'kuntest ieħor tista' tkun saħta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'nirra' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: Here it expresses a good wish, but in another context it can be a curse.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 nirra 是什么意思？保罗：这里表示祝福，但换个语境也可能是诅咒。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 nirra 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'nirra' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tesprimi xewqa tajba, iżda f'kuntest ieħor tista' tkun saħta.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tesprimi xewqa tajba, iżda f'kuntest ieħor tista' tkun saħta.
messages.zh: 这里表示祝福，但换个语境也可能是诅咒。
messages.en: Here it expresses a good wish, but in another context it can be a curse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nirra 想成一张双面祝愿卡：一面祝福，一面诅咒；读到时先看语境，再判断善意恶意。

gloss_zh: 毒蛇的种类；毒蛇之辈（《圣经》中的斥责语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brood of vipers; a biblical expression used as a severe rebuke when addressing a group of people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 字面指一窝毒蛇或毒蛇的后代；在《圣经》中用作对一群人的严厉斥责，可译为“毒蛇之辈”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nisel ta' sriep velenużi; espressjoni biblika użata biex grupp ta' nies jiġi mċanfar bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: brood of vipers; generation of vipers; address used by Jesus for the Pharisees and Sadducees (three times in Matthew), and by John the Baptist for the unregerate Jews (Luke 3:7)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一窝毒蛇；毒蛇的后代；“毒蛇之辈”。耶稣用来斥责法利赛人和撒都该人的称呼，在《马太福音》中出现三次；施洗约翰也用它称呼不悔改的犹太人（《路加福音》3:7）。

collocations.mt: jindirizza lil xi ħadd bħala 'nisel lifgħat'
collocations.en: to address someone as a 'brood of vipers'

formal.mt: Fil-kummentarju dwar it-test bibliku, l-espressjoni 'nisel lifgħat' hija spjegata bħala ċanfira qawwija indirizzata lil grupp ta' nies.
formal.en: In the commentary on the biblical text, the expression 'brood of vipers' is explained as a severe rebuke addressed to a group of people.
formal.zh: 在这篇《圣经》文本注释中，“毒蛇之辈”被解释为针对一群人的严厉斥责。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Nisel lifgħat' hawn qed jitkellem fuq sriep? Mark: Le, hawn hija ċanfira lin-nies; litteralment tfisser nisel ta' lifgħat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is 'brood of vipers' talking about snakes here? Mark: No, here it is a rebuke directed at people; literally it means the offspring of vipers.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的“毒蛇之辈”是在说蛇吗？马克：不是，这里是在斥责人；字面意思是毒蛇的后代。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Nisel lifgħat' hawn qed jitkellem fuq sriep?
messages.mt_standard: 'Nisel lifgħat' hawn qed jitkellem fuq sriep?
messages.zh: 这里的“毒蛇之辈”是在说蛇吗？
messages.en: Is 'brood of vipers' talking about snakes here?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn hija ċanfira lin-nies; litteralment tfisser nisel ta' lifgħat.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn hija ċanfira lin-nies; litteralment tfisser nisel ta' lifgħat.
messages.zh: 不是，这里是在斥责人；字面意思是毒蛇的后代。
messages.en: No, here it is a rebuke directed at people; literally it means the offspring of vipers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“一窝毒蛇”的字面画面，再记《圣经》中对人的严厉斥责；遇到人物对话时可理解为“毒蛇之辈”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tendency or state of forgetting information, tasks, or other things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易忘记信息、事情或应做事项的倾向，也指遗忘的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tendenza jew l-istat li wieħed jinsa informazzjoni, affarijiet jew dak li għandu jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健忘；容易忘事的倾向或遗忘的状态。

formal.mt: Biex inaqqas l-iżbalji minħabba n-nisi, l-uffiċċju juża lista ta' kontroll għal kull applikazzjoni.
formal.en: To reduce errors caused by forgetfulness, the office uses a checklist for every application.
formal.zh: 为了减少因遗忘造成的错误，办公室为每份申请使用一张核对清单。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Erġajt insejt il-ħobż! Ġużi: Minħabba n-nisi, jien nikteb lista qabel immur nixtri.
colloquial.en: Marija: I forgot the bread again! Ġużi: Because I tend to forget things, I write a list before going shopping.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我又忘记买面包了！朱齐：我容易忘事，所以出门买东西前会写张清单。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 我又忘记买面包了！
messages.en: I forgot the bread again!

messages.speaker: Ġużi (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba n-nisi, jien nikteb lista qabel immur nixtri.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba n-nisi, jien nikteb lista qabel immur nixtri.
messages.zh: 我容易忘事，所以出门买东西前会写张清单。
messages.en: Because I tend to forget things, I write a list before going shopping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nisi 贴在购物清单旁，联想“怕健忘就列清单”；记住它是表示健忘状态的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To interlace threads to make fabric, or to devise a secret plan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使纱线相互交织而织成布料；也可指在暗中策划或密谋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel drapp billi daħħal il-ħjut f'xulxin, jew ħejja pjan bil-moħbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编织；使纱线交错结合，织成布料。
密谋；在暗中策划某项行动。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan nisseġ drapp b'ħjut ta' kuluri differenti biex juri lill-istudenti kif jinħoloq disinn.
formal.en: The artisan wove fabric with threads of different colours to show the students how a pattern is created.
formal.zh: 工匠用不同颜色的纱线织布，向学生展示图案是如何形成的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-villain fl-aħħar tal-film? Mark: Nisseġ komplott kontra ħuh, imma ħuh skopra kollox.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the villain do at the end of the film? Mark: He hatched a plot against his brother, but his brother discovered everything.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电影结尾那个反派干了什么？马克：他密谋对付自己的兄弟，但他的兄弟发现了一切。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影结尾那个反派干了什么？
messages.en: What did the villain do at the end of the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nisseġ komplott kontra ħuh, imma ħuh skopra kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Nisseġ komplott kontra ħuh, imma ħuh skopra kollox.
messages.zh: 他密谋对付自己的兄弟，但他的兄弟发现了一切。
messages.en: He hatched a plot against his brother, but his brother discovered everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把线织成布，再想象人物把步骤编成阴谋；用“编织动作”联记两个动词义，不当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who begets offspring, especially a biological father.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使后代出生的人，尤指生育子女的父亲或生身父亲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tnissel l-ulied, b'mod speċjali l-missier bijoloġiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生育者；使后代出生的人，尤指生身父亲。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-protagonist ifittex lil missieru bijoloġiku, in-nissiel tiegħu, wara ħafna snin ta' firda.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist searches for his biological father, his begetter, after many years of separation.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公在分别多年后寻找自己的生身父亲，也就是生育他的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu n-nissiel tat-tifel f'din l-istorja? Mark: Huwa r-raġel li jidher fl-ewwel kapitlu, missieru bijoloġiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the boy's begetter in this story? Mark: It is the man who appears in the first chapter, his biological father.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里，男孩的生身父亲是谁？马克：就是第一章出现的那个男人，他的亲生父亲。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu n-nissiel tat-tifel f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu n-nissiel tat-tifel f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里，男孩的生身父亲是谁？
messages.en: Who is the boy's begetter in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa r-raġel li jidher fl-ewwel kapitlu, missieru bijoloġiku.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa r-raġel li jidher fl-ewwel kapitlu, missieru bijoloġiku.
messages.zh: 就是第一章出现的那个男人，他的亲生父亲。
messages.en: It is the man who appears in the first chapter, his biological father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在家谱图中，从孩子向上画箭头指向生身父亲，并在旁标 nissiel；用“使后代出生的人”记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who weaves cloth by interlacing threads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过使纱线相互交织来制作布料的人；织工或编织者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel id-drapp billi ddaħħal il-ħjut f'xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 织工；从事织布或编织的人。

formal.mt: Il-mużew stieden nissieġ tas-sengħa biex juri lill-viżitaturi kif isir id-drapp fuq newl.
formal.en: The museum invited a skilled weaver to show visitors how cloth is made on a loom.
formal.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位技艺熟练的织工，向参观者展示如何使用织机织布。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel dan id-drapp? Toni: Nissieġ mir-raħal tagħna; tista' tarah jaħdem fil-ħanut tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made this fabric? Toni: A weaver from our village; you can watch him work in his shop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布是谁织的？托尼：我们村的一位织工；你可以去他的店里看他工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布是谁织的？
messages.en: Who made this fabric?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nissieġ mir-raħal tagħna; tista' tarah jaħdem fil-ħanut tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Nissieġ mir-raħal tagħna; tista' tarah jaħdem fil-ħanut tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我们村的一位织工；你可以去他的店里看他工作。
messages.en: A weaver from our village; you can watch him work in his shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nissieġ 配上一位坐在织机前的工人；与动词 nisseġ 对照记，特别看清 nissieġ 中的 ie，提醒自己这是人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to weaving, including its work, equipment, or techniques.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与编织或织布有关的，可用于描述相关工作、设备或技术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam max-xogħol, mat-tagħmir jew mat-tekniki tal-insiġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与编织、织布有关的；纺织方面的。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi t-tagħmir nissieġi espost fil-mużew u jispjega l-użu ta' kull għodda.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the weaving equipment displayed in the museum and explains the use of each tool.
