formal.zh: 这份目录介绍了博物馆展出的织布设备，并说明每件工具的用途。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm dawn l-għodod kollha fuq il-mejda? Pawlu: Għandi bżonnhom għax-xogħol nissieġi li qed nagħmel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are all these tools on the table? Pawlu: I need them for the weaving work I am doing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：桌子上为什么放着这么多工具？保罗：我正在做编织，需要用到它们。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn l-għodod kollha fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn l-għodod kollha fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌子上为什么放着这么多工具？
messages.en: Why are all these tools on the table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (编织爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonnhom għax-xogħol nissieġi li qed nagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonnhom għax-xogħol nissieġi li qed nagħmel.
messages.zh: 我正在做编织，需要用到它们。
messages.en: I need them for the weaving work I am doing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nissieġi 写在织布设备的标签上，记成“与编织有关的”；它修饰事物，对照 nissieġ“织工”一起辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The weft in woven cloth; the texture of a material; or the connected sequence of events forming a story's plot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指织物中横向穿过经纱的纬纱，也可指材料的纹理或质地；用于故事时指相互交织的情节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħjut li jgħaddu minn naħa għal oħra bejn il-ħjut tat-tul fi drapp; it-tessut ta' materjal; jew il-ġrajja u r-rabta bejn l-avvenimenti ta' storja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纬纱；织布时横向穿过经纱的纱线。
纹理；质地；材料表面或内部组织呈现的结构与触感。
情节；故事中各个事件的安排及其相互联系。

formal.mt: In-nisġa tar-rumanz torbot flimkien tliet stejjer, filwaqt li kull kapitlu jiżvela rabta ġdida bejn il-personaġġi.
formal.en: The novel's plot links three stories together, while each chapter reveals a new connection between the characters.
formal.zh: 这部小说的情节把三个故事联系起来，每一章都揭示人物之间的一层新关系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Togħġbok din il-purtiera? Toni: Iva, in-nisġa tad-drapp hija fina, u l-kulur jaqbel mal-kamra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you like this curtain? Toni: Yes, the fabric has a fine texture, and the colour matches the room.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你喜欢这幅窗帘吗？托尼：喜欢，布料的纹理很细腻，颜色也和房间很搭。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这幅窗帘吗？
messages.en: Do you like this curtain?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, in-nisġa tad-drapp hija fina, u l-kulur jaqbel mal-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, in-nisġa tad-drapp hija fina, u l-kulur jaqbel mal-kamra.
messages.zh: 喜欢，布料的纹理很细腻，颜色也和房间很搭。
messages.en: Yes, the fabric has a fine texture, and the colour matches the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“交织”串起三个义项：纬纱交织成布，布面呈现纹理，故事事件交织成情节；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The slow escape of liquid, or a substance produced and released by secretion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体缓慢渗出的过程，也可指分泌产生并排出的物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ bil-mod ta' likwidu, jew sustanza prodotta u rilaxxata permezz tas-sekrezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 液体缓慢渗出的过程。
分泌；分泌产生的物质。

formal.mt: Matul l-eżami tal-kampjun, ġiet osservata nixja ta' likwidu mill-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: During the examination of the sample, liquid was observed oozing from its surface.
formal.zh: 检查样本时，观察到其表面有液体渗出。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm qatra taħt il-kontenitur? Pawlu: Hemm nixja żgħira minn taħt; poġġi ċarruta hemm.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is there a drop under the container? Pawlu: A little liquid is oozing from underneath; put a cloth there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：容器下面为什么有一滴液体？保罗：底下有一点液体渗出；在那里垫块布吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 容器下面为什么有一滴液体？
messages.en: Why is there a drop under the container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm nixja żgħira minn taħt; poġġi ċarruta hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm nixja żgħira minn taħt; poġġi ċarruta hemm.
messages.zh: 底下有一点液体渗出；在那里垫块布吧。
messages.en: A little liquid is oozing from underneath; put a cloth there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象容器底部慢慢冒出液滴，把 nixja 与“渗出”联系起来；再用“身体排出的分泌物”记住另一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove moisture from something, including drying it thoroughly or preserving food by drying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 除去某物中的水分，使其变干或充分脱水，也可指通过干燥来保存食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tneħħi l-umdità minn xi ħaġa, tnixxifha għalkollox, jew tippreserva l-ikel bit-tnixxif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物弄干、擦干或晾干。
使某物充分干燥或脱水。
通过晒干、风干等干燥方式保存。

formal.mt: Wara li taħsel il-kontenitur, nixxef il-wiċċ tiegħu b'ċarruta nadifa qabel terġa' tużah.
formal.en: After washing the container, dry its surface with a clean cloth before using it again.
formal.zh: 清洗容器后，用干净的布擦干其表面，再次使用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nista' npoġġi dawn it-tazzi fl-armarju? Ġużeppi: Iva, imma l-ewwel nixxef kull tazza b'din iċ-ċarruta.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can I put these glasses in the cupboard? Ġużeppi: Yes, but first dry each glass with this cloth.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我可以把这些玻璃杯放进柜子里吗？朱塞佩：可以，不过先用这块布把每个杯子擦干。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 我可以把这些玻璃杯放进柜子里吗？
messages.en: Can I put these glasses in the cupboard?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel nixxef kull tazza b'din iċ-ċarruta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel nixxef kull tazza b'din iċ-ċarruta.
messages.zh: 可以，不过先用这块布把每个杯子擦干。
messages.en: Yes, but first dry each glass with this cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“擦干手、晾干物品、晒干食物”三个动作记住 nixxef：共同点都是主动除去水分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to let liquid ooze out or leak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有让液体缓慢渗出或泄漏的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jħalli l-likwidu joħroġ bil-mod jew inixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易让液体缓慢渗出的。
容易漏液或发生渗漏的。

formal.mt: Il-kontenitur nixxej tneħħa mill-użu wara li nstab likwidu taħtu waqt l-ispezzjoni.
formal.en: The leaky container was taken out of use after liquid was found underneath it during the inspection.
formal.zh: 检查时发现容器下方有液体，随后这个容易渗漏的容器被停用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nimla dan il-kontenitur bl-ilma? Mark: Aħjar tuża l-ieħor; dan nixxej u jħalli l-mejda mxarrba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I fill this container with water? Mark: Better use the other one; this one leaks and leaves the table wet.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我可以用这个容器装水吗？马克：最好用另一个；这个容易漏水，会把桌子弄湿。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我可以用这个容器装水吗？
messages.en: Can I fill this container with water?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar tuża l-ieħor; dan nixxej u jħalli l-mejda mxarrba.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar tuża l-ieħor; dan nixxej u jħalli l-mejda mxarrba.
messages.zh: 最好用另一个；这个容易漏水，会把桌子弄湿。
messages.en: Better use the other one; this one leaks and leaves the table wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给经常漏水的容器贴上 nixxej 标签，记住这是描述“容易渗漏”的性质的形容词。

gloss_zh: 干燥器；起干燥作用的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thing or device that makes something dry by removing moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过除去水分使其他东西变干的物品或设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew apparat li jneħħi l-umdità minn xi ħaġa u jagħmilha niexfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能使其他东西变干的物品或装置；干燥器。

formal.mt: Il-lista tat-tagħmir tinkludi nixxief tax-xagħar għal kull kamra tal-banju.
formal.en: The equipment list includes a hair dryer for each bathroom.
formal.zh: 设备清单列明，每间浴室配备一台吹风机。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu n-nixxief tax-xagħar? David: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera; tista' tużah.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the hair dryer? David: In the drawer next to the mirror; you can use it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：吹风机在哪里？戴维：在镜子旁边的抽屉里；你可以用。

messages.speaker: Sara (住客)
messages.zh: 吹风机在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the hair dryer?

messages.speaker: David (房东)
messages.zh: 在镜子旁边的抽屉里；你可以用。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the mirror; you can use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象吹风机和干衣机并排放着，把 nixxief 记成“负责把东西弄干的工具或物品”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of liquid slowly coming out through a surface or opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体通过表面或开口缓慢流出的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih likwidu joħroġ bil-mod minn wiċċ jew minn fetħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 液体缓慢渗出的过程或现象。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi nixxija kontinwa ta' ilma mill-qiegħ tal-kampjun matul il-prova.
formal.en: The report describes water continuously oozing from the bottom of the sample during the test.
formal.zh: 报告描述了试验期间水从样本底部持续渗出的现象。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qiegħed iżżomm platt taħt l-isponża? Toni: Hemm nixxija ta' ilma minnha; qed nistenna sakemm tieqaf.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you holding a plate under the sponge? Toni: Water is oozing from it; I am waiting until it stops.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在海绵下面托着一个盘子？托尼：有水从里面慢慢渗出来；我在等它停止。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qiegħed iżżomm platt taħt l-isponża?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qiegħed iżżomm platt taħt l-isponża?
messages.zh: 你为什么在海绵下面托着一个盘子？

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm nixxija ta' ilma minnha; qed nistenna sakemm tieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm nixxija ta' ilma minnha; qed nistenna sakemm tieqaf.
messages.zh: 有水从里面慢慢渗出来；我在等它停止。
messages.en: Water is oozing from it; I am waiting until it stops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象湿海绵里的水缓缓渗出，用这段持续发生的画面记住名词 nixxija 所表示的“渗出过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The grass Hordeum murinum var. leporinum, also called bunixxief or bunixxuf; nixxufijiet refers to quantities of this grass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Hordeum murinum var. leporinum 的鼠大麦，也称 bunixxief 或 bunixxuf；nixxufijiet 表示若干份或若干批这种草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta Hordeum murinum var. leporinum, magħrufa wkoll bħala bunixxief jew bunixxuf; nixxufijiet jirreferi għal kwantitajiet ta' din il-pjanta.

sense_translations.en_definition: (botany) also bunixxief/bunixxuf, mouse barely (Hordeum murinum var. leporinum); nixxufijiet, quantities of nixxuf
sense_translations.zh_definition: 【植物学】鼠大麦（Hordeum murinum var. leporinum），也称 bunixxief 或 bunixxuf；nixxufijiet 指若干份或若干批这种草。

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu tal-pjanti, in-nixxuf huwa mniżżel bl-isem xjentifiku Hordeum murinum var. leporinum.
formal.en: In the plant catalogue, mouse barley is listed under the scientific name Hordeum murinum var. leporinum.
formal.zh: 在植物目录中，鼠大麦以学名 Hordeum murinum var. leporinum 列出。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Xi nكتب fuq it-tikketta ta' dan il-kampjun? Noel: Ikteb 'nixxuf' u żid l-isem xjentifiku li hemm fil-lista.
colloquial.en: Emma: What should I write on this sample's label? Noel: Write 'nixxuf' and add the scientific name from the list.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：这个样本的标签上该写什么？诺埃尔：写上“nixxuf”，再加上清单里的学名。

messages.speaker: Emma (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi nikteb fuq it-tikketta ta' dan il-kampjun?
messages.mt_standard: Xi nikteb fuq it-tikketta ta' dan il-kampjun?
messages.zh: 这个样本的标签上该写什么？
messages.en: What should I write on this sample's label?

messages.speaker: Noel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb 'nixxuf' u żid l-isem xjentifiku li hemm fil-lista.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb 'nixxuf' u żid l-isem xjentifiku li hemm fil-lista.
messages.zh: 写上“nixxuf”，再加上清单里的学名。
messages.en: Write 'nixxuf' and add the scientific name from the list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张写着 nixxuf 和“鼠大麦”的植物标签，并把 bunixxief、bunixxuf 作为同一植物的别名一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sponge; in slang, a knife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指海绵；在俚语中也可指刀，具体含义需要根据语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sponża; fis-slang tista' tfisser ukoll sikkina, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 【俚语】刀。
海绵。

collocations.en: a knife that cuts well, using the slang sense
collocations.zh: 锋利好用的刀，其中 nixxufa 使用俚语义

formal.mt: Għat-tindif tal-mejda, uża nixxufa mxarrba u mbagħad imsaħ il-wiċċ b'ċarruta nadifa.
formal.en: To clean the table, use a wet sponge and then wipe the surface with a clean cloth.
formal.zh: 清洁桌子时，先用湿海绵，再用干净的布擦拭表面。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek nixxufa biex innaddaf il-mejda? Ben: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn is-sink; għadha nadifa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you have a sponge so I can clean the table? Ben: Yes, there is one next to the sink; it is still clean.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你有海绵吗？我想擦一下桌子。本：有，水槽旁边有一块；还是干净的。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 你有海绵吗？我想擦一下桌子。
messages.en: Do you have a sponge so I can clean the table?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn is-sink; għadha nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn is-sink; għadha nadifa.
messages.zh: 有，水槽旁边有一块；还是干净的。
messages.en: Yes, there is one next to the sink; it is still clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nixxufa 的记忆卡分成两格：清洁画面里放海绵，俚语画面里放刀；靠上下文选择对应义项。

gloss_zh: 容易使物干燥的；有脱水作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to remove moisture from things or having a drying effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易除去其他物体中的水分，或具有使其干燥、脱水的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jneħħi l-umdità mill-affarijiet jew ikollu effett ta' tnixxif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易使其他东西变干的。
具有干燥或脱水作用的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effett nixxufi tal-arja fuq il-kampjun u jirreġistra t-telf tal-umdità tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the drying effect of the air on the sample and records its loss of moisture.
formal.zh: 报告描述了空气对样本的干燥作用，并记录了样本水分的流失。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Għaliex qed tgħatti t-tafal? Karl: Dan ir-riħ nixxufi; it-tafal jitlef l-umdità malajr jekk inħallih mikxuf.
colloquial.en: Julia: Why are you covering the clay? Karl: This wind has a drying effect; the clay loses moisture quickly if I leave it uncovered.
colloquial.zh: 尤莉娅：你为什么把黏土盖起来？卡尔：这风很容易把东西吹干；如果我不盖住，黏土很快就会失去水分。

messages.speaker: Julia (陶艺学员)
messages.zh: 你为什么把黏土盖起来？
messages.en: Why are you covering the clay?

messages.speaker: Karl (陶艺教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-riħ nixxufi; it-tafal jitlef l-umdità malajr jekk inħallih mikxuf.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-riħ nixxufi; it-tafal jitlef l-umdità malajr jekk inħallih mikxuf.
messages.zh: 这风很容易把东西吹干；如果我不盖住，黏土很快就会失去水分。
messages.en: This wind has a drying effect; the clay loses moisture quickly if I leave it uncovered.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象风把湿黏土越吹越干，用 nixxufi 描述这股风“使别的东西变干”的作用。

gloss_zh: 长出狗牙根草；生出百慕大草

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce Bermuda grass, as when this grass begins to grow on a piece of land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指土地长出狗牙根草，即百慕大草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal art li tipproduċi l-ħaxix tal-Bermuda, jiġifieri li jibda jikber fiha dan il-ħaxix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出狗牙根草；生出百慕大草

collocations.zh: 这片土地长出了狗牙根草

collocations.en: produced Bermuda grass after the rain

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, it-terren niġġem u l-ħaxix tal-Bermuda beda jkopri parti mill-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: After the rain, the land produced Bermuda grass, which began to cover part of its surface.
formal.zh: 雨后，这片土地长出了狗牙根草，草开始覆盖部分地表。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara minn din il-biċċa art wara x-xita? Pawlu: Niġġem it-terren; ara l-ħaxix tal-Bermuda li qed jikber hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened to this patch of land after the rain? Pawlu: The land produced Bermuda grass; look at it growing here.
colloquial.zh: 马克：下雨后，这块地怎么了？保罗：地里长出了狗牙根草；你看，这里正在长呢。

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara minn din il-biċċa art wara x-xita?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara minn din il-biċċa art wara x-xita?
messages.zh: 下雨后，这块地怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to this patch of land after the rain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Niġġem it-terren; ara l-ħaxix tal-Bermuda li qed jikber hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Niġġem it-terren; ara l-ħaxix tal-Bermuda li qed jikber hawn.
messages.zh: 地里长出了狗牙根草；你看，这里正在长呢。
messages.en: The land produced Bermuda grass; look at it growing here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动态画面记 niġġem：先看一块土地，再看狗牙根草冒出来；这个词表示“长出这种草”的动作。

gloss_zh: 长有狗牙根草的；生长百慕大草的（土壤）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing soil or ground in which Bermuda grass grows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述长有狗牙根草，即百慕大草的土壤或地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih jikber il-ħaxix tal-Bermuda, meta wieħed ikun qed jiddeskrivi l-art jew it-terren.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长有狗牙根草的（土壤）；生长百慕大草的（土地）

collocations.en: the Bermuda-grass-growing surface of the field
collocations.zh: 田地里长有狗牙根草的地表

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, it-terren ġie deskritt bħala niġġiemi minħabba l-ħaxix tal-Bermuda li jikber fih.
formal.en: In the report, the ground was described as supporting Bermuda grass because this grass grows there.
formal.zh: 报告将这片土地描述为长有狗牙根草的土地，因为那里生长着这种草。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser terren niġġiemi? Pawlu: Ifisser terren fejn jikber il-ħaxix tal-Bermuda, bħal dan ta' quddiemna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does ground described as niġġiemi mean? Pawlu: It means ground where Bermuda grass grows, like this patch in front of us.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：土地被说成 niġġiemi 是什么意思？保罗：意思是长有狗牙根草的土地，就像我们面前这一块。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺学徒)
messages.zh: 土地被说成 niġġiemi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ground described as niġġiemi mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser terren fejn jikber il-ħaxix tal-Bermuda, bħal dan ta' quddiemna.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser terren fejn jikber il-ħaxix tal-Bermuda, bħal dan ta' quddiemna.
messages.zh: 意思是长有狗牙根草的土地，就像我们面前这一块。
messages.en: It means ground where Bermuda grass grows, like this patch in front of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niġġiemi 当作土地照片上的形容标签：照片里有狗牙根草，这片土地便可用它来描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes something dirty, polluted, or contaminated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体、环境等受到污染或沾染的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħammeġ jew tikkontamina xi ħaġa jew l-ambjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成污染或沾染的人；污染者

collocations.en: a person who pollutes the environment

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lir-raġel li jitfa' l-iskart fix-xmara bħala niġġies tal-ambjent.
formal.en: The author describes the man who dumps waste into the river as a polluter of the environment.
formal.zh: 作者把向河里倾倒垃圾的男子描述为环境污染者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt lil dak ir-raġel jitfa' l-iskart fl-ilma? Mark: Iva, dak niġġies; qed iħammeġ l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that man throwing waste into the water? Mark: Yes, he is a polluter; he is making the water dirty.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到那个男子往水里扔垃圾了吗？马克：看到了，他是个污染者，正在把水弄脏。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil dak ir-raġel jitfa' l-iskart fl-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil dak ir-raġel jitfa' l-iskart fl-ilma?
messages.zh: 你看到那个男子往水里扔垃圾了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that man throwing waste into the water?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak niġġies; qed iħammeġ l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak niġġies; qed iħammeġ l-ilma.
messages.zh: 看到了，他是个污染者，正在把水弄脏。
messages.en: Yes, he is a polluter; he is making the water dirty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 niġġies 时把镜头对准“造成污染的人”：河水变脏是结果，往河里倒垃圾的人才是这个名词所指。

gloss_zh: 造成沾染的；有污染作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing contamination or pollution by making something impure, dirty, or harmful to its surroundings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会使物体受到沾染，或使周围环境受到污染的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża kontaminazzjoni jew tniġġis billi jħammeġ xi ħaġa jew l-ambjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成沾染的；使物体混入不洁或有害物质的
造成污染的；使环境变脏或受到损害的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effett niġġiesi tal-iskart fuq l-ilma u l-effett tal-gass fuq l-arja.
formal.en: The report describes the contaminating effect of the waste on water and the effect of the gas on the air.
formal.zh: 报告描述了垃圾对水的污染作用，以及气体对空气的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma rridux inħallu dan il-likwidu jidħol fil-bir? Mark: Għax għandu effett niġġiesi fuq l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why must we keep this liquid out of the well? Mark: Because it has a contaminating effect on the water.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么必须防止这种液体流进井里？马克：因为它会污染井水。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma rridux inħallu dan il-likwidu jidħol fil-bir?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma rridux inħallu dan il-likwidu jidħol fil-bir?
messages.zh: 为什么必须防止这种液体流进井里？
messages.en: Why must we keep this liquid out of the well?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu effett niġġiesi fuq l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu effett niġġiesi fuq l-ilma.
messages.zh: 因为它会污染井水。
messages.en: Because it has a contaminating effect on the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niġġiesi 写在“会把水弄脏的液体”旁边：它描述造成污染的性质，可分别联系物体沾染和环境污染。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deep emotional pain or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈的内心痛苦、悲伤或煎熬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbatija qawwija fil-qalb jew fil-moħħ minħabba niket jew dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深切的痛苦；悲苦；精神上的煎熬。

collocations.zh: 因失去而产生的深切痛苦

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur esprima n-niżi li ħass wara t-telf ta' ħabibu.
formal.en: In his letter, the author expressed the anguish he felt after losing his friend.
formal.zh: 作者在信中表达了失去朋友后内心的悲苦。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ħallietni daqshekk imdejqa dik l-ittra? Pawlu: Għax fiha hemm ħafna niżi; jidher kemm qed ibati min kitibha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did that letter leave me so sad? Pawlu: Because there is so much anguish in it; you can tell how much the writer is suffering.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：为什么那封信让我这么难过？保罗：因为里面满是悲苦，能看出写信的人有多痛苦。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallietni daqshekk imdejqa dik l-ittra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallietni daqshekk imdejqa dik l-ittra?
messages.zh: 为什么那封信让我这么难过？
messages.en: Why did that letter leave me so sad?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fiha hemm ħafna niżi; jidher kemm qed ibati min kitibha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fiha hemm ħafna niżi; jidher kemm qed ibati min kitibha.
messages.zh: 因为里面满是悲苦，能看出写信的人有多痛苦。
messages.en: Because there is so much anguish in it; you can tell how much the writer is suffering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niżi 放进“一封写满失去与悲伤的信”的画面，记住它表示深切的内心痛苦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moving or directed downward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述正在下降，或运动方向朝下的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun miexi jew sejjer 'l isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下降的；正在往下走或向下移动的。

formal.mt: Il-vleġġa fid-dijagramma tindika moviment niżli tal-ilma minn tank għal ieħor.
formal.en: The arrow in the diagram indicates a downward movement of water from one tank to another.
formal.zh: 图中的箭头表示水从一个水箱向另一个水箱向下流动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-vleġġa turi li l-ilma jitla'? Mark: Le, turi fluss niżli; l-ilma sejjer 'l isfel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this arrow show the water going up? Mark: No, it shows a downward flow; the water is going down.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个箭头表示水往上流吗？马克：不是，它表示向下流动，水是往下走的。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-vleġġa turi li l-ilma jitla'?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-vleġġa turi li l-ilma jitla'?
messages.zh: 这个箭头表示水往上流吗？
messages.en: Does this arrow show the water going up?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, turi fluss niżli; l-ilma sejjer 'l isfel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, turi fluss niżli; l-ilma sejjer 'l isfel.
messages.zh: 不是，它表示向下流动，水是往下走的。
messages.en: No, it shows a downward flow; the water is going down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 niżli 就想象一支朝下的箭头，重点记住“方向向下、正在下降”这个状态。

gloss_zh: 把东西搬下或带下来的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who brings someone or something down from a higher position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或物从较高位置带下来、搬下来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa minn post ogħla għal post aktar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把人或物带下来、搬下来的人。

collocations.en: a person who brings boxes down
a person who brings luggage down

formal.mt: In-niżżiel tal-kaxxi kellu jġibhom mill-maħżen ta' fuq sal-bitħa.
formal.en: The person bringing the boxes down had to move them from the upstairs storeroom to the courtyard.
formal.zh: 负责把箱子搬下来的人需要将它们从楼上的储藏室搬到院子里。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jkun in-niżżiel tal-bagalji llum? David: Jien; int stenna ħdejn il-karozza u nġibhomlok minn fuq.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is bringing the luggage down today? David: I am; wait by the car and I'll bring it down to you from upstairs.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天谁负责把行李搬下来？戴维：我来，你在车旁等着，我从楼上把行李搬给你。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun in-niżżiel tal-bagalji llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun in-niżżiel tal-bagalji llum?
messages.zh: 今天谁负责把行李搬下来？
messages.en: Who is bringing the luggage down today?

messages.speaker: David (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; int stenna ħdejn il-karozza u nġibhomlok minn fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; int stenna ħdejn il-karozza u nġibhomlok minn fuq.
messages.zh: 我来，你在车旁等着，我从楼上把行李搬给你。
messages.en: I am; wait by the car and I'll bring it down to you from upstairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象楼梯上抱着箱子往下走的人，用“谁把东西搬下来”这个问题记住 niżżiel 指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that encourages or causes prices to be lowered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 推动或促使价格下调的事物、条件或因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tħeġġeġ jew twassal biex jitnaqqsu l-prezzijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that motivates the bringing down of prices
sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使价格下调的事物；推动降价的因素。

collocations.en: to serve as an incentive to lower prices

formal.mt: Il-kompetizzjoni bejn il-ħwienet tista' sservi ta' niżżiela tal-prezzijiet, għax kull ħanut jipprova jiġbed aktar klijenti.
formal.en: Competition between shops can act as an incentive to lower prices, as each shop tries to attract more customers.
formal.zh: 商店之间的竞争可以成为促使降价的因素，因为每家店都试图吸引更多顾客。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-ħanut tagħna raħħas il-ħobż? Toni: Il-ħanut il-ġdid qed ibigħu irħas; dik il-kompetizzjoni serviet ta' niżżiela tal-prezzijiet.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did our shop lower the price of bread? Toni: The new shop is selling it more cheaply; that competition acted as an incentive to lower prices.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们这家店为什么把面包降价了？托尼：新开的店卖得更便宜，这种竞争促使了价格下调。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 我们这家店为什么把面包降价了？
messages.en: Why did our shop lower the price of bread?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut il-ġdid qed ibigħu irħas; dik il-kompetizzjoni serviet ta' niżżiela tal-prezzijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut il-ġdid qed ibigħu irħas; dik il-kompetizzjoni serviet ta' niżżiela tal-prezzijiet.
messages.zh: 新开的店卖得更便宜，这种竞争促使了价格下调。
messages.en: The new shop is selling it more cheaply; that competition acted as an incentive to lower prices.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niżżiela 想成价格牌旁边的“降价推手”：例如竞争让店主愿意把标价往下调。

gloss_zh: 倾向于使之降低的；有降低作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to make something lower or bring it down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某事物降低、下降或被拉低的倾向或作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jniżżel jew ibaxxi xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于使某事物降低的；具有拉低作用的。

collocations.en: a factor tending to bring something down

formal.mt: Żieda fil-provvista tista' jkollha effett niżżieli fuq il-prezzijiet meta d-domanda tibqa' l-istess.
formal.en: An increase in supply can have a lowering effect on prices when demand remains unchanged.
formal.zh: 在需求不变时，供应增加可能对价格产生拉低作用。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Jekk jaslu aktar kaxxi tat-tadam, il-prezz jista' jonqos? Ġorġ: Iva, provvista akbar jista' jkollha effett niżżieli fuq il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Marta: If more boxes of tomatoes arrive, could the price fall? Ġorġ: Yes, a larger supply could have a lowering effect on the price.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：如果运来更多箱番茄，价格会下降吗？乔治：会，供应增加可能对价格产生拉低作用。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk jaslu aktar kaxxi tat-tadam, il-prezz jista' jonqos?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk jaslu aktar kaxxi tat-tadam, il-prezz jista' jonqos?
messages.zh: 如果运来更多箱番茄，价格会下降吗？
messages.en: If more boxes of tomatoes arrive, could the price fall?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, provvista akbar jista' jkollha effett niżżieli fuq il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, provvista akbar jista' jkollha effett niżżieli fuq il-prezz.
messages.zh: 会，供应增加可能对价格产生拉低作用。
messages.en: Yes, a larger supply could have a lowering effect on the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“有一股力量把数值往下拉”的画面记 niżżieli，重点是具有降低作用，而不只是自己下降。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For an utterance to be spoken with a groan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一句话、呼喊或其他话语伴着呻吟声被说出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad bi tnehida ta' wġigħ jew ta' tbatija.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be said with a groan
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被伴着呻吟声说出；被呻吟着讲出来。

collocations.en: the complaint was uttered with a groan
collocations.zh: 抱怨的话被呻吟着说出

collocations.en: the plea for help was uttered with a groan
collocations.zh: 求救的话伴着呻吟声被说出

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-appell għall-għajnuna nkarab mir-raġel ferut qabel waslu sħabu.
formal.en: In the story, the injured man uttered his plea for help with a groan before his companions arrived.
formal.zh: 在故事中，受伤的男子在同伴赶到之前，伴着呻吟声发出了求救。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex bilkemm fhimtu meta talab l-għajnuna? Ben: Għax l-appell tiegħu nkarab; tant kellu wġigħ li bilkemm seta' jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why could I barely understand him when he asked for help? Ben: Because his plea came out with a groan; he was in so much pain that he could barely speak.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他求助时，我为什么几乎听不懂他的话？本：因为他的求助是伴着呻吟声说出来的，他痛得几乎说不出话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bilkemm fhimtu meta talab l-għajnuna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bilkemm fhimtu meta talab l-għajnuna?
messages.zh: 他求助时，我为什么几乎听不懂他的话？
messages.en: Why could I barely understand him when he asked for help?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-appell tiegħu nkarab; tant kellu wġigħ li bilkemm seta' jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-appell tiegħu nkarab; tant kellu wġigħ li bilkemm seta' jitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为他的求助是伴着呻吟声说出来的，他痛得几乎说不出话。
messages.en: Because his plea came out with a groan; he was in so much pain that he could barely speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句“帮帮我”夹在呻吟声里被说出来：nkarab 描写的是话语被说出的方式。

gloss_zh: 迷恋某人；强烈渴求某物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infatuated with someone or strongly crave something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人产生强烈迷恋，或对某物产生迫切的欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa ġibda qawwija lejn xi ħadd jew xewqa kbira għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have an infatuation for sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 迷恋某人；对某人产生强烈的痴迷或爱慕。
强烈渴求某物；非常想要某物。

collocations.en: to develop a strong craving for sweets

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, Pawlu nkaram għal Lara għalkemm kien għadu bilkemm jafha.
formal.en: In the novel, Pawlu became infatuated with Lara even though he barely knew her yet.
formal.zh: 在小说中，保罗虽然还几乎不了解拉拉，却已经迷恋上了她。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Sam mar jixtri l-ħelu daqshekk tard? Luka: Ra ritratt ta' kejk u nkaram għall-ħelu; qal li ma setax jistenna sa għada.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did Sam go out to buy sweets so late? Luka: He saw a picture of a cake and developed a craving for sweets; he said he couldn't wait until tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：萨姆为什么这么晚还出去买甜食？卢卡：他看到一张蛋糕照片，突然特别想吃甜食，说等不到明天了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Sam mar jixtri l-ħelu daqshekk tard?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Sam mar jixtri l-ħelu daqshekk tard?
messages.zh: 萨姆为什么这么晚还出去买甜食？
messages.en: Why did Sam go out to buy sweets so late?

messages.speaker: Luka (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ra ritratt ta' kejk u nkaram għall-ħelu; qal li ma setax jistenna sa għada.
messages.mt_standard: Ra ritratt ta' kejk u nkaram għall-ħelu; qal li ma setax jistenna sa għada.
messages.zh: 他看到一张蛋糕照片，突然特别想吃甜食，说等不到明天了。
messages.en: He saw a picture of a cake and developed a craving for sweets; he said he couldn't wait until tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nkaram 记成“心被强烈吸引”：对象是人时是迷恋，对象是东西时是迫切想要。

gloss_zh: 烦恼；难过；疲惫不堪；忧虑

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become annoyed or upset, to be worn out, or to worry restlessly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因事情而烦恼或难过，因劳累而疲惫不堪，或反复忧心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddejjaq jew jitnikket, ikun għajjien ħafna, jew joqgħod jinkwieta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到烦躁；生气；被惹得不耐烦。
感到难过、苦恼或心绪不宁。
疲惫不堪；累得精疲力竭。
忧心忡忡；反复为某事烦恼。

collocations.en: to get annoyed because of the noise
to become distressed or worn down by worry
collocations.zh: 因忧虑而苦恼或心力交瘁

formal.mt: Wara ġimgħa ta' xogħol bla mistrieħ, ir-raġel nkedd tant li kellu jieqaf u jistrieħ.
formal.en: After a week of work without rest, the man was so worn out that he had to stop and rest.
formal.zh: 连续工作一周没有休息后，那名男子累得精疲力竭，不得不停下来休息。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex Mark qiegħed daqshekk kwiet illum? Pawlu: Nkedd għax ħaseb li kien weġġgħek bi kliemu; ilu jinkwieta minn dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why is Mark so quiet today? Pawlu: He got upset because he thought his words had hurt you; he's been worrying since this morning.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：马克今天为什么这么安静？保罗：他以为自己说的话伤害了你，所以很难过，从早上起就一直为这件事忧心。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark qiegħed daqshekk kwiet illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark qiegħed daqshekk kwiet illum?
messages.zh: 马克今天为什么这么安静？
messages.en: Why is Mark so quiet today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nkedd għax ħaseb li kien weġġgħek bi kliemu; ilu jinkwieta minn dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Nkedd għax ħaseb li kien weġġgħek bi kliemu; ilu jinkwieta minn dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 他以为自己说的话伤害了你，所以很难过，从早上起就一直为这件事忧心。
messages.en: He got upset because he thought his words had hurt you; he's been worrying since this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅画面记 nkedd：噪声让人烦、误会让人难过、劳累让人疲惫、挂念让人忧心；结合原因判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have the edge of a piece of fabric folded over and sewn down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指布料的边缘被折起并缝好，形成整齐的缝边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu t-tarf tad-drapp mitwi u meħjut biex jagħmel keffa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被折边缝好；布料边缘被缝成一道边。

collocations.en: the edge of the curtain was hemmed
collocations.zh: 窗帘的边缘被折边缝好了

formal.mt: It-tarf tal-purtiera nkeff bl-idejn biex id-drapp ma jinħallx.
formal.en: The edge of the curtain was hemmed by hand to prevent the fabric from fraying.
formal.zh: 窗帘边缘经过手工折边缝制，以防布料脱线。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tarf tal-purtiera nkeff diġà? Rita: Iva, issa lest u tista' ddendilha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the edge of the curtain been hemmed already? Rita: Yes, it's finished now, and you can hang it up.
colloquial.zh: Marija：窗帘的边已经缝好了吗？Rita：是的，已经做好了，你可以把它挂起来了。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 窗帘的边已经缝好了吗？
messages.en: Has the edge of the curtain been hemmed already?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa lest u tista' ddendilha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa lest u tista' ddendilha.
messages.zh: 是的，已经做好了，你可以把它挂起来了。
messages.en: Yes, it's finished now, and you can hang it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nkeff 配上窗帘边被折起、再沿边缝好的画面，重点记住它表示布边已经受到缝制处理。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Teasing or provoking someone through words or actions, sometimes with spiteful intent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语或行动戏弄、惹恼或嘲弄别人，有时带有恶意或怄气的动机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiċċajta b'xi ħadd jew iddejqu bi kliem jew b'azzjonijiet, kultant b'intenzjoni ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗弄或戏弄别人的行为。
惹恼某人、使某人烦躁的行为。
以嘲笑或挑衅的言语奚落别人。
想让别人难受或不痛快的恶意、怄气心理。

formal.mt: Kliem ta' nkejja jista' jweġġa' lil ħaddieħor u jħassar ir-relazzjonijiet bejn l-istudenti.
formal.en: Taunting words can hurt others and damage relationships between students.
formal.zh: 嘲弄的话可能伤害别人，并破坏同学之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak li għedt kien ċajta jew nkejja? Pawlu: Kienet ċajta, imma fhimt li weġġgħek. Ma nerġax ngħid hekk.
colloquial.en: Marija: Was what you said a joke or a dig at me? Pawlu: It was a joke, but I understand that it hurt you. I won't say that again.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你刚才那话是开玩笑，还是故意挖苦我？Pawlu：本来是开玩笑，但我明白那伤到你了。我不会再那么说了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li għedt kien ċajta jew nkejja?
messages.mt_standard: Dak li għedt kien ċajta jew nkejja?
messages.zh: 你刚才那话是开玩笑，还是故意挖苦我？
messages.en: Was what you said a joke or a dig at me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet ċajta, imma fhimt li weġġgħek. Ma nerġax ngħid hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet ċajta, imma fhimt li weġġgħek. Ma nerġax ngħid hekk.
messages.zh: 本来是开玩笑，但我明白那伤到你了。我不会再那么说了。
messages.en: It was a joke, but I understand that it hurt you. I won't say that again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一条情绪刻度记 nkejja：从逗弄、惹烦，到嘲弄、恶意；阅读时根据语境判断行为的轻重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made available for use in exchange for rent, including under a lease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指房屋、场地或物品以支付租金为条件被人租用，也可指按租约被租赁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħata għall-użu bi ħlas ta' kera, ukoll permezz ta' kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被租用；以支付租金为条件供人使用。
按租约被租赁；依约定条件供承租人使用。

collocations.en: the garage was rented for a year
the apartment was rented to a family
collocations.zh: 公寓被出租给了一个家庭

formal.mt: Il-garaxx nkera għal sena skont il-kundizzjonijiet imniżżla fil-kuntratt.
formal.en: The garage was leased for a year under the conditions set out in the contract.
formal.zh: 该车库依照合同所列条件出租，租期为一年。

colloquial.mt: Mark: L-appartament ta' fuq għadu vojt? Anna: Le, nkera lil familja l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the upstairs apartment still empty? Anna: No, it was rented to a family last week.
colloquial.zh: Mark：楼上的公寓还空着吗？Anna：没有了，上周已经租给一个家庭了。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 楼上的公寓还空着吗？
messages.en: Is the upstairs apartment still empty?

messages.speaker: Anna (房东)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nkera lil familja l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nkera lil familja l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 没有了，上周已经租给一个家庭了。
messages.en: No, it was rented to a family last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nkera 放进房屋交钥匙的场景：房子被租用，租客取得使用权；再搭配 għal sena 记住租期表达。

gloss_zh: 被覆盖；被包上软垫面料

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a surface covered with a material or layer, including upholstery on furniture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指表面被某种材料或一层东西覆盖，也可指家具被包上软垫面料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu wiċċu mgħotti b'materjal jew b'saff, ukoll b'drapp tal-tapizzerija fuq għamara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被覆盖；表面被一层东西遮盖。
家具被包上软垫面料；被进行软包处理。

collocations.en: the ground was covered with snow
the chair was upholstered in new fabric
collocations.zh: 椅子被包上了新的软垫面料

formal.mt: Waqt ir-restawr, is-siġġu nkesa b'drapp ġdid li jaqbel mal-kulur oriġinali tiegħu.
formal.en: During restoration, the chair was upholstered in new fabric matching its original colour.
formal.zh: 修复过程中，这把椅子换上了与原有颜色相配的新软包面料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan is-siġġu huwa ġdid? Ġużeppi: Le, huwa l-qadim; nkesa b'drapp ġdid u issa jidher differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this chair new? Ġużeppi: No, it's the old one; it was upholstered in new fabric and looks different now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这把椅子是新的吗？Ġużeppi：不是，就是原来那把；换了新的软包面料，现在看起来不一样了。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这把椅子是新的吗？
messages.en: Is this chair new?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (家具修复师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa l-qadim; nkesa b'drapp ġdid u issa jidher differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa l-qadim; nkesa b'drapp ġdid u issa jidher differenti.
messages.zh: 不是，就是原来那把；换了新的软包面料，现在看起来不一样了。
messages.en: No, it's the old one; it was upholstered in new fabric and looks different now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 nkesa 时想象给表面加上一层：地面盖雪是覆盖，椅子包布是软包；共同画面都是外面多了一层。

gloss_zh: 被加热至高温；烧至白热；被烧灼处理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be heated to a very high temperature, to become white-hot, or to undergo cauterisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被加热到很高的温度、烧至白热状态，或指组织被施以烧灼处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jissaħħan għal temperatura għolja ħafna, isir abjad bis-sħana, jew jiġi kawterizzat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be heated up to a high temperature
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加热到很高的温度。
烧至白热；因极高温度而发出白光。
被施以烧灼处理；组织被灼烧处理。

collocations.en: the iron was heated to a very high temperature in the furnace
collocations.zh: 铁在炉中被加热至高温

formal.mt: Il-ħadid nkewa fil-forn sakemm sar abjad bis-sħana.
formal.en: The iron was heated in the furnace until it became white-hot.
formal.zh: 铁在炉中持续受热，直到达到白热状态。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex mhux qed tmiss dak il-ħadid? Toni: Għax nkewa fil-forn u għadu jaħraq ħafna. Qed nistenna li jiksaħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why aren't you touching that iron? Toni: Because it was heated to a very high temperature in the furnace and is still extremely hot. I'm waiting for it to cool.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么不碰那块铁？Toni：因为它刚在炉里烧到很高的温度，现在还烫得很。我在等它冷却。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex mhux qed tmiss dak il-ħadid?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex mhux qed tmiss dak il-ħadid?
messages.zh: 你为什么不碰那块铁？
messages.en: Why aren't you touching that iron?

messages.speaker: Toni (铁匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nkewa fil-forn u għadu jaħraq ħafna. Qed nistenna li jiksaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nkewa fil-forn u għadu jaħraq ħafna. Qed nistenna li jiksaħ.
messages.zh: 因为它刚在炉里烧到很高的温度，现在还烫得很。我在等它冷却。
messages.en: Because it was heated to a very high temperature in the furnace and is still extremely hot. I'm waiting for it to cool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nkewa 配三张高温卡片：炉中受热、金属白热、组织烧灼；按宾语和场景选择对应中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of changing direction by taking a turn, for example around a corner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过转弯来改变行进方向的动作，例如拐过一个街角。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tbiddel id-direzzjoni billi ddur, pereżempju madwar kantuniera.

sense_translations.en_definition: taking a turn (e.g. round a corner)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 转弯这一动作，例如拐过街角。

collocations.en: taking a turn around a corner

formal.mt: Waqt in-nkib madwar il-kantuniera, is-sewwieq naqqas il-veloċità.
formal.en: While taking the turn around the corner, the driver reduced speed.
formal.zh: 驾驶员在拐过街角时降低了车速。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta waqgħet il-borża minn fuq is-sedil? Mark: Waqt in-nkib madwar dik il-kantuniera; kienet qrib wisq tat-tarf.
colloquial.en: Nina: When did the bag fall off the seat? Mark: While we were taking the turn around that corner; it was too close to the edge.
colloquial.zh: Nina：包是什么时候从座位上掉下来的？Mark：就在拐过那个街角时；它放得太靠边了。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta waqgħet il-borża minn fuq is-sedil?
messages.mt_standard: Meta waqgħet il-borża minn fuq is-sedil?
messages.zh: 包是什么时候从座位上掉下来的？
messages.en: When did the bag fall off the seat?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqt in-nkib madwar dik il-kantuniera; kienet qrib wisq tat-tarf.
messages.mt_standard: Waqt in-nkib madwar dik il-kantuniera; kienet qrib wisq tat-tarf.
messages.zh: 就在拐过那个街角时；它放得太靠边了。
messages.en: While we were taking the turn around that corner; it was too close to the edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nkib 画成路线上的弯箭头，并用 waqt in-nkib 记住“在转弯时”；它指转弯动作，不是街角本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be erased or worn away so that a mark or inscription is no longer visible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指字迹、标记或刻痕被抹去或逐渐磨灭，以致不再清晰可见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitħassar jew jintlibes sakemm marka jew kitba ma tibqax tidher.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抹去或磨灭；原有的字迹、标记等不再可见。

formal.mt: L-isem imnaqqax fuq il-ġebla nkifes maż-żmien u ma baqax jinqara.
formal.en: The name carved into the stone was effaced over time and could no longer be read.
formal.zh: 石头上刻着的名字随着时间推移逐渐磨灭，已经无法辨读。

colloquial.mt: Elena: L-isem fuq din il-lapida għadu jidher? David: Le, nkifes maż-żmien; issa ma nistgħux naqrawh.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is the name on this memorial stone still visible? David: No, it has been effaced over time; we can't read it now.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这块纪念石上的名字还看得见吗？David：看不见了，年深日久已经磨灭，现在读不出来了。

messages.speaker: Elena (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: L-isem fuq din il-lapida għadu jidher?
messages.mt_standard: L-isem fuq din il-lapida għadu jidher?
messages.zh: 这块纪念石上的名字还看得见吗？
messages.en: Is the name on this memorial stone still visible?

messages.speaker: David (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nkifes maż-żmien; issa ma nistgħux naqrawh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nkifes maż-żmien; issa ma nistgħux naqrawh.
messages.zh: 看不见了，年深日久已经磨灭，现在读不出来了。
messages.en: No, it has been effaced over time; we can't read it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用石刻名字从清楚到模糊、最后消失的连续画面记 nkifes，抓住“原有痕迹被磨掉”的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel strong enthusiasm or passion for something or someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事或某个人怀有强烈的热情，表现出十分投入或热衷的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu ħeġġa jew passjoni kbira għal xi ħaġa jew għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be passionate about sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 热衷于某事；对某人充满热情。

collocations.zh: 对音乐产生了强烈的热情

formal.mt: Matul is-snin tal-iskola, Daniel nkileb għall-qari u beda jżur il-librerija kull ġimgħa.
formal.en: During his school years, Daniel became passionate about reading and began visiting the library every week.
formal.zh: 上学期间，丹尼尔迷上了阅读，开始每周去图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Daniel dejjem għandu ktieb f'idu? Lara: Nkileb għall-qari; anki fuq il-karozza tal-linja jaqra!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Daniel always have a book in his hand? Lara: He's become passionate about reading; he even reads on the bus!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：丹尼尔怎么总是手里拿着一本书？拉拉：他迷上阅读了，连坐公交车都在看书！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Daniel dejjem għandu ktieb f'idu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Daniel dejjem għandu ktieb f'idu?
messages.zh: 丹尼尔怎么总是手里拿着一本书？
messages.en: Why does Daniel always have a book in his hand?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nkileb għall-qari; anki fuq il-karozza tal-linja jaqra!
messages.mt_standard: Nkileb għall-qari; anki fuq il-karozza tal-linja jaqra!
messages.zh: 他迷上阅读了，连坐公交车都在看书！
messages.en: He's become passionate about reading; he even reads on the bus!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人坐公交车也舍不得放下书，把 nkileb 和“热衷得停不下来”这一画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be swept clean, or to be defeated in a contest or struggle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指地方被清扫，也可指在比赛或较量中被击败。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitnaddaf bil-ġummar, jew jingħeleb f'logħba jew f'taqbida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被清扫；被扫过。
被击败；在比赛或较量中落败。

formal.mt: Il-kuritur nkines qabel ma nfetħu l-bibien tal-iskola.
formal.en: The corridor was swept before the school doors were opened.
formal.zh: 学校开门之前，走廊已经清扫过了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif mar it-tim tagħna lbieraħ? Sara: It-tim tagħna nkines fil-finali, imma l-plejers ma qatgħux qalbhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did our team do yesterday? Sara: Our team was defeated in the final, but the players didn't lose heart.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们队昨天表现怎么样？萨拉：我们队在决赛中输了，不过队员们没有灰心。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.zh: 我们队昨天表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did our team do yesterday?

messages.speaker: Sara (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tim tagħna nkines fil-finali, imma l-plejers ma qatgħux qalbhom.
messages.mt_standard: It-tim tagħna nkines fil-finali, imma l-plejers ma qatgħux qalbhom.
messages.zh: 我们队在决赛中输了，不过队员们没有灰心。
messages.en: Our team was defeated in the final, but the players didn't lose heart.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项画成两格：第一格走廊被扫干净，第二格球队被对手击败；用画面记住同词的两种语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be obtained or acquired, or to be achieved as a goal or result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物被取得或获得，也指目标、成果等经过努力得以实现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi akkwistat jew miksub, jew jintlaħaq bħala għan jew riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被取得；被获得。
得以实现；被达成。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat mixtieq nkiseb permezz ta' ħidma regolari u kooperazzjoni bejn il-membri kollha.
formal.en: The desired result was achieved through regular work and cooperation among all members.
formal.zh: 通过持续有规律的工作和全体成员的合作，预期成果得以实现。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu nibdew ix-xogħol għada? Mark: Iva, il-permess nkiseb dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we start the work tomorrow? Mark: Yes, permission was obtained this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们明天可以开工吗？马克：可以，今天早上已经获得许可了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们明天可以开工吗？
messages.en: Can we start the work tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目负责人)
messages.zh: 可以，今天早上已经获得许可了。
messages.en: Yes, permission was obtained this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“许可拿到了，目标达成了”串起 nkiseb：前半句记获得，后半句记实现，注意句子突出的是所得之物或成果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become uncovered or exposed, or for hidden information to be revealed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原本被遮住的东西显露出来，或原本不为人知的信息被揭露、披露。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidher wara li jitneħħa dak li kien jgħattih, jew isir magħruf wara li kien moħbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被揭开；被遮盖的部分显露出来。
被披露；隐秘的信息被公开或透露。

formal.mt: Meta tneħħa l-ġibs, nkixef ħajt tal-ġebel li kien ilu mgħotti għal ħafna snin.
formal.en: When the plaster was removed, a stone wall that had been covered for many years was uncovered.
formal.zh: 灰泥被去除后，一面被覆盖多年的石墙显露出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadha sorpriża l-festa ta' għada? Pawlu: Le, is-sigriet nkixef meta Anna rat l-istediniet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is tomorrow's party still a surprise? Pawlu: No, the secret came out when Anna saw the invitations.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天的派对还是个惊喜吗？保罗：不是了，安娜看到邀请函时，秘密就露馅了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天的派对还是个惊喜吗？
messages.en: Is tomorrow's party still a surprise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (派对组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, is-sigriet nkixef meta Anna rat l-istediniet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, is-sigriet nkixef meta Anna rat l-istediniet.
messages.zh: 不是了，安娜看到邀请函时，秘密就露馅了。
messages.en: No, the secret came out when Anna saw the invitations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象揭开一块遮布：遮住墙就是墙显露，遮住消息就是秘密曝光；用“隐藏变可见”记住 nkixef 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sexual act involving people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人与人之间发生的性行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att sesswali bejn persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性行为；具有性性质的行为。

formal.mt: It-test jispjega li n-nkiħ huwa att sesswali u jenfasizza l-importanza tal-kunsens bejn l-adulti involuti.
formal.en: The text explains that nkiħ means a sexual act and emphasises the importance of consent between the adults involved.
formal.zh: 该文说明 nkiħ 指性行为，并强调参与其中的成年人之间相互同意的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'nkiħ' f'dan it-test? Lara: Tfisser att sesswali. Hawnhekk it-test qed jitkellem dwar il-kunsens bejn adulti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'nkiħ' mean in this text? Lara: It means a sexual act. Here the text is discussing consent between adults.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的 nkiħ 是什么意思？Lara：意思是性行为。这里文章谈的是成年人之间的同意。

messages.speaker: Maja (成年学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 nkiħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'nkiħ' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser att sesswali. Hawnhekk it-test qed jitkellem dwar il-kunsens bejn adulti.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser att sesswali. Hawnhekk it-test qed jitkellem dwar il-kunsens bejn adulti.
messages.zh: 意思是性行为。这里文章谈的是成年人之间的同意。
messages.en: It means a sexual act. Here the text is discussing consent between adults.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nkiħ 与解释短语 att sesswali 配成词义卡，记住它指性行为；抄写时留意末尾是带横线的 ħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small ant; the diminutive form of the noun nemla.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只小蚂蚁；这是名词 nemla 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nemla żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva tan-nom nemla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小蚂蚁，名词 nemla 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small ant on the table
a small ant carrying bread crumbs
collocations.zh: 一只搬运面包屑的小蚂蚁

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, it-tfal raw nmejla ġġorr frak tal-ħobż lejn il-bejta.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the children saw a small ant carrying bread crumbs towards the nest.
formal.zh: 在花园里观察时，孩子们看见一只小蚂蚁正把面包屑搬向蚁巢。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara, hemm nmejla ħdejn il-platt! Omm: Iva, ejja nneħħu l-frak minn fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look, there's a little ant beside the plate! Mum: Yes, let's clear the crumbs off the table.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：看，盘子旁边有只小蚂蚁！妈妈：是啊，我们把桌上的碎屑清理掉吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 看，盘子旁边有只小蚂蚁！
messages.en: Look, there's a little ant beside the plate!

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nneħħu l-frak minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nneħħu l-frak minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们把桌上的碎屑清理掉吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's clear the crumbs off the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemla“蚂蚁”和 nmejla“小蚂蚁”并排记，再想象一只小蚂蚁搬着面包屑，帮助记住指小含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express romantic affection or interest towards someone through courting or flirting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过求爱、谈情说爱或调情，向某人表达浪漫情意或爱慕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri mħabba jew interess romantiku lejn xi ħadd permezz ta' kliem jew imġiba ta' namur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈情说爱；求爱；调情。

collocations.en: courted or flirted with a young woman
collocations.zh: 向一位年轻女子求爱或与她调情

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żagħżugħ nnamra ma' tfajla li kien iltaqa' magħha waqt festa fir-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, the young man courted a young woman whom he had met at a village celebration.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个年轻男子向一位在村庄庆典上结识的年轻女子求爱。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt lil Mark u lil Lara fil-festa? Maja: Iva, Mark nnamra magħha l-lejla kollha!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see Mark and Lara at the party? Maja: Yes, Mark flirted with her all evening!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到派对上的马克和拉拉了吗？玛雅：看到了，马克整晚都在跟她调情！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil Mark u lil Lara fil-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil Mark u lil Lara fil-festa?
messages.zh: 你看到派对上的马克和拉拉了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Mark and Lara at the party?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Mark nnamra magħha l-lejla kollha!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Mark nnamra magħha l-lejla kollha!
messages.zh: 看到了，马克整晚都在跟她调情！
messages.en: Yes, Mark flirted with her all evening!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象派对上两个人含笑交谈、互表好感，把 nnamra 记成“谈情说爱、调情”的动作，并连同 ma'“与”一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grant a foreign person citizenship of a country through a formal process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过正式程序授予外国人本国国籍，使其成为本国公民。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil persuna barranija ċ-ċittadinanza ta' pajjiż permezz ta' proċess formali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使外国人入籍；授予其本国国籍。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-istat nnaturalizza lill-applikant wara li tlesta l-proċess formali.
formal.en: In this example, the state granted the applicant citizenship after the formal process was completed.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，正式程序完成后，国家授予了申请人国籍。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'jiġifieri li l-istat nnaturalizza lil xi ħadd? Għalliem: Jiġifieri li tah iċ-ċittadinanza permezz ta' proċess formali.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does it mean that the state naturalized someone? Teacher: It means that it granted that person citizenship through a formal process.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：说国家使某人入籍，是什么意思？老师：意思是国家通过正式程序授予了那个人国籍。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri li l-istat nnaturalizza lil xi ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri li l-istat nnaturalizza lil xi ħadd?
messages.zh: 说国家使某人入籍，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the state naturalized someone?

messages.speaker: Għalliem (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li tah iċ-ċittadinanza permezz ta' proċess formali.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li tah iċ-ċittadinanza permezz ta' proċess formali.
messages.zh: 意思是国家通过正式程序授予了那个人国籍。
messages.en: It means that it granted that person citizenship through a formal process.

cognitive_memory_aid: 认识英语 naturalize 的学习者可用词形相似来辅助记忆，再配上“国家授予申请人国籍”的画面，记清动作的施受关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To discuss terms with another party in order to reach an agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为达成协议，与另一方讨论价格、条件或其他安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddiskuti prezzijiet, kundizzjonijiet jew arranġamenti ma' parti oħra sabiex jintlaħaq ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈判；就价格、条件或协议进行协商。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant tal-kumpanija nnegozja mal-fornitur dwar il-prezz u d-data tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The company representative negotiated with the supplier about the price and delivery date.
formal.zh: 公司代表与供应商就价格和交货日期进行了谈判。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif irnexxielu Mark iħallas inqas? Pawlu: Nnegozja prezz aħjar mal-bejjiegħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark manage to pay less? Pawlu: He negotiated a better price with the seller.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克怎么做到少付一点钱的？保罗：他跟卖家谈到了更好的价格。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么做到少付一点钱的？
messages.en: How did Mark manage to pay less?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他跟卖家谈到了更好的价格。
messages.en: He negotiated a better price with the seller.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买卖双方围着价格标签商量，把 nnegozja 和“谈条件、求共识”联系起来；搭配 prezz aħjar 记“谈到更好的价格”。

gloss_zh: 自己；本人（须接代词后缀）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form used with a pronominal suffix to emphasize the person concerned, as in 'I myself' or 'you yourself'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与代词后缀结合，强调所指的人本人，如“我自己”“你本人”；不能把这个带连字符的形式单独使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tingħaqad ma' suffiss pronominali biex tenfasizza l-persuna msemmija, bħal f' 'jien innifsi' jew 'int innifsek'.

sense_translations.en_definition: -self; used with a pronominal suffix to form emphatic pronouns
sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己；与代词后缀结合构成强调代词，用来强调某人本人。

formal.mt: Jien innifsi ċċekkjajt id-dokumenti kollha qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: I myself checked all the documents before the meeting.
formal.zh: 会议之前，我本人检查了所有文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel dan il-kejk? Lara: Jien innifsi għamiltu! Maja: Int innifsek? Prosit!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made this cake? Lara: I made it myself! Maja: You yourself? Well done!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个蛋糕是谁做的？拉拉：是我自己做的！玛雅：你亲手做的？真棒！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this cake?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我自己做的！
messages.en: I made it myself!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你亲手做的？真棒！
messages.en: You yourself? Well done!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把连字符想成等待接上人物后缀的接口；整组记住 jien innifsi、int innifsek，突出“本人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become aware of something, such as a detail, a change, or a mistake.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 注意到或察觉某件事，例如一个细节、一处变化或一个错误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinduna b'xi ħaġa, bħal dettall, bidla jew żball.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 注意到；察觉到。

formal.mt: L-għalliem nnuta żball fit-tweġiba u talab lill-istudent jerġa' jiċċekkjaha.
formal.en: The teacher noticed a mistake in the answer and asked the student to check it again.
formal.zh: 老师注意到答案中有一个错误，请学生再检查一次。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark nnuta l-bidla fil-kamra? Maja: Iva, nnuta mill-ewwel li ċċaqlaqna l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark notice the change in the room? Maja: Yes, he noticed straight away that we had moved the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克注意到房间的变化了吗？玛雅：注意到了，他马上就发现我们挪了桌子。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 马克注意到房间的变化了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark notice the change in the room?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nnuta mill-ewwel li ċċaqlaqna l-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nnuta mill-ewwel li ċċaqlaqna l-mejda.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他马上就发现我们挪了桌子。
messages.en: Yes, he noticed straight away that we had moved the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师用笔圈出答案中的小错误：nnuta 表示这一刻“注意到、察觉到”，可搭配 żball 或 bidla。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element nobelium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锘的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-element kimiku nobelju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锘，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom isibu n-nobelju fit-tabella perjodika u jiktbu ismu.
formal.en: In the exercise, students must find nobelium in the periodic table and write its name.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生须在元素周期表里找到锘，并写出它的名称。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser nobelju bl-Ingliż? Mark: Nobelium. Qed nitkellmu dwar element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does nobelju mean in English? Mark: Nobelium. We are talking about a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：nobelju 用英语怎么说？马克：Nobelium。我们说的是一种化学元素。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: nobelju 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: What does nobelju mean in English?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nobelium. Qed nitkellmu dwar element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Nobelium. Qed nitkellmu dwar element kimiku.
messages.zh: Nobelium。我们说的是一种化学元素。
messages.en: Nobelium. We are talking about a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三语元素卡片：正面写 nobelju，背面并列“锘、nobelium”，再想象它在元素周期表中的一格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part situated in the middle of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个物体或整体处于中间的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti li tinsab fin-nofs ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中间部分；中央部分。

collocations.en: the middle part of the cake
the middle part of the fabric

formal.mt: Poġġi l-mudell fuq in-nofsana tad-drapp qabel tibda taqta'.
formal.en: Place the template on the middle part of the fabric before you start cutting.
formal.zh: 开始裁剪之前，把样板放在布料的中间部分。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema parti tal-kejk trid? Lara: In-nofsana, jekk jogħġbok; hemm ħafna krema hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: Which part of the cake would you like? Lara: The middle part, please; there is plenty of cream there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你想要蛋糕的哪一部分？拉拉：请给我中间的部分，那里奶油多。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想要蛋糕的哪一部分？
messages.en: Which part of the cake would you like?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nofsana, jekk jogħġbok; hemm ħafna krema hemm.
messages.mt_standard: In-nofsana, jekk jogħġbok; hemm ħafna krema hemm.
messages.zh: 请给我中间的部分，那里奶油多。
messages.en: The middle part, please; there is plenty of cream there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块蛋糕，把中央区域涂上颜色并标 nofsana；用位置图记住“中间部分”，不要把它只理解成一个中心点。

gloss_zh: 中午十二点半；午夜十二点半

teaching_sense.en_definition: Half past twelve, referring either to half past noon or to half past midnight according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十二点半；依语境指中午十二点半或午夜十二点半。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin tat-tnax u nofs, jew ta' wara nofsinhar jew ta' billejl, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中午十二点半，即12:30。
午夜十二点半，即00:30。

formal.mt: L-ikla tibda fin-nofsiegħa ta' wara nofsinhar, jiġifieri fit-12:30.
formal.en: The meal begins at half past noon, that is, at 12:30 p.m.
formal.zh: 用餐于中午十二点半开始，即12:30。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-film spiċċa fin-nofsiegħa ta' billejl? Mark: Iva, fit-tnax u nofs ta' billejl; wasalt id-dar fis-siegħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the film finish at half past midnight? Mark: Yes, at half past twelve at night; I got home at one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影是午夜十二点半结束的吗？马克：是的，夜里十二点半结束；我一点到家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影是午夜十二点半结束的吗？
messages.en: Did the film finish at half past midnight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fit-tnax u nofs ta' billejl; wasalt id-dar fis-siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fit-tnax u nofs ta' billejl; wasalt id-dar fis-siegħa.
messages.zh: 是的，夜里十二点半结束；我一点到家。
messages.en: Yes, at half past twelve at night; I got home at one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为本词画两只十二点半的钟：一只旁边画太阳，一只画月亮，分别记住中午12:30与午夜00:30两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deep bowl used to hold food or other contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 碗身较深、可盛放食物或其他东西的碗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skutella fonda li tintuża biex iżżomm l-ikel jew affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只深碗；碗身较深的容器。

collocations.en: a deep bowl full of rice

formal.mt: Ferra' s-soppa f'nofsija u serviha waqt li tkun għadha sħuna.
formal.en: Pour the soup into a deep bowl and serve it while it is still hot.
formal.zh: 把汤倒进深碗，趁热端上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi s-soppa? Mark: F'dik in-nofsija, jekk jogħġbok; il-platt huwa baxx wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall I put the soup? Mark: In that deep bowl, please; the plate is too shallow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：汤盛在哪里？马克：请盛进那只深碗里，盘子太浅了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 汤盛在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the soup?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dik in-nofsija, jekk jogħġbok; il-platt huwa baxx wisq.
messages.mt_standard: F'dik in-nofsija, jekk jogħġbok; il-platt huwa baxx wisq.
messages.zh: 请盛进那只深碗里，盘子太浅了。
messages.en: In that deep bowl, please; the plate is too shallow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只碗壁很高、能盛热汤的深碗，在碗旁写 nofsija；让“深度明显的碗”成为记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A game in which one player looks for the other players while they hide.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种由一人寻找、其他人躲藏的游戏，即捉迷藏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba li fiha persuna tfittex lill-oħrajn waqt li dawn jinħbew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捉迷藏，一人寻找、其他人躲藏的游戏。

collocations.en: a game of hide and seek

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba noli, tifel wieħed jgħodd sa għaxra filwaqt li l-oħrajn jinħbew.
formal.en: During the game of hide and seek, one boy counts to ten while the others hide.
formal.zh: 玩捉迷藏时，一个男孩数到十，其他人则躲起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid nilagħbu noli? Mark: Iva! Jien ngħodd sa għaxra u int tinħeba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to play hide and seek? Mark: Yes! I'll count to ten and you hide.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：想玩捉迷藏吗？马克：想！我数到十，你躲起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (玩伴)
messages.zh: 想玩捉迷藏吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play hide and seek?

messages.speaker: Mark (玩伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Jien ngħodd sa għaxra u int tinħeba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Jien ngħodd sa għaxra u int tinħeba.
messages.zh: 想！我数到十，你躲起来。
messages.en: Yes! I'll count to ten and you hide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 noli 配上一个捂眼数数、另一个躲在树后的画面，再整句记 nilagħbu noli：“我们玩捉迷藏”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The large number called a nonillion in English; its numerical value depends on the naming scale being used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语称作 nonillion 的大数；具体数值须结合所采用的大数命名制确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Numru kbir li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ nonillion; il-valur tiegħu jiddependi mis-sistema tal-ismijiet tan-numri li tkun qed tintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: nonillion，极大数的名称；具体数值依所用的大数命名制而定。

collocations.zh: 数量为一个 nonillion 的恒星

formal.mt: Meta tuża n-numru noniljun f'test, speċifika s-sistema tal-ismijiet tan-numri biex il-valur ikun ċar.
formal.en: When using the number nonillion in a text, specify the number-naming scale so that its value is clear.
formal.zh: 在文章中使用 noniljun 这个数时，应注明采用的大数命名制，以明确其数值。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Noniljun huwa numru kbir? Mark: Iva, kbir ħafna! Biex inkunu nafu l-valur eżatt, irridu nkunu nafu liema sistema qed tintuża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is a nonillion a large number? Mark: Yes, a very large one! To know its exact value, we need to know which naming scale is being used.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：noniljun 是很大的数吗？马克：是的，非常大！要知道确切数值，得先知道用的是哪种大数命名制。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: noniljun 是很大的数吗？
messages.en: Is a nonillion a large number?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kbir ħafna! Biex inkunu nafu l-valur eżatt, irridu nkunu nafu liema sistema qed tintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kbir ħafna! Biex inkunu nafu l-valur eżatt, irridu nkunu nafu liema sistema qed tintuża.
messages.zh: 是的，非常大！要知道确切数值，得先知道用的是哪种大数命名制。
messages.en: Yes, a very large one! To know its exact value, we need to know which naming scale is being used.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 noniljun 与英语 nonillion 并排做成大数卡片，旁边写“先确认命名制，再确定数值”，避免只凭名称猜零的个数。

gloss_zh: 小穿孔；小个子的人，尤指小女孩

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small puncture; also a small person, especially a little girl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被刺出的小孔，也可指个子小的人，尤其是小女孩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqba żgħira magħmula b'titqiba; tintuża wkoll għal persuna żgħira, speċjalment tifla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小穿孔；被刺出的小孔。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small person (especially used for a little girl)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小个子的人，尤其用来指小女孩。

collocations.en: a small puncture in the tyre

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabet noqba fit-tajer ta' wara.
formal.en: During the inspection, a small puncture was found in the rear tyre.
formal.zh: 检查时发现后轮胎上有一个小穿孔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hi dik in-noqba ħdejn il-bieb? Rita: Dik binti, Lea. Għadha kif għalqet erba' snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that little girl by the door? Rita: That's my daughter, Lea. She has just turned four.
colloquial.zh: Maja：门边那个小女孩是谁？Rita：那是我女儿 Lea，她刚满四岁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hi dik in-noqba ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hi dik in-noqba ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个小女孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is that little girl by the door?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik binti, Lea. Għadha kif għalqet erba' snin.
messages.mt_standard: Dik binti, Lea. Għadha kif għalqet erba' snin.
messages.zh: 那是我女儿 Lea，她刚满四岁。
messages.en: That's my daughter, Lea. She has just turned four.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个“小”画面记忆：轮胎上的小穿孔，以及门边的小女孩；具体词义由上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of gradually decreasing or waning, as when the visible illuminated part of the moon becomes smaller.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐减小或减弱的过程，例如月亮可见的明亮部分逐渐缩小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' tnaqqis gradwali, bħal meta l-parti mdawla tal-qamar li naraw issir iżgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: waning. this is a hybrid formation from a mixture of the roots nqs and qsr
sense_translations.zh_definition: 渐弱；亏缺。此词是由 nqs 与 qsr 两组词根混合形成的混合构词。

formal.mt: Matul in-noqsar tal-qamar, il-parti mdawla li naraw mid-Dinja tonqos gradwalment.
formal.en: During the waning of the moon, the illuminated portion we see from Earth gradually decreases.
formal.zh: 月亮亏缺期间，我们从地球上看到的明亮部分逐渐缩小。

colloquial.mt: Lea: X'jiġifieri n-noqsar tal-qamar? Pawlu: Jiġifieri li l-parti mdawla li naraw qed tiċkien.
colloquial.en: Lea: What does the waning of the moon mean? Pawlu: It means that the illuminated part we see is getting smaller.
colloquial.zh: Lea：月亮的亏缺是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是我们看到的明亮部分正在缩小。

messages.speaker: Lea (学生)
messages.zh: 月亮的亏缺是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the waning of the moon mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li l-parti mdawla li naraw qed tiċkien.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li l-parti mdawla li naraw qed tiċkien.
messages.zh: 意思是我们看到的明亮部分正在缩小。
messages.en: It means that the illuminated part we see is getting smaller.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象满月的亮面一天比一天小，把 noqsar 与“逐渐亏缺的过程”联系起来，注意它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Norway, a country in Scandinavia in Northern Europe, officially called the Kingdom of Norway.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挪威，位于北欧斯堪的纳维亚的国家，正式名称为挪威王国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Iskandinavja, fit-Tramuntana tal-Ewropa, li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Renju tan-Norveġja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Norway (a country in Scandinavia in Northern Europe; official name: Renju tan-Norveġja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挪威，位于北欧斯堪的纳维亚的国家；正式名称为挪威王国，马耳他语为 Renju tan-Norveġja。

formal.mt: L-istudenta għażlet in-Norveġja bħala s-suġġett tal-preżentazzjoni tagħha dwar pajjiż Ewropew.
formal.en: The student chose Norway as the subject of her presentation about a European country.
formal.zh: 这名学生选择挪威作为她介绍一个欧洲国家的报告主题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur in-Norveġja biex inżur lil ħija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Norway to visit my brother.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你打算去哪里度假？Mark：我要去挪威看望我的兄弟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur in-Norveġja biex inżur lil ħija.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur in-Norveġja biex inżur lil ħija.
messages.zh: 我要去挪威看望我的兄弟。
messages.en: I'm going to Norway to visit my brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Norveġja 写在北欧地图上的挪威位置，再连读 in-Norveġja，记住国家名称的首字母要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something new or unfamiliar that attracts attention because it is new.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因新出现或不熟悉而引人注意的新事物、新鲜玩意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa ġdida jew mhux tas-soltu li tiġbed l-attenzjoni għax tkun ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 新事物；新鲜玩意。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut introduċa novità: magna li tippermetti lill-klijenti jistampaw ir-ritratti tagħhom.
formal.en: The shop introduced a novelty: a machine that allows customers to print their photographs.
formal.zh: 商店引入了一样新事物：一台让顾客自行打印照片的机器。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi din il-magna? Mark: Hija novità fil-ħanut tagħna. Tista' tistampa r-ritratti biha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this machine? Mark: It's something new in our shop. You can use it to print photographs.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这是什么机器？Mark：这是我们店里的新玩意，你可以用它打印照片。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这是什么机器？
messages.en: What is this machine?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija novità fil-ħanut tagħna. Tista' tistampa r-ritratti biha.
messages.mt_standard: Hija novità fil-ħanut tagħna. Tista' tistampa r-ritratti biha.
messages.zh: 这是我们店里的新玩意，你可以用它打印照片。
messages.en: It's something new in our shop. You can use it to print photographs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店里摆出一件大家没见过的新玩意，用 novità 给它贴标签；这里记的是具体的新事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be caught or captured, or to become involved in a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被抓住、被捕获，或卷入某种情况、事情之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqabad minn xi ħadd jew f'xi ħaġa, jew jidħol involut f'sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抓住；被捕获。
卷入；牵涉到某事之中。

formal.mt: Is-suspettat nqabad mill-pulizija qrib l-istazzjon tal-ferrovija.
formal.en: The suspect was caught by the police near the railway station.
formal.zh: 嫌疑人在火车站附近被警方抓获。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark għadu ma ġiex? Sara: Nqabad f'argument ma' sieħbu u għadu qed jitkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why hasn't Mark arrived yet? Sara: He got involved in an argument with his friend and is still talking to him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 怎么还没来？Sara：他卷入了和朋友的一场争论，现在还在跟对方说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 怎么还没来？
messages.en: Why hasn't Mark arrived yet?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nqabad f'argument ma' sieħbu u għadu qed jitkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Nqabad f'argument ma' sieħbu u għadu qed jitkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 他卷入了和朋友的一场争论，现在还在跟对方说话。
messages.en: He got involved in an argument with his friend and is still talking to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“被抓住”和“卷入事情”画成两幅图：一个人被抓获，一个人陷入争论；两种情境都可用 nqabad。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be skipped during a sequence or to be omitted from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在依次进行时被跳过，或在内容、名单等之中被遗漏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jingħatax kas tiegħu waqt sekwenza, jew jitħalla barra minn test, lista jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被跳过；未按顺序被处理。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be omitted or left out
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被省略；被遗漏或排除在外。

collocations.en: was left out of the list

formal.mt: Paragrafu importanti nqabeż waqt il-qari tar-rapport.
formal.en: An important paragraph was skipped while the report was being read.
formal.zh: 宣读报告时，一个重要段落被跳过了。

colloquial.mt: Lea: Għaliex ismi mhux fuq il-lista? Mark: Jiddispjaċini, ismek nqabeż bi żball. Se nżidu issa.
colloquial.en: Lea: Why isn't my name on the list? Mark: I'm sorry, your name was left out by mistake. I'll add it now.
colloquial.zh: Lea：为什么名单上没有我的名字？Mark：抱歉，你的名字被误漏了，我现在就加上。

messages.speaker: Lea (参加者)
messages.zh: 为什么名单上没有我的名字？
messages.en: Why isn't my name on the list?

messages.speaker: Mark (组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiddispjaċini, ismek nqabeż bi żball. Se nżidu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Jiddispjaċini, ismek nqabeż bi żball. Se nżidu issa.
messages.zh: 抱歉，你的名字被误漏了，我现在就加上。
messages.en: I'm sorry, your name was left out by mistake. I'll add it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指读名单时越过一个名字：阅读顺序中是“被跳过”，最终名单中则是“被遗漏”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a boat to be moved through water by someone using oars.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指船由人划桨而在水中移动，着重表达船被划动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal dgħajsa li titmexxa fl-ilma minn xi ħadd bl-użu tal-imqadef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被划动；指船由人用桨推进。

collocations.en: the boat was rowed towards the shore

formal.mt: Id-dgħajsa nqadfet lejn ix-xatt minn żewġ membri tal-ekwipaġġ.
formal.en: The boat was rowed towards the shore by two crew members.
formal.zh: 两名船员划桨，将船划向岸边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif waslet id-dgħajsa sax-xatt mingħajr magna? Pawlu: Nqadfet minn żewġ sajjieda.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the boat reach the shore without an engine? Pawlu: It was rowed by two fishermen.
colloquial.zh: Sara：没有发动机，那条船怎么到岸边的？Pawlu：是两名渔民划过来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif waslet id-dgħajsa sax-xatt mingħajr magna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif waslet id-dgħajsa sax-xatt mingħajr magna?
messages.zh: 没有发动机，那条船怎么到岸边的？
messages.en: How did the boat reach the shore without an engine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.zh: 是两名渔民划过来的。
messages.en: It was rowed by two fishermen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把注意力放在被桨推动的小船上，记住“船被划动”；搭配阴性名词 dgħajsa 时，例句使用 nqadfet。

gloss_zh: 被关起来；自我隔绝；入修会过隐修生活

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be locked up, to withdraw from society, or to enter a religious order and live in a cloister.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被关起来；主动远离社会生活；或加入修会并在修道院中过隐修生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħalaq f'post, iwarrab ruħu mill-ħajja soċjali, jew jidħol f'ordni reliġjuż u jgħix fil-klawsura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被关起来；被锁在某处。

sense_translations.en_definition: to keep oneself away from society
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己远离社会；过自我隔绝的生活。

sense_translations.en_definition: to join a religious order and live in a cloister
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加入修会，并在修道院中过隐修生活。

collocations.en: was locked up in a cell
entered a convent to live a cloistered religious life
collocations.zh: 进入修道院过隐修生活

formal.mt: Wara li daħal fl-ordni reliġjuż, Pawlu nqafel f'kunvent u għex ħajja ta' talb u skiet.
formal.en: After joining the religious order, Pawlu entered a cloistered life in a convent and lived a life of prayer and silence.
formal.zh: 加入修会后，Pawlu 进入修道院隐修，过着祈祷与静默的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma għadniex naraw lil Mark? Rita: Dan l-aħħar nqafel f'daru u ma jridx jiltaqa' ma' nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't we see Mark anymore? Rita: Lately he has shut himself away at home and doesn't want to meet people.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们怎么再也见不到 Mark 了？Rita：他最近把自己封闭在家里，不愿见人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma għadniex naraw lil Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma għadniex naraw lil Mark?
messages.zh: 我们怎么再也见不到 Mark 了？
messages.en: Why don't we see Mark anymore?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-aħħar nqafel f'daru u ma jridx jiltaqa' ma' nies.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-aħħar nqafel f'daru u ma jridx jiltaqa' ma' nies.
messages.zh: 他最近把自己封闭在家里，不愿见人。
messages.en: Lately he has shut himself away at home and doesn't want to meet people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅场景分开记忆：被关进牢房、主动闭居家中、进入修道院隐修；同一个词要靠情境区分三义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be said or expressed in speech, with attention on the words rather than the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指话语被说出或意思被表达，重点在所说的内容，而非说话的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta kliem jingħad jew ħsieb jiġi espress bil-fomm, bl-enfasi fuq il-kontenut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被说出；被谈到或表达出来。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiġbor dak li nqal waqt il-laqgħa dwar il-bżonnijiet tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The report summarizes what was said during the meeting about the students' needs.
formal.zh: 报告概述了会议上关于学生需求的发言内容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tiftakar dak li nqal fil-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, qalu li l-kors jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you remember what was said at the meeting? Mark: Yes, they said the course starts on Monday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你记得会上说了什么吗？Mark：记得，他们说课程周一开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你记得会上说了什么吗？
messages.en: Do you remember what was said at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qalu li l-kors jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qalu li l-kors jibda nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 记得，他们说课程周一开始。
messages.en: Yes, they said the course starts on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dak li nqal 整块记成“所说的话”：想象会议记录只留下发言内容，帮助记住被动意义。

gloss_zh: 脱落；突然发生；被赚得；能够应付

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come off or become detached; also used of a problem or situation that arises unexpectedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物脱落、脱离原处；也可指问题或情况突然出现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tinqala' minn fejn kienet imwaħħla, jew meta tinqala' problema jew sitwazzjoni bla mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被赚得；作为劳动或付出的所得而获得。
脱落；从原本连接或固定的地方脱离。
毫无预警地发生；突然出现。

sense_translations.en_definition: to occur as a result of one's prayers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某人的祈祷而发生或实现。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be up to a task
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够胜任某项任务；有本领应付。
受到打扰或被迫费事；因某事而遭遇不便。

collocations.en: to be capable of doing this work

formal.mt: Wara li nqala' l-manku tal-bieb, il-manutenzjoni tas-sala ġiet posposta sakemm waslet il-biċċa l-ġdida.
formal.en: After the door handle came off, maintenance of the hall was postponed until the new part arrived.
formal.zh: 门把手脱落后，大厅的维修工作被推迟，直到新零件送达。
