colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex wasalt tard? Pawlu: Skużani, nqala' xi ħaġa d-dar u kelli nistenna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you arrive late? Pawlu: Sorry, something came up at home and I had to wait.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么来晚了？Pawlu：抱歉，家里突然出了点事，我得等一等。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么来晚了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, nqala' xi ħaġa d-dar u kelli nistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, nqala' xi ħaġa d-dar u kelli nistenna.
messages.zh: 抱歉，家里突然出了点事，我得等一等。
messages.en: Sorry, something came up at home and I had to wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分别记忆：门把手突然脱落、家里突然出事。再把“赚得、祈祷应验、胜任、受扰”各作独立义项记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn over or be overturned; also to be translated into another language or to change, as the weather does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体翻倒或被翻转；也可指文字被译成另一种语言，或天气等发生转变。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tinqaleb fuq naħa oħra, meta test jiġi tradott, jew meta jinbidel it-temp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被翻倒；翻覆或倒转。
被翻译；被译成另一种语言。

sense_translations.en_definition: to change (used e.g. of the weather)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 转变；发生变化，例如天气转变。

formal.mt: It-test li nqaleb għall-Malti ġie rivedut minn żewġ għalliema qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The text translated into Maltese was reviewed by two teachers before publication.
formal.zh: 译成马耳他语的文本在出版前由两位教师审校。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadna sejrin il-baħar? David: Aħjar le, ara kif nqaleb it-temp!
colloquial.en: Nina: Are we still going to the seaside? David: Better not; look how the weather has changed!
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们还去海边吗？David：最好别去了，你看天气变成什么样了！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还去海边吗？
messages.en: Are we still going to the seaside?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le, ara kif nqaleb it-temp!
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le, ara kif nqaleb it-temp!
messages.zh: 最好别去了，你看天气变成什么样了！
messages.en: Better not; look how the weather has changed!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“翻”作学习联想：水桶翻倒、文本翻译、天气翻变。这只是串联三个义项的记忆画面，不是词源说明。

gloss_zh: 被用力擦洗；被刷洗干净

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be scoured by vigorous rubbing or scrubbing to remove dirt or residue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指表面经过用力摩擦或刷洗，以去除污垢、残留物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta wiċċ jitnaddaf bi tħakkik qawwi biex jitneħħa l-ħmieġ jew dak li jkun weħel miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用力擦洗或刷洗，以清除附着的污垢。

formal.mt: Wara li nqarad bix-xkupilja, il-qiegħ tal-borma tlaħlaħ b'ilma nadif.
formal.en: After being scoured with a brush, the bottom of the pot was rinsed with clean water.
formal.zh: 锅底用刷子刷洗后，又用清水冲洗。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadu maħmuġ il-qiegħ tal-borma? Toni: Le, wara li nqarad sew bl-isponża, sar nadif.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the bottom of the pot still dirty? Toni: No, after a thorough scouring with the sponge, it came clean.
colloquial.zh: Rita：锅底还脏吗？Toni：不脏了，用海绵使劲擦洗后就干净了。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 锅底还脏吗？
messages.en: Is the bottom of the pot still dirty?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, wara li nqarad sew bl-isponża, sar nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Le, wara li nqarad sew bl-isponża, sar nadif.
messages.zh: 不脏了，用海绵使劲擦洗后就干净了。
messages.en: No, after a thorough scouring with the sponge, it came clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锅底黏着顽固污垢，必须用刷子来回使劲刷；把这个动作画面与“被用力擦洗”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer a scratch, scrape, or bruise, especially on a part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体某个部位受到划伤、擦伤或碰伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta parti tal-ġisem issofri girfa, brix jew tbenġil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被划伤、擦伤或碰伤。

collocations.en: got scratched or bruised while playing

formal.mt: Il-minkeb li nqaraħ waqt il-waqgħa ġie mnaddaf u mgħotti b'faxxa.
formal.en: The elbow scraped in the fall was cleaned and covered with a bandage.
formal.zh: 摔倒时擦伤的手肘经过清洁后，用绷带包扎起来。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex għandek faxxa fuq minkbek? Ben: Għax nqaraħ mal-ħajt waqt li kont nilgħab.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why do you have a bandage on your elbow? Ben: Because it got scraped against the wall while I was playing.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你手肘上为什么缠着绷带？Ben：因为我玩的时候蹭到墙，擦伤了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你手肘上为什么缠着绷带？
messages.en: Why do you have a bandage on your elbow?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nqaraħ mal-ħajt waqt li kont nilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nqaraħ mal-ħajt waqt li kont nilgħab.
messages.zh: 因为我玩的时候蹭到墙，擦伤了。
messages.en: Because it got scraped against the wall while I was playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进“手肘蹭墙后贴上绷带”的小故事，记住它描述擦伤或碰伤的结果，并不只指流血的伤口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break, split, or be torn apart so that something separates into parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体裂开、断开或被撕裂，使原本连在一起的部分分离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tinkiser, tinqasam jew titqatta' u tifred f'partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裂开；断裂或破开。
被撕裂；被扯开而分成彼此分离的部分。

formal.mt: It-travu li nqasam min-nofs ġie sostitwit qabel ma reġa' beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The beam that split down the middle was replaced before work resumed.
formal.zh: 从中间裂开的横梁在复工前已被更换。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'ġara mill-platt? Luqa: Waqa' minn idi u nqasam fi tnejn.
colloquial.en: Marta: What happened to the plate? Luqa: It fell from my hand and broke in two.
colloquial.zh: Marta：盘子怎么了？Luqa：它从我手里掉下去，裂成两半了。

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.zh: 盘子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the plate?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' minn idi u nqasam fi tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' minn idi u nqasam fi tnejn.
messages.zh: 它从我手里掉下去，裂成两半了。
messages.en: It fell from my hand and broke in two.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fi tnejn“成两份”与词一起记：完整盘子落地后变成两半，突出从一个整体裂成几部分的结果。

gloss_zh: 被切断；被决定；被猜中；断开连接

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut or severed, or to become disconnected; in other contexts, to be decided or correctly guessed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被切开、切断或中断连接；在其他语境中，也可指事情被决定或答案被猜中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tinqata' jew titlef il-konnessjoni; f'kuntesti oħra, meta tittieħed deċiżjoni jew tinstab tweġiba b'taqtiegħ il-moħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被切开、剪开或切断。
被决定；某事得到裁定或定夺。
被猜出；答案或结果被猜中。
连接被切断；线路或服务中断。

collocations.en: the rope was cut or snapped

formal.mt: Wara li nqata' l-kejbil waqt ix-xogħol, il-konnessjoni ġiet restawrata minn tekniku.
formal.en: After the cable was cut during the work, the connection was restored by a technician.
formal.zh: 施工期间电缆被切断，随后由技术人员恢复了连接。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaf il-film? Mark: Għax nqata' d-dawl. Nistennew ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the film stop? Mark: Because the power went out. Let's wait a little.
colloquial.zh: Sara：电影怎么停了？Mark：因为停电了。我们等一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 电影怎么停了？
messages.en: Why did the film stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 因为停电了。我们等一会儿吧。
messages.en: Because the power went out. Let's wait a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“绳断、停电、断联”记住切断与中断，再为“事情定了、答案猜中了”各做一张独立例句卡，避免混淆义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive service or assistance; with b', to make use of a person, object, or resource.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指得到服务或帮助；与 b' 搭配时，表示使用某物、借助某人或利用某种资源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta persuna tirċievi servizz jew għajnuna; ma' b', meta tuża persuna, oġġett jew riżorsa biex tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到接待或服务；需求得到服务人员处理。
使用；借助某人、某物或某种资源来办事。
利用某人、某物或某种条件；根据语境，也可含占便宜的意味。

collocations.en: made use of a friend's help

formal.mt: L-istudent nqeda bid-dizzjunarju biex jifhem il-kliem il-ġdid fit-test.
formal.en: The student used the dictionary to understand the new words in the text.
formal.zh: 学生借助词典理解课文中的生词。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Inqdejt fil-ħanut? Ġanni: Iva, xtrajt dak kollu li kelli bżonn u ma stennejtx wisq.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you get served at the shop? Ġanni: Yes, I bought everything I needed and didn't wait too long.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你在店里办妥了吗？Ġanni：办妥了，需要的东西都买到了，也没等太久。

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.zh: 你在店里办妥了吗？
messages.en: Did you get served at the shop?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtrajt dak kollu li kelli bżonn u ma stennejtx wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtrajt dak kollu li kelli bżonn u ma stennejtx wisq.
messages.zh: 办妥了，需要的东西都买到了，也没等太久。
messages.en: Yes, I bought everything I needed and didn't wait too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两张场景卡：商店柜台前“得到服务”，书桌前“借助词典”。看到 bid-dizzjunarju，就联想借词典办成事情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of making a hole by puncturing or piercing, including a hatching bird breaking its shell with its beak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺破或穿透某物形成孔洞的动作，也指雏鸟孵化时用喙啄破蛋壳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ssir toqba f'xi ħaġa billi tittaqqab, inkluż meta fellus itaqqab il-qoxra tal-bajda bil-munqar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺破；扎出孔洞的动作。
刺穿；穿透某物的动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: puncturing of a shell by a bird's beak during hatching
sense_translations.zh_definition: 雏鸟孵化时用喙啄破蛋壳的动作。

formal.mt: In-nqib tal-qoxra bil-munqar jgħin lill-fellus joħroġ mill-bajda.
formal.en: Puncturing the shell with its beak helps the chick emerge from the egg.
formal.zh: 雏鸟用喙啄破蛋壳，有助于从蛋中出来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik it-toqba żgħira fil-bajda? Pawlu: Hija sinjal tan-nqib: il-fellus qed jiftaħ il-qoxra bil-munqar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that little hole in the egg? Pawlu: It is a sign of shell puncturing: the chick is opening the shell with its beak.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：蛋上的那个小孔是什么？保罗：那是啄壳的迹象，小鸡正用喙啄开蛋壳。

messages.speaker: Lara (孩子)
messages.zh: 蛋上的那个小孔是什么？
messages.en: What is that little hole in the egg?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija sinjal tan-nqib: il-fellus qed jiftaħ il-qoxra bil-munqar.
messages.mt_standard: Hija sinjal tan-nqib: il-fellus qed jiftaħ il-qoxra bil-munqar.
messages.zh: 那是啄壳的迹象，小鸡正用喙啄开蛋壳。
messages.en: It is a sign of shell puncturing: the chick is opening the shell with its beak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nqib 配上“尖端穿出小孔”的画面，再想小鸡用喙啄壳，串联刺破与孵化两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's size or quantity measured, or to be regarded or judged in a particular way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸或数量受到测量；也指受到某种看待、评价或认定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mkejjel fid-daqs jew fil-kwantità, jew jiġi kkunsidrat jew meqjus b'ċertu mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被测量；尺寸、长度或数量得到测定。
被考虑；被认为或被评价为。

formal.mt: It-tul tad-drapp nqies darbtejn qabel il-qtugħ biex jiġi evitat l-iżball.
formal.en: The length of the fabric was measured twice before cutting to avoid an error.
formal.zh: 为避免出错，裁剪前对布料长度测量了两次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-post nqies tajjeb għall-festa? Mark: Iva, għandu biżżejjed spazju għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this place considered suitable for the party? Mark: Yes, it has enough space for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个地方被认为适合办聚会吗？马克：是的，这里有足够的空间容纳大家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个地方被认为适合办聚会吗？
messages.en: Was this place considered suitable for the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (聚会组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu biżżejjed spazju għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu biżżejjed spazju għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 是的，这里有足够的空间容纳大家。
messages.en: Yes, it has enough space for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 nqies 时画两幅图：尺子量布是“被测量”，大家评价场地是“被认为”；按上下文选择意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The softening of something by leaving it immersed in a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物浸在液体中，使它逐渐变软的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trattib ta' xi ħaġa billi titħalla mgħaddsa f'likwidu għal xi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过浸在液体中使某物变软；浸泡软化。

formal.mt: In-nqigħ taċ-ċiċri fl-ilma matul il-lejl irattabhom qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: Soaking the chickpeas in water overnight softens them before cooking.
formal.zh: 将鹰嘴豆放在水中浸泡一夜，可以在烹煮前使其变软。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ħallejt il-fażola fl-ilma? Rita: Għan-nqigħ, biex tirtab qabel insajjarha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you leave the beans in water? Rita: To soak them so they soften before I cook them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把豆子放在水里？丽塔：为了浸泡，让它们在下锅前变软。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 你为什么把豆子放在水里？
messages.en: Why did you leave the beans in water?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 为了浸泡，让它们在下锅前变软。
messages.en: To soak them so they soften before I cook them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nqigħ 记成一碗泡了一夜的干豆：重点是“浸在液体里，逐渐变软”这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of a bird striking or picking at something with its beak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟用喙敲击、啄取或啄食某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' għasfur li jolqot jew jiġbor xi ħaġa bil-munqar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟用喙啄击或啄食的动作。

formal.mt: In-nqir tat-tiġieġ fl-art jgħinhom isibu żrieragħ u insetti żgħar.
formal.en: The chickens' pecking at the ground helps them find seeds and small insects.
formal.zh: 鸡啄地面，有助于找到种子和小昆虫。

colloquial.mt: Luca: X'qed jagħmlu t-tiġieġ ħdejn is-siġra? Anna: Qed ifittxu l-ikel; ara n-nqir tagħhom fl-art.
colloquial.en: Luca: What are the chickens doing beside the tree? Anna: They are looking for food; look at their pecking at the ground.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：树旁的鸡在做什么？安娜：它们在找吃的，你看它们正啄地面。

messages.speaker: Luca (孩子)
messages.zh: 树旁的鸡在做什么？
messages.en: What are the chickens doing beside the tree?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed ifittxu l-ikel; ara n-nqir tagħhom fl-art.
messages.mt_standard: Qed ifittxu l-ikel; ara n-nqir tagħhom fl-art.
messages.zh: 它们在找吃的，你看它们正啄地面。
messages.en: They are looking for food; look at their pecking at the ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 nqir 就想鸡低头啄米的连续动作；这个名词关注“啄”，不要求已经啄出孔洞。

gloss_zh: 被猛地摔碰；被砰地关上

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shut or thrown against something with a sudden, forceful impact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被突然用力关上，或被猛地摔碰到某物上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħalaq jew jintlaqat ma' xi ħaġa b'ħabta qawwija u għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被猛地摔碰；门等被砰地关上。

collocations.en: the door was slammed shut by the wind
the book was slammed against the table

formal.mt: Il-bieb nsabat bir-riħ u l-ħoss instema' fil-kuritur kollu.
formal.en: The door was slammed shut by the wind, and the sound was heard throughout the corridor.
formal.zh: 门被风砰地吹关，整个走廊都听到了声响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Ben: Il-bieb nsabat bir-riħ. Se nagħlaq it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that noise? Ben: The door slammed shut in the wind. I will close the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才是什么声音？本：门被风砰地吹关了。我去关窗。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb nsabat bir-riħ. Se nagħlaq it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb nsabat bir-riħ. Se nagħlaq it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 门被风砰地吹关了。我去关窗。
messages.en: The door slammed shut in the wind. I will close the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nsabat 配上“砰”的声音：门被风猛地关上，或书被摔在桌上，都突出突然的强烈碰撞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be drawn inward or through an opening by suction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到吸力作用而被吸入，或被吸着通过某个开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġibed 'il ġewwa jew minn fetħa permezz tal-irdigħ jew tal-ġbid ta' pompa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被吸；在吸力作用下被吸入或抽走。

collocations.en: the liquid was sucked through the tube
the water was sucked out by the pump

formal.mt: Il-likwidu nsaff mill-kontenitur permezz ta' tubu mqabbad ma' pompa.
formal.en: The liquid was sucked out of the container through a tube connected to a pump.
formal.zh: 液体通过连接泵的管子被吸出容器。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn mar l-ilma mill-kontenitur? Toni: Nsaff bil-pompa u daħal fit-tank l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did the water from the container go? Toni: It was sucked out by the pump and went into the other tank.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：容器里的水到哪里去了？托尼：被泵吸走，流进另一个水箱了。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 容器里的水到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the water from the container go?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Nsaff bil-pompa u daħal fit-tank l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Nsaff bil-pompa u daħal fit-tank l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 被泵吸走，流进另一个水箱了。
messages.en: It was sucked out by the pump and went into the other tank.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nsaff 放进透明管子吸水的画面里：液体顺着吸力移动，记住主语是“被吸走”的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made sharper, especially by grinding or honing a cutting edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被磨得更锋利，尤指刀刃等经过打磨而变利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar jaqta', speċjalment billi t-tarf tiegħu jingħorok ma' ġebla tas-sann.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被磨利；刃口经过打磨而变锋利。

collocations.en: the edge was sharpened on a whetstone
collocations.zh: 刃口在磨刀石上被磨利

formal.mt: Il-mus nsann fuq ġebla tas-sann qabel ma ntuża biex jaqta' l-ħabel.
formal.en: The pocketknife was sharpened on a whetstone before being used to cut the rope.
formal.zh: 小刀先在磨刀石上磨利，然后才用来割绳子。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Il-mus lest biex nużah? Pawlu: Iva, nsann dalgħodu u issa jaqta' sew.
colloquial.en: Luca: Is the pocketknife ready for me to use? Pawlu: Yes, it was sharpened this morning and now cuts well.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：小刀准备好了，我可以用了吗？保罗：可以，今天早上磨利了，现在很好切。

messages.speaker: Luca (手工学员)
messages.zh: 小刀准备好了，我可以用了吗？
messages.en: Is the pocketknife ready for me to use?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (手工教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nsann dalgħodu u issa jaqta' sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nsann dalgħodu u issa jaqta' sew.
messages.zh: 可以，今天早上磨利了，现在很好切。
messages.en: Yes, it was sharpened this morning and now cuts well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nsann 和磨刀前后的对照图一起记：钝刃经过打磨变锋利，主语是那把“被磨利”的刀。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be driven or guided forward by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人驱赶或引导着向前移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jew immexxi minn xi ħadd biex jimxi 'l quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被驱赶；被赶着前往某处。

collocations.en: was driven out of the field

formal.mt: Il-barri nsaq lejn l-istalla qabel bdiet ix-xita.
formal.en: The bull was driven towards the stable before the rain began.
formal.zh: 下雨之前，公牛被赶向牲畜棚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-barri? Mark: Nsaq lejn l-istalla; issa qiegħed ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the bull go? Mark: It was driven towards the stable; it is inside now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：公牛去哪儿了？Mark：被赶到牲畜棚去了，现在在里面。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.zh: 公牛去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the bull go?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nsaq lejn l-istalla; issa qiegħed ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Nsaq lejn l-istalla; issa qiegħed ġewwa.
messages.zh: 被赶到牲畜棚去了，现在在里面。
messages.en: It was driven towards the stable; it is inside now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公牛在人的引导下走进棚里，把 nsaq 和“被赶着走”的被动场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be taken aback, confused, or troubled by something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事而感到错愕、困惑或烦扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħasad, jitħawwad jew jitħasseb minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因意外的事情而感到错愕，一时不知如何反应。
感到困惑或思绪混乱，弄不清情况。
感到烦扰、不安或忧虑。

collocations.en: was taken aback by the news

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant nsaram bl-aħbar tal-bidla u talab aktar tagħrif qabel wieġeb.
formal.en: The representative was taken aback by the news of the change and requested more information before replying.
formal.zh: 代表听到变更的消息后感到错愕，在答复之前要求提供更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu baqa' sieket? Maja: Nsaram b'dak li sema'; se nitkellem miegħu aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu stay quiet? Maja: He was troubled by what he heard; I will talk to him later.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 为什么一直不说话？Maja：他听了那些事后心里不安，我晚点会和他聊聊。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么一直不说话？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stay quiet?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nsaram b'dak li sema'; se nitkellem miegħu aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Nsaram b'dak li sema'; se nitkellem miegħu aktar tard.
messages.zh: 他听了那些事后心里不安，我晚点会和他聊聊。
messages.en: He was troubled by what he heard; I will talk to him later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听到消息先愣住，再疑惑，最后心里烦”这一连串反应，串起 nsaram 的三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be gathered into a bundle or packed for storage or transport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被收拢捆成一束，或被打包以便存放、运输。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġabar f'gozz jew jiġi ppakkjat għall-ħażna jew għat-trasport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被收拢、捆扎成一束或一包。
被打包或包装好，以便携带、存放或运输。

formal.mt: Id-drapp nsarr f'gozz u tqiegħed fil-maħżen sakemm ikun lest it-trasport.
formal.en: The fabric was bundled up and placed in the storeroom until transport was ready.
formal.zh: 布料被收拢成一包，放进库房等待运输安排就绪。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Id-drapp lest biex nieħduh? Rita: Iva, nsarr f'gozz; qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the fabric ready for us to take? Rita: Yes, it has been bundled up; it is beside the door.
colloquial.zh: Mark：布料准备好让我们拿走了吗？Rita：好了，已经包成一包，放在门旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (搬运工)
messages.zh: 布料准备好让我们拿走了吗？
messages.en: Is the fabric ready for us to take?

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nsarr f'gozz; qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nsarr f'gozz; qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 好了，已经包成一包，放在门旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it has been bundled up; it is beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象散开的布料被收紧成一个包：成束强调收拢，打包强调便于携带，都可联系 nsarr。

gloss_zh: 躲藏起来；把自己藏起来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hide oneself away where other people cannot easily see or find one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把自己藏到别人不容易看见或找到的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħeba f'post fejn ħaddieħor ma jarahx jew ma jsibux faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躲藏起来，使别人看不见或找不到自己。

collocations.en: hid himself away in a corner

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel nsatar wara l-bieb biex ħadd ma jarah.
formal.en: In the story, the boy hid himself behind the door so that no one would see him.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩躲到门后，不让任何人看见自己。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu Leo? Mark: Nsatar wara l-bieb; qed jilgħab magħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Leo? Mark: He has hidden himself behind the door; he is playing with us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Leo 在哪儿？Mark：他躲到门后去了，在和我们玩呢。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: Leo 在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Leo?

messages.speaker: Mark (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Nsatar wara l-bieb; qed jilgħab magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Nsatar wara l-bieb; qed jilgħab magħna.
messages.zh: 他躲到门后去了，在和我们玩呢。
messages.en: He has hidden himself behind the door; he is playing with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nsatar 配成捉迷藏画面：自己轻轻躲到门后，别人看不见，重点是“把自己藏起来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be broken down or flattened by repeated blows or strong pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到反复捶击或强力挤压而被捣碎、压碎或压扁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkisser f'biċċiet żgħar jew jiċċattja b'daqqiet ripetuti jew bi pressjoni qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反复捶打或捣击。
被压碎、碾碎或压扁。

collocations.en: the pepper was pounded in the mortar
the stone was crushed by the machine

formal.mt: Il-bżar nsaħaq fil-mehrież qabel ma żdied maz-zalza.
formal.en: The pepper was pounded in the mortar before being added to the sauce.
formal.zh: 胡椒先在研钵中捣碎，然后加入酱汁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-bżar għadu sħiħ? Rita: Le, nsaħaq fil-mehrież. Tista' żżidu maz-zalza issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the pepper still whole? Rita: No, it was pounded in the mortar. You can add it to the sauce now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：胡椒还是整粒的吗？丽塔：不是，已经在研钵里捣碎了。现在可以加进酱汁了。

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 胡椒还是整粒的吗？
messages.en: Is the pepper still whole?

messages.speaker: Rita (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nsaħaq fil-mehrież. Tista' żżidu maz-zalza issa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nsaħaq fil-mehrież. Tista' żżidu maz-zalza issa.
messages.zh: 不是，已经在研钵里捣碎了。现在可以加进酱汁了。
messages.en: No, it was pounded in the mortar. You can add it to the sauce now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 nsaħaq 时想研钵中的胡椒：连续捣击对应“被捣”，颗粒破碎的结果对应“被压碎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be surpassed by someone who performs better.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被表现更好的人超过或比下去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi megħlub minn xi ħadd li jagħmel aħjar minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在表现、成绩或能力等方面被别人超过；被比下去。

formal.mt: Il-kandidat nsebaq minn parteċipant ieħor li kiseb aktar punti fil-prova finali.
formal.en: The candidate was outdone by another participant who scored more points in the final test.
formal.zh: 另一位参赛者在最后一轮测试中得分更高，超过了这名候选人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar Pawlu fil-kompetizzjoni? Lara: Mar tajjeb, imma nsebaq minn ħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu do in the competition? Lara: He did well, but his brother outdid him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 比赛表现怎么样？Lara：表现不错，不过被他的兄弟比下去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 比赛表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu do in the competition?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mar tajjeb, imma nsebaq minn ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Mar tajjeb, imma nsebaq minn ħuh.
messages.zh: 表现不错，不过被他的兄弟比下去了。
messages.en: He did well, but his brother outdid him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象成绩榜上有人从自己下方升到上方，用“我被别人超过了”的视角记住 nsebaq。

gloss_zh: 被带得打转；被甩得转向

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to reel or turn around by a force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受某种力量作用而被带得打转或转向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mdawwar minn forza li taġixxi fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被外力带得打转或甩得转向。

collocations.en: was reeled around by the waves
was reeled around by the force of the water

formal.mt: Il-bastiment nsefaħ bil-forza tal-mewġ u biddel id-direzzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The ship was reeled around by the force of the waves and changed direction.
formal.zh: 船被海浪的力量带得转向，改变了航行方向。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Rajt il-bastiment idur? Rita: Iva, nsefaħ mal-mewġ; il-baħar qawwi llum.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you see the ship turn? Rita: Yes, it was reeled around by the waves; the sea is rough today.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你看到那艘船转向了吗？Rita：看到了，是被海浪带得转过去的，今天海浪很大。

messages.speaker: Mark (海边游客)
messages.zh: 你看到那艘船转向了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the ship turn?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nsefaħ mal-mewġ; il-baħar qawwi llum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nsefaħ mal-mewġ; il-baħar qawwi llum.
messages.zh: 看到了，是被海浪带得转过去的，今天海浪很大。
messages.en: Yes, it was reeled around by the waves; the sea is rough today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一艘被浪推得转向的船，再画弯箭头；用“外力带着转”的画面记住 nsefaħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have the skin removed, or to be bruised or grazed through injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮被剥去，或身体因碰撞、摩擦而受伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titneħħielu l-ġilda, jew iweġġa' b'daqqa jew bi ħakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被剥去皮。
因碰撞等而被碰伤、挫伤。

formal.mt: Il-fenek nselaħ qabel beda t-tisjir.
formal.en: The rabbit was skinned before cooking began.
formal.zh: 开始烹饪之前，兔子被剥了皮。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara lil driegħ Pawlu? Mark: Driegħu nselaħ meta waqa' waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to Pawlu's arm? Mark: His arm was bruised when he fell during the game.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 的手臂怎么了？Mark：他在比赛时摔倒，手臂碰伤了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu 的手臂怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu's arm?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Driegħu nselaħ meta waqa' waqt il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Driegħu nselaħ meta waqa' waqt il-logħba.
messages.zh: 他在比赛时摔倒，手臂碰伤了。
messages.en: His arm was bruised when he fell during the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nselaħ 分成两张场景卡：食材处理时皮被剥去，摔倒之后手臂碰伤；靠语境选择义项。

gloss_zh: 被浇水；被喂水；得到灌溉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive water through watering or irrigation, or to be given water to drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物或土地被浇水、灌溉，或人和动物被给予水喝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi l-ilma għat-tisqija, jew jingħata l-ilma biex jixrob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被浇水；得到浇灌。
被给予水或饮品喝；被喂水。
土地或作物得到灌溉。

collocations.en: the horse was given water to drink

formal.mt: Ir-raba' nseqa kmieni filgħodu, qabel ma bdiet is-sħana.
formal.en: The farmland was irrigated early in the morning, before the heat began.
formal.zh: 农田在清晨天气变热之前得到了灌溉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Iż-żiemel diġà nseqa? Mark: Iva, nseqa qabel ħriġna; issa qed jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the horse already been given water to drink? Mark: Yes, it was given water before we went out; it is resting now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：马已经喂过水了吗？Mark：喂过了，我们出门前就喂了，现在它在休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (骑手)
messages.zh: 马已经喂过水了吗？
messages.en: Has the horse already been given water to drink?

messages.speaker: Mark (马厩管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nseqa qabel ħriġna; issa qed jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nseqa qabel ħriġna; issa qed jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 喂过了，我们出门前就喂了，现在它在休息。
messages.en: Yes, it was given water before we went out; it is resting now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一桶水分向花园、马和农田：花园被浇水，马被喂水，农田被灌溉，三幅画都联系 nseqa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be taken by someone without the owner's permission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品未经物主允许被他人偷走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittieħed minn xi ħadd mingħajr il-permess ta' sidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被偷走；遭窃。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-kompjuter nseraq mill-uffiċċju matul il-lejl.
formal.en: According to the report, the computer was stolen from the office during the night.
formal.zh: 根据报告，电脑夜间在办公室内被盗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu t-telefon tiegħek? Mark: Nseraq mill-karozza lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is your phone? Mark: It was stolen from the car yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的手机在哪里？马克：昨天被人从车里偷走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手机在哪里？
messages.en: Where is your phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天被人从车里偷走了。
messages.en: It was stolen from the car yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手机原来放在车里，回来却不见了；把 nseraq 和“东西被偷走”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of catching birds using traps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用捕捉装置诱捕鸟类的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-qbid tal-għasafar permezz tan-nases.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鸟；以捕捉装置诱捕鸟类的活动。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi n-nsib tal-għasafar u l-effetti tiegħu fuq il-popolazzjonijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The study describes bird trapping and its effects on bird populations.
formal.zh: 该研究描述捕鸟活动及其对鸟类种群的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Pawlu: Dwar in-nsib tal-għasafar u l-ħajja fil-kampanja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this book about? Pawlu: About bird trapping and life in the countryside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书讲什么？保罗：讲捕鸟活动和乡村生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar in-nsib tal-għasafar u l-ħajja fil-kampanja.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar in-nsib tal-għasafar u l-ħajja fil-kampanja.
messages.zh: 讲捕鸟活动和乡村生活。
messages.en: About bird trapping and life in the countryside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nsib 放进 in-nsib tal-għasafar 整组记忆，看到“鸟类”就联想这里表示捕鸟活动的名词。

gloss_zh: 被剥去叶子；叶片被除去

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have its leaves stripped off, leaving it bare.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物的叶子被剥去或除去，变得光秃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitneħħielu l-weraq u jibqa' għeri minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被剥去叶子；用于描述叶子被除去的情况。

collocations.en: the shrub was stripped of its leaves

formal.mt: Wara l-maltempata, l-arbuxxell nsibek mill-weraq u baqgħu jidhru biss il-friegħi.
formal.en: After the storm, the shrub was stripped of its leaves, leaving only its branches visible.
formal.zh: 暴风雨过后，灌木的叶子被剥去了，只剩枝条清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan l-arbuxxell bla weraq? Toni: Nsibek mill-weraq waqt il-maltempata.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this shrub have no leaves? Toni: It was stripped of its leaves during the storm.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这丛灌木怎么没有叶子？托尼：暴风雨把它的叶子都打掉了。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 这丛灌木怎么没有叶子？
messages.en: Why does this shrub have no leaves?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.zh: 暴风雨把它的叶子都打掉了。
messages.en: It was stripped of its leaves during the storm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一丛灌木从满枝绿叶变成光秃枝条，把 nsibek 和“叶子被剥去”的前后画面对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be called or addressed by someone, for example by name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被他人叫到或呼唤，例如被叫出姓名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi msejjaħ minn xi ħadd, pereżempju b'ismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被叫到；被呼唤。

formal.mt: Il-kandidat nsieħ b'ismu u daħal fil-kamra tal-intervista.
formal.en: The candidate was called by name and entered the interview room.
formal.zh: 应聘者被叫到姓名后，走进了面试室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex daħal Mark? Luqa: Nsieħ b'ismu; issa jmiss lilu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark go in? Luqa: He was called by name; it is his turn now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克怎么进去了？卢卡：叫到他的名字了，现在轮到他。

messages.speaker: Sara (等候者)
messages.zh: 马克怎么进去了？
messages.en: Why did Mark go in?

messages.speaker: Luqa (等候者)
messages.zh: 叫到他的名字了，现在轮到他。
messages.en: He was called by name; it is his turn now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等候室里有人叫出你的名字，再把 nsieħ b'ismu 记成“他被叫到姓名”的完整场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given to someone for temporary use, with the expectation of being returned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品被交给他人暂时使用，并预期之后归还。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata lil xi ħadd biex jużah għal żmien limitat u mbagħad iroddhu lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被借出；被交给他人暂时使用。

formal.mt: Il-ktieb nsilef lil student għal ġimgħa u għandu jingħata lura nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The book was lent to a student for a week and must be returned on Monday.
formal.zh: 这本书借给一名学生使用一周，须于星期一归还。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn hu l-ktieb tal-istorja? David: Nsilef lil Pawlu għal ftit jiem.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is the history book? David: It was lent to Pawlu for a few days.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：那本历史书在哪里？戴维：借给保罗用几天了。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 那本历史书在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the history book?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nsilef lil Pawlu għal ftit jiem.
messages.mt_standard: Nsilef lil Pawlu għal ftit jiem.
messages.zh: 借给保罗用几天了。
messages.en: It was lent to Pawlu for a few days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本书暂时到了同学手里，日历上还标着归还日期；用这幅画面记住 nsilef 表示“被借出”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slip off or out of something, or to get away from someone or somewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从原来的位置滑落或滑出，也可指脱身、逃离某人或某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ jew jaqa' billi jiżloq minn postu, jew jirnexxilu jitbiegħed u jaħrab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑脱；从套着、戴着或抓着的位置滑落。
脱身；逃开；成功离开受困或受限制的处境。

collocations.en: the ring slipped off her finger
collocations.zh: 戒指从她手指上滑脱了

collocations.en: the cat got away from his grasp

formal.mt: Waqt li kienet taħsel idejha, iċ-ċurkett nsilek minn subgħajha u waqa' fis-sink.
formal.en: While she was washing her hands, the ring slipped off her finger and fell into the sink.
formal.zh: 她洗手时，戒指从手指上滑脱，掉进了洗手池。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-qattus qiegħed barra? Ben: Nsilek minn idejja meta ftaħt il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the cat outside? Ben: It got away from my grasp when I opened the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫怎么在外面？本：我开门时，它从我手里挣脱跑出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 猫怎么在外面？
messages.en: Why is the cat outside?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nsilek minn idejja meta ftaħt il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Nsilek minn idejja meta ftaħt il-bieb.
messages.zh: 我开门时，它从我手里挣脱跑出去了。
messages.en: It got away from my grasp when I opened the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象戒指滑出手指、猫挣脱双手两幅画面，用“脱离原来的束缚”串起 nsilek 的滑脱与脱身两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making fabric by interlacing threads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将线相互交织，制成布料的过程或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-ħjut jitqassmu u jinkroċjaw biex jiffurmaw drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 织布；将线交织成布料的活动。

formal.mt: Il-wirja turi l-istadji tan-nsiġ tad-drapp, mill-ħjut sal-biċċa lesta.
formal.en: The exhibition shows the stages of weaving fabric, from the threads to the finished piece.
formal.zh: 展览展示了织布的各个阶段，从线材到完成的布料。

colloquial.mt: Ella: X'qed titgħallem fil-kors? Rita: In-nsiġ; illum qed nagħmel biċċa drapp żgħira.
colloquial.en: Ella: What are you learning on the course? Rita: Weaving; today I am making a small piece of fabric.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：你在课程里学什么？丽塔：织布；今天我在织一小块布。

messages.speaker: Ella (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在课程里学什么？
messages.en: What are you learning on the course?

messages.speaker: Rita (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nsiġ; illum qed nagħmel biċċa drapp żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: In-nsiġ; illum qed nagħmel biċċa drapp żgħira.
messages.zh: 织布；今天我在织一小块布。
messages.en: Weaving; today I am making a small piece of fabric.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nsiġ 对应到一根根线交叉成为布的过程，并和 nsiġ tad-drapp 一起记成名词“织布”。

gloss_zh: 发觉自己处于某种心境

teaching_sense.en_definition: To find oneself in a particular emotional or mental state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发觉自己处于某种情绪或心理状态之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isib ruħu f'ċerta qagħda emozzjonali jew fi stat mentali partikolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: to find oneself (to be in a particular state of mind)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发觉自己处于某种心境或心理状态之中。

collocations.en: found himself in a state of confusion
collocations.zh: 发觉自己陷入困惑之中

collocations.en: found himself in a state of anxiety
collocations.zh: 发觉自己处于焦虑状态

formal.mt: Wara li qara l-ittra, Mark nstab fi stat ta' konfużjoni u kellu bżonn ħin biex jaħseb.
formal.en: After reading the letter, Mark found himself in a state of confusion and needed time to think.
formal.zh: 读完信后，马克发觉自己陷入困惑，需要一些时间思考。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif ħassu Mark wara dik l-aħbar? Lara: Nstab fi stat ta' konfużjoni, allura qgħadt nitkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did Mark feel after that news? Lara: He found himself confused, so I stayed and talked to him.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：听到那个消息后，马克感觉怎么样？拉拉：他一下子陷入困惑，所以我留下来陪他聊了聊。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassu Mark wara dik l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassu Mark wara dik l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 听到那个消息后，马克感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark feel after that news?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nstab fi stat ta' konfużjoni, allura qgħadt nitkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Nstab fi stat ta' konfużjoni, allura qgħadt nitkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 他一下子陷入困惑，所以我留下来陪他聊了聊。
messages.en: He found himself confused, so I stayed and talked to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读完一封信后才意识到自己很困惑；把 nstab fi stat ta' konfużjoni 整组记成“发觉自己处于困惑状态”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become blocked so that passage is obstructed; also, to become constipated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通道被堵住，导致东西无法通过；也指人出现便秘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħalaq passaġġ u ma jħallix l-affarijiet jgħaddu; ukoll, li persuna jkollha diffikultà biex tippurgaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被堵住；发生堵塞。
便秘；排便困难。

collocations.en: Mark was constipated for two days.

formal.mt: Il-pajp tal-kċina nstadd bix-xaħam, u l-ilma ma setax jgħaddi.
formal.en: The kitchen pipe became blocked with grease, and the water could not pass through.
formal.zh: 厨房的管道被油脂堵住，水无法流过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma jħossux tajjeb? Lara: Qalli li nstadd u li ilu jumejn ma jippurga.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Mark feeling unwell? Lara: He told me he was constipated and hadn't had a bowel movement for two days.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么不舒服？拉拉：他告诉我他便秘了，已经两天没有排便了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么不舒服？
messages.en: Why is Mark feeling unwell?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li nstadd u li ilu jumejn ma jippurga.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li nstadd u li ilu jumejn ma jippurga.
messages.zh: 他告诉我他便秘了，已经两天没有排便了。
messages.en: He told me he was constipated and hadn't had a bowel movement for two days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项并排记：管道堵了水不通，人便秘了排便不通；具体含义由主语判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be heard, as when a sound or voice reaches someone's ears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音或说话声被人听见，强调声音传到了听者耳中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ħoss jew leħen jasal għand xi ħadd u jinstema' minn dik il-persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被听见；声音传入耳中。

collocations.zh: 从远处传来；在远处被听见

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, il-leħen tal-kelliem nstama' ċar fis-sala kollha.
formal.en: During the meeting, the speaker's voice was heard clearly throughout the hall.
formal.zh: 会议期间，整个大厅都能清楚地听见发言者的声音。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Iva, nstama' anki mill-kċina.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear that noise? Pawlu: Yes, it could even be heard from the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见那个声音了吗？保罗：听见了，连在厨房里都能听到。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，连在厨房里都能听到。
messages.en: Yes, it could even be heard from the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象声音从远处传进耳朵：句子的焦点是声音被听见，记词时也保留末尾的撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be injured by scalding, usually through contact with hot water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因接触高温液体而被烫伤，通常指被热水烫伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsofri ħruq, ġeneralment minħabba kuntatt ma' ilma sħun ħafna.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be scalded (usually with hot water)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烫伤，通常指被热水烫伤。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem nstamat f'idu meta l-ilma sħun inxtered mill-kontenitur.
formal.en: The worker was scalded on his hand when hot water spilled from the container.
formal.zh: 热水从容器中洒出时，那名工人的手被烫伤了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara lil Ben fil-kċina? Mark: Nstamat bl-ilma sħun waqt li kien qed jagħmel it-te.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to Ben in the kitchen? Mark: He was scalded by hot water while making tea.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：本在厨房里怎么了？马克：他泡茶的时候被热水烫伤了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 本在厨房里怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Ben in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nstamat bl-ilma sħun waqt li kien qed jagħmel it-te.
messages.mt_standard: Nstamat bl-ilma sħun waqt li kien qed jagħmel it-te.
messages.zh: 他泡茶的时候被热水烫伤了。
messages.en: He was scalded by hot water while making tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用泡茶时热水洒到手上的画面记忆：这里强调已经被烫伤，而不只是觉得水很热。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stolen, with something taken by another person without permission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物未经许可被他人偷走，强调物品遭到盗窃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tittieħed minn xi ħadd mingħajr permess, b'serq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被偷走；遭到盗窃。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-kompjuter nsteraq mill-uffiċċju matul il-lejl.
formal.en: According to the report, the computer was stolen from the office during the night.
formal.zh: 据报告，那台电脑夜间在办公室内失窃。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu t-telefon tiegħek? Mark: Nsteraq mill-karozza lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is your phone? Mark: It was stolen from the car yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的手机在哪里？马克：昨天被人从车里偷走了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手机在哪里？
messages.en: Where is your phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天被人从车里偷走了。
messages.en: It was stolen from the car yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本放在车里的手机被小偷拿走：把手机作为句子焦点，就能记住“被偷走”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be overwhelmed by demands, difficulties, or feelings that become too much to manage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因任务、困难或情绪过于强烈而难以承受或应付。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss li x-xogħol, id-diffikultajiet jew l-emozzjonijiet huma wisq għalih biex ilaħħaq magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被压倒；因负担、困难或情绪而难以承受。

collocations.zh: 被种种问题压得难以承受

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur nsteħet bix-xogħol meta waslu diversi talbiet fl-istess ħin.
formal.en: The coordinator was overwhelmed by work when several requests arrived at the same time.
formal.zh: 几项请求同时到来时，协调员被工作压得难以应付。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Ġanni talab l-għajnuna? Maja: Nsteħet bix-xogħol; kellu wisq affarijiet x'jagħmel f'daqqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Ġanni ask for help? Maja: He was overwhelmed by work; he had too many things to do at once.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：詹尼为什么求助？玛雅：他忙得应付不过来了，同时要做的事情太多。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 詹尼为什么求助？
messages.en: Why did Ġanni ask for help?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nsteħet bix-xogħol; kellu wisq affarijiet x'jagħmel f'daqqa.
messages.mt_standard: Nsteħet bix-xogħol; kellu wisq affarijiet x'jagħmel f'daqqa.
messages.zh: 他忙得应付不过来了，同时要做的事情太多。
messages.en: He was overwhelmed by work; he had too many things to do at once.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象许多任务同时堆到一个人面前，超过他的承受能力；用“多到应付不过来”记住这个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be printed, with text or images reproduced on paper or another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文字或图像通过印刷、打印等方式呈现在纸张或其他表面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li test jew stampa jitqiegħed fuq karta jew wiċċ ieħor permezz tal-istampar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被印刷；被打印出来。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ntabagħ bil-kulur sabiex il-qarrejja setgħu jaraw il-grafiċi b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The report was printed in colour so that readers could see the charts clearly.
formal.zh: 报告采用彩色打印，以便读者清楚地查看图表。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-poster lest? Pawlu: Iva, ntabagħ dalgħodu fuq karta ħoxna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the poster ready? Pawlu: Yes, it was printed this morning on thick paper.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：海报准备好了吗？保罗：好了，今天早上已经印在厚纸上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 海报准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the poster ready?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (印刷店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ntabagħ dalgħodu fuq karta ħoxna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ntabagħ dalgħodu fuq karta ħoxna.
messages.zh: 好了，今天早上已经印在厚纸上了。
messages.en: Yes, it was printed this morning on thick paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把电子文稿变成纸上海报的画面记住：文稿或海报是被印出来的对象，颜色和纸张可接着说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clean or wash oneself, making one's own body clean.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清洗自己的身体，使自己保持洁净。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li persuna taħsel lilha nfisha biex tnaddaf ġisimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清洗自己；洗净自己的身体。

collocations.en: washed himself with water and soap
collocations.zh: 用水和肥皂清洗了身体

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol fl-għalqa, il-bidwi ntadar bl-ilma u s-sapun qabel ma libes ħwejjeġ nodfa.
formal.en: After working in the field, the farmer washed himself with water and soap before putting on clean clothes.
formal.zh: 在田里干完活后，农夫先用水和肥皂清洗身体，再换上干净衣服。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ben għadu maħmuġ wara x-xogħol fil-ġnien? Lara: Le, diġà ntadar u biddel ħwejġu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is Ben still dirty after working in the garden? Lara: No, he has already washed himself and changed his clothes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：本在花园干完活后，身上还脏着吗？拉拉：没有，他已经洗干净，也换过衣服了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ben għadu maħmuġ wara x-xogħol fil-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Ben għadu maħmuġ wara x-xogħol fil-ġnien?
messages.zh: 本在花园干完活后，身上还脏着吗？
messages.en: Is Ben still dirty after working in the garden?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà ntadar u biddel ħwejġu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà ntadar u biddel ħwejġu.
messages.zh: 没有，他已经洗干净，也换过衣服了。
messages.en: No, he has already washed himself and changed his clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象园艺劳动后洗去自己身上的泥土：动作的执行者和被清洗的人是同一个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown, chucked, or flung from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人扔出、随手抛去或用力甩向另一处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintrema jew jitwaddab minn post għal ieħor, xi drabi b'saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔出；被抛向某处。
被随手扔去；被随意抛开。
被用力抛出；被猛地甩出。

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, il-ballun ntafa' fl-arja sabiex il-plejer seta' jipprattika kif jaqbdu.
formal.en: During training, the ball was thrown into the air so that the player could practise catching it.
formal.zh: 训练时，球被抛向空中，让球员练习接球。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn mar il-kuxxin? Mark: Ntafa' b'saħħa minn fuq is-sufan u spiċċa ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did the cushion go? Mark: It was flung forcefully off the sofa and ended up beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：靠垫到哪里去了？马克：它被人从沙发上用力甩出去，最后落在门边。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 靠垫到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the cushion go?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntafa' b'saħħa minn fuq is-sufan u spiċċa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ntafa' b'saħħa minn fuq is-sufan u spiċċa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 它被人从沙发上用力甩出去，最后落在门边。
messages.en: It was flung forcefully off the sofa and ended up beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 连看三个动作画面：普通抛球、随手扔物、用力甩垫；共同点都是物体被扔向另一处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given food to eat by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由他人给予食物吃，或由他人喂食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-ikel minn xi ħadd biex jiekol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被给予食物吃；受到喂食。

collocations.en: the dog was fed in the morning

formal.mt: Il-pazjent ntagħam skont l-istruzzjonijiet tat-tabib, u l-ħin tal-ikla ġie rreġistrat.
formal.en: The patient was fed according to the doctor's instructions, and the time of the meal was recorded.
formal.zh: 病人按医生的指示接受了喂食，用餐时间也已记录。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelb diġà ntagħam? Mark: Iva, tajtu l-ikel qabel ħriġt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the dog already been fed? Mark: Yes, I gave him his food before I went out.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：狗已经喂过了吗？马克：是的，我出门前给它吃过东西了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 狗已经喂过了吗？
messages.en: Has the dog already been fed?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是的，我出门前给它吃过东西了。
messages.en: Yes, I gave him his food before I went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象照料者把食物送到孩子或小狗面前，记住句子的焦点是接受食物的一方：ntagħam 表示被喂食，不必把喂食者说出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be asked for, or to be asked to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某事物被提出请求，或某人被请求、被要求做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ssir talba għal xi ħaġa jew li persuna tintalab tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被请求；被要求。可指某物被请求提供，也可指某人被请求做某事。

collocations.zh: 已以书面形式申请许可。

collocations.en: The doctor was asked to give advice.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ntalab mill-kumitat biex ikun jista' jevalwa l-proposta.
formal.en: The report was requested by the committee so that it could evaluate the proposal.
formal.zh: 委员会要求提供该报告，以便评估这项提案。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-permess għall-ħarġa diġà ntalab? Pawlu: Iva, ntalab ilbieraħ. Issa qed nistennew it-tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has permission for the outing been requested yet? Pawlu: Yes, it was requested yesterday. Now we're waiting for the reply.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：出游的许可已经申请了吗？保罗：是的，昨天申请了。现在我们在等回复。

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.zh: 出游的许可已经申请了吗？
messages.en: Has permission for the outing been requested yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ntalab ilbieraħ. Issa qed nistennew it-tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ntalab ilbieraħ. Issa qed nistennew it-tweġiba.
messages.zh: 是的，昨天申请了。现在我们在等回复。
messages.en: Yes, it was requested yesterday. Now we're waiting for the reply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“许可被申请、医生被请教”两个画面记忆 ntalab：注意主语承受请求，并把“被要求做某事”与后面的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a hole or holes made through it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物被打出或刺出一个或多个贯穿的孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsiru toqba jew toqob minn naħa għal oħra ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被打孔；被穿孔，指物体上被弄出贯穿的孔洞。

collocations.en: The cardboard was pierced with a needle.
The lid had a hole made through its centre.
collocations.zh: 盖子的正中央被打出了一个孔。

formal.mt: Il-pannell ntaqab f'erba' postijiet biex jitwaħħal mal-ħajt bil-viti.
formal.en: The panel was perforated at four points so that it could be attached to the wall with screws.
formal.zh: 面板上打了四个孔，以便用螺丝将其固定在墙上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-kartun għandu dawn it-toqob? Mark: Ntaqab biex ngħaddu l-ħajt minnu u ndendlu t-tpinġija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the cardboard have these holes? Mark: It had holes made in it so we can pass thread through it and hang up the drawing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：纸板上为什么有这些孔？马克：这些孔是打来穿线的，这样我们就能把画挂起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 纸板上为什么有这些孔？
messages.en: Why does the cardboard have these holes?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntaqab biex ngħaddu l-ħajt minnu u ndendlu t-tpinġija.
messages.mt_standard: Ntaqab biex ngħaddu l-ħajt minnu u ndendlu t-tpinġija.
messages.zh: 这些孔是打来穿线的，这样我们就能把画挂起来。
messages.en: It had holes made in it so we can pass thread through it and hang up the drawing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象纸板被打孔后，一根线从孔里穿过：把 ntaqab 和“物体被穿出孔”的画面绑定，重点记住受到打孔动作的物体。

gloss_zh: 被凿刻；被雕塑；被雕刻；被刮削；被削制

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a material or object shaped, marked, or reduced by chiseling, sculpting, carving, scraping, or whittling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指材料或物件受到凿刻、雕塑、雕刻、刮削或削制，形成形状、留下刻痕或去除部分材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li materjal jew oġġett jingħata forma, jitħalla b'marki jew jitnaqqas permezz tat-tinqix, l-iskultura, il-brix jew it-tqaxxir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用凿子凿刻或凿出形状。
被雕塑成具有立体形态的作品。
被雕刻，形成图案、文字或具体形状。
被刮削，表面材料受到刮除。
被用刀逐步削去小片材料，削制成形。

collocations.zh: 被雕刻在大理石上；以大理石雕成
被雕刻在木头上；以木头雕成

formal.mt: Il-bust ntaqax fl-irħam skont id-disinn approvat.
formal.en: The bust was sculpted in marble according to the approved design.
formal.zh: 这座半身像按照获批的设计用大理石雕成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ħadem dan l-għasfur tal-injam? Pawlu: Dan ntaqax bl-idejn minn missieri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made this wooden bird? Pawlu: It was carved by hand by my father.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这只木鸟是谁做的？保罗：这是我爸爸手工雕刻的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只木鸟是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this wooden bird?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是我爸爸手工雕刻的。
messages.en: It was carved by hand by my father.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把木鸟想成句子的主角：它接受雕刻，所以是“被雕成”。再联想石头被凿、表面被刮、木条被削，把几个义项串成材料接受加工的画面；这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be seen or visually noticed by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个人或事物被他人用眼睛看见或注意到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li persuna jew ħaġa tiġi osservata jew innutata bl-għajnejn minn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被看见；进入他人的视线而被观察到。

collocations.zh: 被看见出现在学校附近

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-vapur ntara mill-bogħod kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: According to the report, the ship was seen from a distance early in the morning.
formal.zh: 据报告，这艘船清晨被人从远处看见。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Hemm xi aħbar dwar il-qattus tagħna? Ġanni: Iva, dalgħodu ntara ħdejn l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is there any news about our cat? Ġanni: Yes, it was seen near the school this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：有我们家猫的消息吗？詹尼：有，今天早上有人在学校附近看见它了。

messages.speaker: Marija (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi aħbar dwar il-qattus tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi aħbar dwar il-qattus tagħna?
messages.zh: 有我们家猫的消息吗？
messages.en: Is there any news about our cat?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.zh: 有，今天早上有人在学校附近看见它了。
messages.en: Yes, it was seen near the school this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象寻找走失的猫，邻居报告“它被看见了”。把 ntara 和猫进入别人视线的画面联系起来，记住句中主角是被看见的对象；这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pursued or followed by someone moving after you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被他人追赶，或被人跟在后面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun hemm xi ħadd jiġri warajk jew jimxi warajk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被追赶；被追逐。
被跟随；有人跟在后面。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel ntarad mill-pulizija wara li ħarab mill-post.
formal.en: The man was pursued by the police after he fled the scene.
formal.zh: 那名男子逃离现场后遭到警察追赶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex beda jiġri dak it-tifel? Pawlu: Għax ntarad minn kelb, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did that boy start running? Pawlu: Because he was chased by a dog, but he's all right now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩为什么突然跑起来？保罗：因为有只狗追他，不过他现在没事了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么突然跑起来？
messages.en: Why did that boy start running?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ntarad minn kelb, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ntarad minn kelb, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 因为有只狗追他，不过他现在没事了。
messages.en: Because he was chased by a dog, but he's all right now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人走在前面，后面有人追赶或跟随；把 ntarad 与“自己是被追、被跟的一方”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For eggs to be pushed out of an animal's body during laying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指蛋在动物产卵时被从体内排出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-bajd meta jinħareġ mill-ġisem tal-annimal waqt it-tbid.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be pushed out (used of eggs during laying)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挤出、被排出，专指蛋在产卵过程中排出体外。

collocations.en: the eggs were pushed out during laying
the eggs were pushed out without difficulty

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tat-tiġieġa, il-bajd ntarr mingħajr diffikultà.
formal.en: During observation of the hen, the eggs were pushed out without difficulty.
formal.zh: 观察这只母鸡时，蛋顺利排出了体外。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tiġieġa biedet? Toni: Iva, il-bajd ntarr bla diffikultà.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the hen laid her eggs? Toni: Yes, the eggs came out without difficulty.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：母鸡下蛋了吗？托尼：下了，蛋很顺利地排出来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (养鸡人)
messages.zh: 母鸡下蛋了吗？
messages.en: Has the hen laid her eggs?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 下了，蛋很顺利地排出来了。
messages.en: Yes, the eggs came out without difficulty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntarr 放进母鸡下蛋的画面：关注的是“蛋被排出来”，记住这里描述蛋在产卵时的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For stone, to be cut or shaped for use in building; for a person, to become more refined in manners.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指石材经过切削、修整而适合建筑使用；也指人的举止变得更文雅、更有教养。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta jingħad għall-ġebel, jiġi maqtugħ jew iffurmat għall-bini; meta jingħad għal persuna, issir aktar edukata fl-imġiba tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （指石材）被切削、修整或加工成所需形状。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiġi maqtugħ jew iffurmat kif meħtieġ, meta jingħad għall-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be refined in one's manners
sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止变得文雅，待人接物变得更有教养。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isir aktar edukat u raffinat fl-imġiba tiegħu.

collocations.en: stone that was dressed for construction
collocations.zh: 为建筑用途修整过的石材

collocations.en: he became more refined in his manners
collocations.zh: 他的举止变得更文雅了

formal.mt: Il-ġebel għall-faċċata ntaġar b'attenzjoni sabiex kull biċċa tidħol sewwa f'postha.
formal.en: The stone for the façade was carefully dressed so that each piece would fit properly in its place.
formal.zh: 用于建筑立面的石材经过仔细修整，以便每块石头都能准确嵌入相应位置。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-ġebel diġà ntaġar? Pawlu: Iva, issa lest biex jinbena l-ħajt bih.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has this stone already been dressed? Pawlu: Yes, it is now ready to be used to build the wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这些石材已经修整好了吗？保罗：是的，现在可以用来砌墙了。

messages.speaker: Marija (屋主)
messages.zh: 这些石材已经修整好了吗？
messages.en: Has this stone already been dressed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (石匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa lest biex jinbena l-ħajt bih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa lest biex jinbena l-ħajt bih.
messages.zh: 是的，现在可以用来砌墙了。
messages.en: Yes, it is now ready to be used to build the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记义：石头经过修整，边角变得合用；人的举止经过培养，待人变得文雅。这只是帮助区分两个义项的学习联想。

gloss_zh: 被磨碎；在碰撞后严重受伤

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be crushed into powder or small particles by grinding; also, to be badly injured in a collision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指东西被研磨成粉末或细小颗粒；也可指人在碰撞事故中严重受伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal xi ħaġa li ssir trab jew frak bit-tħin; jingħad ukoll għal persuna li tweġġa' ħafna f'ħabta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被研磨；被磨成粉末或细小颗粒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be injured badly after a collision (e.g. in a car accident)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在碰撞后严重受伤，例如在交通事故中受到重伤。

collocations.en: was badly injured in a collision

formal.mt: Il-qamħ ntaħan fil-mitħna u d-dqiq tpoġġa f'boroż nodfa.
formal.en: The wheat was ground at the mill, and the flour was placed in clean bags.
formal.zh: 小麦在磨坊里被磨成粉，随后面粉被装进干净的袋子里。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-ħabta? David: Ntaħan, iżda issa qed jieħu l-kura fl-isptar.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is Pawlu after the collision? David: He was badly injured, but he is receiving treatment in hospital now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗碰撞事故后情况怎么样？戴维：他伤得很重，不过现在正在医院接受治疗。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗碰撞事故后情况怎么样？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after the collision?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntaħan, iżda issa qed jieħu l-kura fl-isptar.
messages.mt_standard: Ntaħan, iżda issa qed jieħu l-kura fl-isptar.
messages.zh: 他伤得很重，不过现在正在医院接受治疗。
messages.en: He was badly injured, but he is receiving treatment in hospital now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅情景卡记 ntaħan：一幅是小麦被磨成粉，一幅是人在碰撞后受重伤。看到小麦、磨坊就联想“被磨碎”，看到人物和碰撞就联想“严重受伤”；这是帮助辨义的情景联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have the throat or neck cut, said of an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于动物，表示其喉部或颈部被割。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal annimal meta jinqatagħlu għonqu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be cut (used of an animal's throat or neck)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被割，专用于描述动物的喉部或颈部被割。

collocations.en: an animal whose throat or neck was cut
collocations.zh: 喉部或颈部被割的动物

collocations.en: had its throat cut at the slaughterhouse

formal.mt: Ir-rapport veterinarju jiddeskrivi annimal li ntaħar fil-biċċerija.
formal.en: The veterinary report describes an animal whose throat was cut at the slaughterhouse.
formal.zh: 兽医报告描述了一只在屠宰场被割喉的动物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'ntaħar' f'din is-sentenza dwar il-ħaruf? Mark: Ifisser li l-ħaruf inqatagħlu għonqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ntaħar' mean in this sentence about the lamb? Mark: It means that the lamb had its throat or neck cut.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这句讲小羊的话里，'ntaħar' 是什么意思？马克：意思是小羊的喉部或颈部被割了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'ntaħar' f'din is-sentenza dwar il-ħaruf?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'ntaħar' f'din is-sentenza dwar il-ħaruf?
messages.zh: 这句讲小羊的话里，'ntaħar' 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ntaħar' mean in this sentence about the lamb?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是小羊的喉部或颈部被割了。
messages.en: It means that the lamb had its throat or neck cut.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntaħar 写在“兽医报告：动物颈喉被割”的情景卡上，连同动物这一使用对象一起记。再留意末尾字母 r，帮助与末尾为 n 的 ntaħan 区分；这是拼写辨认提示，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For an item of clothing to be taken off the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指衣物从身上被脱下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal ilbies meta jitneħħa minn fuq il-ġisem.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be taken off (used of clothing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被脱下，指身上穿着的衣物被取下。

collocations.en: the coat was taken off on arrival

formal.mt: Il-kowt imxarrab ntaża' qabel ma r-raġel qagħad bilqiegħda.
formal.en: The wet coat was taken off before the man sat down.
formal.zh: 那名男子坐下之前，身上湿透的外套被脱了下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-kowt ta' Mark? Nina: Il-kowt ntaża' malli daħal; qiegħed fuq is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Mark's coat? Nina: The coat was taken off as soon as he came in; it's on the chair.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克的外套在哪儿？妮娜：他一进来外套就脱下了，在椅子上。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克的外套在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Mark's coat?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kowt ntaża' malli daħal; qiegħed fuq is-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kowt ntaża' malli daħal; qiegħed fuq is-siġġu.
messages.zh: 他一进来外套就脱下了，在椅子上。
messages.en: The coat was taken off as soon as he came in; it's on the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象外套从肩膀滑下来，放到椅子上；用这个动作记住 ntaża' 表示“衣物被脱下”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For intestinal gas to be expelled as a fart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指肠道内的气体以放屁的方式被排出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-gass tal-imsaren meta jinħareġ bħala bass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被以放屁的方式排出，指肠气。

collocations.zh: 无声地以屁的形式排出

collocations.en: was farted out with a loud noise
collocations.zh: 伴着很大的声响以屁的形式排出

formal.mt: Il-gass ntbass bla ma nstema' ħoss.
formal.en: The gas was farted out without any audible sound.
formal.zh: 这股肠气以放屁的方式排出，没有发出可听见的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ntbass'? Pawlu: Ifisser li gass ħareġ mill-imsaren bħala bass.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ntbass' mean? Pawlu: It means that gas came out of the intestines as a fart.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：ntbass 是什么意思？保罗：意思是肠道里的气体以屁的形式排出来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ntbass 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ntbass' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li gass ħareġ mill-imsaren bħala bass.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li gass ħareġ mill-imsaren bħala bass.
messages.zh: 意思是肠道里的气体以屁的形式排出来了。
messages.en: It means that gas came out of the intestines as a fart.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“肠气被排出”的身体动作记住 ntbass；练习时把注意力放在被排出的气体上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made moist, dunked into a liquid, or dipped into it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被弄湿、润湿，或被浸入、蘸入液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixxarrab jew jiddaħħal f'likwidu, pereżempju ħobż fil-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被润湿；被弄得微湿。
被浸入液体中，常指食物被放入饮料等液体里浸一下。
被蘸入液体；一部分或短暂地被浸入。

collocations.en: the bread was dunked in milk
the cloth was moistened with water

formal.mt: Id-drapp ntbell bi ftit ilma qabel ma ntuża biex jitnaddaf il-wiċċ.
formal.en: The cloth was moistened with a little water before it was used to clean the surface.
formal.zh: 这块布先用少量水润湿，再用来清洁表面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħobż sar artab? Toni: Għax ntbell fil-ħalib. Trid ftit?
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has the bread gone soft? Toni: Because it was dunked in milk. Would you like some?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：面包怎么变软了？托尼：因为浸过牛奶。你要来一点吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 面包怎么变软了？
messages.en: Why has the bread gone soft?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 因为浸过牛奶。你要来一点吗？
messages.en: Because it was dunked in milk. Would you like some?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包蘸进牛奶后变湿变软；把 ntbell 的“润湿、浸入、蘸入”三个意思串成一个画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be closed tightly, leaving no opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被紧紧关上或严实合拢，不留开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħalaq sewwa, mingħajr ma jibqa' miftuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被紧紧关上；被严实合拢。

formal.mt: L-għatu ntebaq sew sabiex it-trab ma jidħolx fil-kaxxa.
formal.en: The lid was shut tight so that dust would not enter the box.
formal.zh: 盖子被严实盖好，以免灰尘进入盒子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bieb għadu miftuħ? Pawlu: Le, ntebaq mar-riħ. Tista' tiftaħuli?
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the door still open? Pawlu: No, the wind blew it shut tight. Can you open it for me?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门还开着吗？保罗：没有，风把它吹得严严实实地关上了。你能帮我打开吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 门还开着吗？
messages.en: Is the door still open?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 没有，风把它吹得严严实实地关上了。你能帮我打开吗？
messages.en: No, the wind blew it shut tight. Can you open it for me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门缝中的最后一线光也消失了；用“完全合紧”的画面记住 ntebaq 所强调的关闭状态。

gloss_zh: 意识到；终于明白；另义：被煮熟

teaching_sense.en_definition: To realise or come to understand something; in a separate sense, to be cooked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意识到某件事，或终于弄明白；另有“被煮熟”的独立义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinduna b'xi ħaġa jew jifhem x'qiegħed jiġri; f'tifsira oħra, jissajjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意识到；察觉到某个事实或情况。
突然明白；终于领会，带口语色彩。
逐渐或终于弄懂；领会正在发生的事情，带口语色彩。
被烹煮；被煮熟。

formal.mt: Wara li reġa' qara r-rapport, l-awtur ntebaħ li kien hemm żball fil-kalkolu.
formal.en: After rereading the report, the author realised that there was an error in the calculation.
formal.zh: 作者重新阅读报告后，意识到计算中存在一处错误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark għadu jaħseb li qed niċċajtaw? Nina: Le, fl-aħħar intebaħ li qed nitkellmu bis-serjetà.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does Mark still think we're joking? Nina: No, he has finally cottoned on that we're being serious.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克还以为我们在开玩笑吗？妮娜：没有，他终于明白我们是认真的了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark għadu jaħseb li qed niċċajtaw?
messages.mt_standard: Mark għadu jaħseb li qed niċċajtaw?
messages.zh: 马克还以为我们在开玩笑吗？
messages.en: Does Mark still think we're joking?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fl-aħħar intebaħ li qed nitkellmu bis-serjetà.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fl-aħħar intebaħ li qed nitkellmu bis-serjetà.
messages.zh: 没有，他终于明白我们是认真的了。
messages.en: No, he has finally cottoned on that we're being serious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“脑中灯泡亮了”记住意识到、终于懂了；把“被煮熟”另做一张义项卡，避免混成同一意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be used up or paid out, especially when referring to money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指钱款等被花出去或被用掉，重点在被支出的金额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal flus li ġew użati biex jitħallas xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被花费；被支出

formal.mt: Il-baġit kollu ntefaq fuq it-tiswija tal-bini.
formal.en: The entire budget was spent on repairing the building.
formal.zh: 全部预算都用于修缮大楼。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn mar il-bqija tal-flus? Pawlu: Ntefaq fuq l-ikel għall-festa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where did the rest of the money go? Pawlu: It was spent on food for the party.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：剩下的钱去哪儿了？保罗：花在聚会的食物上了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 剩下的钱去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the rest of the money go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 花在聚会的食物上了。
messages.en: It was spent on food for the party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象账本上一笔钱被划入支出栏：ntefaq强调钱被花掉，可连同fuq记住花在哪一项。

gloss_zh: 肿胀；膨胀；变得骄傲自负

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swell or increase in size; figuratively, to become proud or vain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肿胀或膨大；也可比喻人变得骄傲、自负。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fil-volum jew jintefaħ; b'mod figurattiv, isir kburi jew minfuħ bih innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肿胀；膨胀；体积变大。
变得骄傲或自负；因自我感觉良好而得意膨胀。

formal.mt: Wara l-ġrieħi, is-saba' ntefaħ u l-moviment tiegħu sar diffiċli.
formal.en: After the injuries, the finger swelled and became difficult to move.
formal.zh: 受伤后，手指肿了起来，活动也变得困难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark qed jiftaħar daqshekk? Toni: Minn meta rebaħ il-premju, ntefaħ bil-kburija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is Mark boasting so much? Toni: Since he won the prize, he's become full of himself.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克怎么这么爱炫耀？托尼：自从拿了奖，他就变得得意自满了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么这么爱炫耀？
messages.en: Why is Mark boasting so much?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn meta rebaħ il-premju, ntefaħ bil-kburija.
messages.mt_standard: Minn meta rebaħ il-premju, ntefaħ bil-kburija.
messages.zh: 自从拿了奖，他就变得得意自满了。
messages.en: Since he won the prize, he's become full of himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntefaħ 联想到中文“膨胀”：手指可以真的肿胀，人也可以因获奖而心理膨胀，串联两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very tiny amount of something; the diminutive form of 'nitfa'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物极少的一点点，是nitfa的指小形式，用来突出数量非常少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir ħafna ta' xi ħaġa; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'nitfa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一丁点；极少量，nitfa的指小形式

formal.mt: Żid ntejfa melħ mat-taħlita u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add a tiny bit of salt to the mixture and stir well.
formal.zh: 在混合物中加入一丁点盐，并充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid zokkor fil-kafè? Mark: Iva, imma ntejfa biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like sugar in your coffee? Mark: Yes, but just a tiny bit.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：咖啡里要加糖吗？马克：要，不过只加一丁点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 咖啡里要加糖吗？
messages.en: Would you like sugar in your coffee?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，不过只加一丁点。
messages.en: Yes, but just a tiny bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指尖只捏起几粒盐：ntejfa就是这一丁点。把ntejfa biss一起记，表示仅仅一点点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reach a particular amount or total.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指数额或总数达到某个数值，相当于合计为或总计达到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laħaq ammont jew total partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合计为；总计达到

collocations.en: the bill amounted to one hundred euros
the total amounted to one thousand euros

formal.mt: Il-kont għax-xogħol kollu ntela' għal ħames mitt ewro.
formal.en: The bill for all the work amounted to five hundred euros.
formal.zh: 全部工作的账单合计五百欧元。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm ntela' l-kont? Mark: Ntela' għal sittin ewro, kollox flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much did the bill come to? Mark: It came to sixty euros altogether.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：账单一共多少？马克：全部加起来六十欧元。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 账单一共多少？
messages.en: How much did the bill come to?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntela' għal sittin ewro, kollox flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ntela' għal sittin ewro, kollox flimkien.
messages.zh: 全部加起来六十欧元。
messages.en: It came to sixty euros altogether.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收银员把各项金额相加，最后指向总额：ntela'对应合计达到，可搭配għal和具体金额记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slump down, let oneself go, or relax, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指身体松垮地瘫坐或倒下，也可指放任自己、不再自我约束，或放松休息；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla ġismu jaqa' jew jintelaq, waqaf jieħu ħsieb lilu nnifsu, jew irrilassa, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体松垮地瘫坐或倒下
放任自己；不再注意自身的状态或自我约束
放松；松弛下来休息

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata twila ta' xogħol, il-ħaddiem ntelaq fuq is-sufan biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After a long day at work, the worker slumped onto the sofa to rest.
formal.zh: 工作了一整天后，那名工人瘫坐在沙发上休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu Pawlu? Anna: Għadu kif wasal u ntelaq fuq is-sufan. Kien għajjien ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is Pawlu? Anna: He just arrived and slumped onto the sofa. He was very tired.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗在哪儿？安娜：他刚到家就瘫坐在沙发上了。他累坏了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kif wasal u ntelaq fuq is-sufan. Kien għajjien ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kif wasal u ntelaq fuq is-sufan. Kien għajjien ħafna.
messages.zh: 他刚到家就瘫坐在沙发上了。他累坏了。
messages.en: He just arrived and slumped onto the sofa. He was very tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用下班后整个人陷进沙发的画面记ntelaq：身体可以瘫下来，精神可以放松；若说长期不管自己，则是放任自己。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come to an end, be fulfilled, or reach completion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指事情结束、要求或承诺得到履行，或工作达到完成状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wasal fi tmiemu, ġie mwettaq jew ġie komplut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结束；告终
得到履行或实现
被完成；达到完整完成的状态

formal.mt: Il-proġett ntemm fiż-żmien miftiehem.
formal.en: The project was completed within the agreed time.
formal.zh: 项目在约定的时间内完成了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ntemm il-film? Lara: Iva, ntemm ftit ilu. Issa nistgħu noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has the film ended? Lara: Yes, it ended a little while ago. We can go out now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：电影结束了吗？拉拉：是的，刚结束不久。我们现在可以出去了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影结束了吗？
messages.en: Has the film ended?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ntemm ftit ilu. Issa nistgħu noħorġu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ntemm ftit ilu. Issa nistgħu noħorġu.
messages.zh: 是的，刚结束不久。我们现在可以出去了。
messages.en: Yes, it ended a little while ago. We can go out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ntemm放在终点线旁记忆：电影到了终点是结束，项目到了终点是完成，承诺落实到位是得到履行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be folded or bent over into a different position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体被折叠起来，或某一部分被弯折过去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie mitwi jew milwi b'tali mod li parti minnu daret fuq parti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被折叠；被叠起来
被折弯；被弯折过去

formal.mt: Il-kartun ntena bin-nofs qabel tqiegħed fil-kaxxa.
formal.en: The cardboard was folded in half before being placed in the box.
formal.zh: 纸板先被对折，然后放入箱子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-kartun ma baqax ċatt? Pawlu: Ntena fil-borża meta poġġejt il-kotba fuqu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is the cardboard no longer flat? Pawlu: It got bent in the bag when I put the books on top of it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：纸板怎么不平了？保罗：我把书放在它上面时，它在包里被压弯了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 纸板怎么不平了？
messages.en: Why is the cardboard no longer flat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntena fil-borża meta poġġejt il-kotba fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Ntena fil-borża meta poġġejt il-kotba fuqu.
messages.zh: 我把书放在它上面时，它在包里被压弯了。
messages.en: It got bent in the bag when I put the books on top of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张平纸出现折痕：整张对折是被折叠，边角翻过去是被折弯，两个画面都可帮助记住ntena。

gloss_zh: 伸展开；变得虚弱；疲惫不堪

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stretched out, become weakened, or be worn out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指身体伸展开，也可指力量减弱、变得虚弱，或因劳累而疲惫不堪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal min jew għal dak li jiġi mġebbed, jiddgħajjef jew jispiċċa bla saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被伸展；伸展开
变得虚弱；力量被削弱
累得筋疲力尽；疲惫不堪

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, ir-raġel nteraħ fuq is-sodda biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After the long walk, the man stretched out on the bed to rest.
formal.zh: 长途步行后，那名男子伸展身体躺在床上休息。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn hu Mark? Lara: Nteraħ fuq is-sodda wara x-xogħol. Kien għajjien ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is Mark? Lara: He stretched out on the bed after work. He was very tired.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：马克在哪儿？拉拉：他下班后伸展身体躺到床上了。他累坏了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nteraħ fuq is-sodda wara x-xogħol. Kien għajjien ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Nteraħ fuq is-sodda wara x-xogħol. Kien għajjien ħafna.
messages.zh: 他下班后伸展身体躺到床上了。他累坏了。
messages.en: He stretched out on the bed after work. He was very tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用长途步行后摊开身体躺下的画面记nteraħ；再分别记住伸展、虚弱和疲惫三个义项，读句子时按语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be forgotten, left behind, or neglected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指从记忆中被忘掉、物品被遗落在某处，或应得到的关注与照料被忽略。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma baqax fil-memorja, tħalla xi mkien bi żball, jew ma ngħatax l-attenzjoni meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被忘记；不再被记得
被遗落；因忘记而被留在某处
被忽视；未得到应有的关注或照料

collocations.en: the book was left behind in the classroom

formal.mt: Il-ġnien ntesa għal snin sħaħ u ma ngħatax il-kura meħtieġa.
formal.en: The garden was neglected for years and did not receive the care it needed.
formal.zh: 花园多年来一直被忽视，没有得到必要的照料。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu l-ktieb tiegħi? Pawlu: Ntesa fil-klassi. Nistgħu mmorru għalih issa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is my book? Pawlu: It was left behind in the classroom. We can go and get it now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我的书在哪儿？保罗：落在教室里了。我们现在可以去拿。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 我的书在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is my book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntesa fil-klassi. Nistgħu mmorru għalih issa.
messages.mt_standard: Ntesa fil-klassi. Nistgħu mmorru għalih issa.
messages.zh: 落在教室里了。我们现在可以去拿。
messages.en: It was left behind in the classroom. We can go and get it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ntesa连成三个小画面：名字想不起来、书落在教室、花园无人照料，分别对应被忘记、被遗落和被忽视。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be folded, so that one part lies over another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被折叠，使一部分叠在另一部分上，常用于纸张、布料等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħaġa li tiġi mitwija, b'parti fuq oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被折叠；被叠起来。

collocations.en: the cardboard was folded in half

formal.mt: Il-kartun ntewa min-nofs qabel ma tqiegħed fil-kaxxa.
formal.en: The cardboard was folded in half before being placed in the box.
formal.zh: 硬纸板先被对折，然后放进箱子里。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-kartun għandu linja fin-nofs? Pawlu: Għax ntewa meta poġġejtu fil-borża.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does the cardboard have a line down the middle? Pawlu: Because it got folded when I put it in the bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：硬纸板中间为什么有一道线？保罗：因为我把它放进袋子时，它被折了一下。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 硬纸板中间为什么有一道线？
messages.en: Why does the cardboard have a line down the middle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为我把它放进袋子时，它被折了一下。
messages.en: Because it got folded when I put it in the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张硬纸板沿中线合拢，把 ntewa 和“东西被折起来”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be taught, with a subject or body of material as the thing being taught.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个科目、主题或知识内容被教授；这里说的是教学内容，而不是接受教学的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal suġġett jew materjal li jiġi mgħallem waqt lezzjoni jew kors.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be taught (said of the subject or matter that is being taught)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被教授；用于表示某个科目或某项内容得到讲授。

collocations.en: the subject was taught in class
collocations.zh: 这个主题在课堂上被讲授了

collocations.en: the material was taught through examples
collocations.zh: 这些内容通过例子得到了讲授

formal.mt: Dan is-suġġett ntgħallem matul il-kors permezz ta' eżempji prattiċi.
formal.en: This subject was taught during the course through practical examples.
formal.zh: 课程通过实际例子讲授了这个主题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan is-suġġett kien fil-kors? Mark: Iva, ntgħallem fl-ewwel ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was this subject part of the course? Mark: Yes, it was taught in the first week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：课程里有这个主题吗？马克：有，第一周就讲过了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 课程里有这个主题吗？
messages.en: Was this subject part of the course?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 有，第一周就讲过了。
messages.en: Yes, it was taught in the first week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把课堂黑板上的“教学内容”圈出来：此处 ntgħallem 说的是内容被教授，记忆时让科目站在主语位置。
