teaching_sense.en_definition: To be bent, so that something straight becomes curved or changes shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被弯曲或弄弯，原本较直的物体变成弯曲的形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħaġa li tiġi mgħawġa u ma tibqax dritta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弯曲；被弄弯。

collocations.en: the pipe was bent under the weight

formal.mt: Il-pajp ntgħaweġ taħt il-piż tal-kaxxi u kellu jinbidel.
formal.en: The pipe was bent under the weight of the boxes and had to be replaced.
formal.zh: 管子被箱子的重量压弯了，必须更换。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-wajer ma jidħolx fit-toqba? Ġanni: Għax ntgħaweġ. Ipprova ddrittah ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why won't the wire go into the hole? Ġanni: Because it got bent. Try straightening it a little.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：金属丝怎么穿不进这个孔？詹尼：因为它弯了。试着把它稍微弄直一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 金属丝怎么穿不进这个孔？
messages.en: Why won't the wire go into the hole?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.zh: 因为它弯了。试着把它稍微弄直一点。
messages.en: Because it got bent. Try straightening it a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根笔直金属丝被压成弧形，用“直线变弯线”的动作记住 ntgħaweġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be ground until reduced to a powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被研磨，直至变成粉末。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal materjal li jiġi mitħun sakemm isir trab.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be ground to a powder
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被磨成粉末；被研磨成粉。

collocations.en: the cumin was ground to a powder in a mortar
collocations.zh: 孜然在研钵里被磨成了粉

collocations.mt: il-bżar ntibek sa ma sar trab fin
collocations.en: the pepper was ground until it became a fine powder

formal.mt: Il-kemmun ntibek f'mehrież sakemm sar trab fin, imbagħad żdied mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The cumin was ground in a mortar until it became a fine powder, then added to the mixture.
formal.zh: 孜然在研钵里被磨成细粉，然后加入混合物中。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-kemmun għadu sħiħ? Luqa: Le, diġà ntibek. Qiegħed fil-vażett iż-żgħir.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this cumin still whole? Luqa: No, it has already been ground to a powder. It's in the small jar.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这些孜然还是整粒的吗？卢卡：不是，已经磨成粉了。在那个小罐子里。

messages.speaker: Marta (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 这些孜然还是整粒的吗？
messages.en: Is this cumin still whole?

messages.speaker: Luqa (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà ntibek. Qiegħed fil-vażett iż-żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà ntibek. Qiegħed fil-vażett iż-żgħir.
messages.zh: 不是，已经磨成粉了。在那个小罐子里。
messages.en: No, it has already been ground to a powder. It's in the small jar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象研钵里的整粒孜然一点点变成细粉，用“颗粒变粉末”的结果记住 ntibek。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of plucking, such as pulling out feathers or hairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拔除的动作或过程，例如拔去羽毛或毛发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li jinqala' r-rix jew ix-xagħar billi jinġibed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拔除；拔毛，指将羽毛或毛发等拔出的动作或过程。

formal.mt: In-ntif tar-rix kien l-ewwel pass fit-tħejjija tat-tiġieġa għat-tisjir.
formal.en: Plucking the feathers was the first step in preparing the chicken for cooking.
formal.zh: 拔除羽毛是处理这只鸡、准备烹饪的第一步。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Lestejt bit-tiġieġa? Marju: Għadni kemm spiċċajt in-ntif tar-rix. Issa nkompli nħejjiha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you finished with the chicken? Marju: I've just finished plucking the feathers. Now I'll carry on preparing it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：鸡处理好了吗？马里奥：我刚拔完毛。现在继续处理。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 鸡处理好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished with the chicken?

messages.speaker: Marju (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kemm spiċċajt in-ntif tar-rix. Issa nkompli nħejjiha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kemm spiċċajt in-ntif tar-rix. Issa nkompli nħejjiha.
messages.zh: 我刚拔完毛。现在继续处理。
messages.en: I've just finished plucking the feathers. Now I'll carry on preparing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一根根羽毛被拔出的连续动作想成一项工作：ntif 是名词，表示“拔除这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To expand or become puffy, used of dough as it increases in volume.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指面团体积增大、鼓起或变得蓬松。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-għaġina meta tiżdied fil-volum u ssir minfuħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to expand or become puffy (used of dough)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 膨胀；鼓起；胀发，用于面团。

collocations.zh: 面团在静置时膨起来了

formal.mt: L-għaġina ntifxet waqt li tħalliet tistrieħ f'post sħun qabel il-ħami.
formal.en: The dough expanded while it was left to rest in a warm place before baking.
formal.zh: 烘烤前，面团放在温暖的地方静置，其间膨胀起来了。

colloquial.mt: Elena: L-għaġina lesta għall-forn? Pietru: Iva, ara kemm intifxet! Issa nistgħu naħmuha.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is the dough ready for the oven? Pietru: Yes, look how much it has risen! We can bake it now.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：面团可以进烤箱了吗？彼得：可以了，看它发得多大！现在可以烤了。

messages.speaker: Elena (学烘焙的朋友)
messages.zh: 面团可以进烤箱了吗？
messages.en: Is the dough ready for the oven?

messages.speaker: Pietru (一起烘焙的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm intifxet! Issa nistgħu naħmuha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm intifxet! Issa nistgħu naħmuha.
messages.zh: 可以了，看它发得多大！现在可以烤了。
messages.en: Yes, look how much it has risen! We can bake it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象碗里的小面团慢慢鼓成大面团，用体积变大、表面蓬起的画面记 ntifex 的面团用义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have varnish applied to a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面被涂上一层清漆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa b'saff ta' verniċ fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被涂上清漆；表面经过清漆涂饰。

collocations.en: The door was varnished with clear varnish.

formal.mt: Wara t-tiswija, il-bieb tal-injam ntila b'verniċ trasparenti biex il-wiċċ tiegħu jkun protett.
formal.en: After the repair, the wooden door was coated with clear varnish to protect its surface.
formal.zh: 修理完成后，木门被涂上透明清漆，以保护其表面。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Nista' nagħlaq il-bieb? Toni: Stenna ftit; ntila dalgħodu u għadu ma nixifx.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can I close the door? Toni: Wait a little; it was varnished this morning and hasn't dried yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我可以关门吗？托尼：再等一会儿，今天早上刚涂了清漆，还没干。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 我可以关门吗？
messages.en: Can I close the door?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; ntila dalgħodu u għadu ma nixifx.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; ntila dalgħodu u għadu ma nixifx.
messages.zh: 再等一会儿，今天早上刚涂了清漆，还没干。
messages.en: Wait a little; it was varnished this morning and hasn't dried yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ntila，就想象木门表面刚刷完清漆、还不能碰的样子，连同“被涂上”的被动意义一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass to someone as an inheritance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为遗产传给某人，由某人继承。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi għand xi ħadd bħala wirt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被继承；作为遗产传给继承人。

collocations.en: The garden was inherited by the grandson.
The clock was inherited from the grandfather.
collocations.zh: 这座钟是从祖父那里继承的。

formal.mt: Skont it-testment, il-ġnien ntiret min-neputi, li se jieħu ħsiebu.
formal.en: According to the will, the garden was inherited by the grandson, who will look after it.
formal.zh: 根据遗嘱，花园由孙子继承，并将由他照料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-arloġġ ilu fil-familja? Mark: Iva, ntiret mingħand in-nannu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has this clock been in the family for a long time? Mark: Yes, it was inherited from Grandpa.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这座钟在你家传了很久吗？马克：是的，是从爷爷那里继承的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这座钟在你家传了很久吗？
messages.en: Has this clock been in the family for a long time?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，是从爷爷那里继承的。
messages.en: Yes, it was inherited from Grandpa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 ntiret 记一座祖父留下的老钟：句子的主角是“被继承的物品”，再补充由谁继承或从谁那里继承。

gloss_zh: 被织成；被设计；被密谋策划

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be woven from threads, or figuratively to be designed or secretly plotted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由线织成；也可比喻事物被设计，或阴谋被暗中策划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħadem billi jingħaqdu l-ħjut; f'sens figurattiv, jiġi ddisinjat jew jitfassal bil-moħbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被编织；由纱线等交织而成。
被设计；经构思而形成。
被密谋策划；指阴谋或秘密行动被筹划。

collocations.en: The fabric was woven by hand.
The plot was hatched in secret.

formal.mt: Id-drapp espost fil-mużew ntiseġ bl-idejn minn ħjut tas-suf.
formal.en: The fabric displayed in the museum was woven by hand from woollen threads.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出的布料由羊毛线手工织成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan id-drapp sar b'magna? Luqa: Le, ntiseġ bl-idejn; ara kemm hu fin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was this fabric made by machine? Luqa: No, it was woven by hand; look how fine it is.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块布是机器做的吗？卢卡：不是，是手工织的；你看它多细致。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布是机器做的吗？
messages.en: Was this fabric made by machine?

messages.speaker: Luqa (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ntiseġ bl-idejn; ara kemm hu fin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ntiseġ bl-idejn; ara kemm hu fin.
messages.zh: 不是，是手工织的；你看它多细致。
messages.en: No, it was woven by hand; look how fine it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntiseġ 的三个义项画成三张卡：布料被织成、计划被设计、阴谋被密谋；借“逐步组织成形”的画面辅助区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of striking or pushing with the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用头部撞击或顶推的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jolqot jew jimbotta b'rasu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用头顶撞；以头部进行撞击。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ntiħ bejn żewġ imtaten waqt il-ġlied.
formal.en: The report describes headbutting between two rams during a fight.
formal.zh: 报告描述了两只公羊争斗时相互顶撞的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Kien hemm ntiħ bejn żewġ imtaten ħdejn iċ-ċint.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that noise? Pawlu: Two rams were butting heads near the fence.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刚才是什么声音？保罗：两只公羊在围栏旁边互相顶撞。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ntiħ bejn żewġ imtaten ħdejn iċ-ċint.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ntiħ bejn żewġ imtaten ħdejn iċ-ċint.
messages.zh: 两只公羊在围栏旁边互相顶撞。
messages.en: Two rams were butting heads near the fence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntiħ 配上两只公羊低头相撞的画面，记住它是表示“用头顶撞这一动作”的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's weight measured, or to be carefully considered before a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重量被测量；也指在作出决定前被认真考虑和权衡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkejjel il-piż tiegħu, jew jiġi kkunsidrat bir-reqqa qabel tittieħed deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被称重；重量被测量。
被考虑；被审慎权衡。

collocations.en: The parcel was weighed on the scales.
collocations.zh: 包裹放在秤上称了重量。
每个论点都经过了仔细权衡。

formal.mt: Qabel ittieħdet id-deċiżjoni, kull argument ntiżen bir-reqqa mill-kumitat.
formal.en: Before the decision was made, every argument was carefully considered by the committee.
formal.zh: 作出决定前，委员会仔细权衡了每个论点。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-pakkett diġà ntiżen? Ġorġ: Iva, jiżen żewġ kilos.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has this parcel already been weighed? Ġorġ: Yes, it weighs two kilos.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这个包裹已经称过了吗？乔治：是的，重两公斤。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个包裹已经称过了吗？
messages.en: Has this parcel already been weighed?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邮局职员)
messages.zh: 是的，重两公斤。
messages.en: Yes, it weighs two kilos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一架天平记 ntiżen：放上包裹是“被称重”，放上论点是“被权衡”；两幅学习画面帮助区分具体义和抽象义。

gloss_zh: 被进行或玩过；被拿去赌博；被骗

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be played as a game, to be staked in gambling as money or winnings, or to be cheated as a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指比赛或游戏被进行，钱款或赢款被拿去赌博，或某人受到欺骗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal logħob li jsir, flus jew rebħ li jitqiegħdu f'logħob tal-ażżard, jew persuna li tiġi mqarrqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被玩；被进行，指游戏或比赛等。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be gambled (used of the money or winnings being gambled)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拿去赌博，专指作为赌注的钱款或赢款。
被骗；受到欺骗。

collocations.en: All the winnings were gambled at the casino.
collocations.zh: 全部赢款都被拿到赌场去赌了。

collocations.en: The customer was cheated by a dishonest seller.
collocations.zh: 顾客被不诚实的卖家骗了。

formal.mt: Il-konfront ntlagħab ilbieraħ filgħaxija u ntemm mingħajr gowls.
formal.en: The match was played yesterday evening and ended without any goals.
formal.zh: 比赛于昨晚进行，最终双方均未进球。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-konfront ntlagħab ilbieraħ? David: Iva, imma ma rajtux; kont għax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Rita: Was the match played yesterday? David: Yes, but I didn't watch it; I was at work.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：比赛是昨天踢的吗？戴维：是的，不过我没看，当时我在上班。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 比赛是昨天踢的吗？
messages.en: Was the match played yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma rajtux; kont għax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma rajtux; kont għax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我没看，当时我在上班。
messages.en: Yes, but I didn't watch it; I was at work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ntlagħab 时先看主语：比赛对应“被进行”，钱或赢款对应“被拿去赌”，人对应“被骗”；用三张主语卡避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a tongue passed over one's surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面被舌头舔过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintmess jew jingħorok bl-ilsien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被舔；表面被舌头触碰或舔舐。

collocations.en: The plate was licked by the cat.
The ice cream was licked by the boy.

formal.mt: Il-platt li ntlagħaq mill-qattus għandu jinħasel qabel jerġa' jintuża.
formal.en: The plate that was licked by the cat should be washed before being used again.
formal.zh: 被猫舔过的盘子应在再次使用前清洗。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed taħsel dak il-platt mill-ġdid? Ben: Għax ntlagħaq mill-qattus.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you washing that plate again? Ben: Because it was licked by the cat.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么又洗那个盘子？本：因为它被猫舔过了。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed taħsel dak il-platt mill-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed taħsel dak il-platt mill-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你为什么又洗那个盘子？
messages.en: Why are you washing that plate again?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 因为它被猫舔过了。
messages.en: Because it was licked by the cat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntlagħaq 和“盘子被猫舔过”的画面绑定，记住句子主角是被舔的东西；复习时与 ntlaħaq“被达到”分开辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be accepted or agreed to, especially when a suggestion, request, or proposal receives a positive response.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被接受或得到同意，尤指建议、请求或提案获得肯定回应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi aċċettat jew jingħata l-kunsens għalih, speċjalment meta jkun suġġeriment, rikjesta jew proposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被接受；得到接纳。
获得同意；得到赞同。

collocations.zh: 受到好评；获得良好反响

formal.mt: Is-suġġeriment biex jiżdied il-ħin għall-qari ntlaqa' b'approvazzjoni mill-kumitat.
formal.en: The suggestion to increase the time allocated to reading was met with approval by the committee.
formal.zh: 增加阅读时间的建议获得了委员会的赞同。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar is-suġġeriment tiegħek? Mark: Ntlaqa' tajjeb; kulħadd qabel miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your suggestion go down? Mark: It was well received; everyone agreed with it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：大家对你的建议反应怎么样？Mark：反应很好，大家都同意了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家对你的建议反应怎么样？
messages.en: How did your suggestion go down?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 反应很好，大家都同意了。
messages.en: It was well received; everyone agreed with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象建议递交后，大家点头接受：用“获得接纳、得到同意”的画面记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be struck by something or to have something brush against one's body or surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到某物的击打，或身体、表面被某物轻轻擦碰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi daqqa jew jintmess ħafif minn xi ħaġa li tgħaddi maġenbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被击中；遭到碰撞或击打。
被轻轻擦碰到；被掠过的物体碰到。

collocations.en: was lightly brushed by a branch

formal.mt: Il-plejer ntlaqat minn ballun f'rasu u ħareġ mill-grawnd għall-kura.
formal.en: The player was hit on the head by a ball and left the field for treatment.
formal.zh: 这名球员被球击中头部，随后离场接受治疗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaf Pawlu? Toni: Ntlaqat ħafif minn fergħa waqt li kien miexi, imma ma weġġax.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu stop? Toni: A branch lightly brushed against him while he was walking, but he wasn't hurt.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu为什么停下来了？Toni：他走路时被树枝轻轻擦碰了一下，不过没受伤。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntlaqat ħafif minn fergħa waqt li kien miexi, imma ma weġġax.
messages.mt_standard: Ntlaqat ħafif minn fergħa waqt li kien miexi, imma ma weġġax.
messages.zh: 他走路时被树枝轻轻擦碰了一下，不过没受伤。
messages.en: A branch lightly brushed against him while he was walking, but he wasn't hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把球撞到身体和树枝擦过肩膀放在一起记：两种情景都是身体被外物碰到。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be reached as a destination, target, or result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为目的地被到达，或作为目标、结果被达到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed jasal għalih bħala post, għan jew riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被到达；被达到，适用于地点、目标或结果等。

collocations.en: The agreement was reached after a long discussion.
collocations.zh: 经过长时间讨论，协议达成了。

collocations.en: The target was reached on time.
The summit was reached before noon.
collocations.zh: 中午之前便登上了山顶。

formal.mt: Wara diversi laqgħat, il-ftehim ntlaħaq u ġie ffirmat miż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: After several meetings, the agreement was reached and signed by both parties.
formal.zh: 经过多次会议，双方达成并签署了协议。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif sejjer il-ġbir tal-flus? Samwel: Tajjeb ħafna! L-għan ntlaħaq illum.
colloquial.en: Elena: How is the fundraising going? Samwel: Very well! The target was reached today.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：筹款进展如何？萨姆韦尔：非常好！今天已经达到目标了。

messages.speaker: Elena (志愿者)
messages.zh: 筹款进展如何？
messages.en: How is the fundraising going?

messages.speaker: Samwel (筹款负责人)
messages.zh: 非常好！今天已经达到目标了。
messages.en: Very well! The target was reached today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ntlaħaq，就想象进度条抵达终点：地点是“被到达”，目标是“被达到”，协议则译为“达成”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be covered by material wrapped around something, or to dress warmly by covering oneself with warm clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被材料包住，或通过穿上保暖衣物把自己裹暖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mgħotti b'materjal imdawwar miegħu, jew jilbes ħwejjeġ sħan biex iżomm ruħu sħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被包住；被包裹起来。
穿上保暖衣物；把自己穿裹暖和。

collocations.en: wrapped himself up in a thick coat
collocations.zh: 穿上厚外套把自己裹暖

formal.mt: Il-ktieb ntleff fil-karta biex jiġi protett waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The book was wrapped in paper to protect it during transport.
formal.zh: 这本书用纸包了起来，以便在运输过程中得到保护。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark ħareġ f'dan il-bard? Nina: Iva, imma ntleff f'kowt oħxon qabel ħareġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark go out in this cold? Nina: Yes, but he wrapped himself up in a thick coat before leaving.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这么冷，Mark还出门了吗？Nina：出去了，不过他出门前穿了厚外套，把自己裹得暖暖的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这么冷，Mark还出门了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark go out in this cold?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ntleff f'kowt oħxon qabel ħareġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ntleff f'kowt oħxon qabel ħareġ.
messages.zh: 出去了，不过他出门前穿了厚外套，把自己裹得暖暖的。
messages.en: Yes, but he wrapped himself up in a thick coat before leaving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“外面裹上一层”的画面：书裹纸是被包裹，人裹厚衣服就是穿暖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be seen or briefly noticed, sometimes only for a moment or from a distance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被看见或短暂注意到，有时指只被瞥见一瞬间，或从远处被发现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidher jew jiġi nnutat, xi drabi għal ftit ħin biss jew mill-bogħod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被瞥见；被短暂地看见。
被看见；出现在视线中。

formal.mt: Dgħajsa tas-salvataġġ resqet lejn bastiment li ntlemaħ mill-bogħod.
formal.en: A rescue boat approached a ship that had been spotted from a distance.
formal.zh: 一艘救援艇驶向一艘从远处被发现的船只。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajtu l-qattus? Ben: Iva, ntlemaħ għal mument wara s-siġra, imbagħad reġa' nħeba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the cat? Ben: Yes, it was visible for a moment behind the tree, then it hid again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到那只猫了吗？Ben：看到了，它在树后露了一下，随后又藏起来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那只猫了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the cat?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ntlemaħ għal mument wara s-siġra, imbagħad reġa' nħeba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ntlemaħ għal mument wara s-siġra, imbagħad reġa' nħeba.
messages.zh: 看到了，它在树后露了一下，随后又藏起来了。
messages.en: Yes, it was visible for a moment behind the tree, then it hid again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象远处的猫从树后露面一瞬间：重点是它进入了别人的视线，被看见了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become bent or curved, or to lose an original shape through bending or pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变弯、形成曲线，或因弯折、受压而失去原来的形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mgħawweġ jew jieħu forma ta' kurva, jew jitlef il-forma oriġinali minħabba li jitgħawweġ jew jingħafas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄弯；发生弯折。
变成弧形；呈弯曲状。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be put out of shape
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄变形；失去原有形状。

formal.mt: Il-qafas tal-metall ntlewa taħt il-piż u tilef il-forma oriġinali tiegħu.
formal.en: The metal frame bent under the weight and lost its original shape.
formal.zh: 金属框架被重量压弯，失去了原来的形状。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma jagħlaqx l-umbrella? Mark: Il-qafas ntlewa bir-riħ; issa ma jagħlaqx sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why won't the umbrella close? Mark: The frame got bent by the wind; now it won't close properly.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这把伞怎么合不上？Mark：伞架被风吹弯了，现在没法好好合上。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这把伞怎么合不上？
messages.en: Why won't the umbrella close?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qafas ntlewa bir-riħ; issa ma jagħlaqx sew.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qafas ntlewa bir-riħ; issa ma jagħlaqx sew.
messages.zh: 伞架被风吹弯了，现在没法好好合上。
messages.en: The frame got bent by the wind; now it won't close properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用直铁丝被压成弧线的画面记忆：既能表示弯曲，也能强调原来的形状变了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be worn on the body as clothing or an accessory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为衣物或配饰被穿在、戴在身上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed fuq il-ġisem bħala lbies jew aċċessorju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被穿着；被佩戴，指衣物或配饰用于身体上。

collocations.en: was worn for the first time

formal.mt: Il-kostum tradizzjonali ntlibes waqt iċ-ċerimonja tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: The traditional costume was worn during the opening ceremony.
formal.zh: 这套传统服装在开幕仪式上被穿着展示。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kowt għadu ġdid? Nina: Kważi! Ntlibes darba biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this coat still new? Nina: Almost! It's only been worn once.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这件外套还是新的吗？Nina：差不多！只穿过一次。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件外套还是新的吗？
messages.en: Is this coat still new?

messages.speaker: Nina (卖家)
messages.zh: 差不多！只穿过一次。
messages.en: Almost! It's only been worn once.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把视角放在外套身上，想成“这件衣服被人穿过”，就能记住它的被动意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To crouch or shrink back in fear, making oneself small in response to something frightening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因害怕而蹲缩、蜷缩或向后退缩，做出缩小身体的姿态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġabar fih innifsu jew jitbaxxa minħabba l-biża' quddiem xi ħaġa li tbeżżgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因恐惧而畏缩、蹲伏或蜷缩。

formal.mt: Meta sema' r-ragħad, il-kelb ntlibet f'rokna tal-kamra.
formal.en: When it heard the thunder, the dog cowered in a corner of the room.
formal.zh: 听到雷声时，那只狗害怕得蜷缩在房间的角落里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-kelb? Ben: Taħt il-mejda. Ntlibet bil-biża' meta beda n-nar tal-arti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the dog? Ben: Under the table. It cowered in fear when the fireworks started.
colloquial.zh: Maja：狗在哪里？Ben：在桌子下面。烟花一响，它就吓得蜷缩起来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 狗在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the dog?

messages.speaker: Ben (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt il-mejda. Ntlibet bil-biża' meta beda n-nar tal-arti.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt il-mejda. Ntlibet bil-biża' meta beda n-nar tal-arti.
messages.zh: 在桌子下面。烟花一响，它就吓得蜷缩起来了。
messages.en: Under the table. It cowered in fear when the fireworks started.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗听到雷声后缩进角落：把“害怕”和“身体缩小”连成一个记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be crushed or broken into smaller pieces by the teeth through chewing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被牙齿反复咬压、嚼碎，通常指食物在吞咽前被咀嚼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mfarrak bis-snien permezz tal-magħad, normalment qabel jinbela'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被咀嚼；被牙齿嚼碎。

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, kull biċċa ħobż intmagħdet bil-mod; il-ħobż kollu ntmagħad sew qabel ma nbela'.
formal.en: During the exercise, each piece of bread was chewed slowly; all the bread was thoroughly chewed before being swallowed.
formal.zh: 练习过程中，每块面包都被慢慢咀嚼；所有面包都在充分嚼碎后才被吞下。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Il-ħobż ntmagħad sew qabel ma nbela'? Leo: Iva, ħadt il-ħin tiegħi u ma għaġġiltx.
colloquial.en: Mum: Was the bread chewed thoroughly before you swallowed it? Leo: Yes, I took my time and didn't rush.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：面包充分嚼碎以后才咽下去了吗？Leo：是的，我慢慢吃的，没有着急。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħobż ntmagħad sew qabel ma nbela'?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħobż ntmagħad sew qabel ma nbela'?
messages.zh: 面包充分嚼碎以后才咽下去了吗？
messages.en: Was the bread chewed thoroughly before you swallowed it?

messages.speaker: Leo (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadt il-ħin tiegħi u ma għaġġiltx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadt il-ħin tiegħi u ma għaġġiltx.
messages.zh: 是的，我慢慢吃的，没有着急。
messages.en: Yes, I took my time and didn't rush.

cognitive_memory_aid: 从面包的角度想“我被牙齿慢慢嚼碎了”，用食物作为被咀嚼对象来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be prohibited or disallowed by a rule or an authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到规定或有关机构的禁止，不获准进行、使用或传播。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa ma tibqax permessa minħabba regola jew deċiżjoni ta' awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被禁止；被明令禁止使用、进行或传播。

formal.mt: Skont ir-regolament il-ġdid, l-użu ta' dan il-prodott ntmana' fil-bini kollu.
formal.en: Under the new regulation, the use of this product was banned throughout the building.
formal.zh: 根据新规定，整栋楼内禁止使用这种产品。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex m'għadniex nużaw dan il-prodott hawn? Pawlu: Għax l-użu tiegħu ntmana' fil-bini.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why don't we use this product here anymore? Pawlu: Because its use was banned in the building.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们为什么不再在这里用这种产品了？保罗：因为楼内已经禁止使用它了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex m'għadniex nużaw dan il-prodott hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex m'għadniex nużaw dan il-prodott hawn?
messages.zh: 我们为什么不再在这里用这种产品了？
messages.en: Why don't we use this product here anymore?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 因为楼内已经禁止使用它了。
messages.en: Because its use was banned in the building.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象产品旁贴上禁止标志，用“被规定禁止”这一画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's hair combed, or for hair to be arranged with a comb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指头发经过梳子的梳理，或某人被梳理了头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li x-xagħar jiġi rranġat b'moxt, jew li xi ħadd ikollu xagħru mimxut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被梳理，通常指头发被用梳子梳过。

collocations.en: was combed with a fine-toothed comb

formal.mt: Qabel ma ttieħed ir-ritratt, ix-xagħar tat-tifel ntmaxat bir-reqqa.
formal.en: Before the photograph was taken, the boy's hair was carefully combed.
formal.zh: 拍照之前，男孩的头发经过了仔细梳理。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tifel lest għar-ritratt? Pawlu: Iva, anki xagħru ntmaxat.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the boy ready for the photograph? Pawlu: Yes, even his hair has been combed.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：孩子准备好拍照了吗？保罗：好了，连头发都梳好了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子准备好拍照了吗？
messages.en: Is the boy ready for the photograph?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 好了，连头发都梳好了。
messages.en: Yes, even his hair has been combed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上“拍照前梳好头发”的画面，重点记住头发接受梳理。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be placed down or laid out on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被放到某个表面上，或沿着某处铺开、铺设。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa titqiegħed fuq wiċċ jew tiġi mifruxa tul xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放下、平放或铺设在某处。

formal.mt: Il-kejbil il-ġdid ntmedd mal-art tul il-ħajt qabel ma twaħħal f'postu.
formal.en: The new cable was laid along the ground beside the wall before being fixed in place.
formal.zh: 新电缆先沿墙边的地面铺开，随后固定到位。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hu l-kejbil il-ġdid? Pawlu: Ntmedd mal-art ħdejn il-ħajt; għad irridu nwaħħluh.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is the new cable? Pawlu: It was laid on the ground beside the wall; we still need to fix it in place.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：新电缆在哪里？保罗：已经铺在墙边地上了，我们还得把它固定好。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 新电缆在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the new cable?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntmedd mal-art ħdejn il-ħajt; għad irridu nwaħħluh.
messages.mt_standard: Ntmedd mal-art ħdejn il-ħajt; għad irridu nwaħħluh.
messages.zh: 已经铺在墙边地上了，我们还得把它固定好。
messages.en: It was laid on the ground beside the wall; we still need to fix it in place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一卷电缆被放下并沿地面铺开，用“平放铺开”的动作帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wiped with a cloth or similar material, or to wipe oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被用布等物品擦拭；也指某人擦拭自己的身体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa titnaddaf jew titnixxef b'ċarruta jew b'xi ħaġa simili, jew li persuna timsaħ lilha nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被擦拭，以清除表面的污物或水分。
擦拭自己的身体，例如洗澡后用毛巾擦身。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, il-ħġieġ ntmesaħ b'ċarruta niexfa biex ma jibqgħux marki.
formal.en: After cleaning, the glass was wiped with a dry cloth so that no marks would remain.
formal.zh: 清洗之后，玻璃用干布擦过，以免留下痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu għadu mxarrab wara l-għawma? Anna: Le, diġà ntmesaħ b'xugaman.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is Pawlu still wet after his swim? Anna: No, he has already wiped himself dry with a towel.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗游完泳，身上还湿着吗？安娜：不湿了，他已经用毛巾擦干身体了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗游完泳，身上还湿着吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still wet after his swim?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 不湿了，他已经用毛巾擦干身体了。
messages.en: No, he has already wiped himself dry with a towel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：玻璃被布擦，人用毛巾擦自己；注意区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a hole made through it by a sharp object or a tool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被尖锐物体或工具穿透，从而形成孔洞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ssir toqba f'xi ħaġa permezz ta' oġġett bil-ponta jew ta' għodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刺穿、穿透或打出孔洞。

formal.mt: Il-metall ntnaqab f'żewġ postijiet biex jitwaħħal mal-qafas.
formal.en: The metal was pierced in two places so that it could be attached to the frame.
formal.zh: 金属上打了两个孔，以便将它固定到框架上。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ħareġ l-arja mill-bużżieqa? Pawlu: Għax il-gomma ntnaqab b'labra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did the air escape from the balloon? Pawlu: Because the rubber was pierced with a needle.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：气球怎么漏气了？保罗：因为橡胶被针扎穿了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 气球怎么漏气了？
messages.en: Why did the air escape from the balloon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为橡胶被针扎穿了。
messages.en: Because the rubber was pierced with a needle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象针尖穿过材料留下小孔，抓住“穿透形成孔洞”这个核心画面。

gloss_zh: 被凿刻；被雕塑；被雕刻；被刮削；被削制

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be worked by chiseling, sculpting, carving, scraping, or whittling, usually by removing material from a surface or an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过凿刻、雕塑、雕刻、刮削或削制而被加工，通常涉及去除物体表面或局部的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tinħadem billi jitneħħa materjal minnha, ngħidu aħna bi skarpell, b'sikkina jew bil-brix, biex tingħata forma jew isiru marki fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用凿子凿刻或凿削。
被雕塑成某种形体或造型。
被雕刻出形状、文字或图案。
被刮削，表面材料被刮去。
被用刀逐片削制成形，通常指木料。

collocations.en: was carved into the surface of the stone

formal.mt: L-isem tal-artist ntnaqax fil-ġebla b'ittri żgħar taħt il-figura.
formal.en: The artist's name was carved into the stone in small letters beneath the figure.
formal.zh: 艺术家的名字以小字刻在雕像下方的石头上。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan id-disinn tpitter fuq l-injam? Pawlu: Le, ntnaqax fih b'sikkina żgħira.
colloquial.en: Marija: Was this design painted on the wood? Pawlu: No, it was carved into it with a small knife.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这个图案是画在木头上的吗？保罗：不是，是用小刀刻进去的。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个图案是画在木头上的吗？
messages.en: Was this design painted on the wood?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (手艺人)
messages.zh: 不是，是用小刀刻进去的。
messages.en: No, it was carved into it with a small knife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“工具去掉材料”串起五义：凿、雕、刻、刮、削，再按工具和成品区分。

gloss_zh: 在某处坐下；留在某处；被困住

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sit down or remain in a place; also, to be caught in a trap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个地方坐下或停留下来；也指落入圈套、被陷阱困住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li persuna toqgħod bilqiegħda jew tibqa' f'xi post; ukoll, li persuna jew annimal jinqabad f'nassa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某个地方坐下。
留在或停留在某个地方。
被陷阱困住；落入圈套而无法脱身。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-fenek ntnasab f'nassa u mbagħad inħeles mingħajr ġrieħi.
formal.en: The report describes how the rabbit was caught in a trap and then released without injury.
formal.zh: 报告描述了那只兔子如何落入陷阱，随后又毫发无伤地获释。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn mar Mark? Pawlu: Ntnasab ħdejn it-tieqa bil-ktieb tiegħu; ilu hemm siegħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did Mark go? Pawlu: He sat down by the window with his book; he has been there for an hour.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：马克去哪儿了？保罗：他拿着书在窗边坐下了，已经在那里待了一个小时。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntnasab ħdejn it-tieqa bil-ktieb tiegħu; ilu hemm siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ntnasab ħdejn it-tieqa bil-ktieb tiegħu; ilu hemm siegħa.
messages.zh: 他拿着书在窗边坐下了，已经在那里待了一个小时。
messages.en: He sat down by the window with his book; he has been there for an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三格记忆：窗边坐下、原处停留、陷阱被困；看地点和情境判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For an item of clothing to be hung up or spread out so that it can dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指衣物被挂起或展开晾晒，使其变干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta lbies jitqiegħed fuq ħabel jew jinfirex biex jinxef.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be hung out to dry (used of clothes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （衣物）被挂起晾干；被晾晒。

collocations.en: The T-shirt was hung on the washing line to dry.
collocations.zh: 那件T恤被挂在晾衣绳上晾干。

collocations.en: The T-shirt was hung out to dry in the sun.

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, il-flokk ntnaxar fil-bitħa biex jinxef qabel filgħaxija.
formal.en: After washing, the T-shirt was hung out in the courtyard to dry before the evening.
formal.zh: 洗完后，那件T恤被晾在院子里，以便在傍晚前晾干。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-flokk blu tiegħi? Sara: Ntnaxar fuq il-ħabel fil-bitħa; għadu mxarrab.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is my blue T-shirt? Sara: It was hung on the washing line in the courtyard; it is still wet.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我的蓝色T恤在哪里？Sara：晾在院子的晾衣绳上了，还湿着呢。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我的蓝色T恤在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my blue T-shirt?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntnaxar fuq il-ħabel fil-bitħa; għadu mxarrab.
messages.mt_standard: Ntnaxar fuq il-ħabel fil-bitħa; għadu mxarrab.
messages.zh: 晾在院子的晾衣绳上了，还湿着呢。
messages.en: It was hung on the washing line in the courtyard; it is still wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“湿衣服上晾衣绳”的画面一起记，重点是衣物被晾起，而不是已经干了。

gloss_zh: 石料被修整；举止变得文雅

teaching_sense.en_definition: For stone to be cut and finished into shape; figuratively, for a person's manners to become more refined.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指石料被加工修整成形；也比喻一个人的言谈举止变得更文雅、得体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-ġebel jinħadem u jingħata l-għamla mixtieqa; b'mod figurattiv, li persuna ssir aktar edukata fl-imġiba tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石料被切削、修整或加工，使其达到所需形状或表面状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be refined in one's manners
sense_translations.zh_definition: 言谈举止变得更文雅、有礼或得体。

collocations.en: became more refined in his manners

formal.mt: Il-ġebel ntnaġar skont il-qisien meħtieġa qabel ma ntuża fil-bini tal-ħajt.
formal.en: The stone was dressed to the required dimensions before being used to build the wall.
formal.zh: 石料先按要求的尺寸修整，再用于砌墙。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Mark sar jitkellem b'aktar rispett, hux? Pawlu: Iva, minn mindu beda x-xogħol il-ġdid, ntnaġar ħafna fl-imġiba tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Mark speaks more respectfully now, doesn't he? Pawlu: Yes, since starting his new job, he has become much more refined in his manners.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：马克现在说话更有礼貌了，是吧？保罗：是啊，自从开始新工作，他的举止文雅多了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark sar jitkellem b'aktar rispett, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Mark sar jitkellem b'aktar rispett, hux?
messages.zh: 马克现在说话更有礼貌了，是吧？
messages.en: Mark speaks more respectfully now, doesn't he?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn mindu beda x-xogħol il-ġdid, ntnaġar ħafna fl-imġiba tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn mindu beda x-xogħol il-ġdid, ntnaġar ħafna fl-imġiba tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，自从开始新工作，他的举止文雅多了。
messages.en: Yes, since starting his new job, he has become much more refined in his manners.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把修整石料和改善举止并排想象：石头修得整齐，人也变得文雅；这是义项联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For an item of clothing to be removed from the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指穿在身上的某件衣物被脱下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta biċċa lbies titneħħa minn fuq il-ġisem.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be taken off (used of clothes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （衣物）被脱下；从身上被除去。

collocations.en: The coat was taken off on arrival.
collocations.zh: 一到地方，外套就被脱下了。

collocations.en: The T-shirt was taken off before swimming.

formal.mt: Il-kowt imxarrab ntnaża' malli t-tifel daħal id-dar u tqiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The wet coat was taken off as soon as the boy entered the house and was placed near the door.
formal.zh: 男孩一进屋，湿外套就被脱下，放在门边。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadek bil-kowt imxarrab? Pawlu: Le, ntnaża' malli dħalt; issa għandi flokk niexef.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you still wearing the wet coat? Pawlu: No, it was taken off as soon as I came in; now I have a dry T-shirt on.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你还穿着那件湿外套吗？Pawlu：没有，一进来就脱下了；我现在穿着干T恤。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 你还穿着那件湿外套吗？
messages.en: Are you still wearing the wet coat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ntnaża' malli dħalt; issa għandi flokk niexef.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ntnaża' malli dħalt; issa għandi flokk niexef.
messages.zh: 没有，一进来就脱下了；我现在穿着干T恤。
messages.en: No, it was taken off as soon as I came in; now I have a dry T-shirt on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“进门后外套离开身体”的画面记忆：关注衣物被脱下这个动作，不是把衣物拿走。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For money or another available resource to be used up or paid out for a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指金钱或其他可用资源为了某个目的被花费、支出或耗用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta flus jew riżorsi oħra jintużaw għal xi skop.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被花费；被支出；被耗用。

collocations.en: The money was spent on repairs.

formal.mt: Il-baġit tal-proġett ntnefaq fuq materjal ġdid u tiswijiet fil-bini.
formal.en: The project budget was spent on new materials and repairs to the building.
formal.zh: 项目预算被用于购买新材料和维修楼房。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fadal xi flus għall-ikel? Mark: Le, il-flus kollu ntnefaq fuq il-biljetti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any money left for food? Mark: No, all the money was spent on the tickets.
colloquial.zh: Sara：还有钱买吃的吗？Mark：没有，钱全花在票上了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 还有钱买吃的吗？
messages.en: Is there any money left for food?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-flus kollu ntnefaq fuq il-biljetti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-flus kollu ntnefaq fuq il-biljetti.
messages.zh: 没有，钱全花在票上了。
messages.en: No, all the money was spent on the tickets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预算表上的金额一笔笔变成支出：把注意力放在“钱被花掉”，并连同用途一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become swollen or larger; also, to become excessively proud or vain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体部位或物体肿起、胀大，也指人变得骄傲自满或虚荣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta parti tal-ġisem jew oġġett jiżdied fil-volum; ukoll meta persuna ssir kburija żżejjed jew vanituża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肿胀；膨胀；体积增大。
变得骄傲自满；变得虚荣。

collocations.en: The ankle swelled after the fall.
He became conceited because of the praise.
collocations.zh: 他受到夸奖后变得自满了。

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa waqt il-logħba, l-għaksa ta' Mark ntnefaħ u kellu jieqaf jilgħab.
formal.en: After the fall during the match, Mark's ankle swelled and he had to stop playing.
formal.zh: 比赛中摔倒后，Mark的脚踝肿了起来，他只好停止比赛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu kif laqa' t-tifħir? Mark: Ntnefaħ u beda jgħid li ħadd ma jilgħab aħjar minnu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Pawlu take the praise? Mark: He became conceited and started saying that nobody plays better than him.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu受到夸奖后是什么反应？Mark：他得意起来，开始说谁都没他打得好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu受到夸奖后是什么反应？
messages.en: How did Pawlu take the praise?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntnefaħ u beda jgħid li ħadd ma jilgħab aħjar minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Ntnefaħ u beda jgħid li ħadd ma jilgħab aħjar minnu.
messages.zh: 他得意起来，开始说谁都没他打得好。
messages.en: He became conceited and started saying that nobody plays better than him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个“胀起来”的画面联记：脚踝肿起来，以及受夸后自我感觉膨胀；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be forgotten, accidentally left somewhere, or neglected through lack of attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某事被忘记、某物因疏忽被落在某处，或某人某事没有得到应有的关注。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa ma jibqax fil-ħsieb, jitħalla f'post bi żball, jew ma jingħatax l-attenzjoni meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被忘记；没有被记住或想起。
被遗落；因忘记携带而被留在原处。
被忽视；未得到应有的关注或照顾。

collocations.en: The bag was left behind on the bus.
collocations.zh: 袋子被落在公共汽车上了。

collocations.en: The elderly man was neglected by his family.
collocations.zh: 那位老人被家人忽视了。

formal.mt: Għal ħafna snin, il-bżonn ta' spazju sigur għat-tfal ntnesa fid-diskussjonijiet dwar il-lokalità.
formal.en: For many years, the need for a safe space for children was neglected in discussions about the locality.
formal.zh: 多年来，在关于该地区的讨论中，儿童需要安全活动空间这一点一直被忽视。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-basket tax-xiri? Pawlu: Ntnesa fil-karozza; immur inġibu issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the shopping bag? Pawlu: It was left in the car; I will go and get it now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：购物袋在哪里？Pawlu：落在车里了，我现在去拿。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 购物袋在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the shopping bag?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 落在车里了，我现在去拿。
messages.en: It was left in the car; I will go and get it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三幅画面记忆：名字想不起来、袋子落在车里、老人无人关心，分别对应忘记、遗落和忽视。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be teased by someone, either playfully or in a way that causes embarrassment or annoyance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指受到别人的逗弄或取笑，可能是玩笑，也可能使人尴尬或不快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd jiġi mċajpar minn oħrajn, biċ-ċajt jew b'mod li jdejqu jew jimbarazzah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被逗弄；被取笑；受到戏弄。

collocations.en: He was teased by his friends.
He was teased about his new hairstyle.
collocations.zh: 他因为新发型被取笑了。

formal.mt: L-istudent ntnibex dwar il-mod kif kien jitkellem, u l-għalliem talab lill-klassi turi aktar rispett.
formal.en: The student was teased about the way he spoke, and the teacher asked the class to show more respect.
formal.zh: 那名学生因说话方式受到取笑，老师要求全班更加尊重他人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark deher imdejjaq? Lara: Ntnibex dwar ix-xagħar il-ġdid tiegħu, u ċ-ċajt ma għoġbux.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark look upset? Lara: He was teased about his new hairstyle, and he did not like the joking.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark为什么看起来不高兴？Lara：有人拿他的新发型开玩笑，他不喜欢这些玩笑。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么看起来不高兴？
messages.en: Why did Mark look upset?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntnibex dwar ix-xagħar il-ġdid tiegħu, u ċ-ċajt ma għoġbux.
messages.mt_standard: Ntnibex dwar ix-xagħar il-ġdid tiegħu, u ċ-ċajt ma għoġbux.
messages.zh: 有人拿他的新发型开玩笑，他不喜欢这些玩笑。
messages.en: He was teased about his new hairstyle, and he did not like the joking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新发型成了朋友开玩笑的话题，记住主语是“被逗弄的人”；是否友善要看语境和感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a hole made in it by something pointed, or to be pierced or penetrated by something entering or passing through.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体被尖物扎出孔洞、被刺穿，或被进入其中的东西穿透。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tittaqqab b'oġġett bil-ponta, jew meta oġġett jidħol fiha jew jgħaddi minn ġo fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扎破；被戳出小孔。
被刺穿；被尖物穿过。
被穿入；被穿透。

collocations.en: The tyre was punctured by a nail.
The fabric was pierced by a needle.
The wood was penetrated by an arrow.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġie kkonfermat li t-tajer ntnifed b'musmar li kien fit-triq.
formal.en: During the inspection, it was confirmed that the tyre had been punctured by a nail lying in the road.
formal.zh: 检查时确认，轮胎是被路上的一枚钉子扎破的。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex waqaft bir-rota? Pawlu: It-tajer ntnifed b'musmar; irrid insewwih qabel inkompli.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you stop cycling? Pawlu: The tyre was punctured by a nail; I need to repair it before I carry on.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你怎么停下不骑了？Pawlu：轮胎被钉子扎破了，我得修好才能继续骑。

messages.speaker: Mark (骑行伙伴)
messages.zh: 你怎么停下不骑了？
messages.en: Why did you stop cycling?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (骑行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tajer ntnifed b'musmar; irrid insewwih qabel inkompli.
messages.mt_standard: It-tajer ntnifed b'musmar; irrid insewwih qabel inkompli.
messages.zh: 轮胎被钉子扎破了，我得修好才能继续骑。
messages.en: The tyre was punctured by a nail; I need to repair it before I carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个画面记：钉子扎破轮胎、针刺穿布料、箭穿入木头；共同抓住“外物穿入”的动作。

gloss_zh: 被拔毛；被剪毛；钱财被弄走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have feathers or hair plucked or shorn off; also, to have one's cash taken away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指羽毛或毛发被拔掉、剪掉，也可指人的钱财被他人弄走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta r-rix jew is-suf jitneħħa bit-tnittif jew bil-qtugħ; ukoll meta persuna jittiħdulha flusha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拔毛；羽毛或毛发被拔除。
被剪毛；身上的毛被剪去。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be relieved of one's cash
sense_translations.zh_definition: 钱财被人弄走；被掏空腰包。

collocations.en: He was relieved of his cash.

formal.mt: Waqt it-tħejjija tal-ikel, is-serduk ntnitef u tnaddaf qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: During food preparation, the rooster was plucked and cleaned before cooking.
formal.zh: 备餐时，公鸡先被拔毛并清理干净，然后才进行烹饪。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu ma xtara xejn aktar fil-fiera? Mark: Ntnitef minn flusu f'logħba u ma baqagħlu xejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu not buy anything else at the fair? Mark: He was relieved of his cash in a game and had nothing left.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu为什么在集市上没再买东西？Mark：他玩了个游戏，钱都被弄走了，一分也没剩下。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma xtara xejn aktar fil-fiera?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma xtara xejn aktar fil-fiera?
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么在集市上没再买东西？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu not buy anything else at the fair?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntnitef minn flusu f'logħba u ma baqagħlu xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Ntnitef minn flusu f'logħba u ma baqagħlu xejn.
messages.zh: 他玩了个游戏，钱都被弄走了，一分也没剩下。
messages.en: He was relieved of his cash in a game and had nothing left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把鸡被拔毛、羊被剪毛和钱包被掏空并排想象，帮助区分三个义项；这只是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be said or expressed in words, often without naming the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某句话、意见或消息被说出，常不明确指出说话的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta kliem, opinjoni jew aħbar jingħadu, spiss mingħajr ma jissemma min qalhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被说出；被讲述

formal.mt: Fil-laqgħa ntqal li l-librerija se tiftaħ aktar kmieni.
formal.en: It was said at the meeting that the library would open earlier.
formal.zh: 会议上有人表示，图书馆将提前开门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ntqal fil-laqgħa? Mark: Ntqal li għada nibdew fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was said at the meeting? Mark: It was said that we start at nine tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：会上说了什么？Mark：说是我们明天九点开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 会上说了什么？
messages.en: What was said at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 说是我们明天九点开始。
messages.en: It was said that we start at nine tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议记录里只写“会上说了”，没有写谁说的，把 ntqal 与“话被说出来”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut with scissors or a similar tool, especially with a small, quick cut.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指东西被剪刀或类似工具剪开、剪短，尤其指小幅度的剪切。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa tinqata' b'imqass jew b'għodda simili, speċjalment b'qatgħa żgħira u malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被剪一下；被剪断或剪短

collocations.en: the end was snipped with scissors

formal.mt: It-tarf tal-ħajt ntqass bl-imqass biex il-ħjata tidher pulita.
formal.en: The end of the thread was snipped with scissors so that the stitching would look neat.
formal.zh: 线头被剪刀剪掉，使缝线看起来整齐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan il-ħajt hu iqsar? Nina: It-tarf ntqass għax kien twil wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this thread shorter? Nina: The end was snipped because it was too long.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这根线怎么变短了？Nina：因为太长，末端被剪掉了。

messages.speaker: Lara (缝纫学员)
messages.zh: 这根线怎么变短了？
messages.en: Why is this thread shorter?

messages.speaker: Nina (缝纫老师)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarf ntqass għax kien twil wisq.
messages.mt_standard: It-tarf ntqass għax kien twil wisq.
messages.zh: 因为太长，末端被剪掉了。
messages.en: The end was snipped because it was too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象剪刀“咔嚓”剪掉一截线头，用这个小动作记住 ntqass 表示“被剪”，重点看被剪的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a size, length, or other quantity determined by measurement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物的尺寸、长度或其他数值通过测量被确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta d-daqs, it-tul jew kwantità oħra jiġu stabbiliti permezz ta' kejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被测量；被量出尺寸或数值

collocations.en: was measured with a tape measure

formal.mt: It-tul tal-mejda ntqies b'tejp tal-kejl qabel ma nxtara d-drapp.
formal.en: The length of the table was measured with a tape measure before the fabric was bought.
formal.zh: 购买布料之前，先用卷尺测量了桌子的长度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tul tal-mejda ntqies diġà? Mark: Iva, hu metru u nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the length of the table been measured already? Mark: Yes, it is one and a half metres.
colloquial.zh: Maja：桌子的长度已经量过了吗？Mark：量过了，是一米半。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子的长度已经量过了吗？
messages.en: Has the length of the table been measured already?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 量过了，是一米半。
messages.en: Yes, it is one and a half metres.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntqies 放进“桌长已经量过”的画面：卷尺展开，数值确定，记住它强调对象被测量。

gloss_zh: 被系住；受约束；作出承诺

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be tied or bound, or to become committed to an obligation or course of action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被绳索等系住、受到约束，或承担某项义务并作出承诺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jintrabtu b'ħabel jew b'mod ieħor, jew meta persuna tieħu fuqha obbligu jew impenn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被系住；被捆扎
被束缚；受到约束
作出承诺；承担义务或投入某项事业

formal.mt: Permezz tal-ftehim, il-fornitur ntrabat li jwassal il-kotba sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: Under the agreement, the supplier committed to delivering the books by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 根据协议，供应商承诺在月底之前送达书籍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-pakkett lest għall-vjaġġ? Mark: Iva, ntrabat sew b'ħabel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the parcel ready for the journey? Mark: Yes, it has been tied securely with a rope.
colloquial.zh: Lara：包裹准备好运走了吗？Mark：好了，已经用绳子牢牢捆好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 包裹准备好运走了吗？
messages.en: Is the parcel ready for the journey?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好了，已经用绳子牢牢捆好了。
messages.en: Yes, it has been tied securely with a rope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个教学画面串联：绳子系住包裹、合同约束责任、口头承诺帮助。共同记忆点是“有了牵系或责任”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To kiss passionately on the lips, or to suck; the intended meaning depends on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指热烈地亲吻嘴唇，也可指吮吸，具体含义需要结合上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tbus b'passjoni fuq ix-xufftejn, jew li terda'; it-tifsira tiddependi mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.en_definition: to kiss passionately on the lips
sense_translations.zh_definition: 热烈地亲吻嘴唇
吮吸；吸吮

collocations.zh: ntrada' 在上下文中的含义

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, il-verb "ntrada'" għandu jinftiehem skont il-kuntest: jista' jfisser li tbus b'passjoni fuq ix-xufftejn jew li terda'.
formal.en: In analysing the text, the verb "ntrada'" should be understood in context: it can mean to kiss passionately on the lips or to suck.
formal.zh: 分析文本时，应结合上下文理解动词 ntrada'：它可以表示热烈地亲吻嘴唇，也可以表示吮吸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: "Ntrada'" dejjem ifisser li tbus fuq ix-xufftejn? Lara: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll li terda'. Ħares lejn il-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does "ntrada'" always mean to kiss on the lips? Lara: No, it can also mean to suck. Look at the context.
colloquial.zh: Maja：ntrada' 总是表示亲吻嘴唇吗？Lara：不是，它也可以表示吮吸。要看上下文。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: "Ntrada'" dejjem ifisser li tbus fuq ix-xufftejn?
messages.mt_standard: "Ntrada'" dejjem ifisser li tbus fuq ix-xufftejn?
messages.zh: ntrada' 总是表示亲吻嘴唇吗？
messages.en: Does "ntrada'" always mean to kiss on the lips?

messages.speaker: Lara (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll li terda'. Ħares lejn il-kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll li terda'. Ħares lejn il-kuntest.
messages.zh: 不是，它也可以表示吮吸。要看上下文。
messages.en: No, it can also mean to suck. Look at the context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张独立义项卡：一张画嘴唇热吻，一张画吮吸动作。看到 ntrada' 时先读上下文，再选择对应卡片。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be buried or covered over by earth, rubble, or similar material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被泥土、碎石或类似材料覆盖、掩埋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jitgħattew jew jindifnu taħt il-ħamrija, it-terrapien jew materjal simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被掩埋；被埋在覆盖物下面

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa tal-ħajt, il-passaġġ ntradam taħt it-terrapien u ngħalaq għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: After the wall collapsed, the passage was buried under rubble and closed to the public.
formal.zh: 墙体倒塌后，通道被瓦砾掩埋，并停止向公众开放。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-barmil li ħallejt fil-ġnien? Nina: Ntradam bil-ħamrija meta ħaffru hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the bucket I left in the garden? Nina: It got buried in soil when they dug there.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我放在花园里的水桶在哪里？Nina：他们在那里挖土时，水桶被土埋住了。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-barmil li ħallejt fil-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-barmil li ħallejt fil-ġnien?
messages.zh: 我放在花园里的水桶在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bucket I left in the garden?

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 他们在那里挖土时，水桶被土埋住了。
messages.en: It got buried in soil when they dug there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本看得见的水桶被一铲铲泥土盖住，最后消失在土下，用“被覆盖而埋住”记忆 ntradam。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be rendered or given, as with a service or response, or to be returned to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指服务、回应等被给予或提供，也可指某物被交还给他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta servizz jew tweġiba jingħataw, jew meta xi ħaġa tingħata lura lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被给予；被提供，如服务或回应
被归还；被交还

collocations.en: the book was given back to its owner

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie rreġistrat is-servizz li ntradd lill-komunità matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report recorded the service rendered to the community during the year.
formal.zh: 报告记录了这一年中向社区提供的服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ktieb ta' Mark għadu għandek? Maja: Le, ntradd lilu lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you still have Mark's book? Maja: No, it was given back to him yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 的书还在你那里吗？Maja：不在了，昨天已经还给他了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 的书还在你那里吗？
messages.en: Do you still have Mark's book?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 不在了，昨天已经还给他了。
messages.en: No, it was given back to him yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅“交付”画面记忆：服务被提供给社区，借书被交回主人。遇到 ntradd 时，根据宾语和语境区分两义。

gloss_zh: 在重负下弯腰；被重物压弯

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend or stoop under the weight of a load.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指因承受重物而弯腰、俯身，或在重负下弯曲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li titgħawweġ jew titbaxxa taħt it-toqol ta' tagħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在重负下弯曲；因负重而弯腰

collocations.en: stooped under the weight of the sack
collocations.zh: 被袋子的重量压得弯下了腰

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ntrakat taħt it-toqol tal-ixkora waqt li kien iġorrha lejn il-maħżen.
formal.en: The worker stooped under the weight of the sack as he carried it towards the warehouse.
formal.zh: 工人扛着袋子走向仓库时，被袋子的重量压得弯下了腰。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt kif Mark ntrakat taħt dik l-ixkora? Lara: Iva, kienet tqila wisq. Ejja ngħinuh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see how Mark bent under that sack? Lara: Yes, it was too heavy. Let's help him.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看见 Mark 被那袋东西压弯腰了吗？Lara：看见了，太重了。我们去帮他吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif Mark ntrakat taħt dik l-ixkora?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif Mark ntrakat taħt dik l-ixkora?
messages.zh: 你看见 Mark 被那袋东西压弯腰了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how Mark bent under that sack?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet tqila wisq. Ejja ngħinuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet tqila wisq. Ejja ngħinuh.
messages.zh: 看见了，太重了。我们去帮他吧。
messages.en: Yes, it was too heavy. Let's help him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象肩上突然多了一袋重物，身体随重量弯下去。把“负重造成弯曲”这个完整动作与 ntrakat 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be set up or made ready for use; of an animal, to be fitted with a harness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被搭建或布置妥当以供使用；指动物时，表示被套上挽具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitwaqqaf jew jitħejja għall-użu; dwar annimal, jitwaħħallu x-xedd biex jiġbed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被搭建；被布置好
被套上挽具，以便拉车或牵引

collocations.en: The horse was harnessed to pull the cart.
collocations.zh: 马被套上挽具，用来拉车。

formal.mt: Il-palk ntrama fil-pjazza qabel il-bidu tal-kunċert.
formal.en: The stage was set up in the square before the concert began.
formal.zh: 音乐会开始前，舞台已在广场上搭建好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-palk għadu ma ntram ax? Mark: Iva, ntrama dalgħodu. Jonqos biss id-dwal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Hasn't the stage been set up yet? Mark: Yes, it was set up this morning. Only the lights are left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：舞台还没搭好吗？马克：搭好了，今天早上搭的。只剩灯光还没弄。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 舞台还没搭好吗？
messages.en: Hasn't the stage been set up yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (舞台工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ntrama dalgħodu. Jonqos biss id-dwal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ntrama dalgħodu. Jonqos biss id-dwal.
messages.zh: 搭好了，今天早上搭的。只剩灯光还没弄。
messages.en: Yes, it was set up this morning. Only the lights are left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntrama 联想到“舞台搭好了、马也套好了”两个画面，用“准备妥当”串起搭建和套挽具两种意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pressed or squeezed tightly, often between other things or people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到挤压或被挤得很紧，常指夹在其他物体或人之间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħafas jew jiġi magħfus sewwa, spiss bejn affarijiet jew persuni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挤压；被挤在狭窄空间中

formal.mt: Il-passiġġier ntrass bejn żewġ persuni meta l-karozza tal-linja mtliet.
formal.en: The passenger was squeezed between two people when the bus filled up.
formal.zh: 公交车挤满人时，那名乘客被挤在两个人之间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Leo niżel mill-karozza tal-linja? Mark: Ntrass mal-bieb u ma felaħx aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Leo get off the bus? Mark: He was squeezed against the door and couldn't take it anymore.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利奥为什么下公交车了？马克：他被挤在车门边，实在受不了了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 利奥为什么下公交车了？
messages.en: Why did Leo get off the bus?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntrass mal-bieb u ma felaħx aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Ntrass mal-bieb u ma felaħx aktar.
messages.zh: 他被挤在车门边，实在受不了了。
messages.en: He was squeezed against the door and couldn't take it anymore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ntrass 时想象拥挤公交车上肩膀被两边夹紧，抓住“受挤压”的身体感觉来记词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be scattered in small amounts or drops over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以少量颗粒或液滴的形式被撒落、洒落在某个表面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitferrex fi kwantitajiet żgħar jew fi qtar fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被撒上；以细小颗粒或液滴的形式被洒落

collocations.en: The salt was sprinkled over the potatoes.
The cheese was sprinkled over the pasta.

formal.mt: Il-ġobon maħkuk ntraxx fuq l-għaġin qabel ma ġie servut.
formal.en: The grated cheese was sprinkled over the pasta before it was served.
formal.zh: 意面上桌前，上面撒了磨碎的奶酪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà żidt il-melħ? Mark: Iva, ntraxx ftit melħ fuq il-patata. Duqha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you added the salt already? Mark: Yes, a little salt was sprinkled over the potatoes. Try them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你已经加盐了吗？马克：加了，土豆上撒了一点盐。尝尝吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你已经加盐了吗？
messages.en: Have you added the salt already?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ntraxx ftit melħ fuq il-patata. Duqha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ntraxx ftit melħ fuq il-patata. Duqha.
messages.zh: 加了，土豆上撒了一点盐。尝尝吧。
messages.en: Yes, a little salt was sprinkled over the potatoes. Try them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntraxx 配成撒盐的慢镜头：细小颗粒散落在食物表面，记住它表示“被撒上、被洒上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be won, as a prize or contest; of a person, to be persuaded to support or accept something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指奖项或比赛被赢得；指人被说服，从而愿意支持或接受某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkiseb b'rebħa, bħal premju jew konkors; dwar persuna, tiġi persważa biex taċċetta jew tappoġġa xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被赢得；通过竞争而获得
被说服；被争取过来而表示支持或接受

collocations.en: The prize was won by the team.
collocations.zh: 该奖项由这个团队赢得。

collocations.en: was won over by the arguments

formal.mt: Il-konkors ntrebaħ minn student li ppreżenta proġett dwar l-ambjent.
formal.en: The competition was won by a student who presented a project about the environment.
formal.zh: 一名展示了环保项目的学生赢得了这次比赛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu kontra l-pjan? Mark: Le, fl-aħħar ntrebaħ bl-argumenti tagħna u issa jaqbel magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still against the plan? Mark: No, he was finally won over by our arguments and now agrees with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗还反对这个计划吗？马克：不反对了，他终于被我们的理由说服，现在同意我们的看法了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗还反对这个计划吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still against the plan?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fl-aħħar ntrebaħ bl-argumenti tagħna u issa jaqbel magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fl-aħħar ntrebaħ bl-argumenti tagħna u issa jaqbel magħna.
messages.zh: 不反对了，他终于被我们的理由说服，现在同意我们的看法了。
messages.en: No, he was finally won over by our arguments and now agrees with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ntrebaħ 时并排画“奖杯被赢得”和“反对者点头支持”，分别对应赢得比赛与争取人心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To kiss someone passionately, especially with an open mouth and contact between tongues.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人热烈接吻，尤指张嘴并有舌头接触的法式接吻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbewwes b'passjoni ma' xi ħadd, speċjalment b'bewsa b'ħalq miftuħ u kuntatt bejn l-ilsna.

sense_translations.en_definition: to kiss passionately; to French-kiss; to snog
sense_translations.zh_definition: 热烈接吻；法式接吻；亲热地拥吻

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist adult ntreda' mas-sieħba tiegħu wara li t-tnejn stqarrew imħabbithom.
formal.en: In the novel, the adult protagonist kissed his partner passionately after they both declared their love.
formal.zh: 小说中，成年男主角与伴侣互诉爱意后热烈接吻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar l-appuntament ta' Leo ma' Sara? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna! Qalli li ntreda' magħha qabel ma sellmu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Leo's date with Sara go? Mark: Really well! He told me he kissed her passionately before they said goodbye.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：利奥和萨拉的约会怎么样？马克：特别好！他说他们道别前热吻了。

messages.speaker: Maja (成年朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif mar l-appuntament ta' Leo ma' Sara?
messages.mt_standard: Kif mar l-appuntament ta' Leo ma' Sara?
messages.zh: 利奥和萨拉的约会怎么样？
messages.en: How did Leo's date with Sara go?

messages.speaker: Mark (成年朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Qalli li ntreda' magħha qabel ma sellmu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Qalli li ntreda' magħha qabel ma sellmu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 特别好！他说他们道别前热吻了。
messages.en: Really well! He told me he kissed her passionately before they said goodbye.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntreda' 放进恋人约会后热吻的场景，记住这里说的是亲密热烈的接吻，强度超过普通轻吻。

gloss_zh: 被举起；被抬起；被收好；被存放

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be raised or lifted; also, to be put away or kept in storage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被举起、抬高或提起；也指被收起来，放在某处保存。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittella' jew jiġi mgħolli; ukoll, jitqiegħed f'post biex jinżamm jew jiġi maħżun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被升起；被抬高
被举起；被从原处提起或抬起
被收好；被放入合适的位置
被存放；被储存以供日后使用

collocations.en: The crate was lifted off the ground.
The equipment was put away in the storeroom.

formal.mt: It-tagħmir ntrefa' fil-maħżen wara li ntemmet l-attività.
formal.en: The equipment was stored in the storeroom after the activity ended.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，设备被存放在储藏室里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-kaxxon li kien hawn? Mark: Ntrefa' minn mal-art u tqiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the crate that was here go? Mark: It was lifted off the floor and put on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：原来在这里的木箱去哪儿了？马克：从地上抬起来，放到架子上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar il-kaxxon li kien hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar il-kaxxon li kien hawn?
messages.zh: 原来在这里的木箱去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the crate that was here go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntrefa' minn mal-art u tqiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Ntrefa' minn mal-art u tqiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 从地上抬起来，放到架子上了。
messages.en: It was lifted off the floor and put on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“箱子被抬起，再被收进仓库”的连续画面记 ntrefa'，同时掌握向上移动和收纳存放两组意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown away or discarded because something is no longer wanted or useful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不再需要或不再有用而被扔掉、丢弃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mitfugħ jew jitwarrab għax ma jkunx għadu mixtieq jew utli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔掉；被作为不要的东西丢掉
被丢弃；被弃置而不再保留或使用

formal.mt: Id-dokument oriġinali ntrema bi żball waqt it-tindif tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The original document was discarded by mistake during the office cleaning.
formal.zh: 清理办公室时，文件原件被误丢弃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-biljett li ħallejt fuq il-mejda? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fil-kexxun. Għall-ewwel ħsibt li ntrema!
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the ticket I left on the table? Mark: Yes, it's in the drawer. At first I thought it had been thrown away!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见我放在桌上的票了吗？马克：看见了，在抽屉里。我一开始还以为它被扔掉了！

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-biljett li ħallejt fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-biljett li ħallejt fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 你看见我放在桌上的票了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the ticket I left on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-kexxun. Għall-ewwel ħsibt li ntrema!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-kexxun. Għall-ewwel ħsibt li ntrema!
messages.zh: 看见了，在抽屉里。我一开始还以为它被扔掉了！
messages.en: Yes, it's in the drawer. At first I thought it had been thrown away!

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 ntrema 和垃圾桶的画面绑定：东西被判定不要了，随后被扔掉；再用它与“被收好”的 ntrefa' 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wanted or desired by someone, or to be needed for a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为某人想要或希望得到的对象；也指为实现某个目的而被需要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mixtieq minn xi ħadd, jew ikun meħtieġ għal xi skop.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被想要；有人希望得到或选用
被需要；为某个目的而成为必要条件

collocations.en: was needed to finish the work

formal.mt: Dan id-dokument ntried biex titlesta l-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: This document was needed to complete the application.
formal.zh: 完成申请需要这份文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġibt sellum ieħor? Mark: Ntried wieħed itwal biex nilħqu s-saqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you bring another ladder? Mark: A longer one was needed so we could reach the ceiling.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么又拿了一架梯子？马克：得用一架更长的，我们才能够到天花板。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起整理房间的朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么又拿了一架梯子？
messages.en: Why did you bring another ladder?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起整理房间的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntried wieħed itwal biex nilħqu s-saqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Ntried wieħed itwal biex nilħqu s-saqaf.
messages.zh: 得用一架更长的，我们才能够到天花板。
messages.en: A longer one was needed so we could reach the ceiling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ntried 时问两句：“有人想要它吗？”“办事需要它吗？”分别对应主观愿望和实际需要这两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be held upright or kept in position by a supporting object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借助支柱等支撑物保持直立或固定在原位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm wieqaf jew f'postu permezz ta' xi ħaġa li tagħtih appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被支撑起来；用支柱等撑住。
吃；进食。

collocations.en: The wall was propped up with wooden poles.
The roof was propped up from underneath.

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol ta' tiswija, il-ħajt ntrifed b'lasti tal-injam biex jibqa' stabbli.
formal.en: During the repair work, the wall was propped up with wooden poles to keep it stable.
formal.zh: 维修期间，墙用木杆撑住，以保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm dawk il-lasti ħdejn il-ħajt? Pawlu: Il-ħajt ntrifed għax kien qed jixxaqleb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are those poles next to the wall? Pawlu: The wall was propped up because it was leaning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：墙边为什么有那些杆子？保罗：墙有些倾斜，所以用杆子撑住了。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawk il-lasti ħdejn il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawk il-lasti ħdejn il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 墙边为什么有那些杆子？
messages.en: Why are those poles next to the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħajt ntrifed għax kien qed jixxaqleb.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħajt ntrifed għax kien qed jixxaqleb.
messages.zh: 墙有些倾斜，所以用杆子撑住了。
messages.en: The wall was propped up because it was leaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntrifed 和“墙靠木杆撑住”的画面一起记；遇到“吃”的义项时另建进食画面，不强行把两个意思连成一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have someone step or walk on something, often pressing it down or damaging it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人用脚踩到或从上面走过，常因此被压倒或损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħaġa li xi ħadd jgħaddi minn fuqha b'saqajh, u jista' jagħfasha jew jagħmlilha ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被踩到；被踩踏。
受压迫；遭到压制。

collocations.en: The people were oppressed by the rulers.
collocations.zh: 人民受到统治者的压迫。

formal.mt: Għal ħafna snin, il-poplu ntrifes minn ħakkiema li ma rrispettawx id-drittijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: For many years, the people were oppressed by rulers who did not respect their rights.
formal.zh: 多年来，人民受到不尊重其权利的统治者压迫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħaxix hawn kollu mgħaffeġ? Mark: Ntrifes meta n-nies għaddew minn hawn wara l-kunċert.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is all the grass here flattened? Mark: It was trodden on when people passed through here after the concert.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的草怎么全被压倒了？马克：音乐会结束后，人们从这里经过，把草踩倒了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这里的草怎么全被压倒了？
messages.en: Why is all the grass here flattened?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntrifes meta n-nies għaddew minn hawn wara l-kunċert.
messages.mt_standard: Ntrifes meta n-nies għaddew minn hawn wara l-kunċert.
messages.zh: 音乐会结束后，人们从这里经过，把草踩倒了。
messages.en: It was trodden on when people passed through here after the concert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记草地被脚踩倒的具体画面，再记人民受到压迫的抽象场景；用两个例句区分 ntrifes 的两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be held back or kept under control so that free movement or action is limited.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被控制或制止，使自由移动或行动受到限制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżamm lura jew taħt kontroll sabiex ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq jew jaġixxi liberament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被约束；被制住；行动受到限制。

collocations.en: The horse was restrained with the reins.

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel ntrigen bir-riedni biex il-veterinarju jkun jista' jeżaminah mingħajr periklu.
formal.en: The horse was restrained with the reins so that the veterinarian could examine it safely.
formal.zh: 马被缰绳控制住，以便兽医安全地为它检查。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Iż-żiemel kien se jaħrab? Toni: Iva, imma ntrigen bir-riedni u issa hu kalm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the horse about to run away? Toni: Yes, but it was restrained with the reins and is calm now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那匹马刚才要跑掉吗？托尼：是的，不过用缰绳控制住了，现在已经平静了。

messages.speaker: Sara (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 那匹马刚才要跑掉吗？
messages.en: Was the horse about to run away?

messages.speaker: Toni (骑术教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ntrigen bir-riedni u issa hu kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ntrigen bir-riedni u issa hu kalm.
messages.zh: 是的，不过用缰绳控制住了，现在已经平静了。
messages.en: Yes, but it was restrained with the reins and is calm now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“马想往前跑，却被缰绳控制住”的场景：ntrigen 强调受到约束、不能自由行动的状态。

gloss_zh: 被骑乘；被置于从属地位

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry a rider who sits on and travels on an animal or vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人骑在上面，作为动物或交通工具承载骑乘者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal annimal jew vettura li xi ħadd joqgħod fuqhom biex jivvjaġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被骑；被骑乘。
被迫服从他人；被置于受支配的从属地位。

collocations.en: The horse was ridden by an experienced rider.
collocations.zh: 这匹马由一位经验丰富的骑手骑乘。

collocations.en: The people were made subservient by a ruler.
collocations.zh: 人民被一位统治者置于受支配的地位。

formal.mt: Matul it-taħriġ, iż-żiemel ntrikeb minn rikkieb b'esperjenza taħt is-superviżjoni tal-għalliem.
formal.en: During training, the horse was ridden by an experienced rider under the instructor's supervision.
formal.zh: 训练期间，一位经验丰富的骑手在教练监督下骑乘了这匹马。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan iż-żiemel ntrikeb illum? Luqa: Iva, Marija ħarġet bih dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was this horse ridden today? Luqa: Yes, Marija took it out for a ride this morning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天有人骑过这匹马吗？卢卡：有，玛丽亚今天早上骑它出去过。

messages.speaker: Nina (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 今天有人骑过这匹马吗？
messages.en: Was this horse ridden today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (马场工作人员)
messages.zh: 有，玛丽亚今天早上骑它出去过。
messages.en: Yes, Marija took it out for a ride this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“马被骑乘”记具体义，用“人民被迫服从统治者”记抽象义；看到 ntrikeb 时先判断句子谈的是骑乘还是支配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be employed as a tool, material, or means of achieving a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被当作工具、材料或手段，用来实现某种目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iservi bħala għodda, materjal jew mezz biex jintlaħaq xi skop.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被使用；被用于某种目的。
被人利用以牟利或获益；受到剥削。

collocations.en: The computer was used for work.
The worker was exploited for someone else's profit.
collocations.zh: 这名工人被剥削，为他人创造利润。

formal.mt: Fil-proġett, il-materjal riċiklat ntuża biex jitnaqqas l-iskart.
formal.en: In the project, recycled material was used to reduce waste.
formal.zh: 该项目使用了再生材料，以减少废弃物。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-kompjuter ntuża waqt il-laqgħa? Ben: Iva, u fih għad hemm il-preżentazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was this computer used during the meeting? Ben: Yes, and the presentation is still on it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：开会时用过这台电脑吗？本：用过，演示文稿还在里面。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 开会时用过这台电脑吗？
messages.en: Was this computer used during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u fih għad hemm il-preżentazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u fih għad hemm il-preżentazzjoni.
messages.zh: 用过，演示文稿还在里面。
messages.en: Yes, and the presentation is still on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntuża 放进“电脑被用于工作”的句子记忆；主语换成人并出现他人获利的语境时，再留意“被利用、被剥削”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sent through the air by someone throwing or tossing an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因被人扔出或抛出而在空中移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintrema jew jintefa' fl-arja minn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔出；被抛出。

collocations.en: The ball was thrown into the air.
The stones were thrown into the sea.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-ballun ntwaddab minn naħa għall-oħra tal-grawnd.
formal.en: During the exercise, the ball was thrown from one side of the field to the other.
formal.zh: 练习时，球从场地的一侧被扔到了另一侧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-ballun? Sam: Ntwaddab fuq il-bejt. Ejja nitolbu l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the ball go? Sam: It was thrown onto the roof. Let's ask for help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：球到哪里去了？萨姆：被扔到屋顶上了。我们找人帮忙吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 球到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the ball go?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ntwaddab fuq il-bejt. Ejja nitolbu l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Ntwaddab fuq il-bejt. Ejja nitolbu l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 被扔到屋顶上了。我们找人帮忙吧。
messages.en: It was thrown onto the roof. Let's ask for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个球被抛起，再落到屋顶上：用这条运动路线记 ntwaddab，并一起练习表示去向的短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be presented or made visible so that people can see it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被呈现或展示出来，让人能够看见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi ppreżentat jew jidher b'mod li n-nies ikunu jistgħu jarawh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被展示；被显示出来。
被证明属实或成立；得到证实。
被展出；作为展品公开陈列。

collocations.en: The result was displayed on the screen.
This was proven by the evidence.
collocations.zh: 这一点得到了证据的证明。

formal.mt: Il-kwadru ntwera fil-mużew bħala parti minn wirja dwar l-arti lokali.
formal.en: The painting was exhibited in the museum as part of an exhibition about local art.
formal.zh: 这幅画作为本地艺术展的一部分，在博物馆展出。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ir-riżultat ntwera fuq l-iskrin? Karl: Iva, imma ma lħaqtx qrajtu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Was the result displayed on the screen? Karl: Yes, but I didn't manage to read it in time.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：结果显示在屏幕上了吗？卡尔：显示了，但我没来得及看清。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 结果显示在屏幕上了吗？
messages.en: Was the result displayed on the screen?

messages.speaker: Karl (同学)
messages.zh: 显示了，但我没来得及看清。
messages.en: Yes, but I didn't manage to read it in time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ntwera 配三张学习卡：屏幕显示结果、证据证明事实、博物馆展出画作；根据搭配选择相应中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive an answer or response to a question, request, or message.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 问题、请求或消息得到回答或回应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal mistoqsija, talba jew messaġġ li jingħata tweġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被回答；得到答复或回应。

collocations.zh: 这条消息立即得到了回复。

collocations.en: The appeal was answered by the community.
collocations.zh: 这一呼吁得到了社区的回应。

formal.mt: Il-messaġġ tal-klijent ntwieġeb bil-miktub fi żmien jumejn.
formal.en: The client's message was answered in writing within two days.
formal.zh: 客户的消息在两天内得到了书面回复。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Il-messaġġ tiegħek ntwieġeb? David: Iva, qaluli li nista' mmur għada.
colloquial.en: Elena: Was your message answered? David: Yes, they told me I can go tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：你的消息收到回复了吗？戴维：收到了，他们说我明天可以去。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的消息收到回复了吗？
messages.en: Was your message answered?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qaluli li nista' mmur għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qaluli li nista' mmur għada.
messages.zh: 收到了，他们说我明天可以去。
messages.en: Yes, they told me I can go tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ntwieġeb 与“发出的消息终于有了回复”连起来记；练习时让消息作主语，突出“得到答复”的视角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be left in a place or condition, or to be abandoned without care or support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被留在某处或某种状态中；也可指遭到遗弃，不再得到照料或支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li titħalla f'post jew f'qagħda, jew li tiġi abbandunata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被留下；被留在某处或某种状态中。
被遗弃；被抛下而无人照料或支持。

collocations.en: the book was left on the table
the dog was abandoned in the street

formal.mt: Il-kelb ntħalla fit-triq mingħajr ikel jew ilma, u aktar tard ittieħed f'kenn għall-annimali.
formal.en: The dog was abandoned in the street without food or water and was later taken to an animal shelter.
formal.zh: 这只狗被遗弃在街上，没有食物和水，后来被送进了动物收容所。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajtu l-ktieb tiegħi? David: Iva, ntħalla fuq il-mejda tal-kċina.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you seen my book? David: Yes, it was left on the kitchen table.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看见我的书了吗？戴维：看见了，留在厨房桌上了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你看见我的书了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my book?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 看见了，留在厨房桌上了。
messages.en: Yes, it was left on the kitchen table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 ntħalla：桌上的书是“被留下”，无人照料的狗是“被遗弃”；具体含义靠语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be planted in soil so that a plant can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物被栽入土中，以便继续生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal pjanta li titqiegħed fil-ħamrija biex tikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被种植；被栽入土中。

collocations.en: the basil was planted in a pot
the pomegranate tree was planted in the garden
collocations.zh: 石榴树被栽在了花园里

formal.mt: Il-ħabaq ntħawwel f'borma kbira u tqiegħed f'post xemxi.
