formal.en: The basil was planted in a large pot and placed in a sunny spot.
formal.zh: 罗勒被种进一个大花盆，并放在阳光充足的地方。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-ħabaq ġdid? Toni: Iva, ntħawwel ilbieraħ. Tista' ssaqqih ftit?
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this basil new? Toni: Yes, it was planted yesterday. Can you water it a little?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这株罗勒是新种的吗？托尼：是，昨天种的。你能给它浇一点水吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 这株罗勒是新种的吗？
messages.en: Is this basil new?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ntħawwel ilbieraħ. Tista' ssaqqih ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ntħawwel ilbieraħ. Tista' ssaqqih ftit?
messages.zh: 是，昨天种的。你能给它浇一点水吗？
messages.en: Yes, it was planted yesterday. Can you water it a little?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象罗勒从育苗盆搬进土里，把 ntħawwel 与“植物被栽好、等待生长”的画面连接。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An integer that leaves a remainder of one when divided by two.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 除以二后余数为一的整数，如一、三、五。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Numru sħiħ li, meta jinqasam bi tnejn, iħalli fdal ta' wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奇数，不能被二整除的整数。

collocations.en: an odd number greater than ten
the sum of two odd numbers

formal.mt: Sebgħa huwa numru bil-fard għax, meta jinqasam bi tnejn, iħalli fdal ta' wieħed.
formal.en: Seven is an odd number because it leaves a remainder of one when divided by two.
formal.zh: 七是奇数，因为七除以二余一。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Disgħa huwa numru bil-fard? Mark: Iva, għax jekk tagħmel pari minn disa' oġġetti, jibqa' wieħed waħdu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is nine an odd number? Mark: Yes, because if you pair up nine objects, one is left on its own.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：九是奇数吗？马克：是的，因为把九件东西两两配对，会剩下一件。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 九是奇数吗？
messages.en: Is nine an odd number?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax jekk tagħmel pari minn disa' oġġetti, jibqa' wieħed waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax jekk tagħmel pari minn disa' oġġetti, jibqa' wieħed waħdu.
messages.zh: 是的，因为把九件东西两两配对，会剩下一件。
messages.en: Yes, because if you pair up nine objects, one is left on its own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一、三、五个小圆点两两配对，总有一个落单；用这个画面记住 numru bil-fard 是奇数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An integer that is divisible by two without a remainder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能被二整除、没有余数的整数，如零、二、四。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Numru sħiħ li jista' jinqasam bi tnejn mingħajr ma jibqa' fdal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偶数，能被二整除的整数。

collocations.en: an even number less than ten
the sum of two even numbers

formal.mt: Tmienja huwa numru biż-żewġ għax jista' jinqasam bi tnejn mingħajr ma jibqa' fdal.
formal.en: Eight is an even number because it can be divided by two without a remainder.
formal.zh: 八是偶数，因为八除以二没有余数。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sitta huwa numru biż-żewġ? David: Iva, tista' taqsam sitt buttuni fi tliet pari.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is six an even number? David: Yes, you can divide six buttons into three pairs.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：六是偶数吗？戴维：是的，六颗纽扣可以分成三对。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 六是偶数吗？
messages.en: Is six an even number?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' taqsam sitt buttuni fi tliet pari.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' taqsam sitt buttuni fi tliet pari.
messages.zh: 是的，六颗纽扣可以分成三对。
messages.en: Yes, you can divide six buttons into three pairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象六颗纽扣恰好排成三对，没有任何一颗落单；把这个整齐配对的画面与 numru biż-żewġ 联结。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A positive integer greater than one whose only positive divisors are one and itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大于一且正因数只有一和它本身的整数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Numru sħiħ akbar minn wieħed li l-uniċi diviżuri pożittivi tiegħu huma wieħed u n-numru nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 质数，又称素数；大于一且仅能被一和自身整除的正整数。

collocations.en: a prime number greater than twenty

formal.mt: Ħdax huwa numru prim għax l-uniċi diviżuri pożittivi tiegħu huma wieħed u ħdax.
formal.en: Eleven is a prime number because its only positive divisors are one and eleven.
formal.zh: 十一是质数，因为它的正因数只有一和十一。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Wieħed huwa numru prim? Paul: Le, numru prim irid ikun akbar minn wieħed u jkollu eżattament żewġ diviżuri pożittivi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is one a prime number? Paul: No, a prime number must be greater than one and have exactly two positive divisors.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：一是质数吗？保罗：不是，质数必须大于一，而且恰好有两个正因数。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 一是质数吗？
messages.en: Is one a prime number?

messages.speaker: Paul (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, numru prim irid ikun akbar minn wieħed u jkollu eżattament żewġ diviżuri pożittivi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, numru prim irid ikun akbar minn wieħed u jkollu eżattament żewġ diviżuri pożittivi.
messages.zh: 不是，质数必须大于一，而且恰好有两个正因数。
messages.en: No, a prime number must be greater than one and have exactly two positive divisors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 numru prim 画两扇门，门牌分别写“一”和“自身”；记住它大于一，而且正因数只有这两个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The outer layers of cereal grains separated during milling, used in food and animal feed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谷物磨制时分离出来的外层部分，可用于制作食品或作为动物饲料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet ta' barra tal-qamħ jew ta' ċereali oħra li jinfirdu waqt it-tħin u jintużaw fl-ikel jew bħala għalf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麸皮，谷物磨制时分离出的外层部分。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li tiżdied in-nuħħala mad-dqiq qabel ma jitħalltu l-ingredjenti l-oħra.
formal.en: The recipe calls for adding the bran to the flour before mixing in the other ingredients.
formal.zh: 食谱要求先把麸皮加入面粉，再混入其他配料。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'żidt ma' dan il-ħobż? Pawlu: Żidt ftit nuħħala mad-dqiq.
colloquial.en: Marija: What did you add to this bread? Pawlu: I added a little bran to the flour.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你在这个面包里加了什么？保罗：我在面粉里加了一点麸皮。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在这个面包里加了什么？
messages.en: What did you add to this bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在面粉里加了一点麸皮。
messages.en: I added a little bran to the flour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象磨面时分离出来的一层谷物外皮，再把 nuħħala 与“麦麸面包”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool containing a liquid-filled tube with a bubble, used to check whether a surface is horizontal or vertical.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用液体管中气泡的位置来检查表面是否水平或垂直的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'tubu mimli b'likwidu u bżieżaq tal-arja li tintuża biex tiċċekkja jekk wiċċ huwiex orizzontali jew vertikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 气泡水平仪，用于检查表面是否水平或垂直的工具。

sense_translations.en_definition: on a par, on a level
sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于同等程度或同一水平；齐平地。

collocations.en: place the spirit level on the shelf

formal.mt: Qabel ma twaħħal l-ixkaffa mal-ħajt, uża l-invell biex tiżgura li tkun orizzontali.
formal.en: Before fixing the shelf to the wall, use the spirit level to ensure that it is horizontal.
formal.zh: 把搁板固定到墙上之前，先用水平仪确认它处于水平位置。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tini l-invell, jekk jogħġbok? Mario: Hawn hu. Poġġih fuq l-ixkaffa u ara fejn qiegħda l-bużżieqa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you pass me the spirit level, please? Mario: Here it is. Put it on the shelf and see where the bubble is.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：请把水平仪递给我，好吗？马里奥：给你。把它放在搁板上，看看气泡在哪里。

messages.speaker: Rita (安装工)
messages.zh: 请把水平仪递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the spirit level, please?

messages.speaker: Mario (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hu. Poġġih fuq l-ixkaffa u ara fejn qiegħda l-bużżieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hu. Poġġih fuq l-ixkaffa u ara fejn qiegħda l-bużżieqa.
messages.zh: 给你。把它放在搁板上，看看气泡在哪里。
messages.en: Here it is. Put it on the shelf and see where the bubble is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 nvell 就想象水平仪中央的小气泡：名词指检查水平的工具，副词义则联想“处于同一水平”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Blossom considered collectively, especially the flowers appearing on a plant or tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 统指植物或树木上开放的花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fjuri ta' pjanta jew ta' siġra meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花，尤指作为整体来谈论的植物或树木上的花。

formal.mt: Fir-rebbiegħa, in-nwar tas-siġar tal-larinġ jimla l-ġnien b'riħa ħelwa.
formal.en: In spring, the blossom on the orange trees fills the garden with a sweet scent.
formal.zh: 春天，橙树上的花让花园弥漫着甜美的香气。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa sabiħa? Ġużi: Min-nwar tas-siġra tal-larinġ ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is this lovely scent coming from? Ġużi: From the blossom on the orange tree next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这股好闻的香气是从哪里来的？朱齐：来自门旁那棵橙树上的花。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa sabiħa?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa sabiħa?
messages.zh: 这股好闻的香气是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this lovely scent coming from?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (园主)
messages.zh: 来自门旁那棵橙树上的花。
messages.en: From the blossom on the orange tree next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 nwar 时想象整棵树一起开花的景象，用“一树花、一阵香”帮助记住它统称花的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual blossom on a plant or tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物或树木上的一朵花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjura waħda fuq pjanta jew siġra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一朵花，指植物或树木上的单个花朵。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tidher nwara bajda fuq fergħa tas-siġra tal-larinġ.
formal.en: The picture shows a white blossom on a branch of the orange tree.
formal.zh: 图片中可以看到橙树枝上的一朵白花。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ara dik in-nwara ċkejkna fuq il-fergħa! Toni: Sabiħa ħafna. Se nieħu ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Look at that tiny blossom on the branch! Toni: It's beautiful. I'll take a photo of it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：看树枝上那朵小花！托尼：真漂亮。我要给它拍张照。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik in-nwara ċkejkna fuq il-fergħa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik in-nwara ċkejkna fuq il-fergħa!
messages.zh: 看树枝上那朵小花！
messages.en: Look at that tiny blossom on the branch!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sabiħa ħafna. Se nieħu ritratt tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Sabiħa ħafna. Se nieħu ritratt tagħha.
messages.zh: 真漂亮。我要给它拍张照。
messages.en: It's beautiful. I'll take a photo of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头从整树的 nwar 拉近到单独一朵 nwara；用“整树花与一朵花”的画面对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slightly dry or somewhat lacking in moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有些干燥或水分略显不足的，程度较轻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit niexef jew b'inqas umdità milli jkun mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点干的，略微缺少水分的。

formal.mt: Il-kejk kien nwejxef, għalhekk ġie servut ma' ftit krema.
formal.en: The cake was somewhat dry, so it was served with a little cream.
formal.zh: 蛋糕有点干，因此搭配了少量奶油一起上桌。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Dan il-ħobż nwejxef, hux? Samwel: Iva, ejja niekluh mas-soppa.
colloquial.en: Lina: This bread is a bit dry, isn't it? Samwel: Yes, let's eat it with the soup.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这个面包有点干，对吧？萨姆韦尔：是啊，我们配着汤吃吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个面包有点干，对吧？
messages.en: This bread is a bit dry, isn't it?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们配着汤吃吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's eat it with the soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象咬下一口面包后觉得“稍微有点干，配口汤就好”；把 nwejxef 与这种轻度干燥的感觉联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be detected by the sense of smell, or to give off a smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物的气味被人闻到，或某物本身散发出气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta xi ħaġa tinħass bis-sens tax-xamm jew meta toħroġ riħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被闻到；气味被嗅觉察觉。
散发气味；发出可闻到的味道。

collocations.en: The smoke could be smelled from far away.
The cheese gave off a smell.

formal.mt: Id-duħħan nxamm fil-kuritur qabel ma deher in-nar.
formal.en: The smoke was smelled in the corridor before the fire became visible.
formal.zh: 在看见火之前，走廊里就已闻到烟味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik ir-riħa? Toni: Il-ġobon nxamm malli ftaħt il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that smell? Toni: The cheese gave off a smell as soon as I opened the box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么味道？托尼：我一打开盒子，奶酪就散发出了气味。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是什么味道？
messages.en: What's that smell?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我一打开盒子，奶酪就散发出了气味。
messages.en: The cheese gave off a smell as soon as I opened the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nxamm 放进“鼻子察觉气味”的画面：从闻者看是“被闻到”，从物体看是“散发气味”，用两个视角记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a crack or become split, without necessarily breaking into separate pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体出现裂纹或裂开，不一定完全碎成几块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta f'oġġett tidher qasma, mingħajr ma bilfors jinkiser f'biċċiet separati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裂开；表面或内部出现裂纹。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġie nnutat li l-ħajt nxaqq qrib it-tieqa.
formal.en: During the inspection, it was noted that the wall had developed a crack near the window.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，靠近窗户的墙面出现了裂纹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lill-vażun? Mark: Waqa' minn fuq il-mejda u nxaqq, imma ma nkisirx f'biċċiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the vase? Mark: It fell off the table and cracked, but it didn't break into pieces.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：花瓶怎么了？马克：它从桌上掉下来裂了，但没有碎成几块。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 花瓶怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the vase?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' minn fuq il-mejda u nxaqq, imma ma nkisirx f'biċċiet.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' minn fuq il-mejda u nxaqq, imma ma nkisirx f'biċċiet.
messages.zh: 它从桌上掉下来裂了，但没有碎成几块。
messages.en: It fell off the table and cracked, but it didn't break into pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nxaqq 与玻璃上的一道裂纹连起来记：看见“裂缝出现”，就想到这个词；画面可以保留完整轮廓，不必想成碎片。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be purchased in exchange for money, or, of a person, to be bribed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品被花钱买下；用于人时，也可指被贿赂、被收买。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta xi ħaġa tinkiseb bi ħlas, jew meta persuna taċċetta flus jew favur biex taġixxi b'mod mhux onest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被买下；被购买。
被贿赂；被金钱或其他利益收买。

collocations.en: The book was bought from the shop.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-uffiċjal nxara biex jagħlaq għajnejh għall-ksur tar-regoli.
formal.en: In the story, the official was bribed to turn a blind eye to breaches of the rules.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那名官员被收买，对违规行为视而不见。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ktieb ġdid? Pawlu: Iva, nxara lbieraħ mill-ħanut ħdejn l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this book new? Pawlu: Yes, it was bought yesterday from the shop next to the school.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书是新的吗？保罗：是的，昨天从学校旁边的商店买的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书是新的吗？
messages.en: Is this book new?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nxara lbieraħ mill-ħanut ħdejn l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nxara lbieraħ mill-ħanut ħdejn l-iskola.
messages.zh: 是的，昨天从学校旁边的商店买的。
messages.en: Yes, it was bought yesterday from the shop next to the school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nxara 配两张学习卡：物品旁写“被买下”，人物旁写“被收买”。先看句中谈的是物还是人，再结合情境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be considered carefully and at length.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个想法、问题或计划受到仔细而深入的思考。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta ħsieb, suġġett jew pjan jitqies bil-kwiet u bir-reqqa għal xi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被深思；被反复、仔细地琢磨。

collocations.zh: 这个想法经过了深入思考。

collocations.en: The plan was pondered at length.
collocations.zh: 这个计划经过了长时间的琢磨。

formal.mt: Il-pjan nxarr fit-tul qabel ittieħdet id-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: The plan was pondered at length before the final decision was made.
formal.zh: 在作出最终决定之前，这个计划经过了长时间的深思。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-pjan għamiltuh malajr? David: Le, il-pjan nxarr sew qabel qbilna fuqu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you put this plan together quickly? David: No, the plan was carefully pondered before we agreed on it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们很快就拟好这个计划了吗？戴维：没有，这个计划经过仔细琢磨，我们才达成一致。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你们很快就拟好这个计划了吗？
messages.en: Did you put this plan together quickly?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-pjan nxarr sew qabel qbilna fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-pjan nxarr sew qabel qbilna fuqu.
messages.zh: 没有，这个计划经过仔细琢磨，我们才达成一致。
messages.en: No, the plan was carefully pondered before we agreed on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nxarr 想成桌上放着一份计划，大家安静地反复琢磨；记忆重点是“计划被深思”，而不是某个人一闪而过的念头。

gloss_zh: 发生便秘；变得排便困难

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become constipated and have difficulty passing stools.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指开始出现便秘，排便变得困难或不顺畅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta persuna tibda tbati minn stitikezza u ssibha diffiċli tagħmel l-ippurgar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生便秘；开始出现排便困难。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie nnutat li l-pazjent nxedd matul iż-żjara tiegħu fl-isptar.
formal.en: The report noted that the patient became constipated during his hospital stay.
formal.zh: 报告记录，该患者在住院期间出现了便秘。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif inhu Leo llum? Marija: Nxedd u qed isibha diffiċli jagħmel l-ippurgar.
colloquial.en: Anna: How is Leo today? Marija: He has become constipated and is having difficulty passing stools.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：利奥今天怎么样？玛丽亚：他便秘了，现在排便有困难。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 利奥今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is Leo today?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Nxedd u qed isibha diffiċli jagħmel l-ippurgar.
messages.mt_standard: Nxedd u qed isibha diffiċli jagħmel l-ippurgar.
messages.zh: 他便秘了，现在排便有困难。
messages.en: He has become constipated and is having difficulty passing stools.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nxedd 记在“身体状况发生变化”这一栏，用“原先正常，后来排便困难”的前后画面，帮助记住“开始便秘”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be lit, or to be switched or turned on so that a light, appliance, or other device starts operating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指火被点燃，或灯具、电器等被开启、接通而开始工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta jibda jaqbad nar, jew meta dawl jew apparat jibda jaħdem wara li jintuża l-iswiċċ jew il-kontroll tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被点燃；被点亮。
被打开开关；被接通电源。
被开启；设备或装置被启动。

formal.mt: Id-dawl nxegħel malli s-senser irreġistra moviment fil-kuritur.
formal.en: The light was switched on as soon as the sensor detected movement in the corridor.
formal.zh: 传感器一检测到走廊里有动静，灯就亮了。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Għad hawn id-dlam? Rita: Le, id-dawl nxegħel issa. Tista' tidħol.
colloquial.en: Ben: Is it still dark in here? Rita: No, the light has come on now. You can come in.
colloquial.zh: 本：这里还黑着吗？丽塔：不黑了，灯现在亮了。你可以进来。

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 这里还黑着吗？
messages.en: Is it still dark in here?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, id-dawl nxegħel issa. Tista' tidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Le, id-dawl nxegħel issa. Tista' tidħol.
messages.zh: 不黑了，灯现在亮了。你可以进来。
messages.en: No, the light has come on now. You can come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nxegħel 配一个连续画面：火点着、灯亮起、电脑启动。三者都从未启动变成已启动，帮助串联三个给定义项。

gloss_zh: 被作为证据陈述；经证言提出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stated or presented as evidence, especially through testimony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某件事或某项事实被作为证据陈述，尤其指通过证言提出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta fatt jew dak li ġara jingħad bħala xhieda biex jgħin jistabbilixxi l-verità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被作为证据提出或陈述；通过证言加以说明。

collocations.en: The fact was given as evidence in court.
collocations.zh: 这一事实在法庭上被作为证据陈述。

collocations.mt: Dak li ġara nxehed taħt ġurament.
collocations.en: What happened was given as evidence under oath.
collocations.zh: 事情的经过在宣誓后被作为证据陈述。

formal.mt: Waqt is-seduta, nxehed li l-bieb kien magħluq meta waslu l-pulizija.
formal.en: During the hearing, it was given as evidence that the door was closed when the police arrived.
formal.zh: 庭审期间，有证言指出，警察到达时门是关着的。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fil-qorti ssemma meta wasal ir-raġel? Ġużeppi: Iva, nxehed li wasal fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Marta: Was it mentioned in court when the man arrived? Ġużeppi: Yes, it was given as evidence that he arrived at eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：法庭上提到那个男人什么时候到达了吗？朱塞佩：提到了，有证言说他八点到达。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 法庭上提到那个男人什么时候到达了吗？
messages.en: Was it mentioned in court when the man arrived?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.zh: 提到了，有证言说他八点到达。
messages.en: Yes, it was given as evidence that he arrived at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nxehed 放在法庭证人席的画面里：一句话被正式作为证据说出来。用“证言进入庭审”记住它的陈述功能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be communicated or passed on to someone, as knowledge, information, or teaching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指知识、信息或教导被传给他人，使对方得以了解或学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad meta għarfien, tagħrif jew tagħlim jitwassal lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被传授；知识、信息或教导被传达给他人。

collocations.en: The knowledge was imparted to the students.

collocations.zh: 教学内容得到了清楚的传授。

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, l-għarfien nxeher lill-istudenti permezz ta' spjegazzjonijiet u eżempji.
formal.en: During the lesson, knowledge was imparted to the students through explanations and examples.
formal.zh: 课堂上，知识通过讲解和例子传授给了学生。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif tgħallimtu dan kollu? Samwel: L-għarfien nxeher lilna waqt il-kors, bi spjegazzjonijiet sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Elena: How did you learn all this? Samwel: The knowledge was imparted to us during the course, through simple explanations.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你们是怎么学会这些的？萨姆韦尔：课程中，这些知识通过简单的讲解传授给了我们。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们是怎么学会这些的？
messages.en: How did you learn all this?

messages.speaker: Samwel (课程学员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għarfien nxeher lilna waqt il-kors, bi spjegazzjonijiet sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: L-għarfien nxeher lilna waqt il-kors, bi spjegazzjonijiet sempliċi.
messages.zh: 课程中，这些知识通过简单的讲解传授给了我们。
messages.en: The knowledge was imparted to us during the course, through simple explanations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nxeher 想成老师把知识交到学生手中，重点是“内容被传给别人”；再用课堂画面与 nxehed 的法庭证言画面区分记忆。

gloss_zh: 被尖锐工具刺穿，扎出孔

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a hole made in it by a sharp instrument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体被针、锥子等尖锐工具刺穿或扎出孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ssir toqba f'xi ħaġa permezz ta' għodda bil-ponta.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be perforated with a sharp instrument
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被尖锐工具刺穿或扎出孔。

collocations.en: was perforated with a pointed tool

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-kartun nxekk bil-labra biex il-ħajta tkun tista' tgħaddi minnu.
formal.en: During the exercise, the cardboard was pierced with a needle so that the thread could pass through it.
formal.zh: 练习时，纸板被针扎出孔，以便让线穿过去。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif saret din it-toqba fil-kartun? Lara: Il-kartun nxekk bil-labra waqt li kont qed naħdem.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did this hole get into the cardboard? Lara: The cardboard was pierced with the needle while I was working.
colloquial.zh: 马克：纸板上的这个孔是怎么来的？拉拉：我干活时，纸板被针扎穿了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 纸板上的这个孔是怎么来的？
messages.en: How did this hole get into the cardboard?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kartun nxekk bil-labra waqt li kont qed naħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kartun nxekk bil-labra waqt li kont qed naħdem.
messages.zh: 我干活时，纸板被针扎穿了。
messages.en: The cardboard was pierced with the needle while I was working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象针尖穿过纸板留下小孔，把这个词与“尖头工具造成穿孔”的完整画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be accused of wrongdoing or formally charged with an offence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被指称做了错事，也可指因涉嫌某项罪行而被正式起诉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li persuna tkun akkużata li għamlet xi ħaġa ħażina jew li titressaq akkuża formali kontriha għal reat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被指责做了错事；被指控。
因涉嫌犯罪而被正式起诉。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel nxela formalment b'serq, iżda ċaħad l-akkuża.
formal.en: In the story, the man was formally charged with theft, but he denied the accusation.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子因盗窃被正式起诉，但他否认了指控。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex kien imdejjaq it-tifel fl-istorja? Ben: Għax nxela li seraq il-flus, iżda qal li ma kien ħa xejn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why was the boy in the story upset? Ben: Because he was accused of stealing the money, but he said he had taken nothing.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：故事里的男孩为什么难过？本：因为他被指控偷了钱，但他说自己什么也没拿。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的男孩为什么难过？
messages.en: Why was the boy in the story upset?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nxela li seraq il-flus, iżda qal li ma kien ħa xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nxela li seraq il-flus, iżda qal li ma kien ħa xejn.
messages.zh: 因为他被指控偷了钱，但他说自己什么也没拿。
messages.en: Because he was accused of stealing the money, but he said he had taken nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义放进故事中的指控场景：别人说他偷钱是“被指控”，进入正式起诉程序则对应第二义。

gloss_zh: 被沿长度方向切开，纵向剖开

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut open along its length.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体沿自身的长度方向被切开或剖开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tinqata' jew tinfetaħ b'qatgħa mat-tul tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be cut along the length
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被沿长度方向切开；被纵向剖开。

collocations.en: was slit lengthwise with a knife

formal.mt: It-tubu nxeraħ mat-tul tiegħu sabiex l-istudenti setgħu jaraw il-parti ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The tube was cut along its length so that the students could see the inside.
formal.zh: 管子被沿长度方向剖开，以便学生观察内部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan it-tubu miftuħ minn tarf sa tarf? Pawlu: Nxeraħ mat-tul biex inkunu nistgħu naraw ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this tube open from one end to the other? Pawlu: It was cut lengthwise so that we could see inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这根管子为什么从一头到另一头都开着？保罗：它被纵向剖开了，方便我们看里面。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tubu miftuħ minn tarf sa tarf?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tubu miftuħ minn tarf sa tarf?
messages.zh: 这根管子为什么从一头到另一头都开着？
messages.en: Why is this tube open from one end to the other?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Nxeraħ mat-tul biex inkunu nistgħu naraw ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Nxeraħ mat-tul biex inkunu nistgħu naraw ġewwa.
messages.zh: 它被纵向剖开了，方便我们看里面。
messages.en: It was cut lengthwise so that we could see inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沿着长管画一条从头到尾的切线，再顺线剖开；用这个动作牢牢记住“纵向切开”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become scattered over an area or dispersed from one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指原本聚在一起的东西散落到各处，或人群等从一处散开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tinfirex f'postijiet differenti, jew li grupp jitferrex minn post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散落，被散布到各处。
散开，被分散。

formal.mt: Meta nfetħet il-borża, ir-ross nxered mal-art.
formal.en: When the bag opened, the rice scattered over the floor.
formal.zh: 袋子一打开，米就散落在地上。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm ross kullimkien? Mark: Il-borża waqgħet u r-ross nxered mal-art. Se niġbru issa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is there rice everywhere? Mark: The bag fell and the rice scattered over the floor. I'll pick it up now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：怎么到处都是米？马克：袋子掉了，米散落了一地。我现在就把它收拾起来。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 怎么到处都是米？
messages.en: Why is there rice everywhere?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-borża waqgħet u r-ross nxered mal-art. Se niġbru issa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-borża waqgħet u r-ross nxered mal-art. Se niġbru issa.
messages.zh: 袋子掉了，米散落了一地。我现在就把它收拾起来。
messages.en: The bag fell and the rice scattered over the floor. I'll pick it up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一袋米撒开和一群人散开的画面并排记忆：共同点是从集中一处变成分布各处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cooked by grilling, or to have its surface scorched by strong heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物被烤制，也可指表面受到强热而被烤焦或灼焦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tissajjar fuq il-gradilja, jew li l-wiċċ tagħha jinħaraq bis-sħana qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放在烤架上烤制。
被强热烤焦或灼焦。

formal.mt: Il-ħut nxewa fuq il-gradilja u ġie servut ma' ħaxix frisk.
formal.en: The fish was grilled and served with fresh vegetables.
formal.zh: 鱼在烤架上烤好后，配上新鲜蔬菜端上桌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħobż sar iswed minn barra? Ben: Kien qrib wisq tan-nar u nxewa minn barra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has the bread turned black on the outside? Ben: It was too close to the fire and got scorched on the outside.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：面包外面怎么变黑了？本：它离火太近，外面烤焦了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħobż sar iswed minn barra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħobż sar iswed minn barra?
messages.zh: 面包外面怎么变黑了？
messages.en: Why has the bread turned black on the outside?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qrib wisq tan-nar u nxewa minn barra.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qrib wisq tan-nar u nxewa minn barra.
messages.zh: 它离火太近，外面烤焦了。
messages.en: It was too close to the fire and got scorched on the outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用火候串联两个义项：火候合适时食物被烤好，热量过强时表面被烤焦；结合上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown, or to throw oneself onto something or into a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被扔到某处，也可指自己扑向、倒在某物上或纵身进入某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jkunu mitfugħin, jew li persuna titfa' lilha nfisha fuq xi ħaġa jew f'xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔，被投掷。
自己扑过去、倒下或纵身投入。

collocations.en: was thrown to the ground; threw himself to the ground

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif, il-kartun qadim nxeħet fil-kontenitur tar-riċiklaġġ.
formal.en: During the cleaning, the old cardboard was thrown into the recycling container.
formal.zh: 清理时，旧纸板被扔进了回收箱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Rita: Għadu kif wasal u nxeħet fuq is-sodda. Kien għajjien ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu? Rita: He just arrived and threw himself onto the bed. He was very tired.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在哪里？丽塔：他刚到家就一头倒在床上。他累极了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kif wasal u nxeħet fuq is-sodda. Kien għajjien ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kif wasal u nxeħet fuq is-sodda. Kien għajjien ħafna.
messages.zh: 他刚到家就一头倒在床上。他累极了。
messages.en: He just arrived and threw himself onto the bed. He was very tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分义项：纸板被扔进箱子，人疲惫地扑到床上；都围绕身体或物体被投向某处来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of having little or no moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水分很少或缺乏水分的状态，即干燥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' xi ħaġa li fiha ftit ilma jew ftit umdità, jew xejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥；缺少水分或湿气的状态。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu n-nxief tal-ħamrija fiż-żewġ qsari qabel ma saqqew il-pjanti.
formal.en: The students compared the dryness of the soil in the two pots before watering the plants.
formal.zh: 学生们在给植物浇水之前，比较了两个花盆中土壤的干燥程度。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed tmiss il-ħamrija? Pawlu: Qed niċċekkja n-nxief tagħha biex nara jekk il-pjanta għandhiex bżonn l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you touching the soil? Pawlu: I'm checking its dryness to see whether the plant needs water.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么摸土？保罗：我在检查它的干燥程度，看看植物是否需要浇水。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么摸土？
messages.en: Why are you touching the soil?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed niċċekkja n-nxief tagħha biex nara jekk il-pjanta għandhiex bżonn l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Qed niċċekkja n-nxief tagħha biex nara jekk il-pjanta għandhiex bżonn l-ilma.
messages.zh: 我在检查它的干燥程度，看看植物是否需要浇水。
messages.en: I'm checking its dryness to see whether the plant needs water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词贴在干土和干燥皮肤的画面旁，记住它表示“缺少水分的状态”，学习时搭配具体事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of having a thin or lean body or appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体或外貌显得瘦、瘦削的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' ġisem jew dehra b'laħam jew xaħam ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘦；身体或外貌的瘦削状态。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-karattru, l-awtriċi semmiet in-nxiefa tal-ġisem tiegħu u l-għajnejn kbar tiegħu.
formal.en: In her description of the character, the author mentioned the thinness of his body and his large eyes.
formal.zh: 描写这个人物时，作者提到了他瘦削的身体和大大的眼睛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħmel il-wiċċ fir-ritratt daqshekk distint? Mark: In-nxiefa tal-wiċċ u l-għajnejn kbar. Dawk innutajt l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What makes the face in the portrait so distinctive? Mark: The thinness of the face and the large eyes. Those were what I noticed first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：画像里的脸为什么这么有辨识度？马克：因为瘦削的脸庞和大大的眼睛。我最先注意到的就是这些。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 画像里的脸为什么这么有辨识度？
messages.en: What makes the face in the portrait so distinctive?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nxiefa tal-wiċċ u l-għajnejn kbar. Dawk innutajt l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: In-nxiefa tal-wiċċ u l-għajnejn kbar. Dawk innutajt l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 因为瘦削的脸庞和大大的眼睛。我最先注意到的就是这些。
messages.en: The thinness of the face and the large eyes. Those were what I noticed first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将这个词配上瘦削人物的速写来记；再与表示干燥的 nxief 做词卡对照，分别记住“瘦”和“干燥”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of having little moisture, especially in skin, soil, or another material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤、土壤或其他物质缺少水分的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' ġilda, ħamrija jew materjal ieħor meta jkun fih ftit umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥；水分不足的状态。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi n-nxif tal-ħamrija wara diversi ġimgħat mingħajr xita.
formal.en: The report describes the dryness of the soil after several weeks without rain.
formal.zh: 报告描述了连续数周无雨后土壤的干燥状况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed inħoss il-ġilda ta' jdejja tiġbidni. Lara: Forsi minħabba n-nxif. Għandek xi krema għall-idejn?
colloquial.en: Maja: The skin on my hands feels tight. Lara: Maybe it's because of dryness. Do you have any hand cream?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我觉得手上的皮肤紧绷绷的。拉拉：可能是因为干燥。你有护手霜吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss il-ġilda ta' jdejja tiġbidni.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss il-ġilda ta' jdejja tiġbidni.
messages.zh: 我觉得手上的皮肤紧绷绷的。
messages.en: The skin on my hands feels tight.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi minħabba n-nxif. Għandek xi krema għall-idejn?
messages.mt_standard: Forsi minħabba n-nxif. Għandek xi krema għall-idejn?
messages.zh: 可能是因为干燥。你有护手霜吗？
messages.en: Maybe it's because of dryness. Do you have any hand cream?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nxif 与手背紧绷、泥土干裂的画面联系起来，记住它是表示“干燥状态”的名词。

gloss_zh: 晾衣；把衣物挂到晾衣绳上

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of hanging clothes on a line so that they can dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣物挂到晾衣绳上使其晾干的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha l-ħwejjeġ jiddendlu ma' ħabel biex jinxfu.

sense_translations.en_definition: hanging of clothes on a line
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把衣物挂到晾衣绳上晾晒的活动。

collocations.en: hanging clothes out on a line

formal.mt: In-nxir tal-ħwejjeġ fil-bitħa jsir filgħodu, meta jkun hemm biżżejjed dawl u arja.
formal.en: Clothes are hung out on a line in the courtyard in the morning, when there is enough light and airflow.
formal.zh: 衣物在早晨挂到院子里的晾衣绳上，那时光照和通风都比较充足。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għad għandna ħafna x'nagħmlu? Rita: Il-ħasil lest; fadal biss in-nxir. Tgħinni bil-lożor?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do we still have a lot to do? Rita: The washing is done; we just need to hang it out. Will you help me with the sheets?
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们还有很多事要做吗？丽塔：衣服洗好了，只剩晾晒。你帮我晾床单好吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 我们还有很多事要做吗？
messages.en: Do we still have a lot to do?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħasil lest; fadal biss in-nxir. Tgħinni bil-lożor?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħasil lest; fadal biss in-nxir. Tgħinni bil-lożor?
messages.zh: 衣服洗好了，只剩晾晒。你帮我晾床单好吗？
messages.en: The washing is done; we just need to hang it out. Will you help me with the sheets?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把湿衣服一件件夹到绳上的动作，用 nxir 记“晾衣这件事”，重点放在活动本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smaller or lose moisture; when said of a drink or other liquid, to be consumed by drinking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变小或失去水分；用于饮料或其他液体时，表示被饮用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiċkien jew jitlef l-umdità; meta jingħad għal xarba jew likwidu ieħor, li jiġi kkunsmat bix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收缩；尺寸或体积变小。
失去水分；变干。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be drunk (used of a beverage or other liquid)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喝下；被饮用，用于饮料或其他液体。

collocations.en: the grapes lost moisture in the sun
collocations.zh: 葡萄在阳光下失去了水分

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil b'ilma sħun, id-drapp nxorob u sar iżgħar mid-daqs oriġinali tiegħu.
formal.en: After being washed in hot water, the fabric shrank and became smaller than its original size.
formal.zh: 经热水洗涤后，布料发生收缩，比原来的尺寸小了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fadal meraq fil-buqar? Mark: Le, nxorob kollu waqt l-ikla. Trid ftit ilma?
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there any juice left in the jug? Mark: No, it was all drunk during the meal. Would you like some water?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：壶里还有果汁吗？马克：没有，吃饭时全喝光了。你要喝点水吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 壶里还有果汁吗？
messages.en: Is there any juice left in the jug?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nxorob kollu waqt l-ikla. Trid ftit ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Le, nxorob kollu waqt l-ikla. Trid ftit ilma?
messages.zh: 没有，吃饭时全喝光了。你要喝点水吗？
messages.en: No, it was all drunk during the meal. Would you like some water?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个独立画面记 nxorob：布料缩水、葡萄失水、果汁被喝光。先看主语，再选择对应意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be something that someone wishes for or desires.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为某人所期望或渴望得到的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun xi ħaġa li xi ħadd jixtieq jew jittama li jikseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被期望；成为他人希望实现或得到的事物。
被渴望；成为他人想要得到的事物。

collocations.en: a result that everyone wished for
an agreement that both sides desired
collocations.zh: 双方都渴望达成的协议

formal.mt: Il-ftehim nxtaq miż-żewġ naħat għaliex seta' jġib aktar stabbiltà fir-reġjun.
formal.en: The agreement was desired by both sides because it could bring greater stability to the region.
formal.zh: 双方都希望达成这项协议，因为它能够为该地区带来更大的稳定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kulħadd feraħ bir-riżultat? Pawlu: Iva, kien riżultat li nxtaq minn kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was everyone happy with the result? Pawlu: Yes, it was a result that everyone wished for.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家都对这个结果感到高兴吗？保罗：是的，这是大家都期望的结果。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家都对这个结果感到高兴吗？
messages.en: Was everyone happy with the result?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien riżultat li nxtaq minn kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien riżultat li nxtaq minn kulħadd.
messages.zh: 是的，这是大家都期望的结果。
messages.en: Yes, it was a result that everyone wished for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准“大家盼望的结果”：nxtaq 的主语是被期望的事物，可用“这个结果受到期盼”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be considered carefully and thoughtfully before a conclusion or decision is reached.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在作出结论或决定之前，受到认真而深入的思考。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġi kkunsidrat bir-reqqa u bil-ħsieb qabel tintlaħaq konklużjoni jew tittieħed deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被深思；被反复而仔细地考虑。

collocations.zh: 这项计划经过了仔细考虑

collocations.en: the advice was pondered at length
collocations.zh: 这条建议经过了长时间思考

formal.mt: Il-pjan nxtarr bir-reqqa mill-kumitat qabel ittieħdet id-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: The plan was pondered carefully by the committee before the final decision was made.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出最终决定之前，仔细考虑了这项计划。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex damet daqshekk biex ittieħdet deċiżjoni? Mark: Il-pjan nxtarr sew; kien hemm ħafna affarijiet x'inqisu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did it take so long to make a decision? Mark: The plan was carefully thought over; there were many things for us to consider.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么花了这么久才作出决定？马克：这项计划经过了仔细考虑；我们有很多事情要权衡。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex damet daqshekk biex ittieħdet deċiżjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex damet daqshekk biex ittieħdet deċiżjoni?
messages.zh: 为什么花了这么久才作出决定？
messages.en: Why did it take so long to make a decision?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pjan nxtarr sew; kien hemm ħafna affarijiet x'inqisu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pjan nxtarr sew; kien hemm ħafna affarijiet x'inqisu.
messages.zh: 这项计划经过了仔细考虑；我们有很多事情要权衡。
messages.en: The plan was carefully thought over; there were many things for us to consider.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份计划被放在桌上，大家反复推敲后才决定。用这个画面把 nxtarr 记成“被仔细思考”。

gloss_zh: 产生欲望；感到渴望或情欲

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel desire or longing, including sexual desire in an appropriate context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生想要某人或某物的欲望；在相应语境中也可指产生情欲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iħoss xewqa għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa, inkluża xewqa sesswali skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到欲望或渴求；也可指产生情欲，具体取决于语境。

collocations.en: felt a craving for a piece of cake
felt desire as soon as he saw the food
collocations.zh: 一看到食物就产生了想吃的欲望

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-vjaġġatur nxteha malli xamm ir-riħa tal-ħobż frisk.
formal.en: In the story, the traveller felt a craving as soon as he smelled the fresh bread.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅人一闻到新鲜面包的香味，就产生了想吃的欲望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għaliex waqaf quddiem il-vetrina tal-ħelu? Lara: Ra l-kejk u nxteha għal biċċa. Ejja nidħlu miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu stop in front of the pastry display? Lara: He saw the cake and felt a craving for a slice. Let's go in with him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么停在甜点橱窗前？拉拉：他看到了蛋糕，馋得想吃一块。我们陪他进去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għaliex waqaf quddiem il-vetrina tal-ħelu?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għaliex waqaf quddiem il-vetrina tal-ħelu?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么停在甜点橱窗前？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop in front of the pastry display?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ra l-kejk u nxteha għal biċċa. Ejja nidħlu miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ra l-kejk u nxteha għal biċċa. Ejja nidħlu miegħu.
messages.zh: 他看到了蛋糕，馋得想吃一块。我们陪他进去吧。
messages.en: He saw the cake and felt a craving for a slice. Let's go in with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看见蛋糕，心里忽然很想吃”的画面记 nxteha，核心是本人产生欲望；是否涉及情欲要看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move into a lying position, for example on a bed or sofa, often to rest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让身体进入躺卧姿势，例如躺到床或沙发上休息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jimtedd, pereżempju fuq sodda jew sufan, spiss biex jistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躺下；使身体由坐着或站着转为躺卧。

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata twila ta' xogħol, ir-raġel nxteħet fuq is-sodda biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After a long day at work, the man lay down on the bed to rest.
formal.zh: 工作了漫长的一天后，那名男子躺到床上休息。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn hu Mark? Pawlu: Nxteħet fuq is-sufan. Qal li kellu bżonn jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is Mark? Pawlu: He lay down on the sofa. He said he needed a little rest.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克在哪里？保罗：他躺到沙发上了。他说需要休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 马克在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nxteħet fuq is-sufan. Qal li kellu bżonn jistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Nxteħet fuq is-sufan. Qal li kellu bżonn jistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他躺到沙发上了。他说需要休息一会儿。
messages.en: He lay down on the sofa. He said he needed a little rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象劳累一天后整个人躺到沙发上，用 nxteħet 记住“躺下”的动作，注意拼写中带横线的 ħ。

gloss_zh: 受到辱骂；成为侮辱性言语的对象

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be the person at whom insulting comments are directed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为侮辱性评论或辱骂所针对的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun il-persuna li kontriha jingħad kliem ta' insult.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be the object of insulting remarks
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到辱骂；成为侮辱性言论所针对的对象。

collocations.en: was subjected to insulting remarks in front of everyone
was subjected to insulting remarks because of a mistake
collocations.zh: 因为一个错误而受到辱骂

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-impjegat nziek quddiem il-kollegi tiegħu wara żball żgħir.
formal.en: According to the report, the employee was subjected to insulting remarks in front of his colleagues after a minor mistake.
formal.zh: 据报告，该员工犯了一个小错误后，在同事面前受到了辱骂。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex telaq Pawlu? Toni: Nziek quddiem kulħadd u ħassu ħażin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu leave? Toni: He was subjected to insulting remarks in front of everyone and felt upset.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么走了？托尼：他在大家面前受到辱骂，心里很难受。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nziek quddiem kulħadd u ħassu ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Nziek quddiem kulħadd u ħassu ħażin.
messages.zh: 他在大家面前受到辱骂，心里很难受。
messages.en: He was subjected to insulting remarks in front of everyone and felt upset.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象难听的话像箭头一样指向某个人：这个词描述被言语攻击的人所遭遇的事，记作“受到辱骂”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: to be put in prison and kept there
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被关进监狱，受到监禁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed fil-ħabs u jinżamm hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被监禁；被关进监狱。

collocations.en: was imprisoned together with his brother
collocations.zh: 与他的兄弟一起被监禁

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li r-raġel nħabes għal sena wara s-sentenza tal-qorti.
formal.en: The report states that the man was imprisoned for a year following the court's sentence.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该男子在法院判决后被监禁一年。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ir-raġel fir-rakkont nħabes? Pawlu: Iva, nħabes għal sena, u wara mar lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Was the man in the story imprisoned? Pawlu: Yes, he was imprisoned for a year, and afterwards he returned to his family.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：故事里的那个男人被关进监狱了吗？保罗：是的，他被监禁了一年，后来回到了家人身边。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男人被关进监狱了吗？
messages.en: Was the man in the story imprisoned?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nħabes għal sena, u wara mar lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nħabes għal sena, u wara mar lura għand il-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，他被监禁了一年，后来回到了家人身边。
messages.en: Yes, he was imprisoned for a year, and afterwards he returned to his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“铁门关上、人被监禁”的画面中记忆；同时对比 nħabeż 的烤箱画面，注意词尾 s 与 ż 的区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: to be cooked by baking, especially in an oven
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过烘烤而熟成，尤其指食物在烤箱中被烤制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissajjar bil-ħami, speċjalment f'forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烘烤；被放入烤箱烤制。

formal.mt: Il-ħobż nħabeż fil-forn sakemm sar dehbi u tħalla jiksaħ qabel tqatta'.
formal.en: The bread was baked in the oven until golden and left to cool before it was sliced.
formal.zh: 面包在烤箱中烤至金黄色，放凉后才切片。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħobż nħabeż illum? Mark: Iva, nħabeż dalgħodu; għadu sħun.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was this bread baked today? Mark: Yes, it was baked this morning; it is still warm.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个面包是今天烤的吗？马克：是的，今天早晨烤的，还热着呢。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个面包是今天烤的吗？
messages.en: Was this bread baked today?

messages.speaker: Mark (面包师)
messages.zh: 是的，今天早晨烤的，还热着呢。
messages.en: Yes, it was baked this morning; it is still warm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想面包躺在烤箱里慢慢变成金黄色，记住主语是“被烤”的食物；再与 nħabes 的监狱画面对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 被制作；被制造；被计算出来；受骗

teaching_sense.en_definition: to be made or manufactured, to be worked out as a calculation, or to be tricked
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品被制作或制造、算题被算出，也可指人受到欺骗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi magħmul jew immanifatturat; fil-każ ta' kalkolu, jiġi kkalkulat; fil-każ ta' persuna, tiġi mqarrqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被制作；被做成。
被制造；通过生产加工制成。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be worked out (e.g. used of a sum or calculation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被计算出来；指算题或计算过程得到完成。
受骗；被欺骗或被耍弄。

collocations.en: the calculation was worked out correctly
was deceived by a dishonest seller

formal.mt: Il-mudell nħadem bl-idejn, filwaqt li l-prodott finali nħadem f'fabbrika.
formal.en: The model was made by hand, while the final product was manufactured in a factory.
formal.zh: 模型由手工制作，而最终产品则在工厂制造。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark jgħid li nħadem? Toni: Ħallas għal arloġġ ġdid, imma l-bejjiegħ bagħatlu wieħed qadim.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does Mark say he was tricked? Toni: He paid for a new watch, but the seller sent him an old one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么说自己受骗了？托尼：他付钱买的是新手表，卖家却寄给他一块旧的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么说自己受骗了？
messages.en: Why does Mark say he was tricked?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallas għal arloġġ ġdid, imma l-bejjiegħ bagħatlu wieħed qadim.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallas għal arloġġ ġdid, imma l-bejjiegħ bagħatlu wieħed qadim.
messages.zh: 他付钱买的是新手表，卖家却寄给他一块旧的。
messages.en: He paid for a new watch, but the seller sent him an old one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格画面记忆：手工做模型、工厂造产品、纸上算题、买家受骗。看到这个词先看主语和上下文，再选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: to be caught and held firmly in a hand
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被手抓住并握牢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqabad u jinżamm sew fl-id.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抓住；被握住。

collocations.en: was grasped in the boy's hand

formal.mt: Il-ħabel nħafen biż-żewġ idejn biex ma jiżloqx waqt l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The rope was grasped with both hands so that it would not slip during the exercise.
formal.zh: 练习时，绳子被双手牢牢抓住，以免滑脱。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-ħabel żelaq minn id it-tifel? David: Le, nħafen sew biż-żewġ idejn.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did the rope slip out of the boy's hand? David: No, it was grasped firmly with both hands.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：绳子从男孩手里滑出去了吗？戴维：没有，他用双手把绳子牢牢抓住了。

messages.speaker: Marta (教练)
messages.zh: 绳子从男孩手里滑出去了吗？
messages.en: Did the rope slip out of the boy's hand?

messages.speaker: David (助教)
messages.zh: 没有，他用双手把绳子牢牢抓住了。
messages.en: No, it was grasped firmly with both hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象绳子即将滑落，双手立刻收紧抓牢；把注意力放在“绳子被握住”的结果上，就能记住这个被动含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: to be forgiven for a fault, mistake, or wrongdoing
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因过失、错误或不当行为而获得原谅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-maħfra għal żball, nuqqas jew għemil ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被原谅；获得宽恕。

formal.mt: L-iżball tal-istudent nħafer wara li talab skuża u kkoreġa x-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The student's mistake was forgiven after he apologised and corrected his work.
formal.zh: 学生道歉并改正作业后，他的错误得到了谅解。

colloquial.mt: Anna: L-iżball tiegħi nħafer? Luqa: Iva, l-għalliem aċċetta l-apoloġija tiegħek. Tinkwetax aktar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was my mistake forgiven? Luqa: Yes, the teacher accepted your apology. Don't worry any more.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我的错误得到原谅了吗？卢卡：是的，老师接受了你的道歉。别再担心了。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 我的错误得到原谅了吗？
messages.en: Was my mistake forgiven?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-għalliem aċċetta l-apoloġija tiegħek. Tinkwetax aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-għalliem aċċetta l-apoloġija tiegħek. Tinkwetax aktar.
messages.zh: 是的，老师接受了你的道歉。别再担心了。
messages.en: Yes, the teacher accepted your apology. Don't worry any more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“犯错、道歉、对方点头接受”连成一幅画面；最后的安心感对应“获得原谅”，帮助记住这个词的含义。

gloss_zh: 被统治；被殖民；受支配；被情绪压倒

teaching_sense.en_definition: to come under rule, colonial control, or subjection, or to be overwhelmed by a feeling
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于统治、殖民控制或支配之下，也可指被某种情绪压倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqa' taħt il-ħakma, il-kontroll kolonjali jew is-setgħa ta' ħaddieħor, jew jinħakem minn sentiment qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被统治；处于某个统治者或政权的管辖之下。
被殖民；受到殖民统治。
被置于支配或控制之下；受到制伏。
被压倒；被强烈情绪等完全占据。

collocations.en: was colonised by a colonial power
collocations.zh: 受到殖民势力的殖民统治

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-pajjiż nħakem minn setgħa kolonjali għal ħafna snin qabel kiseb l-indipendenza.
formal.en: In the story, the country was colonised by a colonial power for many years before gaining independence.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个国家在获得独立之前，曾受到殖民势力多年的统治。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex Mark waqaf jitkellem fuq il-palk? Toni: Nħakem mill-biża', imma wara ftit kompla.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did Mark stop speaking on stage? Toni: He was overcome by fear, but after a little while he continued.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：马克为什么在台上突然不说话了？托尼：他一下子被恐惧压倒了，不过过了一会儿就继续说了。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark waqaf jitkellem fuq il-palk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark waqaf jitkellem fuq il-palk?
messages.zh: 马克为什么在台上突然不说话了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop speaking on stage?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nħakem mill-biża', imma wara ftit kompla.
messages.mt_standard: Nħakem mill-biża', imma wara ftit kompla.
messages.zh: 他一下子被恐惧压倒了，不过过了一会儿就继续说了。
messages.en: He was overcome by fear, but after a little while he continued.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“受到控制”的画面串联各义：国家受统治、地区被殖民、人被制伏、心被恐惧占满；具体意思要由主语和后接内容判断。

gloss_zh: 被刮擦；被磨碎或刨碎；向某人讨好

teaching_sense.en_definition: to be scratched or grated, or to try to gain someone's favour
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指表面被刮擦、食物被磨碎或刨碎，也可指设法讨好某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mħokk jew maħkuk; jista' wkoll ifisser li wieħed jipprova jikseb il-favur ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刮擦；表面被划出擦痕。
被磨碎或刨碎，尤其指奶酪等食物。
讨好某人；通过奉承等方式博取某人的好感。

collocations.en: the surface of the table was scratched

formal.mt: Il-ġobon nħakk fin u żdied mal-għaġin eżatt qabel ma ġie servut.
formal.en: The cheese was finely grated and added to the pasta just before it was served.
formal.zh: 奶酪被细细刨碎，并在意大利面上桌前加入其中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mario nħakk mal-kap il-ġurnata kollha? Luqa: Ried jieħu ġurnata vaganza, u għalhekk baqa' jfaħħru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mario curry favour with the boss all day? Luqa: He wanted to take a day off, so he kept praising him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马里奥为什么一整天都在向上司献殷勤？卢卡：他想请一天假，所以一直夸上司。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mario nħakk mal-kap il-ġurnata kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mario nħakk mal-kap il-ġurnata kollha?
messages.zh: 马里奥为什么一整天都在向上司献殷勤？
messages.en: Why did Mario curry favour with the boss all day?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jieħu ġurnata vaganza, u għalhekk baqa' jfaħħru.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jieħu ġurnata vaganza, u għalhekk baqa' jfaħħru.
messages.zh: 他想请一天假，所以一直夸上司。
messages.en: He wanted to take a day off, so he kept praising him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张情景卡：桌面有刮痕、奶酪成细屑、员工向上司献殷勤。用主语及 mal-kap 等搭配区分三个义项，不必强行合成一个中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be created or brought into existence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被创造出来，或从原先不存在的状态变为存在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi maħluq jew jibda jeżisti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被创造；被创立；被赋予存在。

collocations.en: a group that was created recently

formal.mt: Il-kumitat inħalaq biex jikkoordina l-attivitajiet kulturali tal-iskola.
formal.en: The committee was created to coordinate the school's cultural activities.
formal.zh: 该委员会的成立是为了协调学校的文化活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta nħalaq dan il-grupp? Toni: Ilbieraħ, biex nippjanaw il-vjaġġ flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: When was this group created? Toni: Yesterday, so we can plan the trip together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个群是什么时候建的？Toni：昨天建的，方便我们一起安排旅行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个群是什么时候建的？
messages.en: When was this group created?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天建的，方便我们一起安排旅行。
messages.en: Yesterday, so we can plan the trip together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nħalaq 配上“空白处出现一个新群组”的画面，记住重点是某物被创造或成立。

gloss_zh: 宣誓就任；被要求宣誓；被置于誓言约束之下

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be formally sworn in or placed under oath.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在正式程序中宣誓就任，或被要求宣誓并受誓言约束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittieħed il-ġurament tiegħu meta jidħol f'kariga jew qabel ma jagħti xhieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被正式安排宣誓；经宣誓就任或承担职务。
被要求宣誓，使其陈述受到誓言约束。

collocations.en: an official who was sworn into office
a witness who was put under oath in court
collocations.zh: 在法庭上被要求宣誓的证人

formal.mt: Ix-xhud inħalef qabel ma beda jagħti x-xhieda tiegħu.
formal.en: The witness was put under oath before he began giving his testimony.
formal.zh: 证人在开始作证前宣了誓。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ix-xhud tkellem mill-ewwel? Mark: Le, l-ewwel inħalef u mbagħad wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the witness speak straight away? Mark: No, first he was put under oath, and then he answered the questions.
colloquial.zh: Lara：证人一上来就发言了吗？Mark：没有，他先宣了誓，然后才回答问题。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 证人一上来就发言了吗？
messages.en: Did the witness speak straight away?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-ewwel inħalef u mbagħad wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-ewwel inħalef u mbagħad wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 没有，他先宣了誓，然后才回答问题。
messages.en: No, first he was put under oath, and then he answered the questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nħalef 放在“就职仪式或证人席上举手宣誓”的场景中，联记正式宣誓与誓言约束。

gloss_zh: 被梳理（纤维）；被耗尽；累得筋疲力尽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be carded, as wool or other fibres, or to become exhausted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指羊毛等纤维被梳理，也可指精力被耗尽、变得筋疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi mill-ħliġ, bħas-suf, jew jispiċċa għajjien ħafna u bla saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被梳理，使羊毛等纤维分开并理顺。
被耗尽精力；变得筋疲力尽。

collocations.en: wool that was carded before spinning
collocations.zh: 纺纱前经过梳理的羊毛
因工作而筋疲力尽的工人

formal.mt: Is-suf inħaleġ biex il-fibri jkunu lesti għall-għażil.
formal.en: The wool was carded so that the fibres would be ready for spinning.
formal.zh: 羊毛经过梳理，使纤维做好纺纱准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ġej magħna llejla? Toni: Ma naħsibx; illum inħaleġ bix-xogħol u jrid jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu coming with us tonight? Toni: I don't think so; work exhausted him today, and he wants to rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu今晚跟我们一起去吗？Toni：我看不会，他今天工作累坏了，想休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu今晚跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu coming with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naħsibx; illum inħaleġ bix-xogħol u jrid jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naħsibx; illum inħaleġ bix-xogħol u jrid jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 我看不会，他今天工作累坏了，想休息。
messages.en: I don't think so; work exhausted him today, and he wants to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张词义卡记 nħaleġ：一张画羊毛被梳理，一张画工人累瘫；这只是记忆配图，不表示两义的历史关系。

gloss_zh: 被解开；被松开；被拆散；关系或契约解除；被免除责任

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become untied, loose or unravelled; also, for a relationship or contract to be dissolved, or for someone to be released from a responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指结或束缚被解开、松开，线等被拆散；也指关系或契约解除，或某人被免除责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfetaħ jew jinħeles minn rabta, jew jitħoll f'ħjut; jista' jingħad ukoll għal relazzjoni jew kuntratt li jintemm, jew għal persuna li tinħeles minn responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被解开；打成的结或系缚被解除。
被松开；由紧变松。
被拆散或拆开，尤指线、编织物等。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be broken up (used of a relationship or contract)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被解除或终止，用于关系或契约。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be absolved of a responsibility
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被免除某项责任；不再承担该责任。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt inħall bi ftehim bejn iż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: The contract was dissolved by agreement between the two parties.
formal.zh: 双方协商解除了该契约。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqa' l-pakkett? Ben: L-għoqda nħallet u l-ħabel żelaq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the parcel fall? Ben: The knot came untied, and the rope slipped.
colloquial.zh: Sara：包裹怎么掉下来了？Ben：结松开了，绳子就滑脱了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 包裹怎么掉下来了？
messages.en: Why did the parcel fall?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.zh: 结松开了，绳子就滑脱了。
messages.en: The knot came untied, and the rope slipped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“解除连接”串记 nħall：绳结解开、编织拆散、关系或契约解除、责任免除；遇到句子再判断具体义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be borne or endured, or to be tolerated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指痛苦、负担等被承受，或不受欢迎的行为、情况被容忍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġarrab jew issapportat, bħal uġigħ, piż jew imġiba li mhix mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被承受；被忍受，尤指痛苦、困难或负担。
被容忍；虽不受欢迎但仍被接受或允许存在。

collocations.en: pain that was borne in silence

collocations.mt: storbju li nħamel għal ftit ħin
collocations.en: noise that was tolerated for a short time

formal.mt: L-istorbju nħamel għal ftit ħin, iżda mbagħad intalab is-skiet.
formal.en: The noise was tolerated for a short time, but silence was then requested.
formal.zh: 噪声起初被容忍了一会儿，但随后大家被要求保持安静。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ġirien ilmentaw mill-istorbju? Mark: Le, inħamel għal ftit ħin għax ix-xogħol kien se jispiċċa malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the neighbours complain about the noise? Mark: No, it was tolerated for a while because the work was going to finish soon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：邻居抱怨噪声了吗？Mark：没有，大家容忍了一会儿，因为施工很快就要结束。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 邻居抱怨噪声了吗？
messages.en: Did the neighbours complain about the noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, inħamel għal ftit ħin għax ix-xogħol kien se jispiċċa malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Le, inħamel għal ftit ħin għax ix-xogħol kien se jispiċċa malajr.
messages.zh: 没有，大家容忍了一会儿，因为施工很快就要结束。
messages.en: No, it was tolerated for a while because the work was going to finish soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 nħamel 时想象“疼痛被忍住、噪声被容忍”，把注意力放在被承受的事物上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deceive oneself by accepting an unrealistically favourable belief as true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把不切实际、对自己有利的想法当成事实，从而蒙骗自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq bih innifsu billi jemmen xi ħaġa li jixtieq tkun vera, minkejja li mhix realistika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自欺；以不符合实际的想法蒙骗自己。

collocations.en: deluded himself with the hope of easy success
collocations.zh: 抱着轻易成功的希望自欺
把空头承诺当真而自欺

formal.mt: L-istudent inħan meta ħaseb li seta' jgħaddi mill-eżami mingħajr ma jistudja.
formal.en: The student deluded himself when he thought he could pass the exam without studying.
formal.zh: 那名学生以为不学习也能通过考试，这是在自欺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ħaseb li kien se jirbaħ mingħajr taħriġ? Toni: Iva, inħan; issa jaf li jrid jitħarreġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu think he would win without training? Toni: Yes, he deluded himself; now he knows he needs to train.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu以为不训练就能赢吗？Toni：是啊，他当时在自欺；现在他知道得训练了。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ħaseb li kien se jirbaħ mingħajr taħriġ?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ħaseb li kien se jirbaħ mingħajr taħriġ?
messages.zh: Pawlu以为不训练就能赢吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu think he would win without training?

messages.speaker: Toni (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħan; issa jaf li jrid jitħarreġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħan; issa jaf li jrid jitħarreġ.
messages.zh: 是啊，他当时在自欺；现在他知道得训练了。
messages.en: Yes, he deluded himself; now he knows he needs to train.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nħan 配一句“不复习也一定能考过”，用愿望冒充事实的画面记住“自我蒙骗”。

gloss_zh: 变得嘶哑；被闷住而窒息；挤满人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become hoarse, to be smothered, or, of a place, to become crowded with people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人嗓音变得嘶哑、被闷住而难以呼吸，也可指某个地方挤满了人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir b'leħen maħnuq, jew ma jkunx jista' jieħu n-nifs; għal post, jimtela bin-nies tant li jkun hemm ħafna iffullar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗓音变得嘶哑；喊哑或说哑了嗓子。
被闷住，使呼吸受到阻碍或发生窒息。
挤满人；因人群聚集而变得拥挤。

collocations.en: a place that became packed with people

formal.mt: Il-kantant inħanaq wara prova twila u kellu jserraħ leħnu.
formal.en: The singer became hoarse after a long rehearsal and had to rest his voice.
formal.zh: 歌手经过长时间排练后嗓音变得嘶哑，不得不让嗓子休息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ħriġt barra? Lara: Il-post inħanaq bin-nies u ridt ftit arja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you go outside? Lara: The place got packed with people, and I wanted some air.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你怎么出来了？Lara：里面挤满了人，我想透透气。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么出来了？
messages.en: Why did you go outside?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-post inħanaq bin-nies u ridt ftit arja.
messages.mt_standard: Il-post inħanaq bin-nies u ridt ftit arja.
messages.zh: 里面挤满了人，我想透透气。
messages.en: The place got packed with people, and I wanted some air.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“声音哑、呼吸闷、场地挤”三幅画记 nħanaq，再根据主语是人还是地方选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be oppressed or brought under another's power through force or pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到压迫，或在强力、压力之下被压服、制服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi trattat b'mod inġust u oppressiv, jew jitqiegħed taħt il-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor bil-forza jew bil-pressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受压迫；受到不公正的压制或欺凌。
被压服；被制服并置于控制之下。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi poplu li nħaqar għal ħafna snin u li baqa' jitlob il-ġustizzja.
formal.en: The account describes a people who were oppressed for many years and continued to demand justice.
formal.zh: 这篇记述描写了一个遭受多年压迫、仍不断要求公正的民族。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-ħaddiem mar jitkellem mal-maniġer? Ben: Għax inħaqar fuq ix-xogħol u ried li xi ħadd jisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the worker go to speak to the manager? Ben: Because he was oppressed at work and wanted someone to hear him out.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那个工人为什么去找经理谈话？Ben：因为他在工作中受了压迫，想找个人听他说说。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 那个工人为什么去找经理谈话？
messages.en: Why did the worker go to speak to the manager?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax inħaqar fuq ix-xogħol u ried li xi ħadd jisimgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax inħaqar fuq ix-xogħol u ried li xi ħadd jisimgħu.
messages.zh: 因为他在工作中受了压迫，想找个人听他说说。
messages.en: Because he was oppressed at work and wanted someone to hear him out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nħaqar 记成“被强者压在下面”的学习画面：长期受到压制是受压迫，被强力控制是被制服。

gloss_zh: 被作为粪便排出；随粪便排出

teaching_sense.en_definition: For material to be passed out of the body as or with faeces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物质作为粪便或随粪便从体内排出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li materjal joħroġ mill-ġisem bħala ppurgar jew mal-ippurgar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被作为粪便排出；随排便排出体外。

collocations.en: was passed out of the body in faeces

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li l-materjal nħara mal-ippurgar.
formal.en: The report states that the material was passed with the stool.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该物质随粪便排出了体外。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ġara minn dak il-materjal fil-ġisem? Pawlu: Nħara mal-ippurgar.
colloquial.en: Marija: What happened to that material in the body? Pawlu: It was passed with the stool.
colloquial.zh: Marija：体内的那种物质后来怎么样了？Pawlu：它随粪便排出了。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 体内的那种物质后来怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to that material in the body?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 它随粪便排出了。
messages.en: It was passed with the stool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nħara 与 mal-ippurgar（随粪便）一起记，想象物质随排便离开身体的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a danger, obligation, or other unwanted thing to be evaded or avoided.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指危险、义务或其他不愿面对的事物被避开或规避。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li periklu, obbligu jew xi ħaġa mhux mixtieqa jiġu evitati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被避开；被逃避或规避。

formal.mt: Il-periklu nħarab billi nbidlet ir-rotta tal-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The danger was avoided by changing the route of the journey.
formal.zh: 通过改变行程路线，危险得以避开。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaddejtu mit-triq fejn waqgħu l-ġebel? Pawlu: Le, ħadna triq oħra u l-periklu nħarab.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you take the road where the rocks fell? Pawlu: No, we took another road and avoided the danger.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你们走了那条有落石的路吗？Pawlu：没有，我们走了另一条路，避开了危险。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们走了那条有落石的路吗？
messages.en: Did you take the road where the rocks fell?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħadna triq oħra u l-periklu nħarab.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħadna triq oħra u l-periklu nħarab.
messages.zh: 没有，我们走了另一条路，避开了危险。
messages.en: No, we took another road and avoided the danger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 il-periklu nħarab：危险摆在面前，路线绕开它；用这个画面记住被避开之义。

gloss_zh: 被烧毁；被烫伤；感到恼火或沮丧

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be damaged by fire or heat, or figuratively to become vexed or dismayed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指受到火或高温的损伤，也可比喻因某事而恼火、懊恼或沮丧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa ssirilhom ħsara bin-nar jew bis-sħana, jew li xi ħadd jinkedd jew jitnikket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烧着、烧毁或烧伤；被高温烫伤。
感到恼火、懊恼或沮丧。

collocations.en: was vexed or dismayed when he heard the news
collocations.zh: 听到消息时感到恼火或沮丧

formal.mt: Il-ħobż nħaraq għax tħalla fil-forn għal żmien twil wisq.
formal.en: The bread got burnt because it was left in the oven for too long.
formal.zh: 面包因为在烤箱里放得太久而烤焦了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif ħadha Pawlu meta sema' li l-vjaġġ tħassar? Sara: Nħaraq! Kien ilu jistenna dan il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did Pawlu react when he heard the trip was cancelled? Sara: He was really upset! He had been waiting for this trip for ages.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 听说旅行取消时是什么反应？Sara：他可懊恼了！他盼这次旅行盼了很久。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħadha Pawlu meta sema' li l-vjaġġ tħassar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħadha Pawlu meta sema' li l-vjaġġ tħassar?
messages.zh: Pawlu 听说旅行取消时是什么反应？
messages.en: How did Pawlu react when he heard the trip was cancelled?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nħaraq! Kien ilu jistenna dan il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Nħaraq! Kien ilu jistenna dan il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 他可懊恼了！他盼这次旅行盼了很久。
messages.en: He was really upset! He had been waiting for this trip for ages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 nħaraq：面包被火烤焦，人听到坏消息后心里冒火；分别对应实义和比喻义。

gloss_zh: 被耕过；在体育比赛中被击败

teaching_sense.en_definition: For land to be ploughed, or for a player or team to be beaten in sport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指土地被翻耕，也指运动员或球队在体育比赛中被击败。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-art tinqaleb bil-moħriet, jew li plejer jew tim jitlef f'logħba sportiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被犁过；被翻耕。
在体育比赛中被击败。

formal.mt: Il-qasam nħarat qabel iż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The plot of land was ploughed before sowing.
formal.zh: 这块土地在播种前进行了翻耕。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif mar it-tim tagħna lbieraħ? Pawlu: Nħarat! Tlifna erbgħa b'xejn.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did our team do yesterday? Pawlu: It got beaten! We lost four-nil.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们队昨天踢得怎么样？Pawlu：被打败了！我们零比四输了。

messages.speaker: Marija (球迷)
messages.zh: 我们队昨天踢得怎么样？
messages.en: How did our team do yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.zh: 被打败了！我们零比四输了。
messages.en: It got beaten! We lost four-nil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nħarat 放进两张词卡：土地被翻耕、球队被击败；看主语是土地还是球队来选义。

gloss_zh: 被拿出；被带出；被出版或发行

teaching_sense.en_definition: For something to be brought out of a place, or for a work to be published or issued.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物被从一个地方拿出或带出，也指作品被出版或发行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tittieħed minn ġewwa għal barra, jew li xogħol jiġi ppubblikat jew maħruġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拿出来；被带出来。
被出版；被发表或发行。

collocations.en: was brought out of the storeroom
was published in a new edition

formal.mt: Il-ktieb nħareġ f'edizzjoni ġdida b'daħla tal-awtur.
formal.en: The book was published in a new edition with a preface by the author.
formal.zh: 这本书出版了新版，并附有作者撰写的前言。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-pakkett għadu fil-maħżen? Pawlu: Le, nħareġ dalgħodu. Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the parcel still in the storeroom? Pawlu: No, it was brought out this morning. It's by the door.
colloquial.zh: Marija：包裹还在储藏室里吗？Pawlu：没有，今天早上已经拿出来了。就在门边。

messages.speaker: Marija (店员)
messages.zh: 包裹还在储藏室里吗？
messages.en: Is the parcel still in the storeroom?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nħareġ dalgħodu. Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nħareġ dalgħodu. Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 没有，今天早上已经拿出来了。就在门边。
messages.en: No, it was brought out this morning. It's by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 nħareġ 的两个场景：包裹从仓库拿出来，书籍出版后面向读者；用具体场景区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Copper, a reddish-brown metal used for electrical wiring, pipes, and other objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铜，一种呈红棕色的金属，可用于制作电线、水管和其他物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metall ta' lewn ħamrani fil-kannella li jintuża fil-wajers tal-elettriku, fil-pajpijiet u f'oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铜；一种红棕色的金属。

formal.mt: In-nħas jintuża fil-manifattura tal-wajers għax imexxi l-elettriku tajjeb.
formal.en: Copper is used in the manufacture of wires because it conducts electricity well.
formal.zh: 铜具有良好的导电性，因此被用于制造电线。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-brazzulett tal-fidda? Pawlu: Le, tan-nħas. Ara l-kulur ħamrani tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this bracelet silver? Pawlu: No, it's copper. Look at its reddish colour.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个手镯是银的吗？Pawlu：不是，是铜的。你看它泛红的颜色。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个手镯是银的吗？
messages.en: Is this bracelet silver?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tan-nħas. Ara l-kulur ħamrani tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tan-nħas. Ara l-kulur ħamrani tiegħu.
messages.zh: 不是，是铜的。你看它泛红的颜色。
messages.en: No, it's copper. Look at its reddish colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nħas 写在红棕色铜线的图旁，再配上 tan-nħas（铜制的），用颜色和材质一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a crop to be harvested, or for a person to be startled by something sudden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指庄稼被收割，也指人因突如其来的事情而受到惊吓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinġabar il-prodott tar-raba', jew li xi ħadd jibża' minħabba xi ħaġa għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被收割；作为农作物被采收。
受到惊吓；因突然发生的事而吃惊。

collocations.en: was startled when he opened the door

formal.mt: Il-qamħ nħasad u nġabar qabel ma bdiet ix-xita.
formal.en: The wheat was harvested and gathered before the rain began.
formal.zh: 小麦在下雨前完成了收割和收集。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qabeż Pawlu? Sara: Nħasad bil-ħoss tal-bieb. Ma kienx qed jistenna lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu jump? Sara: He was startled by the sound of the door. He wasn't expecting anyone.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 怎么突然一哆嗦？Sara：他被门的响声吓了一跳。他没想到会有人来。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 怎么突然一哆嗦？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu jump?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nħasad bil-ħoss tal-bieb. Ma kienx qed jistenna lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Nħasad bil-ħoss tal-bieb. Ma kienx qed jistenna lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 他被门的响声吓了一跳。他没想到会有人来。
messages.en: He was startled by the sound of the door. He wasn't expecting anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用主语给 nħasad 分组：il-qamħ 是小麦被收割，Pawlu 是人受惊；看到主语就切换画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For an idea, name, or possibility to be thought of by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个想法、名称或可能性被人想到或构想出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li idea, isem jew possibbiltà jiġu f'moħħ xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被想到；被构想或提出。

collocations.en: was thought of as a solution
collocations.zh: 被想到可作为解决办法

formal.mt: Dan il-pjan nħaseb bħala soluzzjoni għall-problema tat-traffiku.
formal.en: This plan was thought of as a solution to the traffic problem.
formal.zh: 这个方案被构想出来，用于解决交通问题。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan l-isem nħaseb għall-ħanut il-ġdid? Pawlu: Iva, ħsibna fih flimkien ilbieraħ. Jogħġbok?
colloquial.en: Marija: Was this name thought of for the new shop? Pawlu: Yes, we came up with it together yesterday. Do you like it?
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个名字是给新店想的吗？Pawlu：是啊，我们昨天一起想出来的。你喜欢吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个名字是给新店想的吗？
messages.en: Was this name thought of for the new shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħsibna fih flimkien ilbieraħ. Jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħsibna fih flimkien ilbieraħ. Jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 是啊，我们昨天一起想出来的。你喜欢吗？
messages.en: Yes, we came up with it together yesterday. Do you like it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nħaseb 放在脑中亮起的灯泡旁，灯泡里写一个新店名，记住名称或办法被想出来的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wash one's own body to become clean.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清洗自己的身体，使身体干净。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed jaħsel ġismu biex ikun nadif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清洗自己的身体；洗澡。

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol fl-għalqa, il-ħaddiem nħasel u biddel ħwejġu.
formal.en: After working in the field, the worker washed himself and changed his clothes.
formal.zh: 在田里干完活后，工人洗了澡，换了衣服。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Mark? Lara: Għadu fil-kamra tiegħu; nħasel u issa qed jilbes.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Mark? Lara: He's still in his room; he washed himself and is getting dressed now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在哪里？拉拉：他还在自己房间里；他洗过澡了，现在正在穿衣服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu fil-kamra tiegħu; nħasel u issa qed jilbes.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu fil-kamra tiegħu; nħasel u issa qed jilbes.
messages.zh: 他还在自己房间里；他洗过澡了，现在正在穿衣服。
messages.en: He's still in his room; he washed himself and is getting dressed now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人干完农活后自己洗澡，把 nħasel 和“清洗自己的身体”这个完整动作一起记住。

gloss_zh: 被感觉到；被体验到；产生影响

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be felt or experienced, or to have an effect that people notice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人感觉或体验到，也可指对人产生了可察觉的影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tiġi perċepita jew esperjenzata, jew ikollha effett li jinħass min-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被感觉到；被感受到。
被亲身体验到；被经历。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have an effect on others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对他人产生影响；使别人感受到其作用。

collocations.zh: 他的缺席让人明显感到不便或失落

formal.mt: L-effett tat-tibdil fl-iskeda nħass minn kull membru tat-tim.
formal.en: The effect of the schedule change was felt by every member of the team.
formal.zh: 团队中的每位成员都感受到了日程调整带来的影响。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ħassejt it-terremot ilbieraħ? Maja: Iva, nħass sew hawn, anki fil-kċina.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you feel the earthquake yesterday? Maja: Yes, it was clearly felt here, even in the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你昨天感觉到地震了吗？玛雅：感觉到了，这里震感很明显，连厨房里都能感觉到。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 你昨天感觉到地震了吗？
messages.en: Did you feel the earthquake yesterday?

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nħass sew hawn, anki fil-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nħass sew hawn, anki fil-kċina.
messages.zh: 感觉到了，这里震感很明显，连厨房里都能感觉到。
messages.en: Yes, it was clearly felt here, even in the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地震的震感、亲身体验和缺席造成的影响连成三个画面：共同点都是“让人感受到了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made or joined by sewing with a needle and thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过针线缝制而成，或用针线连接起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa ssir jew tingħaqad permezz tal-ħjata bil-labra u l-ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被缝制；被用针线缝合。

formal.mt: Il-kowt nħat bl-idejn skont il-qisien tal-klijent.
formal.en: The coat was sewn by hand according to the customer's measurements.
formal.zh: 这件外套按照顾客的尺寸手工缝制而成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kowt nħat bil-magna? Pawlu: Le, nħat bl-idejn minn ħajjat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this coat sewn by machine? Pawlu: No, it was sewn by hand by a tailor.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这件外套是用缝纫机缝的吗？保罗：不是，是裁缝手工缝的。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件外套是用缝纫机缝的吗？
messages.en: Was this coat sewn by machine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 不是，是裁缝手工缝的。
messages.en: No, it was sewn by hand by a tailor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象外套放在桌上，一针一线被缝好；记住这里强调衣物“被缝制”，并搭配手工或机器来练习。

gloss_zh: 被抢走；被迅速抢购一空；被绑架

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be snatched away, bought up very quickly, or kidnapped.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被突然抢走；商品被迅速抢购一空；人被绑架。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tittieħed malajr jew tinbiegħ malajr ħafna; persuna tittieħed bil-forza kontra r-rieda tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被猛然抢走；被一把夺走。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be sold out very fast
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迅速抢购一空；很快售罄。
被绑架；被强行劫持。

collocations.en: the phone was snatched from his hand
collocations.zh: 手机被人从他手中抢走了

collocations.en: the book sold out as soon as it was released
collocations.zh: 这本书一出版就被抢购一空

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport tal-pulizija, in-negozjant nħataf waqt li kien sejjer lejn l-uffiċċju.
formal.en: According to the police report, the businessman was kidnapped while on his way to the office.
formal.zh: 根据警方报告，那名商人在前往办公室的途中遭到绑架。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandkom il-ktieb il-ġdid? Mark: Le, nħataf malli ħareġ; qed nistennew aktar kopji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still have the new book? Mark: No, it sold out as soon as it was released; we're waiting for more copies.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们还有那本新书吗？马克：没有了，一出版就被抢购一空；我们正在等补货。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们还有那本新书吗？
messages.en: Do you still have the new book?

messages.speaker: Mark (书店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nħataf malli ħareġ; qed nistennew aktar kopji.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nħataf malli ħareġ; qed nistennew aktar kopji.
messages.zh: 没有了，一出版就被抢购一空；我们正在等补货。
messages.en: No, it sold out as soon as it was released; we're waiting for more copies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个教学画面区分词义：手机被夺走、新书被抢光、人物被绑架；看主语和上下文判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be officially appointed or selected to hold a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被正式任命，或被选中担任某个职位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tingħata kariga uffiċjalment jew tintgħażel biex tokkupa pożizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被任命；被委任。
