sense_translations.en_definition: to be selected for a position
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被选中担任某个职位；被选任。

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa tal-kumitat, Daniel nħatar direttur tal-proġett.
formal.en: After the committee meeting, Daniel was appointed director of the project.
formal.zh: 委员会会议结束后，丹尼尔被任命为项目主管。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jmexxi t-tim? Mark: Daniel nħatar kap tat-tim ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will lead the team? Mark: Daniel was appointed team leader yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁来带领团队？马克：丹尼尔昨天被任命为团队负责人了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁来带领团队？
messages.en: Who will lead the team?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 丹尼尔昨天被任命为团队负责人了。
messages.en: Daniel was appointed team leader yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象任命通知上写着一个人的姓名和新职位，把 nħatar 与后面的职位名称一起记：被任命为谁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To undergo circumcision, the surgical removal of the foreskin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受切除阴茎包皮的手术，即包皮环切术。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ssirilha ċ-ċirkonċiżjoni, jiġifieri operazzjoni biex titneħħa l-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接受包皮环切术；被施行割礼。

collocations.zh: 在诊所接受了包皮环切术

collocations.en: was circumcised when he was a baby
collocations.zh: 在婴儿时期接受了包皮环切术

formal.mt: Ir-rekord mediku jindika li l-pazjent nħaten meta kien tarbija.
formal.en: The medical record indicates that the patient was circumcised when he was a baby.
formal.zh: 病历显示，该患者在婴儿时期接受过包皮环切术。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu ħuk wara l-operazzjoni? Pawlu: Ħija nħaten ilbieraħ u llum qed jistrieħ id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your brother after the operation? Pawlu: My brother was circumcised yesterday and is resting at home today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥术后怎么样？保罗：我哥哥昨天接受了包皮环切术，今天正在家里休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥术后怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother after the operation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (患者的弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija nħaten ilbieraħ u llum qed jistrieħ id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija nħaten ilbieraħ u llum qed jistrieħ id-dar.
messages.zh: 我哥哥昨天接受了包皮环切术，今天正在家里休息。
messages.en: My brother was circumcised yesterday and is resting at home today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进病历场景记忆：某人在某时接受了包皮环切术；主语是接受手术的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be torn down, or to have goods or a load removed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑物等被拆除，或货物被卸下、车辆被卸空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew ħajt jitwaqqa', jew merkanzija titneħħa minn vettura jew vettura titbattal mit-tagħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拆除；被拆毁。
货物被卸下；车辆等被卸货或卸空。

collocations.zh: 卡车上的货物被卸下了

formal.mt: Il-ħajt il-qadim nħatt qabel ma beda x-xogħol fuq il-bini l-ġdid.
formal.en: The old wall was torn down before work began on the new building.
formal.zh: 新楼施工开始前，旧墙已被拆除。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-trakk għadu mimli? Mark: Le, nħatt kollu dalgħodu; il-kaxxi qegħdin fil-maħżen.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the truck still full? Mark: No, it was completely unloaded this morning; the boxes are in the warehouse.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：卡车里还装满货吗？马克：没有了，今天早上已经全部卸完；箱子都在仓库里。

messages.speaker: Lara (仓库主管)
messages.zh: 卡车里还装满货吗？
messages.en: Is the truck still full?

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nħatt kollu dalgħodu; il-kaxxi qegħdin fil-maħżen.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nħatt kollu dalgħodu; il-kaxxi qegħdin fil-maħżen.
messages.zh: 没有了，今天早上已经全部卸完；箱子都在仓库里。
messages.en: No, it was completely unloaded this morning; the boxes are in the warehouse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用主语帮助选义：看到墙或建筑想到“被拆除”，看到卡车或货物想到“被卸货”；用两个画面分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 躲开他人；独自待着；不与人来往

teaching_sense.en_definition: to withdraw from other people, either by hiding away or by keeping to oneself
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 避开他人，躲起来或独自待着，减少与人交往。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitwarrab minn nies oħra, jinħeba minnhom jew joqgħod għalih waħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躲开他人；藏起来以避开别人。
独来独往；独自待着，不主动与人交往。

collocations.en: kept to himself for a while

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, ir-raġel nħaġeb f'kamartu biex iqatta' ftit ħin waħdu.
formal.en: After the meeting, the man withdrew to his room to spend some time alone.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，那名男子回避众人，躲进自己的房间独处了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Pawlu nħaġeb f'kamartu? Marija: Ried joqgħod waħdu ftit; aktar tard joħroġ jitkellem magħna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Pawlu withdraw to his room? Marija: He wanted to be alone for a bit; later he will come out and talk to us.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗为什么躲进自己的房间了？玛丽娅：他想独处一会儿，晚些时候会出来跟我们聊天。

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么躲进自己的房间了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu withdraw to his room?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried joqgħod waħdu ftit; aktar tard joħroġ jitkellem magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Ried joqgħod waħdu ftit; aktar tard joħroġ jitkellem magħna.
messages.zh: 他想独处一会儿，晚些时候会出来跟我们聊天。
messages.en: He wanted to be alone for a bit; later he will come out and talk to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会结束后，一个人轻轻关上房门独处；同一画面可连接“躲开别人”和“不与人来往”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be reduced to smaller pieces by grinding, pounding, or mincing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过研磨、捣打或绞切而变成细小碎块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa titnaqqas f'biċċiet żgħar billi tintħan, tissawwat f'mehrież jew titqatta' fin ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被磨碎；被研磨。
被捣碎；被反复捶打。
被绞碎；被切成细末。

collocations.en: the garlic was pounded in the mortar
collocations.zh: 大蒜在研钵里被捣碎了

formal.mt: It-tewm nħażaq fil-mehrież qabel ma żdied mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The garlic was pounded in the mortar before being added to the mixture.
formal.zh: 大蒜先在研钵里捣碎，然后加入混合物中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tewm lest għaz-zalza? Pawlu: Iva, nħażaq fil-mehrież; tista' żżidu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the garlic ready for the sauce? Pawlu: Yes, it was pounded in the mortar; you can add it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：做酱汁用的大蒜准备好了吗？保罗：好了，已经在研钵里捣碎了；你现在可以加进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (厨师)
messages.zh: 做酱汁用的大蒜准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the garlic ready for the sauce?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (厨房助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nħażaq fil-mehrież; tista' żżidu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nħażaq fil-mehrież; tista' żżidu issa.
messages.zh: 好了，已经在研钵里捣碎了；你现在可以加进去。
messages.en: Yes, it was pounded in the mortar; you can add it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房里的三种处理：磨胡椒、捣大蒜、绞肉；共同结果是原料变碎，再根据工具判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dress up, especially for a special occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为特殊场合穿戴整齐，或把自己打扮得较为正式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilbes ilbies pulit jew speċjali għal xi okkażjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛装打扮；穿上讲究或正式的衣服。

formal.mt: Għall-okkażjoni uffiċjali, Pawlu nħażem u wasal fis-sala fil-ħin.
formal.en: For the official occasion, Pawlu dressed up and arrived at the hall on time.
formal.zh: 为出席正式活动，保罗盛装打扮，并准时到达会场。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu nħażem daqshekk illum? Rita: Għax sejjer għal tieġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu dress up so much today? Rita: Because he is going to a wedding.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗今天怎么打扮得这么正式？丽塔：因为他要去参加婚礼。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天怎么打扮得这么正式？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu dress up so much today?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他要去参加婚礼。
messages.en: Because he is going to a wedding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与婚礼前整理衣领的画面联系起来，记住它表示把自己打扮得正式体面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put away and kept for later use; in another sense, to be mourned after death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被收存起来以备日后使用；另一个义项指去世后受到哀悼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed f'post u jinżamm għal użu aktar tard; f'tifsira oħra, ikun imbikki wara mewtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被储存、存放或收存。
去世后受到哀悼；死后被人悲伤地追念。

collocations.zh: 被储存起来以备日后使用

formal.mt: It-tagħmir nħażen f'post niexef sabiex jibqa' f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: The equipment was stored in a dry place so that it would remain in good condition.
formal.zh: 设备被存放在干燥的地方，以保持良好状态。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nħażen ir-ross? Mark: Fil-kaxxa l-kbira, fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where was the rice stored? Mark: In the big box, on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：大米存放在哪里了？马克：在架子上的大箱子里。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 大米存放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where was the rice stored?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在架子上的大箱子里。
messages.en: In the big box, on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用仓库里的米箱记住储存义，再用追悼会画面单独记住哀悼义，读句子时看主语和场景。

gloss_zh: 被写下；被笔具标记；被乱写

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be written, marked with a writing implement, or scribbled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文字被写下，某处被笔具留下标记，或被随手乱写乱画。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkiteb, jiġi mmarkat b'għodda tal-kitba, jew jinkiteb b'mod imħarbat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被写下；以文字形式被记录。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be marked using a writing implement
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被钢笔、铅笔等书写工具留下标记。
被潦草地写下；被随手乱写乱画。

collocations.en: was written or marked in pencil
was written or scribbled on the paper
collocations.zh: 被写在或随手涂写在纸上

formal.mt: In-numru nħażż bil-lapes fil-marġni tad-dokument.
formal.en: The number was written in pencil in the margin of the document.
formal.zh: 这个数字被用铅笔写在文件的页边空白处。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nħażż in-numru tat-telefon? Ben: Fuq dik il-karta żgħira ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where was the phone number written down? Ben: On that little piece of paper next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：电话号码记在哪里了？本：在门旁边的那张小纸片上。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 电话号码记在哪里了？
messages.en: Where was the phone number written down?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq dik il-karta żgħira ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq dik il-karta żgħira ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 在门旁边的那张小纸片上。
messages.en: On that little piece of paper next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象纸上留下三种笔迹：写好的文字、做出的记号、潦草的涂写，用这三个画面串联义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hide oneself from view, or to be hidden where others cannot see or find something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己躲到别人看不见的地方；也指人或物被藏起来，不容易被看见或找到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistaħba biex ma jidhirx, jew jitqiegħed fejn ħaddieħor ma jarahx jew ma jsibux.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己躲藏起来；藏身以免被看见。
被藏起来；被隐藏而不让人看见或发现。

formal.mt: Id-dokument nħeba f'kexxun u nstab waqt it-tfittxija.
formal.en: The document was hidden in a drawer and was found during the search.
formal.zh: 文件被藏在抽屉里，在搜寻过程中被找到。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn mar it-tifel? Adam: Nħeba wara l-bieb biex jissorprendik.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did the boy go? Adam: He hid behind the door to surprise you.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那孩子去哪儿了？亚当：他躲在门后，想给你一个惊喜。

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: 那孩子去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the boy go?

messages.speaker: Adam (父亲)
messages.zh: 他躲在门后，想给你一个惊喜。
messages.en: He hid behind the door to surprise you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用捉迷藏的孩子记住自己躲藏，用抽屉里的文件记住被藏起来；两种情况都围绕看不见。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be set free, granted a pardon, or acquitted of a charge, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据语境表示被释放、获得赦免，或因指控不成立而被判无罪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata l-ħelsien, jingħata maħfra, jew jiġi ddikjarat mhux ħati, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被释放；恢复自由。
获得赦免；被免除相应的刑罚或处罚。
被判无罪；经审理后被裁定指控不成立。

formal.mt: Wara li l-qorti semgħet ix-xhieda, l-akkużat nħeles mill-akkużi.
formal.en: After the court heard the testimony, the defendant was acquitted of the charges.
formal.zh: 法庭听取证词后，裁定被告所受指控不成立。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-għasfur għadu fil-gaġġa? Toni: Le, nħeles dalgħodu u tar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the bird still in the cage? Toni: No, it was set free this morning and flew away.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：鸟还在笼子里吗？托尼：不在，今天早上放了，它飞走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 鸟还在笼子里吗？
messages.en: Is the bird still in the cage?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 不在，今天早上放了，它飞走了。
messages.en: No, it was set free this morning and flew away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想笼门打开记住获释，再把法律场景分开：赦免侧重免罚，无罪判决侧重指控不成立。

gloss_zh: 被烘烤；被设计；被促成或煽动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be baked; in other senses, to be designed or brought about through motivation or instigation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物被烘烤；其他义项表示被设计，或受到推动、唆使而产生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissajjar fil-forn; f'tifsiriet oħra, jiġi ddisinjat jew jitqanqal permezz ta' motivazzjoni jew tħeġġiġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放入烤箱或烤炉中烘烤。
被设计；被构思或拟定。
受到激励或推动；受到唆使或煽动。

collocations.en: was baked over a low heat

formal.mt: Il-ħobż nħema fil-forn sakemm il-qoxra ħadet kulur dehbi.
formal.en: The bread was baked in the oven until the crust turned golden.
formal.zh: 面包在烤箱中烘烤，直到表皮变成金黄色。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-ħobż nħema llum? Ġanni: Iva, għadu sħun. Aqta' biċċa!
colloquial.en: Marta: Was this bread baked today? Ġanni: Yes, it is still warm. Cut yourself a piece!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这面包是今天烤的吗？詹尼：是啊，还热着呢。切一块尝尝！

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 这面包是今天烤的吗？
messages.en: Was this bread baked today?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (面包师)
messages.zh: 是啊，还热着呢。切一块尝尝！
messages.en: Yes, it is still warm. Cut yourself a piece!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用刚出炉的面包牢牢记住烘烤义；设计和推动两个义项另配语境卡片，避免见词就译成烤熟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be gelded, especially of a male horse or another male animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雄性动物被阉割、去势，尤其用于公马。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi kkastrat, speċjalment meta jkun żiemel jew annimal maskili ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被阉割、被去势，尤指公马等雄性动物。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rekord veterinarju, iż-żiemel nħesa s-sena l-oħra.
formal.en: According to the veterinary record, the horse was gelded last year.
formal.zh: 根据兽医记录，这匹公马去年接受了去势。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan iż-żiemel nħesa diġà? Anna: Iva, il-veterinarju għamel l-operazzjoni x-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has this horse already been gelded? Anna: Yes, the veterinarian performed the operation last month.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这匹公马已经做过去势了吗？安娜：是的，兽医上个月做的手术。

messages.speaker: Mark (马场新员工)
messages.zh: 这匹公马已经做过去势了吗？
messages.en: Has this horse already been gelded?

messages.speaker: Anna (马场管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-veterinarju għamel l-operazzjoni x-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-veterinarju għamel l-operazzjoni x-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 是的，兽医上个月做的手术。
messages.en: Yes, the veterinarian performed the operation last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进马场兽医记录的画面里，看到公马和手术记录，就联想到接受去势这一动作。

gloss_zh: 被填入馅料；性交（粗俗）；被毁坏；被弄糟

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stuffed with filling, especially of poultry; other senses refer to having sex vulgarly, being ruined, or being messed up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在烹饪中指禽类等被填入馅料；其他义项涉及粗俗地表示性交，以及被毁坏或被弄糟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bil-mili, speċjalment fil-każ tat-tjur għall-ikel; f'tifsiriet oħra, jagħmel sess b'espressjoni vulgari, jinqered, jew jitħarbat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be stuffed (used especially in a culinary context, as with a turkey or capon)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被填入馅料，尤用于烹饪中的火鸡或阉鸡等。
性交；发生性关系（粗俗用语）。
被毁坏；被彻底损毁或毁掉。
被弄糟；被搞乱；出了严重问题。

collocations.en: the turkey was stuffed with filling

formal.mt: Id-dundjan nħexa b'taħlita ta' ħobż, basal u ħwawar qabel tpoġġa fil-forn.
formal.en: The turkey was stuffed with a mixture of bread, onion, and herbs before being placed in the oven.
formal.zh: 火鸡先被填入面包、洋葱和香草混合而成的馅料，然后放入烤箱。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Id-dundjan nħexa diġà? Pawlu: Iva, bil-ħobż u l-ħwawar. Issa se ndaħħlu fil-forn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the turkey been stuffed yet? Pawlu: Yes, with bread and herbs. I am going to put it in the oven now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：火鸡已经填好馅了吗？保罗：填好了，用的是面包和香草。现在我要把它放进烤箱。

messages.speaker: Rita (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 火鸡已经填好馅了吗？
messages.en: Has the turkey been stuffed yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bil-ħobż u l-ħwawar. Issa se ndaħħlu fil-forn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bil-ħobż u l-ħwawar. Issa se ndaħħlu fil-forn.
messages.zh: 填好了，用的是面包和香草。现在我要把它放进烤箱。
messages.en: Yes, with bread and herbs. I am going to put it in the oven now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用火鸡肚中装满馅料记住烹饪义，再分别记住粗俗性用语、毁坏和弄糟义，靠上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loud, characteristic cry of a donkey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 驴发出的响亮而有辨识度的叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss qawwi u karatteristiku li jagħmel ħmar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驴叫；驴的嘶鸣声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li jagħmel ħmar meta jgħajjat.

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fir-razzett, it-tfal semgħu n-nħiq tal-ħmar.
formal.en: During the visit to the farm, the children heard the donkey's braying.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，孩子们听到了驴叫声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Dak in-nħiq tal-ħmar li hemm fir-razzett.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that noise? Pawlu: That's the braying of the donkey at the farm.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么声音？保罗：那是农场里那头驴的叫声。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak in-nħiq tal-ħmar li hemm fir-razzett.
messages.mt_standard: Dak in-nħiq tal-ħmar li hemm fir-razzett.
messages.zh: 那是农场里那头驴的叫声。
messages.en: That's the braying of the donkey at the farm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把农场里驴张口大叫的画面与 nħiq 配对，记住它指叫声本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Either slaughtering an animal by cutting its throat or the noisy breathing called snoring during sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指通过割喉宰杀动物，也可指睡眠时发出鼾声；具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtil ta' annimal billi tinqatagħlu griżmejh, jew il-ħoss tan-nifs li persuna tagħmel waqt l-irqad.

sense_translations.en_definition: slaughtering an animal by cutting its throat
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过割断喉部宰杀动物；割喉宰牲。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qtil ta' annimal billi tinqatagħlu griżmejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打鼾；睡眠时发出的鼾声。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħoss tan-nifs li persuna tagħmel waqt l-irqad.

collocations.en: the slaughtering of the animal by cutting its throat

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma nħir tirreferi għall-qtil ta' annimal billi tinqatagħlu griżmejh.
formal.en: In this text, the word nħir refers to slaughtering an animal by cutting its throat.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，nħir 一词指通过割喉宰杀动物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma rqadtx sew? Mark: In-nħir ta' ħija żammni mqajjem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't you sleep well? Mark: My brother's snoring kept me awake.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么没睡好？马克：我兄弟的鼾声让我一直睡不着。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么没睡好？
messages.en: Why didn't you sleep well?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我兄弟的鼾声让我一直睡不着。
messages.en: My brother's snoring kept me awake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nħir 画两张语境卡：牲畜对应宰杀，睡床对应打鼾，避免混淆两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be seen or experienced in a dream, or to be formed in someone's imagination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现在某人的梦中，或作为构想在某人的想象中形成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidher f'ħolma jew jinħoloq fl-immaġinazzjoni ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被梦见；成为梦中的内容。
被想象出来；在脑海中被构想。

collocations.en: a place that was dreamed about

formal.mt: Il-proġett nħolom minn grupp ta' studenti u mbagħad ġie żviluppat f' pjan dettaljat.
formal.en: The project was imagined by a group of students and then developed into a detailed plan.
formal.zh: 这个项目由一群学生构想出来，随后被发展成一份详细计划。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ġnien nħolom minn oħti. Ben: U issa qed isir realtà!
colloquial.en: Lara: This garden was imagined by my sister. Ben: And now it's becoming a reality!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个花园是我姐姐构想出来的。本：现在它正变成现实！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个花园是我姐姐构想出来的。
messages.en: This garden was imagined by my sister.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在它正变成现实！
messages.en: And now it's becoming a reality!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把主语放进梦境或想象的画框：nħolom 表示它被梦见、被构想出来。

gloss_zh: 被求婚；被寻求为婚配对象

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sought as someone whom another person wishes to marry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被他人寻求为结婚对象，成为求婚或婚配请求的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun imfittex bħala persuna li xi ħadd jixtieq jiżżewweġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be sought after for marriage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被寻求为婚配对象；被求婚。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun imfittex minn xi ħadd li jixtieq jiżżewweġ lilu.

collocations.en: a young man who was sought as a marriage partner
collocations.zh: 被寻求为婚配对象的年轻男子

collocations.en: was sought as a marriage partner by two people
collocations.zh: 被两个人寻求为婚配对象

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, iż-żagħżugħ nħotob minn persuna li xtaqet tiżżewweġ lilu, iżda hu ma aċċettax il-proposta.
formal.en: In the story, the young man was sought as a marriage partner by someone who wished to marry him, but he did not accept the proposal.
formal.zh: 在故事中，有人希望与这名年轻男子结婚，向他求婚，但他没有接受。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn jgħid li Pawlu nħotob. Xi jfisser? Rita: Jiġifieri xi ħadd ried jiżżewweġ lilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: It says here that Pawlu was sought as a marriage partner. What does that mean? Rita: It means someone wanted to marry him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里说保罗被寻求为婚配对象，是什么意思？丽塔：就是说有人想和他结婚。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn jgħid li Pawlu nħotob. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn jgħid li Pawlu nħotob. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 这里说保罗被寻求为婚配对象，是什么意思？
messages.en: It says here that Pawlu was sought as a marriage partner. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri xi ħadd ried jiżżewweġ lilu.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri xi ħadd ried jiżżewweġ lilu.
messages.zh: 就是说有人想和他结婚。
messages.en: It means someone wanted to marry him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象求婚请求朝主语递来：nħotob 的主语是被求婚、被寻求结婚的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be needed, required, or necessary for a purpose or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某种目的或情况而被需要、被要求，或成为必要条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun meħtieġ jew neċessarju għal xi għan jew f'xi sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被需要；为满足某种需求而不可缺少。
被要求；按条件或要求必须具备或提供。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun mitlub bħala kundizzjoni jew rekwiżit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有必要；为实现某事而必不可少。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun neċessarju biex isir xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: Biex jitlesta l-proġett fil-ħin, nħtieġ tagħmir addizzjonali.
formal.en: Additional equipment was needed to complete the project on time.
formal.zh: 为按时完成项目，需要额外的设备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex nħtieġ ħaddiem ieħor? Mark: Għax kien hemm wisq xogħol għal persuna waħda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why was another worker needed? Mark: Because there was too much work for one person.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么还需要一名工人？马克：因为工作太多，一个人做不过来。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 为什么还需要一名工人？
messages.en: Why was another worker needed?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien hemm wisq xogħol għal persuna waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien hemm wisq xogħol għal persuna waħda.
messages.zh: 因为工作太多，一个人做不过来。
messages.en: Because there was too much work for one person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格需求清单记 nħtieġ：实际需要、条件要求、事情必需，核心都是必要性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have branches or shoots cut back as part of caring for a tree or shrub.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 树木或灌木的枝条受到修剪，作为养护的一部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitneħħew jew jitqassru l-friegħi ta' siġra jew arbuxxell bħala parti mill-kura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被修剪；树木或灌木的枝条被剪除或剪短。

formal.mt: L-arbuxxell nżabar mill-ġardinar, li neħħa l-friegħi niexfa u qassar dawk twal wisq.
formal.en: The shrub was pruned by the gardener, who removed the dry branches and shortened those that were too long.
formal.zh: 园丁修剪了这丛灌木，去除了干枯的枝条，并剪短了过长的枝条。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-arbuxxell jidher differenti. Mark: Iva, nżabar ilbieraħ. Issa jidħol aktar dawl mit-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: This shrub looks different. Mark: Yes, it was pruned yesterday. Now more light comes in through the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这丛灌木看起来不一样了。马克：是的，昨天修剪过了。现在窗户能透进更多光线。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 这丛灌木看起来不一样了。
messages.en: This shrub looks different.

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nżabar ilbieraħ. Issa jidħol aktar dawl mit-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nżabar ilbieraħ. Issa jidħol aktar dawl mit-tieqa.
messages.zh: 是的，昨天修剪过了。现在窗户能透进更多光线。
messages.en: Yes, it was pruned yesterday. Now more light comes in through the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗前灌木被园丁剪去枯枝，阳光随即照进来。用 nżabar 记“植物被修剪”，主语是接受修剪的植物。

gloss_zh: 被握住；被保留；被警方拘留

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be held, kept in a place or condition, or detained by the police.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被握持、被保存在某处或维持某种状态，也可指被警方拘留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jinżamm f'post jew f'kundizzjoni, jew li persuna tinżamm mill-pulizija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被握住、抱住或扶住。
被保存、保留或留在某处。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be detained by the police
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被警方拘留。

collocations.en: was kept in a safe place
was held firmly in his hand

formal.mt: Id-dokument oriġinali nżamm f'post sigur sakemm tlestiet il-verifika.
formal.en: The original document was kept in a safe place until the verification was completed.
formal.zh: 核验完成之前，原始文件一直保存在安全的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu ċ-ċavetta ż-żgħira? Pawlu: Iċ-ċavetta qiegħda fil-kexxun; iċ-ċurkett tagħha nżamm fil-kaxxa l-blu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the little key? Pawlu: The key is in the drawer; its ring was kept in the blue box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那把小钥匙在哪里？保罗：钥匙在抽屉里；它的钥匙环收在蓝色盒子里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 那把小钥匙在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the little key?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iċ-ċavetta qiegħda fil-kexxun; iċ-ċurkett tagħha nżamm fil-kaxxa l-blu.
messages.mt_standard: Iċ-ċavetta qiegħda fil-kexxun; iċ-ċurkett tagħha nżamm fil-kaxxa l-blu.
messages.zh: 钥匙在抽屉里；它的钥匙环收在蓝色盒子里了。
messages.en: The key is in the drawer; its ring was kept in the blue box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“手里握住、柜里留住、警方扣留”连成三幅图，记住这个词围绕“被留住”展开，再由语境判断具体意思。

gloss_zh: 被喂食，尤指雏鸟被亲鸟喂养

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be fed, especially when a young bird receives food from a parent bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被喂食，尤其指雏鸟接受亲鸟喂来的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħata l-ikel, speċjalment meta ferħ ta' għasfur jingħata l-ikel minn wieħed mill-ġenituri tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be fed (especially used of birds feeding fledglings)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喂食，尤其用于描述雏鸟被亲鸟喂养。

collocations.en: the young bird was fed by its mother

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, il-ferħ nżaqq minn ommu waqt li baqa' fil-bejta.
formal.en: During the observation, the young bird was fed by its mother while it remained in the nest.
formal.zh: 观察期间，雏鸟一直待在巢里，由母鸟喂食。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ferħ għadu bil-ġuħ? Mark: Le, għadu kif nżaqq minn ommu. Ejja narawh mill-bogħod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the young bird still hungry? Mark: No, it has just been fed by its mother. Let's watch it from a distance.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那只雏鸟还饿吗？马克：不饿，母鸟刚刚喂过它。我们远远地看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 那只雏鸟还饿吗？
messages.en: Is the young bird still hungry?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu kif nżaqq minn ommu. Ejja narawh mill-bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu kif nżaqq minn ommu. Ejja narawh mill-bogħod.
messages.zh: 不饿，母鸟刚刚喂过它。我们远远地看吧。
messages.en: No, it has just been fed by its mother. Let's watch it from a distance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸟巢里张嘴等食的雏鸟，把这个词绑定到“雏鸟被喂饱”的画面；句子的关注点是接受食物的小鸟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a visit from someone, whether as a person or as a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到某人的探访；主语是地点时，指被人到访或参观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li persuna jew post jirċievi żjara mingħand xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被探访、被到访或被参观。

collocations.en: the museum was visited by tourists

formal.mt: Il-mużew nżar minn grupp ta' studenti bħala parti minn attività edukattiva.
formal.en: The museum was visited by a group of students as part of an educational activity.
formal.zh: 一组学生参观了博物馆，这是一次教育活动的组成部分。

colloquial.mt: Anna: In-nannu kien waħdu lbieraħ? David: Le, nżar mill-ġirien u qagħdu jitkellmu miegħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was Grandpa alone yesterday? David: No, the neighbours visited him and stayed to chat with him.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：爷爷昨天是一个人吗？戴维：不是，邻居们去看了他，还留下来陪他聊天。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷昨天是一个人吗？
messages.en: Was Grandpa alone yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nżar mill-ġirien u qagħdu jitkellmu miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nżar mill-ġirien u qagħdu jitkellmu miegħu.
messages.zh: 不是，邻居们去看了他，还留下来陪他聊天。
messages.en: No, the neighbours visited him and stayed to chat with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把自己放在家里等客人的位置：有人上门，你就是“被探访”的一方；换成博物馆，就是“被参观”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sown in the soil or scattered over an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被播入土中，或被撒开、散布在某个范围内。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ż-żerriegħa titqiegħed fil-ħamrija biex tikber, jew li xi ħaġa tinfirex fuq żona.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被播种；种子被播入土中。
被撒开、撒布或分散。

collocations.en: the wheat was sown in the field
the rice was scattered on the ground

formal.mt: Il-qamħ nżara' fl-għalqa wara li tlestiet il-preparazzjoni tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: The wheat was sown in the field after the soil preparation was completed.
formal.zh: 土壤准备工作完成后，小麦被播种在田里。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm ross mal-art ħdejn il-bieb? Toni: Nżara' waqt it-tieġ; issa niġbru kollox.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is there rice on the ground by the door? Toni: It was scattered during the wedding; we'll gather it all up now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：门边地上怎么有米？托尼：婚礼时撒的；我们现在把它全部清理起来。

messages.speaker: Rita (婚礼宾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm ross mal-art ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm ross mal-art ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边地上怎么有米？
messages.en: Why is there rice on the ground by the door?

messages.speaker: Toni (婚礼帮手)
messages.mt_spoken: Nżara' waqt it-tieġ; issa niġbru kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Nżara' waqt it-tieġ; issa niġbru kollox.
messages.zh: 婚礼时撒的；我们现在把它全部清理起来。
messages.en: It was scattered during the wedding; we'll gather it all up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“撒下去”串联两个义项：撒进田里等待生长是播种，撒到地面分散开来是撒布；看目的和地点来区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frayed or come undone as threads or joined parts loosen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因线股或连接部分松脱而起毛、散开，或使缝合等结构脱开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-ħjut ta' drapp jew ħabel jinħallu u jinfirdu, jew li xi ħaġa meħjuta tibda tinfetaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线、绳或织物因磨损等原因起毛、散股。
原本连接、缝合或收拢的部分松脱、散开。

collocations.en: the rope became frayed at the end

formal.mt: Wara użu fit-tul, il-ħabel nżarad fit-tarf u kellu jinbidel.
formal.en: After prolonged use, the rope became frayed at the end and had to be replaced.
formal.zh: 长期使用后，绳子的末端散股，必须更换。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tħares lejn dan il-qalziet? Il-keffa nżarad. Sara: Iva, ġibu hawn u nerġa' nħitha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you look at these trousers? The hem has come undone. Sara: Yes, bring them here and I'll sew it back up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能看看这条裤子吗？裤脚折边脱线了。萨拉：可以，拿过来，我把它重新缝好。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tħares lejn dan il-qalziet? Il-keffa nżarad.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tħares lejn dan il-qalziet? Il-keffa nżarad.
messages.zh: 你能看看这条裤子吗？裤脚折边脱线了。
messages.en: Can you look at these trousers? The hem has come undone.

messages.speaker: Sara (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġibu hawn u nerġa' nħitha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġibu hawn u nerġa' nħitha.
messages.zh: 可以，拿过来，我把它重新缝好。
messages.en: Yes, bring them here and I'll sew it back up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根绳子的末端像小刷子一样散开，再想到裤脚缝线松脱；用“线散了”的共同画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be painted or dyed, or to apply make-up to oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体被涂上颜料或油漆，材料被染色；用于人时，也可表示给自己化妆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tingħata ż-żebgħa jew tinbidlilha l-kulur, jew li persuna tagħmel il-makeup.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被涂漆或涂上颜料。
被染色，如布料或头发被染成某种颜色。
使用化妆品化妆。

collocations.en: the actor put on make-up before the show

formal.mt: Il-bieb tal-injam nżeba' blu wara li tnaddaf u tnixxef.
formal.en: The wooden door was painted blue after it was cleaned and dried.
formal.zh: 木门清洁并晾干后，被漆成了蓝色。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għadu qed ibiddel? Nina: Le, diġà nżeba' għall-ispettaklu u qed jistenna ħdejn il-palk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Mark still getting changed? Nina: No, he has already put on his make-up for the show and is waiting by the stage.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克还在换衣服吗？妮娜：没有，他已经化好演出妆，在舞台旁边等着了。

messages.speaker: Lara (演员)
messages.zh: 马克还在换衣服吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still getting changed?

messages.speaker: Nina (舞台助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà nżeba' għall-ispettaklu u qed jistenna ħdejn il-palk.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà nżeba' għall-ispettaklu u qed jistenna ħdejn il-palk.
messages.zh: 没有，他已经化好演出妆，在舞台旁边等着了。
messages.en: No, he has already put on his make-up for the show and is waiting by the stage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“门上刷色、布上染色、脸上化妆”排成三张卡片，都用可见的颜色变化帮助记忆，再看主语判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To abound in something or be full of it in large quantities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种事物大量存在，或某处充满、富有某种事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun hemm ħafna minn xi ħaġa f'post, tant li l-post ikun mimli biha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量存在；充满或富有某种事物。

formal.mt: Fir-rebbiegħa, il-ġnien nżegħed bil-fjuri ta' ħafna kuluri.
formal.en: In spring, the garden abounded in flowers of many colours.
formal.zh: 春天，花园里开满了五颜六色的花。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif sibtu l-ġnien wara x-xita? Pawlu: Sabiħ ħafna! Nżegħed bil-fjuri, u ħadna ħafna ritratti.
colloquial.en: Anna: What was the garden like after the rain? Pawlu: Beautiful! It was full of flowers, and we took lots of photos.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：雨后的花园怎么样？保罗：美极了！到处都是花，我们拍了很多照片。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 雨后的花园怎么样？
messages.en: What was the garden like after the rain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sabiħ ħafna! Nżegħed bil-fjuri, u ħadna ħafna ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Sabiħ ħafna! Nżegħed bil-fjuri, u ħadna ħafna ritratti.
messages.zh: 美极了！到处都是花，我们拍了很多照片。
messages.en: Beautiful! It was full of flowers, and we took lots of photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一个几乎被鲜花填满的花园，用“多得满眼都是”的视觉印象记忆，重点抓住数量丰富、到处可见。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be added to something, or to have an amount increased by a specified quantity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被添加到某物中，或某个数量、金额在原有基础上增加一定数额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa titqiegħed ma' oħra, jew li ammont isir akbar b'ċerta kwantità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被添加到某物中；被加在原有内容或数量之上。
被增加某个数额或幅度；在原有基础上增加。

collocations.en: the milk was added to the mixture
the price was increased by two euros

formal.mt: Il-baġit tal-proġett nżied b'elf ewro biex ikopri l-ispejjeż addizzjonali.
formal.en: The project budget was increased by one thousand euros to cover the additional costs.
formal.zh: 项目预算增加了一千欧元，以支付额外费用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-biljett għadu għaxar ewro? Rita: Le, il-prezz nżied b'żewġ ewro; issa jiswa tnax.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this ticket still ten euros? Rita: No, the price has been increased by two euros; it now costs twelve.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张票还是十欧元吗？丽塔：不是，票价涨了两欧元，现在是十二欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张票还是十欧元吗？
messages.en: Is this ticket still ten euros?

messages.speaker: Rita (售票员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-prezz nżied b'żewġ ewro; issa jiswa tnax.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-prezz nżied b'żewġ ewro; issa jiswa tnax.
messages.zh: 不是，票价涨了两欧元，现在是十二欧元。
messages.en: No, the price has been increased by two euros; it now costs twelve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原来十元，再加两元，变成十二元”记住增加的幅度；另想牛奶倒进混合物，记住被添加到某物中的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a dance to be performed by dancers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某种舞蹈被舞者跳出或表演出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta żfin jiġi esegwit minn żeffiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被跳；被表演，指舞蹈。

collocations.en: the dance was performed on stage
collocations.zh: 这支舞在舞台上被表演了

formal.mt: Dan iż-żfin tradizzjonali nżifen mill-istudenti waqt il-festival tal-iskola.
formal.en: This traditional dance was performed by the students during the school festival.
formal.zh: 这支传统舞蹈由学生们在学校节庆期间表演。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-vals nżifen ilbieraħ? Toni: Iva, nżifen fl-aħħar tal-festa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the waltz danced yesterday? Toni: Yes, it was danced at the end of the party.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天有人跳华尔兹吗？托尼：有，在聚会结束时跳的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天有人跳华尔兹吗？
messages.en: Was the waltz danced yesterday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，在聚会结束时跳的。
messages.en: Yes, it was danced at the end of the party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象节目单上的一支舞被舞者演出来：记住这里关注的是“舞被跳出”，而不是谁主动跳舞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking clothes off the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把身上穿着的衣服脱下来的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ineħħi l-ħwejjeġ minn fuq ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱衣；把衣服从身上脱下来的动作。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent jista' jitlob l-għajnuna waqt in-nżigħ tal-ħwejjeġ qabel l-eżami.
formal.en: The patient may request assistance when taking clothes off before the examination.
formal.zh: 患者在检查前脱衣时可以请求协助。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek bżonn għajnuna fin-nżigħ tal-ġakketta? Nannu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Il-kmiem huma dojoq.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you need help taking off your jacket? Grandfather: Yes, please. The sleeves are tight.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：您脱夹克需要帮忙吗？爷爷：需要，麻烦你了。袖子有点紧。

messages.speaker: Rita (孙女)
messages.zh: 您脱夹克需要帮忙吗？
messages.en: Do you need help taking off your jacket?

messages.speaker: Nannu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Il-kmiem huma dojoq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Il-kmiem huma dojoq.
messages.zh: 需要，麻烦你了。袖子有点紧。
messages.en: Yes, please. The sleeves are tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词配上“从袖子里抽出手臂”的画面，记住它表示脱衣这个动作，而不是某一件衣服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movement from a higher place or level to a lower one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从较高位置或水平向较低位置或水平移动的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment minn post jew livell ogħla għal wieħed aktar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下降；从高处向低处移动的过程。
往下走；下行；向下移动。

formal.mt: Matul in-nżul mill-muntanja, il-grupp waqaf diversi drabi biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: During the descent from the mountain, the group stopped several times to rest.
formal.zh: 下山过程中，队伍停下来休息了几次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nitilqu qabel inżul ix-xemx? Mark: Iva, għax in-nżul minn hawn jieħu siegħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we leave before sunset? Mark: Yes, because the descent from here takes an hour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们日落前出发吗？马克：好，因为从这里下去要一个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 我们日落前出发吗？
messages.en: Shall we leave before sunset?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax in-nżul minn hawn jieħu siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax in-nżul minn hawn jieħu siegħa.
messages.zh: 好，因为从这里下去要一个小时。
messages.en: Yes, because the descent from here takes an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一支向下的箭头：太阳落下、走下楼梯、从山上下来，都可以帮助记住“下降、下行”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being required rather than optional.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某件事必须履行或遵守、不能自由选择不做的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karatteristika ta' xi ħaġa li trid issir jew tiġi osservata u mhijiex fakultattiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强制性；必须履行或遵守的性质。

collocations.en: the compulsory nature of the course

formal.mt: Ir-regolament jispjega l-obbligatorjetà tal-attendenza għal dawn is-sessjonijiet ta' taħriġ.
formal.en: The regulation explains the compulsory nature of attendance at these training sessions.
formal.zh: 该规定说明了参加这些培训课程的强制性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jistaqsi kulħadd dwar il-kors? Ben: Għax hemm dubju dwar l-obbligatorjetà tiegħu. Ma nafux jekk irridux nattendu bilfors.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is everyone asking about the course? Ben: Because there is uncertainty about whether it is compulsory. We don't know if we have to attend.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么大家都在问这门课的事？本：因为还不清楚它是不是强制要求的。我们不知道是否必须参加。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jistaqsi kulħadd dwar il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jistaqsi kulħadd dwar il-kors?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都在问这门课的事？
messages.en: Why is everyone asking about the course?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm dubju dwar l-obbligatorjetà tiegħu. Ma nafux jekk irridux nattendu bilfors.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm dubju dwar l-obbligatorjetà tiegħu. Ma nafux jekk irridux nattendu bilfors.
messages.zh: 因为还不清楚它是不是强制要求的。我们不知道是否必须参加。
messages.en: Because there is uncertainty about whether it is compulsory. We don't know if we have to attend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成规定上盖着的“必须”印章：这个名词谈的是一件事具有强制性的性质，可联想中文“强制性”的“性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Required by a rule or requirement; not optional.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照规定或要求必须做、必须具备或必须参加的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jrid isir jew jiġi osservat skont regola jew rekwiżit; mhux fakultattiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强制的；必须履行的；必修的。

collocations.en: compulsory use of the seat belt

formal.mt: It-taħriġ dwar is-sigurtà huwa obbligatorju għall-impjegati l-ġodda kollha.
formal.en: Safety training is compulsory for all new employees.
formal.zh: 所有新员工都必须参加安全培训。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kors obbligatorju? Mark: Iva, irridu nagħmluh kollha qabel nibdew ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this course compulsory? Mark: Yes, we all have to take it before we start work.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这门课必须上吗？马克：对，我们所有人开始工作前都得上。

messages.speaker: Nina (新员工)
messages.zh: 这门课必须上吗？
messages.en: Is this course compulsory?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu nagħmluh kollha qabel nibdew ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu nagħmluh kollha qabel nibdew ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 对，我们所有人开始工作前都得上。
messages.en: Yes, we all have to take it before we start work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课程名称旁写着醒目的“必修”：obbligatorju 用来给课程、培训或要求贴上“必须完成”的标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duty or commitment that a person is required to fulfil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人按要求、责任或承诺必须履行的义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dmir jew impenn li persuna trid twettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 义务；必须履行的责任或承诺。
债券；发行者向持有人承担偿债责任的债务证券。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jistabbilixxi l-obbligazzjoni tal-fornitur li jwassal il-prodotti fi żmien għaxart ijiem.
formal.en: The contract establishes the supplier's obligation to deliver the products within ten days.
formal.zh: 合同规定供应商有义务在十天内交付产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex se tgħin fl-attività nhar is-Sibt? Pawlu: Għandi obbligazzjoni lejn il-grupp. Wegħedthom li mmur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you helping at the event on Saturday? Pawlu: I have an obligation to the group. I promised them I would go.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么星期六要去活动现场帮忙？保罗：我对这个小组有责任。我答应了他们会去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex se tgħin fl-attività nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex se tgħin fl-attività nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 你为什么星期六要去活动现场帮忙？
messages.en: Why are you helping at the event on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi obbligazzjoni lejn il-grupp. Wegħedthom li mmur.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi obbligazzjoni lejn il-grupp. Wegħedthom li mmur.
messages.zh: 我对这个小组有责任。我答应了他们会去。
messages.en: I have an obligation to the group. I promised them I would go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片分别记忆：生活场景写“履行义务”，金融场景写“发行债券”；看到搭配后再选择对应词义。

gloss_zh: 乐于助人的；愿意帮忙的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Willing to help others or to do what they reasonably ask.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愿意帮助别人，或乐意满足别人合理请求的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun lest jgħin lil ħaddieħor jew jilqa' talbiet raġonevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乐于助人的；愿意帮忙、乐意配合的。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kien obliganti u għen lill-viżitaturi jsibu l-kamra tal-laqgħat.
formal.en: The staff member was obliging and helped the visitors find the meeting room.
formal.zh: 这位工作人员很乐于助人，帮助访客找到了会议室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min għenek iġġorr il-kaxxi? Lara: Il-ġar tiegħi. Hu dejjem obliganti meta jkolli bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who helped you carry the boxes? Lara: My neighbour. He's always willing to help when I need assistance.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁帮你搬的箱子？拉拉：我的邻居。我需要帮助时，他总是很乐意帮忙。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁帮你搬的箱子？
messages.en: Who helped you carry the boxes?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġar tiegħi. Hu dejjem obliganti meta jkolli bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġar tiegħi. Hu dejjem obliganti meta jkolli bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 我的邻居。我需要帮助时，他总是很乐意帮忙。
messages.en: My neighbour. He's always willing to help when I need assistance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象邻居听到请求就伸手帮忙的画面，把 obliganti 和“乐意帮你”一起记住，重点是待人热心、愿意配合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening or done from time to time, rather than regularly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某事只是偶尔发生或进行，并非经常如此。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġri jew isir minn żmien għal żmien, mhux regolarment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偶尔发生的；不经常的。

formal.mt: Il-grupp jorganizza laqgħat okkażjonali għall-membri l-ġodda.
formal.en: The group organizes occasional meetings for new members.
formal.zh: 该小组偶尔为新成员组织聚会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inti taħdem hemm kuljum? Lara: Le, nagħmel biss xogħol okkażjonali meta jkollhom bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you work there every day? Lara: No, I only do occasional work when they need help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你每天都在那里工作吗？拉拉：不是，我只在他们需要帮忙时偶尔去做些工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你每天都在那里工作吗？
messages.en: Do you work there every day?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nagħmel biss xogħol okkażjonali meta jkollhom bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nagħmel biss xogħol okkażjonali meta jkollhom bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 不是，我只在他们需要帮忙时偶尔去做些工作。
messages.en: No, I only do occasional work when they need help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日历上零星出现的几个圆点想成“偶尔的活动”；okkażjonali 用来修饰活动、探访或工作等名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From time to time, but not often or regularly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某个动作只是偶尔发生，而不是经常或固定发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minn żmien għal żmien, iżda mhux ta' spiss jew regolarment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偶尔；间或；有时候。

formal.mt: Il-librerija torganizza okkażjonalment attivitajiet għat-tfal.
formal.en: The library occasionally organizes activities for children.
formal.zh: 图书馆偶尔为儿童组织活动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tmur spiss f'dak il-kafè? Nina: Le, immur okkażjonalment, meta niltaqa' ma' sħabi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you often go to that café? Nina: No, I go occasionally, when I meet my friends.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你经常去那家咖啡馆吗？妮娜：不，我偶尔和朋友见面时才去。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你经常去那家咖啡馆吗？
messages.en: Do you often go to that café?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, immur okkażjonalment, meta niltaqa' ma' sħabi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, immur okkażjonalment, meta niltaqa' ma' sħabi.
messages.zh: 不，我偶尔和朋友见面时才去。
messages.en: No, I go occasionally, when I meet my friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 okkażjonalment，就在动作旁添上“偶尔”二字：偶尔去、偶尔吃、偶尔见面，用它回答动作发生得多频繁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called holmium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钬的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-isem olmju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钬，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom isibu l-olmju fit-tabella perjodika.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should find holmium in the periodic table.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生应在元素周期表中找到钬。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser olmju? Pawlu: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku; ejja nsibuh fit-tabella perjodika.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does olmju mean? Pawlu: It is the name of a chemical element; let's find it in the periodic table.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：olmju 是什么意思？保罗：它是一种化学元素的名称，我们在元素周期表里找找吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: olmju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does olmju mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku; ejja nsibuh fit-tabella perjodika.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku; ejja nsibuh fit-tabella perjodika.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素的名称，我们在元素周期表里找找吧。
messages.en: It is the name of a chemical element; let's find it in the periodic table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张元素词卡，正面写 olmju，背面写“钬”；再配上元素周期表的小格图案，把词义固定在化学场景中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in West Asia, in the Middle East, officially called the Sultanate of Oman.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于西亚、中东地区的国家，正式名称为阿曼苏丹国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Punent, fil-Lvant Nofsani, bl-isem uffiċjali Saltna tal-Oman.

sense_translations.en_definition: Oman (a country in West Asia in the Middle East; official name: Saltna tal-Oman)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿曼，位于西亚、中东地区的国家；正式名称为阿曼苏丹国。

formal.mt: L-Oman huwa pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Punent, fil-Lvant Nofsani.
formal.en: Oman is a country in West Asia, in the Middle East.
formal.zh: 阿曼是位于西亚、中东地区的一个国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tixtieq tmur għall-vaganza? Mark: Nixtieq inżur l-Oman u nitgħallem aktar dwar il-pajjiż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where would you like to go on holiday? Mark: I would like to visit Oman and learn more about the country.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想去哪里度假？马克：我想去阿曼，更多地了解这个国家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where would you like to go on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
