messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq inżur l-Oman u nitgħallem aktar dwar il-pajjiż.
messages.zh: 我想去阿曼，更多地了解这个国家。
messages.en: I would like to visit Oman and learn more about the country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Oman 和地图上的“阿曼”标签配对记忆；它是国家专名，实际书写用大写 O，常见形式可一起记作 l-Oman。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the Greek poet Homer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 希腊诗人荷马的名字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-poeta Grieg Omeru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荷马，希腊诗人。

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti se jaqraw test dwar il-poeta Grieg Omeru.
formal.en: In this lesson, students will read a text about the Greek poet Homer.
formal.zh: 在这节课上，学生将阅读一篇介绍希腊诗人荷马的文章。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fuq min se tagħmel il-preżentazzjoni? Nina: Fuq Omeru, il-poeta Grieg li semmejna fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will your presentation be about? Nina: Homer, the Greek poet we mentioned in class.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的报告要介绍谁？妮娜：荷马，就是我们课堂上提到的那位希腊诗人。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你的报告要介绍谁？
messages.en: Who will your presentation be about?

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq Omeru, il-poeta Grieg li semmejna fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq Omeru, il-poeta Grieg li semmejna fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 荷马，就是我们课堂上提到的那位希腊诗人。
messages.en: Homer, the Greek poet we mentioned in class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Omeru 配一张写着“希腊诗人荷马”的人物卡，再连读 il-poeta Omeru；人名与身份一起记，注意大写 O。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who intentionally murders another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意杀害他人的人，即杀人犯或凶手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toqtol lil persuna oħra apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杀人犯；故意杀害他人的凶手。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, id-ditektiv jidentifika lill-omiċida wara investigazzjoni twila.
formal.en: In the novel, the detective identifies the murderer after a long investigation.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，侦探经过长时间调查后查明了凶手的身份。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Diġà taf min hu l-omiċida fir-rumanz? Sara: Le, għadni ma wasaltx fl-aħħar; tgħidlix!
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you already know who the murderer in the novel is? Sara: No, I haven't reached the end yet; don't tell me!
colloquial.zh: 马克：你已经知道小说里的凶手是谁了吗？萨拉：还没有，我还没读到结尾，别告诉我！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà taf min hu l-omiċida fir-rumanz?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà taf min hu l-omiċida fir-rumanz?
messages.zh: 你已经知道小说里的凶手是谁了吗？
messages.en: Do you already know who the murderer in the novel is?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadni ma wasaltx fl-aħħar; tgħidlix!
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadni ma wasaltx fl-aħħar; tgħidlix!
messages.zh: 还没有，我还没读到结尾，别告诉我！
messages.en: No, I haven't reached the end yet; don't tell me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象侦探小说里被圈出的凶手画像，旁边写 omiċida；把它牢牢记成“实施杀人的那个人”，帮助区分人物与行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The intentional killing of another person; murder, called wilful homicide in Maltese legal English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意杀害他人的行为；在马耳他法律英语中称为 wilful homicide。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtil ta' persuna oħra apposta; fl-Ingliż legali Malti jissejjaħ wilful homicide.

sense_translations.en_definition: murder; in Maltese legal English called wilful homicide
sense_translations.zh_definition: 谋杀；故意杀人，在马耳他法律英语中称为 wilful homicide。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jitlob lill-istudenti jittraduċu l-espressjoni omiċidju volontarju bħala wilful homicide fl-Ingliż legali Malti.
formal.en: The exercise asks students to translate the expression omiċidju volontarju as wilful homicide in Maltese legal English.
formal.zh: 这项练习要求学生把 omiċidju volontarju 译为马耳他法律英语中的 wilful homicide。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser omiċidju volontarju f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Tfisser li persuna toqtol lil xi ħadd apposta.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does omiċidju volontarju mean in this text? Pawlu: It means that a person kills someone intentionally.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这篇文章里的 omiċidju volontarju 是什么意思？保罗：意思是一个人故意杀害另一个人。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser omiċidju volontarju f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser omiċidju volontarju f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 omiċidju volontarju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does omiċidju volontarju mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li persuna toqtol lil xi ħadd apposta.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li persuna toqtol lil xi ħadd apposta.
messages.zh: 意思是一个人故意杀害另一个人。
messages.en: It means that a person kills someone intentionally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“故意杀人案件”的情景卡中，特别圈出“故意”二字；再将整组词与 wilful homicide 配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 天哪；哎呀（表示担忧或震惊）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation used when someone feels worried or shocked, like oh my or mamma mia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达担忧或震惊时使用的感叹语，相当于“天哪”或“哎呀”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex turi tħassib jew xokk.

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to express worry or shock: oh my; mamma mia
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表达担忧或震惊：天哪；哎呀；我的天。

collocations.en: Oh my, I forgot the keys!

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jesprimi t-tħassib tiegħu bil-kliem: "Ommi ma, kif se naslu fil-ħin?"
formal.en: In the story, the character expresses his worry by saying: "Oh my, how will we arrive on time?"
formal.zh: 在故事中，人物用这句话表达担忧：“天哪，我们怎么才能准时到达？”

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ommi ma, insejt il-borża fuq il-karozza tal-linja! Maja: Ejja nċemplu lill-kumpanija u nistaqsu jekk sabuhiex.
colloquial.en: Lara: Oh my, I left my bag on the bus! Maja: Let's call the company and ask whether they found it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：天哪，我把包落在公交车上了！玛雅：我们给公交公司打电话，问问他们有没有找到。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ommi ma, insejt il-borża fuq il-karozza tal-linja!
messages.mt_standard: Ommi ma, insejt il-borża fuq il-karozza tal-linja!
messages.zh: 天哪，我把包落在公交车上了！
messages.en: Oh my, I left my bag on the bus!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nċemplu lill-kumpanija u nistaqsu jekk sabuhiex.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nċemplu lill-kumpanija u nistaqsu jekk sabuhiex.
messages.zh: 我们给公交公司打电话，问问他们有没有找到。
messages.en: Let's call the company and ask whether they found it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象突然发现包丢了，先惊呼一句“天哪！”；把这声带着担忧的惊呼与 ommi ma 整体对应，配合语气朗读记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Knowing everything; in fiction, describing a narrator who knows every character's thoughts and feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 知道一切的；在文学中，也形容了解所有人物思想和感受的全知叙述者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaf kollox; fil-letteratura, jiddeskrivi narratur li jaf il-ħsibijiet u s-sentimenti tal-personaġġi kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全知的；无所不知的。

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rumanz, in-narratur omnixxenti juri lill-qarrej il-ħsibijiet ta' kull personaġġ.
formal.en: In this novel, the omniscient narrator reveals each character's thoughts to the reader.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，全知叙述者向读者揭示每个人物的思想。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jaf in-narratur x'qed jaħsbu t-tnejn? Pawlu: Għax hu narratur omnixxenti; jaf il-ħsibijiet ta' kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does the narrator know what both of them are thinking? Pawlu: Because he is an omniscient narrator; he knows everyone's thoughts.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：叙述者怎么知道他们两个人在想什么？保罗：因为他是全知叙述者，知道每个人的想法。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jaf in-narratur x'qed jaħsbu t-tnejn?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jaf in-narratur x'qed jaħsbu t-tnejn?
messages.zh: 叙述者怎么知道他们两个人在想什么？
messages.en: How does the narrator know what both of them are thinking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu narratur omnixxenti; jaf il-ħsibijiet ta' kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu narratur omnixxenti; jaf il-ħsibijiet ta' kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他是全知叙述者，知道每个人的想法。
messages.en: Because he is an omniscient narrator; he knows everyone's thoughts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象叙述者能同时看见每个人心里的想法，把 omnixxenti 和“全知视角”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 恐同；对同性恋者的偏见或敌意

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prejudice, hostility, or discrimination directed at gay people or homosexuality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对同性恋者或同性恋的偏见、敌意或歧视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preġudizzju, ostilità jew diskriminazzjoni lejn persuni omosesswali jew lejn l-omosesswalità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐同；对同性恋者或同性恋的偏见、敌意或歧视。

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat diskussjoni dwar l-omofobija biex tħeġġeġ ir-rispett lejn kulħadd.
formal.en: The school organized a discussion about homophobia to encourage respect for everyone.
formal.zh: 学校组织了一场关于恐同的讨论，以倡导尊重每个人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik iċ-ċajta kienet turi omofobija. Mark: Għandek raġun. Se nitkellem miegħu dwarha.
colloquial.en: Maja: That joke showed homophobia. Mark: You're right. I'll talk to him about it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个笑话流露出恐同偏见。马克：你说得对。我会跟他谈谈这件事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个笑话流露出恐同偏见。
messages.en: That joke showed homophobia.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Se nitkellem miegħu dwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Se nitkellem miegħu dwarha.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我会跟他谈谈这件事。
messages.en: You're right. I'll talk to him about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 omofobija 放进“反对偏见、尊重同性恋者”的场景记忆；这里的“恐同”也包含敌意和歧视。

gloss_zh: 小个子男人；阴茎（粗俗说法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A little man; also a vulgar word for the penis, with the intended meaning determined by context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指小个子男人；也可作阴茎的粗俗称呼，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel żgħir; ukoll kelma vulgari għall-pene, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小个子男人；身材矮小的男子。
阴茎的粗俗称呼。

collocations.en: a little man wearing a hat

formal.mt: Fl-illustrazzjoni jidher omorin bi kappell kbir ħdejn bieb għoli.
formal.en: The illustration shows a little man wearing a large hat beside a tall door.
formal.zh: 插图中，一个戴着大帽子的小个子男人站在一扇高门旁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawnhekk, omorin ifisser raġel żgħir? Pawlu: Iva, imma jista' jfisser ukoll il-pene b'mod vulgari. Il-kuntest jgħinek tifhem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does omorin mean a little man here? Pawlu: Yes, but it can also mean the penis in vulgar language. The context helps you understand.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 omorin 是指小个子男人吗？保罗：是的，但它也可以粗俗地指阴茎。语境能帮你判断。

messages.speaker: Lara (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 这里的 omorin 是指小个子男人吗？
messages.en: Does omorin mean a little man here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (语言伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma jista' jfisser ukoll il-pene b'mod vulgari. Il-kuntest jgħinek tifhem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma jista' jfisser ukoll il-pene b'mod vulgari. Il-kuntest jgħinek tifhem.
messages.zh: 是的，但它也可以粗俗地指阴茎。语境能帮你判断。
messages.en: Yes, but it can also mean the penis in vulgar language. The context helps you understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 omorin 做两张语境卡：插图里的“小个子男人”和粗俗身体称呼；记住双义，并留意语体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show respect or give recognition to someone; also to fulfil a promise or obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人表示敬意或给予表彰；也可指履行承诺或义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri rispett jew jagħti ġieħ lil xi ħadd; ukoll iżomm wegħda jew iwettaq obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向……致敬；表彰；也可指信守或履行承诺、义务。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill onora lill-voluntiera għal snin ta' servizz lill-komunità.
formal.en: The council honoured the volunteers for years of service to the community.
formal.zh: 议会表彰了志愿者多年来为社区作出的贡献。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu ġie jgħinna kif wiegħed? Mark: Iva, onora l-wegħda tiegħu u wasal kmieni wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu come to help us as he promised? Mark: Yes, he honoured his promise and arrived early too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗按承诺来帮我们了吗？马克：来了，他履行了承诺，而且还提早到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗按承诺来帮我们了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu come to help us as he promised?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, onora l-wegħda tiegħu u wasal kmieni wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, onora l-wegħda tiegħu u wasal kmieni wkoll.
messages.zh: 来了，他履行了承诺，而且还提早到了。
messages.en: Yes, he honoured his promise and arrived early too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 onora 配成两个画面：给志愿者颁奖是“表彰”，按承诺到场是“履行”，都用具体宾语记忆。

gloss_zh: 组织的；组织管理方面的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the structure, management, or coordination of an organization or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与机构或活动的组织结构、管理或协调有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istruttura, it-tmexxija jew il-koordinazzjoni ta' organizzazzjoni jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 组织的；与组织结构、管理或协调有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istruttura organiżżazzjonali tal-istituzzjoni u r-responsabbiltajiet ta' kull dipartiment.
formal.en: The report describes the institution's organizational structure and the responsibilities of each department.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了该机构的组织结构以及各部门的职责。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-avveniment? Mark: Maja. Għandha ħiliet organiżżazzjonali tajbin ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will take care of the event? Mark: Maja. She has very good organizational skills.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来负责这次活动？马克：玛雅。她的组织能力很强。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁来负责这次活动？
messages.en: Who will take care of the event?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Maja. Għandha ħiliet organiżżazzjonali tajbin ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Maja. Għandha ħiliet organiżżazzjonali tajbin ħafna.
messages.zh: 玛雅。她的组织能力很强。
messages.en: Maja. She has very good organizational skills.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张部门分工图和一份活动安排表，把 organiżżazzjonali 同“组织结构、组织能力”成组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An awareness of position or direction; also an introduction that helps someone become familiar with a new place or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对位置或方向的认识，即定向或方向感；也指帮助人熟悉新环境或新情况的入门介绍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għarfien tal-pożizzjoni jew tad-direzzjoni; ukoll introduzzjoni li tgħin lil persuna ssir familjari ma' post jew sitwazzjoni ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 定向；方向感；也可指帮助人熟悉新环境的入门介绍，或某种取向。

formal.mt: L-istudenti l-ġodda attendew sessjoni ta' orjentazzjoni biex isiru jafu l-faċilitajiet u s-servizzi tal-università.
formal.en: The new students attended an orientation session to learn about the university's facilities and services.
formal.zh: 新生参加了入门介绍会，以了解大学的设施和服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taf kif naslu lura lejn il-pjazza? Pawlu: Iva, għandi sens ta' orjentazzjoni tajjeb. Ejja minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you know how to get back to the square? Pawlu: Yes, I have a good sense of direction. Let's go this way.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你知道怎么回到广场吗？保罗：知道，我方向感不错。我们走这边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf kif naslu lura lejn il-pjazza?
messages.mt_standard: Taf kif naslu lura lejn il-pjazza?
messages.zh: 你知道怎么回到广场吗？
messages.en: Do you know how to get back to the square?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi sens ta' orjentazzjoni tajjeb. Ejja minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi sens ta' orjentazzjoni tajjeb. Ejja minn hawn.
messages.zh: 知道，我方向感不错。我们走这边。
messages.en: Yes, I have a good sense of direction. Let's go this way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“找到自己的方向”串联 orjentazzjoni：走路时是方向感，初到学校时是帮助熟悉环境的入门介绍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's pattern of romantic or sexual attraction, such as attraction to people of the same gender, another gender, or more than one gender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人在情感或性方面的吸引倾向，例如受到同性、另一性别或多个性别的人吸引。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tendenza ta' persuna li tħoss attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn persuni tal-istess ġeneru, ta' ġeneru ieħor jew ta' aktar minn ġeneru wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性取向；一个人在情感或性方面受到何种性别的人吸引的倾向。

collocations.en: he spoke about his sexual orientation
collocations.zh: 他谈到了自己的性取向

formal.mt: Il-politika tal-istituzzjoni tipprojbixxi d-diskriminazzjoni abbażi tal-orjentazzjoni sesswali.
formal.en: The institution's policy prohibits discrimination based on sexual orientation.
formal.zh: 该机构的政策禁止基于性取向的歧视。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi nitkellem dwar l-orjentazzjoni sesswali tiegħi fil-laqgħa? Sara: Biss jekk trid. Tista' tagħżel x'taqsam mal-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should I talk about my sexual orientation at the meeting? Sara: Only if you want to. You can choose what to share with others.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我应该在会上谈自己的性取向吗？萨拉：你愿意才谈。你可以自己选择向别人分享什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nitkellem dwar l-orjentazzjoni sesswali tiegħi fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nitkellem dwar l-orjentazzjoni sesswali tiegħi fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 我应该在会上谈自己的性取向吗？
messages.en: Should I talk about my sexual orientation at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biss jekk trid. Tista' tagħżel x'taqsam mal-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Biss jekk trid. Tista' tagħżel x'taqsam mal-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 你愿意才谈。你可以自己选择向别人分享什么。
messages.en: Only if you want to. You can choose what to share with others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 orjentazzjoni sesswali 整组记成“性取向”，用“在情感或性方面会被谁吸引”帮助理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to an orchestra or to music written for or performed by an orchestra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与管弦乐队有关的；为管弦乐队创作或由其演奏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' orkestra jew ma' mużika miktuba għal orkestra jew imdaqqsa minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管弦乐的；管弦乐队的；为管弦乐队创作或由其演奏的。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-kunċert jinkludi xogħol orkestrali ġdid minn kompożitur Malti.
formal.en: The concert programme includes a new orchestral work by a Maltese composer.
formal.zh: 音乐会曲目包括一位马耳他作曲家创作的新管弦乐作品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din l-istess kanzunetta li smajna lbieraħ? Pawlu: Iva, imma dan hu arranġament orkestrali. Isma' l-vjolini!
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the same song we heard yesterday? Pawlu: Yes, but this is an orchestral arrangement. Listen to the violins!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是我们昨天听的那首歌吗？保罗：是的，不过这是管弦乐改编版。听那些小提琴！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-istess kanzunetta li smajna lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-istess kanzunetta li smajna lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 这是我们昨天听的那首歌吗？
messages.en: Is this the same song we heard yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma dan hu arranġament orkestrali. Isma' l-vjolini!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma dan hu arranġament orkestrali. Isma' l-vjolini!
messages.zh: 是的，不过这是管弦乐改编版。听那些小提琴！
messages.en: Yes, but this is an orchestral arrangement. Listen to the violins!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象熟悉的歌曲加入小提琴、木管和铜管，变成管弦乐改编版，用这个声音画面记住 orkestrali。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The arrangement of a piece of music for the different instruments of an orchestra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为管弦乐队的不同乐器安排音乐声部的过程或编配结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-arranġament ta' biċċa mużika għall-istrumenti differenti ta' orkestra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管弦乐编配；配器。

collocations.en: the orchestration of a piece of music
collocations.zh: 一首乐曲的管弦乐编配

formal.mt: F'dan il-kors, l-istudenti jistudjaw l-orkestrazzjoni u kif jitqassmu l-partijiet mużikali bejn l-istrumenti.
formal.en: In this course, students study orchestration and how musical parts are distributed among instruments.
formal.zh: 在这门课程中，学生学习管弦乐编配，以及如何在不同乐器之间分配音乐声部。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tistudja llum? Mark: L-orkestrazzjoni ta' din il-biċċa mużika.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you studying today? Mark: The orchestration of this piece of music.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天在学什么？马克：这首乐曲的管弦乐编配。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying today?

messages.speaker: Mark (音乐学生)
messages.zh: 这首乐曲的管弦乐编配。
messages.en: The orchestration of this piece of music.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一首旋律分给弦乐、木管和铜管演奏，用这个分配声部的画面记住“管弦乐编配”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mechanical musical instrument designed to play automatically and imitate the sound of an orchestra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种能够自动演奏、模拟管弦乐队声音的机械乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali mekkaniku li jdoqq awtomatikament u jimita l-ħoss ta' orkestra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自动管弦乐器，能够自动演奏并模拟管弦乐队声音的机械乐器。

collocations.zh: 一台机械式自动管弦乐器

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi orkestrina u jispjega kif dan l-istrument idoqq awtomatikament.
formal.en: The museum displays an orchestrion and explains how this instrument plays automatically.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出一台自动管弦乐器，并介绍这种乐器如何自动演奏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak l-istrument? Pawlu: Dik orkestrina; tista' ddoqq waħedha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that instrument? Pawlu: That's an orchestrion; it can play by itself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么乐器？保罗：那是自动管弦乐器，它能自己演奏。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 那是什么乐器？
messages.en: What is that instrument?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (博物馆讲解员)
messages.zh: 那是自动管弦乐器，它能自己演奏。
messages.en: That's an orchestrion; it can play by itself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一台机器自动奏出整支乐队的声音，把这个画面与“自动管弦乐器”连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal greeting asking whether someone is well, or a reply saying that you are fine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非正式交谈中的问候语，可询问“你好吗？”，也可回应“我很好”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni informali biex tistaqsi jekk xi ħadd hux tajjeb jew biex twieġeb li inti tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你好吗？你还好吧？用于非正式问候或询问对方的状况。
我很好；我还好。用于回应对方的问候或关心。

formal.mt: F'djalogu miktub, il-mistoqsija 'Orrajt?' tista' tintuża bħala tislima informali, u 'Orrajt, grazzi' bħala tweġiba.
formal.en: In a written dialogue, the question 'Orrajt?' can be used as an informal greeting, and 'Orrajt, grazzi' as a reply.
formal.zh: 在书面对话中，问句“Orrajt?”可以用作非正式问候，而“Orrajt, grazzi”可以用作回应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Orrajt, Mark? Mark: Orrajt, grazzi. U int? Maja: Jien ukoll, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: You alright, Mark? Mark: I'm fine, thanks. And you? Maja: I'm fine too, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，你还好吗？马克：我很好，谢谢。你呢？玛雅：我也很好，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克，你还好吗？
messages.en: You alright, Mark?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我很好，谢谢。你呢？
messages.en: I'm fine, thanks. And you?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也很好，谢谢。
messages.en: I'm fine too, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一问一答来记：升调说“Orrajt?”是在问你好不好，接上“grazzi”回应就是我很好，谢谢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bear species called the spectacled bear, scientifically named Tremarctos ornatus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眼镜熊这一熊类物种，学名为 Tremarctos ornatus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' ors magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Tremarctos ornatus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼镜熊（学名 Tremarctos ornatus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a spectacled bear

formal.mt: L-istudenti kitbu rapport dwar l-ors tan-nuċċali u inkludew l-isem xjentifiku Tremarctos ornatus.
formal.en: The students wrote a report about the spectacled bear and included the scientific name Tremarctos ornatus.
formal.zh: 学生们写了一篇关于眼镜熊的报告，并在其中列出了学名 Tremarctos ornatus。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ors tan-nuċċali? Mark: Iva, hekk jgħid il-ktieb. Ejja naqraw dwaru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a spectacled bear? Mark: Yes, that's what the book says. Let's read about it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是眼镜熊吗？马克：是的，书上是这样写的。我们来读读它的介绍吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这是眼镜熊吗？
messages.en: Is this a spectacled bear?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk jgħid il-ktieb. Ejja naqraw dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk jgħid il-ktieb. Ejja naqraw dwaru.
messages.zh: 是的，书上是这样写的。我们来读读它的介绍吧。
messages.en: Yes, that's what the book says. Let's read about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词汇卡上画一只戴眼镜的卡通熊，帮助记住“眼镜熊”这个名称；卡通画只是记忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bear species called the sun bear, scientifically named Helarctos malayanus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马来熊，又称太阳熊，学名为 Helarctos malayanus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' ors magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Helarctos malayanus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马来熊，又称太阳熊（学名 Helarctos malayanus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a sun bear

formal.mt: Il-paġna dwar l-ors tax-xemx tinkludi ritratt u l-isem xjentifiku Helarctos malayanus.
formal.en: The page about the sun bear includes a photograph and the scientific name Helarctos malayanus.
formal.zh: 介绍马来熊的页面包含一张照片，以及学名 Helarctos malayanus。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema paġna qed tfittex? Pawlu: Il-paġna dwar l-ors tax-xemx. Irrid nara r-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which page are you looking for? Pawlu: The page about the sun bear. I want to see the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在找哪一页？保罗：介绍马来熊的那一页。我想看看照片。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在找哪一页？
messages.en: Which page are you looking for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-paġna dwar l-ors tax-xemx. Irrid nara r-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Il-paġna dwar l-ors tax-xemx. Irrid nara r-ritratt.
messages.zh: 介绍马来熊的那一页。我想看看照片。
messages.en: The page about the sun bear. I want to see the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把太阳图标放在熊的词汇卡旁，联想到英文 sun bear，再对应中文“马来熊”；图标只用于记名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bear species called the sloth bear, scientifically named Melursus ursinus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 懒熊这一熊类物种，学名为 Melursus ursinus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' ors magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Melursus ursinus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒熊（学名 Melursus ursinus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a sloth bear

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, Sara inkludiet ritratt ta' ors xufftejh kbar u kitbet l-isem xjentifiku Melursus ursinus.
formal.en: In her report, Sara included a photograph of a sloth bear and wrote the scientific name Melursus ursinus.
formal.zh: 萨拉在报告中放入了一张懒熊的照片，并写出了学名 Melursus ursinus。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan l-ors? Toni: Ors xufftejh kbar. Ismu hemm taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this bear called? Toni: A sloth bear. Its name is there below the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种熊叫什么？托尼：懒熊。名字就在照片下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这种熊叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bear called?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ors xufftejh kbar. Ismu hemm taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Ors xufftejh kbar. Ismu hemm taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 懒熊。名字就在照片下面。
messages.en: A sloth bear. Its name is there below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语当作物种名称记忆：词汇卡正面写 ors xufftejh kbar，背面配“懒熊”和 sloth bear，反复双向回想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to spelling or the conventions used to write words correctly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与拼写或正确书写词语的规范有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ortografija, jiġifieri mar-regoli tal-kitba korretta tal-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正字法的；与拼写或词语书写规范有关的。

formal.mt: Qabel ma tippreżenta t-test, agħmel kontroll ortografiku u kkoreġi kull żball fil-kitba tal-kliem.
formal.en: Before submitting the text, carry out a spelling check and correct every error in the spelling of words.
formal.zh: 提交文本前，请进行拼写检查，并改正所有词语拼写错误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm żball ortografiku f'din il-kelma? Mark: Iva, jonqos ittra. Ejja nikkoreġuha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there a spelling error in this word? Mark: Yes, a letter is missing. Let's correct it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个词有拼写错误吗？马克：有，少了一个字母。我们改一下吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个词有拼写错误吗？
messages.en: Is there a spelling error in this word?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 有，少了一个字母。我们改一下吧。
messages.en: Yes, a letter is missing. Let's correct it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师圈出写错的字母，在旁边标上 żball ortografiku，用“拼写错误”这个固定搭配记住形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called the cirl bunting, scientifically named Emberiza cirlus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黄道眉鹀这一鸟类物种，学名为 Emberiza cirlus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Emberiza cirlus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄道眉鹀（学名 Emberiza cirlus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a cirl bunting

formal.mt: Fil-gwida tal-għasafar, l-ortolan iswed jidher flimkien mal-isem xjentifiku Emberiza cirlus.
formal.en: In the bird guide, the cirl bunting appears alongside the scientific name Emberiza cirlus.
formal.zh: 在鸟类指南中，黄道眉鹀与其学名 Emberiza cirlus 一同列出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu l-għasfur f'dan ir-ritratt? Pawlu: Ortolan iswed. Nistgħu nfittxu aktar informazzjoni dwaru fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the bird in this photograph called? Pawlu: A cirl bunting. We can look for more information about it in the guide.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张照片里的鸟叫什么？保罗：黄道眉鹀。我们可以在指南里找找更多关于它的资料。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这张照片里的鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is the bird in this photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ortolan iswed. Nistgħu nfittxu aktar informazzjoni dwaru fil-gwida.
messages.mt_standard: Ortolan iswed. Nistgħu nfittxu aktar informazzjoni dwaru fil-gwida.
messages.zh: 黄道眉鹀。我们可以在指南里找找更多关于它的资料。
messages.en: A cirl bunting. We can look for more information about it in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张鸟名卡，把 ortolan iswed、cirl bunting 和“黄道眉鹀”并排写，按整个物种名称对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species Emberiza caesia, known in English as Cretzschmar's bunting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Emberiza caesia 的一种鹀鸟，英文名为 Cretzschmar's bunting。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur bl-isem xjentifiku Emberiza caesia.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种鹀鸟，学名为 Emberiza caesia，英文名为 Cretzschmar's bunting。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Cretzschmar's bunting
collocations.zh: 一张 Emberiza caesia 鹀鸟的照片

collocations.en: an observation of a Cretzschmar's bunting
collocations.zh: 一次对 Emberiza caesia 鹀鸟的观察

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi ritratt tal-ortolan rasu blu u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Emberiza caesia.
formal.en: The catalogue includes a photograph of a Cretzschmar's bunting and gives its scientific name, Emberiza caesia.
formal.zh: 目录收录了一张这种鹀鸟的照片，并列出其学名 Emberiza caesia。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fil-ktieb? Luqa: Dan hu l-ortolan rasu blu. Maja: Tajjeb, nikteb l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this bird in the book called? Luqa: This is a Cretzschmar's bunting. Maja: All right, I'll write the name next to the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：书里的这只鸟叫什么？卢卡：这是 Emberiza caesia，马耳他语叫 ortolan rasu blu。玛雅：好，我把名字写在照片旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 书里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the book called?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 这是 Emberiza caesia，马耳他语叫 ortolan rasu blu。
messages.en: This is a Cretzschmar's bunting.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 好，我把名字写在照片旁边。
messages.en: All right, I'll write the name next to the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整鸟名写在照片正面，把 Emberiza caesia 写在背面，反复进行名称与学名配对；整组记忆，避免只凭名字猜鸟种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species Emberiza aureola, known in English as the yellow-breasted bunting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指黄胸鹀这一鸟种，学名为 Emberiza aureola。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur bl-isem xjentifiku Emberiza aureola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄胸鹀，学名为 Emberiza aureola。

collocations.en: a photograph of a yellow-breasted bunting
an observation of a yellow-breasted bunting

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tal-osservazzjonijiet, l-ortolan tal-lvant huwa mniżżel bl-isem xjentifiku Emberiza aureola.
formal.en: In the observation register, the yellow-breasted bunting is listed under the scientific name Emberiza aureola.
formal.zh: 在观察记录中，黄胸鹀以学名 Emberiza aureola 登记。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu r-ritratt tal-ortolan tal-lvant? Mark: Hawn, fuq din il-paġna. Sara: Sibtu! Hemm l-isem xjentifiku wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the photograph of the yellow-breasted bunting? Mark: Here, on this page. Sara: Found it! The scientific name is there too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：黄胸鹀的照片在哪里？马克：这里，在这一页。萨拉：找到了！旁边还有学名。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟爱好者)
messages.zh: 黄胸鹀的照片在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the photograph of the yellow-breasted bunting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这里，在这一页。
messages.en: Here, on this page.

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟爱好者)
messages.zh: 找到了！旁边还有学名。
messages.en: Found it! The scientific name is there too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三栏词卡：ortolan tal-lvant、黄胸鹀、Emberiza aureola；每次遮住一栏回想另外两栏，把整个鸟名一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species Emberiza schoeniclus, known in English as the reed bunting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指芦鹀这一鸟种，学名为 Emberiza schoeniclus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur bl-isem xjentifiku Emberiza schoeniclus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芦鹀，学名为 Emberiza schoeniclus。

collocations.en: a photograph of a reed bunting
an observation of a reed bunting

formal.mt: Il-folja tat-tagħlim turi l-ortolan tas-sidra u telenka l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Emberiza schoeniclus.
formal.en: The teaching sheet shows a reed bunting and lists its scientific name, Emberiza schoeniclus.
formal.zh: 教学资料展示了芦鹀，并列出其学名 Emberiza schoeniclus。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan ir-ritratt hu tal-ortolan tas-sidra? Pawlu: Iva, hekk hemm miktub taħtu. Nina: Mela nżidu mal-karti tal-għasafar tagħna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a photograph of a reed bunting? Pawlu: Yes, that's what it says underneath. Nina: Then let's add it to our bird cards.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张照片拍的是芦鹀吗？保罗：是的，下面就是这样写的。妮娜：那我们把它加进鸟类词卡里吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这张照片拍的是芦鹀吗？
messages.en: Is this a photograph of a reed bunting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，下面就是这样写的。
messages.en: Yes, that's what it says underneath.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 那我们把它加进鸟类词卡里吧。
messages.en: Then let's add it to our bird cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给芦鹀照片贴上 ortolan tas-sidra 标签，再翻面核对 Emberiza schoeniclus；用照片、中文名和完整词组建立对应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unclear or difficult to understand, or uncertain enough to raise doubts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容意思不清楚、难以理解，或情况不明确、令人怀疑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex ċar jew faċli biex jinftiehem, jew li jqajjem dubju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晦涩难懂的；模糊不清的；含混或可疑的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab spjegazzjoni aktar ċara għaliex it-tifsir tal-paragrafu kien oskur.
formal.en: The committee requested a clearer explanation because the meaning of the paragraph was obscure.
formal.zh: 委员会要求提供更清楚的解释，因为该段落的含义晦涩不明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-paragrafu hu oskur għalija. Luqa: Liema parti ma fhimtx? Maja: L-aħħar sentenza; ma nafx x'irid jgħid l-awtur.
colloquial.en: Maja: This paragraph is obscure to me. Luqa: Which part didn't you understand? Maja: The last sentence; I don't know what the author means.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一段对我来说很难懂。卢卡：哪部分没看懂？玛雅：最后一句；我不知道作者想表达什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这一段对我来说很难懂。
messages.en: This paragraph is obscure to me.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 哪部分没看懂？
messages.en: Which part didn't you understand?

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: L-aħħar sentenza; ma nafx x'irid jgħid l-awtur.
messages.mt_standard: L-aħħar sentenza; ma nafx x'irid jgħid l-awtur.
messages.zh: 最后一句；我不知道作者想表达什么。
messages.en: The last sentence; I don't know what the author means.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 oskur 想成文字前的一层雾：看不清意思时是“晦涩、模糊”，看不清目的而起疑时是“可疑”。这是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To watch or notice something, or to follow a rule, requirement, or custom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 观察、观看或注意到某事物；也可表示遵守规则、要求或习俗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares lejn xi ħaġa jew jinnota xi ħaġa; ukoll iħares regola, rekwiżit jew drawwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to observe, to watch, to notice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 观察；观看；留意到或察觉。

sense_translations.en_definition: to observe, to keep, to follow
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遵守；遵行；依照规则、要求或习俗行事。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur osserva l-bidliet matul l-esperiment u niżżel ir-riżultati fir-rapport.
formal.en: The researcher observed the changes during the experiment and recorded the results in the report.
formal.zh: 研究人员观察了实验过程中的变化，并将结果记入报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi nsegwi dawn l-istruzzjonijiet kollha? Mark: Iva, trid tosserva kull regola qabel tibda. Sara: Tajjeb, naqrahom sew l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do I have to follow all these instructions? Mark: Yes, you need to observe every rule before you start. Sara: All right, I'll read them carefully first.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些说明我都要照着做吗？马克：是的，开始之前就要遵守每一条规则。萨拉：好，我先仔细读一遍。

messages.speaker: Sara (新学员)
messages.zh: 这些说明我都要照着做吗？
messages.en: Do I have to follow all these instructions?

messages.speaker: Mark (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid tosserva kull regola qabel tibda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid tosserva kull regola qabel tibda.
messages.zh: 是的，开始之前就要遵守每一条规则。
messages.en: Yes, you need to observe every rule before you start.

messages.speaker: Sara (新学员)
messages.zh: 好，我先仔细读一遍。
messages.en: All right, I'll read them carefully first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 osserva：眼睛看鸟是“观察”，行动照规则做是“遵守”；先看宾语是事物还是规则，再选择中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be observed or noticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够被观察到或察觉到的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi osservat jew innutat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可观察到的；可察觉的。

formal.mt: Wara t-tieni prova, kien hemm titjib osservabbli fil-kwalità tar-ritratti.
formal.en: After the second trial, there was an observable improvement in the quality of the photographs.
formal.zh: 第二次试验后，照片质量出现了可观察到的改善。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Id-differenza bejn iż-żewġ ritratti hi osservabbli? Pawlu: Iva, fit-tieni wieħed il-kliem jidher aktar ċar. Nina: Issa qed naraha wkoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the difference between the two photographs observable? Pawlu: Yes, the writing looks clearer in the second one. Nina: Now I can see it too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：能看出这两张照片的差别吗？保罗：能，第二张里的字更清楚。妮娜：现在我也看出来了。

messages.speaker: Nina (摄影学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-differenza bejn iż-żewġ ritratti hi osservabbli?
messages.mt_standard: Id-differenza bejn iż-żewġ ritratti hi osservabbli?
messages.zh: 能看出这两张照片的差别吗？
messages.en: Is the difference between the two photographs observable?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fit-tieni wieħed il-kliem jidher aktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fit-tieni wieħed il-kliem jidher aktar ċar.
messages.zh: 能，第二张里的字更清楚。
messages.en: Yes, the writing looks clearer in the second one.

messages.speaker: Nina (摄影学员)
messages.zh: 现在我也看出来了。
messages.en: Now I can see it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把两张照片并排比较，能指出具体差异就贴上 osservabbli 标签；把它和“可观察到的变化”这个完整搭配一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of following rules, obligations, or customs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遵守规则、履行义务或奉行习俗的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħarsien jew it-twettiq ta' regoli, obbligi jew drawwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对规则或义务的遵守、遵行；对习俗或传统的奉行。

formal.mt: L-osservanza tar-regoli tal-librerija tippermetti lil kulħadd jistudja f'ambjent kwiet.
formal.en: Observance of the library rules allows everyone to study in a quiet environment.
formal.zh: 遵守图书馆规则能让所有人在安静的环境中学习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm sinjal li jitlob is-skiet? Luqa: Għax hawn in-nies jistudjaw, u l-osservanza ta' din ir-regola tgħin lil kulħadd. Maja: Tajjeb, nitkellmu barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there a sign asking for silence? Luqa: Because people study here, and observance of this rule helps everyone. Maja: All right, let's talk outside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这里有要求安静的标牌？卢卡：因为大家在这里学习，遵守这条规则对所有人都有帮助。玛雅：好，我们出去聊。

messages.speaker: Maja (图书馆读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm sinjal li jitlob is-skiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm sinjal li jitlob is-skiet?
messages.zh: 为什么这里有要求安静的标牌？
messages.en: Why is there a sign asking for silence?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hawn in-nies jistudjaw, u l-osservanza ta' din ir-regola tgħin lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hawn in-nies jistudjaw, u l-osservanza ta' din ir-regola tgħin lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为大家在这里学习，遵守这条规则对所有人都有帮助。
messages.en: Because people study here, and observance of this rule helps everyone.

messages.speaker: Maja (图书馆读者)
messages.zh: 好，我们出去聊。
messages.en: All right, let's talk outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象图书馆里大家看到安静标牌后放低声音：osservanza 指“遵守”这一行为。用“规则得到遵守”的场景记住它的名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place equipped for scientific observation, especially observation of the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 配备科学观测设施的场所，尤指观测天体的天文台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post mgħammar biex isiru osservazzjonijiet xjentifiċi, speċjalment tas-sema u tal-istilel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 观测站；尤指进行天文观测的天文台。

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fl-osservatorju, l-istudenti tgħallmu kif jintuża teleskopju biex jiġu osservati l-istilel.
formal.en: During the visit to the observatory, the students learned how a telescope is used to observe the stars.
formal.zh: 参观天文台期间，学生们学习了如何使用望远镜观测恒星。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tiġi miegħi l-osservatorju s-Sibt? Mark: Iva! Se nkunu nistgħu nużaw it-teleskopju? Sara: Nistaqsu lill-gwida meta naslu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to come to the observatory with me on Saturday? Mark: Yes! Will we be able to use the telescope? Sara: We'll ask the guide when we arrive.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：星期六想和我一起去天文台吗？马克：想！我们能用望远镜吗？萨拉：到了以后问问讲解员吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 星期六想和我一起去天文台吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to the observatory with me on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Se nkunu nistgħu nużaw it-teleskopju?
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Se nkunu nistgħu nużaw it-teleskopju?
messages.zh: 想！我们能用望远镜吗？
messages.en: Yes! Will we be able to use the telescope?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 到了以后问问讲解员吧。
messages.en: We'll ask the guide when we arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一座装有望远镜、用来观测星空的建筑，门口写 osservatorju；把“走进天文台参观”的动作与整个单词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chemical element present in air as a gas that humans and many other organisms need for breathing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种化学元素，在空气中以气体形式存在，是人类及许多其他生物呼吸所必需的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li jinsab fl-arja bħala gass u li l-bnedmin u ħafna organiżmi oħra jeħtieġu biex jieħdu n-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氧；氧气。

formal.mt: L-isptar għandu jiżgura provvista kontinwa ta' ossiġenu għall-pazjenti li jeħtiġuh.
formal.en: The hospital must ensure a continuous supply of oxygen for patients who need it.
formal.zh: 医院必须确保为需要氧气的患者持续供氧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għandna bżonn l-ossiġenu? Pawlu: Għax ġisimna jeħtieġu biex jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do we need oxygen? Pawlu: Because our bodies need it to function.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么需要氧气？保罗：因为我们的身体需要氧气才能正常运作。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我们为什么需要氧气？
messages.en: Why do we need oxygen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 因为我们的身体需要氧气才能正常运作。
messages.en: Because our bodies need it to function.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ossiġenu 写在氧气瓶的图画旁，再联想深呼吸的动作，将词形与“呼吸所需的氧气”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person held captive to force another person or group to meet a demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被扣押以迫使其他人或团体满足某项要求的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna miżmuma bil-forza biex persuna jew grupp ieħor jaċċetta xi talba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人质；被扣押以迫使他人满足要求的人。

formal.mt: Il-pulizija kkonfermat li l-ostaġġ inħeles u jinsab f'post sigur.
formal.en: The police confirmed that the hostage had been released and was in a safe place.
formal.zh: 警方证实，人质已获释，目前身处安全地点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fl-aħħar tal-film, l-ostaġġ jinħeles? Mark: Iva, il-pulizija ssalvah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the hostage freed at the end of the film? Mark: Yes, the police rescue him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影结尾，人质获救了吗？马克：是的，警察救了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影结尾，人质获救了吗？
messages.en: Is the hostage freed at the end of the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，警察救了他。
messages.en: Yes, the police rescue him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用电影中“人质获释”的画面记 ostaġġ，并把 il-ħelsien tal-ostaġġ 整组朗读，建立人物与事件的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat geometric shape with eight sides and eight angles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有八条边和八个角的平面几何图形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura ġeometrika ċatta bi tmien ġnub u tmien angoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 八边形；有八条边的多边形。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom ipinġu ottagonu regolari u jimmarkaw it-tmien ġnub tiegħu.
formal.en: The students should draw a regular octagon and mark its eight sides.
formal.zh: 学生应画出一个正八边形，并标出它的八条边。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-figura hija ottagonu? Adam: Ejja ngħoddu l-ġnub: iva, għandha tmienja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this shape an octagon? Adam: Let's count the sides: yes, it has eight.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个图形是八边形吗？亚当：我们数数边吧：是的，它有八条边。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个图形是八边形吗？
messages.en: Is this shape an octagon?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ngħoddu l-ġnub: iva, għandha tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ngħoddu l-ġnub: iva, għandha tmienja.
messages.zh: 我们数数边吧：是的，它有八条边。
messages.en: Let's count the sides: yes, it has eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个八边形，在图中央写 ottagonu；沿边数到八，再读一遍单词，用手指动作帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hydrocarbon found in fuels such as petrol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种烃类化合物，存在于汽油等燃料中，中文称为辛烷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idrokarbur li jinsab fi fjuwils bħall-petrol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辛烷；一种烃类化合物。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-laboratorju, l-istudent iddeskriva l-kampjun ta' ottan bħala idrokarbur.
formal.en: In the laboratory report, the student described the sample of octane as a hydrocarbon.
formal.zh: 学生在实验报告中将这份辛烷样品描述为一种烃类化合物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu l-ottan? David: Huwa idrokarbur li jinsab fil-petrol.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is octane? David: It is a hydrocarbon found in petrol.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：辛烷是什么？戴维：它是汽油中存在的一种烃。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 辛烷是什么？
messages.en: What is octane?

messages.speaker: David (化学教师)
messages.zh: 它是汽油中存在的一种烃。
messages.en: It is a hydrocarbon found in petrol.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ottan 与英语 octane 并排写在“辛烷”下方，再画一个标注样品的小瓶，用三语标签巩固词义。

gloss_zh: 极大数名，英语对应 octillion

teaching_sense.en_definition: The very large cardinal number called an octillion; its exact value depends on the number scale being used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个极大的基数，英语对应 octillion；其具体数值须根据所采用的大数命名体系确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Numru kardinali kbir ħafna li l-valur eżatt tiegħu jiddependi mill-iskala tan-numri użata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极大数名 octillion；具体数值取决于所用的大数命名体系。

formal.mt: Jekk tintuża l-kelma ottiljun f'rapport, għandha tiġi speċifikata l-iskala tan-numri użata.
formal.en: If the word octillion is used in a report, the number scale used should be specified.
formal.zh: 如果报告中使用 ottiljun 这个大数名称，应明确说明所采用的大数命名体系。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kemm hu kbir ottiljun? Toni: Huwa numru enormi; biex nagħtuk il-valur eżatt, irridu nkunu nafu liema skala qed tintuża.
colloquial.en: Lina: How big is an octillion? Toni: It is an enormous number; to give you its exact value, we need to know which scale is being used.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：ottiljun 到底有多大？托尼：它是一个极大的数；要给出确切数值，我们得先知道采用哪一种命名体系。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: ottiljun 到底有多大？
messages.en: How big is an octillion?

messages.speaker: Toni (数学教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa numru enormi; biex nagħtuk il-valur eżatt, irridu nkunu nafu liema skala qed tintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa numru enormi; biex nagħtuk il-valur eżatt, irridu nkunu nafu liema skala qed tintuża.
messages.zh: 它是一个极大的数；要给出确切数值，我们得先知道采用哪一种命名体系。
messages.en: It is an enormous number; to give you its exact value, we need to know which scale is being used.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ottiljun 放进“大数名称”记忆卡，与英语 octillion 配对；卡背写“先确认命名体系，再确定数值”。

gloss_zh: 热烈而持久的鼓掌欢呼；规格低于凯旋式的胜利庆典

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prolonged, enthusiastic applause expressing strong approval or admiration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了表达强烈赞赏或敬意而持续进行的热烈鼓掌欢呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċapċip qawwi u fit-tul li jesprimi apprezzament jew ammirazzjoni kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热烈而持久的鼓掌欢呼，用以表达赞赏或敬意。

sense_translations.en_definition: ovation (victory ceremony of less importance than a triumph)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种规格和重要性低于凯旋式的胜利庆典。

collocations.zh: 获得热烈而持久的掌声

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-kunċert, l-orkestra rċeviet ovazjoni twila mill-udjenza.
formal.en: At the end of the concert, the orchestra received a prolonged ovation from the audience.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束时，乐团获得了观众经久不息的热烈掌声。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Smajt l-ovazjoni wara l-aħħar kanzunetta? Ben: Iva, in-nies damu jċapċpu!
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you hear the ovation after the last song? Ben: Yes, people kept clapping for ages!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你听到最后一首歌之后的热烈掌声了吗？本：听到了，大家鼓掌鼓了好久！

messages.speaker: Marta (观众)
messages.zh: 你听到最后一首歌之后的热烈掌声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the ovation after the last song?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，大家鼓掌鼓了好久！
messages.en: Yes, people kept clapping for ages!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演出结束后掌声久久不停，把 ovazjoni 与这段声音一起记；另用一张小卡单独记录其“较低规格胜利庆典”义。

gloss_zh: 猥亵地；下流地；有伤风化地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an obscene or indecent manner, especially in speech or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以猥亵、下流或有伤风化的方式，尤其用于描述言语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod oxxen jew indiċenti, speċjalment fil-kliem jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猥亵地；下流地；以有伤风化的方式。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddikjara li r-raġel tkellem oxxenament mal-persunal.
formal.en: The report states that the man spoke obscenely to the staff.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该男子对工作人员说了下流话。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex tlaqt minn hemm? Karl: Għax wieħed beda jitkellem oxxenament u ħassejtni skomdu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you leave that place? Karl: Because someone started speaking obscenely and I felt uncomfortable.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么离开那里？卡尔：因为有人开始说下流话，让我觉得不舒服。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开那里？
messages.en: Why did you leave that place?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax wieħed beda jitkellem oxxenament u ħassejtni skomdu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax wieħed beda jitkellem oxxenament u ħassejtni skomdu.
messages.zh: 因为有人开始说下流话，让我觉得不舒服。
messages.en: Because someone started speaking obscenely and I felt uncomfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 oxxenament 放在“说话”和“举止”两个动作旁，记成“以猥亵方式做某事”，帮助区分副词与人物称呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ocean surrounding Antarctica, used as the name of a geographical area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 环绕南极洲的海洋，其地理名称为南冰洋，也称南大洋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-oċean li jdawwar l-Antartika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 南冰洋；南大洋

collocations.en: the waters of the Antarctic Ocean

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta studju dwar l-ilmijiet tal-Oċean Antartiku.
formal.en: The report presents a study of the waters of the Antarctic Ocean.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了一项关于南冰洋海域的研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-Oċean Antartiku fuq din il-mappa? Toni: Hawn, madwar l-Antartika.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the Antarctic Ocean on this map? Toni: Here, around Antarctica.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：南冰洋在这张地图的什么位置？托尼：这里，南极洲周围。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-Oċean Antartiku fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-Oċean Antartiku fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 南冰洋在这张地图的什么位置？
messages.en: Where is the Antarctic Ocean on this map?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.zh: 这里，南极洲周围。
messages.en: Here, around Antarctica.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个名称与地图上环绕南极洲的一圈海水配对记忆：Oċean Antartiku＝南冰洋。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ocean in the region around the North Pole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于北极周围地区的海洋，地理名称为北冰洋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-oċean li jinsab fir-reġjun ta' madwar il-Pol tat-Tramuntana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 北冰洋

collocations.en: the ice of the Arctic Ocean
a journey in the Arctic Ocean

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjonijiet tas-silġ fl-Oċean Artiku.
formal.en: The study describes ice conditions in the Arctic Ocean.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了北冰洋的冰况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu l-Oċean Artiku? Mark: Iva, qiegħed madwar il-Pol tat-Tramuntana.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the Arctic Ocean? Mark: Yes, it is around the North Pole.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是北冰洋吗？马克：是的，它在北极周围。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这是北冰洋吗？
messages.en: Is this the Arctic Ocean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 是的，它在北极周围。
messages.en: Yes, it is around the North Pole.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图北极位置贴上 Oċean Artiku，再与南极附近的 Oċean Antartiku 对照，成对记住南北两洋。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ocean between the Americas to the west and Europe and Africa to the east.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于美洲与欧洲、非洲之间的海洋，地理名称为大西洋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-oċean bejn l-Amerki fil-punent u l-Ewropa u l-Afrika fil-lvant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大西洋

collocations.en: the crossing of the Atlantic Ocean
the coast of the Atlantic Ocean

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi r-rotta tal-vapur waqt il-qsim tal-Oċean Atlantiku.
formal.en: The document describes the ship's route during its crossing of the Atlantic Ocean.
formal.zh: 这份文件描述了该船横渡大西洋时的航线。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-vapur se jaqsam l-Oċean Atlantiku? Pawlu: Iva, se jmur mill-Ewropa lejn l-Amerka.
colloquial.en: Nina: Will the ship cross the Atlantic Ocean? Pawlu: Yes, it will go from Europe to America.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这艘船会横渡大西洋吗？保罗：会，它将从欧洲驶向美洲。

messages.speaker: Nina (旅客)
messages.zh: 这艘船会横渡大西洋吗？
messages.en: Will the ship cross the Atlantic Ocean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se jmur mill-Ewropa lejn l-Amerka.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se jmur mill-Ewropa lejn l-Amerka.
messages.zh: 会，它将从欧洲驶向美洲。
messages.en: Yes, it will go from Europe to America.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一艘船从欧洲驶向美洲，把航线中间的海洋标成 Oċean Atlantiku，与“大西洋”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ocean between Africa, Asia, and Australia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于非洲、亚洲和澳大利亚之间的海洋，地理名称为印度洋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-oċean li jinsab bejn l-Afrika, l-Asja u l-Awstralja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印度洋

collocations.en: the islands of the Indian Ocean
a route in the Indian Ocean

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi rotta kummerċjali fl-Oċean Indjan.
formal.en: The map shows a trade route in the Indian Ocean.
formal.zh: 这张地图显示了印度洋中的一条贸易航线。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn jinsabu dawn il-gżejjer? David: Fl-Oċean Indjan; ejja nsibuhom fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are these islands? David: In the Indian Ocean; let's find them on the map.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些岛屿在哪里？戴维：在印度洋里；我们来地图上找找它们吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这些岛屿在哪里？
messages.en: Where are these islands?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Oċean Indjan; ejja nsibuhom fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Oċean Indjan; ejja nsibuhom fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在印度洋里；我们来地图上找找它们吧。
messages.en: In the Indian Ocean; let's find them on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在非洲、亚洲和澳大利亚之间的海域写下 Oċean Indjan，用地图位置帮助牢牢记住“印度洋”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ocean between Asia and Australia to the west and the Americas to the east.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于亚洲、澳大利亚与美洲之间的海洋，地理名称为太平洋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-oċean bejn l-Asja u l-Awstralja fil-punent u l-Amerki fil-lvant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 太平洋

collocations.en: the islands of the Pacific Ocean
the crossing of the Pacific Ocean

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi l-vjaġġ ta' vapur waqt il-qsim tal-Oċean Paċifiku.
formal.en: The article describes a ship's journey during its crossing of the Pacific Ocean.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了一艘船横渡太平洋的航程。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Liema oċean hemm bejn il-Ġappun u l-Amerka? Samwel: L-Oċean Paċifiku; ara kemm hu wiesa' fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which ocean is between Japan and America? Samwel: The Pacific Ocean; look how wide it is on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：日本和美洲之间是哪个大洋？萨姆韦尔：太平洋；看，它在地图上多么辽阔。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema oċean hemm bejn il-Ġappun u l-Amerka?
messages.mt_standard: Liema oċean hemm bejn il-Ġappun u l-Amerka?
messages.zh: 日本和美洲之间是哪个大洋？
messages.en: Which ocean is between Japan and America?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-Oċean Paċifiku; ara kemm hu wiesa' fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: L-Oċean Paċifiku; ara kemm hu wiesa' fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 太平洋；看，它在地图上多么辽阔。
messages.en: The Pacific Ocean; look how wide it is on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上用手指从日本划向美洲，经过的大片海域配上 Oċean Paċifiku，把整条路线与“太平洋”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The geographical region that includes Australia, New Zealand, and many islands of the Pacific Ocean.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包括澳大利亚、新西兰及太平洋众多岛屿的地理区域，称为大洋洲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-reġjun ġeografiku li jinkludi l-Awstralja, New Zealand u ħafna gżejjer tal-Oċean Paċifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大洋洲

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jippreżenta l-ġeografija tal-Oċeanja u jintroduċi l-pajjiżi tar-reġjun.
formal.en: This chapter presents the geography of Oceania and introduces the countries of the region.
formal.zh: 本章介绍大洋洲的地理及该地区的各个国家。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Għal liema reġjun hu dan il-proġett? Luqa: Għall-Oċeanja; se nibdew bl-Awstralja u New Zealand.
colloquial.en: Emma: Which region is this project about? Luqa: Oceania; we will start with Australia and New Zealand.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：这个项目研究哪个地区？卢卡：大洋洲；我们会从澳大利亚和新西兰开始。

messages.speaker: Emma (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal liema reġjun hu dan il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Għal liema reġjun hu dan il-proġett?
messages.zh: 这个项目研究哪个地区？
messages.en: Which region is this project about?

messages.mt_spoken: Għall-Oċeanja; se nibdew bl-Awstralja u New Zealand.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-Oċeanja; se nibdew bl-Awstralja u New Zealand.
messages.zh: 大洋洲；我们会从澳大利亚和新西兰开始。
messages.en: Oceania; we will start with Australia and New Zealand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给澳大利亚、新西兰和周围岛屿画一个区域框，框上写 Oċeanja，用“大洋洲这一地区”来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The scientific study of oceans, including their waters, processes, and marine life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究海洋及其海水、各种过程和海洋生物的科学。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju xjentifiku tal-oċeani, tal-ilmijiet tagħhom, tal-proċessi li jseħħu fihom u tal-ħajja tal-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海洋学；以海洋为研究对象的科学

formal.mt: Il-kors fl-oċeanografija jintroduċi metodi xjentifiċi għall-istudju tal-oċeani.
formal.en: The course in oceanography introduces scientific methods for studying oceans.
formal.zh: 这门海洋学课程介绍研究海洋的科学方法。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'qed tistudja din is-sena? Ben: L-oċeanografija; bħalissa qed nitgħallem dwar il-kurrenti tal-baħar.
colloquial.en: Marta: What are you studying this year? Ben: Oceanography; at the moment I am learning about sea currents.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你今年在学什么？本：海洋学；我现在正在学习洋流。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今年在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying this year?

messages.speaker: Ben (大学生)
messages.mt_spoken: L-oċeanografija; bħalissa qed nitgħallem dwar il-kurrenti tal-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: L-oċeanografija; bħalissa qed nitgħallem dwar il-kurrenti tal-baħar.
messages.zh: 海洋学；我现在正在学习洋流。
messages.en: Oceanography; at the moment I am learning about sea currents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课表上写着 oċeanografija，旁边画海浪和研究笔记；用“课程与学科”的场景记住海洋学。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scientist who studies oceans and their characteristics and processes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究海洋及其特征和各种过程的科学家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xjenzat li jistudja l-oċeani, il-karatteristiċi tagħhom u l-proċessi li jseħħu fihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海洋学家；从事海洋科学研究的人

collocations.zh: 一位经验丰富的海洋学家

formal.mt: L-oċeanografu analizza d-data miġbura waqt l-istudju tal-kurrenti tal-baħar.
formal.en: The oceanographer analysed the data collected during the study of sea currents.
formal.zh: 这位海洋学家分析了研究洋流时收集的数据。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'xogħol jagħmel ħuk? Ġanni: Jaħdem bħala oċeanografu u jistudja l-kurrenti tal-baħar.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does your brother do for work? Ġanni: He works as an oceanographer and studies sea currents.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你兄弟做什么工作？詹尼：他是海洋学家，研究洋流。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟做什么工作？
messages.en: What does your brother do for work?

messages.mt_standard: Jaħdem bħala oċeanografu u jistudja l-kurrenti tal-baħar.
messages.zh: 他是海洋学家，研究洋流。
messages.en: He works as an oceanographer and studies sea currents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 oċeanografu 写在研究船上科学家的名牌上，再把 oċeanografija 写在他的课本上，对照记住“人”和“学科”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on facts rather than personal feelings or preferences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以事实为依据，而非受个人感受或偏好左右的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibbażat fuq il-fatti aktar milli fuq sentimenti jew preferenzi personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客观的；依据事实而不偏袒的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab rapport oġġettiv ibbażat fuq l-evidenza disponibbli.
formal.en: The committee requested an objective report based on the available evidence.
formal.zh: 委员会要求提交一份依据现有证据撰写的客观报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li r-rapport huwa oġġettiv? Mark: Iva, jagħti l-fatti u jinkludi ż-żewġ naħat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think the report is objective? Mark: Yes, it gives the facts and includes both sides.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这份报告客观吗？马克：是的，它陈述事实，也涵盖了双方的观点。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你觉得这份报告客观吗？
messages.en: Do you think the report is objective?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħti l-fatti u jinkludi ż-żewġ naħat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħti l-fatti u jinkludi ż-żewġ naħat.
messages.zh: 是的，它陈述事实，也涵盖了双方的观点。
messages.en: Yes, it gives the facts and includes both sides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份把双方事实都摆上桌的报告，用 rapport oġġettiv 记住“客观的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat or present a person as an object rather than as a person with feelings and agency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将人作为物品来对待或呈现，忽视其感受和自主性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta jew jippreżenta persuna bħala oġġett, mingħajr ma jqis is-sentimenti tagħha jew il-ħila tagħha li tagħżel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物化；把人作为物品对待或呈现。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jikkritika reklamar li joġġettiva lin-nisa u jinjora l-personalità tagħhom.
formal.en: The article criticizes advertising that objectifies women and ignores their individuality.
formal.zh: 这篇文章批评了物化女性、忽视其个性的广告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma jogħġbokx dan ir-reklam? Lara: Għax joġġettiva lin-nisa; jurihom bħallikieku huma biss oġġetti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why don't you like this advertisement? Lara: Because it objectifies women; it shows them as if they were merely objects.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不喜欢这则广告？拉拉：因为它物化女性，把她们表现得仿佛只是物品。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不喜欢这则广告？
messages.en: Why don't you like this advertisement?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax joġġettiva lin-nisa; jurihom bħallikieku huma biss oġġetti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax joġġettiva lin-nisa; jurihom bħallikieku huma biss oġġetti.
messages.zh: 因为它物化女性，把她们表现得仿佛只是物品。
messages.en: Because it objectifies women; it shows them as if they were merely objects.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把广告中“人被当成商品”的画面与这个动词绑定；本词条记的是“物化”这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that relies on facts rather than personal feelings or preferences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以事实为依据、不受个人感受或偏好左右地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod ibbażat fuq il-fatti aktar milli fuq sentimenti jew preferenzi personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客观地；依据事实而不带个人偏见地。

collocations.en: to look at the facts objectively

formal.mt: Il-bord għandu jevalwa oġġettivament kull applikazzjoni skont l-istess kriterji.
formal.en: The board should evaluate every application objectively using the same criteria.
formal.zh: 委员会应按照相同标准，客观地评估每份申请。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-proġett jogħġobni ħafna. Maja: Naf, imma ejja nħarsu lejn ir-riżultati oġġettivament.
colloquial.en: Mark: I really like this project. Maja: I know, but let's look at the results objectively.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我非常喜欢这个项目。玛雅：我知道，不过我们还是客观地看看结果吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我非常喜欢这个项目。
messages.en: I really like this project.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naf, imma ejja nħarsu lejn ir-riżultati oġġettivament.
messages.mt_standard: Naf, imma ejja nħarsu lejn ir-riżultati oġġettivament.
messages.zh: 我知道，不过我们还是客观地看看结果吧。
messages.en: I know, but let's look at the results objectively.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“怎样评估？客观地评估”来记忆，让 oġġettivament 紧跟评估、分析等动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports the philosophical view that reality exists independently of individual perceptions or opinions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持现实独立于个人感知或意见而存在这一哲学观点的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħaddan il-fehma filosofika li r-realtà teżisti indipendentement mill-perċezzjonijiet jew l-opinjonijiet tal-individwu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客观主义者；支持客观主义哲学观点的人。

collocations.zh: 一位客观主义者的观点

formal.mt: Fl-esej tiegħu, l-istudent jispjega għaliex oġġettivista jqis ir-realtà bħala indipendenti mill-opinjonijiet personali.
formal.en: In his essay, the student explains why an objectivist regards reality as independent of personal opinions.
formal.zh: 这名学生在论文中解释了客观主义者为何认为现实独立于个人意见而存在。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser li xi ħadd huwa oġġettivista? Pawlu: Ifisser li jħaddan il-fehma li r-realtà teżisti indipendentement minn dak li naħsbu dwarha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does it mean to say that someone is an objectivist? Pawlu: It means that they hold the view that reality exists independently of what we think about it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：说一个人是客观主义者是什么意思？保罗：意思是这个人认为，现实的存在独立于我们对它的想法。

messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser li xi ħadd huwa oġġettivista?
messages.zh: 说一个人是客观主义者是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to say that someone is an objectivist?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jħaddan il-fehma li r-realtà teżisti indipendentement minn dak li naħsbu dwarha.

messages.zh: 意思是这个人认为，现实的存在独立于我们对它的想法。
messages.en: It means that they hold the view that reality exists independently of what we think about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂里一位主张“现实独立存在”的发言者，把这个词记作持有该观点的“人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of judging or presenting something according to facts rather than personal feelings or bias.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 判断或呈现事物时依据事实、不受个人感情或偏见左右的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li tiġġudika jew tippreżenta xi ħaġa skont il-fatti aktar milli skont sentimenti jew preġudizzji personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客观性；依据事实、不带个人偏见的性质。

formal.mt: L-użu ta' kriterji ċari jgħin biex tinżamm l-oġġettività tal-evalwazzjoni.
formal.en: Using clear criteria helps maintain the objectivity of the evaluation.
formal.zh: 采用明确的标准有助于保持评估的客观性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex irridu t-tieni opinjoni? Mark: Biex niżguraw l-oġġettività tal-evalwazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do we need a second opinion? Mark: To ensure the objectivity of the evaluation.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们为什么需要第二个意见？马克：为了确保评估的客观性。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)

messages.en: To ensure the objectivity of the evaluation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“这份报告有多客观”概括成“报告的客观性”，用这个抽象性质记住名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A philosophical position that holds that reality exists independently of individual perceptions or opinions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为现实独立于个人感知或意见而存在的一种哲学立场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pożizzjoni filosofika li ssostni li r-realtà teżisti indipendentement mill-perċezzjonijiet jew l-opinjonijiet tal-individwu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客观主义；主张现实独立于个人感知或意见而存在的哲学立场。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jippreżenta l-oġġettiviżmu bħala pożizzjoni filosofika li tiddistingwi r-realtà mill-opinjonijiet personali dwarha.
formal.en: The chapter presents objectivism as a philosophical position that distinguishes reality from personal opinions about it.
formal.zh: 这一章将客观主义介绍为一种把现实与个人对现实的意见区分开来的哲学立场。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fuq xiex se tikteb l-esej? Lara: Fuq l-oġġettiviżmu u l-idea li r-realtà teżisti indipendentement mill-opinjonijiet tagħna.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What will you write your essay about? Lara: About objectivism and the idea that reality exists independently of our opinions.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你的论文打算写什么？拉拉：写客观主义，以及现实独立于我们的意见而存在这一观点。

messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-oġġettiviżmu u l-idea li r-realtà teżisti indipendentement mill-opinjonijiet tagħna.
messages.zh: 写客观主义，以及现实独立于我们的意见而存在这一观点。
messages.en: About objectivism and the idea that reality exists independently of our opinions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“现实独立于个人看法”写在一张观点卡上，整张卡代表客观主义这一哲学立场。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express disagreement with something or formally raise a reason against it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事表达反对，或正式提出反对它的理由。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jesprimi nuqqas ta' qbil ma' xi ħaġa jew iressaq raġuni kontriha b'mod formali.

sense_translations.en_definition: to object, to raise an objection
sense_translations.zh_definition: 反对；表示不同意；提出异议。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant oġġezzjona għall-proposta minħabba l-ispejjeż għoljin tagħha.
formal.en: The representative objected to the proposal because of its high costs.
formal.zh: 这位代表因该提案成本过高而提出异议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark oġġezzjona għall-ħin tal-laqgħa? Sara: Iva, għax f'dak il-ħin irid jiġbor lil bintu mill-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark object to the meeting time? Sara: Yes, because he has to pick up his daughter from school at that time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克对会议时间提出异议了吗？萨拉：是的，因为那个时间他得去学校接女儿。

gloss_zh: 令人反感的；不可接受的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to cause disapproval or offense because it is considered unacceptable or inappropriate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因被认为不可接受或不合适而容易引起反对或反感的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jqajjem diżapprovazzjoni jew joffendi għax jitqies inaċċettabbli jew mhux xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人反感的；不可接受的；足以引起异议的。

formal.mt: Il-moderatur neħħa l-kumment oġġezzjonabbli minħabba li kien fih insulti personali.
formal.en: The moderator removed the objectionable comment because it contained personal insults.
formal.zh: 管理员删除了那条令人反感的评论，因为其中包含人身侮辱。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex neħħejt dak il-kumment? Maja: Għax kien oġġezzjonabbli; kien fih insulti personali.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you remove that comment? Maja: Because it was objectionable; it contained personal insults.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The metallic chemical element called osmium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锇，一种金属化学元素。

formal.en: In the chemistry lesson, the teacher introduced osmium as a metallic element.
formal.zh: 在化学课上，老师介绍了锇这种金属元素。

messages.en: What is ożmju in English?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: Osmium，是一种金属化学元素。
messages.en: Osmium; it is a metallic chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡，正面写 ożmju，背面写“锇／osmium”；特别圈出 ż，配合朗读记住拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a broad blade used by hand to move a boat through water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手操作、带有宽桨叶、用于推动船只前进的划桨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'tarf wiesa' li tintuża bl-idejn biex tmexxi dgħajsa fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划桨；用手划水以推动船只的工具。

formal.mt: Qabel ma telqu, l-għalliem wera lill-istudenti kif iżommu l-padil u jaqdfu bih.
formal.en: Before they set off, the teacher showed the students how to hold the paddle and use it to paddle.
formal.zh: 出发前，老师向学生示范了如何握桨并用它划水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-padil? Mark: Ħdejk, fid-dgħajsa. Aqbad miegħu sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the paddle? Mark: Beside you, in the boat. Hold it firmly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：划桨在哪儿？Mark：就在你旁边，船里面。把它握稳。

messages.speaker: Maja (划船同伴)
messages.zh: 划桨在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the paddle?

messages.speaker: Mark (划船同伴)
messages.zh: 就在你旁边，船里面。把它握稳。
messages.en: Beside you, in the boat. Hold it firmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 padil 写在一幅双手握桨划水的小图下面，用“手里的划桨”这一具体画面记住名词含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in South Asia, officially called the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 南亚国家巴基斯坦，正式名称为巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja t'Isfel li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika Iżlamika tal-Pakistan.

sense_translations.en_definition: Pakistan (a country in South Asia; official name: Repubblika Iżlamika tal-Pakistan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴基斯坦，位于南亚的国家；正式名称为巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国。

formal.mt: Il-Pakistan huwa pajjiż fl-Asja t'Isfel, u l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika Iżlamika tal-Pakistan.
formal.en: Pakistan is a country in South Asia, and its official name is the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
formal.zh: 巴基斯坦是南亚国家，正式名称为巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu l-ħabib tiegħek? Mark: Mill-Pakistan. Iltqajna fil-kors tal-lingwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is your friend from? Mark: From Pakistan. We met on the language course.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的朋友来自哪里？Mark：来自巴基斯坦。我们是在语言课上认识的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的朋友来自哪里？
messages.en: Where is your friend from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 来自巴基斯坦。我们是在语言课上认识的。
messages.en: From Pakistan. We met on the language course.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Pakistan 与中文“巴基斯坦”并排写在南亚地图旁，再用 fil-Pakistan 和 mill-Pakistan 分别练习“在”和“来自”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or call, used of certain kinds of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些种类的鸟发出鸣叫或啼鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikanta jew isemma' leħnu, meta jingħad dwar ċerti tipi ta' għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣叫；啼鸣，用于某些种类的鸟。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-għasfur pakpak fuq il-fergħa waqt li t-tfal kienu qed jisimgħu.
formal.en: In the story, the bird sang on the branch while the children listened.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那只鸟在树枝上鸣叫，孩子们听着它的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt l-għasfur dalgħodu? Mark: Iva, pakpak ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the bird this morning? Mark: Yes, it sang near the window.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天早上听到那只鸟了吗？Mark：听到了，它在窗边鸣叫。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 你今天早上听到那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the bird this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 听到了，它在窗边鸣叫。
messages.en: Yes, it sang near the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 pakpak 时配上鸟儿连续鸣叫的画面，作为个人记忆联想；另写“用于某些鸟”，避免把适用范围扩大到所有动物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The northern shoveler, a species of duck with the scientific name Spatula clypeata.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 琵嘴鸭，一种鸭类，学名为 Spatula clypeata。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Spatula clypeata.

sense_translations.en_definition: northern shoveler (Spatula clypeata, formerly Anas clypeata)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 琵嘴鸭，学名 Spatula clypeata，旧学名为 Anas clypeata。

collocations.en: a photograph of a northern shoveler

formal.mt: L-istudenta inkludiet fir-rapport ritratt ta' palettuna u l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Spatula clypeata.
formal.en: The student included a photograph of a northern shoveler and its scientific name, Spatula clypeata, in the report.
formal.zh: 这名学生在报告中放入了一张琵嘴鸭的照片，并注明其学名 Spatula clypeata。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-papra fir-ritratt? Mark: Palettuna. Trid tara ritratt ieħor tagħha?
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this duck in the photograph called? Mark: A northern shoveler. Would you like to see another photograph of it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片里的这种鸭叫什么？Mark：琵嘴鸭。你想再看一张它的照片吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种鸭叫什么？
messages.en: What is this duck in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Palettuna. Trid tara ritratt ieħor tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Palettuna. Trid tara ritratt ieħor tagħha?
messages.zh: 琵嘴鸭。你想再看一张它的照片吗？
messages.en: A northern shoveler. Would you like to see another photograph of it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语鸟名卡：palettuna、琵嘴鸭、northern shoveler，并附上学名；用同一张照片把三个名称连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A separate seating compartment in a theatre, usually for a small group of spectators.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剧院中供少数观众使用的独立观演包厢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompartiment separat fit-teatru fejn grupp żgħir ta' spettaturi jista' joqgħod jara l-ispettaklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （剧院中的）包厢。

formal.mt: Il-grupp ibbukkja palkett għal erba' persuni biex jara l-opra.
formal.en: The group booked a box for four people to watch the opera.
formal.zh: 这个团体预订了一个四人包厢观看歌剧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se noqogħdu llejla? Mark: Fil-palkett; minn hemm naraw il-palk sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we sitting tonight? Mark: In the box; we can see the stage well from there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们今晚坐在哪里？Mark：坐包厢；从那里能清楚地看到舞台。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今晚坐在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we sitting tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-palkett; minn hemm naraw il-palk sew.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-palkett; minn hemm naraw il-palk sew.
messages.zh: 坐包厢；从那里能清楚地看到舞台。
messages.en: In the box; we can see the stage well from there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把剧院想成座位地图：独立的小隔间是 palkett，观众坐在里面看舞台。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The area in a theatre where actors, musicians, or other performers perform before an audience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剧院中演员、音乐家等面向观众表演的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ispazju fit-teatru fejn l-atturi, il-mużiċisti jew artisti oħra jagħtu l-wirja tagħhom quddiem l-udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供演员或其他表演者演出的舞台。

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, it-tekniċi ċċekkjaw id-dwal tal-palkuxeniku.
formal.en: Before the performance, the technicians checked the stage lights.
formal.zh: 演出开始前，技术人员检查了舞台灯光。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġi dan is-siġġu? Luka: Fuq il-palkuxeniku, ħdejn il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where should I put this chair? Luka: On the stage, next to the table.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这把椅子放在哪里？Luka：放到舞台上，桌子旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (演员)
messages.zh: 这把椅子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this chair?

messages.speaker: Luka (舞台工作人员)
messages.zh: 放到舞台上，桌子旁边。
messages.en: On the stage, next to the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象灯光亮起、演员走到表演区，把整个舞台画面与 palkuxeniku 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The metallic chemical element palladium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为钯的金属化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku metalliku magħruf bħala palladju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钯，一种金属化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun ta' palladju tqiegħed f'kontenitur bit-tikketta qabel l-analiżi.
formal.en: The palladium sample was placed in a labelled container before analysis.
formal.zh: 分析前，钯样品被放入贴有标签的容器中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kampjun huwa palladju? Pawlu: Iva, fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub 'palladju pur'.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this sample palladium? Pawlu: Yes, the label says 'pure palladium'.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这份样品是钯吗？Pawlu：是的，标签上写着“纯钯”。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这份样品是钯吗？
messages.en: Is this sample palladium?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub 'palladju pur'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub 'palladju pur'.
messages.zh: 是的，标签上写着“纯钯”。
messages.en: Yes, the label says 'pure palladium'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用实验室样品标签来记：palladju 对应钯，palladju pur 就是纯钯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Palm trees considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对棕榈树的集合称呼，用来谈论一片或一类棕榈树。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġar tal-palm meqjusa flimkien bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棕榈树，作为集合称呼。

formal.mt: Is-siġar tal-palm tul il-mogħdija jipprovdu dell lill-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The palm trees along the path provide shade for visitors.
formal.zh: 小路沿线的棕榈树为游客提供树荫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm fuq dik in-naħa tal-ġnien? Toni: Hemm ħafna palm; ejja nimxu hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's on that side of the garden? Toni: There are lots of palm trees; let's walk over there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：花园那边有什么？Toni：有很多棕榈树；我们走过去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 花园那边有什么？
messages.en: What's on that side of the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħafna palm; ejja nimxu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħafna palm; ejja nimxu hemm.
messages.zh: 有很多棕榈树；我们走过去吧。
messages.en: There are lots of palm trees; let's walk over there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 palm 配上一整片棕榈树的画面；再用 palma 配上一棵树，形成集合与单棵的对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual palm tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 单独的一棵棕榈树。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra waħda tal-palm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棕榈树，指单独的一棵。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tal-ġnien turi palma waħda ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The garden plan shows one palm tree beside the main entrance.
formal.zh: 花园平面图显示，主入口旁有一棵棕榈树。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Ben: Taħt il-palma l-għolja ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we meet? Ben: Under the tall palm tree next to the gate.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们在哪里碰面？Ben：在大门旁那棵高大的棕榈树下。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 在大门旁那棵高大的棕榈树下。
messages.en: Under the tall palm tree next to the gate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一棵树并标上 palma，再画一片树标上 palm；用画面记住单棵与集合的区别。
