teaching_sense.en_definition: A stroke involving the palm of the hand, especially a blow delivered to the palm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及手掌的拍击，尤其指打在掌心的一击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa bil-pala tal-id jew fuq il-pala tal-id.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次掌击或用手掌拍打的动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: stroke on the palm of the hand
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打在手掌心上的一击。

collocations.en: a slap on the palm of the hand

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba, kull parteċipant ta palmata ħafifa fuq il-pala ta' sieħbu.
formal.en: During the game, each participant gave their partner a light slap on the palm.
formal.zh: 游戏过程中，每位参与者都轻轻拍了一下同伴的掌心。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Agħtini palmata ħafifa fuq il-pala. Sam: Hekk tajjeb, jew aktar bil-mod?
colloquial.en: Rita: Give me a light slap on the palm. Sam: Is this all right, or should I do it more gently?
colloquial.zh: Rita：轻轻拍一下我的掌心。Sam：这样可以吗，还是要再轻一点？

messages.speaker: Rita (游戏同伴)
messages.zh: 轻轻拍一下我的掌心。
messages.en: Give me a light slap on the palm.

messages.speaker: Sam (游戏同伴)
messages.zh: 这样可以吗，还是要再轻一点？
messages.en: Is this all right, or should I do it more gently?

cognitive_memory_aid: 伸开手掌，想象掌心被轻拍一下，把这一下动作记作 palmata，注意它表示拍击。

gloss_zh: 持棕榈枝的朝圣者；Palmier（姓氏）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pilgrim associated with carrying a palm branch; also, when capitalized, the surname Palmier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与携带棕榈枝相关的朝圣者；首字母大写的 Palmier 也用作姓氏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pellegrin li jġorr fergħa tal-palm; Palmier, b'ittra kbira fil-bidu, jintuża wkoll bħala kunjom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持棕榈枝的朝圣者。
Palmier：姓氏，可音译为“帕尔米耶”。

collocations.en: a palmer with a palm branch

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-palmier huwa deskritt bħala pellegrin b'fergħa tal-palm f'idu.
formal.en: In the text, the palmer is described as a pilgrim with a palm branch in his hand.
formal.zh: 文中将这位朝圣者描写为手持棕榈枝的旅人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu s-Sur Palmier? Mark: Huwa l-għalliem il-ġdid; Palmier hu kunjomu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is Mr Palmier? Mark: He is the new teacher; Palmier is his surname.
colloquial.zh: Nina：帕尔米耶先生是谁？Mark：他是新来的老师；Palmier 是他的姓。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 帕尔米耶先生是谁？
messages.en: Who is Mr Palmier?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-għalliem il-ġdid; Palmier hu kunjomu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-għalliem il-ġdid; Palmier hu kunjomu.
messages.zh: 他是新来的老师；Palmier 是他的姓。
messages.en: He is the new teacher; Palmier is his surname.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张词卡记忆：palmier 配持枝朝圣者，Palmier 配人物姓名；结合大小写与语境辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having toes joined by a membrane to form webbed feet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脚趾之间有膜相连、形成蹼足的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu s-swaba' tas-saqajn magħqudin b'rita li tifforma għamla ta' pala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹼足的，脚趾之间有蹼相连的。

formal.mt: Il-papru huwa għasfur palmipedu, bis-swaba' tas-saqajn magħqudin b'rita.
formal.en: The duck is a web-footed bird, with its toes joined by a membrane.
formal.zh: 鸭子是蹼足鸟，脚趾之间有膜相连。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Xi jfisser 'palmipedu'? Pawlu: Ifisser li għandu s-swaba' tas-saqajn magħqudin b'rita, bħal papru.
colloquial.en: Ella: What does 'palmipedu' mean? Pawlu: It means having toes joined by a membrane, like a duck.
colloquial.zh: Ella：palmipedu 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是脚趾之间有膜相连，就像鸭子那样。

messages.speaker: Ella (学生)
messages.zh: palmipedu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'palmipedu' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu s-swaba' tas-saqajn magħqudin b'rita, bħal papru.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu s-swaba' tas-saqajn magħqudin b'rita, bħal papru.
messages.zh: 意思是脚趾之间有膜相连，就像鸭子那样。
messages.en: It means having toes joined by a membrane, like a duck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸭脚的脚趾被一层薄膜连成小船桨，用这个画面记住 palmipedu 表示蹼足的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be felt by touch, or so clear and strong that it is readily noticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够用触觉感知的；也形容气氛、情绪或变化十分明显，令人切实感受到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinħass bil-mess, jew li tant hu ċar u qawwi li jinħass minnufih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可触知的；明显到能够切实感受到的。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, it-tensjoni bejn iż-żewġ gruppi kienet palpabbli.
formal.en: During the meeting, the tension between the two groups was palpable.
formal.zh: 会议期间，两组之间的紧张气氛明显可感。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħadd ma tkellem waqt l-ikla. | Mark: Iva, it-tensjoni kienet palpabbli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Nobody spoke during the meal. | Mark: Yes, the tension was palpable.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：吃饭时谁都没说话。 | 马克：是啊，那种紧张气氛太明显了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃饭时谁都没说话。
messages.en: Nobody spoke during the meal.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，那种紧张气氛太明显了。
messages.en: Yes, the tension was palpable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象紧张气氛浓得仿佛能用手摸到，把 palpabbli 与“切实感觉得到”连在一起记。

gloss_zh: 拿起翻看以挑选；摸看挑拣

teaching_sense.en_definition: To handle items while choosing among them, such as goods displayed in a shop.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挑选物品时用手拿起、摸看或翻看，以便比较并作出选择。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qabad u mess oġġetti biex jagħżel minn fosthom, bħal oġġetti għall-bejgħ f'ħanut.

sense_translations.en_definition: to handle objects from among which one chooses (e.g. objects on display in a shop)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在待选物品中动手拿看、摸看或翻拣，例如挑选商店里陈列的商品。

formal.mt: Il-klijent palpal id-drappijiet fuq il-bank qabel għażel wieħed għall-purtieri.
formal.en: The customer handled the fabrics on the counter before choosing one for the curtains.
formal.zh: 顾客拿看了柜台上的各种布料，然后选定一种做窗帘。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Pawlu għażel xi qmis? | Toni: Iva, imma l-ewwel palpal il-qomos kollha fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did Pawlu choose a shirt? | Toni: Yes, but first he handled all the shirts on the table.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗选好衬衫了吗？ | 托尼：选好了，不过他先把桌上的衬衫全拿起来翻看了一遍。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗选好衬衫了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu choose a shirt?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel palpal il-qomos kollha fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel palpal il-qomos kollha fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 选好了，不过他先把桌上的衬衫全拿起来翻看了一遍。
messages.en: Yes, but first he handled all the shirts on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象逛店挑衬衫，手里拿起这件又翻看那件；palpal 要连着“动手比较后挑选”的动作记。

gloss_zh: 满足一时兴致；冒出荒唐念头

teaching_sense.en_definition: To satisfy a passing whim, or to have a foolish idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 顺着一时的兴致满足自己的愿望；也指产生一个愚蠢或不切实际的念头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issodisfa kapriċċ, jew ġietu idea bla sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满足一时的兴致或突发奇想。
产生愚蠢、荒唐或不切实际的想法。

collocations.en: indulged a whim and bought a toy
collocations.zh: 一时兴起，买了个玩具满足自己

collocations.en: indulged a whim and ordered a large cake
collocations.zh: 一时兴起，订了一个大蛋糕

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-fiera, Pawlu panzar u xtara mudell ta' vapur għall-kollezzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: During his visit to the fair, Pawlu indulged a whim and bought a model ship for his collection.
formal.zh: 参观集市时，保罗一时兴起，买了一艘模型船加入自己的收藏。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex xtara dak il-kappell enormi? | Ivan: Panzar! Ried jilbsu għall-festa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did he buy that enormous hat? | Ivan: He indulged a whim! He wanted to wear it to the party.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他为什么买那顶大得夸张的帽子？ | 伊万：一时兴起呗！他想戴着去参加聚会。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么买那顶大得夸张的帽子？
messages.en: Why did he buy that enormous hat?

messages.speaker: Ivan (朋友)
messages.zh: 一时兴起呗！他想戴着去参加聚会。
messages.en: He indulged a whim! He wanted to wear it to the party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一时兴起”的画面串联两个义项：满足小愿望，或冒出荒唐主意；具体意思要看上下文。

gloss_zh: 吃（对幼儿用语）；占便宜；婴儿软食；面包

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat, in speech addressed to a young child; also, disapprovingly, to exploit a situation for one's own benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对幼儿说话时表示“吃、吃饭”；另有贬义用法，指利用某种局面为自己谋利或占便宜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma użata mat-tfal żgħar biex tfisser tiekol; tintuża wkoll b'sens ta' disprezz għal min jieħu vantaġġ minn sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: to eat (a word occurring in child-directed speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃、吃饭，用于对幼儿说话。

sense_translations.en_definition: to use a situation to one's advantage (derogatory)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用局面为自己谋利、趁机占便宜，含贬义。
供婴儿食用的软食或糊状食物。
面包。

collocations.en: eat a little, said to a young child

formal.mt: Fl-istorja għat-tfal, l-omm tgħid lit-tifel: 'Pappa ftit qabel tmur tilgħab.'
formal.en: In the children's story, the mother tells the boy, 'Eat a little before you go and play.'
formal.zh: 在这个儿童故事里，母亲对小男孩说：“先吃一点点，再去玩。”

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pappa ftit, qalbi. | Ben: Ma rridx aktar, ma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Eat a little, sweetheart. | Ben: I don't want any more, Mum.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：宝贝，吃一点点吧。 | 本：妈妈，我不想再吃了。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝贝，吃一点点吧。
messages.en: Eat a little, sweetheart.

messages.speaker: Ben (孩子)
messages.zh: 妈妈，我不想再吃了。
messages.en: I don't want any more, Mum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用妈妈哄宝宝“吃一点”记动词，再把婴儿软食和面包记作名词；另用“趁机捞好处”单独记贬义。

gloss_zh: 软弱无能的人；缺乏胆量的人（贬称）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disapproving term for a person regarded as weak, timid, or lacking resolve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对被认为软弱、胆怯或缺乏主见的人的贬称，相当于“软骨头、没胆量的人”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' disprezz għal persuna meqjusa dgħajfa, beżżiegħa jew bla determinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性情软弱、优柔寡断的人，含贬义。
缺乏胆量或骨气的人；软弱无能的人，含贬义。

collocations.zh: 把他当作软弱无能的人对待

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ħuh isejjaħlu 'pappanejna' għax ma jridx jieħu sehem fil-ġlieda.
formal.en: In the story, his brother calls him a milksop because he does not want to take part in the fight.
formal.zh: 故事里，他的兄弟因为他不愿参与打架，便骂他是个没胆量的人。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Qalli 'pappanejna' għax ma ridtx niġġieled. | Nina: Għamilt sew li ma ġġilidtx.
colloquial.en: Luca: He called me a milksop because I didn't want to fight. | Nina: You were right not to fight.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我不想打架，他就骂我没胆量。 | 妮娜：你没打架是对的。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 我不想打架，他就骂我没胆量。
messages.en: He called me a milksop because I didn't want to fight.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你没打架是对的。
messages.en: You were right not to fight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“他骂我没胆量”的场景记忆，既记住所指的人，也记住这是带贬义的评价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A car: a road vehicle used to carry people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汽车，指在道路上行驶、用于载人的车辆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karozza, jiġifieri vettura li timxi fit-triq u tintuża biex iġġorr in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽车。

formal.mt: Il-paqqa ħamra kienet ipparkjata quddiem id-dar meta wasal is-sid.
formal.en: The red car was parked in front of the house when the owner arrived.
formal.zh: 车主到达时，那辆红色汽车正停在房子前面。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn ħallejt il-paqqa? | Karl: Quddiem id-dar, ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you leave the car? | Karl: In front of the house, beside the tree.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你把车停哪儿了？ | 卡尔：房子前面，那棵树旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把车停哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you leave the car?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 房子前面，那棵树旁边。
messages.en: In front of the house, beside the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给脑中的一辆红色汽车贴上 paqqa 标签，再用“车停在哪里”的问答反复提取这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fender used to cushion contact and protect a boat from damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 护舷，即放在船侧等位置、用于缓冲碰撞并保护船体的防撞物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett protettiv li jitqiegħed mal-ġenb ta' dgħajsa biex itaffi d-daqqiet u jipproteġiha mill-ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 护舷；用于缓冲接触、防止船体受损的防撞物。

formal.mt: Qabel ma rabat id-dgħajsa mal-moll, il-baħri poġġa parabord bejn il-ġenb tad-dgħajsa u l-moll.
formal.en: Before mooring the boat, the sailor placed a fender between its side and the quay.
formal.zh: 将船系泊在码头前，水手在船侧与码头之间放置了一个护舷。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Agħtini l-parabord, jekk jogħġbok. | Rita: Hawn hu. Orbotu ma' dan il-ġenb.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Pass me the fender, please. | Rita: Here it is. Tie it to this side.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：请把护舷递给我。 | 丽塔：给你。把它系在这一侧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (船主)
messages.zh: 请把护舷递给我。
messages.en: Pass me the fender, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hu. Orbotu ma' dan il-ġenb.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hu. Orbotu ma' dan il-ġenb.
messages.zh: 给你。把它系在这一侧。
messages.en: Here it is. Tie it to this side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船靠码头时夹在中间的缓冲垫，把 parabord 与“护住船侧、缓冲碰撞”的画面绑定。

gloss_zh: 框架或镶板的竖梃；竖向框料

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stile: an upright component of a panel or frame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 镶板或框架中竖直设置的构件，例如门框或镶板门的竖向框料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa vertikali li tifforma parti minn pannell jew qafas, bħal fil-binja ta' bieb.

sense_translations.en_definition: stile (vertical component of a panel or frame)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 竖梃；镶板或框架中的竖向构件。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa kejjel il-parant tal-bieb qabel ma qata' l-biċċa l-ġdida tal-injam.
formal.en: The carpenter measured the door stile before cutting the new piece of wood.
formal.zh: 木匠先测量了门的竖梃，再裁切新的木料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema biċċa trid tibdel? | Mark: Il-parant fuq ix-xellug; l-injam maqsum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which piece do you need to replace? | Mark: The stile on the left; the wood is split.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要换哪一块？ | 马克：左边的竖梃，那里的木头裂了。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你要换哪一块？
messages.en: Which piece do you need to replace?

messages.speaker: Mark (木匠)
messages.zh: 左边的竖梃，那里的木头裂了。
messages.en: The stile on the left; the wood is split.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一个门框，把左右两根竖直框料标成 parant；用“竖着的框料”帮助定位词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fishing vessel that catches fish by towing a net through the water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过在水中拖曳渔网来捕捞鱼类的渔船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment tas-sajd li jaqbad il-ħut billi jkaxkar xibka fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖网渔船；通过拖曳渔网捕鱼的船。

formal.mt: Il-paranza daħlet fil-port kmieni filgħodu wara lejl ta' sajd.
formal.en: The trawler entered the harbour early in the morning after a night of fishing.
formal.zh: 这艘拖网渔船在捕捞一夜后，于清晨驶入港口。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dik il-paranza ta' zijuk? Pawlu: Iva, illum ħriġt nistad miegħu fuqha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is that your uncle's trawler? Pawlu: Yes, I went fishing with him on it today.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：那是你叔叔的拖网渔船吗？保罗：是啊，我今天跟他一起坐那艘船出海捕鱼了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是你叔叔的拖网渔船吗？
messages.en: Is that your uncle's trawler?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (渔民的侄子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum ħriġt nistad miegħu fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum ħriġt nistad miegħu fuqha.
messages.zh: 是啊，我今天跟他一起坐那艘船出海捕鱼了。
messages.en: Yes, I went fishing with him on it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paranza 配上一幅船尾拖着大渔网的画面，记住它特指拖网渔船。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak or talk, especially at length or in a chatty way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开口说话或交谈，尤其指长时间地说话、絮叨或闲聊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem jew joqgħod jitkellem fit-tul, speċjalment fuq affarijiet ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话；用口头语言表达意思。
说很多话；长篇大论或说个不停。
闲聊；叽叽喳喳地交谈。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti parla fit-tul dwar l-esperjenza tiegħu.
formal.en: During the meeting, one of the participants talked at length about his experience.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一位与会者长时间讲述了自己的经历。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif għaddiet is-serata ma' Mark? Nina: Parla l-ħin kollu! Bilkemm stajt ngħid kelma.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was your evening with Mark? Nina: He talked the whole time! I could barely get a word in.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你跟马克一起过的那个晚上怎么样？妮娜：他一直说个不停！我几乎插不上一句话。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你跟马克一起过的那个晚上怎么样？
messages.en: How was your evening with Mark?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Parla l-ħin kollu! Bilkemm stajt ngħid kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Parla l-ħin kollu! Bilkemm stajt ngħid kelma.
messages.zh: 他一直说个不停！我几乎插不上一句话。
messages.en: He talked the whole time! I could barely get a word in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友一开口就聊个不停，把 parla 与连续冒出的聊天气泡联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The European Union institution whose elected members represent its citizens in parliamentary work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欧洲联盟的议会机构，其当选议员代表欧盟公民参与议会工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istituzzjoni tal-Unjoni Ewropea li fiha membri eletti jirrappreżentaw liċ-ċittadini fil-ħidma parlamentari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧洲议会，欧洲联盟的议会机构。

collocations.en: a member of the European Parliament

formal.mt: L-artiklu jispjega r-rwol tal-Parlament Ewropew fil-ħidma tal-Unjoni Ewropea.
formal.en: The article explains the role of the European Parliament in the work of the European Union.
formal.zh: 这篇文章解释了欧洲议会在欧盟运作中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fuq xiex inhu dan il-fuljett? Toni: Fuq il-Parlament Ewropew. Jispjega x'jagħmlu l-membri tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lina: What is this leaflet about? Toni: The European Parliament. It explains what its members do.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这本小册子讲什么？托尼：讲欧洲议会，介绍它的议员做些什么。

messages.speaker: Lina (参观者)
messages.zh: 这本小册子讲什么？
messages.en: What is this leaflet about?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-Parlament Ewropew. Jispjega x'jagħmlu l-membri tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-Parlament Ewropew. Jispjega x'jagħmlu l-membri tiegħu.
messages.zh: 讲欧洲议会，介绍它的议员做些什么。
messages.en: The European Parliament. It explains what its members do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Parlament Ewropew 整体记成一个机构名称，想象写着欧洲议会的会场门牌。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system or political principle in which parliament has a central role in government and in holding the executive accountable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以议会在国家治理和监督行政机关方面发挥核心作用为特征的政治制度或政治原则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema jew prinċipju politiku li jagħti lill-parlament rwol ċentrali fit-tmexxija tal-pajjiż u fil-kontroll tal-gvern.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 议会主义；强调议会在政治运作中具有核心地位的制度或理念。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-parlamentariżmu u r-rwol tal-parlament fis-sorveljanza tal-gvern.
formal.en: The study analyses parliamentarianism and parliament's role in overseeing the government.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了议会主义，以及议会在监督政府方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu l-parlamentariżmu? David: Hija sistema fejn il-parlament għandu rwol ċentrali u jżomm lill-gvern responsabbli.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is parliamentarianism? David: It is a system in which parliament has a central role and holds the government accountable.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：什么是议会主义？戴维：就是议会发挥核心作用，并要求政府承担责任的一种制度。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是议会主义？
messages.en: What is parliamentarianism?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija sistema fejn il-parlament għandu rwol ċentrali u jżomm lill-gvern responsabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Hija sistema fejn il-parlament għandu rwol ċentrali u jżomm lill-gvern responsabbli.
messages.zh: 就是议会发挥核心作用，并要求政府承担责任的一种制度。
messages.en: It is a system in which parliament has a central role and holds the government accountable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时把 parlamentariżmu 放在制度概念卡上，配图为议会大厅与政府接受质询的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is a member of a parliament and takes part in its work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于议会并参与其议事、立法或监督工作的成员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li hija membru ta' parlament u tieħu sehem fil-ħidma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 议员；参与议会工作的议会成员。

formal.mt: Il-parlamentarju ressaq mistoqsija dwar il-finanzjament tal-iskejjel.
formal.en: The parliamentarian submitted a question about school funding.
formal.zh: 这名议员就学校经费问题提出了质询。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu dak li qed jitkellem? Mark: Huwa parlamentarju. Qed jitkellem dwar it-trasport pubbliku.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is that person speaking? Mark: He is a parliamentarian. He is talking about public transport.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：正在讲话的那个人是谁？马克：他是一名议员，正在谈公共交通。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jitkellem?
messages.zh: 正在讲话的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that person speaking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa parlamentarju. Qed jitkellem dwar it-trasport pubbliku.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa parlamentarju. Qed jitkellem dwar it-trasport pubbliku.
messages.zh: 他是一名议员，正在谈公共交通。
messages.en: He is a parliamentarian. He is talking about public transport.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 parlamentarju 想成议会座位上举手发言的那个人，本词条记的是议员这一人物身份。

gloss_zh: 近似说白的；近乎口语念唱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing an operatic passage in which the singing is delivered almost as speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容歌剧中的某个段落，其演唱方式接近说话或说白。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi silta f'opra li titkanta b'mod li joqrob ħafna lejn it-taħdit.

sense_translations.en_definition: spoken - used of a part in a musical opera where the song is nearly spoken
sense_translations.zh_definition: 近似说白的；用于形容歌剧中唱得几乎像在说话的段落。

collocations.zh: 一段近似说白的歌剧唱段

formal.mt: F'dan il-passaġġ parlant tal-opra, il-kant joqrob lejn it-taħdit u jagħti enfasi lill-kliem.
formal.en: In this almost-spoken passage of the opera, the singing approaches speech and gives emphasis to the words.
formal.zh: 在歌剧这段近似说白的唱段中，演唱接近说话，使歌词得到突出。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Hawn il-kantant qisu qed jitkellem, hux? Luqa: Iva, dan hu passaġġ parlant. Il-kant kważi jsir taħdit.
colloquial.en: Marija: The singer sounds as though he is speaking here, doesn't he? Luqa: Yes, this is an almost-spoken passage. The singing nearly becomes speech.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这里歌手听起来像在说话，对吧？卢卡：对，这是一段近似说白的唱段，唱得几乎像说话。

messages.speaker: Marija (声乐学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn il-kantant qisu qed jitkellem, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn il-kantant qisu qed jitkellem, hux?
messages.zh: 这里歌手听起来像在说话，对吧？
messages.en: The singer sounds as though he is speaking here, doesn't he?

messages.speaker: Luqa (声乐教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan hu passaġġ parlant. Il-kant kważi jsir taħdit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan hu passaġġ parlant. Il-kant kważi jsir taħdit.
messages.zh: 对，这是一段近似说白的唱段，唱得几乎像说话。
messages.en: Yes, this is an almost-spoken passage. The singing nearly becomes speech.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象歌剧演员仍在唱，却像在台上讲话；用这个声音画面记住 parlant 的说白感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A conversation that continues for a long time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续较长时间的一次交谈或闲聊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konversazzjoni jew taħdita li ddum ħafna ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次长谈；持续很久的交谈。

formal.mt: Wara parlata twila mal-ġenituri, l-għalliem fehem aħjar il-ħtiġijiet tat-tifel.
formal.en: After a lengthy conversation with the parents, the teacher understood the boy's needs better.
formal.zh: 与家长长谈后，老师更加了解了这个男孩的需要。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex domtu daqshekk? Ġanni: Għamilna parlata twila ma' Vera. Kellna ħafna x'nirrakkontaw!
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you take so long? Ġanni: We had a long conversation with Vera. We had so much to tell each other!
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你们怎么去了这么久？詹尼：我们跟薇拉聊了很久，彼此都有好多事要讲！

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们怎么去了这么久？
messages.en: Why did you take so long?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilna parlata twila ma' Vera. Kellna ħafna x'nirrakkontaw!
messages.mt_standard: Għamilna parlata twila ma' Vera. Kellna ħafna x'nirrakkontaw!
messages.zh: 我们跟薇拉聊了很久，彼此都有好多事要讲！
messages.en: We had a long conversation with Vera. We had so much to tell each other!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人从一杯热茶聊到茶凉，把整场长时间交谈当作一次 parlata 来记。

gloss_zh: 探访时段；会客室；医院或惩教机构的探视时间

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period set aside for visits, especially in a hospital or correctional facility; also a parlour where visitors are received.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门安排接待探访的时段，尤指医院或惩教机构的探视时间；也可指接待访客的会客室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħin stabbilit għaż-żjarat, speċjalment fi sptar jew ħabs; ukoll kamra fejn jintlaqgħu l-viżitaturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 探访时段；允许访客前来探访的规定时间。
会客室；用于接待访客和交谈的房间。

sense_translations.en_definition: visiting time in a hospital or correctional facility
sense_translations.zh_definition: 医院或惩教机构规定的探视时间。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi tal-kunvent jintalbu jistennew fil-parlatorju sakemm tasal il-persuna li ġew jaraw.
formal.en: Visitors to the convent are asked to wait in the parlour until the person they have come to see arrives.
formal.zh: 前往修道院的访客请在会客室等候，直到他们要拜访的人到来。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Meta jibda l-parlatorju fl-isptar? Pawlu: Fit-tlieta. Immorru naraw lin-nanna dak il-ħin.
colloquial.en: Elena: When do visiting hours start at the hospital? Pawlu: At three. Let's go and see Grandma then.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：医院的探视时间几点开始？保罗：三点，我们到时候去看奶奶吧。

messages.speaker: Elena (病人的孙女)
messages.zh: 医院的探视时间几点开始？
messages.en: When do visiting hours start at the hospital?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (病人的孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-tlieta. Immorru naraw lin-nanna dak il-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-tlieta. Immorru naraw lin-nanna dak il-ħin.
messages.zh: 三点，我们到时候去看奶奶吧。
messages.en: At three. Let's go and see Grandma then.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用会客室门口的一张探访时间表作记忆图：房间提示会客室，时间表提示规定的探视时段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Casual or excessive talk, often with little serious substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意的闲聊或说个不停、缺少实质内容的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskors ħafif jew żejjed, ħafna drabi mingħajr wisq sustanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叽叽喳喳的交谈；闲聊。
絮絮叨叨地说个不停，通常内容琐碎。
轻松随意的闲谈；寒暄。

collocations.zh: 空话；没有实质内容的话

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, għandna niffukaw fuq proposti konkreti u nevitaw il-paroli fil-vojt.
formal.en: During the meeting, we should focus on concrete proposals and avoid empty talk.
formal.zh: 会议期间，我们应专注于具体建议，避免空谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għadda l-ħin daqshekk malajr? Lara: Bil-paroli! Ilna siegħa nitkellmu fuq il-vaganzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the time pass so quickly? Lara: All that chatting! We've been talking about holidays for an hour.
colloquial.zh: Maja：时间怎么过得这么快？Lara：都顾着闲聊了！我们已经聊了一个小时的假期。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 时间怎么过得这么快？
messages.en: How did the time pass so quickly?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-paroli! Ilna siegħa nitkellmu fuq il-vaganzi.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-paroli! Ilna siegħa nitkellmu fuq il-vaganzi.
messages.zh: 都顾着闲聊了！我们已经聊了一个小时的假期。
messages.en: All that chatting! We've been talking about holidays for an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paroli 与“聊着聊着时间就没了”的场景绑定；ħafna paroli 是很多闲话，paroli fil-vojt 则强调空谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange or place material in layers, one above another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将材料一层一层地铺放或排列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed materjal f'saffi, wieħed fuq l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西分层放置；一层层铺放。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem parpan id-drapp fuq il-mejda qabel ma beda jaqta'.
formal.en: The worker laid the fabric in layers on the table before starting to cut.
formal.zh: 工人在开始裁剪前，把布料一层层铺在桌上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex id-drapp qiegħed saff fuq saff? Mark: Pawlu parpan id-drapp biex ikun lest għall-qtugħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the fabric laid out layer upon layer? Mark: Pawlu layered the fabric so it would be ready for cutting.
colloquial.zh: Lara：布料为什么一层层铺着？Mark：Pawlu 把布料分层铺好了，准备裁剪。

messages.speaker: Lara (裁缝学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-drapp qiegħed saff fuq saff?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-drapp qiegħed saff fuq saff?
messages.zh: 布料为什么一层层铺着？
messages.en: Why is the fabric laid out layer upon layer?

messages.speaker: Mark (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu parpan id-drapp biex ikun lest għall-qtugħ.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu parpan id-drapp biex ikun lest għall-qtugħ.
messages.zh: Pawlu 把布料分层铺好了，准备裁剪。
messages.en: Pawlu layered the fabric so it would be ready for cutting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 parpan 时想象桌上的布一层盖一层；用 saff fuq saff“层层叠放”的画面固定这个动作义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something floppy or flabby so that it loses firmness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物失去挺度或紧实感，变得软塌、松软。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa ratba u mitluqa, hekk li titlef is-sodizza tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sth. floppy or flabby
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得软塌或松软，失去原有的挺度或紧实感。

formal.mt: L-ilma partax il-kartun, li tilef is-sodizza tiegħu u ma baqax adattat għall-imballaġġ.
formal.en: The water made the cardboard floppy; it lost its firmness and was no longer suitable for packaging.
formal.zh: 水使硬纸板变得软塌，失去挺度，不再适合用作包装。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex din il-kaxxa m'għadhiex soda? Mark: L-ilma partax il-kartun. Aħjar nużaw kaxxa oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this box no longer firm? Mark: The water made the cardboard floppy. We'd better use another box.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个箱子怎么不结实了？Mark：水把纸板弄软塌了。我们最好换一个箱子。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 这个箱子怎么不结实了？
messages.en: Why is this box no longer firm?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma partax il-kartun. Aħjar nużaw kaxxa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma partax il-kartun. Aħjar nużaw kaxxa oħra.
messages.zh: 水把纸板弄软塌了。我们最好换一个箱子。
messages.en: The water made the cardboard floppy. We'd better use another box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 partax 记成“让原本挺的东西塌下来”：想象硬纸板遇水后软塌，重点是造成这种变化的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distinctive feature or detail that makes something different from other things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物区别于其他事物的独特特征或细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karatteristika jew dettall li jiddistingwi xi ħaġa minn oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 特殊性；某物独有或值得注意的特征、细节。

collocations.en: a distinctive feature of the building

formal.mt: Partikularità ta' dan il-bini hija t-tieqa tonda fuq id-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: A distinctive feature of this building is the round window above the main entrance.
formal.zh: 这座建筑的一个独特之处，是主入口上方的圆窗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandu speċjali dan l-arloġġ? Pawlu: Għandu partikularità interessanti: juri wkoll il-fażijiet tal-qamar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's special about this clock? Pawlu: It has an interesting feature: it also shows the phases of the moon.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个钟有什么特别的？Pawlu：它有个有趣的特点：还能显示月相。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这个钟有什么特别的？
messages.en: What's special about this clock?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu partikularità interessanti: juri wkoll il-fażijiet tal-qamar.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu partikularità interessanti: juri wkoll il-fażijiet tal-qamar.
messages.zh: 它有个有趣的特点：还能显示月相。
messages.en: It has an interesting feature: it also shows the phases of the moon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 partikularità，就问“它有什么特别之处？”再想象圆窗或显示月相的钟，把这个名词记成可指出的独特特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Especially, or to a greater degree than usual or than other things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尤其；表示某事物比其他事物更突出，或某种程度格外明显。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod speċjali, jew fi grad akbar mis-soltu jew minn affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尤其；特别地；格外。

formal.mt: Din il-gwida hija partikularment utli għal studenti li għadhom kemm bdew jitgħallmu l-Malti.
formal.en: This guide is particularly useful for students who have just started learning Maltese.
formal.zh: 这份指南对刚开始学习马耳他语的学生特别有用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien il-kunċert? Maja: Għoġobni ħafna, partikularment l-aħħar kanzunetta.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the concert? Maja: I really enjoyed it, particularly the last song.
colloquial.zh: Lara：音乐会怎么样？Maja：我很喜欢，尤其是最后一首歌。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the concert?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我很喜欢，尤其是最后一首歌。
messages.en: I really enjoyed it, particularly the last song.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 partikularment 想成聚光灯：“都喜欢，尤其最后一首。”它把后面的内容特别照亮，也能加强“重要、有用”等程度。

gloss_zh: 党派支持者；支持某一方的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who strongly supports a particular political party, group, or cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚定支持某个政党、团体或事业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja bis-saħħa partit politiku, grupp jew kawża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚定支持某个政党、阵营或事业的人；党派支持者。
支持某个政党或阵营的；带有党派立场的。

formal.mt: Għalkemm kien partiġjan leali, fir-rapport tiegħu ppreżenta wkoll l-argumenti tal-avversarji.
formal.en: Although he was a loyal partisan, he also presented his opponents' arguments in his report.
formal.zh: 尽管他是一名忠诚的党派支持者，他仍在报告中呈现了对方的论点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu dejjem jiddefendi l-istess partit. Mark: Iva, huwa partiġjan leali, imma kultant jikkritikah ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu always defends the same party. Mark: Yes, he's a loyal partisan, but he sometimes criticizes it too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 总是维护同一个政党。Mark：是啊，他是个忠诚的支持者，不过有时也会批评这个党。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 总是维护同一个政党。
messages.en: Pawlu always defends the same party.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa partiġjan leali, imma kultant jikkritikah ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa partiġjan leali, imma kultant jikkritikah ukoll.
messages.zh: 是啊，他是个忠诚的支持者，不过有时也会批评这个党。
messages.en: Yes, he's a loyal partisan, but he sometimes criticizes it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“站在哪一边”来记：作名词是站队的人，作形容词则修饰带有阵营立场的讲话或行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong allegiance to one political party or side, especially when it leads to biased judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某一政党或阵营的强烈拥护，尤其指由此产生的偏向或不公正判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta qawwija ma' partit jew naħa waħda, speċjalment meta twassal għal ġudizzju preġudikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某一党派或阵营的偏向；党派之见。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu jevalwa kull proposta fuq il-mertu tagħha, mingħajr partiġjanerija.
formal.en: The committee should evaluate each proposal on its merits, without partisanship.
formal.zh: 委员会应根据每项提案本身的优劣作出评估，不带党派偏见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistgħux naqblu fuq din il-proposta? Mark: Hemm wisq partiġjanerija. Ejja nħarsu lejn il-fatti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we agree on this proposal? Mark: There's too much partisanship. Let's look at the facts.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们为什么无法就这项提案达成一致？Mark：党派之见太重了。我们来看看事实吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux naqblu fuq din il-proposta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux naqblu fuq din il-proposta?
messages.zh: 我们为什么无法就这项提案达成一致？
messages.en: Why can't we agree on this proposal?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm wisq partiġjanerija. Ejja nħarsu lejn il-fatti.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm wisq partiġjanerija. Ejja nħarsu lejn il-fatti.
messages.zh: 党派之见太重了。我们来看看事实吧。
messages.en: There's too much partisanship. Let's look at the facts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它与 partiġjan 配对记：partiġjan 指支持某一方的人，partiġjanerija 指这种党派偏向本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Favoring one person or side in a way that prevents fair judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偏向某个人或某一方，因而无法公正判断的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiffavorixxi persuna jew naħa waħda b'mod li jfixkel ġudizzju ġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏袒某一方的；带有偏见而不公正的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iwissi li ġudizzju parzjali jista' jwassal għal deċiżjonijiet inġusti.
formal.en: The report warns that biased judgment can lead to unfair decisions.
formal.zh: 报告警告说，带有偏见的判断可能导致不公正的决定。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taħseb li l-arbitru kien parzjali? Pawlu: Forsi, imma ejja nerġgħu naraw l-azzjoni qabel niġġudikaw.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you think the referee was biased? Pawlu: Maybe, but let's watch the play again before we judge.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你觉得裁判偏袒一方了吗？Pawlu：也许吧，不过我们先再看一遍那个回合，然后再作判断。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.zh: 你觉得裁判偏袒一方了吗？
messages.en: Do you think the referee was biased?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi, imma ejja nerġgħu naraw l-azzjoni qabel niġġudikaw.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi, imma ejja nerġgħu naraw l-azzjoni qabel niġġudikaw.
messages.zh: 也许吧，不过我们先再看一遍那个回合，然后再作判断。
messages.en: Maybe, but let's watch the play again before we judge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“裁判的天平偏向一边”记 parzjali：这里强调偏袒和不公正，搭配 ġudizzju 时就是带偏见的判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unfair preference for one person or side that affects a judgment or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作判断或决定时对某个人或某一方有所偏袒的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tendenza li wieħed jiffavorixxi persuna jew naħa b'mod li jaffettwa l-ġudizzju jew id-deċiżjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏袒；偏见；对某个人或某一方的不公正倾向。

collocations.en: bias in favour of a candidate

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu jevalwa kull applikazzjoni mingħajr parzjalità.
formal.en: The committee should assess every application without bias.
formal.zh: 委员会应当不带偏见地评估每一份申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dejjem tagħżel lil ħuk? Mark: Għandek raġun, qed nuri parzjalità. Din id-darba nagħżlu bil-polza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you always choose your brother? Mark: You're right, I'm showing partiality. This time we'll draw lots.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么总是选你弟弟？马克：你说得对，我是在偏袒他。这次我们抽签决定。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么总是选你弟弟？
messages.en: Why do you always choose your brother?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, qed nuri parzjalità. Din id-darba nagħżlu bil-polza.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, qed nuri parzjalità. Din id-darba nagħżlu bil-polza.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我是在偏袒他。这次我们抽签决定。
messages.en: You're right, I'm showing partiality. This time we'll draw lots.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象评委的天平总向熟人倾斜，把这个词与“判断偏向一边”的画面一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 临场行事；编造；编造者；散布假话者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act without a prepared plan, or to invent something to say instead of relying on known facts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有预先计划而临场行事，或不依据已知事实而临时编造说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaġixxi mingħajr pjan imħejji, jew jivvinta dak li jgħid minflok ma jibbaża ruħu fuq fatti magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 临场行事；没有预先准备而随机应变。
编造事情或说法；凭空捏造。
编造事情的人；爱凭空编故事的人。
散布假话的人；传播不实说法的人。

collocations.en: I will act on the fly

formal.mt: Meta ma kellux l-informazzjoni meħtieġa, il-kelliem paspar tweġiba.
formal.en: When he did not have the necessary information, the speaker invented an answer.
formal.zh: 发言者没有所需的信息，于是临时编了一个答案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek pjan għal-logħba? Pawlu: M'għandix pjan; se npaspar skont is-sitwazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a plan for the game? Pawlu: I don't have a plan; I'll act on the fly as things develop.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这场游戏你有计划吗？保罗：没有计划，我会看情况临场应变。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这场游戏你有计划吗？
messages.en: Do you have a plan for the game?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: M'għandix pjan; se npaspar skont is-sitwazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: M'għandix pjan; se npaspar skont is-sitwazzjoni.
messages.zh: 没有计划，我会看情况临场应变。
messages.en: I don't have a plan; I'll act on the fly as things develop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：没计划就现场发挥，没事实却现场编造；作名词时则指编造或散布假话的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to invent stories or claims rather than stick to the facts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人倾向于编造故事或说法，而不是忠于事实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jivvinta stejjer jew affarijiet minflok ma jżomm mal-fatti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱编造事情的；有胡编乱造倾向的。

collocations.en: a person who tends to make things up
a speaker inclined to make things up
collocations.zh: 一个惯于胡编的发言者

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala bniedem paspari li spiss jivvinta stejjer dwar il-vjaġġi tiegħu.
formal.en: The author describes the character as someone who tends to make things up and often invents stories about his travels.
formal.zh: 作者将这个人物描写成一个爱编造的人，经常虚构自己的旅行经历。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Temmnu dak li qal Toni? Mark: Mhux kollox; Toni paspari u kultant jivvinta d-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you believe what Toni said? Mark: Not all of it; Toni tends to make things up and sometimes invents the details.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你相信托尼说的话吗？马克：不全信；托尼爱编造，有时会把细节编出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你相信托尼说的话吗？
messages.en: Do you believe what Toni said?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux kollox; Toni paspari u kultant jivvinta d-dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux kollox; Toni paspari u kultant jivvinta d-dettalji.
messages.zh: 不全信；托尼爱编造，有时会把细节编出来。
messages.en: Not all of it; Toni tends to make things up and sometimes invents the details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在“讲故事总添上虚构细节的人”身上，记住它描述的是爱编造的倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single movement of the foot when walking, or one stage in a sequence of actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时脚迈出的一步，也可指一连串行动中的一个步骤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment wieħed tas-sieq waqt il-mixi, jew stadju wieħed f'sensiela ta' azzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一步；步子；行动过程中的一个步骤。

formal.mt: L-ewwel pass fl-attività huwa li taqra l-istruzzjonijiet bir-reqqa.
formal.en: The first step in the activity is to read the instructions carefully.
formal.zh: 这项活动的第一步是仔细阅读说明。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nersaq aktar lejn il-kamera? Luqa: Iva, agħmel pass 'il quddiem u ibqa' hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Should I move closer to the camera? Luqa: Yes, take a step forward and stay there.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我要再靠近相机一点吗？卢卡：对，向前迈一步，然后站在那里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要再靠近相机一点吗？
messages.en: Should I move closer to the camera?

messages.speaker: Luqa (拍照的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħmel pass 'il quddiem u ibqa' hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħmel pass 'il quddiem u ibqa' hemm.
messages.zh: 对，向前迈一步，然后站在那里。
messages.en: Yes, take a step forward and stay there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象脚迈出一步，再想象任务清单推进一步，用同一个“步”连接身体动作和办事步骤。

gloss_zh: 疫病流行；感冒等传染流行；鸟类迁徙

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outbreak or spread of an infectious illness, especially flu or a cold; also the migration of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 传染性疾病的流行或传播，尤其指流感或感冒的流行；也指鸟类迁徙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixrid ta' marda li tittieħed, speċjalment influwenza jew riħ; tfisser ukoll il-migrazzjoni tal-għasafar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疫病的流行；某种疾病在一群人中集中传播的情况。

sense_translations.en_definition: contagion (especially of flu or the common cold)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 传染或传染性疾病的流行，尤其指流感或普通感冒。
鸟类迁徙；候鸟的季节性迁飞。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-iskola jsemmi passa ta' riħ fost l-istudenti matul ix-xahar li għadda.
formal.en: The school report mentions a cold going around among the students during the previous month.
formal.zh: 学校报告提到，上个月学生中出现了一阵感冒流行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hawn daqshekk għasafar illum? Pawlu: Bħalissa għaddejja l-passa tal-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there so many birds here today? Pawlu: The bird migration is taking place at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天这里为什么有这么多鸟？保罗：现在正值鸟类迁徙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天这里为什么有这么多鸟？
messages.en: Why are there so many birds here today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟的朋友)
messages.zh: 现在正值鸟类迁徙。
messages.en: The bird migration is taking place at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别记住两幅场景：班里一阵感冒流行，天空一群候鸟迁飞；靠疾病或鸟类的上下文选择词义。

gloss_zh: 尚可的；过得去的；质量一般但可接受的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Good enough to be acceptable, although not particularly good or excellent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 达到可以接受的程度，但不算特别好或出色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jilħaq livell aċċettabbli, għalkemm mhuwiex tajjeb ħafna jew eċċellenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尚可的；还不错的；达到可接受水平的。
质量一般但过得去的；品质尚可的。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat huwa passabbli, iżda hemm lok għal titjib fil-preċiżjoni u fil-preżentazzjoni.
formal.en: The result is passable, but there is room for improvement in accuracy and presentation.
formal.zh: 结果尚可，但准确性和呈现方式仍有改进空间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien l-ikel? Mark: Passabbli, imma ma kien xejn speċjali.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the food? Mark: Decent, but it was nothing special.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：饭菜怎么样？马克：还过得去，不过没什么特别的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 饭菜怎么样？
messages.en: How was the food?

messages.speaker: Mark (用餐的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Passabbli, imma ma kien xejn speċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Passabbli, imma ma kien xejn speċjali.
messages.zh: 还过得去，不过没什么特别的。
messages.en: Decent, but it was nothing special.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象评价表上的指针停在“可以接受”一格，用“过得去、尚可”的中等评价记住这个词。

gloss_zh: 迁徙的；候鸟类的（用于鸟）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a bird that moves seasonally from one region to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容鸟具有随季节从一个地区迁往另一个地区的习性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħad għal għasfur li jemigra minn reġjun għal ieħor skont l-istaġun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迁徙的、属于候鸟的；用于描述随季节迁飞的鸟。

formal.mt: Dan l-għasfur passajr jidher fil-gżira waqt il-migrazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: This migratory bird appears on the island during its migration.
formal.zh: 这种候鸟在迁徙途中会出现在岛上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak għasfur passajr? Luqa: Iva, jgħaddi minn hawn waqt il-migrazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is that a migratory bird? Luqa: Yes, it passes through here during migration.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那是候鸟吗？卢卡：是的，它迁徙时会经过这里。

messages.speaker: Nina (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 那是候鸟吗？
messages.en: Is that a migratory bird?

messages.speaker: Luqa (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jgħaddi minn hawn waqt il-migrazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jgħaddi minn hawn waqt il-migrazzjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，它迁徙时会经过这里。
messages.en: Yes, it passes through here during migration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和 għasfur 一起记成“会迁徙的鸟”，画面是鸟随季节迁飞；这个词在搭配中负责描述鸟的习性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation used to shoo something away, for example an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来驱赶某个东西、让其离开的感叹语，例如驱赶动物时说的“去去！”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajta biex tkeċċi xi ħaġa minn fejn tkun, pereżempju annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: expression used to shoo sth. away
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于驱赶某物的感叹语，相当于“走开！”或“去去！”。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġardinar jgħajjat 'Passalà!' biex ikeċċi l-għasfur minn fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: In the story, the gardener shouts 'Shoo!' to drive the bird off the table.
formal.zh: 故事中，园丁喊了一声“去去！”，把鸟从桌上赶走。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-qattus reġa' tela' fuq il-mejda. Maja: Passalà! Inżel minn hemm!
colloquial.en: Sara: The cat has climbed onto the table again. Maja: Shoo! Get down from there!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：猫又爬上桌子了。玛雅：去去！从那里下来！

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 猫又爬上桌子了。
messages.en: The cat has climbed onto the table again.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 去去！从那里下来！
messages.en: Shoo! Get down from there!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一边挥手一边把桌上的小鸟赶开，将整声 passalà 和中文“去去！”的动作、语气一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 逐人口传的消息或指令

teaching_sense.en_definition: An order or message passed orally from one person to the next.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由一个人口头转告下一个人，依次传递的指令或消息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ordni jew messaġġ li jgħaddi bil-fomm minn persuna għal oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: order or message passed by word of mouth from one person to another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由人逐一口头传递的指令或消息。

collocations.en: pass the message on by word of mouth

formal.mt: Il-passaparoli għadda minn grupp għal ieħor: kulħadd kellu jinġabar fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The message passed by word of mouth from one group to another: everyone was to gather in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 消息由一组人口头传给另一组人：所有人都要到院子里集合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaddi l-passaparoli: niltaqgħu ħdejn il-bieb. Mark: Tajjeb, ngħid lil dawk ta' warajja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pass the message on: we're meeting by the door. Mark: Okay, I'll tell the people behind me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：把消息传下去：我们在门边集合。Mark：好，我告诉我后面的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 把消息传下去：我们在门边集合。
messages.en: Pass the message on: we're meeting by the door.

messages.speaker: Mark (参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ngħid lil dawk ta' warajja.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ngħid lil dawk ta' warajja.
messages.zh: 好，我告诉我后面的人。
messages.en: Okay, I'll tell the people behind me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排人把集合指令逐个耳语传下去，用这幅画面记住“逐人口传的消息”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Steel wire used for the strings of a piano.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于制作钢琴琴弦的钢丝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wajer tal-azzar li jintuża għall-kordi tal-pjanu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钢琴琴弦所用的钢丝；琴钢丝。

formal.mt: It-tekniku uża biċċa passaperla biex jagħmel korda ġdida għall-pjanu.
formal.en: The technician used a piece of piano wire to make a new string for the piano.
formal.zh: 技术员用一段琴钢丝为钢琴制作了一根新琴弦。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal xiex se tuża dik il-passaperla? Pawlu: Biex nagħmel korda ġdida għall-pjanu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you going to use that piano wire for? Pawlu: To make a new string for the piano.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你准备用那段琴钢丝做什么？Pawlu：给钢琴做一根新琴弦。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex se tuża dik il-passaperla?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex se tuża dik il-passaperla?
messages.zh: 你准备用那段琴钢丝做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to use that piano wire for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (钢琴维修师)
messages.zh: 给钢琴做一根新琴弦。
messages.en: To make a new string for the piano.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和打开钢琴后看见的细长金属琴弦联系起来，记作“钢琴专用钢丝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official document identifying a person for travel between countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供跨国旅行使用、证明持有人身份的官方证件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jidentifika persuna meta tivvjaġġa minn pajjiż għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 护照；用于国际旅行的官方身份证件。

formal.mt: Qabel il-vjaġġ, il-passiġġier iċċekkja d-data ta' skadenza tal-passaport tiegħu.
formal.en: Before the journey, the passenger checked the expiry date of his passport.
formal.zh: 出行前，这位旅客检查了自己护照的有效期。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek il-passaport miegħek? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fil-but ta' ġewwa tal-basket.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have your passport with you? Mark: Yes, it's in the inside pocket of the bag.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你带护照了吗？Mark：带了，在包的内袋里。

messages.speaker: Anna (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 你带护照了吗？
messages.en: Do you have your passport with you?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-but ta' ġewwa tal-basket.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-but ta' ġewwa tal-basket.
messages.zh: 带了，在包的内袋里。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the inside pocket of the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借助英语 passport 的相似拼写记忆，再联想机场取出护照的动作，固定“护照”这一义项。

gloss_zh: 步行通道；时装秀伸展台；登船跳板

teaching_sense.en_definition: A walkway or platform used for walking, displaying clothes, or boarding a boat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人行走的通道或平台，可指步行通道、时装秀伸展台或登船跳板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passaġġ jew pjattaforma għall-mixi, għall-wiri tal-ħwejjeġ jew biex wieħed jitla' fuq dgħajsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 步行通道；供人通行的走道。
时装秀中供模特走秀的伸展台。
连接船只与岸边、供人上下船的跳板。

formal.mt: Waqt l-isfilata tal-moda, il-mudelli mxew fuq il-passarella biex juru l-kollezzjoni l-ġdida.
formal.en: During the fashion show, the models walked along the catwalk to display the new collection.
formal.zh: 时装秀期间，模特走上伸展台，展示新系列服装。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn nitilgħu fuq id-dgħajsa? Toni: Minn dik il-passarella ħdejn il-kaptan.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do we board the boat? Toni: By that gangplank next to the captain.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们从哪里上船？Toni：从船长旁边的那块跳板上去。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 我们从哪里上船？
messages.en: Where do we board the boat?

messages.speaker: Toni (船员)
messages.zh: 从船长旁边的那块跳板上去。
messages.en: By that gangplank next to the captain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三种场景串起来：行人走通道、模特走伸展台、游客走跳板；共同画面都是供人走过的平台。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Belonging to a time before the present; already gone by.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于现在之前的时间的；已经过去的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għal żmien qabel il-preżent jew li diġà għadda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过去的；已经过去的。
过去；已经流逝的时间或往昔。

formal.mt: Ix-xahar passat, il-mużew fetaħ wirja dwar il-passat tal-belt.
formal.en: Last month, the museum opened an exhibition about the city's past.
formal.zh: 上个月，博物馆举办了一场关于这座城市往昔的展览。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta mort Għawdex? Mark: Ix-xahar passat. Kienet vaganza sabiħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: When did you go to Gozo? Mark: Last month. It was a lovely holiday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你什么时候去戈佐岛的？Mark：上个月。那次假期很愉快。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候去戈佐岛的？
messages.en: When did you go to Gozo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 上个月。那次假期很愉快。
messages.en: Last month. It was a lovely holiday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个短语分清词性：ix-xahar passat 是“上个月”，fil-passat 是“在过去”；前者修饰月份，后者指过去的时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coat of paint, or a light application of paint to freshen a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在表面的一层油漆，也可指为使表面焕新而简单刷上的漆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saff żebgħa fuq wiċċ, jew applikazzjoni ħafifa taż-żebgħa biex il-wiċċ jidher aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂在物体表面的一层油漆。
为使外观焕新而简单刷上的一层漆；稍作粉刷。

collocations.en: give the wall a coat of paint

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, il-ħaddiem ta passata żebgħa lill-bieb u ħallieh jinxef.
formal.en: After cleaning it, the worker gave the door a coat of paint and left it to dry.
formal.zh: 清洁后，工人给门刷了一层漆，并让它晾干。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-ħajt jidher maħmuġ. Pawlu: Nagħtuh passata żebgħa u jerġa' jidher sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: This wall looks dirty. Pawlu: Let's give it a lick of paint and it'll look nice again.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这面墙看起来脏了。Pawlu：我们给它简单刷层漆，就会重新好看起来。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.zh: 这面墙看起来脏了。
messages.en: This wall looks dirty.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħtuh passata żebgħa u jerġa' jidher sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħtuh passata żebgħa u jerġa' jidher sabiħ.
messages.zh: 我们给它简单刷层漆，就会重新好看起来。
messages.en: Let's give it a lick of paint and it'll look nice again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刷子在旧墙上刷出一层新颜色，把 passata 和 żebgħa 一起记成“一层漆、简单刷漆”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An activity done for enjoyment in one's free time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空闲时间为获得乐趣而进行的活动；消遣或业余爱好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività li wieħed jagħmel fil-ħin liberu għall-gost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消遣；空闲时用来娱乐或打发时间的活动。
业余爱好；在闲暇时间出于兴趣而从事的活动。

formal.mt: Il-qari huwa passatemp li jista' jagħti gost u jkabbar l-għarfien.
formal.en: Reading is a pastime that can provide enjoyment and increase knowledge.
formal.zh: 阅读是一种既能带来乐趣、又能增长知识的消遣。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek xi passatemp ġdid? Toni: Iva, bdejt nieħu r-ritratti fil-ħin liberu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you got a new hobby? Toni: Yes, I've started taking photos in my free time.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你有新的业余爱好吗？Toni：有，我开始在空闲时拍照了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有新的业余爱好吗？
messages.en: Have you got a new hobby?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bdejt nieħu r-ritratti fil-ħin liberu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bdejt nieħu r-ritratti fil-ħin liberu.
messages.zh: 有，我开始在空闲时拍照了。
messages.en: Yes, I've started taking photos in my free time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把读书、拍照、园艺放进同一个“闲暇兴趣盒”，用这些具体活动记住“消遣、业余爱好”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pretend to be another person or claim a false identity in order to deceive others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为欺骗他人而假扮成另一个人，或冒用不属于自己的身份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ta' persuna oħra jew jieħu identità falza biex iqarraq b'ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pretend to be sb. else
sense_translations.zh_definition: 假扮成别人；冒充他人。
充当冒名者；以虚假身份欺骗他人。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel pastar bħala uffiċjal biex jikseb informazzjoni privata mingħand ir-residenti.
formal.en: The man posed as an official to obtain private information from the residents.
formal.zh: 这名男子冒充官员，企图从居民那里获取私人信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-raġel kien tassew tabib? Mark: Le, pastar bħala tabib biex iqarraq bin-nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was that man really a doctor? Mark: No, he posed as a doctor to deceive people.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个男人真的是医生吗？Mark：不是，他冒充医生骗人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人真的是医生吗？
messages.en: Was that man really a doctor?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, pastar bħala tabib biex iqarraq bin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Le, pastar bħala tabib biex iqarraq bin-nies.
messages.zh: 不是，他冒充医生骗人。
messages.en: No, he posed as a doctor to deceive people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人戴着写有别人的姓名和职业的假胸牌，用“假身份骗人”的画面记住“冒充、当冒名者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vegetable with a compact, usually white head, eaten raw or cooked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花椰菜，具有紧密、通常为白色的花球，可生吃或烹调食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa b'ras magħquda, ġeneralment bajda, li tittiekel nejja jew imsajra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花椰菜；菜花。

formal.mt: Aqta' l-pastard f'biċċiet żgħar u sajru fl-ilma sakemm jirtab.
formal.en: Cut the cauliflower into small pieces and cook it in water until tender.
formal.zh: 将花椰菜切成小块，放入水中煮至变软。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi trid nieklu llejla? Pawlu: Għandna pastard; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa bih.
colloquial.en: Marta: What would you like us to eat tonight? Pawlu: We have cauliflower; we can make soup with it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：今晚你想吃什么？保罗：我们有花椰菜，可以用它做汤。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 今晚你想吃什么？
messages.en: What would you like us to eat tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna pastard; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa bih.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna pastard; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa bih.
messages.zh: 我们有花椰菜，可以用它做汤。
messages.en: We have cauliflower; we can make soup with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pastard 和一颗白色花球的画面绑定，再用“水煮花椰菜”和“花椰菜汤”两个搭配巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 举止粗鲁；说话粗俗；粗鲁者；走卒；承顶梁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave rudely or speak in a vulgar way; also, to act as someone's lackey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得粗鲁无礼，或以粗俗的方式说话；也可指充当某人的走卒或听差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu bla rispett jew jitkellem b'mod vulgari; jista' wkoll jagħmilha ta' qaddej ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止粗鲁；表现得无礼。

sense_translations.en_definition: to speak in a vulgar manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话粗俗；用粗鄙的言语表达。
充当某人的走卒或听差，带贬义。
粗鲁无礼的人。
举止欠教养、没有礼貌的人。
言行粗俗的人。
走卒；听差；替他人唯命是从地办事的人，带贬义。

sense_translations.en_definition: a beam that supports part of a ceiling (a term used in stone masonry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 支撑部分顶棚的梁，属于石砌建筑术语。

collocations.en: he behaved rudely towards the guests
collocations.zh: 他对客人表现得很无礼

collocations.en: he spoke in a vulgar manner

formal.mt: Matul id-diskussjoni, ir-raġel pastaż mal-parteċipanti u l-president tal-laqgħa talbu jitkellem b'rispett.
formal.en: During the discussion, the man behaved rudely towards the participants, and the chair asked him to speak respectfully.
formal.zh: 讨论期间，那名男子对与会者言行无礼，会议主席要求他尊重他人、礼貌发言。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex telaq il-klijent? Mark: Għax l-impjegat pastaż miegħu; issa rridu nitolbuh skuża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the customer leave? Mark: Because the employee was rude to him; now we need to apologize to him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：顾客为什么走了？马克：因为那名员工对他很无礼；现在我们得向他道歉。

messages.speaker: Lara (店长)
messages.zh: 顾客为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did the customer leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-impjegat pastaż miegħu; issa rridu nitolbuh skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-impjegat pastaż miegħu; issa rridu nitolbuh skuża.
messages.zh: 因为那名员工对他很无礼；现在我们得向他道歉。
messages.en: Because the employee was rude to him; now we need to apologize to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“对客人无礼”的场景记住动词，再分卡记名词的粗鲁者、走卒和建筑梁义，避免混淆词性与语境。

gloss_zh: 乌合之众；平民百姓（轻蔑称呼）；下三烂之流

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disparaging collective term for a mob, ordinary people, or people the speaker regards as disreputable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带轻蔑意味的集合名词，可指乌合之众、普通百姓，或说话者眼中不体面的一群人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma kollettiva ta' disprezz għal folla, għan-nies komuni jew għal nies li l-kelliem iqis bla rispettabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌合之众；乱哄哄或具有闹事倾向的人群，带贬义。
平民百姓；普通民众，在此为带轻蔑意味的称呼。
下三烂之流；被轻蔑地视为不体面的一群人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, in-nobbli jsejjaħ lin-nies tal-belt 'pastażalja', u b'hekk juri d-disprezz tiegħu lejhom.
formal.en: In the novel, the nobleman calls the townspeople 'pastażalja', thereby showing his contempt for them.
formal.zh: 小说中的贵族把城里的百姓称为“pastażalja”，以此显露他对他们的轻蔑。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex sejħilhom pastażalja? Tumas: Kien qed jinsultahom; dik mhix kelma newtrali għan-nies.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did he call them pastażalja? Tumas: He was insulting them; that isn't a neutral word for people.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他为什么把他们叫作 pastażalja？托马斯：他是在侮辱他们；这个词不是对人的中性称呼。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 他为什么把他们叫作 pastażalja？
messages.en: Why did he call them pastażalja?

messages.speaker: Tumas (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qed jinsultahom; dik mhix kelma newtrali għan-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qed jinsultahom; dik mhix kelma newtrali għan-nies.
messages.zh: 他是在侮辱他们；这个词不是对人的中性称呼。
messages.en: He was insulting them; that isn't a neutral word for people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pastażalja 想成说话者轻蔑地指着“一整群人”，同时记住集合意义和贬义色彩，不当作中性的“大家”。

gloss_zh: 粗鲁或粗俗的举动；不当行为；粗劣之作；碍眼之物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rude, vulgar, or inappropriate act; also, something badly made or unpleasant to look at.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次粗鲁、粗俗或不合宜的行为；也可指制作粗劣或令人看着不舒服的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għemil goff, vulgari jew mhux xieraq; ukoll xi ħaġa magħmula ħażin jew kerha biex tħares lejha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次粗鲁无礼或粗俗的举动。
不合宜的行为；不得体的举动。
制作粗劣的东西；做工很差的作品或物件。
碍眼之物；外观难看、令人看着不舒服的东西。

collocations.en: he did something rude or inappropriate
collocations.zh: 他做了一件粗鲁或不得体的事

collocations.en: an eyesore that spoils the street
collocations.zh: 破坏街道观感的碍眼之物

formal.mt: L-interruzzjoni waqt id-diskors kienet pastażata li fixklet il-laqgħa u uriet nuqqas ta' rispett lejn il-kelliem.
formal.en: The interruption during the speech was a rude act that disrupted the meeting and showed disrespect towards the speaker.
formal.zh: 在演讲期间打断发言是一种无礼行为，既扰乱了会议，也表现出对发言者的不尊重。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt kif qabeż il-kju? Ġanni: Iva, dik kienet pastażata; kulħadd kien qed jistenna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see how he jumped the queue? Ġanni: Yes, that was rude; everyone was waiting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到他怎么插队了吗？詹尼：看到了，真没礼貌；大家都在等。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你看到他怎么插队了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how he jumped the queue?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik kienet pastażata; kulħadd kien qed jistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik kienet pastażata; kulħadd kien qed jistenna.
messages.zh: 看到了，真没礼貌；大家都在等。
messages.en: Yes, that was rude; everyone was waiting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 pastażata：插队是“一件无礼的事”，粗制滥造的招牌是“一件碍眼的东西”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is very rude, uncouth, or seriously lacking in manners.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常粗鲁、粗野或极其缺乏礼貌的人，是对人的贬义称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna goffa ħafna jew bla manjieri, imsejħa hekk b'disprezz.

sense_translations.en_definition: a very rude or uncouth person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常粗鲁或粗野的人；极没教养的人，带贬义。

collocations.en: an uncouth person with no manners
to behave like a very rude person
collocations.zh: 表现得像个极粗鲁的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru huwa deskritt bħala pastażun għax jgħajjat mal-ġirien u jinsulta lil kull min ikellmu.
formal.en: In the story, the character is described as a very rude person because he shouts at the neighbours and insults anyone who speaks to him.
formal.zh: 故事把这个人物描写成一个极粗鲁的人，因为他对邻居大喊大叫，还辱骂每一个和他说话的人。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak ir-raġel għajjat mal-kaxxiera mingħajr raġuni. David: Kemm hu pastażun! Seta' tkellem bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Marija: That man shouted at the cashier for no reason. David: What a rude man! He could have spoken calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：那个男人无缘无故地冲收银员大喊。戴维：真是个粗鲁的家伙！他本来可以心平气和地说话。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel għajjat mal-kaxxiera mingħajr raġuni.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel għajjat mal-kaxxiera mingħajr raġuni.
messages.zh: 那个男人无缘无故地冲收银员大喊。
messages.en: That man shouted at the cashier for no reason.

messages.speaker: David (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu pastażun! Seta' tkellem bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu pastażun! Seta' tkellem bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 真是个粗鲁的家伙！他本来可以心平气和地说话。
messages.en: What a rude man! He could have spoken calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pastażun 记成“对收银员大吼的粗鲁家伙”，重点记它指一个人，而且责骂语气较强。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very large amount or number of something, often more than is needed or manageable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量非常多的一批事物，常含多得过量、难以处理的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità jew għadd kbir ħafna ta' xi ħaġa, spiss aktar milli jkun meħtieġ jew faċli biex wieħed ilaħħaq miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量；丰盛；过多，指某种事物数量极多，有时多至过量。

formal.mt: Il-proposta qajmet patafjun ta' mistoqsijiet li l-kumitat kellu jeżamina qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The proposal raised a plethora of questions that the committee had to examine before making a decision.
formal.zh: 这项提案引出了一大堆问题，委员会必须在作出决定前逐一审视。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex għadek l-uffiċċju? Karl: Għandi patafjun ta' xogħol; se ndum ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are you still at the office? Karl: I've got a huge amount of work; I'll be a little longer.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你怎么还在办公室？卡尔：我有一大堆工作，还得再待一会儿。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.zh: 你怎么还在办公室？
messages.en: Why are you still at the office?

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi patafjun ta' xogħol; se ndum ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi patafjun ta' xogħol; se ndum ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 我有一大堆工作，还得再待一会儿。
messages.en: I've got a huge amount of work; I'll be a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上的问题纸条堆成小山，用 patafjun ta' mistoqsijiet 记住“大量到令人应接不暇”的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become friendly with someone again after a quarrel or disagreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在争吵或意见不合之后与某人恢复友好关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jkun ħabib ma' xi ħadd wara ġlieda jew nuqqas ta' qbil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人和解；与某人重归于好。

collocations.en: he made peace with his brother
he made peace with his friend

formal.mt: Wara laqgħa mal-familja, Mark paċa ma' ħuh u t-tnejn qablu li jerġgħu jitkellmu bil-kalma.
formal.en: After a meeting with the family, Mark made peace with his brother, and they both agreed to speak calmly again.
formal.zh: 与家人会面后，马克与兄弟和好了，两人都同意重新心平气和地交谈。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu għadu miġġieled ma' ħuh? Rita: Le, ilbieraħ paċa miegħu. Illum marru jieħdu kafè flimkien.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is Pawlu still at odds with his brother? Rita: No, he made peace with him yesterday. Today they went for coffee together.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗还在和兄弟闹矛盾吗？丽塔：没有，他昨天已经与兄弟和好了。今天他们一起去喝咖啡了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还在和兄弟闹矛盾吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still at odds with his brother?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ilbieraħ paċa miegħu. Illum marru jieħdu kafè flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ilbieraħ paċa miegħu. Illum marru jieħdu kafè flimkien.
messages.zh: 没有，他昨天已经与兄弟和好了。今天他们一起去喝咖啡了。
messages.en: No, he made peace with him yesterday. Today they went for coffee together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paċa 放进“吵完架又一起喝咖啡”的画面，记住它表示与某人和好的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to wait, explain, or tolerate difficulties without becoming angry or annoyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够耐心等待、讲解或容忍困难，不轻易生气或烦躁的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaf jistenna, jispjega jew jissaporti d-diffikultajiet mingħajr ma jirrabja malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有耐心的；能忍让、能包容的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem kien paċenzjuż mal-istudenti u spjega l-eżerċizzju diversi drabi sakemm kulħadd fehmu.
formal.en: The teacher was patient with the students and explained the exercise several times until everyone understood it.
formal.zh: 老师耐心对待学生，把练习讲解了好几遍，直到所有人都明白。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadni ma fhimtx dan il-pass. Tista' terġa' tispjegah? Mark: Mela! Nieħduh bil-mod. Lara: Grazzi, int veru paċenzjuż miegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: I still don't understand this step. Can you explain it again? Mark: Of course! Let's take it slowly. Lara: Thanks, you're really patient with me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我还是不明白这一步。你能再讲一次吗？马克：当然！我们慢慢来。拉拉：谢谢，你对我真有耐心。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma fhimtx dan il-pass. Tista' terġa' tispjegah?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma fhimtx dan il-pass. Tista' terġa' tispjegah?
messages.zh: 我还是不明白这一步。你能再讲一次吗？
messages.en: I still don't understand this step. Can you explain it again?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 当然！我们慢慢来。
messages.en: Of course! Let's take it slowly.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 谢谢，你对我真有耐心。
messages.en: Thanks, you're really patient with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把同一道题温和地讲三遍，用 paċenzjuż 形容这种不急不躁、有耐心的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who calms people down and helps settle a quarrel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使争执中的人平静下来，并帮助双方和解的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikkalma lil min ikun qed jiġġieled u tgħinu jasal għal ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安抚他人、平息争执的人；劝和者。

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni bejn il-ġirien, is-sur Vella għamel ta' paċier u għen liż-żewġ naħat jitkellmu bil-kalma.
formal.en: During the discussion between the neighbours, Mr Vella acted as a peacemaker and helped both sides speak calmly.
formal.zh: 邻居们讨论时，韦拉先生充当劝和者，帮助双方心平气和地交谈。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tfal reġgħu bdew jiġġieldu fuq il-logħba. Pawlu: Se mmur nagħmel ta' paċier u nisma' x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Anna: The children have started arguing over the game again. Pawlu: I'll go and act as peacemaker and hear what happened.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：孩子们又为游戏吵起来了。保罗：我去劝劝架，听听发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfal reġgħu bdew jiġġieldu fuq il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfal reġgħu bdew jiġġieldu fuq il-logħba.
messages.zh: 孩子们又为游戏吵起来了。
messages.en: The children have started arguing over the game again.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur nagħmel ta' paċier u nisma' x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur nagħmel ta' paċier u nisma' x'ġara.
messages.zh: 我去劝劝架，听听发生了什么。
messages.en: I'll go and act as peacemaker and hear what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住搭配 jagħmel ta' paċier，想象两人争吵时第三个人走过来劝和，词义就有了具体人物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a peaceful way, without fighting, violence, or disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以和平、平和的方式，没有打斗、暴力或纷扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod kalm u mingħajr ġlied, vjolenza jew tfixkil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和平地；平静地；以不诉诸暴力的方式。

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ komunitajiet qablu li jsolvu t-tilwima paċifikament permezz tad-djalogu.
formal.en: The two communities agreed to resolve the dispute peacefully through dialogue.
formal.zh: 两个社群同意通过对话和平解决争端。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif spiċċat it-tilwima mal-ġar? Mark: Solvejnieha paċifikament. Qgħadna nitkellmu u sibna soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did the dispute with the neighbour end? Mark: We resolved it peacefully. We sat down to talk and found a solution.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你和邻居的争执最后怎么样了？马克：我们和平解决了。大家坐下来谈了谈，找到了解决办法。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和邻居的争执最后怎么样了？
messages.en: How did the dispute with the neighbour end?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Solvejnieha paċifikament. Qgħadna nitkellmu u sibna soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Solvejnieha paċifikament. Qgħadna nitkellmu u sibna soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 我们和平解决了。大家坐下来谈了谈，找到了解决办法。
messages.en: We resolved it peacefully. We sat down to talk and found a solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paċifikament 放在“解决争端”这个动作旁边，回答“怎样解决”：大家坐下来和平地谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who helps opposing people or groups end conflict and establish peace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助对立的人或群体结束冲突、达成和平的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħin lil nies jew gruppi f'kunflitt itemmu l-ġlied u jilħqu l-paċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促成和平的人；使冲突双方和解的调解者。

collocations.en: a peacemaker between the two sides
collocations.zh: 在双方之间促成和解的人

formal.mt: Il-medjatur aġixxa bħala paċifikatur bejn iż-żewġ gruppi u għenhom jilħqu ftehim.
formal.en: The mediator acted as a peacemaker between the two groups and helped them reach an agreement.
formal.zh: 调解人在两个群体之间促成和解，帮助他们达成协议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjaħtu lil David għal-laqgħa? Simon: Biex jagħmel ta' paċifikatur. Jaf jisma' liż-żewġ naħat u jgħinhom jaslu għal ftehim.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you ask David to come to the meeting? Simon: To act as a peacemaker. He knows how to listen to both sides and help them reach an agreement.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们为什么叫戴维来开会？西蒙：让他来调解。他懂得倾听双方，帮助大家达成一致。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你们为什么叫戴维来开会？
messages.en: Why did you ask David to come to the meeting?

messages.speaker: Simon (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jagħmel ta' paċifikatur. Jaf jisma' liż-żewġ naħat u jgħinhom jaslu għal ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jagħmel ta' paċifikatur. Jaf jisma' liż-żewġ naħat u jgħinhom jaslu għal ftehim.
messages.zh: 让他来调解。他懂得倾听双方，帮助大家达成一致。
messages.en: To act as a peacemaker. He knows how to listen to both sides and help them reach an agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 paċifikatur 坐在谈判桌中央，倾听双方并促成握手，把这个词记作“促成和平的人”。

gloss_zh: 平息冲突；恢复和平的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of calming conflict or unrest and bringing about peace or order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使冲突或动荡平息、恢复和平或秩序的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jikkalmaw il-kunflitti jew l-inkwiet u jiġu stabbiliti l-paċi jew l-ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平息冲突或动荡；使局势恢复和平或秩序的过程。

collocations.zh: 为平息冲突而作的努力

formal.mt: Il-proċess ta' paċifikazzjoni kien jinkludi laqgħat regolari bejn ir-rappreżentanti tal-komunitajiet.
formal.en: The pacification process included regular meetings between representatives of the communities.
formal.zh: 平息冲突的过程包括各社群代表之间的定期会面。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'jiġifieri paċifikazzjoni f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Il-proċess biex jikkalma l-kunflitt u terġa' ssaltan il-paċi.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does pacification mean in this text? Pawlu: The process of calming the conflict and restoring peace.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这篇文章里的 paċifikazzjoni 是什么意思？保罗：就是平息冲突、恢复和平的过程。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 paċifikazzjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does pacification mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-proċess biex jikkalma l-kunflitt u terġa' ssaltan il-paċi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-proċess biex jikkalma l-kunflitt u terġa' ssaltan il-paċi.
messages.zh: 就是平息冲突、恢复和平的过程。
messages.en: The process of calming the conflict and restoring peace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一组连续画面记 paċifikazzjoni：争执、会谈、局势平静。它指整个平息过程，可以搭配“过程”和“努力”。

gloss_zh: 和平的；主张和平、反对暴力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Peaceful and free from violence, or favouring peace rather than war or fighting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 和平而没有暴力的；也指倾向和平、反对战争或打斗的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mingħajr ġlied jew vjolenza, jew li jkun favur il-paċi u kontra l-gwerra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和平的；平静而没有冲突或暴力的。
主张和平主义的；反对战争和暴力的。

collocations.zh: 主张和平、反对暴力的态度

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu l-għan li joħloq ambjent paċifiku fejn in-nies isolvu n-nuqqas ta' qbil permezz tad-djalogu.
formal.en: The project aims to create a peaceful environment where people resolve disagreements through dialogue.
formal.zh: 这个项目旨在营造和平的环境，让人们通过对话解决分歧。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Taħseb li Mark se jidħol fil-ġlieda? Lara: Le, hu bniedem paċifiku. Dejjem jgħid li aħjar nitkellmu milli niġġieldu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you think Mark will join the fight? Lara: No, he's a peace-loving person. He always says it's better to talk than to fight.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你觉得马克会加入打斗吗？拉拉：不会，他是个爱好和平的人。他总说，与其打架，不如好好谈谈。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark se jidħol fil-ġlieda?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark se jidħol fil-ġlieda?
messages.zh: 你觉得马克会加入打斗吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark will join the fight?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu bniedem paċifiku. Dejjem jgħid li aħjar nitkellmu milli niġġieldu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu bniedem paċifiku. Dejjem jgħid li aħjar nitkellmu milli niġġieldu.
messages.zh: 不会，他是个爱好和平的人。他总说，与其打架，不如好好谈谈。
messages.en: No, he's a peace-loving person. He always says it's better to talk than to fight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 paċifiku 配两张图：安宁的环境表示“和平的”，拒绝打斗的人表示“主张和平的”，分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who opposes war and violence and supports peaceful ways of resolving conflict.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反对战争和暴力，并主张以和平方式解决冲突的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li topponi l-gwerra u l-vjolenza u tappoġġa mezzi paċifiċi biex jissolvew il-kunflitti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和平主义者；反对战争和暴力、主张和平解决冲突的人。

formal.mt: Bħala paċifist, l-awtur sostna li l-kunflitti għandhom jissolvew permezz tad-djalogu u mhux bil-vjolenza.
formal.en: As a pacifist, the author argued that conflicts should be resolved through dialogue and not through violence.
formal.zh: 作为和平主义者，这位作者主张通过对话而非暴力解决冲突。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex David dejjem jitkellem kontra l-gwerra? Simon: Għax hu paċifist. Jemmen li għandna nfittxu soluzzjonijiet mingħajr vjolenza.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does David always speak against war? Simon: Because he's a pacifist. He believes we should look for solutions without violence.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：戴维为什么总是反对战争？西蒙：因为他是和平主义者。他认为我们应该寻求不使用暴力的解决办法。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex David dejjem jitkellem kontra l-gwerra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex David dejjem jitkellem kontra l-gwerra?
messages.zh: 戴维为什么总是反对战争？
messages.en: Why does David always speak against war?

messages.speaker: Simon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu paċifist. Jemmen li għandna nfittxu soluzzjonijiet mingħajr vjolenza.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu paċifist. Jemmen li għandna nfittxu soluzzjonijiet mingħajr vjolenza.
messages.zh: 因为他是和平主义者。他认为我们应该寻求不使用暴力的解决办法。
messages.en: Because he's a pacifist. He believes we should look for solutions without violence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paċifist 记成一个举着“反对战争，支持对话”标语的人；这个名词指持有和平主义立场的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The belief that war and violence should be rejected and conflicts resolved peacefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反对战争和暴力，主张以和平方式解决冲突的思想或立场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twemmin li l-gwerra u l-vjolenza għandhom jiġu miċħuda u li l-kunflitti għandhom jissolvew b'mezzi paċifiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和平主义；反对战争和暴力、主张和平解决冲突的立场。

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tiddiskuti l-paċifiżmu u l-importanza tad-djalogu biex jissolvew il-kunflitti.
formal.en: The author discusses pacifism and the importance of dialogue in resolving conflicts.
formal.zh: 作者讨论了和平主义，以及通过对话解决冲突的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser għalik il-paċifiżmu? Mark: Li nippruvaw insolvu l-kunflitti bid-djalogu u mingħajr vjolenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does pacifism mean to you? Mark: Trying to resolve conflicts through dialogue and without violence.
colloquial.zh: Maja：对你来说，和平主义意味着什么？Mark：努力通过对话、不使用暴力来解决冲突。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 对你来说，和平主义意味着什么？
messages.en: What does pacifism mean to you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Li nippruvaw insolvu l-kunflitti bid-djalogu u mingħajr vjolenza.
messages.mt_standard: Li nippruvaw insolvu l-kunflitti bid-djalogu u mingħajr vjolenza.
messages.zh: 努力通过对话、不使用暴力来解决冲突。
messages.en: Trying to resolve conflicts through dialogue and without violence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“先坐下对话，再和平解决冲突”的画面绑定，记住它表示一种反对战争和暴力的立场。

gloss_zh: 傻瓜；无能的人；话痨；阴道（粗俗称呼）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insulting term for a silly or incompetent person; it can also refer to someone who talks excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带侮辱意味的名词，指愚蠢或无能的人，也可指说话过多的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' disprezz għal persuna iblah jew bla ħila; tista' tirreferi wkoll għal persuna li titkellem iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傻瓜；笨蛋；无能的人，带贬义或侮辱意味。
话痨；喋喋不休、说话过多的人。
对阴道的粗俗称呼，语气粗鄙。

collocations.en: a chatterbox who never stops talking

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kelma 'paċoċċ' tintuża biex tiddeskrivi persuna li titkellem iżżejjed.
formal.en: In the story, the word 'paċoċċ' is used to describe a person who talks excessively.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，paċoċċ 一词用来形容一个话太多的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħlu paċoċċ? Mark: Għax ma waqafx jitkellem, imma ma kienx sabiħ li jgħidlu hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he call him a chatterbox? Mark: Because he would not stop talking, but it was not nice to call him that.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么叫那个人话痨？Mark：因为那个人一直说个不停，不过这样叫人家不太好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么叫那个人话痨？
messages.en: Why did he call him a chatterbox?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma waqafx jitkellem, imma ma kienx sabiħ li jgħidlu hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma waqafx jitkellem, imma ma kienx sabiħ li jgħidlu hekk.
messages.zh: 因为那个人一直说个不停，不过这样叫人家不太好。
messages.en: Because he would not stop talking, but it was not nice to call him that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张分开的词义卡记忆：傻瓜、话痨、粗俗的阴道称呼。看到具体语境再选义，不把三种意思混成一种。
