messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 小便器在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the urinal?

messages.speaker: Toni (工作人员)
messages.zh: 右边墙上有一个。
messages.en: There is one on the wall on the right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公共厕所右边墙上的小便器，把 pixxatur 与这件具体设施绑定；记住这里说的是器具，而不是排尿动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element platinum, a precious metal used in objects such as jewellery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素铂，也称铂金，是可用于制作首饰等物品的贵金属。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku platinu, metall prezzjuż li jintuża f'oġġetti bħal ġojjellerija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铂，化学元素；在首饰等语境中也称铂金。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi ċurkett magħmul mill-platinu.
formal.en: The catalogue describes a ring made of platinum.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了一枚用铂金制成的戒指。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan iċ-ċurkett tal-platinu? Mark: Iva, huwa magħmul mill-platinu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this ring platinum? Mark: Yes, it is made of platinum.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这枚戒指是铂金的吗？Mark：是的，它是用铂金制成的。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这枚戒指是铂金的吗？
messages.en: Is this ring platinum?

messages.speaker: Mark (珠宝店店员)
messages.zh: 是的，它是用铂金制成的。
messages.en: Yes, it is made of platinum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 platinu 写在想象中的铂金戒指标签上，连同 ċurkett tal-platinu 一起记，就能把元素名称与常见实物联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small shallow dish placed under a cup.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在杯子下面的小而浅的碟子，通常用于承托茶杯或咖啡杯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt żgħir u baxx li jitqiegħed taħt tazza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茶碟；放在茶杯或咖啡杯下面的杯碟。

formal.mt: Kull tazza tat-te tqiegħdet fuq plattina bajda.
formal.en: Each teacup was placed on a white saucer.
formal.zh: 每只茶杯都放在一个白色茶碟上。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tista' tagħtini plattina għat-tazza? Ben: Żgur, hawn waħda ħdejn il-kuċċarini.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you give me a saucer for the cup? Ben: Of course, there is one here next to the teaspoons.
colloquial.zh: Rita：能给我一个放杯子的茶碟吗？Ben：当然，这里茶匙旁边有一个。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 能给我一个放杯子的茶碟吗？
messages.en: Can you give me a saucer for the cup?

messages.speaker: Ben (主人)
messages.zh: 当然，这里茶匙旁边有一个。
messages.en: Of course, there is one here next to the teaspoons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给茶杯配一个小托碟：杯子在上，plattina 在下。用“一杯一碟”的画面记住它专指承托杯子的茶碟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large plate used for holding or serving food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放或端上食物的大盘子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt kbir li jintuża biex jitqiegħed jew jiġi servut l-ikel fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大盘子；可用来盛放较多食物的盘子。

collocations.en: a large plate full of fruit

formal.mt: Il-kok poġġa l-ħut fuq plattun u żejnu bil-lumi.
formal.en: The cook placed the fish on a large plate and garnished it with lemon.
formal.zh: 厨师把鱼放在大盘子上，并用柠檬作装饰。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ġib il-plattun, jekk jogħġbok. Luqa: Dak għall-ħut? Anna: Iva, poġġih fin-nofs tal-mejda.
colloquial.en: Anna: Bring the large plate, please. Luqa: The one for the fish? Anna: Yes, put it in the middle of the table.
colloquial.zh: Anna：请把大盘子拿来。Luqa：盛鱼的那个吗？Anna：对，把它放在桌子中间。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 请把大盘子拿来。
messages.en: Bring the large plate, please.

messages.speaker: Luqa (儿子)
messages.zh: 盛鱼的那个吗？
messages.en: The one for the fish?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 对，把它放在桌子中间。
messages.en: Yes, put it in the middle of the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 plattun 想成餐桌中央盛整条鱼的大盘子；再与杯子下面的 plattina 对照，通过用途和大小区分这两个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organ that develops during pregnancy and enables the exchange of nutrients, oxygen, and waste between mother and fetus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 妊娠期间形成的器官，使母体与胎儿之间能够交换营养、氧气和代谢废物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organu li jiżviluppa waqt it-tqala u jippermetti l-iskambju ta' nutrijenti, ossiġnu u skart bejn l-omm u l-fetu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胎盘；妊娠期间形成、参与母体与胎儿之间物质交换的器官。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega r-rwol tal-plaċenta waqt it-tqala.
formal.en: The chapter explains the role of the placenta during pregnancy.
formal.zh: 本章解释胎盘在妊娠期间的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma plaċenta? Lara: Hija organu li jiżviluppa waqt it-tqala.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word placenta mean? Lara: It is an organ that develops during pregnancy.
colloquial.zh: Maja：plaċenta 这个词是什么意思？Lara：它是妊娠期间形成的一种器官。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: plaċenta 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word placenta mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija organu li jiżviluppa waqt it-tqala.
messages.mt_standard: Hija organu li jiżviluppa waqt it-tqala.
messages.zh: 它是妊娠期间形成的一种器官。
messages.en: It is an organ that develops during pregnancy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“妊娠中的物质交换站”这一教学比喻记住 plaċenta：看到这个词，就联想到母体与胎儿之间交换物质的胎盘。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An upright column or post that supports part of a structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 竖立在建筑或其他结构中、起支撑作用的柱子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kolonna jew struttura wieqfa li ssostni parti minn bini jew minn struttura oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柱子；支撑建筑或其他结构的支柱。

formal.mt: Il-perit eżamina l-plier tal-ġebel ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: The architect examined the stone pillar beside the entrance.
formal.zh: 建筑师检查了入口旁边的石柱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn niltaqgħu? Toni: Ħdejn il-plier tal-ġebel, quddiem il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Toni: Beside the stone pillar, in front of the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在哪里碰面？Toni：在门前那根石柱旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 在门前那根石柱旁边。
messages.en: Beside the stone pillar, in front of the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 plier 设成约见地点：“门前石柱旁见。”每次回想这句话，就让脑中出现一根直立并支撑结构的柱子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element plutonium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钚的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku msejjaħ plutonju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钚，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kampjun ta' plutonju.
formal.en: The report describes a sample of plutonium.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一份钚样品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ngħidu plutonium bil-Malti? Mark: Ngħidu plutonju; huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do we say plutonium in Maltese? Mark: We say plutonju; it is the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: Sara：plutonium 用马耳他语怎么说？Mark：说 plutonju；它是一种化学元素的名称。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: plutonium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do we say plutonium in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu plutonju; huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu plutonju; huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.zh: 说 plutonju；它是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: We say plutonju; it is the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语记忆卡：正面写 plutonju，背面写“钚／plutonium”。与 platinu“铂”并排复习，逐字核对，避免混淆两种元素。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species Pluvialis squatarola, known as the grey plover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸟，中文名为灰斑鸻，学名为 Pluvialis squatarola。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur bl-isem xjentifiku Pluvialis squatarola, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala grey plover.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰斑鸻（学名：Pluvialis squatarola）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a grey plover

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt ta' pluviera griża u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Pluvialis squatarola.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of a grey plover and gives its scientific name, Pluvialis squatarola.
formal.zh: 这本指南收录了一张灰斑鸻的照片，并列出了它的学名 Pluvialis squatarola。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Din pluviera griża. Ejja nfittxuha fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this bird in the photograph called? Pawlu: It's a grey plover. Let's look it up in the guide.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这种鸟叫什么？保罗：这是灰斑鸻。我们在指南里查查吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Din pluviera griża. Ejja nfittxuha fil-gwida.
messages.mt_standard: Din pluviera griża. Ejja nfittxuha fil-gwida.
messages.zh: 这是灰斑鸻。我们在指南里查查吧。
messages.en: It's a grey plover. Let's look it up in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张灰斑鸻图片卡，把 pluviera griża 整体写在图下；借 griża 的“灰色”联想记词，但辨认鸟种时仍看完整名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species Pluvialis fulva, known as the Pacific golden plover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸟，中文名为太平洋金斑鸻，学名为 Pluvialis fulva。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur bl-isem xjentifiku Pluvialis fulva, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Pacific golden plover.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 太平洋金斑鸻（学名：Pluvialis fulva）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Pacific golden plover
collocations.zh: 一张太平洋金斑鸻的照片

collocations.en: to identify a Pacific golden plover
collocations.zh: 辨认一只太平洋金斑鸻

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti jqabblu r-ritratt ta' pluviera żgħira mad-deskrizzjoni fil-gwida.
formal.en: In this exercise, students compare the photograph of a Pacific golden plover with the description in the guide.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生将太平洋金斑鸻的照片与指南中的描述进行对照。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din pluviera żgħira? Mark: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-gwida. L-isem xjentifiku tagħha huwa Pluvialis fulva.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a Pacific golden plover? Mark: Let's check the guide. Its scientific name is Pluvialis fulva.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是太平洋金斑鸻吗？马克：我们查一下指南吧。它的学名是 Pluvialis fulva。

messages.speaker: Nina (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 这是太平洋金斑鸻吗？
messages.en: Is this a Pacific golden plover?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-gwida. L-isem xjentifiku tagħha huwa Pluvialis fulva.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-gwida. L-isem xjentifiku tagħha huwa Pluvialis fulva.
messages.zh: 我们查一下指南吧。它的学名是 Pluvialis fulva。
messages.en: Let's check the guide. Its scientific name is Pluvialis fulva.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pluviera żgħira、太平洋金斑鸻和 Pluvialis fulva 写在同一张卡上；żgħira 的“小”可作提示，但整个词组在本条中指特定鸟种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Literary expression in poems, using carefully chosen language, imagery, rhythm, or sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以诗的形式表达思想和感受的文学，讲究语言、意象、节奏或声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Letteratura f'forma ta' poeżiji li tesprimi ħsibijiet u sentimenti permezz ta' kliem magħżul, xbihat, ritmu jew ħsejjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诗歌；以诗的形式表达思想和情感的文学。

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti jaqraw ġabra ta' poetrija u jiddiskutu kif il-kliem jesprimi s-sentimenti.
formal.en: In this lesson, students read a collection of poetry and discuss how the words express feelings.
formal.zh: 在这节课上，学生阅读一本诗集，并讨论文字如何表达情感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Daniel: Ġabra ta' poetrija. Trid naqralek poeżija qasira?
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Daniel: A collection of poetry. Would you like me to read you a short poem?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读什么？丹尼尔：一本诗集。要我给你读一首短诗吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġabra ta' poetrija. Trid naqralek poeżija qasira?
messages.mt_standard: Ġabra ta' poetrija. Trid naqralek poeżija qasira?
messages.zh: 一本诗集。要我给你读一首短诗吗？
messages.en: A collection of poetry. Would you like me to read you a short poem?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 poetrija 与英语 poetry 并排写，配上一页分行排列的诗；用这个视觉联想记住“诗歌”，无需把词尾拆成词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A closed flat shape whose boundary consists of three or more straight line segments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由三条或更多直线段首尾相接围成的封闭平面图形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura ċatta u magħluqa magħmula minn tliet segmenti ta' linji dritti jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多边形；由三条或更多直线段围成的封闭平面图形。

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jpinġi poligonu b'ħames naħat u jikteb in-numru ta' angoli tiegħu.
formal.en: The student should draw a polygon with five sides and write down its number of angles.
formal.zh: 学生应画一个五条边的多边形，并写出它的角的数量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan iċ-ċirku huwa poligonu? Toni: Le, għax il-poligonu għandu naħat dritti. Ipprova pinġi trijangolu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this circle a polygon? Toni: No, because a polygon has straight sides. Try drawing a triangle.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个圆是多边形吗？托尼：不是，因为多边形的边是直的。试着画个三角形吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个圆是多边形吗？
messages.en: Is this circle a polygon?

messages.speaker: Toni (数学老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għax il-poligonu għandu naħat dritti. Ipprova pinġi trijangolu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għax il-poligonu għandu naħat dritti. Ipprova pinġi trijangolu.
messages.zh: 不是，因为多边形的边是直的。试着画个三角形吧。
messages.en: No, because a polygon has straight sides. Try drawing a triangle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 poligonu 时，用笔画几条直线并让最后一条接回起点；把“直边、闭合、至少三条”连成多边形的记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Central Europe whose official name is the Republic of Poland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于中欧的国家，正式名称为波兰共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa Ċentrali li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tal-Polonja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Poland (a country in Central Europe; official name: Repubblika tal-Polonja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 波兰，中欧国家；正式名称为波兰共和国（Repubblika tal-Polonja）。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-Polonja hija deskritta bħala pajjiż fl-Ewropa Ċentrali, bl-isem uffiċjali r-Repubblika tal-Polonja.
formal.en: In the report, Poland is described as a country in Central Europe, with the official name the Republic of Poland.
formal.zh: 报告将波兰介绍为位于中欧的国家，其正式名称为波兰共和国。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn sejra għall-vaganza? Rita: Se mmur il-Polonja ma' ħabiba tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are you going on holiday? Rita: I'm going to Poland with a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你要去哪里度假？丽塔：我要和一位朋友去波兰。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur il-Polonja ma' ħabiba tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur il-Polonja ma' ħabiba tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要和一位朋友去波兰。
messages.en: I'm going to Poland with a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在中欧地图上把 Polonja、Poland、波兰写在一起，记住国家名正文中首字母大写；再用 il-Polonja 练习带冠词的形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called polonium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种化学元素，中文名称为钋，英文名称为 polonium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala polonium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钋，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: It-test tal-kimika jitlob lill-istudenti jidentifikaw il-polonju bħala element kimiku.
formal.en: The chemistry test asks students to identify polonium as a chemical element.
formal.zh: 化学测验要求学生指出，钋是一种化学元素。

colloquial.mt: Liam: X'inhu l-polonju? Marija: Huwa element kimiku. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ polonium.
colloquial.en: Liam: What is polonju? Marija: It's a chemical element. In English, it's called polonium.
colloquial.zh: 利亚姆：polonju 是什么？玛丽亚：它是一种化学元素，英语叫 polonium，中文叫钋。

messages.speaker: Liam (学生)
messages.zh: polonju 是什么？
messages.en: What is polonju?

messages.speaker: Marija (化学老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ polonium.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku. Bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ polonium.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素，英语叫 polonium，中文叫钋。
messages.en: It's a chemical element. In English, it's called polonium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 polonju 与“钋、化学元素”画进同一个方框；再与国家名 Polonja 对照，借末尾字母差异区分两个词，不推断它们的词源。

gloss_zh: 使某地有人居住；人口迁入过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of bringing people to live in a place or filling a place with inhabitants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人们迁入某地并在那里居住、使该地有居民的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih in-nies jiġu jgħixu f'post u dak il-post jimtela bl-abitanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某地有人居住；向某地迁入居民的过程。

collocations.zh: 使该地区有人居住的过程

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-popolament taż-żona u kif il-familji bdew jgħixu fid-djar il-ġodda.
formal.en: The report describes the populating of the area and how families began living in the new houses.
formal.zh: 报告描述了居民迁入该地区的过程，以及各个家庭如何开始入住新房。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser il-popolament taż-żona f'dan it-test? Ġorġ: Ifisser il-proċess li bih in-nies jiġu jgħixu hemm.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does the populating of the area mean in this text? Ġorġ: It means the process by which people come to live there.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这篇文章里“该地区的 popolament”是什么意思？乔治：就是人们迁来这里居住的过程。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser il-popolament taż-żona f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser il-popolament taż-żona f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里“该地区的 popolament”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the populating of the area mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser il-proċess li bih in-nies jiġu jgħixu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser il-proċess li bih in-nies jiġu jgħixu hemm.
messages.zh: 就是人们迁来这里居住的过程。
messages.en: It means the process by which people come to live there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排空房逐渐亮起灯、家庭陆续入住，把 popolament 记成“居民迁入的过程”；记忆重点放在过程，而非某个时点的人口数字。

gloss_zh: 使某地有人居住；人口迁入过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of filling a place with inhabitants by bringing people to live there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过让人们迁入居住，使一个地方有居民的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih post jimtela bl-abitanti hekk kif in-nies jiġu jgħixu fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某地有人居住；让居民迁入某地的过程。

collocations.zh: 使村庄有人居住的过程

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-popolarizzazzjoni tar-raħal bħala proċess li fih familji ġodda jiġu jgħixu hemm.
formal.en: The text describes the populating of the village as a process in which new families come to live there.
formal.zh: 文章将村庄的人口迁入描述为新家庭陆续来到村里居住的过程。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi tfisser il-popolarizzazzjoni tar-raħal hawn? David: Hawn tfisser li n-nies jiġu jgħixu fir-raħal u jimlew id-djar vojta.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does the populating of the village mean here? David: Here it means that people come to live in the village and fill the empty houses.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这里“村庄的 popolarizzazzjoni”是什么意思？戴维：这里指人们迁到村里居住，住进原来空着的房子。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.zh: 这里“村庄的 popolarizzazzjoni”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the populating of the village mean here?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li n-nies jiġu jgħixu fir-raħal u jimlew id-djar vojta.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li n-nies jiġu jgħixu fir-raħal u jimlew id-djar vojta.
messages.zh: 这里指人们迁到村里居住，住进原来空着的房子。
messages.en: Here it means that people come to live in the village and fill the empty houses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 针对本条给定的 populating 义，把 popolarizzazzjoni 写在“空村庄逐渐住进居民”的连环画下，用迁入、入住的连续动作帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 民间通称地；广为人知地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way familiar to ordinary people, especially when describing a widely used name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以大众熟悉或民间普遍使用的方式，尤用于说明通称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod magħruf fost in-nies, speċjalment meta tingħata isem li jintuża ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大众普遍地；民间通称地

formal.mt: Din il-pjazza hija magħrufa popolarment bħala l-Pjazza tas-Suq.
formal.en: This square is popularly known as Market Square.
formal.zh: 这个广场民间通称为市场广场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex kulħadd jgħidilha l-Pjazza tas-Suq? Toni: Għax hekk hi magħrufa popolarment.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does everyone call it Market Square? Toni: Because that is what it is popularly known as.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么大家都叫它市场广场？Toni：因为这是民间通用的名称。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么大家都叫它市场广场？
messages.en: Why does everyone call it Market Square?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为这是民间通用的名称。
messages.en: Because that is what it is popularly known as.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的正式名称旁，大家都喊着同一个俗称；把这个词连同“民间通称为”的搭配一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ordinary people considered collectively, especially in contrast with powerful or privileged groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为整体而言的普通百姓，尤其用于与有权势或享有特权的群体相对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nies komuni meqjusa bħala grupp, speċjalment meta jitqabblu ma' nies ta' poter jew privileġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平民百姓；普通民众

collocations.en: the voice of the common people

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jiddeskrivi l-ħajja tal-popolin f'belt żgħira.
formal.en: The novel describes the lives of ordinary people in a small town.
formal.zh: 这部小说描写了一座小城里平民百姓的生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar min hu dan il-ktieb? Mark: Dwar il-popolin, nies ordinarji bħalna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is this book about? Mark: The common people, ordinary people like us.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这本书写的是谁？Mark：平民百姓，就是像我们这样的普通人。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.zh: 这本书写的是谁？
messages.en: Who is this book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 平民百姓，就是像我们这样的普通人。
messages.en: The common people, ordinary people like us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准市场里买菜、聊天的普通百姓，用一整群人的生活画面记住这个集合意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many inhabitants, as a country, city, or other populated place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容国家、城市或其他地方居民人数众多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna abitanti, bħal pajjiż, belt jew raħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人口众多的；居民很多的

formal.mt: Dan ir-raħal popoluż jeħtieġ aktar servizzi pubbliċi biex jaqdi lill-abitanti tiegħu.
formal.en: This populous village needs more public services to serve its inhabitants.
formal.zh: 这个人口众多的村镇需要更多公共服务来满足居民的需要。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hawn ħafna nies jgħixu? Pawlu: Iva, dan hu raħal popoluż ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do many people live here? Pawlu: Yes, this is a very populous village.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里住着很多人吗？Pawlu：是的，这个村镇人口很多。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 这里住着很多人吗？
messages.en: Do many people live here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan hu raħal popoluż ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan hu raħal popoluż ħafna.
messages.zh: 是的，这个村镇人口很多。
messages.en: Yes, this is a very populous village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张人口地图上挤满代表居民的小圆点；这个形容词强调居民人数多，不是在评价受欢迎程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal with long, stiff quills on its body that help protect it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身上长有坚硬长刺、利用这些刺保护自己的动物，即豪猪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal b'xewk twil u iebes fuq ġismu li jgħinu jiddefendi ruħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 豪猪

formal.mt: L-istampa fil-ktieb turi porkuspin bix-xewk twil fuq dahru.
formal.en: The picture in the book shows a porcupine with long quills on its back.
formal.zh: 书中的图片展示了一只背部长着长刺的豪猪。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'annimal hu dak fl-istampa? Ben: Dak porkuspin; ara x-xewk twil li għandu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What animal is that in the picture? Ben: That is a porcupine; look at its long quills.
colloquial.zh: Sara：图片里那是什么动物？Ben：那是豪猪，看看它身上的长刺。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里那是什么动物？
messages.en: What animal is that in the picture?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak porkuspin; ara x-xewk twil li għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak porkuspin; ara x-xewk twil li għandu.
messages.zh: 那是豪猪，看看它身上的长刺。
messages.en: That is a porcupine; look at its long quills.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给单词配上一只背着一束长刺的豪猪图，把醒目的长刺作为视觉记忆点，并记准中文是豪猪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexually explicit material, such as images, films, or writing, intended to cause sexual arousal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以引起性兴奋为目的、含有露骨性描写的图片、影片或文字等内容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal bi stampi, films jew kitba li juru jew jiddeskrivu atti sesswali b'mod espliċitu bil-għan li jqanqlu xewqa sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 色情作品；以引起性兴奋为目的的露骨性内容

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddiskuti l-użu ta' filtri biex jillimitaw l-aċċess għall-pornografija fuq in-netwerk.
formal.en: The report discusses the use of filters to limit access to pornography on the network.
formal.zh: 这份报告讨论了使用过滤器限制通过网络获取色情内容的做法。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għal xiex iservi dan il-filtru? David: Jimblokka l-pornografija fuq dan il-kompjuter.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is this filter for? David: It blocks pornography on this computer.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这个过滤器有什么用？David：它会屏蔽这台电脑上的色情内容。

messages.speaker: Marta (电脑用户)
messages.zh: 这个过滤器有什么用？
messages.en: What is this filter for?

messages.speaker: David (技术人员)
messages.zh: 它会屏蔽这台电脑上的色情内容。
messages.en: It blocks pornography on this computer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“内容过滤器”的设置画面，联想到被归类为色情的图像、影片和文字，统一记作色情内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name, written Portelli with an initial capital letter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏波尔泰利，马耳他语书写时首字母大写，为 Portelli。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jinkiteb Portelli, bl-ewwel ittra kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏：波尔泰利

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Portelli bagħtet l-applikazzjoni tagħha lill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Ms Portelli sent her application to the office.
formal.zh: 波尔泰利女士向办公室提交了她的申请。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'kunjom għandek? Luca: Portelli. Nikteblek hawn biex tarah sew.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is your surname? Luca: Portelli. I will write it here so you can see it clearly.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你姓什么？Luca：波尔泰利。我写在这里，让你看清楚。

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What is your surname?

messages.speaker: Luca (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Portelli. Nikteblek hawn biex tarah sew.
messages.mt_standard: Portelli. Nikteblek hawn biex tarah sew.
messages.zh: 波尔泰利。我写在这里，让你看清楚。
messages.en: Portelli. I will write it here so you can see it clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象接待处表格的“姓氏”栏填着 Portelli，把它和中文音译波尔泰利配对，并记住姓名首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Portugal, a country in Southern Europe on the Iberian Peninsula, officially the Portuguese Republic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 葡萄牙，位于欧洲南部伊比利亚半岛的国家，正式名称为葡萄牙共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Ewropa, fil-Peniżola Iberika, li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika Portugiża.

sense_translations.en_definition: Portugal (a country in Southern Europe, on the Iberian Peninsula; official name: Repubblika Portugiża)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄牙，欧洲南部伊比利亚半岛上的国家；正式名称为葡萄牙共和国

formal.mt: Il-Portugall jinsab fin-Nofsinhar tal-Ewropa, fil-Peniżola Iberika.
formal.en: Portugal is located in Southern Europe, on the Iberian Peninsula.
formal.zh: 葡萄牙位于欧洲南部的伊比利亚半岛。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn se ssiefru din is-sena? Mario: Se nsiefru lejn il-Portugall għal ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where are you travelling this year? Mario: We are travelling to Portugal for a week.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你们今年去哪里旅行？Mario：我们要去葡萄牙待一个星期。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们今年去哪里旅行？
messages.en: Where are you travelling this year?

messages.speaker: Mario (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nsiefru lejn il-Portugall għal ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Se nsiefru lejn il-Portugall għal ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 我们要去葡萄牙待一个星期。
messages.en: We are travelling to Portugal for a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在伊比利亚半岛地图上给葡萄牙贴上 Portugall 标签，再用“前往葡萄牙旅行”的短语把国名读熟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of moving a planned event or action to a later time or date.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把原定的活动或行动安排到较晚时间或日期的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li avveniment jew azzjoni ppjanata titmexxa għal ħin jew data aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延期；推迟；延后安排

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ħabbar il-posponiment tal-laqgħa sal-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The committee announced the postponement of the meeting until Friday.
formal.zh: 委员会宣布将会议推迟至星期五。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-laqgħa għadha llum? Mark: Le, kien hemm posponiment; issa se ssir il-Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the meeting still today? Mark: No, there has been a postponement; it will now take place on Friday.
colloquial.zh: Rita：会议还是今天开吗？Mark：不是，已经延期了，现在改到星期五开。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 会议还是今天开吗？
messages.en: Is the meeting still today?

messages.speaker: Mark (会议组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien hemm posponiment; issa se ssir il-Ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien hemm posponiment; issa se ssir il-Ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 不是，已经延期了，现在改到星期五开。
messages.en: No, there has been a postponement; it will now take place on Friday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上的会议便签被移到后面的日期，便签仍在，只是时间延后；用这个动作记住“延期”这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element potassium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bħala potassju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钾，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jindika l-livell ta' potassju fil-kampjun.
formal.en: The laboratory report indicates the potassium level in the sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告注明了样本中的钾含量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tfittex fir-rapport? Pawlu: Il-livell ta' potassju f'dan il-kampjun.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you looking for in the report? Pawlu: The potassium level in this sample.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在报告里找什么？保罗：这个样本的钾含量。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在报告里找什么？
messages.en: What are you looking for in the report?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 这个样本的钾含量。
messages.en: The potassium level in this sample.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 potassju 写在实验样本标签旁，配上中文“钾”，再用“钾含量”这个搭配反复回忆。

gloss_zh: 君主；有强大权势的统治者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ruler who holds great power and authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 掌握强大权力和统治权的君主或统治者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħakkiem li għandu setgħa u awtorità kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有强大权势的君主或统治者。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-potentat jilqa' lid-delegazzjoni fil-palazz tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the potentate receives the delegation in his palace.
formal.zh: 小说中，这位君主在自己的宫殿接见代表团。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jgħix f'dak il-palazz fl-istorja? Pawlu: Potentat li jrid jikkontrolla kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who lives in that palace in the story? Pawlu: A potentate who wants to control everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里谁住在那座宫殿？保罗：一个什么都想控制的君主。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 故事里谁住在那座宫殿？
messages.en: Who lives in that palace in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 一个什么都想控制的君主。
messages.en: A potentate who wants to control everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象宫殿里发号施令的统治者，用 potentat 给这个人物贴标签，记住它指掌权的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having great strength, power, or a strong effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有很强力量、能力或作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu qawwa kbira jew effett qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强有力的，强大的；作用强烈的。

formal.mt: Il-magna l-ġdida għandha mutur potenti li jippermettilha ġġorr tagħbijiet tqal.
formal.en: The new machine has a powerful motor that enables it to carry heavy loads.
formal.zh: 新机器配有强劲的马达，能够搬运重物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mutur kapaċi jagħmel ix-xogħol? Pawlu: Iva, huwa potenti biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can this motor do the job? Pawlu: Yes, it is powerful enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个马达能完成这项工作吗？保罗：能，它的动力足够强。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这个马达能完成这项工作吗？
messages.en: Can this motor do the job?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 能，它的动力足够强。
messages.en: Yes, it is powerful enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见强劲马达搬起重物，就用 potenti 描述它；把这个词与“力量很强”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Power or strength; also, a nation or state with great power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量或功率；也指具有强大实力的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawwa jew saħħa; ukoll stat li għandu qawwa u influwenza kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 力量，实力；机器等的功率。
强国，大国；具有强大实力或影响力的国家。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lil dak l-istat bħala potenza ekonomika.
formal.en: The report describes that state as an economic power.
formal.zh: 报告将该国描述为一个经济强国。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-magna għandha biżżejjed potenza? Pawlu: Iva, għandha l-potenza meħtieġa għal dan ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the machine have enough power? Pawlu: Yes, it has the power needed for this job.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这台机器的功率够吗？保罗：够，它有完成这项工作所需的功率。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这台机器的功率够吗？
messages.en: Does the machine have enough power?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha l-potenza meħtieġa għal dan ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha l-potenza meħtieġa għal dan ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 够，它有完成这项工作所需的功率。
messages.en: Yes, it has the power needed for this job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 potenza 配两张记忆卡：机器旁写“功率”，世界地图旁写“强国”，用场景区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Possible in the future, although not yet actual or realized.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将来可能出现或实现、目前尚未成为现实的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jseħħ jew isir realtà fil-futur, iżda għadu ma seħħx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潜在的，可能成为现实的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika problema potenzjali li teħtieġ aktar studju.
formal.en: The report identifies a potential problem that requires further study.
formal.zh: 报告指出了一个需要进一步研究的潜在问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-raġel diġà xtara xi ħaġa mingħandna? Pawlu: Le, imma huwa klijent potenzjali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has that man already bought anything from us? Pawlu: No, but he is a potential customer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那位先生已经在我们这里买过东西了吗？保罗：没有，不过他是潜在客户。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel diġà xtara xi ħaġa mingħandna?
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel diġà xtara xi ħaġa mingħandna?
messages.zh: 那位先生已经在我们这里买过东西了吗？
messages.en: Has that man already bought anything from us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 没有，不过他是潜在客户。
messages.en: No, but he is a potential customer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象还在店门外考虑购买的人，用 klijent potenzjali 记“潜在客户”：有可能成为客户，但尚未购买。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A capacity or possibility for something to develop, happen, or become real.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物能够发展、发生或成为现实的潜力与可能性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila jew il-possibbiltà li xi ħaġa tiżviluppa, isseħħ jew issir realtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潜能，潜力；尚未实现的可能性。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-potenzjalità ta' din l-idea għal proġetti futuri.
formal.en: The study examines the potential of this idea for future projects.
formal.zh: 该研究考察了这一想法在未来项目中的应用潜力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li din l-idea tista' tiżviluppa? Pawlu: Iva, fiha potenzjalità kbira, imma għandna bżonn naħdmu fuqha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think this idea can develop? Pawlu: Yes, it has great potential, but we need to work on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这个想法能发展起来吗？保罗：能，它很有潜力，不过我们需要继续完善它。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li din l-idea tista' tiżviluppa?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li din l-idea tista' tiżviluppa?
messages.zh: 你觉得这个想法能发展起来吗？
messages.en: Do you think this idea can develop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fiha potenzjalità kbira, imma għandna bżonn naħdmu fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fiha potenzjalità kbira, imma għandna bżonn naħdmu fuqha.
messages.zh: 能，它很有潜力，不过我们需要继续完善它。
messages.en: Yes, it has great potential, but we need to work on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把尚未成形的想法画成一颗等待发芽的种子，用 potenzjalità 命名它所具有的“潜力”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that could become true or have a particular effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种情况或作用有可能出现，但尚未确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jista' jsir realtà jew ikollu effett partikolari, iżda għadu mhux ċert.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潜在地；有可能地，表示某种情况或作用可能出现。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi dan il-metodu bħala potenzjalment utli għal studji futuri.
formal.en: The report describes this method as potentially useful for future studies.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这一方法可能对未来的研究有用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inżommu din il-kaxxa vojta? Pawlu: Iva, hija potenzjalment utli meta niġu biex nippakkjaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we keep this empty box? Pawlu: Yes, it is potentially useful when we come to pack.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个空箱子要留着吗？保罗：要，等我们打包时可能用得上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个空箱子要留着吗？
messages.en: Shall we keep this empty box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija potenzjalment utli meta niġu biex nippakkjaw.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija potenzjalment utli meta niġu biex nippakkjaw.
messages.zh: 要，等我们打包时可能用得上。
messages.en: Yes, it is potentially useful when we come to pack.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 potenzjalment 想成一句话里的“可能”提示灯；读到 potenzjalment utli，就先想到“可能有用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the exercise of power or a person's will; expressing authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与权力的行使或个人意志有关的；表现出权威的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-eżerċizzju tas-setgħa jew mar-rieda ta' persuna; li jesprimi awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 权能的，与个人意志或权力行使有关的；有权威的。

collocations.zh: 可依权利人意志行使的权利

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-ton tal-ittra bħala potestattiv, għax jesprimi b'mod ċar l-awtorità tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The report describes the letter's tone as authoritative because it clearly expresses the committee's authority.
formal.zh: 报告将这封信的语气描述为具有权威性，因为它明确体现了委员会的权威。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien it-ton tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa? Mark: Kien potestattiv; tkellem b'awtorità u kulħadd semgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was his tone like during the meeting? Mark: It was authoritative; he spoke with authority and everyone listened.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他在会议上的语气怎么样？Mark：很有权威；他说话有威信，大家都听他讲。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien it-ton tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien it-ton tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 他在会议上的语气怎么样？
messages.en: What was his tone like during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien potestattiv; tkellem b'awtorità u kulħadd semgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien potestattiv; tkellem b'awtorità u kulħadd semgħu.
messages.zh: 很有权威；他说话有威信，大家都听他讲。
messages.en: It was authoritative; he spoke with authority and everyone listened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进会议场景：发言者掌握决定权，说话带有权威；由此联记权能与权威两个方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Power or authority to govern, make decisions, or act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行管理、作出决定或采取行动的权力与职权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Setgħa jew awtorità li wieħed imexxi, jieħu deċiżjonijiet jew jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 权力，职权；作出决定或实施管理的权威。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega l-limiti tal-potestà tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The document explains the limits of the committee's authority.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了委员会的职权范围。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għandu l-potestà li japprova din it-talba? Pawlu: Il-kumitat; aħna nistgħu biss nirrakkomandaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who has the authority to approve this request? Pawlu: The committee; we can only make a recommendation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁有权批准这项申请？保罗：委员会；我们只能提出建议。

messages.speaker: Maja (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għandu l-potestà li japprova din it-talba?
messages.mt_standard: Min għandu l-potestà li japprova din it-talba?
messages.zh: 谁有权批准这项申请？
messages.en: Who has the authority to approve this request?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (行政同事)
messages.zh: 委员会；我们只能提出建议。
messages.en: The committee; we can only make a recommendation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象申请表上的批准印章，用 potestà 记“谁有权盖章”；再联系委员会的职权范围来巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small toilet or chamber pot used by a young child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供幼儿学习如厕时使用的小便盆或小坐便器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent żgħir li tifel jew tifla jużaw biex jagħmlu l-bżonnijiet tagħhom meta jkunu qed jitgħallmu jużaw it-tojlit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼儿便盆；供幼儿使用的小坐便器。

formal.mt: Meta t-tifel ikun lest biex jitgħallem juża l-poti, l-adulti għandhom jgħinuh bil-paċenzja.
formal.en: When the child is ready to learn to use the potty, adults should help him patiently.
formal.zh: 当孩子准备好学习使用幼儿便盆时，大人应耐心地帮助他。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn hu l-poti ta' Ben? Pawlu: Fil-kamra tal-banju, ħdejn it-tojlit.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where is Ben's potty? Pawlu: In the bathroom, next to the toilet.
colloquial.zh: Lina：Ben的幼儿便盆在哪里？Pawlu：在浴室里，马桶旁边。

messages.speaker: Lina (母亲)
messages.zh: Ben的幼儿便盆在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Ben's potty?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 在浴室里，马桶旁边。
messages.en: In the bathroom, next to the toilet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象浴室里大马桶旁边放着一个儿童小便盆，把 poti 与幼儿学习如厕的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of lacking enough money or resources to meet basic needs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏足够金钱或资源，难以满足基本生活需要的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' min ma għandux biżżejjed flus jew riżorsi biex jissodisfa l-ħtiġijiet bażiċi tal-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫困；缺乏维持基本生活所需金钱或资源的状态。

formal.mt: Il-programm għandu l-għan li jnaqqas il-povertà billi jtejjeb l-aċċess għax-xogħol u għall-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The programme aims to reduce poverty by improving access to employment and education.
formal.zh: 该计划旨在通过改善就业和教育机会来减少贫困。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed niġbru l-ikel? David: Biex ngħinu lill-familji li jgħixu fil-povertà.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we collecting food? David: To help families living in poverty.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们为什么要募集食物？David：为了帮助生活在贫困中的家庭。

messages.speaker: Sara (志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要募集食物？
messages.en: Why are we collecting food?

messages.speaker: David (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ngħinu lill-familji li jgħixu fil-povertà.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ngħinu lill-familji li jgħixu fil-povertà.
messages.zh: 为了帮助生活在贫困中的家庭。
messages.en: To help families living in poverty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个短语成对记忆：生活在贫困中、努力减少贫困；把 povertà 固定联到基本生活资源不足。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Knives, forks and spoons used for eating or serving food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃饭或分取食物时使用的刀、叉、匙等餐具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skieken, frieket u mgħaref li jintużaw biex wieħed jiekol jew iservi l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刀、叉、匙等餐具。

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu jiżgura li l-pożati jkunu nodfa qabel ma jitqiegħdu fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: The staff must ensure that the cutlery is clean before it is placed on the table.
formal.zh: 工作人员必须确保刀叉匙清洁后再将其摆上餐桌。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tista' ġġib il-pożati, jekk jogħġbok? Mark: Iva, inġib il-frieket, is-skieken u l-imgħaref issa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you bring the cutlery, please? Mark: Yes, I'll bring the forks, knives and spoons now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：请把餐具拿来，好吗？Mark：好，我现在就拿叉子、刀和匙来。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 请把餐具拿来，好吗？
messages.en: Can you bring the cutlery, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inġib il-frieket, is-skieken u l-imgħaref issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inġib il-frieket, is-skieken u l-imgħaref issa.
messages.zh: 好，我现在就拿叉子、刀和匙来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll bring the forks, knives and spoons now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐桌旁并排摆好的刀、叉、匙，三样一起叫 pożati；用整套餐具的画面记住这个词。

gloss_zh: 栖居；以某处为栖息地，尤指鸟类

teaching_sense.en_definition: To live in or use a particular place as a habitat, especially of a bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某处栖居，把该处作为栖息地，尤用于鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħix f'post jew jużah bħala l-post fejn joqgħod, speċjalment meta jingħad dwar għasfur.

sense_translations.en_definition: to use a place as a habitat (used especially of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以某处为栖息地；栖居，尤用于鸟类。

collocations.en: used a tree as a habitat
made its home in the woodland

formal.mt: L-għasfur pożda fil-bosk ħdejn ix-xmara, fejn sab kenn u ikel.
formal.en: The bird made its home in the woodland beside the river, where it found shelter and food.
formal.zh: 这只鸟在河边的林地中栖居，在那里找到了庇护之所和食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn pożda dak l-għasfur? Toni: Fis-siġra l-kbira wara d-dar; ilu jgħix hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did that bird make its home? Toni: In the big tree behind the house; it has been living there for some time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那只鸟在哪里安了家？Toni：在屋后的大树上；它在那里住了一段时间了。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 那只鸟在哪里安了家？
messages.en: Where did that bird make its home?

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-siġra l-kbira wara d-dar; ilu jgħix hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-siġra l-kbira wara d-dar; ilu jgħix hemm.
messages.zh: 在屋后的大树上；它在那里住了一段时间了。
messages.en: In the big tree behind the house; it has been living there for some time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只鸟把屋后的大树当作家，反复在那里生活；用这个安家栖居的画面记 pożda。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in an activity, event or shared undertaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入某项活动、事件或共同事务，并在其中参与行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu sehem f'attività, avveniment jew ħidma ma' oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加；参与某项活动或共同事务。

formal.mt: Kull student li pparteċipa fil-proġett ippreżenta r-riżultati tiegħu lill-klassi.
formal.en: Every student who participated in the project presented their results to the class.
formal.zh: 每位参与该项目的学生都向全班展示了自己的成果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk ukoll pparteċipa fil-kompetizzjoni? Ben: Iva, pparteċipa u ħa gost ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did your brother participate in the competition too? Ben: Yes, he took part and really enjoyed it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你哥哥也参加那场比赛了吗？Ben：是啊，他参加了，而且很开心。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥也参加那场比赛了吗？
messages.en: Did your brother participate in the competition too?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, pparteċipa u ħa gost ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, pparteċipa u ħa gost ħafna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他参加了，而且很开心。
messages.en: Yes, he took part and really enjoyed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pparteċipa 与亲自加入活动的画面绑定：参加比赛、参与讨论，都强调自己也在其中出一份力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass into or through something, reaching its interior or the other side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入某物内部，或穿过某种材料、表层或障碍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol fil-ġewwieni ta' xi ħaġa jew jgħaddi minn ġo fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿透；渗入；进入某物内部。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, l-ilma ppenetra fil-ħamrija u laħaq l-għeruq tal-pjanti.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, the water penetrated the soil and reached the plants' roots.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，水渗入土壤，到达了植物的根部。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-ħajt hu mxarrab minn ġewwa? Pawlu: L-ilma ppenetra minn ġol-ħajt waqt ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is the wall wet on the inside? Pawlu: Water penetrated through the wall during the rain.
colloquial.zh: Nina：为什么墙的内侧湿了？Pawlu：下雨时水穿过墙体渗进来了。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħajt hu mxarrab minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħajt hu mxarrab minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 为什么墙的内侧湿了？
messages.en: Why is the wall wet on the inside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma ppenetra minn ġol-ħajt waqt ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma ppenetra minn ġol-ħajt waqt ix-xita.
messages.zh: 下雨时水穿过墙体渗进来了。
messages.en: Water penetrated through the wall during the rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨水从表面一路进入土壤深处，用从外到内的箭头记 ppenetra，抓住穿透或渗入的方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To subject a person or group to repeated cruel or unfair treatment, especially because of their identity or beliefs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人的身份、信仰等原因，对其本人或所属群体反复施加残酷或不公正的待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta persuna jew grupp bi krudeltà jew b'inġustizzja ripetuta, speċjalment minħabba l-identità jew it-twemmin tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迫害；因身份、信仰等原因持续欺压或残酷对待某人或某个群体。

collocations.en: persecuted people because of their beliefs
collocations.zh: 因人们的信仰而迫害他们

formal.mt: Ir-reġim ppersegwita lil dawk li esprimew opinjonijiet differenti u ċaħħadhom minn drittijiet bażiċi.
formal.en: The regime persecuted those who expressed different opinions and deprived them of basic rights.
formal.zh: 该政权迫害表达不同意见的人，并剥夺了他们的基本权利。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dik il-familja telqet minn pajjiżha? Mark: Ir-reġim ppersegwitaha minħabba t-twemmin tagħha, u kellha titlaq biex tkun sigura.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did that family leave their country? Mark: The regime persecuted them because of their beliefs, and they had to leave to be safe.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那个家庭为什么离开自己的国家？Mark：政权因他们的信仰而迫害他们，他们只好离开以确保安全。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dik il-familja telqet minn pajjiżha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dik il-familja telqet minn pajjiżha?
messages.zh: 那个家庭为什么离开自己的国家？
messages.en: Why did that family leave their country?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-reġim ppersegwitaha minħabba t-twemmin tagħha, u kellha titlaq biex tkun sigura.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-reġim ppersegwitaha minħabba t-twemmin tagħha, u kellha titlaq biex tkun sigura.
messages.zh: 政权因他们的信仰而迫害他们，他们只好离开以确保安全。
messages.en: The regime persecuted them because of their beliefs, and they had to leave to be safe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个家庭因信仰而反复遭受不公待遇的故事记 ppersegwita，抓住持续迫害这一核心意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hit someone or something repeatedly with the fists.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用拳头连续击打某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa ripetutament bil-ponn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用拳头连续猛击；接连拳打。

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, il-boxer pponnja l-borża għal ftit minuti.
formal.en: During training, the boxer pummelled the bag for a few minutes.
formal.zh: 训练时，那名拳击手连续击打沙袋几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Mark fit-taħriġ illum? Lara: Pponnja l-borża u mbagħad straħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark do at training today? Lara: He pummelled the bag and then rested a little.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark今天训练时做了什么？Lara：他连续打了沙袋，然后休息了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark今天训练时做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark do at training today?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pponnja l-borża u mbagħad straħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Pponnja l-borża u mbagħad straħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他连续打了沙袋，然后休息了一会儿。
messages.en: He pummelled the bag and then rested a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和拳击手连续打沙袋的画面联系起来，重点记住“接连出拳”。

gloss_zh: 使有人居住；使人口迁入

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause people to live in a place or fill a place with inhabitants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人们迁入并居住在某地，为该地增加居民。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel jew iwassal biex in-nies imorru jgħixu f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某地有人居住；向某地迁入居民。

collocations.zh: 使一片空旷地区有了居民

formal.mt: Il-proġett tad-djar ppopola ż-żona b'familji ġodda.
formal.en: The housing project populated the area with new families.
formal.zh: 该住宅项目使新的家庭迁入这片地区居住。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ppopola din il-belt fil-logħba? Mark: Ħija. Żied ħafna familji ġodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who populated this city in the game? Mark: My brother. He added lots of new families.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁给游戏里的这座城市安排了居民？Mark：我哥哥。他添加了很多新家庭。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给游戏里的这座城市安排了居民？
messages.en: Who populated this city in the game?

messages.speaker: Mark (游戏玩家)
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他添加了很多新家庭。
messages.en: My brother. He added lots of new families.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上一片空地逐渐出现住户，用“让地方住进人”记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something widely known, liked, or used by many people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物广为人知、受到欢迎或得到广泛使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa magħrufa, maħbuba jew użata minn ħafna nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推广某事物，使其普及或流行。

collocations.zh: 使一种音乐风格流行起来

formal.mt: Il-programm televiżiv ppopolarizza x-xjenza fost it-tfal permezz ta' esperimenti sempliċi.
formal.en: The television programme popularized science among children through simple experiments.
formal.zh: 这档电视节目通过简单实验向儿童普及科学知识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sar daqshekk popolari dan iż-żfin? Mark: Kantant famuż ppopolarizza dan iż-żfin bil-vidjows tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did this dance become so popular? Mark: A famous singer popularized it through his videos.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种舞蹈怎么变得这么流行？Mark：一位著名歌手通过自己的视频把它带火了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sar daqshekk popolari dan iż-żfin?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sar daqshekk popolari dan iż-żfin?
messages.zh: 这种舞蹈怎么变得这么流行？
messages.en: How did this dance become so popular?

messages.mt_spoken: Kantant famuż ppopolarizza dan iż-żfin bil-vidjows tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Kantant famuż ppopolarizza dan iż-żfin bil-vidjows tiegħu.
messages.zh: 一位著名歌手通过自己的视频把这种舞蹈带火了。
messages.en: A famous singer popularized this dance through his videos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“从少数人知道到大家都知道”的传播画面，记住推广和普及的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move a planned event or action to a later time or date.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把原定的活动或行动改到更晚的时间或日期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imexxi avveniment jew azzjoni ppjanata għal ħin jew data aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推迟原定事项；使延期。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ppospona l-laqgħa għal nhar it-Tnejn minħabba l-maltemp.
formal.en: The committee postponed the meeting until Monday because of the bad weather.
formal.zh: 由于天气恶劣，委员会把会议推迟到了星期一。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark telaq għall-vaganza? Maja: Le, ppospona l-vjaġġ għal ġimgħa oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Mark left for his holiday? Maja: No, he postponed the trip until next week.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark出发去度假了吗？Maja：没有，他把旅行推迟到下周了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark出发去度假了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark left for his holiday?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ppospona l-vjaġġ għal ġimgħa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ppospona l-vjaġġ għal ġimgħa oħra.
messages.zh: 没有，他把旅行推迟到下周了。
messages.en: No, he postponed the trip until next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把日历上的会议标记往后挪，记住“事情仍要做，只是时间推后”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To determine someone's fate or future in advance, especially through divine will.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预先决定某人的命运或未来，尤指通过神的意志加以预定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeċiedi minn qabel id-destin jew il-futur ta' xi ħadd, speċjalment permezz tar-rieda ta' Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先决定命运；使注定，尤用于宗教语境。

collocations.mt: ppredestina lil xi ħadd għal għan
collocations.zh: 预定某人去实现某个目的

formal.mt: Skont it-twemmin deskritt fit-test, Alla ppredestina lil kull persuna għal għan partikolari.
formal.en: According to the belief described in the text, God predestined each person for a particular purpose.
formal.zh: 按照文中描述的信仰，上帝预定每个人去实现某个特定目的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li xi ħadd ppredestina ħajjitna? Mark: Ma nafx. Jien naħseb li l-għażliet tagħna jagħmlu differenza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think someone predestined our lives? Mark: I don't know. I think our choices make a difference.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得有人预先决定了我们的人生吗？Mark：我不知道。我觉得我们的选择会产生影响。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li xi ħadd ppredestina ħajjitna?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li xi ħadd ppredestina ħajjitna?
messages.zh: 你觉得有人预先决定了我们的人生吗？
messages.en: Do you think someone predestined our lives?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Jien naħseb li l-għażliet tagħna jagħmlu differenza.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Jien naħseb li l-għażliet tagħna jagħmlu differenza.
messages.zh: 我不知道。我觉得我们的选择会产生影响。
messages.en: I don't know. I think our choices make a difference.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事尚未开始，人物的命运已经被写好，用这个画面记住“预定命运”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To like or choose one thing more than another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相比另一事物，更喜欢或更愿意选择某一事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħobb jew jagħżel ħaġa aktar minn oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更喜欢；认为某一选择更合意；宁愿选择。

formal.mt: Wara li qabbel iż-żewġ proposti, il-kumitat ppreferixxa l-għażla bl-inqas spiża.
formal.en: After comparing the two proposals, the committee preferred the option with the lowest cost.
formal.zh: 比较两份提案后，委员会更倾向于费用最低的方案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex magħna? Lara: Kien għajjien u ppreferixxa jibqa' d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark come with us? Lara: He was tired and preferred to stay at home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么没跟我们一起来？Lara：他累了，更愿意待在家里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么没跟我们一起来？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark come with us?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien għajjien u ppreferixxa jibqa' d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Kien għajjien u ppreferixxa jibqa' d-dar.
messages.zh: 他累了，更愿意待在家里。
messages.en: He was tired and preferred to stay at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面前有茶和咖啡，你把手伸向更喜欢的一杯，记住比较中的偏好。

gloss_zh: 开处方；开具药物或治疗

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially direct a patient to use a medicine or treatment as a medical professional.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由医务专业人员正式为患者开具药物或指定治疗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bħala professjonist mediku, jordna uffiċjalment mediċina jew trattament għal pazjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开处方；为患者开具药物等。

formal.mt: Wara l-eżami, it-tabib ppreskriva mediċina u spjega lill-pazjent kif jużaha.
formal.en: After the examination, the doctor prescribed a medicine and explained to the patient how to use it.
formal.zh: 检查后，医生开了一种药，并向患者说明如何使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tabib ppreskriva xi mediċina? Mark: Iva, u spjegali kif għandi nużaha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the doctor prescribe any medicine? Mark: Yes, and he explained how I should use it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：医生开药了吗？Mark：开了，他还向我说明了该怎么用。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生开药了吗？
messages.en: Did the doctor prescribe any medicine?

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u spjegali kif għandi nużaha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u spjegali kif għandi nużaha.
messages.zh: 开了，他还向我说明了该怎么用。
messages.en: Yes, and he explained how I should use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和医生写下药名、交给患者处方的画面联系起来，记住“开处方”。

gloss_zh: 明确说明；准确指出；具体说明

teaching_sense.en_definition: To state something exactly and clearly, giving the specific details needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准确、清楚地说明某事，给出所需的具体细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid xi ħaġa b'mod eżatt u ċar, u jagħti d-dettalji meħtieġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to state, tell exactly, state exactly, specify
sense_translations.zh_definition: 陈述；准确告知；明确、具体地说明或指明。

formal.mt: Id-direttur ppreċiża li l-applikazzjonijiet għandhom jaslu sa nofsinhar tal-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The director specified that applications must arrive by noon on Friday.
formal.zh: 主任明确说明，申请必须在星期五中午之前送达。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-għalliem ppreċiża x'ħin jibda l-eżami? Mark: Iva, qal li jibda fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the teacher specify what time the exam starts? Mark: Yes, he said it starts at nine.
colloquial.zh: Maja：老师明确说考试几点开始了吗？Mark：说了，他说九点开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 老师明确说考试几点开始了吗？
messages.en: Did the teacher specify what time the exam starts?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 说了，他说九点开始。
messages.en: Yes, he said it starts at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把模糊的“上午”改成明确的“九点”，借此记住“准确、具体地说明”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deliver a religious talk that explains beliefs or encourages people to follow religious teachings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向听众讲解宗教信仰或教义，劝导人们依照教义生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti prietka biex jispjega t-tagħlim reliġjuż jew iħeġġeġ lin-nies jgħixu skont dak it-tagħlim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布道；向人宣讲宗教教义。

collocations.zh: 宣讲了有关宽恕的道理

formal.mt: Waqt il-quddiesa tal-Ħadd, il-kappillan ipprietka dwar l-importanza li ngħinu lill-proxxmu.
formal.en: During Sunday Mass, the parish priest preached about the importance of helping others.
formal.zh: 在星期日弥撒中，堂区神父宣讲了帮助他人的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dwar xiex ipprietka l-qassis illum? Pawlu: Dwar il-maħfra. Qal li għandna naħfru lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Marija: What did the priest preach about today? Pawlu: Forgiveness. He said we should forgive one another.
colloquial.zh: Marija：神父今天讲了什么？Pawlu：宽恕。他说我们应该彼此宽恕。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 神父今天讲了什么？
messages.en: What did the priest preach about today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-maħfra. Qal li għandna naħfru lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-maħfra. Qal li għandna naħfru lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 宽恕。他说我们应该彼此宽恕。
messages.en: Forgiveness. He said we should forgive one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象神父站在讲坛上讲解宽恕，把 pprietka 与“向众人布道”的场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make goods, create a work, or generate something through an activity or process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过劳动、创作或某种过程制造产品、制作作品或产生某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel prodotti, joħloq xogħol artistiku jew jiġġenera xi ħaġa permezz ta' attività jew proċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生产或制作某物；通过某种过程产生某物。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena li għaddiet, dan l-impjant ipproduċa biżżejjed elettriku biex iforni elf dar.
formal.en: During the past year, this plant generated enough electricity to supply a thousand homes.
formal.zh: 在过去一年中，这座发电厂产生的电力足以供应一千户家庭。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ipproduċa dan il-film? Toni: Mario pproduċieh ma' tim żgħir minn Malta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who produced this film? Toni: Mario produced it with a small team from Malta.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这部电影是谁制作的？Toni：Mario 和一个来自马耳他的小团队制作的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部电影是谁制作的？
messages.en: Who produced this film?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Mario pproduċieh ma' tim żgħir minn Malta.
messages.zh: Mario 和一个来自马耳他的小团队制作的。
messages.en: Mario produced it with a small team from Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pproduċa 放进“工厂产出商品、团队制作电影”的画面，抓住“做出或产生东西”这一共同点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To help something gain attention or develop, or to raise someone to a higher position at work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使产品、活动或理念获得更多关注或发展，也可指将某人提升到更高的工作职位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħin biex prodott, attività jew idea jsiru aktar magħrufa jew jiżviluppaw, jew jagħti lil xi ħadd kariga ogħla fuq ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推广或促进某事；也可指晋升某人。

formal.mt: Waqt il-fiera, ir-rappreżentant ip promwova prodotti lokali u spjega kif isiru.
formal.en: At the fair, the representative promoted local products and explained how they are made.
formal.zh: 在展会上，代表推广了本地产品，并介绍了它们的制作方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt li l-maniġer ippromwova lil Pawlu? Toni: Iva, issa Pawlu huwa responsabbli mit-tim kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear that the manager promoted Pawlu? Toni: Yes, Pawlu is now responsible for the whole team.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你听说经理给 Pawlu 升职了吗？Toni：听说了，Pawlu 现在负责整个团队。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li l-maniġer ippromwova lil Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li l-maniġer ippromwova lil Pawlu?
messages.zh: 你听说经理给 Pawlu 升职了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that the manager promoted Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa Pawlu huwa responsabbli mit-tim kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa Pawlu huwa responsabbli mit-tim kollu.
messages.zh: 听说了，Pawlu 现在负责整个团队。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu is now responsible for the whole team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把产品推向更多人、把员工提升到更高职位”两个画面记 ppromwova，注意根据宾语选择中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put forward an idea, plan, or action for other people to consider.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提出一个想法、计划或行动方案，供他人考虑或讨论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iressaq idea, pjan jew azzjoni biex oħrajn jikkunsidrawhom jew jiddiskutuhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提议；提出想法、计划或方案供人考虑。

collocations.en: proposed a change to the plan

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Mario ppropona bidla fil-pjan biex jitnaqqsu l-ispejjeż.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mario proposed a change to the plan to reduce costs.
formal.zh: 会议期间，Mario 提议修改计划，以降低成本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ippropona Mario għall-Ħadd? Pawlu: Ippropona li mmorru Għawdex jekk it-temp ikun tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Mario suggest for Sunday? Pawlu: He suggested that we go to Gozo if the weather is good.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mario 对星期日有什么提议？Pawlu：他提议，如果天气好，我们就去戈佐岛。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Mario 对星期日有什么提议？
messages.en: What did Mario suggest for Sunday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ippropona li mmorru Għawdex jekk it-temp ikun tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Ippropona li mmorru Għawdex jekk it-temp ikun tajjeb.
messages.zh: 他提议，如果天气好，我们就去戈佐岛。
messages.en: He suggested that we go to Gozo if the weather is good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开会时有人举手说“我有个建议”，把 ppropona 与“提出方案让大家考虑”的动作相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep someone or something safe from danger, injury, or damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采取措施，使人或事物免受危险、伤害或损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa mill-periklu, mill-ħsara jew minn korriment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保护；使人或事物免受危险或损害。

collocations.en: protected the documents from the rain

formal.mt: Matul ix-xogħol ta' restawr, it-tim ipproteġa l-pitturi mit-trab billi għattiehom b'materjal adattat.
formal.en: During the restoration work, the team protected the paintings from dust by covering them with suitable material.
formal.zh: 修复期间，团队用合适的材料覆盖画作，保护它们免受灰尘影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kotba xxarrbu fix-xita? Toni: Le, Mario pproteġiehom b'borża tal-plastik.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the books get wet in the rain? Toni: No, Mario protected them with a plastic bag.
colloquial.zh: Lara：书被雨淋湿了吗？Toni：没有，Mario 用塑料袋把它们保护好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 书被雨淋湿了吗？
messages.en: Did the books get wet in the rain?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，Mario 用塑料袋把它们保护好了。
messages.en: No, Mario protected them with a plastic bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pproteġa 想成雨中给书套上防水袋：先辨认“保护什么”，再留意“防止什么伤害”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To plan something in advance by deciding what will be done and how it will be carried out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预先确定要做什么以及如何实施，为某项工作或活动制订计划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifassal minn qabel x'se jsir u kif se jitwettaq xogħol jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规划；预先为某事安排内容与实施步骤。

collocations.en: planned the work for next year

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ipproġetta ċentru komunitarju ġdid biex joffri aktar spazju għall-attivitajiet tar-residenti.
formal.en: The council planned a new community centre to provide more space for residents' activities.
formal.zh: 地方议会规划了一座新的社区中心，以便为居民活动提供更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Mario diġà pproġetta x-xogħol għas-sena d-dieħla? Toni: Iva, u għada se jispjegalna l-pjan.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has Mario already planned the work for next year? Toni: Yes, and tomorrow he will explain the plan to us.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mario 已经规划好明年的工作了吗？Toni：是的，他明天会向我们说明计划。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mario diġà pproġetta x-xogħol għas-sena d-dieħla?
messages.mt_standard: Mario diġà pproġetta x-xogħol għas-sena d-dieħla?
messages.zh: Mario 已经规划好明年的工作了吗？
messages.en: Has Mario already planned the work for next year?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għada se jispjegalna l-pjan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għada se jispjegalna l-pjan.
messages.zh: 是的，他明天会向我们说明计划。
messages.en: Yes, and tomorrow he will explain the plan to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 pproġetta，就想象先在纸上安排未来工作的步骤，用“提前规划”把词义固定下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a book, article, report, or other material available to the public in print or online.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以印刷或网络等方式，使书籍、文章、报告或其他资料向公众公开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ktieb, artiklu, rapport jew materjal ieħor disponibbli għall-pubbliku, stampat jew fuq l-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出版书籍；发表文章；向公众公布资料。

formal.mt: Id-dipartiment ippubblika rapport dwar il-kwalità tal-ilma fuq is-sit elettroniku tiegħu.
formal.en: The department published a report on water quality on its website.
formal.zh: 该部门在其网站上公布了一份水质报告。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Mario diġà ppubblika l-ktieb il-ġdid? Pawlu: Iva, ħareġ il-ġimgħa li għaddiet. Tista' ssibu fil-ħanut tal-kotba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has Mario already published the new book? Pawlu: Yes, it came out last week. You can find it at the bookshop.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mario 的新书已经出版了吗？Pawlu：是的，上周出的。你可以在书店找到。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Mario 的新书已经出版了吗？
messages.en: Has Mario already published the new book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħareġ il-ġimgħa li għaddiet. Tista' ssibu fil-ħanut tal-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħareġ il-ġimgħa li għaddiet. Tista' ssibu fil-ħanut tal-kotba.
messages.zh: 是的，上周出的。你可以在书店找到。
messages.en: Yes, it came out last week. You can find it at the bookshop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象写好的书上架、报告上传公开网站，用“让公众看得到”串起 ppubblika 的出版、发表和公布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove unwanted or harmful substances from something so that it becomes cleaner or purer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除某物中不需要或有害的物质，使其更清洁或更纯净。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi sustanzi mhux mixtieqa jew ta' ħsara minn xi ħaġa biex jagħmilha aktar nadifa jew pura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 净化；去除杂质或有害物质，使某物更纯净。

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, it-tekniku ppurifika l-ilma permezz ta' distillazzjoni biex ineħħi l-melħ maħlul fih.
formal.en: During the experiment, the technician purified the water by distillation to remove the salt dissolved in it.
formal.zh: 实验期间，技术员通过蒸馏净化水，以去除其中溶解的盐。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel Mario bl-ilma tal-esperiment? Toni: L-ewwel ippurifikah, imbagħad poġġieh fi flixkun nadif.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mario do with the water for the experiment? Toni: First he purified it, then he put it in a clean bottle.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mario 怎么处理实验用水的？Toni：他先把水净化了，然后装进一个干净的瓶子。

messages.speaker: Lara (实验室同事)
messages.zh: Mario 怎么处理实验用水的？
messages.en: What did Mario do with the water for the experiment?

messages.speaker: Toni (实验室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel ippurifikah, imbagħad poġġieh fi flixkun nadif.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel ippurifikah, imbagħad poġġieh fi flixkun nadif.
messages.zh: 他先把水净化了，然后装进一个干净的瓶子。
messages.en: First he purified it, then he put it in a clean bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象实验中把杂质从水里除去，再把纯净的水装瓶，用“去杂质、变纯净”记住 ppurifika。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A metallic chemical element called praseodymium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种名为镨的金属化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku metalliku msejjaħ praseodimju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镨，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-laboratorju, l-istudenta ddeskriviet il-kampjun ta' praseodimju.
formal.en: In the laboratory report, the student described the sample of praseodymium.
formal.zh: 在实验报告中，这名女学生描述了那份镨样品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu l-isem ta' dan l-element? Pawlu: Praseodimju. Qed naqra dwaru għall-lezzjoni tal-kimika.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the name of this element? Pawlu: Praseodymium. I'm reading about it for chemistry class.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这种元素叫什么名字？保罗：镨。我正在为化学课阅读有关它的资料。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这种元素叫什么名字？
messages.en: What is the name of this element?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Praseodimju. Qed naqra dwaru għall-lezzjoni tal-kimika.
messages.mt_standard: Praseodimju. Qed naqra dwaru għall-lezzjoni tal-kimika.
messages.zh: 镨。我正在为化学课阅读有关它的资料。
messages.en: Praseodymium. I'm reading about it for chemistry class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个较长的词写在元素卡片上，背面写“镨”；每次连读“元素名称—镨—praseodimju”，用化学课堂画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A confused mess, or a fuss involving unnecessary commotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杂乱不清的局面，也可指引起喧闹的一阵折腾或大惊小怪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni mħawda, jew storbju u għaġeb żejjed dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一团混乱；杂乱不清的局面。
一阵喧闹、骚动或大惊小怪；这里不是指待办事项。

collocations.zh: 大惊小怪；闹出一阵动静

formal.mt: Il-bidliet fl-aħħar minuta ħolqu praspura sħiħa fl-organizzazzjoni tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The last-minute changes created a complete muddle in the organisation of the meeting.
formal.zh: 最后一刻的改动使会议安排陷入了一团混乱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tagħmel din il-praspura kollha? Mark: Ħsibt li tlift iċ-ċwievet, imma kienu fil-but!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you making all this fuss? Mark: I thought I'd lost my keys, but they were in my pocket!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么闹出这么大动静？马克：我以为钥匙丢了，结果它们就在口袋里！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tagħmel din il-praspura kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tagħmel din il-praspura kollha?
messages.zh: 你怎么闹出这么大动静？
messages.en: Why are you making all this fuss?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħsibt li tlift iċ-ċwievet, imma kienu fil-but!
messages.mt_standard: Ħsibt li tlift iċ-ċwievet, imma kienu fil-but!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象找钥匙时把桌面翻得乱七八糟，又惊动所有人：乱成一团和闹出动静这两个画面，都可以帮助记住 praspura。

gloss_zh: 预定的；具有预先决定作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the effect or function of determining a person's destiny or an outcome in advance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有预先决定人的命运或某种结果的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-effett jew il-funzjoni li jiddetermina minn qabel id-destin ta' persuna jew ir-riżultat ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有预定作用的；预先决定命运或结果的。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test teoloġiku, l-awtriċi tispjega l-effett predestinattiv tad-digriet divin.
formal.en: In her analysis of the theological text, the author explains the predestinative effect of the divine decree.
formal.zh: 作者在分析这篇神学文本时，解释了神圣谕令预先决定命运的作用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser 'predestinattiv' f'dan il-kapitlu? David: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tiddetermina d-destin minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'predestinative' mean in this chapter? David: It means that something determines destiny in advance.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这一章里的“具有预定作用的”是什么意思？戴维：意思是某种事物预先决定了命运。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这一章里的“具有预定作用的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'predestinative' mean in this chapter?

messages.speaker: David (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tiddetermina d-destin minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tiddetermina d-destin minn qabel.
messages.zh: 意思是某种事物预先决定了命运。
messages.en: It means that something determines destiny in advance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住它是修饰词：给“谕令”贴上“预先决定命运的”标签，就是 predestinattiv；重点记其作用，不把它当成人的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who believes in predestination, especially the belief that God determines human destinies in advance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相信预定论的人，尤指相信上帝预先决定人类命运的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li temmen fil-predestinazzjoni, speċjalment li Alla jiddetermina minn qabel id-destin tal-bnedmin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预定论者；相信命运已被预先决定的人。

formal.mt: Fl-esej, il-predestinazjan jiddefendi l-fehma li d-destin tal-bniedem huwa determinat minn qabel minn Alla.
formal.en: In the essay, the predestinarian defends the view that human destiny is determined in advance by God.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，这位预定论者为上帝预先决定人类命运的观点进行辩护。

colloquial.mt: Elena: L-awtur jgħid li hu predestinazjan. Xi jfisser? Ġorġ: Li jemmen fil-predestinazzjoni, jiġifieri li d-destin hu determinat minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Elena: The author says he is a predestinarian. What does that mean? Ġorġ: That he believes in predestination, meaning that destiny is determined in advance.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：作者说自己是预定论者。这是什么意思？乔治：就是说他相信预定论，也就是命运已经被预先决定。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-awtur jgħid li hu predestinazjan. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: L-awtur jgħid li hu predestinazjan. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 作者说自己是预定论者。这是什么意思？
messages.en: The author says he is a predestinarian. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li jemmen fil-predestinazzjoni, jiġifieri li d-destin hu determinat minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Li jemmen fil-predestinazzjoni, jiġifieri li d-destin hu determinat minn qabel.
messages.zh: 就是说他相信预定论，也就是命运已经被预先决定。
messages.en: That he believes in predestination, meaning that destiny is determined in advance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个举着“我相信命运已被预定”牌子的人，把 predestinazjan 写在人像下面；用“持这种信念的人”记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The determination of destiny in advance, especially the religious doctrine that God has already determined human destinies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 命运被预先决定，尤指上帝已预先决定人类命运的宗教教义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-determinazzjoni tad-destin minn qabel, speċjalment id-duttrina reliġjuża li Alla diġà ddetermina d-destin tal-bnedmin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预定；命运被预先决定，尤指宗教上的预定论。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-relazzjoni bejn il-predestinazzjoni u l-libertà tal-għażla fil-ħsieb reliġjuż.
formal.en: The study examines the relationship between predestination and freedom of choice in religious thought.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察宗教思想中预定论与选择自由之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Illum iddiskutejna l-predestinazzjoni fil-klassi. Luqa: Jiġifieri l-idea li d-destin ikun diġà determinat minn qabel?
colloquial.en: Marija: We discussed predestination in class today. Luqa: You mean the idea that destiny has already been determined in advance?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：今天我们在课堂上讨论了预定论。卢卡：就是命运已经被预先决定的那种观念吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 今天我们在课堂上讨论了预定论。
messages.en: We discussed predestination in class today.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri l-idea li d-destin ikun diġà determinat minn qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri l-idea li d-destin ikun diġà determinat minn qabel?
messages.zh: 就是命运已经被预先决定的那种观念吗？
messages.en: You mean the idea that destiny has already been determined in advance?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“命运早已写好”当作理解预定论的课堂示意图，并在图旁写 predestinazzjoni；这是帮助理解概念的比喻，不是对信仰真假的判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In grammar, the part of a clause that says something about the subject; in logic, an expression of a property or relation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 语法中对主语作出陈述的部分；逻辑中表达性质或关系的谓词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-grammatika, il-parti tal-propożizzjoni li tgħid xi ħaġa dwar is-suġġett; fil-loġika, espressjoni ta' proprjetà jew relazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谓语，即句中对主语作出陈述的部分；也可指逻辑中的谓词。

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'It-tifel qiegħed jaqra', il-predikat 'qiegħed jaqra' jgħid x'qiegħed jagħmel is-suġġett.
formal.en: In the sentence 'The boy is reading', the predicate 'is reading' says what the subject is doing.
formal.zh: 在“男孩正在读书”这句话中，谓语“正在读书”说明主语正在做什么。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema hu l-predikat f''Il-qattus rieqed'? Ben: 'Rieqed', għax jgħid xi ħaġa dwar il-qattus.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is the predicate in 'The cat is asleep'? Ben: 'Is asleep', because it says something about the cat.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：“猫睡着了”这句话的谓语是什么？本：“睡着了”，因为它对猫作出了陈述。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: “猫睡着了”这句话的谓语是什么？
messages.en: What is the predicate in 'The cat is asleep'?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Rieqed', għax jgħid xi ħaġa dwar il-qattus.
messages.mt_standard: 'Rieqed', għax jgħid xi ħaġa dwar il-qattus.
messages.zh: “睡着了”，因为它对猫作出了陈述。
messages.en: 'Is asleep', because it says something about the cat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先圈出句子里的“谁或什么”，再给“对它说了什么”画下划线；下划线部分对应 predikat，用句子结构记住“谓语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who delivers sermons or publicly teaches a religious message.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向听众讲道或公开传讲宗教教义的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel prietki jew tgħallem messaġġ reliġjuż fil-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲道者；向听众传讲宗教教义的人。

formal.mt: Matul il-prietka, il-predikatur ħeġġeġ lis-semmiegħa biex jgħinu lil dawk fil-bżonn.
formal.en: During the sermon, the preacher encouraged the listeners to help those in need.
formal.zh: 讲道时，这位讲道者鼓励听众帮助有需要的人。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min se jagħmel il-prietka llum? Toni: Predikatur mistieden. Smajtu darba u jispjega kollox b'mod ċar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is giving the sermon today? Toni: A guest preacher. I heard him once, and he explains everything clearly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：今天谁来讲道？托尼：一位受邀的讲道者。我听过他讲道，他什么都解释得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Rita (教友)
messages.zh: 今天谁来讲道？
messages.en: Who is giving the sermon today?

messages.speaker: Toni (教友)
messages.mt_spoken: Predikatur mistieden. Smajtu darba u jispjega kollox b'mod ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Predikatur mistieden. Smajtu darba u jispjega kollox b'mod ċar.
messages.zh: 一位受邀的讲道者。我听过他讲道，他什么都解释得很清楚。
messages.en: A guest preacher. I heard him once, and he explains everything clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位站在听众前讲解宗教教义的人，把 predikatur 写在人物旁边；抓住“讲道的人”这个画面来记，不要和语法词“谓语”混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of delivering a religious message or explaining religious teachings to an audience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向听众宣讲宗教信息或讲解宗教教义的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li twassal messaġġ reliġjuż jew tispjega tagħlim reliġjuż lil udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲道；向听众宣讲宗教教义。

formal.mt: Il-predikazzjoni tas-saċerdot enfasizzat l-importanza tal-maħfra fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The priest's preaching emphasized the importance of forgiveness in everyday life.
formal.zh: 神父的讲道强调了宽恕在日常生活中的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'kien is-suġġett tal-predikazzjoni tal-lum? Pawlu: Il-maħfra u kif nittrattaw lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Marija: What was the subject of today's preaching? Pawlu: Forgiveness and how we treat one another.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：今天讲道的主题是什么？保罗：宽恕，以及我们如何对待彼此。

messages.speaker: Marija (教友)
messages.zh: 今天讲道的主题是什么？
messages.en: What was the subject of today's preaching?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maħfra u kif nittrattaw lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maħfra u kif nittrattaw lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 宽恕，以及我们如何对待彼此。
messages.en: Forgiveness and how we treat one another.
