cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进教堂讲道的画面：一人宣讲，众人聆听，记住它表示讲道这一活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving someone an advantage or more favorable treatment than others receive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人相较他人更有利的待遇或条件的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti lil xi ħadd vantaġġ jew trattament aħjar minn dak li jingħata lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 优待的；给予优先待遇或优惠条件的。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jipprovdi tariffa preferenzjali għall-membri tal-assoċjazzjoni.
formal.en: The agreement provides a preferential rate for members of the association.
formal.zh: 该协议为协会会员提供优惠费率。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ħallast inqas minni? Lara: Għandi karta tas-sħubija u nieħu tariffa preferenzjali.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you pay less than I did? Lara: I have a membership card and get a preferential rate.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么比我付得少？拉拉：我有会员卡，可以享受优惠费率。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你为什么比我付得少？
messages.en: Why did you pay less than I did?

messages.speaker: Lara (会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi karta tas-sħubija u nieħu tariffa preferenzjali.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi karta tas-sħubija u nieħu tariffa preferenzjali.
messages.zh: 我有会员卡，可以享受优惠费率。
messages.en: I have a membership card and get a preferential rate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会员出示卡片后享受优惠：这个词描述受到优待的条件，可与费率、待遇一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Better or more suitable to choose than another available option.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他可选方案相比，更值得选择或更合适的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun aħjar jew aktar xieraq li tagħżlu minn għażla oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更可取的；比较之下更值得选择的。

formal.mt: Huwa preferibbli li l-applikazzjoni tintbagħat qabel l-aħħar jum.
formal.en: It is preferable to submit the application before the final day.
formal.zh: 最好在截止日期的最后一天之前提交申请。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nitilqu issa jew wara l-ikel? David: Huwa preferibbli li nitilqu issa, għax wara jkun hemm ħafna traffiku.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we leave now or after lunch? David: It is preferable to leave now, because there will be a lot of traffic later.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们现在出发，还是午饭后出发？戴维：现在出发更好，因为之后车会很多。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们现在出发，还是午饭后出发？
messages.en: Shall we leave now or after lunch?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa preferibbli li nitilqu issa, għax wara jkun hemm ħafna traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa preferibbli li nitilqu issa, għax wara jkun hemm ħafna traffiku.
messages.zh: 现在出发更好，因为之后车会很多。
messages.en: It is preferable to leave now, because there will be a lot of traffic later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在两个方案之间画一个选择箭头，箭头指向更合适的方案，就把它标作 preferibbli。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fold of skin that covers the glans, or head, of the penis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖阴茎头的皮肤褶层，即包皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tinja tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包皮；覆盖阴茎头的皮肤褶层。

formal.mt: Il-manwal tal-anatomija jiddeskrivi l-prepuzju bħala tinja tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.
formal.en: The anatomy manual describes the foreskin as a fold of skin that covers the head of the penis.
formal.zh: 解剖学手册将包皮描述为覆盖阴茎头的皮肤褶层。

colloquial.mt: Adam: Xi jfisser prepuzju f'dan il-kapitlu? Rita: Il-prepuzju huwa tinja tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.
colloquial.en: Adam: What does prepuzju mean in this chapter? Rita: The foreskin is a fold of skin that covers the head of the penis.
colloquial.zh: 亚当：这一章中的 prepuzju 是什么意思？丽塔：包皮是覆盖阴茎头的皮肤褶层。

messages.speaker: Adam (学生)
messages.zh: 这一章中的 prepuzju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does prepuzju mean in this chapter?

messages.speaker: Rita (生物教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prepuzju huwa tinja tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prepuzju huwa tinja tal-ġilda li tgħatti r-ras tal-pene.
messages.zh: 包皮是覆盖阴茎头的皮肤褶层。
messages.en: The foreskin is a fold of skin that covers the head of the penis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在解剖示意图上把 prepuzju 与包皮标签配对，抓住覆盖阴茎头的皮肤褶层这一位置特征。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being precious, highly valuable, or deeply cherished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物十分宝贵、价值很高或深受珍视的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun prezzjuża, ta' valur kbir jew għażiża ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珍贵性；十分宝贵或值得珍视的性质。

formal.mt: Il-poeżija tesprimi l-prezzjożità tal-mumenti li nqattgħu mal-familja.
formal.en: The poem expresses the preciousness of the moments we spend with family.
formal.zh: 这首诗表达了与家人共度的时光有多么珍贵。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ktibt dwar din il-laqgħa fid-djarju? Ben: Ridt infakkar lili nnifsi fil-prezzjożità tal-mument.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you write about this gathering in your diary? Ben: I wanted to remind myself of the preciousness of the moment.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在日记里写下这次聚会？本：我想提醒自己，这一刻有多么珍贵。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ktibt dwar din il-laqgħa fid-djarju?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ktibt dwar din il-laqgħa fid-djarju?
messages.zh: 你为什么在日记里写下这次聚会？
messages.en: Why did you write about this gathering in your diary?

messages.speaker: Ben (日记作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ridt infakkar lili nnifsi fil-prezzjożità tal-mument.
messages.mt_standard: Ridt infakkar lili nnifsi fil-prezzjożità tal-mument.
messages.zh: 我想提醒自己，这一刻有多么珍贵。
messages.en: I wanted to remind myself of the preciousness of the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把难忘的一刻写进日记，所记录的那份珍贵就是 prezzjożità，记住它表示抽象性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being precise, exact, and clearly specified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达、说明或描述准确、明确而不含糊的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li xi ħaġa tkun preċiża, eżatta u definita b'mod ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精确性；准确而明确的性质。

formal.mt: Il-preċiżazzjoni fit-termini hija essenzjali biex il-qarrej jifhem ir-rapport mingħajr ambigwità.
formal.en: Preciseness in terminology is essential for the reader to understand the report without ambiguity.
formal.zh: 术语使用的准确性至关重要，能使读者理解报告而不产生歧义。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ktibt il-ħin eżatt saħansitra bis-sekondi? Adam: Għall-preċiżazzjoni; irrid li jkun ċar eżatt meta beda l-esperiment.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you write the exact time down to the second? Adam: For preciseness; I want it to be clear exactly when the experiment began.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把准确时间连秒数都写下来了？亚当：为了精确；我想清楚说明实验究竟什么时候开始。

messages.speaker: Nina (实验搭档)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ktibt il-ħin eżatt saħansitra bis-sekondi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ktibt il-ħin eżatt saħansitra bis-sekondi?
messages.zh: 你为什么把准确时间连秒数都写下来了？
messages.en: Why did you write the exact time down to the second?

messages.speaker: Adam (实验搭档)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-preċiżazzjoni; irrid li jkun ċar eżatt meta beda l-esperiment.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-preċiżazzjoni; irrid li jkun ċar eżatt meta beda l-esperiment.
messages.zh: 为了精确；我想清楚说明实验究竟什么时候开始。
messages.en: For preciseness; I want it to be clear exactly when the experiment began.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“下午开始”改成“下午三点零五分开始”，比较两种表达的准确程度；用这个具体对比记住 preċiżazzjoni 的“精确性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having considerable value or being highly prized for quality, rarity, or importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有较高价值，或因品质、稀有性、重要性而备受珍视的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu valur kbir jew huwa apprezzat ħafna għall-kwalità, ir-rarità jew l-importanza tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贵重的；珍贵的；具有很高价值或备受珍视的。

formal.mt: Il-kollezzjoni tinkludi armarju magħmul minn injam preġjat.
formal.en: The collection includes a cabinet made from valuable timber.
formal.zh: 该藏品系列中包括一个用名贵木材制作的柜子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed iżżomm dan l-arloġġ f'kaxxa? Toni: Huwa oġġett preġjat li ħallieli n-nannu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you keeping this watch in a box? Toni: It is a precious object that my grandfather left me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把这块手表放在盒子里？托尼：这是祖父留给我的珍贵物品。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iżżomm dan l-arloġġ f'kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iżżomm dan l-arloġġ f'kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你为什么把这块手表放在盒子里？
messages.en: Why are you keeping this watch in a box?

messages.speaker: Toni (手表主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa oġġett preġjat li ħallieli n-nannu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa oġġett preġjat li ħallieli n-nannu.
messages.zh: 这是祖父留给我的珍贵物品。
messages.en: It is a precious object that my grandfather left me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件被小心放进盒中的传家宝，用 preġjat 给它贴上珍贵的标签，记住这是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The value or worth of something, including the qualities that make it appreciated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物具有的价值，包括使其受到重视的可贵品质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur ta' xi ħaġa, inklużi l-kwalitajiet li jagħmluha apprezzata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价值；某事物值得重视或欣赏之处。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-preġju artistiku ta' din il-pittura.
formal.en: The report emphasizes the artistic worth of this painting.
formal.zh: 报告强调了这幅画的艺术价值。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan il-ktieb antik għandu xi preġju? Mark: Iva, huwa ta' preġju kbir għall-istorja tar-raħal.
colloquial.en: Elena: Does this old book have any value? Mark: Yes, it is of great value to the history of the village.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这本旧书有什么价值吗？马克：有，它对村庄的历史很有价值。

messages.speaker: Elena (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb antik għandu xi preġju?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb antik għandu xi preġju?
messages.zh: 这本旧书有什么价值吗？
messages.en: Does this old book have any value?

messages.speaker: Mark (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa ta' preġju kbir għall-istorja tar-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa ta' preġju kbir għall-istorja tar-raħal.
messages.zh: 有，它对村庄的历史很有价值。
messages.en: Yes, it is of great value to the history of the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到旧书先问它有什么价值，把答案中的价值本身记作 preġju；它是可以被讨论的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female member of a royal family with the title of princess, such as a monarch's daughter or a prince's wife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有公主或王妃头衔的王室女性，例如君主的女儿或王子的妻子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara tal-familja rjali li għandha t-titlu ta' prinċipessa, bħal bint monarka jew il-mara ta' prinċep.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公主；王妃；拥有相应王室头衔的女性。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-prinċipessa żagħżugħa titlaq mill-palazz biex tgħin lin-nies tar-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, the young princess leaves the palace to help the villagers.
formal.zh: 故事中，年轻的公主离开宫殿，去帮助村民。

colloquial.mt: Mia: Min hi t-tifla bil-kuruna f'din l-istampa? Anna: Hija l-prinċipessa tal-istorja li se naqraw illejla.
colloquial.en: Mia: Who is the girl with the crown in this picture? Anna: She is the princess in the story we are going to read tonight.
colloquial.zh: 米娅：这张图里戴王冠的女孩是谁？安娜：她是我们今晚要读的故事里的公主。

messages.speaker: Mia (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hi t-tifla bil-kuruna f'din l-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hi t-tifla bil-kuruna f'din l-istampa?
messages.zh: 这张图里戴王冠的女孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is the girl with the crown in this picture?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-prinċipessa tal-istorja li se naqraw illejla.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-prinċipessa tal-istorja li se naqraw illejla.
messages.zh: 她是我们今晚要读的故事里的公主。
messages.en: She is the princess in the story we are going to read tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用童话中戴王冠的公主作画面，把 prinċipessa 与英语 princess、中文公主并排记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rate or capacity at which useful output is produced, especially in relation to time or resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生有用成果的速率或能力，尤其指相对于所用时间或资源的产出水平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rata jew il-kapaċità li biha jsir xogħol utli jew jiġu prodotti oġġetti, speċjalment meta mqabbla mal-ħin jew mar-riżorsi użati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生产率；工作产出效率；产生有用成果的能力。

formal.mt: It-taħriġ tal-ħaddiema wassal għal żieda fil-produttività mingħajr ma naqqas il-kwalità.
formal.en: Employee training led to an increase in productivity without reducing quality.
formal.zh: 员工培训提高了生产率，同时没有降低质量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum lestejt aktar xogħol fl-istess ħin. David: Mela l-produttività tiegħek żdiedet!
colloquial.en: Sara: Today I got more work done in the same amount of time. David: Then your productivity has increased!
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天我在同样的时间里完成了更多工作。David：那你的工作效率提高了！

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum lestejt aktar xogħol fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Illum lestejt aktar xogħol fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 今天我在同样的时间里完成了更多工作。
messages.en: Today I got more work done in the same amount of time.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 那你的工作效率提高了！
messages.en: Then your productivity has increased!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同样一小时内做出的成品变多，用“单位时间的产出”来记这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that produces goods, or a person responsible for organizing the production of a film, programme, or similar work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生产商品的个人或机构，也指负责组织电影、节目等作品制作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tipproduċi oġġetti, jew persuna li torganizza l-produzzjoni ta' film, programm jew xogħol simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生产者；电影、节目等的制作人或制片人。
制造商；生产厂家；制作物品的人。

formal.mt: Il-produttur tal-films ippreżenta l-baġit u l-iskeda tal-produzzjoni lill-kumitat.
formal.en: The film producer presented the budget and production schedule to the committee.
formal.zh: 电影制片人向委员会提交了预算和制作日程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Minn fejn xtrajt din il-mejda? Toni: Xtrajtha direttament mingħand produttur tal-għamara.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did you buy this table? Toni: I bought it directly from a furniture manufacturer.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这张桌子你在哪里买的？Toni：我直接从一家家具制造商那里买的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张桌子你在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy this table?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我直接从一家家具制造商那里买的。
messages.en: I bought it directly from a furniture manufacturer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面并排记忆：片场安排制作的制片人，以及工厂制造家具的厂家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing useful results or achieving a worthwhile effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够产生有用成果或取得良好效果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti riżultati utli jew iwassal għal effett tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 富有成果的；有成效的；能产生良好效果的。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa kienet produċenti u wasslet għal ftehim dwar il-passi li jmiss.
formal.en: The meeting was productive and led to agreement on the next steps.
formal.zh: 会议富有成果，各方就接下来的步骤达成了一致。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-laqgħa? Mark: Kienet produċenti ħafna; fl-aħħar qbilna fuq pjan.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the meeting go? Mark: It was very productive; we finally agreed on a plan.
colloquial.zh: Maja：会议开得怎么样？Mark：很有成效，我们终于就一个计划达成了一致。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet produċenti ħafna; fl-aħħar qbilna fuq pjan.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet produċenti ħafna; fl-aħħar qbilna fuq pjan.
messages.zh: 很有成效，我们终于就一个计划达成了一致。
messages.en: It was very productive; we finally agreed on a plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开完会议手里多了一份可执行计划，用“做出了成果”来记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be produced or manufactured.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够被生产或制造出来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi prodott jew immanifatturat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可生产的；能够制造出来的。

formal.mt: L-istudju juri li dan il-materjal huwa produċibbli lokalment bl-apparat eżistenti.
formal.en: The study shows that this material can be produced locally using the existing equipment.
formal.zh: 研究表明，利用现有设备即可在本地生产这种材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-mudell huwa produċibbli fil-ħanut tagħna? Pawlu: Iva, għandna l-għodda kollha li neħtieġu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can this model be produced in our workshop? Pawlu: Yes, we have all the tools we need.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个模型能在我们的工坊里制作出来吗？Pawlu：能，我们需要的工具都有。

messages.speaker: Lara (工坊负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-mudell huwa produċibbli fil-ħanut tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-mudell huwa produċibbli fil-ħanut tagħna?
messages.zh: 这个模型能在我们的工坊里制作出来吗？
messages.en: Can this model be produced in our workshop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna l-għodda kollha li neħtieġu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna l-għodda kollha li neħtieġu.
messages.zh: 能，我们需要的工具都有。
messages.en: Yes, we have all the tools we need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把设计图旁边的“可以做出来”勾选框作为画面，记住它表达可生产性。

gloss_zh: 牟取暴利者；趁机牟利者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes unfair advantage of a situation, especially a shortage or crisis, to make excessive profit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用某种局势，尤其是短缺或危机，以不公平方式牟取过高利润的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisfrutta sitwazzjoni, speċjalment nuqqas ta' prodotti jew kriżi, biex tagħmel qligħ eċċessiv b'mod inġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用短缺、危机等机会牟取暴利的人。

collocations.zh: 毫无顾忌的暴利牟取者

collocations.en: a profiteer who exploits a crisis
collocations.zh: 利用危机牟取暴利的人

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iddeskriva lill-bejjiegħ bħala profittatur għax għolla ħafna l-prezz tal-ilma waqt il-kriżi.
formal.en: The report described the seller as a profiteer because he sharply increased the price of water during the crisis.
formal.zh: 报告将这名卖家称为暴利牟取者，因为他在危机期间大幅提高了水价。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Waqt in-nuqqas tal-ilma, dak il-bejjiegħ talab għaxar darbiet il-prezz tas-soltu! Ġorġ: Dak profittatur; qed jisfrutta l-bżonn tan-nies.
colloquial.en: Rita: During the water shortage, that seller charged ten times the usual price! Ġorġ: He is a profiteer; he is exploiting people's need.
colloquial.zh: Rita：缺水期间，那个卖家竟然收取平时十倍的价格！Ġorġ：他就是个牟取暴利的人，在利用大家的迫切需要赚钱。

messages.speaker: Rita (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqt in-nuqqas tal-ilma, dak il-bejjiegħ talab għaxar darbiet il-prezz tas-soltu!
messages.mt_standard: Waqt in-nuqqas tal-ilma, dak il-bejjiegħ talab għaxar darbiet il-prezz tas-soltu!
messages.zh: 缺水期间，那个卖家竟然收取平时十倍的价格！
messages.en: During the water shortage, that seller charged ten times the usual price!

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak profittatur; qed jisfrutta l-bżonn tan-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Dak profittatur; qed jisfrutta l-bżonn tan-nies.
messages.zh: 他就是个牟取暴利的人，在利用大家的迫切需要赚钱。
messages.en: He is a profiteer; he is exploiting people's need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象缺水时有人把水价抬到十倍，这个词带有谴责趁机牟取暴利的意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deeply or to a great degree, especially in feeling, thought, or effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深深地或在很大程度上，尤其用于感受、思想或影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod profond jew fi grad qawwi, speċjalment f'sentiment, ħsieb jew effett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深深地；深刻地；程度很深地。

collocations.zh: 深受触动的；留下深刻印象的

formal.mt: Il-kittieb jirrifletti profondament fuq ir-relazzjoni bejn il-memorja u l-identità.
formal.en: The writer reflects profoundly on the relationship between memory and identity.
formal.zh: 这位作家深入思考记忆与身份认同之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għoġbok il-film? Mark: Iva, messni profondament, speċjalment ix-xena tal-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Elena: Did you like the film? Mark: Yes, it touched me profoundly, especially the last scene.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你喜欢这部电影吗？Mark：喜欢，它深深打动了我，尤其是最后那一幕。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, messni profondament, speċjalment ix-xena tal-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, messni profondament, speċjalment ix-xena tal-aħħar.
messages.zh: 喜欢，它深深打动了我，尤其是最后那一幕。
messages.en: Yes, it touched me profoundly, especially the last scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影的一幕深深留在心里，用“感受深入内心”记住这个副词的程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The extent or quality of being deep, or a deep or deepest part of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深的程度或性质，也指某物的深处或最深处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kejl jew il-kwalità ta' kemm xi ħaġa hi fonda, jew il-parti fonda jew l-aktar fonda tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: depth (quality or degree of being deep)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 深度；深的程度或性质，也可指思想、论述等的深刻程度。

sense_translations.en_definition: depth (that which is deep below; the deepest part)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 深处；位于很深位置的部分；最深处。

collocations.en: in the depths of the sea

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkaturi użaw kamera speċjali biex josservaw il-ħajja fil-profondità tal-baħar.
formal.en: The researchers used a special camera to observe life in the depths of the sea.
formal.zh: 研究人员使用特殊摄像机观察海洋深处的生命。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf il-profondità ta' din il-pixxina? Luka: Iva, hawnhekk hija metru u nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know the depth of this swimming pool? Luka: Yes, it is one and a half metres here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道这个游泳池有多深吗？Luka：知道，这里是一米半。

messages.speaker: Maja (泳客)
messages.zh: 你知道这个游泳池有多深吗？
messages.en: Do you know the depth of this swimming pool?

messages.speaker: Luka (救生员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawnhekk hija metru u nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawnhekk hija metru u nofs.
messages.zh: 知道，这里是一米半。
messages.en: Yes, it is one and a half metres here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把量水深的刻度和海底深处并排想象：前者记“深度”，后者记“深处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A development through successive stages, or an ordered sequence of numbers following a rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按连续阶段逐步发展的过程，也可指数学中按一定规律排列的数列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żvilupp li jgħaddi minn stadju għal ieħor, jew sekwenza ta' numri li timxi skont regola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐步进展；递进过程；按规律排列的数列

formal.mt: In-numri 2, 4, 6 u 8 jiffurmaw progressjoni aritmetika b'differenza kostanti ta' tnejn.
formal.en: The numbers 2, 4, 6 and 8 form an arithmetic progression with a constant difference of two.
formal.zh: 数字2、4、6和8构成一个公差为2的等差数列。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġi wara 3, 6 u 9 f'din il-progressjoni? Pawlu: Jiġi 12, għax kull darba nżidu tlieta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What comes after 3, 6 and 9 in this progression? Pawlu: 12 comes next, because we add three each time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个数列里，3、6、9后面是什么？保罗：接下来是12，因为每次都加3。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个数列里，3、6、9后面是什么？
messages.en: What comes after 3, 6 and 9 in this progression?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġi 12, għax kull darba nżidu tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġi 12, għax kull darba nżidu tlieta.
messages.zh: 接下来是12，因为每次都加3。
messages.en: 12 comes next, because we add three each time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一排逐级升高的台阶：一般语境记“逐步进展”，数学语境记“按规律前进的数列”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called promethium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钷的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala promezju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钷，一种化学元素

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-elementi, l-istudenti identifikaw il-promezju u kitbu ismu bl-Ingliż.
formal.en: In the table of elements, the students identified promethium and wrote its name in English.
formal.zh: 学生们在元素表中找出钷，并写下它的英文名称。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif ngħid 'promethium' bil-Malti? David: Promezju. Ikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet ħdejn xulxin fin-noti tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Marta: How do I say 'promethium' in Maltese? David: Promezju. Write the two names next to each other in your notes.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：英语的promethium用马耳他语怎么说？戴维：Promezju。把这两个名称并排写在笔记里。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 英语的promethium用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say 'promethium' in Maltese?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Promezju. Ikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet ħdejn xulxin fin-noti tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Promezju. Ikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet ħdejn xulxin fin-noti tiegħek.
messages.zh: Promezju。把这两个名称并排写在笔记里。
messages.en: Promezju. Write the two names next to each other in your notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡，正面写promezju，背面并排写“钷、promethium”，反复遮住一面进行配对回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word used in place of a noun or noun phrase, such as a word meaning 'I', 'you' or 'they'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来代替名词或名词短语的词，例如表示“我”“你”“他们”的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża minflok nom jew frażi nominali, bħal 'jien', 'int' jew 'huma'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代词，用来代替名词或名词短语的词

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'Hija taqra ktieb', il-kelma 'hija' hija pronom personali.
formal.en: In the sentence 'She reads a book', the word 'she' is a personal pronoun.
formal.zh: 在“她读一本书”这句话中，“她”是人称代词。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Irrid nerġa' nikteb 'Marija' fit-tieni sentenza? Mark: Tista' tuża l-pronom 'hija' jekk ikun ċar li qed titkellem fuq Marija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do I need to write 'Marija' again in the second sentence? Mark: You can use the pronoun 'she' if it is clear that you are talking about Marija.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：第二句话里还要再写一次“玛丽亚”吗？马克：如果已经清楚你说的是玛丽亚，就可以用代词“她”。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 第二句话里还要再写一次“玛丽亚”吗？
messages.en: Do I need to write 'Marija' again in the second sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tuża l-pronom 'hija' jekk ikun ċar li qed titkellem fuq Marija.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tuża l-pronom 'hija' jekk ikun ċar li qed titkellem fuq Marija.
messages.zh: 如果已经清楚你说的是玛丽亚，就可以用代词“她”。
messages.en: You can use the pronoun 'she' if it is clear that you are talking about Marija.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把句子里重复出现的人名换成“他”或“她”，这个负责替换的词就是pronom，也就是代词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object pronoun that is attached to another word rather than used as a separate word.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 附着在其他词上、不能作为独立词使用的宾语代词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pronom li jindika l-oġġett u jkun magħqud ma' kelma oħra minflok ma jintuża bħala kelma għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 附着式宾语代词，依附于其他词并表示宾语的代词形式

collocations.en: a verb with a bound object pronoun
collocations.zh: 带附着式宾语代词的动词

collocations.en: the use of the bound object pronoun
collocations.zh: 附着式宾语代词的用法

formal.mt: Fil-kelma 'rajtek', il-pronom mehmuż '-ek' jindika li l-persuna li ra l-kelliem hija dik li qed ikellem.
formal.en: In the word 'rajtek', the bound object pronoun '-ek' indicates that the person the speaker saw is the person being addressed.
formal.zh: 在rajtek（我看见了你）一词中，附着式宾语代词-ek表示，说话者看见的人就是听话者。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fil-kelma 'rajtni', liema parti tfisser 'lili'? Toni: Il-parti '-ni'. Hija pronom mehmuż mal-verb.
colloquial.en: Sara: In the word 'rajtni', which part means 'me'? Toni: The part '-ni'. It is a bound object pronoun attached to the verb.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：在rajtni（你看见了我）这个词里，哪一部分表示“我”这个宾语？托尼：是-ni这一部分。它是附着在动词上的宾语代词。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 在rajtni（你看见了我）这个词里，哪一部分表示“我”这个宾语？
messages.en: In the word 'rajtni', which part means 'me'?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.zh: 是-ni这一部分。它是附着在动词上的宾语代词。
messages.en: The part '-ni'. It is a bound object pronoun attached to the verb.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把宾语代词想成贴在动词上的小标签：rajtek里的-ek标出“你”，rajtni里的-ni标出“我”，连着整词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Near in space, time or causal connection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空间、时间或因果联系上接近的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qrib fl-ispazju, fiż-żmien jew fir-rabta bejn kawża u effett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邻近的；接近的；在因果联系上直接相关的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport identifika x-xogħol fit-triq bħala l-kawża prossima tal-ħsara fil-pajp.
formal.en: The report identified the roadworks as the proximate cause of the damage to the pipe.
formal.zh: 报告认定，道路施工是管道受损的直接原因。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Meta tgħid 'kuntatt prossimu', tfisser li n-nies kienu qrib xulxin? Karl: Iva, hawn 'prossimu' jfisser li kienu f'distanza żgħira minn xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lina: When you say 'close contact', do you mean that the people were near each other? Karl: Yes, here 'prossimu' means that they were a short distance from each other.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你说“近距离接触”，是指人们彼此靠得很近吗？卡尔：对，这里的prossimu表示他们之间的距离很小。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid 'kuntatt prossimu', tfisser li n-nies kienu qrib xulxin?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid 'kuntatt prossimu', tfisser li n-nies kienu qrib xulxin?
messages.zh: 你说“近距离接触”，是指人们彼此靠得很近吗？
messages.en: When you say 'close contact', do you mean that the people were near each other?

messages.speaker: Karl (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn 'prossimu' jfisser li kienu f'distanza żgħira minn xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn 'prossimu' jfisser li kienu f'distanza żgħira minn xulxin.
messages.zh: 对，这里的prossimu表示他们之间的距离很小。
messages.en: Yes, here 'prossimu' means that they were a short distance from each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个靠近的圆来记“接近”；再画原因紧挨结果来记“近因”。搭配阴性名词kawża时，记住形式是prossima。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gland that forms part of the male reproductive system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性生殖系统中的一种腺体，即前列腺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Glandola li tifforma parti mis-sistema riproduttiva maskili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前列腺

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jinkludi r-riżultati tal-eżami tal-prostata.
formal.en: The medical report includes the results of the prostate examination.
formal.zh: 医疗报告包含前列腺检查的结果。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Xi tfisser 'prostata' f'dan il-fuljett? Ġużeppi: Hija glandola fis-sistema riproduttiva maskili; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ 'prostate'.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does 'prostata' mean in this leaflet? Ġużeppi: It is a gland in the male reproductive system; in English it is called the 'prostate'.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这本小册子里的prostata是什么意思？朱塞佩：它是男性生殖系统中的一种腺体，中文叫前列腺，英文叫prostate。

messages.speaker: Marija (读者)
messages.zh: 这本小册子里的prostata是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'prostata' mean in this leaflet?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija glandola fis-sistema riproduttiva maskili; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ 'prostate'.
messages.mt_standard: Hija glandola fis-sistema riproduttiva maskili; bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ 'prostate'.
messages.zh: 它是男性生殖系统中的一种腺体，中文叫前列腺，英文叫prostate。
messages.en: It is a gland in the male reproductive system; in English it is called the 'prostate'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把prostata、prostate和“前列腺”并排写在身体词汇卡上，再用“前列腺检查”这个完整搭配帮助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called protactinium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素镤的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala protattinju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镤，一种化学元素

formal.mt: Il-glossarju tal-kimika jagħti l-isem Ingliż 'protactinium' ħdejn l-isem Malti 'protattinju'.
formal.en: The chemistry glossary gives the English name 'protactinium' beside the Maltese name 'protattinju'.
formal.zh: 化学术语表在马耳他语名称protattinju旁列出英文名称protactinium。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Il-protattinju huwa l-istess element bħall-promezju? Rita: Le, huma żewġ elementi differenti. Il-protattinju jissejjaħ 'protactinium' bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Is protactinium the same element as promethium? Rita: No, they are two different elements. Protattinju is called 'protactinium' in English.
colloquial.zh: 丹尼尔：镤和钷是同一种元素吗？丽塔：不是，它们是两种不同的元素。Protattinju是镤，英文叫protactinium。

messages.speaker: Daniel (学生)
messages.zh: 镤和钷是同一种元素吗？
messages.en: Is protactinium the same element as promethium?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huma żewġ elementi differenti. Il-protattinju jissejjaħ 'protactinium' bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huma żewġ elementi differenti. Il-protattinju jissejjaħ 'protactinium' bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 不是，它们是两种不同的元素。Protattinju是镤，英文叫protactinium。
messages.en: No, they are two different elements. Protattinju is called 'protactinium' in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别制作“protattinju—镤”和“promezju—钷”两张卡，用不同颜色标记，练习看到完整拼写再选对应的元素名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action or arrangement made to meet a need or deal with a situation, or a provision in a formal text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为满足需要或处理某种情况而采取的措施、作出的安排，也可指正式文本中的规定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura jew arranġament biex tiġi indirizzata ħtieġa jew sitwazzjoni, jew dispożizzjoni f'test formali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规定；措施；为应对某种情况而作出的安排

formal.mt: Il-kunsill ħa provdiment biex itejjeb id-dawl fit-triq ħdejn l-iskola.
formal.en: The council took a measure to improve the lighting on the street near the school.
formal.zh: 地方议会采取措施，改善学校附近街道的照明。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadu jidħol l-ilma mit-tieqa meta tagħmel ix-xita? Ben: Le, sid id-dar ħa provdiment u bagħat lil xi ħadd isewwiha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does water still come in through the window when it rains? Ben: No, the landlord took action and sent someone to repair it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：下雨时，窗户还会进水吗？本：不会了，房东采取了措施，派人来修好了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu jidħol l-ilma mit-tieqa meta tagħmel ix-xita?
messages.mt_standard: Għadu jidħol l-ilma mit-tieqa meta tagħmel ix-xita?
messages.zh: 下雨时，窗户还会进水吗？
messages.en: Does water still come in through the window when it rains?

messages.speaker: Ben (租客)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, sid id-dar ħa provdiment u bagħat lil xi ħadd isewwiha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, sid id-dar ħa provdiment u bagħat lil xi ħadd isewwiha.
messages.zh: 不会了，房东采取了措施，派人来修好了。
messages.en: No, the landlord took action and sent someone to repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗户漏水后房东安排维修：这个应对安排就是provdiment；把它放进正式文本时，还可以表示其中的一项规定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or business that supplies goods, especially food or other provisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向个人或机构供应商品，尤其是食品等日常物资的人或企业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew negozju li jipprovdi prodotti, speċjalment ikel jew provvisti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应商；供货人，尤指供应食品或其他日常物资者。

formal.mt: L-iskola għażlet provditur tal-ikel li jista' jwassal prodotti friski kuljum.
formal.en: The school selected a food supplier who can deliver fresh products every day.
formal.zh: 学校选择了一家能够每天配送新鲜食品的供应商。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek provditur tajjeb għall-ħaxix? Mark: Iva, il-provditur tagħna jġib ħaxix frisk kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a good vegetable supplier? Mark: Yes, our supplier brings fresh vegetables every morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有好的蔬菜供应商吗？Mark：有，我们的供应商每天早上都送来新鲜蔬菜。

messages.speaker: Maja (餐馆经营者)
messages.zh: 你有好的蔬菜供应商吗？
messages.en: Do you have a good vegetable supplier?

messages.speaker: Mark (餐馆经营者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-provditur tagħna jġib ħaxix frisk kull filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-provditur tagħna jġib ħaxix frisk kull filgħodu.
messages.zh: 有，我们的供应商每天早上都送来新鲜蔬菜。
messages.en: Yes, our supplier brings fresh vegetables every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每天把蔬菜送到餐馆门口的人，把 provditur 与“持续供应货物的人”一起记。

gloss_zh: 如有天助的；恰逢其时的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening at just the right moment to help, as if arranged by providence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容帮助或事件在关键时刻恰好出现，令人觉得如有天助。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jasal jew iseħħ fil-mument it-tajjeb biex jgħin, bħallikieku kien frott tal-providenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 如有天助的；仿佛出于天意而在关键时刻带来帮助的。

collocations.zh: 如有天助般及时的帮助

formal.mt: L-għajnuna providenzjali tal-ġirien ippermettiet lill-familja ssib kenn qabel il-maltemp.
formal.en: The neighbors' providential help enabled the family to find shelter before the storm.
formal.zh: 邻居如有天助般及时伸出援手，使这家人在暴风雨来临前找到了避难处。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kont se nitlef il-ferrovija, imma wasal Mark bil-karozza. Lara: Dak kien intervent providenzjali!
colloquial.en: Maja: I was about to miss the train, but Mark arrived by car. Lara: That was a providential intervention!
colloquial.zh: Maja：我眼看就要赶不上火车了，但 Mark 开车来了。Lara：这次帮忙真是如有天助！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont se nitlef il-ferrovija, imma wasal Mark bil-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Kont se nitlef il-ferrovija, imma wasal Mark bil-karozza.
messages.zh: 我眼看就要赶不上火车了，但 Mark 开车来了。
messages.en: I was about to miss the train, but Mark arrived by car.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这次帮忙真是如有天助！
messages.en: That was a providential intervention!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“快误车时朋友恰好开车出现”的画面，providenzjali 用来形容这种如有天助的及时帮助。

gloss_zh: 如有天助地；幸而恰在关键时刻

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that brings help at just the right moment, as if arranged by providence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示事情如有天助般发生，恰在关键时刻带来帮助或避免困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jġib għajnuna fil-mument it-tajjeb, bħallikieku kien frott tal-providenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 如有天助地；幸而在关键时刻，以仿佛出于天意的方式。

collocations.zh: 如有天助般找到了避难处

formal.mt: Providenzjalment, voluntier wasal b'provvista ta' ilma eżatt meta spiċċa l-ilma fiċ-ċentru.
formal.en: Providentially, a volunteer arrived with a supply of water just as the center ran out.
formal.zh: 如有天助，一位志愿者恰在中心的水用完时带着一批水赶到了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif irnexxielek tidħol jekk insejt iċ-ċavetta? Maja: Providenzjalment, oħti kienet għadha d-dar u fetħitli.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did you manage to get in if you forgot your key? Maja: Providentially, my sister was still at home and opened the door for me.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你忘了带钥匙，是怎么进去的？Maja：真是如有天助，我姐姐还在家，给我开了门。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irnexxielek tidħol jekk insejt iċ-ċavetta?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irnexxielek tidħol jekk insejt iċ-ċavetta?
messages.zh: 你忘了带钥匙，是怎么进去的？
messages.en: How did you manage to get in if you forgot your key?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Providenzjalment, oħti kienet għadha d-dar u fetħitli.
messages.mt_standard: Providenzjalment, oħti kienet għadha d-dar u fetħitli.
messages.zh: 真是如有天助，我姐姐还在家，给我开了门。
messages.en: Providentially, my sister was still at home and opened the door for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 providenzjalment 放在整件幸运事件前，记成“如有天助地，事情刚好解决了”，体会副词的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who prepares the design or detailed plans for a project.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为项目制定设计方案或详细规划的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħejji d-disinn jew il-pjanijiet dettaljati għal proġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设计师；负责制定项目方案或详细规划的人员。

collocations.zh: 经验丰富的设计或规划人员

collocations.en: to consult the designer or planner
collocations.zh: 向设计或规划人员咨询

formal.mt: Il-proġettist ħejja pjan dettaljat għar-rinnovazzjoni tal-bini u ppreżentah lill-klijent.
formal.en: The designer prepared a detailed plan for the renovation of the building and presented it to the client.
formal.zh: 设计师为建筑翻修制定了详细方案，并将其提交给客户。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nistgħu nbiddlu l-pjan tal-kċina? Pawlu: Ejja nitkellmu mal-proġettist; jista' jipproponi arranġament ieħor.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can we change the kitchen plan? Pawlu: Let's speak to the designer; he can suggest another layout.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们能改一下厨房的设计方案吗？Pawlu：我们和设计师谈谈吧，他可以提出另一种布局。

messages.speaker: Anna (屋主)
messages.zh: 我们能改一下厨房的设计方案吗？
messages.en: Can we change the kitchen plan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nitkellmu mal-proġettist; jista' jipproponi arranġament ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nitkellmu mal-proġettist; jista' jipproponi arranġament ieħor.
messages.zh: 我们和设计师谈谈吧，他可以提出另一种布局。
messages.en: Let's speak to the designer; he can suggest another layout.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着详细图纸、为项目安排布局的人，把人物与“设计和规划”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the mind, inner mental life, or soul.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与人的心理、内在精神活动或心灵有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-moħħ, mal-ħajja mentali ta' ġewwa jew mar-ruħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: mental, psychic, psychological (referring to the psyche or soul)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 心理的、精神的、心灵的，指与心理或灵魂有关。

collocations.zh: 心理健康；精神上的良好状态

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-relazzjoni bejn l-ambjent tax-xogħol u l-benesseri psikiku tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The study examines the relationship between the work environment and workers' mental well-being.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察工作环境与员工心理健康之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-istorbju kollu qed joħloqli stress psikiku. Mark: Ejja mmorru f'post aktar kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: All this noise is causing me psychological stress. Mark: Let's go somewhere quieter.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些噪声让我产生了心理压力。Mark：我们去个安静一点的地方吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-istorbju kollu qed joħloqli stress psikiku.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-istorbju kollu qed joħloqli stress psikiku.
messages.zh: 这些噪声让我产生了心理压力。
messages.en: All this noise is causing me psychological stress.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去个安静一点的地方吧。
messages.en: Let's go somewhere quieter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 psikiku 与“内心感受”联系起来：身体之外的心理压力、精神状态和心灵活动，都能帮助理解这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 心理学家；心理专业人员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person trained in psychology who studies mental processes and behavior or applies that knowledge professionally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受过心理学训练，研究心理活动与行为，或在专业工作中运用这些知识的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa fil-psikoloġija li tistudja l-proċessi mentali u l-imġiba jew tapplika dan l-għarfien fix-xogħol tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心理学家；接受心理学专业训练并从事研究或应用工作的人。

collocations.zh: 与心理专业人员的预约

formal.mt: Il-psikologu spjega lill-għalliema kif l-istress jista' jinfluwenza l-attenzjoni tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The psychologist explained to the teachers how stress can influence students' attention.
formal.zh: 心理学家向教师们解释了压力会如何影响学生的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' min se tiltaqa' wara x-xogħol? Mark: Għandi appuntament ma' psikologu biex nitkellem dwar l-istress.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who are you meeting after work? Mark: I have an appointment with a psychologist to talk about stress.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你下班后要去见谁？Mark：我预约了一位心理专业人员，想聊聊压力问题。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min se tiltaqa' wara x-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min se tiltaqa' wara x-xogħol?
messages.zh: 你下班后要去见谁？
messages.en: Who are you meeting after work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi appuntament ma' psikologu biex nitkellem dwar l-istress.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi appuntament ma' psikologu biex nitkellem dwar l-istress.
messages.zh: 我预约了一位心理专业人员，想聊聊压力问题。
messages.en: I have an appointment with a psychologist to talk about stress.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 psikologu 记成一个具体的人：他研究人的心理和行为，也可能与你讨论压力；用人物画面记住这个职业名词。

gloss_zh: 在心理上；从心理学角度

teaching_sense.en_definition: In relation to a person's mental or emotional state, or from the viewpoint of psychology.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 就人的心理或情绪状态而言，或从心理学的角度来看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istat mentali jew emozzjonali ta' persuna, jew mill-perspettiva tal-psikoloġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在心理上；就心理状态而言；从心理学角度。

formal.mt: Il-programm jgħin lill-istudenti jħejju ruħhom psikoloġikament għall-eżamijiet.
formal.en: The program helps students prepare themselves psychologically for examinations.
formal.zh: 这项计划帮助学生为考试做好心理准备。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lest għall-intervista ta' għada? Maja: Qrajt kollox, imma għadni qed inħejji ruħi psikoloġikament.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you ready for tomorrow's interview? Maja: I've read everything, but I'm still preparing myself psychologically.
colloquial.zh: Mark：明天的面试准备好了吗？Maja：资料都读完了，但我还在做心理准备。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天的面试准备好了吗？
messages.en: Are you ready for tomorrow's interview?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt kollox, imma għadni qed inħejji ruħi psikoloġikament.
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt kollox, imma għadni qed inħejji ruħi psikoloġikament.
messages.zh: 资料都读完了，但我还在做心理准备。
messages.en: I've read everything, but I'm still preparing myself psychologically.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面试资料已经读完，心里仍在调整状态；用 psikoloġikament 补充说明“在心理上”怎样准备。

gloss_zh: 古罗马税吏；税收承包人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who collected taxes under the Roman system, often as a tax contractor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 古罗马制度下负责征税的人，常指承包税收征集的税吏或包税人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li kienet tiġbor it-taxxi fis-sistema Rumana, spiss bħala kuntrattur tal-ġbir tat-taxxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古罗马税吏；税收承包人

formal.mt: Fit-test storiku, il-pubblikan jiġbor it-taxxi mingħand in-nies tal-belt.
formal.en: In the historical text, the publican collects taxes from the people of the town.
formal.zh: 在这篇历史文本中，古罗马税吏向城里的居民征税。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu pubblikan f'din l-istorja? Pawlu: Huwa raġel li kien jiġbor it-taxxi fi żmien ir-Rumani.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is a publican in this story? Pawlu: He is a man who collected taxes in Roman times.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个故事里的 pubblikan 是什么人？保罗：是古罗马时期负责收税的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 pubblikan 是什么人？
messages.en: What is a publican in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa raġel li kien jiġbor it-taxxi fi żmien ir-Rumani.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa raġel li kien jiġbor it-taxxi fi żmien ir-Rumani.
messages.zh: 是古罗马时期负责收税的人。
messages.en: He is a man who collected taxes in Roman times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pubblikan 放进古罗马收税场景：手拿税册、向居民收款的人，就是这里的税吏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that prepares and issues books, journals, or other works for the public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责筹备并向公众发行书籍、期刊或其他作品的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tħejji u toħroġ kotba, rivisti jew xogħlijiet oħra għall-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出版者；出版商

formal.mt: L-awtriċi bagħtet il-manuskritt lill-pubblikatur biex jiġi evalwat qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The author sent the manuscript to the publisher for evaluation before publication.
formal.zh: 作者把书稿寄给出版商，以便在出版前进行评估。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sibt pubblikatur għall-ktieb tiegħek? David: Iva, u se niltaqa' miegħu għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you found a publisher for your book? David: Yes, and I am meeting him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的书找到出版商了吗？戴维：找到了，我明天要和他见面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的书找到出版商了吗？
messages.en: Have you found a publisher for your book?

messages.speaker: David (作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u se niltaqa' miegħu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u se niltaqa' miegħu għada.
messages.zh: 找到了，我明天要和他见面。
messages.en: Yes, and I am meeting him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用书稿变成书的画面记忆：作者写稿，pubblikatur 负责把作品出版给读者。

gloss_zh: 宣传人员；公关宣传人员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is to attract public attention to a person, organization, event, or product.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以为人物、机构、活动或产品争取公众关注为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-pubbliku lejn persuna, organizzazzjoni, avveniment jew prodott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣传人员；负责为人物、机构、活动或产品争取公众关注的公关宣传人员。

formal.mt: Il-pubbliċist tal-kumpanija ħejja stqarrija għall-istampa dwar it-tnedija tal-prodott il-ġdid.
formal.en: The company's publicist prepared a press release about the launch of the new product.
formal.zh: 公司的公关宣传人员准备了一份关于新产品发布的新闻稿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jikkuntattja lill-ġurnalisti għall-kunċert? Mark: Il-pubbliċist tagħna se jibgħatilhom l-informazzjoni llum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will contact the journalists about the concert? Mark: Our publicist will send them the information today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁来为音乐会联系记者？Mark：我们的宣传人员今天会把资料发给他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动主办者)
messages.zh: 谁来为音乐会联系记者？
messages.en: Who will contact the journalists about the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pubbliċist tagħna se jibgħatilhom l-informazzjoni llum.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pubbliċist tagħna se jibgħatilhom l-informazzjoni llum.
messages.zh: 我们的宣传人员今天会把资料发给他们。
messages.en: Our publicist will send them the information today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位联系记者、准备新闻稿、让活动受到关注的人，把 pubbliċist 与“宣传公关人员”这个工作画面绑定。

gloss_zh: 宣传人员；公关宣传人员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who promotes a person, organization, event, or product by arranging publicity and public attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过安排宣传活动、争取公众关注来推广人物、机构、活动或产品的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tippromwovi persuna, organizzazzjoni, avveniment jew prodott billi torganizza l-pubbliċità u tiġbed l-attenzjoni tal-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣传人员；通过组织宣传、联系媒体等方式提升人物、机构、活动或产品关注度的人。

formal.mt: Il-pubbliċista tal-festival organizzat intervisti mal-artisti biex tqajjem interess fil-programm.
formal.en: The festival's publicist organized interviews with the artists to generate interest in the program.
formal.zh: 艺术节的宣传人员安排了艺术家访谈，以激发公众对活动安排的兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif se n-nies isiru jafu bil-wirja? Lara: Qabbadna pubbliċista biex tikkuntattja l-midja u tippromwovi l-avveniment.
colloquial.en: Mark: How will people find out about the exhibition? Lara: We hired a publicist to contact the media and promote the event.
colloquial.zh: Mark：大家怎么会知道这个展览呢？Lara：我们聘请了一位宣传人员，负责联系媒体并推广活动。

messages.speaker: Mark (参展艺术家)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se n-nies isiru jafu bil-wirja?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se n-nies isiru jafu bil-wirja?
messages.zh: 大家怎么会知道这个展览呢？
messages.en: How will people find out about the exhibition?

messages.speaker: Lara (展览主办者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabbadna pubbliċista biex tikkuntattja l-midja u tippromwovi l-avveniment.
messages.mt_standard: Qabbadna pubbliċista biex tikkuntattja l-midja u tippromwovi l-avveniment.
messages.zh: 我们聘请了一位宣传人员，负责联系媒体并推广活动。
messages.en: We hired a publicist to contact the media and promote the event.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“展览即将开幕，有人忙着联系媒体和安排访谈”的画面记 pubbliċista；核心是负责争取公众关注的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of attracting public attention to a person, product, event, or organization, or the attention gained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为人物、产品、活动或机构吸引公众注意的宣传活动，也指由此获得的公众关注。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħidma biex persuna, prodott, avveniment jew organizzazzjoni jiġbdu l-attenzjoni tal-pubbliku, jew l-attenzjoni li jiksbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣传；公众关注

formal.mt: Il-mużew nieda kampanja ta' pubbliċità biex aktar nies iżuru l-wirja l-ġdida.
formal.en: The museum launched a publicity campaign to encourage more people to visit the new exhibition.
formal.zh: 博物馆开展了宣传活动，吸引更多人参观新展览。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed taqsmu dan il-filmat? Mark: Biex nagħmlu ftit pubbliċità għall-kunċert.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you sharing this video? Mark: To get some publicity for the concert.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们为什么分享这个视频？马克：给音乐会做点宣传。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么分享这个视频？
messages.en: Why are you sharing this video?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 给音乐会做点宣传。
messages.en: To get some publicity for the concert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象音乐会海报被大家转发：pubbliċità 就是让公众注意到的宣传，也可指获得的关注。

gloss_zh: Puglisevich（姓氏，来自塞尔维亚—克罗地亚语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname from Serbo-Croatian, used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自塞尔维亚—克罗地亚语的姓氏，用作个人的家族姓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom mis-Serbo-Kroat li jintuża bħala isem tal-familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个来自塞尔维亚—克罗地亚语的姓氏

formal.mt: Is-Sur Puglisevich huwa mistieden jiffirma r-reġistru qabel ma tidħol il-klassi.
formal.en: Mr Puglisevich is invited to sign the register before the class enters.
formal.zh: 请 Puglisevich 先生在班级入场前签署登记簿。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu kunjomok, jekk jogħġbok? Mark: Puglisevich. Tridni niktbu?
colloquial.en: Anna: What is your surname, please? Mark: Puglisevich. Would you like me to write it down?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：请问您贵姓？马克：Puglisevich。需要我写下来吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 请问您贵姓？
messages.en: What is your surname, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: Puglisevich。需要我写下来吗？
messages.en: Puglisevich. Would you like me to write it down?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象登记表的姓氏栏写着 Puglisevich；按完整姓氏记忆，实际书写时首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the police or to police work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与警察、警方或警务工作有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-pulizija jew max-xogħol tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警察的；警方的；警务的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport pulizjesk jiddeskrivi l-inċident u jiġbor id-dikjarazzjonijiet tax-xhieda.
formal.en: The police report describes the incident and brings together the witnesses' statements.
formal.zh: 警方报告描述了事件经过，并汇集了证人的陈述。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qed taqra? Toni: Artiklu dwar ix-xogħol pulizjesk fil-belt.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are you reading? Toni: An article about police work in the city.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在读什么？托尼：一篇讲城市警务工作的文章。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Toni (读者)
messages.zh: 一篇讲城市警务工作的文章。
messages.en: An article about police work in the city.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pulizjesk 放在报告或工作后面记：rapport pulizjesk 是警方报告，词义是警务相关的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The points obtained in a game; also the act of marking something with dots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比赛中取得的分数；也指在某物上加点、作点状标记的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għadd ta' punti miksuba f'logħba; ukoll l-għemil ta' tikek jew marki b'tikek fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加点；点绘；作点状标记
比赛中的得分；比分

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju artistiku, il-punteġġ isir b'tikek żgħar biex jinħoloq disinn.
formal.en: In this art exercise, dotting is done with small dots to create a design.
formal.zh: 在这项美术练习中，通过绘制小点来构成图案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien il-punteġġ finali? Mark: Tnejn b'wieħed; it-tim tagħna rebaħ!
colloquial.en: Lara: What was the final score? Mark: Two to one; our team won!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：最后比分是多少？马克：二比一，我们队赢了！

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷)
messages.zh: 最后比分是多少？
messages.en: What was the final score?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 二比一，我们队赢了！
messages.en: Two to one; our team won!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分别记 punteġġ：画纸上逐个加点是点绘，比赛记分牌上的数字是得分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The use of written marks such as commas, full stops, and question marks to organize text and clarify meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用逗号、句号、问号等书面符号来组织文字、划分句子并明确意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu ta' sinjali bħal virgoli, punti u marki tal-mistoqsija biex jorganizzaw it-test u jiċċaraw it-tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标点；标点符号及其使用

formal.mt: L-użu korrett tal-punteġġjatura jgħin lill-qarrej jifhem fejn tintemm sentenza u tibda oħra.
formal.en: Correct use of punctuation helps the reader understand where one sentence ends and another begins.
formal.zh: 正确使用标点有助于读者理解一句话在哪里结束、下一句话在哪里开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tiċċekkja l-punteġġjatura f'dan il-messaġġ? Pawlu: Żgur. Hawn għandek bżonn virgola, u fl-aħħar punt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you check the punctuation in this message? Pawlu: Sure. You need a comma here and a full stop at the end.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能检查一下这条消息的标点吗？保罗：当然。这里需要一个逗号，结尾需要一个句号。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你能检查一下这条消息的标点吗？
messages.en: Can you check the punctuation in this message?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Hawn għandek bżonn virgola, u fl-aħħar punt.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Hawn għandek bżonn virgola, u fl-aħħar punt.
messages.zh: 当然。这里需要一个逗号，结尾需要一个句号。
messages.en: Sure. You need a comma here and a full stop at the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一段文字补上逗号、句号和问号：整套标点的使用就是 punteġġjatura。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Punjabi language, referred to as a language people speak, read, or study.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旁遮普语，作为人们使用、阅读或学习的一种语言的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-lingwa Punġabi, li n-nies jitkellmu, jaqraw jew jistudjaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旁遮普语

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-Punġabi jinkludi eżerċizzji ta' qari, kitba u konverżazzjoni.
formal.en: The Punjabi course includes exercises in reading, writing, and conversation.
formal.zh: 旁遮普语课程包括阅读、写作和会话练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem? Amir: Qed nitgħallem il-Punġabi biex nitkellem man-nanniet tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which language are you learning? Amir: I am learning Punjabi so I can speak with my grandparents.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在学哪种语言？阿米尔：我在学旁遮普语，好和祖父母交流。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在学哪种语言？
messages.en: Which language are you learning?

messages.speaker: Amir (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitgħallem il-Punġabi biex nitkellem man-nanniet tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitgħallem il-Punġabi biex nitkellem man-nanniet tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我在学旁遮普语，好和祖父母交流。
messages.en: I am learning Punjabi so I can speak with my grandparents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Punġabi 放进语言课表：学这门语言用 il-Punġabi，用这门语言说话用 bil-Punġabi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In some Christian beliefs, a state or place where souls are purified after death before entering heaven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某些基督教信仰中，灵魂死后进入天堂之前接受净化的状态或地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'ċertu twemmin Nisrani, stat jew post fejn l-erwieħ jitnaddfu wara l-mewt qabel jidħlu fil-ġenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炼狱；某些基督教信仰中灵魂死后接受净化的状态或地方。

formal.mt: It-test jispjega t-twemmin fil-purgatorju bħala stat ta' tisfija wara l-mewt.
formal.en: The text explains belief in purgatory as a state of purification after death.
formal.zh: 这篇文章解释了将炼狱视为死后净化状态的信仰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser purgatorju f'dan il-ktieb? Pawlu: Skont dan it-twemmin, huwa stat fejn l-erwieħ jitnaddfu qabel jidħlu fil-ġenna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does purgatory mean in this book? Pawlu: According to this belief, it is a state where souls are purified before entering heaven.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书里的“炼狱”是什么意思？保罗：按照这种信仰，它是灵魂进入天堂之前接受净化的状态。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这本书里的“炼狱”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does purgatory mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont dan it-twemmin, huwa stat fejn l-erwieħ jitnaddfu qabel jidħlu fil-ġenna.
messages.mt_standard: Skont dan it-twemmin, huwa stat fejn l-erwieħ jitnaddfu qabel jidħlu fil-ġenna.
messages.zh: 按照这种信仰，它是灵魂进入天堂之前接受净化的状态。
messages.en: According to this belief, it is a state where souls are purified before entering heaven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 purgatorju 与英语 purgatory 对照记忆，并联想“灵魂进入天堂前接受净化”的宗教画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shoot of a vine or tree laid into the soil to take root for propagation, including a vine layer prepared in winter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为繁殖而压入土中使其生根的葡萄藤或树木枝条，也包括冬季制作的葡萄压条枝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fergħa tad-dielja jew ta' siġra mqiegħda fil-ħamrija biex tagħmel l-għeruq u tintuża għat-tnissil, inkluża waħda mħejjija fix-xitwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: Layered shoot of vine; winter layer (in the propagation of vines by layers); a layer of a vine or tree, provine
sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄藤的压条枝；葡萄压条繁殖时冬季制作的压条；葡萄藤或树木用于压条繁殖的枝条。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw purpajna tad-dielja biex jifhmu kif fergħa tista' tagħmel l-għeruq fil-ħamrija.
formal.en: The students observed a vine layer to understand how a shoot can take root in the soil.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一根葡萄压条枝，以了解枝条如何在土中生根。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex din il-fergħa tinsab fil-ħamrija? Toni: Din purpajna; qed inħalluha tagħmel l-għeruq biex ikollna dielja oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this shoot in the soil? Toni: It is a layer; we are letting it take root so we can have another vine.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这根枝条为什么埋在土里？托尼：这是压条枝；我们让它生根，好再繁殖一株葡萄。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺学生)
messages.zh: 这根枝条为什么埋在土里？
messages.en: Why is this shoot in the soil?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Din purpajna; qed inħalluha tagħmel l-għeruq biex ikollna dielja oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Din purpajna; qed inħalluha tagħmel l-għeruq biex ikollna dielja oħra.
messages.zh: 这是压条枝；我们让它生根，好再繁殖一株葡萄。
messages.en: It is a layer; we are letting it take root so we can have another vine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根葡萄枝弯下埋进土里，长根后成为新植株；用这幅“枝条压土生根”的画面记住 purpajna。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A localized swelling containing pus in the body's tissues.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体组织中局部积聚脓液而形成的肿块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nefħa f'post fil-ġisem fejn jinġabar il-materja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脓肿；身体组织中因局部积脓形成的肿块。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi pustumetta fil-ħanek li kienet qed tikkawża uġigħ lill-pazjent.
formal.en: The report describes an abscess in the gum that was causing the patient pain.
formal.zh: 报告描述了患者牙龈处一处引起疼痛的脓肿。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Id-dentist qalli li għandi pustumetta fil-ħanek. Sara: Għalhekk kien qed juġgħek daqshekk?
colloquial.en: Mark: The dentist told me I have an abscess in my gum. Sara: Is that why it was hurting so much?
colloquial.zh: 马克：牙医说我的牙龈上有个脓肿。萨拉：所以才会那么痛吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dentist qalli li għandi pustumetta fil-ħanek.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dentist qalli li għandi pustumetta fil-ħanek.
messages.zh: 牙医说我的牙龈上有个脓肿。
messages.en: The dentist told me I have an abscess in my gum.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 所以才会那么痛吗？
messages.en: Is that why it was hurting so much?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pustumetta 配上一张“局部肿包里积着脓液”的示意图，抓住“积脓形成肿块”来记忆。

gloss_zh: 盐渍风干鱼卵；乌鱼子类食品

teaching_sense.en_definition: Salted and dried fish roe used as food, also called botargo or bottarga.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将鱼卵盐渍、风干后制成的食品，即 botargo 或 bottarga，属于乌鱼子一类的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bajd tal-ħut immellaħ u mnixxef li jintuża bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盐渍风干鱼卵制品；乌鱼子一类的食品，也称 bottarga。

collocations.zh: 配盐渍风干鱼卵的意大利面

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob flieli rqaq ta' putarga biex jitqiegħdu fuq l-għaġin qabel ma jiġi servut.
formal.en: The recipe calls for thin slices of botargo to be placed on the pasta before it is served.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在上桌前，将盐渍风干鱼卵薄片放在意大利面上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm fuq l-għaġin? Luqa: Putarga, jiġifieri bajd tal-ħut immellaħ u mnixxef.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is on the pasta? Luqa: Botargo, which is salted and dried fish roe.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：面上放的是什么？卢卡：盐渍风干鱼卵，就是把鱼卵腌咸后风干做成的食品。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 面上放的是什么？
messages.en: What is on the pasta?

messages.speaker: Luqa (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Putarga, jiġifieri bajd tal-ħut immellaħ u mnixxef.
messages.mt_standard: Putarga, jiġifieri bajd tal-ħut immellaħ u mnixxef.
messages.zh: 盐渍风干鱼卵，就是把鱼卵腌咸后风干做成的食品。
messages.en: Botargo, which is salted and dried fish roe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象意大利面上铺着几片咸香的风干鱼卵，把这道菜与 putarga 配对记忆，牢记它指鱼卵制品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The digestive organ that receives food after it is swallowed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吞咽后接收食物并参与消化的器官，即胃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organu tad-diġestjoni fejn jasal l-ikel wara li jinbela'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胃；接收吞咽下去的食物并参与消化的器官。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta uġigħ fil-qab wara l-ikla.
formal.en: The patient reported stomach pain after the meal.
formal.zh: 患者报告饭后出现胃痛。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi uġigħ fil-qab. David: Beda wara l-ikel?
colloquial.en: Marija: I have a pain in my stomach. David: Did it start after you ate?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我胃疼。戴维：是吃完东西以后开始疼的吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 我胃疼。
messages.en: I have a pain in my stomach.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 是吃完东西以后开始疼的吗？
messages.en: Did it start after you ate?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短词 qab 写在消化系统图的胃部，再连读 uġigħ fil-qab“胃痛”，用器官位置和短语一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to catch fire easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易被点燃、容易起火的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jaqbad in-nar malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 易燃的；容易着火的。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li l-likwidu huwa qabbadi u għandu jinżamm 'il bogħod min-nar.
formal.en: The label indicates that the liquid is flammable and should be kept away from fire.
formal.zh: 标签说明这种液体易燃，应远离火源存放。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Nista' nħalli dan il-kontenitur ħdejn ix-xemgħa? Rita: Le, fih likwidu qabbadi; poġġih 'il bogħod min-nar.
colloquial.en: Ben: Can I leave this container next to the candle? Rita: No, it contains a flammable liquid; put it away from the flame.
colloquial.zh: 本：我能把这个容器放在蜡烛旁边吗？丽塔：不能，里面是易燃液体；把它放到远离火焰的地方。

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nħalli dan il-kontenitur ħdejn ix-xemgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nħalli dan il-kontenitur ħdejn ix-xemgħa?
messages.zh: 我能把这个容器放在蜡烛旁边吗？
messages.en: Can I leave this container next to the candle?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fih likwidu qabbadi; poġġih 'il bogħod min-nar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fih likwidu qabbadi; poġġih 'il bogħod min-nar.
messages.zh: 不能，里面是易燃液体；把它放到远离火焰的地方。
messages.en: No, it contains a flammable liquid; put it away from the flame.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qabbadi 想成容器上的火焰警示词，看到它就联想“容易着火”，并用 likwidu qabbadi“易燃液体”巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dig a grave or several graves for burial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为安葬而挖掘一座或多座墓穴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħaffer qabar wieħed jew diversi oqbra għad-dfin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖掘一座墓穴。
挖掘多座墓穴。
掘墓人；从事挖掘墓穴工作的人。

collocations.en: he dug a grave or graves in the cemetery

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem qabbar fiċ-ċimiterju bi tħejjija għad-dfin.
formal.en: The worker dug a grave in the cemetery in preparation for the burial.
formal.zh: 工人在墓地挖了一座墓穴，为安葬作准备。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'xogħol jagħmel Pawlu? Mark: Jaħdem bħala qabbar fiċ-ċimiterju.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does Pawlu do for work? Mark: He works as a gravedigger in the cemetery.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗做什么工作？马克：他在墓地做掘墓人。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗做什么工作？
messages.en: What does Pawlu do for work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在墓地做掘墓人。
messages.en: He works as a gravedigger in the cemetery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一幅掘墓场景分开记词性：动词 qabbar 表示挖墓，名词 qabbar 表示掘墓人；动作可以涉及一座或多座墓穴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To start a fire using wood or twigs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用木柴或细枝点起火来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqabbad nar bl-injam jew bi friegħi rqaq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to start a fire with wood or twigs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用木柴或细枝生火；点燃木柴或细枝来起火。

collocations.en: he started the fire with wood
he started the fire with twigs

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliem qabbas in-nar bi friegħi rqaq u mbagħad żied biċċiet akbar tal-injam.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the teacher started the fire with twigs and then added larger pieces of wood.
formal.zh: 示范时，老师先用细枝生火，然后添入较大的木块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif beda n-nar? Toni: Pawlu qabbas in-nar bi ftit friegħi niexfa.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the fire started? Toni: Pawlu started it with a few dry twigs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这火是怎么生起来的？托尼：保罗用几根干细枝把火生起来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (露营伙伴)
messages.zh: 这火是怎么生起来的？
messages.en: How was the fire started?

messages.speaker: Toni (露营伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qabbas in-nar bi ftit friegħi niexfa.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qabbas in-nar bi ftit friegħi niexfa.
messages.zh: 保罗用几根干细枝把火生起来了。
messages.en: Pawlu started it with a few dry twigs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象露营时把干细枝点着、火苗刚刚升起的瞬间，用 qabbas 记住“拿木柴或细枝把火生起来”这个动作。

gloss_zh: 使跳跃；越过排队者；获得不应有的优先待遇

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something jump; also used for passing over someone in a queue or receiving undeserved priority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物跳起来；也用于表示在排队中越过别人，或获得本不应享有的优先待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi annimal jaqbeż; jintuża wkoll meta wieħed jitħalla lura fil-kju jew meta xi ħadd jingħata prijorità li ma jistħoqqlux.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人或某物跳跃。

sense_translations.en_definition: to skip sb. in a queue
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在排队次序中越过某人，让后面的人先获得服务。
获得不应有的优先待遇。

collocations.en: passed over someone in the queue
collocations.zh: 在队列中越过某人的轮次

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, it-trejner qabbeż liż-żiemel minn fuq ostaklu baxx.
formal.en: During training, the trainer made the horse jump over a low obstacle.
formal.zh: 训练时，训练员让马跳过一道低矮的障碍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadu kif daħal dak ir-raġel? Mark: L-impjegat qabbeż lili fil-kju u daħħal lilu qabli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has that man just gone in? Mark: The employee passed over me in the queue and let him in before me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男人怎么刚才就进去了？马克：工作人员越过了我的轮次，让他先于我进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (排队者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadu kif daħal dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadu kif daħal dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 那个男人怎么刚才就进去了？
messages.en: Why has that man just gone in?

messages.speaker: Mark (排队者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-impjegat qabbeż lili fil-kju u daħħal lilu qabli.
messages.mt_standard: L-impjegat qabbeż lili fil-kju u daħħal lilu qabli.
messages.zh: 工作人员越过了我的轮次，让他先于我进去。
messages.en: The employee passed over me in the queue and let him in before me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项画成三格：让马跳起来、排队越过别人、有人被优先照顾；用场景区别动作与待遇，不把三义混成一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who composes rhyming verses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创作押韵诗句的人，重点在于能写出相互押韵的诗行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikkomponi versi li jirrimaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创作押韵诗句的人。

collocations.en: a skilled composer of rhyming verse
collocations.zh: 技艺娴熟的押韵诗句创作者

formal.mt: Il-qabbiel kiteb erba' versi li jirrimaw għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni tal-iskola.
formal.en: The verse-maker wrote four rhyming lines for the school celebration.
formal.zh: 这位押韵诗句创作者为学校庆典写了四行押韵的诗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min kiteb dawn il-versi li jirrimaw? Pawlu: Ħija; hu qabbiel tas-sengħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who wrote these rhyming verses? Pawlu: My brother; he is a skilled verse-maker.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些押韵的诗句是谁写的？保罗：我哥哥；他很擅长创作押韵诗句。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kiteb dawn il-versi li jirrimaw?
messages.mt_standard: Min kiteb dawn il-versi li jirrimaw?
messages.zh: 这些押韵的诗句是谁写的？
messages.en: Who wrote these rhyming verses?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥；他很擅长创作押韵诗句。
messages.en: My brother; he is a skilled verse-maker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把诗行末尾圈起来，检查它们是否押韵；qabbiel 指这位创作者，记住它是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 倾向押韵的；善于改作调整的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to rhyme, or able to adapt things for different purposes or circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有押韵倾向的；也可形容能够调整、改作事物，使之适合不同用途或情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jirrima, jew li jaf jadatta l-affarijiet għal użi jew ċirkostanzi differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于押韵的，具有押韵倾向的。
能够调整或改作事物的，善于使事物适应需要的。

collocations.en: a craftsman skilled at adapting things

formal.mt: L-awtur juża stil qabbieli, b'ħafna kliem li jirrima fit-truf tal-versi.
formal.en: The author uses a style inclined toward rhyme, with many rhyming words at the ends of the lines.
formal.zh: 作者采用倾向押韵的风格，在诗行末尾使用许多相互押韵的词。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taħseb li dan l-artiġjan jista' jadatta l-mejda għall-kamra ż-żgħira? Toni: Iva, hu qabbieli u jaf ibiddel l-għamara skont il-bżonn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you think this craftsman can adapt the table for the small room? Toni: Yes, he is good at adapting things and knows how to alter furniture as needed.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得这位工匠能把桌子改得适合那个小房间吗？托尼：能，他善于改作物件，知道怎样按需要调整家具。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan l-artiġjan jista' jadatta l-mejda għall-kamra ż-żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan l-artiġjan jista' jadatta l-mejda għall-kamra ż-żgħira?
messages.zh: 你觉得这位工匠能把桌子改得适合那个小房间吗？
messages.en: Do you think this craftsman can adapt the table for the small room?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu qabbieli u jaf ibiddel l-għamara skont il-bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu qabbieli u jaf ibiddel l-għamara skont il-bżonn.
messages.zh: 能，他善于改作物件，知道怎样按需要调整家具。
messages.en: Yes, he is good at adapting things and knows how to alter furniture as needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立图片记这个形容词：一张是押韵的诗行，一张是被工匠改好的桌子；两义分别记，不强编共同词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who jumps, including someone taking part in a jumping event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行跳跃的人；在体育语境中可指参加跳跃项目的运动员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqbeż, fosthom atleta li jieħu sehem f'kompetizzjoni tal-qbiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳跃的人，跳跃者。

formal.mt: Il-qabbież tal-għoli qabeż il-lasta fit-tieni tentattiv tiegħu.
formal.en: The high jumper cleared the bar on his second attempt.
formal.zh: 这名跳高运动员在第二次试跳中越过了横杆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak li qed jitħarreġ ħdejn il-lasta? Ben: Dak ħija; hu qabbież tal-għoli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that training beside the bar? Ben: That is my brother; he is a high jumper.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：在横杆旁边训练的那个人是谁？本：那是我哥哥；他是跳高运动员。

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jitħarreġ ħdejn il-lasta?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jitħarreġ ħdejn il-lasta?
messages.zh: 在横杆旁边训练的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that training beside the bar?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我哥哥；他是跳高运动员。
messages.en: That is my brother; he is a high jumper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qabbież 写在跳高运动员的号码牌上，提醒自己这个词指跳跃的人；再配合跳高、跳远两个搭配一起记。

gloss_zh: 精力充沛的；活泼的；欢蹦乱跳的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Full of energy, lively, or playfully active.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精力充沛、活泼好动的；也可形容带着玩闹劲儿、欢蹦乱跳的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mimli enerġija, ħaj u attiv, jew dejjem lest biex jilgħab u jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精力充沛的，充满活力的。
活泼的，生气勃勃的。
欢蹦乱跳的，活泼爱玩闹的。

formal.mt: It-tifel qabbieżi ħa sehem fil-logħob kollu u baqa' mimli enerġija sa tmiem l-attività.
formal.en: The energetic boy took part in every game and remained full of energy until the activity ended.
formal.zh: 这个精力充沛的男孩参加了所有游戏，直到活动结束仍然活力十足。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem irid jilgħab? Luqa: Iva, hu qabbieżi ħafna, speċjalment filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does your dog always want to play? Luqa: Yes, he is very frisky, especially in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你的狗总想玩吗？卢卡：是啊，它特别爱蹦爱闹，尤其是早上。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗总想玩吗？
messages.en: Does your dog always want to play?

messages.speaker: Luqa (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu qabbieżi ħafna, speċjalment filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu qabbieżi ħafna, speċjalment filgħodu.
messages.zh: 是啊，它特别爱蹦爱闹，尤其是早上。
messages.en: Yes, he is very frisky, especially in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象早晨还没玩够的小狗：有精力、很活泼、爱蹦闹；这三个观察角度分别帮助记住三个近义用法。

gloss_zh: 一种儿童游戏名；因喜悦或兴奋而跳跃

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a children's game; also jumping prompted by joy or excitement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种儿童游戏的名称；也表示因高兴或兴奋而跳起来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' logħba tat-tfal; ukoll qbiż minħabba ferħ jew eċċitament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种儿童游戏的名称。
因喜悦或兴奋而跳跃。

collocations.zh: 名为 qabbiżija 的儿童游戏

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni dwar il-logħob tat-tfal, l-għalliema semmiet il-logħba tal-qabbiżija.
formal.en: In the lesson about children's games, the teacher mentioned the game called qabbiżija.
formal.zh: 在介绍儿童游戏的课上，老师提到了名为 qabbiżija 的游戏。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif irreaġixxa ħuk meta sema' li rebaħ? David: Għamel qabbiżija ta' ferħ u beda jidħak.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did your brother react when he heard that he had won? David: He jumped for joy and started laughing.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你弟弟听说自己赢了以后有什么反应？戴维：他高兴得跳了起来，还笑出了声。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa ħuk meta sema' li rebaħ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa ħuk meta sema' li rebaħ?
messages.zh: 你弟弟听说自己赢了以后有什么反应？
messages.en: How did your brother react when he heard that he had won?

messages.speaker: David (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamel qabbiżija ta' ferħ u beda jidħak.
messages.mt_standard: Għamel qabbiżija ta' ferħ u beda jidħak.
messages.zh: 他高兴得跳了起来，还笑出了声。
messages.en: He jumped for joy and started laughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给词卡画两个框：一个写儿童游戏名称，另一个画获胜后高兴跳起的人；分别记游戏义和动作义，不自行补游戏规则。

gloss_zh: 传统上由女孩用玻璃珠玩的游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: A game traditionally played by girls using glass beads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种使用玻璃珠的游戏，传统上由女孩玩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba biż-żibeġ tal-ħġieġ li tradizzjonalment kienu jilagħbuha l-bniet.

sense_translations.en_definition: game traditionally played by girls with glass beads
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种传统上由女孩使用玻璃珠玩的游戏。

collocations.zh: 玩 qabbuż 玻璃珠游戏
玩 qabbuż 用的玻璃珠

formal.mt: Il-qabbuż huwa logħba biż-żibeġ tal-ħġieġ li tradizzjonalment kienu jilagħbuha l-bniet.
formal.en: Qabbuż is a game using glass beads that was traditionally played by girls.
formal.zh: Qabbuż 是一种使用玻璃珠的游戏，传统上由女孩玩。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhuma dawn iż-żibeġ tal-ħġieġ? Marija: Huma għall-qabbuż, logħba li tradizzjonalment kienu jilagħbuha l-bniet.
colloquial.en: Rita: What are these glass beads? Marija: They are for qabbuż, a game traditionally played by girls.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些玻璃珠是什么？玛丽亚：是玩 qabbuż 用的，那是一种传统上由女孩玩的游戏。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这些玻璃珠是什么？
messages.en: What are these glass beads?

messages.speaker: Marija (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma għall-qabbuż, logħba li tradizzjonalment kienu jilagħbuha l-bniet.
messages.mt_standard: Huma għall-qabbuż, logħba li tradizzjonalment kienu jilagħbuha l-bniet.
messages.zh: 是玩 qabbuż 用的，那是一种传统上由女孩玩的游戏。
messages.en: They are for qabbuż, a game traditionally played by girls.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 qabbuż 词卡旁画一袋玻璃珠，并写上游戏名称；用明确的游戏材料帮助记忆，不把它误记成玻璃珠本身的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The thing that has been taken or obtained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被取走或取得的东西，着重指取得的对象或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħaġa li tkun ittieħdet jew inkisbet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所取之物，被取得的东西。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tas-sajd, il-qabd tal-lum ġie deskritt bħala ħuta waħda biss.
formal.en: In the fishing report, what was taken today was described as just one fish.
formal.zh: 捕鱼报告中记载，今天取得的渔获只有一条鱼。

colloquial.mt: Mina: X'kien il-qabd tal-lum? Ġorġ: Ħuta waħda biss, imma kienet kbira.
colloquial.en: Mina: What did you get today? Ġorġ: Just one fish, but it was big.
colloquial.zh: 米娜：今天捕到了什么？乔治：只有一条鱼，不过个头很大。

messages.speaker: Mina (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天捕到了什么？
messages.en: What did you get today?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (钓鱼者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuta waħda biss, imma kienet kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Ħuta waħda biss, imma kienet kbira.
messages.zh: 只有一条鱼，不过个头很大。
messages.en: Just one fish, but it was big.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把取得的东西放到桌上，再给它贴上 qabd 标签；学习重点是桌上的所取之物，而不是伸手取得的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tribe: a community of people connected by shared ancestry, customs or identity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 部落，指因共同血缘、习俗或群体认同而联系在一起的人群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies magħqudin b'nisel, drawwiet jew identità komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 部落；具有共同血缘、习俗或身份认同的人群。
部落；种类或物种，具体含义取决于所指的人群或生物。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi d-drawwiet tal-qabil u r-relazzjonijiet bejn il-membri tiegħu.
formal.en: The study describes the tribe's customs and the relationships among its members.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了该部落的习俗及其成员之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Mark: Dwar qabil u d-drawwiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this book about? Mark: About a tribe and its customs.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书讲什么？马克：讲一个部落和它的习俗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 讲一个部落和它的习俗。
messages.en: About a tribe and its customs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qabil 和“共同生活、共享习俗的一群人”连起来记；读到生物语境时，再考虑“种类、物种”这一义项。

gloss_zh: 玩得很开心；嬉戏、蹦跳玩耍

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enjoy oneself greatly, especially by playing or moving about playfully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尽情玩乐、玩得很开心，尤其指嬉戏或活泼地蹦跳玩耍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu gost ħafna, speċjalment waqt il-logħob jew meta jiġri u jaqbeż bil-ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩得非常开心；尽情享受欢乐时光。
嬉戏玩耍；欢快地蹦跳、奔跑。

collocations.en: had a great time with friends
played and gambolled in the garden

formal.mt: Waqt il-ħarġa tal-iskola, it-tifel qabras mal-ħbieb tiegħu fil-ġnien.
formal.en: During the school outing, the boy played happily with his friends in the garden.
formal.zh: 学校组织外出活动时，那个男孩和朋友们在花园里尽情嬉戏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar Luqa fil-festa? Pawlu: Qabras il-ħin kollu mal-ħbieb tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Luqa get on at the party? Pawlu: He had a great time with his friends the whole time!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：卢卡在聚会上玩得怎么样？保罗：他一直和朋友们玩得特别开心！

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 卢卡在聚会上玩得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Luqa get on at the party?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 他一直和朋友们玩得特别开心！
messages.en: He had a great time with his friends the whole time!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子在花园里开心地跑跳，把 qabras 同“玩得尽兴”和“蹦跳嬉戏”这两个相连的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 引火柴；生火用的细小燃料

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small, easily burning material, such as dry twigs, used to start a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引燃火堆的细小易燃材料，例如干燥的小树枝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal żgħir li jaqbad malajr, bħal friegħi rqaq u niexfa, u li jintuża biex jitqabbad in-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生火用的引火物，如干细枝、碎木片等易燃材料。

formal.mt: Biex iqabbad in-nar, poġġa l-qabs niexef taħt il-biċċiet l-kbar tal-injam.
formal.en: To start the fire, he placed the dry kindling beneath the larger pieces of wood.
formal.zh: 为了生火，他把干燥的引火柴放在较大的木块下面。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandna qabs għan-nar? Rita: Iva, hemm ftit friegħi niexfa fil-kaxxa.
