colloquial.en: Mark: Do we have kindling for the fire? Rita: Yes, there are some dry twigs in the box.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们有生火用的引火柴吗？丽塔：有，箱子里有一些干细枝。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们有生火用的引火柴吗？
messages.en: Do we have kindling for the fire?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit friegħi niexfa fil-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit friegħi niexfa fil-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 有，箱子里有一些干细枝。
messages.en: Yes, there are some dry twigs in the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住生火时先放细干枝、再放大木块的顺序：qabs 就是最先帮助火烧起来的那一小堆引火材料。

gloss_zh: 敢于；有胆量、有勇气去做

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dare to do something or have the courage and initiative to do it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敢于做某事；有胆量和主动采取行动的勇气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu l-kuraġġ jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jieħu l-inizjattiva biex jagħmilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敢于；有胆量做某事。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have the gumption to do sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有勇气、有魄力或有主见去做某事。

formal.mt: Minkejja l-biża' tiegħu, l-istudent qadar jitkellem quddiem il-klassi kollha.
formal.en: Despite his fear, the student dared to speak in front of the whole class.
formal.zh: 尽管心里害怕，这名学生还是鼓起勇气在全班面前发言。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Luqa qadar jistaqsi lill-għalliem? Maja: Iva, fl-aħħar għamel il-mistoqsija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Luqa have the courage to ask the teacher? Maja: Yes, he finally asked the question.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：卢卡敢向老师提问了吗？玛雅：敢了，他终于把问题问出来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 卢卡敢向老师提问了吗？
messages.en: Did Luqa have the courage to ask the teacher?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 敢了，他终于把问题问出来了。
messages.en: Yes, he finally asked the question.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qadar 放进“心里害怕，最后仍敢开口”的情景来记；重点是有勇气采取行动，而不只是具备做事的能力。

gloss_zh: 勉强干活；和别人一起不停地苦干

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work reluctantly, or to work very hard alongside others without resting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不情愿地干活；也指与别人一起非常卖力地工作而不休息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem kontra qalbu, jew jaħdem iebes ħafna mal-oħrajn mingħajr ma jieqaf jistrieħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to work reluctantly; to work very hard with others without taking a rest
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不情愿地工作；与他人一起不停歇地苦干、拼命干活。

collocations.en: worked very hard alongside the others

formal.mt: Biex ix-xogħol jitlesta fil-ħin, Ġużeppi qadaħ mal-oħrajn minn filgħodu sa filgħaxija mingħajr mistrieħ.
formal.en: To get the work finished on time, Ġużeppi toiled alongside the others from morning until evening without a rest.
formal.zh: 为了按时完成工作，朱塞佩和其他人从早到晚不停歇地苦干。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Ġużeppi hu daqshekk għajjien? Pawlu: Qadaħ magħna l-ġurnata kollha, lanqas waqaf jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is Ġużeppi so tired? Pawlu: He toiled with us all day and did not even stop for a rest.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：朱塞佩为什么这么累？保罗：他和我们苦干了一整天，连休息都没停下来过。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 朱塞佩为什么这么累？
messages.en: Why is Ġużeppi so tired?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qadaħ magħna l-ġurnata kollha, lanqas waqaf jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Qadaħ magħna l-ġurnata kollha, lanqas waqaf jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他和我们苦干了一整天，连休息都没停下来过。
messages.en: He toiled with us all day and did not even stop for a rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qadaħ 配两幅工作画面：一幅是心里不情愿仍在干活，另一幅是跟大家一直苦干不休息；结合上下文判断侧重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the body between the ribs and the hips, where a belt is usually worn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肋骨与髋部之间的身体部位，通常也是系腰带的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġisem bejn il-kustilji u l-ġenbejn, fejn normalment jintlibes iċ-ċinturin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腰；躯干中位于肋骨与髋部之间的部位。

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat ħa l-kejl tal-qadd qabel ma beda jħit il-qalziet.
formal.en: The tailor took the waist measurement before beginning to sew the trousers.
formal.zh: 裁缝在开始缝制裤子之前量了腰围。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-qalziet issikkat wisq mal-qadd. Rita: Ipprova daqs akbar.
colloquial.en: Mark: These trousers are too tight at the waist. Rita: Try a larger size.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条裤子的腰部太紧了。丽塔：试试大一码的。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这条裤子的腰部太紧了。
messages.en: These trousers are too tight at the waist.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 试试大一码的。
messages.en: Try a larger size.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象腰带围住身体的位置来记 qadd，再把“量腰围”和“裤腰太紧”两个日常场景一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something forward, put forward an idea or proposal, or introduce someone to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事向前推进，提出想法或建议，或把某人介绍给别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexxa xi ħaġa 'l quddiem, ressaq idea jew proposta, jew introduċa persuna ma' oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 推进某事；使某物向前移动。
提出某事，如想法、建议或方案。
介绍某人，使其与别人认识。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, il-membru qaddam proposta biex jitjieb is-servizz.
formal.en: During the meeting, the member put forward a proposal to improve the service.
formal.zh: 会议期间，这位成员提出了一项改善服务的建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark qaddam lil Sara lill-grupp? Lara: Iva, u wara tkellimna magħha lkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark introduce Sara to the group? Lara: Yes, and afterwards we all talked to her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把萨拉介绍给小组了吗？拉拉：介绍了，后来我们大家都和她聊了聊。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把萨拉介绍给小组了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark introduce Sara to the group?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u wara tkellimna magħha lkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u wara tkellimna magħha lkoll.
messages.zh: 介绍了，后来我们大家都和她聊了聊。
messages.en: Yes, and afterwards we all talked to her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个连续画面记忆 qaddam：把项目向前推，把建议摆到大家面前，再把新朋友介绍给大家；分别对应推进、提出和介绍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove moisture from something, especially to preserve food by drying, or to make someone skinny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物失去水分，尤指通过干燥保存食物；也指使人变得干瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-umdità minn xi ħaġa, speċjalment biex jippreserva l-ikel bit-tnixxif, jew ġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir irqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄干；使水分减少或消失。
通过晒干或其他干燥方式保存食物。
使脱水；使充分干燥。
使人变得很瘦或干瘦。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi qadded it-tadam fix-xemx biex ikun jista' jaħżnu għal żmien itwal.
formal.en: The farmer dried the tomatoes in the sun so that he could store them for longer.
formal.zh: 农民把番茄晒干，以便保存更长时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu qadded il-bżar? Mark: Biex iżommu għax-xitwa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu dry the peppers? Mark: To keep them for the winter.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么把辣椒晒干了？马克：为了留到冬天吃。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么把辣椒晒干了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu dry the peppers?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了留到冬天吃。
messages.en: To keep them for the winter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qadded 配上鲜番茄变成番茄干的前后对照图，记住它表示使东西变干；再用人物变干瘦的画面补记另一义。

gloss_zh: 鞭打者；棍打者；生枝或发芽的载体

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who whips or strikes with a stick; also, something from which branches or shoots grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用鞭子抽打或用棍棒打人的人；也指枝条或新芽从中长出的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssawwat b'frosta jew b'bastun; ukoll xi ħaġa li minnha joħorġu friegħi jew rimjiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who whips or hits with a stick
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用鞭子抽打或用棍棒打人的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. from which branches or shoots grow
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能长出枝条或新芽的东西，如承载新生枝芽的植物部分。

collocations.en: a person who beats others, with a stick in his hand
collocations.zh: 手里拿着棍棒的打人者

collocations.en: a bearer from which shoots emerge

formal.mt: F'din id-deskrizzjoni tal-pjanta, il-kelma qaddieb tindika l-parti li minnha joħorġu r-rimjiet.
formal.en: In this description of the plant, the word qaddieb identifies the part from which shoots emerge.
formal.zh: 在这段植物描述中，qaddieb 一词指长出新芽的部位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-qaddieb fl-istorja? Mark: Ir-raġel li jsawwat lin-nies b'bastun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the qaddieb in the story? Mark: The man who beats people with a stick.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里谁是那个棍打者？马克：就是那个用棍棒打人的男人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里谁是那个棍打者？
messages.en: Who is the qaddieb in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 就是那个用棍棒打人的男人。
messages.en: The man who beats people with a stick.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qaddieb 做两张独立图卡：一张是持鞭或持棍的人，一张是冒出新芽的植物部位。两义分开记，遇到句子再按语境选择。

gloss_zh: 惯于鞭打或棍打的；易生枝芽的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to whip or strike with a stick, or inclined to produce shoots or branches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人惯于鞭打或用棍棒打人；也形容植物容易长出新芽或枝条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jsawwat b'frosta jew b'bastun, jew li joħroġ rimjiet jew friegħi.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to whip or hit with a stick
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于用鞭子抽打或用棍棒打人的。

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to grow shoots or branches
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易长出新芽或枝条的。

collocations.en: a man inclined to whip or beat with a stick
collocations.zh: 惯于鞭打或棍打别人的男人

collocations.en: a shrub that readily produces shoots or branches
collocations.zh: 容易萌芽或生枝的灌木

formal.mt: Il-karattru qaddiebi fir-rakkont juża bastun biex isawwat lil ħaddieħor.
formal.en: The character inclined to beating in the story uses a stick to strike others.
formal.zh: 故事中这个惯于打人的角色用棍棒殴打别人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-arbuxxell qaddiebi? Pawlu: Iva, joħroġ ħafna rimjiet ġodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this shrub readily produce shoots? Pawlu: Yes, it puts out lots of new shoots.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这株灌木容易发新芽吗？保罗：是的，它会长出很多新芽。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这株灌木容易发新芽吗？
messages.en: Does this shrub readily produce shoots?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.zh: 是的，它会长出很多新芽。
messages.en: Yes, it puts out lots of new shoots.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 qaddiebi 时，在两幅图旁都写上“容易、惯于”：人惯于挥鞭打人，植物容易抽枝发芽。这样同时记住两义和形容词功能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who dries fruit or vegetables.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事水果或蔬菜干燥处理的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tnixxef il-frott jew il-ħaxix.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who dries fruits or vegetables
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把水果或蔬菜晒干、烘干或以其他方式制干的人。

formal.mt: Il-qaddied tal-frott iqiegħed it-tin fuq xtillieri nodfa biex jinxef.
formal.en: The fruit dryer places the figs on clean racks to dry.
formal.zh: 这位水果干制者把无花果放在干净的架子上晾干。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak ħdejn it-tadam? Mark: Hu l-qaddied; qed iħejji t-tadam biex jinxef.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that beside the tomatoes? Mark: He's the person who dries them; he's preparing the tomatoes for drying.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：番茄旁边那个人是谁？马克：他是干制工，正在准备把番茄制干。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 番茄旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that beside the tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-qaddied; qed iħejji t-tadam biex jinxef.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-qaddied; qed iħejji t-tadam biex jinxef.
messages.zh: 他是干制工，正在准备把番茄制干。
messages.en: He's the person who dries them; he's preparing the tomatoes for drying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位把无花果逐个摆上晾架的工人，在他的名牌上写 qaddied；重点记住这里指做果蔬干制工作的人。

gloss_zh: 有干燥作用的；使脱水的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a drying effect that removes moisture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有去除水分、使物体干燥的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jneħħi l-umdità u jnixxef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使物体失去水分、变得干燥的作用的。

formal.mt: Ir-riħ qaddiedi jnaqqas l-umdità fil-wiċċ tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: The desiccating wind reduces moisture at the soil surface.
formal.zh: 具有干燥作用的风会减少土壤表面的水分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħamrija nixfet daqshekk malajr? Pawlu: Illum hemm riħ qaddiedi ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the soil dry out so quickly? Pawlu: There's a very drying wind today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：土怎么这么快就干了？保罗：今天的风特别容易把水分吹干。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 土怎么这么快就干了？
messages.en: Why did the soil dry out so quickly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.zh: 今天的风特别容易把水分吹干。
messages.en: There's a very drying wind today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qaddiedi 写在吹向湿土的风箭头上，想象水滴逐渐消失；记忆重点是“有使东西变干的作用”，而非只描述已经干了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to row a boat quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具备快速划船能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li kapaċi jaqdef dgħajsa malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够快速划船的。

collocations.en: a man who can row fast
a sailor who can row fast

formal.mt: Għall-kompetizzjoni ntgħażel baħħar qaddiefi li kapaċi jżomm ritmu mgħaġġel.
formal.en: A sailor who can row fast and maintain a quick pace was selected for the competition.
formal.zh: 一位能快速划船并保持较快节奏的水手获选参加比赛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu qaddiefi? Mark: Iva, jaqdef malajr ħafna; nagħżluh għat-tellieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can Pawlu row fast? Mark: Yes, he rows very fast; let's choose him for the race.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗划船快吗？马克：快，他划得很快；我们选他参加比赛吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.zh: 保罗划船快吗？
messages.en: Can Pawlu row fast?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jaqdef malajr ħafna; nagħżluh għat-tellieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jaqdef malajr ħafna; nagħżluh għat-tellieqa.
messages.zh: 快，他划得很快；我们选他参加比赛吧。
messages.en: Yes, he rows very fast; let's choose him for the race.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一名划手双桨飞动、小船迅速前进，把 qaddiefi 标在划手身旁；记住它形容人的快速划船能力。

gloss_zh: 使人衰老者；提出者；伐木者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes aging, a person who puts something forward, or a woodcutter, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境可指使人衰老的人、提出某事的人，或砍伐木材的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont il-kuntest, persuna li ġġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jixjieħ, persuna li tressaq xi ħaġa, jew persuna li taqta' s-siġar għall-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使别人衰老或显老的人。
提出某事的人，如建议或方案的提出者。
伐木者；砍树或砍木材的人。

collocations.en: the person putting forward the proposal
a woodcutter who cuts down trees

collocations.mt: qaddiem li jġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jixjieħ
collocations.en: a person who causes others to age

formal.mt: Il-qaddiem tal-proposta spjega l-għan tagħha u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tal-kumitat.
formal.en: The person putting forward the proposal explained its purpose and answered the committee's questions.
formal.zh: 该建议的提出者说明了建议的目的，并回答了委员会的问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min qata' dawk is-siġar? Mark: Il-qaddiem li rajna fil-bosk dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who cut down those trees? Mark: The woodcutter we saw in the woods this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那些树是谁砍的？马克：就是我们今天早上在树林里见到的那个伐木者。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那些树是谁砍的？
messages.en: Who cut down those trees?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 就是我们今天早上在树林里见到的那个伐木者。
messages.en: The woodcutter we saw in the woods this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qaddiem 建三格人物卡：让别人添白发的人、递交建议的人、持斧伐木的人。三个画面分别存放，读句子时用上下文判断所指。

gloss_zh: 使显老的；使过时的；促使提出或推进的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make someone or something appear older; also used of an effect that makes something obsolete or helps put something forward or advance it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于使人或事物显老的；也可指使事物过时，或促使某事被提出、得到推进的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa tidher eqdem; jista' wkoll jagħmel xi ħaġa skaduta, iressaqha jew jgħinha timxi 'l quddiem.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to have an aging effect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于产生老化或显老效果的。
使某事物过时或不再适用的。
倾向于把某事物提出或向前推的。
倾向于促进或推进某事物的。

collocations.zh: 使人或事物显老的效果

collocations.en: a style that makes something look older
collocations.zh: 使事物显得老旧的风格

formal.mt: Fil-valutazzjoni tad-disinn, il-kulur skur tqies li kellu effett qaddiemi fuq id-dehra tal-kamra.
formal.en: In the design assessment, the dark colour was considered to have an aging effect on the room's appearance.
formal.zh: 在设计评估中，这种深色被认为会使房间的外观显得老旧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kulur għandu effett qaddiemi fuq il-kamra. Lara: Iva, ejja nagħżlu kulur li jagħmilha tidher aktar friska.
colloquial.en: Maja: This colour makes the room look older. Lara: Yes, let's choose a colour that makes it look fresher.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个颜色让房间显得老旧。Lara：是啊，我们选个让房间看起来更清新的颜色吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kulur għandu effett qaddiemi fuq il-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kulur għandu effett qaddiemi fuq il-kamra.
messages.zh: 这个颜色让房间显得老旧。
messages.en: This colour makes the room look older.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nagħżlu kulur li jagħmilha tidher aktar friska.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nagħżlu kulur li jagħmilha tidher aktar friska.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们选个让房间看起来更清新的颜色吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's choose a colour that makes it look fresher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分组记忆：一幅是颜色让房间显老，一幅是把方案向前推进；再按语境区分显老、过时与推进。

gloss_zh: 使成圣者；主持神圣仪式者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sanctifies someone or something, or who presides over a holy rite such as Mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物成圣的人，或主持弥撒等神圣仪式的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqaddes lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew li tmexxi rit qaddis bħall-quddiesa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人或事物成圣的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who presides over a holy rite (e.g. mass)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 主持神圣仪式（例如弥撒）的人。

collocations.en: the person presiding over the rite

formal.mt: Il-qaddies mexxa r-rit qaddis, filwaqt li l-kongregazzjoni ħadet sehem fit-talb.
formal.en: The officiant presided over the holy rite while the congregation took part in the prayers.
formal.zh: 主持者主持了神圣仪式，会众则参与祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min hu l-qaddies tar-rit illum? Anna: Huwa s-saċerdot li qed jitkellem mal-kongregazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is presiding over the rite today? Anna: It is the priest who is speaking to the congregation.
colloquial.zh: Mark：今天谁主持这个仪式？Anna：就是正在和会众说话的那位神父。

messages.speaker: Mark (参加仪式者)
messages.zh: 今天谁主持这个仪式？
messages.en: Who is presiding over the rite today?

messages.speaker: Anna (参加仪式者)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa s-saċerdot li qed jitkellem mal-kongregazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa s-saċerdot li qed jitkellem mal-kongregazzjoni.
messages.zh: 就是正在和会众说话的那位神父。
messages.en: It is the priest who is speaking to the congregation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词放在仪式主持者的胸牌上记忆：它指执行成圣行为或主持圣礼的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that sanctifies a person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使人或事物成圣、成为神圣之物的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett ta' tqaddis fuq persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使人或事物成圣的作用的。

formal.mt: Fil-kummentarju reliġjuż, ir-rit huwa deskritt bħala qaddiesi minħabba l-effett tiegħu ta' tqaddis.
formal.en: In the religious commentary, the rite is described as sanctifying because of its sanctifying effect.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教评注中，该仪式因其成圣作用而被描述为具有成圣功效。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser li rit huwa qaddiesi? Pawlu: Ifisser li għandu effett ta' tqaddis.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does it mean to say that a rite is sanctifying? Pawlu: It means that it has an effect that makes someone or something holy.
colloquial.zh: Lara：说一个仪式具有成圣作用是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是它具有使人或事物成为神圣的作用。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li rit huwa qaddiesi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li rit huwa qaddiesi?
messages.zh: 说一个仪式具有成圣作用是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean to say that a rite is sanctifying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu effett ta' tqaddis.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu effett ta' tqaddis.
messages.zh: 意思是它具有使人或事物成为神圣的作用。
messages.en: It means that it has an effect that makes someone or something holy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 与 qaddies 对照记忆：前者可以指仪式中的人，qaddiesi 则贴在仪式或效果旁，表示具有成圣作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A foot or a pace forward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脚，或向前迈出的一步。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sieq jew pass 'il quddiem.

sense_translations.en_definition: (N.B. For common roots see also quddiem) Foot. Pace Forward
sense_translations.zh_definition: 脚；向前一步。（注：关于共同词根，另参见 quddiem。）

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipant jagħmel qadm 'il quddiem u mbagħad jieqaf.
formal.en: In the exercise, the participant takes a pace forward and then stops.
formal.zh: 练习中，参与者向前迈出一步，然后停下。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nagħmel qadm ieħor 'il quddiem? Mark: Iva, u mbagħad ieqaf hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall I take another pace forward? Mark: Yes, and then stop there.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我要再向前迈一步吗？Mark：对，然后停在那里。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 我要再向前迈一步吗？
messages.en: Shall I take another pace forward?

messages.speaker: Mark (教练)
messages.zh: 对，然后停在那里。
messages.en: Yes, and then stop there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地上画着一个脚印和向前的箭头，把“脚”与“向前迈一步”连成同一幅记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put birds, especially domestic fowl, into a cage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把鸟类，尤其是家禽，放进或关进笼子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed għasafar, speċjalment tjur domestiċi, f'gaġġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to put in a cage (used of birds, especially domestic fowl)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把鸟关进笼子，尤其用于家禽。
制作笼子的人；造笼者。

collocations.en: put the chickens in a cage
put the birds in a cage

formal.mt: Qabel it-trasport, il-bidwi qaffas it-tiġieġ f'gaġġa spazjuża u ventilata.
formal.en: Before transport, the farmer put the chickens in a spacious, ventilated cage.
formal.zh: 运输前，农民把鸡放进一个宽敞、通风的笼子里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu qaffas it-tiġieġ? Toni: Għax se jeħodhom fir-razzett l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu put the chickens in a cage? Toni: Because he is taking them to the other farm.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 为什么把鸡关进笼子？Toni：因为他要把它们带到另一个农场。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么把鸡关进笼子？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu put the chickens in a cage?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场帮手)
messages.zh: 因为他要把它们带到另一个农场。
messages.en: Because he is taking them to the other farm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片区分词性：动词卡画把鸡放入笼子的动作，名词卡画正在制作笼子的工匠。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who locks someone or something away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人或某物关起来并上锁的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħlaq lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa f'post u ssakkar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把人或物锁起来的人。

collocations.en: the person who locks the documents away
the person who locks valuables away
collocations.zh: 把贵重物品锁起来的人

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, il-qaffiel ipoġġi d-dokumenti fil-kaxxa u jagħlaqha biċ-ċavetta kull filgħaxija.
formal.en: In this story, the person who locks things away places the documents in the box and locks it with a key every evening.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，负责把东西锁起来的人每晚把文件放进箱子，再用钥匙锁好。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu l-qaffiel tad-dokumenti fir-rakkont? Mark: Huwa r-raġel li jpoġġihom fil-kaxxa u jsakkarha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the person who locks the documents away in the story? Mark: It is the man who puts them in the box and locks it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：故事里把文件锁起来的是谁？Mark：就是那个把文件放进箱子并锁好的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 故事里把文件锁起来的是谁？
messages.en: Who is the person who locks the documents away in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa r-raġel li jpoġġihom fil-kaxxa u jsakkarha.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa r-raġel li jpoġġihom fil-kaxxa u jsakkarha.
messages.zh: 就是那个把文件放进箱子并锁好的人。
messages.en: It is the man who puts them in the box and locks it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把文件放进箱子、转动钥匙，再把词贴在这个人身上，记住它指执行上锁动作的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make baskets by weaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过编织来制作篮子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel qfief billi jinseġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编织篮子。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-artiġjan qafqaf qoffa tal-qasab quddiem il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the craftsperson wove a reed basket in front of the participants.
formal.zh: 示范期间，工匠在参与者面前编织了一个芦苇篮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel in-nannu lbieraħ? Toni: Qafqaf qoffa żgħira għall-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Grandpa do yesterday? Toni: He wove a small basket for bread.
colloquial.zh: Nina：爷爷昨天做了什么？Toni：他编了一个装面包的小篮子。

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷昨天做了什么？
messages.en: What did Grandpa do yesterday?

messages.speaker: Toni (孙子)
messages.zh: 他编了一个装面包的小篮子。
messages.en: He wove a small basket for bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词分成两拍 qaf、qaf 来朗读，同时想象双手一上一下交替编篮；这是动作联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 平地田野的；用于 raba' qagħadi

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing fields on flat ground, especially in raba' qagħadi, in contrast to uphill fields called raba' tas-sellum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容位于平地上的田野，尤其用于 raba' qagħadi，与称为 raba' tas-sellum 的坡地田野相对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi raba' fuq art ċatta, fl-espressjoni raba' qagħadi, għall-kuntrarju ta' raba' tas-sellum fuq art li titla'.

sense_translations.en_definition: (for qagħdi) raba' qagħadi, plain fields as opposed to raba' tas-sellum, uphill fields. (toponymy) Il-Qagħdi, white soil fields (bajjad) lying north-east of L-Imdawra south of Imqarqċa near Is-Salina ta' Burmarrad
sense_translations.zh_definition: （代 qagħdi）用于 raba' qagħadi，指平地田野，与 raba' tas-sellum（坡地田野）相对。地名义：Il-Qagħdi，指白土田地（bajjad），位于 L-Imdawra 东北、Imqarqċa 以南，靠近 Is-Salina ta' Burmarrad。

collocations.en: a plot of farmland on flat ground

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, it-terminu raba' qagħadi jintuża għall-għelieqi fuq art ċatta, biex jintgħarfu mir-raba' tas-sellum.
formal.en: In the report, the term raba' qagħadi is used for fields on flat ground to distinguish them from uphill fields.
formal.zh: 报告使用 raba' qagħadi 一词指平地上的田野，以便将其与坡地田野区分开来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-biċċa raba' hija fuq art ċatta? Pawlu: Iva, hija raba' qagħadi; mhijiex raba' tas-sellum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this plot of farmland on flat ground? Pawlu: Yes, it is flat farmland; it is not uphill farmland.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块农田位于平地上吗？Pawlu：是的，这是平地农田，不是坡地农田。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-biċċa raba' hija fuq art ċatta?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-biċċa raba' hija fuq art ċatta?
messages.zh: 这块农田位于平地上吗？
messages.en: Is this plot of farmland on flat ground?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija raba' qagħadi; mhijiex raba' tas-sellum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija raba' qagħadi; mhijiex raba' tas-sellum.
messages.zh: 是的，这是平地农田，不是坡地农田。
messages.en: Yes, it is flat farmland; it is not uphill farmland.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两块并排的田：平坦的一块标 raba' qagħadi，沿坡向上的一块标 raba' tas-sellum，用地形对比记忆。

gloss_zh: 使人尝试；促使人试一试

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to try something or make an attempt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人尝试某事，促使某人作出尝试。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jipprova xi ħaġa jew jagħmel tentattiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人尝试；促使某人试一试。

collocations.en: to get the student to try a new method

formal.mt: L-eżempju tal-għalliem qajjar lill-istudent jipprova metodu ġdid biex isolvi l-problema.
formal.en: The teacher's example got the student to try a new method for solving the problem.
formal.zh: 老师的示例促使这名学生尝试用一种新方法解决问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qajjrek tipprova din il-logħba? Nina: Il-filmat li bgħattli; dehret divertenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What got you to try this game? Nina: The video you sent me; it looked fun.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是什么让你想试试这个游戏的？妮娜：你发给我的那个视频；看起来挺好玩的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是什么让你想试试这个游戏的？
messages.en: What got you to try this game?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你发给我的那个视频；看起来挺好玩的。
messages.en: The video you sent me; it looked fun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条“看到示例→动手试试”的箭头，把 qajjar 放在箭头上，记住它表示促成别人的尝试。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wake someone from sleep or bring someone to a standing position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人从睡眠中叫醒，或把某人扶起、拉起至站立姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd jistenbaħ mill-irqad jew jgħinu joqgħod fuq saqajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叫醒；使从睡眠中醒来。
把某人扶起或拉起，使其站立。

collocations.en: to wake the boy from sleep
to help the patient to his feet

formal.mt: L-infermier qajjem lill-pazjent fuq saqajh u għenu jimxi lejn is-siġġu.
formal.en: The nurse helped the patient to his feet and helped him walk towards the chair.
formal.zh: 护士把患者扶起来站好，并扶着他走向椅子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qajjimtni daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Għax il-karozza tal-linja titlaq fis-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you wake me so early? Mark: Because the bus leaves at seven.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么这么早叫醒我？马克：因为公交车七点就出发。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么早叫醒我？
messages.en: Why did you wake me so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.zh: 因为公交车七点就出发。
messages.en: Because the bus leaves at seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 qajjem：一幅是叫醒床上的人，一幅是扶起坐着的人，分别对应“醒来”和“站起来”。

gloss_zh: 给人上镣铐或锁链的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who puts shackles or chains on someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责给别人戴上镣铐或锁链的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li torbot lil ħaddieħor bil-ktajjen jew tqegħidlu l-irbit tal-ħadid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给别人戴上镣铐或用锁链捆缚的人。

collocations.en: the person who shackles the prisoners

collocations.zh: 手里拿着锁链的上镣者

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qajjied resaq lejn il-priġunier u rabatlu saqajh bil-ktajjen.
formal.en: In the story, the shackler approached the prisoner and chained his feet.
formal.zh: 故事中，负责上镣铐的人走向囚犯，用锁链锁住了他的双脚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak bil-ktajjen f'idu? Mark: Dak il-qajjied; se jorbot lill-priġunier.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that holding the chains? Mark: That's the shackler; he's going to chain the prisoner.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个手里拿着锁链的人是谁？Mark：那是负责上镣铐的人，他要给囚犯上锁链。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个手里拿着锁链的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that holding the chains?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是负责上镣铐的人，他要给囚犯上锁链。
messages.en: That's the shackler; he's going to chain the prisoner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qajjied 配上一幅手持锁链、给人上镣铐的画面，记住它指执行这个动作的人。

gloss_zh: 负责让畜群待在阴凉处的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person responsible for keeping a herd of animals in shaded places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责照管畜群，让动物待在阴凉处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna responsabbli biex iżżomm il-merħliet tal-annimali f'postijiet fid-dell.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is responsible for keeping herds of animals in shady places
sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责将畜群安置、看管在阴凉处的人。

collocations.en: the person responsible for keeping the herd in the shade
collocations.zh: 负责让畜群待在阴凉处的人

collocations.en: a person who keeps the sheep in the shade
collocations.zh: 把羊群照管在阴凉处的人

formal.mt: Il-qajjiel żamm il-merħla fid-dell tas-siġar waqt l-aktar sigħat sħan tal-ġurnata.
formal.en: The person responsible for shading the herd kept it under the trees during the hottest hours of the day.
formal.zh: 在一天中最热的几个小时里，负责照管畜群避暑的人让畜群待在树荫下。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jieħu ħsieb li n-nagħaġ jibqgħu fid-dell? Pawlu: Il-qajjiel; diġà sab post taħt is-siġar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will make sure the sheep stay in the shade? Pawlu: The person in charge of that; he's already found a spot under the trees.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁来照看羊群，让它们待在阴凉处？Pawlu：负责这件事的看管人，他已经在树下找好地方了。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb li n-nagħaġ jibqgħu fid-dell?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb li n-nagħaġ jibqgħu fid-dell?
messages.zh: 谁来照看羊群，让它们待在阴凉处？
messages.en: Who will make sure the sheep stay in the shade?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牧羊人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qajjiel; diġà sab post taħt is-siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qajjiel; diġà sab post taħt is-siġar.
messages.zh: 负责这件事的看管人，他已经在树下找好地方了。
messages.en: The person in charge of that; he's already found a spot under the trees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qajjiel 想成站在树荫旁照管羊群的人，记忆重点是畜群加阴凉处这两个条件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who wakes other people from sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把睡着的人叫醒的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqajjem lil nies oħra mill-irqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唤醒别人、把别人从睡梦中叫醒的人。

collocations.en: to work as someone who wakes others
the person who wakes the workers

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qajjiem għadda jħabbat fuq il-bibien biex iqajjem lill-ħaddiema qabel is-sebħ.
formal.en: In the story, the person responsible for waking others went around knocking on doors to wake the workers before dawn.
formal.zh: 故事中，负责叫醒别人的人挨家敲门，在黎明前叫醒工人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jqajjimna għada filgħodu? Toni: Jien se nkun il-qajjiem tagħkom; inħabbat fuq il-bieb fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who's going to wake us tomorrow morning? Toni: I'll be your wake-up person; I'll knock on the door at six.
colloquial.zh: Nina：明天早上谁来叫醒我们？Toni：我来当你们的叫醒人，六点敲门。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 明天早上谁来叫醒我们？
messages.en: Who's going to wake us tomorrow morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se nkun il-qajjiem tagħkom; inħabbat fuq il-bieb fis-sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Jien se nkun il-qajjiem tagħkom; inħabbat fuq il-bieb fis-sitta.
messages.zh: 我来当你们的叫醒人，六点敲门。
messages.en: I'll be your wake-up person; I'll knock on the door at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qajjiem 画成清晨敲门叫人起床的人；本词条按名词记，重点是叫醒者。

gloss_zh: 容易激起情绪或反应的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to stir feelings, interest, or a reaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有唤起、激发作用的，容易引起情绪、兴趣或反应的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jqanqal sentimenti, interess jew reazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易唤起或激发情绪、兴趣、反应等的。

collocations.en: a speech that stirs a response

formal.mt: Id-diskors qajjiemi tal-kelliem qanqal interess qawwi fost dawk li attendew.
formal.en: The speaker's stirring speech aroused strong interest among those who attended.
formal.zh: 演讲者那番富有感染力的讲话激起了在场听众的浓厚兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kulħadd beda jiddiskuti wara d-diskors? Ben: Għax kien diskors qajjiemi; il-kliem tiegħu qanqal ħafna emozzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did everyone start discussing things after the speech? Ben: Because it was a stirring speech; his words brought out a lot of emotions.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么讲话结束后大家都讨论起来了？Ben：因为那番讲话很能激起反应，他的话唤起了许多情绪。

messages.speaker: Sara (听众)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd beda jiddiskuti wara d-diskors?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd beda jiddiskuti wara d-diskors?
messages.zh: 为什么讲话结束后大家都讨论起来了？
messages.en: Why did everyone start discussing things after the speech?

messages.speaker: Ben (听众)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien diskors qajjiemi; il-kliem tiegħu qanqal ħafna emozzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien diskors qajjiemi; il-kliem tiegħu qanqal ħafna emozzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 因为那番讲话很能激起反应，他的话唤起了许多情绪。
messages.en: Because it was a stirring speech; his words brought out a lot of emotions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一段让听众情绪被带动的讲话记 qajjiemi；它描述事物容易激起反应的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rest or a period of repose after activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活动后停下来休息的状态或一段休息时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mistrieħ jew żmien ta' mistrieħ wara attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 休息；歇息。
非常缓慢地；慢慢地。

formal.mt: Wara x-xogħol, il-ħaddiem ħa ftit qajl taħt siġra u mbagħad mexa qajl qajl lejn id-dar.
formal.en: After work, the worker took a little rest under a tree and then walked very slowly towards home.
formal.zh: 工作结束后，工人在树下稍作休息，然后慢慢地朝家走去。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed timxi qajl qajl? Ġużi: Għax għajjejt; nieħu ftit qajl u mbagħad inkomplu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you walking so slowly? Ġużi: Because I'm tired; I'll take a little rest and then we'll carry on.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你怎么走得这么慢？Ġużi：因为我累了，我稍微歇一会儿，然后我们继续走。

messages.speaker: Marta (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għajjejt; nieħu ftit qajl u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għajjejt; nieħu ftit qajl u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.zh: 因为我累了，我稍微歇一会儿，然后我们继续走。
messages.en: Because I'm tired; I'll take a little rest and then we'll carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想走累后慢慢走、停下来歇一歇的场景：名词记休息，副词记非常缓慢地。

gloss_zh: 被悲痛之剑刺穿的心；丧子般悲恸的心

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deeply grieving or broken heart, said of the Virgin Mary and also of a mother who has lost a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容极度悲恸、如被悲痛之剑刺穿的心，用于圣母玛利亚，也用于失去孩子的母亲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qalb mimlija niket kbir jew maqsuma bin-niket, kif jingħad dwar il-Verġni Marija jew omm li tilfet lil binha jew lil bintha.

sense_translations.en_definition: a grieving heart, broken heart; said of the Virgin Mary, but also generally of a mother who has lost a child
sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲恸的心、破碎的心；用于形容圣母玛利亚，也泛指失去孩子的母亲那颗悲痛欲绝的心。

collocations.en: a mother with a heart pierced by the sword of grief
collocations.zh: 心如被悲痛之剑刺穿的母亲

collocations.mt: ix-xbieha ta' qalb minfuda b'sejf in-niket
collocations.en: the image of a heart pierced by the sword of grief
collocations.zh: 心被悲痛之剑刺穿的意象

formal.mt: Il-poeżija tuża l-espressjoni 'qalb minfuda b'sejf in-niket' biex turi t-tbatija ta' omm li tilfet lil bintha.
formal.en: The poem uses the expression 'a heart pierced by the sword of grief' to convey the suffering of a mother who has lost her daughter.
formal.zh: 这首诗用“被悲痛之剑刺穿的心”这一表达，呈现一位失去女儿的母亲所承受的痛苦。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'tfisser 'qalb minfuda b'sejf in-niket' f'din il-poeżija? Marija: Hawn tiddeskrivi n-niket kbir ta' omm li tilfet lil binha.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'a heart pierced by the sword of grief' mean in this poem? Marija: Here it describes the deep grief of a mother who has lost her son.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这首诗里的“被悲痛之剑刺穿的心”是什么意思？Marija：这里形容一位失去儿子的母亲内心极深的悲痛。

messages.speaker: Anna (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser 'qalb minfuda b'sejf in-niket' f'din il-poeżija?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser 'qalb minfuda b'sejf in-niket' f'din il-poeżija?
messages.zh: 这首诗里的“被悲痛之剑刺穿的心”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'a heart pierced by the sword of grief' mean in this poem?

messages.speaker: Marija (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tiddeskrivi n-niket kbir ta' omm li tilfet lil binha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tiddeskrivi n-niket kbir ta' omm li tilfet lil binha.
messages.zh: 这里形容一位失去儿子的母亲内心极深的悲痛。
messages.en: Here it describes the deep grief of a mother who has lost her son.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句记成一幅悲痛之剑刺穿心脏的文学画面，并联想到圣母或失去孩子的母亲。

gloss_zh: 勃然大怒；变得具有威胁性

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very angry or to become threatening in manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得极为愤怒，或态度、举止变得具有威胁性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrabja ħafna jew jibda jġib ruħu b'mod ta' theddid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴怒；变得怒不可遏。
变得具有威胁性；开始显露威吓的态度。

collocations.en: he became threatening and started making threats
collocations.zh: 他变得气势汹汹，开始出言威胁

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-akkuża, ir-raġel qall u beda jhedded lil dawk ta' madwaru.
formal.en: When he heard the accusation, the man became enraged and began threatening those around him.
formal.zh: 听到指控后，那名男子勃然大怒，开始威胁周围的人。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex tlaqt mil-laqgħa? David: Meta sema' l-kritika, qall u beda jhedded lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did you leave the meeting? David: When he heard the criticism, he flew into a rage and started threatening everyone.
colloquial.zh: Lina：你为什么离开会议？David：他一听到批评就暴怒起来，开始威胁所有人。

messages.speaker: Lina (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开会议？
messages.en: Why did you leave the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta sema' l-kritika, qall u beda jhedded lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Meta sema' l-kritika, qall u beda jhedded lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 他一听到批评就暴怒起来，开始威胁所有人。
messages.en: When he heard the criticism, he flew into a rage and started threatening everyone.

gloss_zh: 排泄；嘲蔑某人；频繁排便的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To excrete bodily waste; also, figuratively, to express scorn towards someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排出身体废物；也可比喻对某人表示轻蔑、加以嘲弄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ l-iskart tal-ġisem; b'mod figurattiv, juri disprezz lejn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排泄；排出身体废物。

sense_translations.en_definition: a person that evacuates his bowels frequently
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常排便的人；排便次数频繁的人。

formal.en: In the story, the man poured scorn on his companion and spoke about him contemptuously in front of everyone.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子对同伴大加嘲讽，并当着所有人的面轻蔑地谈论他。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to empty the bowels frequently.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有频繁排便倾向的。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, ir-raġel huwa deskritt bħala qallati, għax ibattal l-imsaren ta' spiss.

messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li xi ħadd għandu tendenza jbattal l-imsaren ta' spiss.

messages.en: It means someone tends to empty their bowels frequently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上一天多次走向厕所的画面，记住它描述的是频繁排便的倾向。

gloss_zh: 翻转；翻阅；翻找；使不安；制造混乱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn something over, leaf through a book, or rummage; also to upset someone or cause chaos.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西翻过来、翻阅书本或翻找物品；也可表示使人不安或造成混乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawwar xi ħaġa fuq in-naħa l-oħra, fittex fi ktieb jew fost oġġetti; ukoll ħawwad lil xi ħadd jew ġab kaos.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物翻过来；翻转。
翻阅书本；随手翻看书页。
翻找；在物品中翻来翻去地寻找。
使人心烦、不安或情绪受到扰乱。
造成混乱；把局面搅乱。

formal.mt: L-istudent qalleb il-ktieb biex isib il-kapitlu meħtieġ, imbagħad qalleb il-paġna u beda jaqra.
formal.en: The student leafed through the book to find the required chapter, then turned the page and began reading.
formal.zh: 学生翻阅书本，找到所需章节，然后翻了一页，开始阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt iċ-ċavetta? Mark: Qalleb fil-kexxun ħdejn il-bieb; naħseb qiegħda hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the key? Mark: Rummage through the drawer by the door; I think it is there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把钥匙放哪儿了？马克：在门边的抽屉里翻找一下，我想就在那儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)

gloss_zh: 见于马耳他若干地名中的词

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现在马耳他若干地名中的词，学习时应结合地名语境识别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tidher f'diversi ismijiet ta' postijiet f'Malta u li għandha tingħaraf f'dak il-kuntest.

sense_translations.en_definition: this word occurs in several place-names in malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这个词出现在马耳他的若干地名中。

collocations.zh: 地名中的 qallegħija 一词
含有 qallegħija 一词的地名

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'qallegħija' tidher f'diversi ismijiet ta' postijiet f'Malta; f'din il-lezzjoni se nagħrfuha bħala parti minn isem ta' post.
formal.en: The word 'qallegħija' occurs in several place-names in Malta; in this lesson we will recognize it as part of a place-name.
formal.zh: qallegħija 一词出现在马耳他的若干地名中；本课将学习把它识别为地名的组成部分。

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在一个地名里看到了 qallegħija 这个词。马克：是的，它出现在马耳他的若干地名中。

messages.mt_standard: Iva, tidher f'diversi ismijiet ta' postijiet f'Malta.

gloss_zh: 煎炸者；煎炸容器；欺骗者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who fries food, a vessel used for frying, or a person who cheats, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按语境可指煎炸食物的人、用于煎炸的容器，或欺骗他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqli l-ikel, reċipjent biex taqli fih, jew persuna li tqarraq, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煎炸食物的人。
用于煎炸的容器；煎锅或炸锅。
欺骗他人的人；骗子。

formal.mt: Il-qallej tal-ħut ħejja l-porzjonijiet qabel ma beda x-xogħol fil-kċina.

formal.zh: 负责煎炸鱼的人在厨房开始工作前备好了各份食材。

messages.mt_standard: Jien il-qallej illum; inti tista' tħejji l-insalata.

gloss_zh: 惹怒；激怒；长出附着于蚕豆根部的肉质根

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jirrabja; fis-sens botaniku, żviluppa għerq imlaħħam marbut mal-għeruq ta' pjanta tal-ful, b'referenza għal broomrape.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人生气；惹怒。
激起某人的怒气。
使人极为愤怒；激怒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to develop a fleshy root attached to the roots of a broad beans plant: broomrape
sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出附着于蚕豆植株根部的肉质根，指列当的这一生长现象。

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么生气了？保罗：我的话惹怒了马克，我会向他道歉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who turns something over or overturns it.

gloss_zh: 变化快的；多变的；反复无常的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to change quickly; changeable or inconstant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易迅速改变的；可形容多变、不稳定或反复无常的状态与表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jinbidel malajr, li jinbidel ta' spiss jew li mhuwiex kostanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有迅速变化倾向的。
多变的；容易改变的。
不恒定的；反复无常的。
