collocations.en: food that tends to upset the stomach
collocations.zh: 容易引起胃部不适的食物

formal.mt: Dan il-materjal huwa qalliegħi u għalhekk għandu jiġi mmaniġġjat b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: This material is brittle and should therefore be handled carefully.
formal.zh: 这种材料容易破碎，因此应小心搬动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit minn dan l-ikel? Pawlu: Le, grazzi. Għalija huwa qalliegħi u jġibli taqlib fl-istonku.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some of this food? Pawlu: No, thanks. It tends to upset my stomach.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你要吃一点这个吗？Pawlu：不了，谢谢。我吃这个容易胃不舒服。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要吃一点这个吗？
messages.en: Would you like some of this food?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Għalija huwa qalliegħi u jġibli taqlib fl-istonku.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Għalija huwa qalliegħi u jġibli taqlib fl-istonku.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。我吃这个容易胃不舒服。
messages.en: No, thanks. It tends to upset my stomach.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qalliegħi 配两张情境卡：材料卡写“容易碎”，食物卡写“容易胃不舒服”；看到搭配名词再判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the two parts of a pair of trousers that covers a leg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一条裤子中包住一条腿的部分，即一只裤腿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ partijiet tal-qalziet li jgħattu s-saqajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裤腿；裤子包住一条腿的部分。

collocations.en: the bottom of the pant leg

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat qassar qalza waħda biex iż-żewġ naħat tal-qalziet jiġu ndaqs.
formal.en: The tailor shortened one pant leg so that both sides of the trousers would be even.
formal.zh: 裁缝把其中一只裤腿改短，使两边裤腿一样长。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-qalza twila wisq, hux? Rita: Iva, il-qiegħ tagħha qed imiss mal-art.
colloquial.en: Mark: This pant leg is too long, isn't it? Rita: Yes, its bottom is touching the ground.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这只裤腿太长了，对吧？Rita：是啊，裤脚都碰到地面了。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这只裤腿太长了，对吧？
messages.en: This pant leg is too long, isn't it?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-qiegħ tagħha qed imiss mal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-qiegħ tagħha qed imiss mal-art.
messages.zh: 是啊，裤脚都碰到地面了。
messages.en: Yes, its bottom is touching the ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裁缝只提起裤子的一边，说 qalza waħda“一只裤腿”；用这个局部画面记住 qalza 指裤腿。

gloss_zh: 英寻；约六英尺的长度单位

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fathom: a length based on the span between the fingertips of horizontally outstretched arms, officially six feet or about 1.8 metres, often used for sea depth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英寻：以双臂水平伸展时两端之间的距离为参照的长度单位，标准为六英尺，约1.8米，常用于表示海水深度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura ta' tul ibbażata fuq il-medda bejn it-truf taż-żewġ dirgħajn miftuħa orizzontalment, uffiċjalment sitt piedi jew madwar 1.8 metri, li spiss tintuża għall-fond tal-baħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a fathom (linear measure from the end of one arm extended horizontally to the end of the other) which was often used to measure the depth of seawater, officially 6 ft. or ~1.8 m.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 英寻：以双臂水平伸展时一端至另一端的距离为参照的长度单位，常用于测量海水深度，标准为六英尺，约1.8米。

formal.mt: F'dan il-punt, il-baħar għandu fond ta' qama waħda, jiġifieri sitt piedi jew madwar 1.8 metri.
formal.en: At this point, the sea is one fathom deep, meaning six feet or about 1.8 metres.
formal.zh: 此处海水深一英寻，即六英尺，约1.8米。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi qama? Toni: Hija miżura ta' tul ta' sitt piedi, madwar 1.8 metri, li tintuża għall-fond tal-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is a fathom? Toni: It's a measure of length equal to six feet, about 1.8 metres, used for sea depth.
colloquial.zh: Maja：一英寻是多少？Toni：这是一个长度单位，等于六英尺，约1.8米，用来表示海水深度。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 一英寻是多少？
messages.en: What is a fathom?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija miżura ta' tul ta' sitt piedi, madwar 1.8 metri, li tintuża għall-fond tal-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Hija miżura ta' tul ta' sitt piedi, madwar 1.8 metri, li tintuża għall-fond tal-baħar.
messages.zh: 这是一个长度单位，等于六英尺，约1.8米，用来表示海水深度。
messages.en: It's a measure of length equal to six feet, about 1.8 metres, used for sea depth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 qama 时想象双臂水平展开，再把画面标上“六英尺、约1.8米”；这样把身体尺度与海水深度单位联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A louse, a small parasitic insect; the word can also refer to a nit, the egg of a louse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 虱子，一种小型寄生昆虫；该词也可指虱子的卵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett żgħir parassita; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal bajda ta' dan l-insett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虱子；一种小型寄生昆虫。
虱卵；虱子的卵。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami tax-xagħar, instabet qamla ħajja qrib il-qorriegħa.
formal.en: During the hair examination, a live louse was found near the scalp.
formal.zh: 检查头发时，在靠近头皮的地方发现了一只活虱子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din qamla jew bajda ta' qamla? Rita: Din hija qamla ħajja; ara kif qed tiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a louse or a louse egg? Rita: This is a live louse; look at how it's moving.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是虱子还是虱卵？Rita：这是活虱子，你看它在动。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Din qamla jew bajda ta' qamla?
messages.mt_standard: Din qamla jew bajda ta' qamla?
messages.zh: 这是虱子还是虱卵？
messages.en: Is this a louse or a louse egg?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hija qamla ħajja; ara kif qed tiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Din hija qamla ħajja; ara kif qed tiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 这是活虱子，你看它在动。
messages.en: This is a live louse; look at how it's moving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qamla 记在检查头发的场景里：一张图画会动的虱子，另一张画虱卵；用上下文区分这个词的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 发狂般行事；造成混乱；行为疯癫的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave in a wild or irrational way, or to cause confusion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以发狂般或不理性的方式行事；也可指制造混乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod miġnun jew bla raġuni, jew joħloq konfużjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发狂般行事；举止疯癫。
造成混乱；使局面混乱。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who exhibits mad or lunatic behaviour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容某人举止疯癫、表现出发狂般的行为。

collocations.en: he behaved wildly and started shouting
collocations.zh: 他发狂般闹起来，开始大喊

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, ir-raġel qammar u beda jgħajjat, u b'hekk waqqaf id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: During the meeting, the man behaved wildly and began shouting, bringing the discussion to a halt.
formal.zh: 会议期间，那名男子发狂般闹起来并开始大喊，导致讨论中断。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqfet il-logħba? Mark: Toni qammar u beda jgħajjat ma' kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the game stop? Mark: Toni started acting wildly and shouting at everyone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：比赛怎么停了？Mark：Toni突然闹了起来，对着所有人大喊。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 比赛怎么停了？
messages.en: Why did the game stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni qammar u beda jgħajjat ma' kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Toni qammar u beda jgħajjat ma' kulħadd.
messages.zh: Toni突然闹了起来，对着所有人大喊。
messages.en: Toni started acting wildly and shouting at everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一个人突然大闹，整个场面随之混乱”的连续画面记 qammar，分别对应行为发狂和造成混乱；形容词义另记为对人的描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young woman described as flighty: changeable, easily distracted, or lacking steadiness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被认为轻浮善变、容易分心或做事不够稳重的年轻女子，带有评价意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara żagħżugħa li titqies bħala waħda li tbiddel fehmitha malajr, titfixkel faċilment jew ma turix serjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻浮善变、做事不够稳重的年轻女子。

collocations.en: a flighty young woman who changes her mind
collocations.zh: 一个常改变主意的轻浮年轻女子

collocations.en: to call someone a flighty young woman
collocations.zh: 把某人称为轻浮善变的年轻女子

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-narratur isejjaħ lit-tfajla qammasa għax kontinwament tbiddel il-pjanijiet tagħha.
formal.en: In the story, the narrator calls the young woman flighty because she constantly changes her plans.
formal.zh: 故事中，叙述者称那位年轻女子轻浮善变，因为她总是改变自己的计划。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lara reġgħet bidlet il-pjan; kemm hi qammasa! Rita: Forsi għandha raġuni. Ejja nistaqsuha l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Lara has changed the plan again; she's so flighty! Rita: Maybe she has a reason. Let's ask her first.
colloquial.zh: Mark：Lara又改计划了，她真是个善变的姑娘！Rita：也许她有原因，我们先问问她吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lara reġgħet bidlet il-pjan; kemm hi qammasa!
messages.mt_standard: Lara reġgħet bidlet il-pjan; kemm hi qammasa!
messages.zh: Lara又改计划了，她真是个善变的姑娘！
messages.en: Lara has changed the plan again; she's so flighty!

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi għandha raġuni. Ejja nistaqsuha l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi għandha raġuni. Ejja nistaqsuha l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 也许她有原因，我们先问问她吧。
messages.en: Maybe she has a reason. Let's ask her first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事人物一天内反复改变计划，旁人用 qammasa 评价她；把词义记成“轻浮善变的年轻女子”，同时记住这是带评价的称呼。

gloss_zh: 捆住手脚；穿着非常紧；偏爱紧身衣物的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bind someone's hands and feet; also, of a garment, to fit very tightly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人的手脚捆住；也可形容衣物穿在身上非常紧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorbot l-idejn u s-saqajn ta' xi ħadd; jingħad ukoll għal ilbies li joqgħod issikkat ħafna fuq il-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捆住手脚；把双手和双脚绑住。
穿着非常紧；紧紧箍住身体。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who goes for tight-fitting garments
sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏爱穿紧身衣物的人。

collocations.en: he bound his hands and feet
collocations.zh: 他捆住了其双手和双脚

collocations.en: the trousers fitted me very tightly
collocations.zh: 这条裤子把我箍得很紧

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħalliel qammat idejn u saqajn il-priġunier bil-ħabel.
formal.en: In the novel, the thief bound the prisoner's hands and feet with rope.
formal.zh: 小说中，窃贼用绳子捆住了俘虏的双手和双脚。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta lbistu, il-qalziet qammatni wisq. Rita: Mela pprova daqs ikbar biex tkun aktar komdu.
colloquial.en: Mark: When I put them on, the trousers were far too tight on me. Rita: Then try a larger size so you'll be more comfortable.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我一穿上，这条裤子就把我箍得太紧了。Rita：那就试试大一号的，穿着会舒服些。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我一穿上，这条裤子就把我箍得太紧了。
messages.en: When I put them on, the trousers were far too tight on me.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela pprova daqs ikbar biex tkun aktar komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela pprova daqs ikbar biex tkun aktar komdu.
messages.zh: 那就试试大一号的，穿着会舒服些。
messages.en: Then try a larger size so you'll be more comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qammat 画三格学习图：绳子捆住手脚、裤子紧紧箍身、一个人偏爱紧身衣；前两格记动词，第三格单独记名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very tight-fitting, describing clothes that fit closely against the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容衣服贴身得很紧，穿着时有明显束缚感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi ħwejjeġ li jkunu ssikkati ħafna mal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （用于衣服）非常紧身的，紧紧贴着身体的。

collocations.en: clothes that are far too tight

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju, agħżel ħwejjeġ komdi u evita ħwejjeġ qammati li jillimitaw il-moviment.
formal.en: For exercise, choose comfortable clothes and avoid very tight-fitting clothes that restrict movement.
formal.zh: 运动时应选择舒适的衣服，避免穿限制活动的紧身衣物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn il-ħwejjeġ qammati wisq; bilkemm nista' niċċaqlaq. Lina: Mela pprova daqs ikbar.
colloquial.en: Maja: These clothes are far too tight; I can barely move. Lina: Then try a bigger size.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些衣服太紧了，我几乎动不了。Lina：那就试试大一号的。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-ħwejjeġ qammati wisq; bilkemm nista' niċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-ħwejjeġ qammati wisq; bilkemm nista' niċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 这些衣服太紧了，我几乎动不了。
messages.en: These clothes are far too tight; I can barely move.

messages.speaker: Lina (店员)
messages.zh: 那就试试大一号的。
messages.en: Then try a bigger size.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衣服紧紧箍住身体、抬手都困难的画面，把 qammati 与“衣服非常紧身”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or an animal kick, or to cause restlessness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物踢腿；也指使其躁动、无法安静下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil annimal jagħti bis-saqajn, jew iqajjem fih nuqqas ta' kwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使踢腿，使人或动物作出踢的动作。
使躁动不安，使无法保持平静。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi qammes liż-żiemel, li beda jagħti bis-saqajn ta' wara.
formal.en: The loud noise made the horse kick with its hind legs.
formal.zh: 巨大的声响使马开始用后腿踢蹬。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak l-istorbju qammes lit-tifel; ma jistax joqgħod kwiet. Pawlu: Ejja mmorru miegħu f'kamra aktar kwieta.
colloquial.en: Sara: That noise made the boy restless; he can't settle down. Pawlu: Let's take him to a quieter room.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那阵噪声弄得孩子躁动不安，怎么也静不下来。Pawlu：我们带他去一间更安静的房间吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-istorbju qammes lit-tifel; ma jistax joqgħod kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-istorbju qammes lit-tifel; ma jistax joqgħod kwiet.
messages.zh: 那阵噪声弄得孩子躁动不安，怎么也静不下来。
messages.en: That noise made the boy restless; he can't settle down.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja mmorru miegħu f'kamra aktar kwieta.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja mmorru miegħu f'kamra aktar kwieta.
messages.zh: 我们带他去一间更安静的房间吧。
messages.en: Let's take him to a quieter room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“外界刺激使对方动起来”：马受到刺激便踢腿，孩子受到刺激便躁动，两个义项都有使动意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very stingy person who is extremely unwilling to spend or part with money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极不愿花钱或拿出钱财的人，即吝啬鬼、守财奴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna xħiħa ħafna li ma tkunx trid tonfoq jew tagħti flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常吝啬的人，极不愿花钱或出钱的人。
守财奴，紧抓钱财不愿花用的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qammiel jirrifjuta li jonfoq flus anki fuq il-bżonnijiet tiegħu stess.
formal.en: In the story, the miser refuses to spend money even on his own necessities.
formal.zh: 故事中的守财奴甚至不愿为自己的基本生活需要花钱。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandu flus biżżejjed, imma qatt ma jrid iħallas sehmu. Rita: Dak qammiel kbir!
colloquial.en: Mark: He has enough money, but he never wants to pay his share. Rita: He's a terrible miser!
colloquial.zh: Mark：他钱明明够，却从来不肯付自己那一份。Rita：他真是个十足的吝啬鬼！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu flus biżżejjed, imma qatt ma jrid iħallas sehmu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu flus biżżejjed, imma qatt ma jrid iħallas sehmu.
messages.zh: 他钱明明够，却从来不肯付自己那一份。
messages.en: He has enough money, but he never wants to pay his share.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他真是个十足的吝啬鬼！
messages.en: He's a terrible miser!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把钱包抱得紧紧的，连自己该付的钱也不肯拿出；qammiel 指这个吝啬的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Infested with lice; describing a person or animal that has lice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或动物身上生有虱子、受到虱子侵扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna jew annimal li jkollu l-qamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生满虱子的，受到虱子侵扰的。

formal.mt: Fit-test, l-aġġettiv 'qammieli' jiddeskrivi annimal li għandu l-qamel.
formal.en: In the text, the adjective 'qammieli' describes an animal that has lice.
formal.zh: 文中的形容词 qammieli 用来描述一只有虱子的动物。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'tifel qammieli'? Marija: Tfisser tifel li għandu l-qamel.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'tifel qammieli' mean? Marija: It means a boy who has lice.
colloquial.zh: Lina：“tifel qammieli”是什么意思？Marija：意思是一个生了虱子的男孩。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: “tifel qammieli”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tifel qammieli' mean?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.zh: 意思是一个生了虱子的男孩。
messages.en: It means a boy who has lice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个近形词分开记：qammiel 是吝啬的人，末尾多一个 i 的 qammieli 在本条中形容身上有虱子。

gloss_zh: 不断嘟囔抱怨；公牛（名词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grumble repeatedly or keep expressing dissatisfaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不停地嘟囔、反复抱怨，持续表达不满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Igerger il-ħin kollu jew jibqa' jesprimi n-nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不断嘟囔抱怨，没完没了地发牢骚。
公牛；牛只的名词义，与表示不断抱怨的动词义分开学习。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, ir-raġel qamqam il-ħin kollu dwar id-dewmien.
formal.en: During the meeting, the man kept grumbling about the delay.
formal.zh: 会议期间，那名男子一直在抱怨延误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif marret l-ikla ma' Mark? Pawlu: Qamqam dwar l-ikel mill-bidu sal-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the meal with Mark go? Pawlu: He grumbled about the food from beginning to end.
colloquial.zh: Sara：和 Mark 一起吃饭怎么样？Pawlu：他从头到尾都在抱怨饭菜。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 和 Mark 一起吃饭怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meal with Mark go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他从头到尾都在抱怨饭菜。
messages.en: He grumbled about the food from beginning to end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借重复的字形联想抱怨一遍又一遍；另做一张“名词：公牛”的卡片，避免把两个词性义项混在一起。

gloss_zh: 用于“痛斥对方并翻旧账”这一表达中的词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun used in the expression 'qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma', meaning that he spoke his mind forcefully to someone and brought up old grievances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表达 qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma 的名词；整个表达指毫不客气地痛斥对方，并翻出以往的旧账。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom fl-espressjoni 'qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma', li tfisser li qallu bla tlaqliq x'jaħseb u fakkru fi ħwejjeġ qodma li kellu kontrih.

sense_translations.en_definition: Victor Galea's mother uses this word in the expression 'qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma', he did not hesitate to give him a piece of his mind and rake up old scores
sense_translations.zh_definition: Victor Galea 的母亲在 qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma 这一表达中使用此词；整个表达意为他毫不迟疑地痛斥对方，并翻出旧账。

collocations.en: he gave him a piece of his mind and brought up old grievances
collocations.zh: 他痛斥了对方，并翻出旧账
该表达中的 qamqum 一词

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-djalogu, 'qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma' tindika li l-kelliem esprima r-rabja tiegħu u semma wkoll tilwim antik.
formal.en: In the analysis of the dialogue, 'qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma' indicates that the speaker expressed his anger and also brought up old disputes.
formal.zh: 在对话分析中，qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma 表示说话者发泄了愤怒，还提起了过去的争执。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma'? Mark: Jiġifieri qallu bla tlaqliq x'jaħseb u reġa' semma l-kwistjonijiet ta' qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma' mean? Mark: It means he told him bluntly what he thought and brought up their earlier disputes again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma”是什么意思？Mark：就是毫不客气地把想法说给对方听，还重新翻出了以前的旧账。

messages.speaker: Maja (学习伙伴)
messages.zh: “qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qalagħlu l-qamqum wil-qamquma' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri qallu bla tlaqliq x'jaħseb u reġa' semma l-kwistjonijiet ta' qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri qallu bla tlaqliq x'jaħseb u reġa' semma l-kwistjonijiet ta' qabel.
messages.zh: 就是毫不客气地把想法说给对方听，还重新翻出了以前的旧账。
messages.en: It means he told him bluntly what he thought and brought up their earlier disputes again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个表达记成一场“当面痛斥加翻旧账”的争执；本材料只给出表达中的用法，不为 qamqum 单独猜义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A canal: a constructed waterway used to carry water or provide a route for boats.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人工修建的水道，可用于输水或供船只通行，即水渠、运河。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passaġġ artifiċjali għall-ilma, użat biex iwassal l-ilma jew biex jgħaddu d-dgħajjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 运河，人工开凿的水道或水渠。

formal.mt: L-ilma jgħaddi mill-qana tal-irrigazzjoni lejn l-għelieqi.
formal.en: The water flows through the irrigation canal towards the fields.
formal.zh: 水经过灌溉水渠流向田地。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Minn fejn jasal l-ilma sal-għalqa? Pawlu: Jgħaddi minn dik il-qana ħdejn it-triq.
colloquial.en: Lina: How does the water reach the field? Pawlu: It flows through that canal beside the road.
colloquial.zh: Lina：水是从哪里流到田里的？Pawlu：从路边那条水渠流过来。

messages.speaker: Lina (访客)
messages.zh: 水是从哪里流到田里的？
messages.en: How does the water reach the field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħaddi minn dik il-qana ħdejn it-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħaddi minn dik il-qana ħdejn it-triq.
messages.zh: 从路边那条水渠流过来。
messages.en: It flows through that canal beside the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条把水引向田地的人工水道，在旁边写 qana；再与末尾带撇号、表示顺从的 qana' 分卡记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Submission or resignation: accepting a situation without resistance, as used in the supplied saying about silence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 顺从或认命，指不再反抗而接受处境的态度；本材料中的用法见所给的“使人闭口”谚语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sottomissjoni jew aċċettazzjoni tas-sitwazzjoni bla reżistenza, kif tidher fil-qawl mogħti dwar is-skiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: submission, resignation, occuring in the following saying: il-qana' u d-dnewwa jitbqu l-fomm, resignation (submission) and violence shut up one's mouth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 顺从、认命；见谚语 il-qana' u d-dnewwa jitbqu l-fomm，意为逆来顺受与暴力都会使人闭口不言。

collocations.en: submission as expressed in the saying

formal.mt: Il-qawl 'il-qana' u d-dnewwa jitbqu l-fomm' juri li kemm is-sottomissjoni kif ukoll il-vjolenza jistgħu jwasslu għas-skiet.
formal.en: The saying 'il-qana' u d-dnewwa jitbqu l-fomm' shows that both submission and violence can lead to silence.
formal.zh: 谚语 il-qana' u d-dnewwa jitbqu l-fomm 表明，顺从与暴力都可能使人沉默。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser il-qana' f'dan il-qawl? Marija: Ifisser li wieħed jaċċetta s-sitwazzjoni bla ma jirreżisti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does qana' mean in this saying? Marija: It means accepting the situation without resisting.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这句谚语里的 qana' 是什么意思？Marija：就是不加反抗地接受自己的处境。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句谚语里的 qana' 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does qana' mean in this saying?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li wieħed jaċċetta s-sitwazzjoni bla ma jirreżisti.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li wieħed jaċċetta s-sitwazzjoni bla ma jirreżisti.
messages.zh: 就是不加反抗地接受自己的处境。
messages.en: It means accepting the situation without resisting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用谚语里的“闭口不言”画面记住顺从和认命；把末尾撇号当作辨认提示，与表示水渠的 qana 区分，这只是记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird called a lark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为云雀的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bħala qanbra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 云雀。

formal.mt: Waqt il-mixja, l-istudenti raw qanbra fl-għalqa u semgħu l-għana tagħha.
formal.en: During the walk, the students saw a lark in the field and heard its song.
formal.zh: 散步时，学生们看见田野里有一只云雀，并听见了它的鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'għasfur hu dak fl-għalqa? Pawlu: Dik qanbra. Isma' kif qed tgħanni!
colloquial.en: Marija: What bird is that in the field? Pawlu: That's a lark. Listen to it singing!
colloquial.zh: Marija：田野里那是什么鸟？Pawlu：那是云雀。听它唱得多好！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 田野里那是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is that in the field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik qanbra. Isma' kif qed tgħanni!
messages.mt_standard: Dik qanbra. Isma' kif qed tgħanni!
messages.zh: 那是云雀。听它唱得多好！
messages.en: That's a lark. Listen to it singing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qanbra 配上田野中云雀鸣唱的画面，连同“云雀的歌声”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry or move something heavy with effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 费力地提、抱或搬运沉重的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġorr jew iċaqlaq xi ħaġa tqila bi sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 费力地搬运、拖着或提着重物走。
搬运或提着沉重的东西。

collocations.zh: 费力搬了一只沉重的箱子

collocations.en: lugged the suitcase to the stairs
collocations.zh: 把行李箱费力搬到了楼梯口

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem qandel il-kaxxa tqila mill-maħżen sal-vettura bl-għajnuna ta' kollega.
formal.en: The worker lugged the heavy box from the storeroom to the vehicle with a colleague's help.
formal.zh: 工人在一位同事的帮助下，把沉重的箱子从储藏室费力搬到了车旁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min qandel din il-bagalja tqila sat-taraġ? Pawlu: Toni, imma issa se ngħinu jġorrha sal-karozza.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who lugged this heavy suitcase to the stairs? Pawlu: Toni did, but now we're going to help him carry it to the car.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁把这么重的行李箱搬到了楼梯口？Pawlu：Toni 搬的，不过我们现在要帮他把它搬到车旁。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min qandel din il-bagalja tqila sat-taraġ?
messages.mt_standard: Min qandel din il-bagalja tqila sat-taraġ?
messages.zh: 谁把这么重的行李箱搬到了楼梯口？
messages.en: Who lugged this heavy suitcase to the stairs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni, imma issa se ngħinu jġorrha sal-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Toni, imma issa se ngħinu jġorrha sal-karozza.
messages.zh: Toni 搬的，不过我们现在要帮他把它搬到车旁。
messages.en: Toni did, but now we're going to help him carry it to the car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手搬沉箱、走几步就要歇一下，用这份费力感记住 qandel。

gloss_zh: 搬运重物的人；费力扛东西的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lugs or carries heavy objects with effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 费力搬动、扛运沉重物件的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġorr jew tmexxi oġġetti tqal bi sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搬运、扛运沉重物件的人。

formal.mt: Il-qandiel ġarr is-sider tqil sal-maħżen bl-għajnuna ta' żewġ ħaddiema.
formal.en: The person lugging the heavy chest carried it to the storeroom with the help of two workers.
formal.zh: 搬运者在两名工人的帮助下，把沉重的大箱子搬到了储藏室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jġorr dan l-armarju? Toni: Jien il-qandiel illum, imma għinni min-naħa l-oħra!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's going to carry this wardrobe? Toni: I'm the one lugging things today, but help me from the other side!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来搬这个衣柜？托尼：今天我负责扛重物，不过你得在另一边帮我！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁来搬这个衣柜？
messages.en: Who's going to carry this wardrobe?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien il-qandiel illum, imma għinni min-naħa l-oħra!
messages.mt_standard: Jien il-qandiel illum, imma għinni min-naħa l-oħra!
messages.zh: 今天我负责扛重物，不过你得在另一边帮我！
messages.en: I'm the one lugging things today, but help me from the other side!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人弯腰扛着沉重衣柜，把 qandiel 与“费力搬重物的人”这个画面绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 能搬运重物的；扛得动重物的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to lug or carry heavy objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有能力搬动、扛运沉重物件的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jġorr jew imexxi oġġetti tqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够搬运或扛动沉重物件的。

collocations.en: a man able to lug heavy objects
a worker capable of carrying heavy objects

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol hemm bżonn ħaddiem qandieli li jista' jġorr il-kaxxi tqal.
formal.en: This job requires a worker able to lug heavy objects who can carry the heavy boxes.
formal.zh: 这项工作需要一名能搬运重物、扛得动沉重箱子的工人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min jista' jgħinni b'din il-kaxxa tqila? Mark: Staqsi lil Toni; hu qandieli u jista' jgħinek iġġorrha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who can help me with this heavy box? Mark: Ask Toni; he can handle heavy loads and can help you carry it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁能帮我搬这个重箱子？马克：问问托尼；他扛得动重物，可以帮你搬。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jgħinni b'din il-kaxxa tqila?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jgħinni b'din il-kaxxa tqila?
messages.zh: 谁能帮我搬这个重箱子？
messages.en: Who can help me with this heavy box?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Toni; hu qandieli u jista' jgħinek iġġorrha.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Toni; hu qandieli u jista' jgħinek iġġorrha.
messages.zh: 问问托尼；他扛得动重物，可以帮你搬。
messages.en: Ask Toni; he can handle heavy loads and can help you carry it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qandieli 写在搬运者的能力标签上：强调“扛得动重物”，记住这里描述的是能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having wattles hanging from the head or throat, said of a goat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容山羊头部或喉部下方长有下垂的肉垂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu qnie del żgħar tal-ġilda mdendlin taħt rasu jew ma' għonqu, meta jingħad għal bodbod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有肉垂的，指山羊头部或喉部下方长有下垂的皮肉附属物。

collocations.en: a young billy goat with wattles

formal.mt: Il-bodbod qandli jidher fir-ritratt, bil-biċċiet tal-ġilda mdendlin taħt rasu.
formal.en: The billy goat with wattles appears in the photograph, with the pieces of skin hanging beneath its head.
formal.zh: 照片中的公山羊长有肉垂，可以看到其头部下方悬垂的皮肉。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex tgħid li dan il-bodbod qandli? Pawlu: Għax għandu dawk il-biċċiet żgħar tal-ġilda mdendlin taħt rasu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why do you describe this billy goat as having wattles? Pawlu: Because it has those small pieces of skin hanging beneath its head.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你为什么说这只公山羊有肉垂？保罗：因为它头部下方挂着那些小小的皮肉。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li dan il-bodbod qandli?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li dan il-bodbod qandli?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这只公山羊有肉垂？
messages.en: Why do you describe this billy goat as having wattles?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu dawk il-biċċiet żgħar tal-ġilda mdendlin taħt rasu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu dawk il-biċċiet żgħar tal-ġilda mdendlin taħt rasu.
messages.zh: 因为它头部下方挂着那些小小的皮肉。
messages.en: Because it has those small pieces of skin hanging beneath its head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看山羊图片时圈出喉部下方的小肉垂，再给整只羊贴上 qandli 标签，记住它是描述外形的形容词。

gloss_zh: 难以搬动的东西；悬垂的物件

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object that is difficult to move; also, an object that hangs or dangles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 难以搬动的物件；也可指悬挂着、向下垂的物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jitmexxa b'diffikultà; ukoll oġġett li jkun imdendel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搬动起来很费劲的东西。
悬挂着、向下垂的物件。

collocations.en: a heavy object that is difficult to move
an object dangling from the door

formal.mt: Dan il-qandul tqil kellu jitmexxa minn erba' persuni sabiex jitneħħa mill-kamra.
formal.en: This heavy, cumbersome object had to be moved by four people to remove it from the room.
formal.zh: 这件沉重难搬的东西需要四个人一起搬，才能移出房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-qandul ħdejn it-tieqa? Toni: Dekorazzjoni mdendla ma' ħabel; meta jonfoħ ir-riħ, titbandal.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that dangling object by the window? Toni: A decoration hanging from a string; it sways when the wind blows.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：窗边垂着的那个东西是什么？托尼：是用绳子挂着的装饰品；风一吹就会摇晃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边垂着的那个东西是什么？
messages.en: What's that dangling object by the window?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dekorazzjoni mdendla ma' ħabel; meta jonfoħ ir-riħ, titbandal.
messages.mt_standard: Dekorazzjoni mdendla ma' ħabel; meta jonfoħ ir-riħ, titbandal.
messages.zh: 是用绳子挂着的装饰品；风一吹就会摇晃。
messages.en: A decoration hanging from a string; it sways when the wind blows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qandul 配两幅图：一幅是四个人费力搬大物件，一幅是窗边垂挂的饰物，分别记住两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the paired wattles hanging from a goat's head or throat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 山羊头部或喉部下方成对悬垂的肉垂中的一条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda minn par biċċiet tal-ġilda li jiddendlu minn ras jew għonq mogħża.

sense_translations.en_definition: One of a pair of wattles hanging down from the head or throat of a goat
sense_translations.zh_definition: 山羊头部或喉部下方成对悬垂的肉垂中的一条。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher qandula waħda taħt ras il-mogħża; l-oħra hija moħbija.
formal.en: One wattle is visible beneath the goat's head in the photograph; the other is hidden.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到山羊头部下方的一条肉垂，另一条被遮住了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-biċċa żgħira taħt ras il-mogħża x'jisimha? Pawlu: Dik qandula; ħares lejn in-naħa l-oħra u tara oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's this little piece beneath the goat's head called? Pawlu: That's a wattle; look on the other side and you'll see another one.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：山羊头部下面这小条东西叫什么？保罗：那是一条肉垂；你看看另一边，还会看到一条。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-biċċa żgħira taħt ras il-mogħża x'jisimha?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-biċċa żgħira taħt ras il-mogħża x'jisimha?
messages.zh: 山羊头部下面这小条东西叫什么？
messages.en: What's this little piece beneath the goat's head called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik qandula; ħares lejn in-naħa l-oħra u tara oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dik qandula; ħares lejn in-naħa l-oħra u tara oħra.
messages.zh: 那是一条肉垂；你看看另一边，还会看到一条。
messages.en: That's a wattle; look on the other side and you'll see another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象山羊喉下挂着一对小肉垂，用手指只指其中一条并说 qandula，突出“成对中的一条”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ruffle, tousle, or make something untidy, especially hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过揉动或拨动把东西弄乱，尤其指把头发揉乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħawwad jew iġiegħel xi ħaġa titlef l-ordni tagħha, speċjalment ix-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揉乱、拨乱，尤指使头发蓬乱。
弄乱，使原本整齐的东西变得凌乱。

collocations.zh: 他把自己的头发揉乱了

formal.mt: Qabel ma tela' fuq il-palk, l-attur qanfed xagħru biex jidher bħallikieku kien għadu kemm qam.
formal.en: Before going on stage, the actor tousled his hair to look as though he had just woken up.
formal.zh: 上台前，演员把自己的头发揉乱，营造出刚睡醒的样子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min qanfed xagħrek hekk? Toni: Ħija, waqt li konna nilagħbu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who tousled your hair like that? Toni: My brother, while we were playing!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把你的头发揉得这么乱？托尼：我兄弟，我们玩的时候弄的！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把你的头发揉得这么乱？
messages.en: Who tousled your hair like that?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我兄弟，我们玩的时候弄的！
messages.en: My brother, while we were playing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 一边想象手掌揉过整齐头发、一边记 qanfed：画面的关键是“把整齐弄成蓬乱”的动作。

gloss_zh: 把东西弄乱的人；揉乱头发的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who ruffles or tousles something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过揉拨等动作把东西弄乱的人，例如揉乱别人头发的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħawwad xi ħaġa u tagħmilha mqanfda, bħax-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西拨乱、揉乱或弄蓬乱的人。

collocations.en: a mischievous person who ruffles things
collocations.zh: 爱把东西弄乱的淘气家伙

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, it-tifel huwa qanfied li jħobb iħawwad ix-xagħar ta' ħutu waqt il-logħob.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is someone who ruffles things and likes to tousle his siblings' hair during play.
formal.zh: 故事里的男孩爱把东西弄乱，玩耍时喜欢揉乱兄弟姐妹的头发。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara x'għamiltli f'xagħri! Int qanfied! Mark: Kont qed niċċajta; trid il-moxt?
colloquial.en: Lina: Look what you've done to my hair! You hair-ruffler! Mark: I was joking around; do you want the comb?
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：看看你把我的头发弄成什么样了！你这个揉乱头发的家伙！马克：我闹着玩呢；你要梳子吗？

messages.speaker: Lina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 看看你把我的头发弄成什么样了！你这个揉乱头发的家伙！
messages.en: Look what you've done to my hair! You hair-ruffler!

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我闹着玩呢；你要梳子吗？
messages.en: I was joking around; do you want the comb?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头从蓬乱的头发转向伸手揉乱它的人，再说 qanfied，记住这个名词指动作的实施者。

gloss_zh: 容易变蓬乱的；容易被弄乱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to become ruffled, tousled, or untidy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易变得蓬乱或凌乱的，尤可用于描述头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jitħawwad jew isir imqanfed faċilment.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to get ruffled or tousled
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易被弄蓬乱、揉乱或变得凌乱的。

collocations.en: hair that gets tousled very easily

formal.mt: Ix-xagħar qanfiedi tiegħu jitlef l-ordni tiegħu malajr, speċjalment meta jkun hemm ir-riħ.
formal.en: His easily tousled hair quickly becomes untidy, especially when it is windy.
formal.zh: 他的头发容易蓬乱，很快就会失去整齐的样子，尤其是在刮风的时候。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadni kemm mxatt xagħri u diġà tħawwad! Maja: Għandek xagħar qanfiedi; ir-riħ illum qawwi wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: I've only just combed my hair and it's already messy! Maja: Your hair gets tousled easily; the wind is strong today too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我刚梳好头发，怎么已经乱了！玛雅：你的头发本来就容易蓬乱，今天风也大。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kemm mxatt xagħri u diġà tħawwad!
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kemm mxatt xagħri u diġà tħawwad!
messages.zh: 我刚梳好头发，怎么已经乱了！
messages.en: I've only just combed my hair and it's already messy!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xagħar qanfiedi; ir-riħ illum qawwi wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xagħar qanfiedi; ir-riħ illum qawwi wkoll.
messages.zh: 你的头发本来就容易蓬乱，今天风也大。
messages.en: Your hair gets tousled easily; the wind is strong today too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚梳好的头发一遇风就乱，用 qanfiedi 标注这种“容易蓬乱”的特点，重点记住它表示倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A prickly plant of the species Cichorium spinosum, known as prickly endive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Cichorium spinosum 的带刺植物，英语称 prickly endive。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta bix-xewk tal-ispeċi Cichorium spinosum, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala prickly endive.

sense_translations.en_definition: a plant of the Cichorium spinosum species, aka the prickly endive
sense_translations.zh_definition: 学名为 Cichorium spinosum 的植物，又称刺苣。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-botanika, l-istudenti għandhom josservaw il-weraq tal-qanfuda u jiktbu l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Cichorium spinosum.
formal.en: In the botany exercise, students should observe the prickly endive's leaves and write down its scientific name, Cichorium spinosum.
formal.zh: 在植物学练习中，学生应观察刺苣的叶子，并写出它的学名 Cichorium spinosum。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Toni: Din qanfuda. Fuq it-tikketta hemm l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Cichorium spinosum.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called? Toni: It's prickly endive. Its scientific name, Cichorium spinosum, is on the label.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这株植物叫什么？托尼：这是刺苣，标签上写着它的学名 Cichorium spinosum。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din qanfuda. Fuq it-tikketta hemm l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Cichorium spinosum.
messages.mt_standard: Din qanfuda. Fuq it-tikketta hemm l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Cichorium spinosum.
messages.zh: 这是刺苣，标签上写着它的学名 Cichorium spinosum。
messages.en: It's prickly endive. Its scientific name, Cichorium spinosum, is on the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qanfuda 与一张带刺植物的识别卡联系起来，卡上写着 Cichorium spinosum，帮助记牢本条的植物义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone tolerate something, especially something unpleasant, against their wishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违背某人的意愿，迫使其忍受或容忍某种事物，尤其是不愉快的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jissaporti xi ħaġa kontra qalbu, speċjalment xi ħaġa li ddejqu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to force sb. to put up with sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫某人忍受或容忍某事。

collocations.mt: qanna' lil xi ħadd biex jissaporti l-istorbju
collocations.en: forced someone to put up with the noise
forced the workers to put up with the heat

formal.mt: Skont l-ilment, il-kap qanna' lill-ħaddiema biex jissaportu l-istorbju waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: According to the complaint, the supervisor forced the workers to put up with the noise while working.
formal.zh: 根据投诉内容，主管强迫工人在工作时忍受噪声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħaddiema baqgħu jaħdmu f'dik is-sħana? Mark: Il-kap qanna' lill-ħaddiema biex jissaportuha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the workers keep working in that heat? Mark: The supervisor forced them to put up with it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：工人为什么在那么热的环境里继续工作？马克：主管强迫他们忍受。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħaddiema baqgħu jaħdmu f'dik is-sħana?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħaddiema baqgħu jaħdmu f'dik is-sħana?
messages.zh: 工人为什么在那么热的环境里继续工作？
messages.en: Why did the workers keep working in that heat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 主管强迫工人忍受那种高温。
messages.en: The supervisor forced the workers to put up with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“有人不愿忍受，却被迫继续承受”的场景记住 qanna'；记忆重点是强迫别人忍受，而非自己忍耐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A jug or ewer used to hold and pour water or other liquids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放和倾倒水或其他液体的罐或壶，通常带有把手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent, ġeneralment b'manku, li jintuża biex iżomm u jferra' l-ilma jew likwidi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛装和倾倒液体用的罐或壶；水罐。

formal.mt: Għall-laqgħa, poġġi qannata ilma u sitt tazzi fiċ-ċentru tal-mejda.
formal.en: For the meeting, place a jug of water and six glasses in the centre of the table.
formal.zh: 为会议做准备时，请在桌子中央放一壶水和六个杯子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tgħaddili l-qannata, jekk jogħġbok? Pawlu: Iva, hawn hi. Trid nimlieha bl-ilma?
colloquial.en: Nina: Could you pass me the jug, please? Pawlu: Yes, here it is. Would you like me to fill it with water?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：请把水壶递给我好吗？保罗：好，给你。要我把它装满水吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 请把水壶递给我好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the jug, please?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hi. Trid nimlieha bl-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hi. Trid nimlieha bl-ilma?
messages.zh: 好，给你。要我把它装满水吗？
messages.en: Yes, here it is. Would you like me to fill it with water?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐桌上有一只带把手的水罐，拿起 qannata 给杯子倒水，用动作把词义记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A portable pot kept in a room for use as a toilet, especially for urination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在房间内、供人便溺尤其是小便使用的可移动容器，即夜壶或尿壶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jista' jinġarr u jinżamm f'kamra biex wieħed jagħmel il-bżonnijiet fih, speċjalment biex jgħaddi l-awrina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放在室内供便溺使用的夜壶或尿壶。

collocations.en: a chamber pot with a lid

formal.mt: L-inventarju jelenka qannata tal-bewl b'għatu u jitlob li tinżamm nadifa.
formal.en: The inventory lists a chamber pot with a lid and requires it to be kept clean.
formal.zh: 物品清单列有一只带盖夜壶，并要求保持其清洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-reċipjent għalxiex jintuża? Toni: Dik qannata tal-bewl; tintuża biex wieħed jgħaddi l-awrina fiha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this container used for? Toni: That's a chamber pot; it's used for urinating into.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个容器是做什么用的？托尼：那是夜壶，供人小便使用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个容器是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this container used for?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik qannata tal-bewl; tintuża biex wieħed jgħaddi l-awrina fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik qannata tal-bewl; tintuża biex wieħed jgħaddi l-awrina fiha.
messages.zh: 那是夜壶，供人小便使用。
messages.en: That's a chamber pot; it's used for urinating into.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语 qannata tal-bewl 配上一只带盖夜壶的图，整组记成“尿壶”，避免只记住前面的容器词。

gloss_zh: 似大麻的；似大麻纤维的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling hemp, for example in appearance or texture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在外观、质地等方面类似大麻或大麻纤维的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah il-qanneb, pereżempju fid-dehra jew fin-nisġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 似大麻的；具有类似大麻或其纤维特征的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kampjun bħala materjal qannbi minħabba d-dehra tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the sample as a hemp-like material because of its appearance.
formal.zh: 报告根据样本的外观，将其描述为类似大麻纤维的材料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tiddeskrivi dan il-materjal? Leo: Jidher qannbi, jiġifieri jixbah il-qanneb.
colloquial.en: Sara: How would you describe this material? Leo: It looks hemp-like, meaning it resembles hemp.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你会怎样描述这种材料？利奥：它看起来像大麻纤维，也就是与大麻纤维相似。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 你会怎样描述这种材料？
messages.en: How would you describe this material?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.zh: 它看起来像大麻纤维，也就是与大麻纤维相似。
messages.en: It looks hemp-like, meaning it resembles hemp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qannbi 放进“看起来像麻纤维”的描述句里，提醒自己它是表示相似性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hemp, the plant or its fibre used as a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大麻植物，或作为材料使用的这种植物的纤维。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta tal-qanneb jew il-fibra tagħha użata bħala materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大麻；也可指用作材料的大麻纤维。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-prodott tispeċifika li l-ħabel huwa magħmul mill-fibra tal-qanneb.
formal.en: The product description specifies that the rope is made from hemp fibre.
formal.zh: 产品说明明确指出，这条绳子由大麻纤维制成。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħabel minn xiex hu magħmul? Nina: Mill-qanneb. Hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is this rope made from? Nina: Hemp. That's what it says on the label.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这条绳子是什么做的？妮娜：大麻纤维，标签上是这样写的。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħabel minn xiex hu magħmul?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħabel minn xiex hu magħmul?
messages.zh: 这条绳子是什么做的？
messages.en: What is this rope made from?

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-qanneb. Hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Mill-qanneb. Hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 大麻纤维，标签上是这样写的。
messages.en: Hemp. That's what it says on the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 qanneb 就想象一条标着“大麻纤维”的绳子，用具体材料记住这个名词及其植物义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seed of the hemp plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大麻植物的种子，即大麻籽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żerriegħa tal-pjanta tal-qanneb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大麻的种子；大麻籽。

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju ta' osservazzjoni, poġġi qannebusa waħda fuq karta bajda u pinġi l-forma tagħha.
formal.en: For the observation exercise, place one hempseed on white paper and draw its shape.
formal.zh: 进行观察练习时，请把一粒大麻籽放在白纸上，并画出它的形状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din iż-żerriegħa żgħira? Pawlu: Dik qannebusa, jiġifieri żerriegħa tal-qanneb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this little seed? Pawlu: That's a hempseed, meaning a seed of the hemp plant.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这粒小种子是什么？保罗：那是大麻籽，也就是大麻植物的种子。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这粒小种子是什么？
messages.en: What is this little seed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 那是大麻籽，也就是大麻植物的种子。
messages.en: That's a hempseed, meaning a seed of the hemp plant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qannebusa 画一粒放在白纸上的小种子，并写上“大麻籽”，把记忆焦点放在种子这个具体部位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To measure the depth of water by lowering a weight into it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把重物放入水中，借此测量水的深度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kejjel il-fond tal-ilma billi niżżel piż fih.

sense_translations.en_definition: to measure water depth using a weight
sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用重物测量水深；用测深重锤探测水深。

collocations.en: measured the water depth using a weight
sounded the depth with a weight attached to a rope
collocations.zh: 用绑在绳子上的重物探测了水深

formal.mt: Qabel resaq bid-dgħajsa lejn ix-xatt, il-baħri qanpen il-fond tal-ilma b'piż marbut ma' ħabel.
formal.en: Before bringing the boat towards the shore, the sailor measured the water depth with a weight attached to a rope.
formal.zh: 在驾船靠近岸边之前，水手用绑在绳子上的重物测量了水深。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-baħri qabel resaq lejn ix-xatt? Toni: Qanpen il-fond b'piż biex ikun jaf kemm kien fond l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the sailor do before approaching the shore? Toni: He measured the depth with a weight to find out how deep the water was.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水手靠近岸边之前做了什么？托尼：他用重物测深，看看水有多深。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel il-baħri qabel resaq lejn ix-xatt?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel il-baħri qabel resaq lejn ix-xatt?
messages.zh: 水手靠近岸边之前做了什么？
messages.en: What did the sailor do before approaching the shore?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qanpen il-fond b'piż biex ikun jaf kemm kien fond l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Qanpen il-fond b'piż biex ikun jaf kemm kien fond l-ilma.
messages.zh: 他用重物测深，看看水有多深。
messages.en: He measured the depth with a weight to find out how deep the water was.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qanpen 记成一段动作画面：绳端绑着重物，慢慢放入水中，再据此测出水深。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The small piece of soft tissue that hangs from the back of the soft palate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从软腭后缘垂下的小块软组织，俗称小舌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira ta' tessut artab li tiddendel mit-tarf ta' wara tal-palat artab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬雍垂，俗称小舌。

formal.mt: L-istampa turi l-qanpiena tal-ħalq imdendla mit-tarf ta' wara tal-palat artab.
formal.en: The picture shows the uvula hanging from the back edge of the soft palate.
formal.zh: 图片展示了从软腭后缘垂下的悬雍垂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-biċċa żgħira li tidher fuq wara tal-ħalq? Lara: Dik hi l-qanpiena tal-ħalq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that little piece you can see at the back of the mouth? Lara: That's the uvula.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：嘴巴后面能看到的那一小块是什么？拉拉：那是悬雍垂。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-biċċa żgħira li tidher fuq wara tal-ħalq?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-biċċa żgħira li tidher fuq wara tal-ħalq?
messages.zh: 嘴巴后面能看到的那一小块是什么？

messages.en: That's the uvula.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把悬雍垂想成嘴巴深处垂着的小铃铛，用这个位置图像记住整条短语。

gloss_zh: 容易激起情绪的；令人心绪激荡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to stir strong feelings or cause emotional disturbance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易激起强烈感情或使人情绪波动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jqajjem emozzjonijiet qawwija jew iħawwad is-sentimenti.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to excite or cause emotional upheaval
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易使人激动或引起情绪剧烈波动的。

formal.mt: Id-diskors qanqali qajjem emozzjonijiet qawwija fost dawk li semgħuh.
formal.en: The emotionally stirring speech aroused strong feelings among those who heard it.
formal.zh: 这场令人情绪激荡的演说在听众中激起了强烈感情。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif kien il-film? Maja: Kien qanqali ħafna; għadni naħseb fih.
colloquial.en: Mark: How was the film? Maja: It was very emotionally unsettling; I'm still thinking about it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：电影怎么样？玛雅：很让人心绪难平，我现在还在想。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影怎么样？
messages.en: How was the film?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qanqali ħafna; għadni naħseb fih.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qanqali ħafna; għadni naħseb fih.
messages.zh: 很让人心绪难平，我现在还在想。
messages.en: It was very emotionally unsettling; I'm still thinking about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词和看完电影仍久久平静不下来的感受配对，记住它强调情绪被激起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To live economically by keeping spending low and avoiding unnecessary expenses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过减少开支、避免不必要的花费而节俭生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħix bi ftit spejjeż u jevita nfiq li mhuwiex meħtieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节俭度日，过俭省的生活。

collocations.en: lived frugally for a whole year

formal.mt: Pawlu qansar għal sena sħiħa sabiex ikollu biżżejjed flus għall-istudji tiegħu.
formal.en: Pawlu lived frugally for a whole year so that he would have enough money for his studies.
formal.zh: 保罗整整一年都节俭度日，以便攒够求学所需的钱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irnexxielu Pawlu jiffranka daqshekk? Mark: Qansar għal sena sħiħa u xtara biss dak li kellu bżonn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Pawlu manage to save so much? Mark: He lived frugally for a whole year and bought only what he needed.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗怎么攒下这么多钱的？马克：他整整一年都很节俭，只买必需的东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么攒下这么多钱的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu manage to save so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qansar għal sena sħiħa u xtara biss dak li kellu bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Qansar għal sena sħiħa u xtara biss dak li kellu bżonn.
messages.zh: 他整整一年都很节俭，只买必需的东西。
messages.en: He lived frugally for a whole year and bought only what he needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每天记账、只买必需品、慢慢攒出学费的生活，把整套节俭行为与此词相连。

gloss_zh: 规则；规范；租金；教会法令

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rule or norm that guides conduct or establishes what is expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指导行为或规定应当如何行事的规则、准则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola jew norma li tgħid kif wieħed għandu jġib ruħu jew jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 规则，规范，行为准则。
租金，为租用房屋、土地或其他财物而支付的费用。
教会法令，教会制定的法规或教规。

collocations.en: to act according to the rule

formal.mt: Il-qanun tal-grupp jgħid li kull membru għandu jisma' lill-oħrajn mingħajr ma jinterrompi.
formal.en: The group's rule states that every member should listen to others without interrupting.
formal.zh: 小组的规则规定，每位成员都应听别人说话，不得打断。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nibda nitkellem issa? Mark: Stenna ftit; il-qanun hu li kulħadd jitkellem meta jmissu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I start speaking now? Mark: Wait a moment; the rule is that everyone speaks when it's their turn.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我现在可以开始说了吗？马克：稍等，规则是大家轮到自己时再说。

messages.speaker: Maja (小组成员)
messages.zh: 我现在可以开始说了吗？
messages.en: Can I start speaking now?

messages.speaker: Mark (小组主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; il-qanun hu li kulħadd jitkellem meta jmissu.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; il-qanun hu li kulħadd jitkellem meta jmissu.
messages.zh: 稍等，规则是大家轮到自己时再说。
messages.en: Wait a moment; the rule is that everyone speaks when it's their turn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词画三张语境卡：行为规则、缴付租金、教会法规；每次靠搭配判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use money or resources carefully, reduce spending, or save.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谨慎使用金钱或资源，减少开支，或把钱节省下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża l-flus jew ir-riżorsi bil-għaqal, inaqqas l-infiq jew ifaddal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过日子节俭，谨慎花钱。
节约使用金钱或资源，避免浪费。
节省、积攒钱财。

collocations.en: was thrifty in order to save

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, Pawlu qanċeċ fl-ispejjeż biex ifaddal għall-istudji tiegħu.
formal.en: Throughout the year, Pawlu economized on expenses to save for his studies.
formal.zh: 这一年里，Pawlu 节省开支，为自己的学业攒钱。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif irnexxielu Pawlu jfaddal daqshekk? Toni: Qanċeċ fl-ispejjeż u xtara biss dak li kellu bżonn.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did Pawlu manage to save so much? Toni: He economized on expenses and bought only what he needed.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 怎么攒下了这么多钱？Toni：他节省开支，只买自己需要的东西。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 怎么攒下了这么多钱？
messages.en: How did Pawlu manage to save so much?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qanċeċ fl-ispejjeż u xtara biss dak li kellu bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Qanċeċ fl-ispejjeż u xtara biss dak li kellu bżonn.
messages.zh: 他节省开支，只买自己需要的东西。
messages.en: He economized on expenses and bought only what he needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qanċeċ 记成一个动作：少花一点，把省下的钱放进储蓄罐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who spends carefully; in a critical sense, a miser who is unwilling to spend.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花钱谨慎、生活节俭的人；在批评语境中，也指舍不得花钱的守财奴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tonfoq bil-għaqal; f'sens ta' kritika, persuna li ma tridx tonfoq il-flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个花钱谨慎、生活节俭的人。
守财奴；过分吝啬、舍不得花钱的人。

collocations.en: a person who is careful or stingy with money
collocations.zh: 一个用钱节俭或吝啬的人
一个一分钱也不肯花的守财奴

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni huwa qanċieċ li jippreferi jżomm il-flus milli jonfoqhom, anki meta jkun hemm bżonn.
formal.en: The main character is a miser who prefers to keep his money rather than spend it, even when spending is necessary.
formal.zh: 主人公是个守财奴，即使有必要花钱，也宁愿把钱留着。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu hu qanċieċ? Toni: Jekk tfisser li joqgħod attent għall-flus, iva; imma jagħti sehmu meta jkun hemm bżonn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is Pawlu a thrifty person? Toni: If you mean that he's careful with money, yes; but he contributes when needed.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 是个节俭的人吗？Toni：如果你指他花钱谨慎，是的；不过有需要时，他也会出自己的一份。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 是个节俭的人吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu a thrifty person?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk tfisser li joqgħod attent għall-flus, iva; imma jagħti sehmu meta jkun hemm bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk tfisser li joqgħod attent għall-flus, iva; imma jagħti sehmu meta jkun hemm bżonn.
messages.zh: 如果你指他花钱谨慎，是的；不过有需要时，他也会出自己的一份。
messages.en: If you mean that he's careful with money, yes; but he contributes when needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qanċieċ 配一张人物卡：谨慎用钱可译“节俭者”，过分惜钱则译“守财奴”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful about spending money, or excessively unwilling to spend, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容花钱节俭；也可按语境表示过分舍不得花钱、吝啬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil min joqgħod attent kif jonfoq il-flus, jew lil min ma jridx jonfoq iżżejjed fil-fehma ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吝啬的；过分舍不得花钱的。
节俭的；用钱谨慎、不浪费的。

collocations.zh: 一个节俭或吝啬的男人

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa qanċieċi: jippjana x-xiri tiegħu u jevita l-ħela, iżda jħallas għal dak li hu meħtieġ.
formal.en: Pawlu is thrifty: he plans his shopping and avoids waste, but pays for what is necessary.
formal.zh: Pawlu 很节俭：他会计划采购、避免浪费，但必要的东西仍然会花钱买。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Toni hu qanċieċi wisq; lanqas irid iħallas għat-tiswija. Pawlu: Iva, din id-darba mhux qed jiffranka bil-għaqal.
colloquial.en: Marija: Toni is too miserly; he won't even pay for the repair. Pawlu: Yes, this time he isn't saving wisely.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Toni 太吝啬了，连维修费都不愿意付。Pawlu：是啊，这次他这样省钱并不明智。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni hu qanċieċi wisq; lanqas irid iħallas għat-tiswija.
messages.mt_standard: Toni hu qanċieċi wisq; lanqas irid iħallas għat-tiswija.
messages.zh: Toni 太吝啬了，连维修费都不愿意付。
messages.en: Toni is too miserly; he won't even pay for the repair.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din id-darba mhux qed jiffranka bil-għaqal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din id-darba mhux qed jiffranka bil-għaqal.
messages.zh: 是啊，这次他这样省钱并不明智。
messages.en: Yes, this time he isn't saving wisely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qanċieċi 放在花钱尺度上：适度是“节俭的”，过度便是“吝啬的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who is very unwilling to spend or give money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人很不愿意花钱或给别人钱，带有批评意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jsibha bi tqila ħafna biex jonfoq jew jagħti l-flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容某人花钱抠门、舍不得掏钱。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, is-sid huwa qanċiċu u jirrifjuta li jonfoq anki fuq tiswijiet meħtieġa.
formal.en: In the story, the owner is tight-fisted and refuses to spend even on necessary repairs.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人很吝啬，连必要的维修都不愿意花钱。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Toni ma jridx jagħti sehmu għar-rigal? Pawlu: Għax hu qanċiċu ħafna, anki meta nitolbuh ftit flus biss.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why doesn't Toni want to contribute to the gift? Pawlu: Because he's very tight-fisted, even when we ask him for only a little money.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Toni 为什么不愿意出一份钱买礼物？Pawlu：因为他很抠门，哪怕我们只请他出一点钱。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Toni ma jridx jagħti sehmu għar-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Toni ma jridx jagħti sehmu għar-rigal?
messages.zh: Toni 为什么不愿意出一份钱买礼物？
messages.en: Why doesn't Toni want to contribute to the gift?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu qanċiċu ħafna, anki meta nitolbuh ftit flus biss.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu qanċiċu ħafna, anki meta nitolbuh ftit flus biss.
messages.zh: 因为他很抠门，哪怕我们只请他出一点钱。
messages.en: Because he's very tight-fisted, even when we ask him for only a little money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人紧紧捂住钱包，用 qanċiċu 形容他“舍不得掏钱”的性格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant common sow thistle, scientifically named Sonchus oleraceus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指苦苣菜这种植物，学名为 Sonchus oleraceus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Sonchus oleraceus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苦苣菜，学名 Sonchus oleraceus。

collocations.en: the leaves of common sow thistle

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-botanika, l-istudenti qabblu l-pjanta tal-qanċlita mar-ritratt bit-tikketta Sonchus oleraceus.
formal.en: In the botany exercise, the students compared the common sow thistle plant with the photograph labelled Sonchus oleraceus.
formal.zh: 在植物学练习中，学生们把这株苦苣菜与标有 Sonchus oleraceus 的照片进行了比较。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Qanċlita. Fittex Sonchus oleraceus fil-ktieb u qabbel ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Marija: What's this plant called? Pawlu: Common sow thistle. Look up Sonchus oleraceus in the book and compare the photograph.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这植物叫什么？Pawlu：苦苣菜。在书里查一下 Sonchus oleraceus，再对照照片。

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指英文名为 tuberous hawk's-beard 的植物，可释作“块茎鹰须草”，学名为 Aetheorhiza bulbosa。

formal.en: In the catalogue, the photograph of tuberous hawk's-beard appears beside the scientific name Aetheorhiza bulbosa.
formal.zh: 图录中，块茎鹰须草的照片旁边标有学名 Aetheorhiza bulbosa。

messages.en: Is this also called qanċlita?

gloss_zh: 过度使劲；勉强费力地做；把事情搞砸

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strain oneself by putting too much effort into an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某项活动时用力过度，使自己过分吃力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz żejjed waqt attività, aktar milli jiflaħ jew milli hemm bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过度使劲，过分勉力，使自己过度劳累。

sense_translations.en_definition: to do sth. with great reluctance or difficulty
sense_translations.zh_definition: 极不情愿地或十分吃力地做某事。
把任务做坏，把事情搞砸。

collocations.en: strained himself too much trying to lift the box
collocations.zh: 为了抬箱子而过度使劲

formal.mt: Pawlu qanżaħ biex jerfa' l-kaxxa waħdu, għalkemm kien hemm min seta' jgħinu.
formal.en: Pawlu strained himself too much trying to lift the box alone, although someone was available to help him.
formal.zh: 保罗为了独自抬起箱子而过度使劲，尽管当时有人可以帮他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqaf Pawlu? Mark: Qanżaħ biex iġorr kollox waħdu u issa għajjien ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu stop? Mark: He overexerted himself trying to carry everything alone, and now he's very tired.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么停下来了？马克：他想一个人搬完所有东西，太勉强自己了，现在累得很。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qanżaħ biex iġorr kollox waħdu u issa għajjien ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Qanżaħ biex iġorr kollox waħdu u issa għajjien ħafna.
messages.zh: 他想一个人搬完所有东西，太勉强自己了，现在累得很。
messages.en: He overexerted himself trying to carry everything alone, and now he's very tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个小场景分别记忆：搬箱子过度使劲、很不情愿地做事、做任务出了差错；注意按语境区分。

gloss_zh: 做事过分使劲的人；过度勉力者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who puts more effort than necessary or manageable into performing a task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成任务时过分使劲，付出超出必要程度或自身承受能力的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel sforz żejjed biex twettaq biċċa xogħol, aktar milli hemm bżonn jew milli tiflaħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who makes too much effort to perform a task
sense_translations.zh_definition: 做一项任务时过度使劲、过分勉力的人。

collocations.en: someone who overexerts himself at work
someone who overexerts himself by doing everything alone
collocations.zh: 凡事独自承担而过度费力的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, Pawlu jidher bħala qanżieħ: jagħmel sforz żejjed anki biex iwettaq xogħol sempliċi.
formal.en: In the story, Pawlu comes across as someone who overexerts himself: he puts excessive effort even into simple work.
formal.zh: 在故事中，保罗是个做事过度勉力的人：即使做简单的工作，他也会过分使劲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu reġa' qed iġorr kollox waħdu. Lara: Kemm hu qanżieħ! Se ngħidlu biex iħallina ngħinuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is carrying everything by himself again. Lara: He really does overexert himself! I'll tell him to let us help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗又在一个人搬所有东西了。拉拉：他真是个太勉强自己的人！我去叫他让我们帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu reġa' qed iġorr kollox waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu reġa' qed iġorr kollox waħdu.
messages.zh: 保罗又在一个人搬所有东西了。
messages.en: Pawlu is carrying everything by himself again.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu qanżieħ! Se ngħidlu biex iħallina ngħinuh.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu qanżieħ! Se ngħidlu biex iħallina ngħinuh.
messages.zh: 他真是个太勉强自己的人！我去叫他让我们帮忙。
messages.en: He really does overexert himself! I'll tell him to let us help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上画一个坚持独自搬很多箱子的人，提醒自己这个名词指过度费力的人。

gloss_zh: 需要极大力气的；十分费劲的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Demanding a great amount of effort or physical exertion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要付出很大努力或耗费大量体力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitlob sforz kbir jew ħafna taħbit fiżiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要极大努力或体力的，十分费劲的。

formal.mt: Il-ġarr tal-ġebel kien xogħol qanżieħi li kien jitlob ħafna saħħa u ħin.
formal.en: Carrying the stones was strenuous work that required considerable strength and time.
formal.zh: 搬运石头是十分费劲的工作，需要大量体力和时间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif kien ix-xogħol illum? Pawlu: Kien qanżieħi ħafna; ġarrejna ġebel il-ġurnata kollha.
colloquial.en: Mark: How was work today? Pawlu: It was very strenuous; we carried stones all day.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天工作怎么样？保罗：特别费劲，我们搬了一整天石头。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天工作怎么样？
messages.en: How was work today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qanżieħi ħafna; ġarrejna ġebel il-ġurnata kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qanżieħi ħafna; ġarrejna ġebel il-ġurnata kollha.
messages.zh: 特别费劲，我们搬了一整天石头。
messages.en: It was very strenuous; we carried stones all day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在一堆等待搬运的重石头旁，记住它描述工作很费劲、需要很大力气。

gloss_zh: 咯咯；嘎嘎；呱呱，模仿禽鸟叫声

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation imitating a bird's cackle or caw.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 模仿鸡等禽鸟咯咯叫声或乌鸦呱呱叫声的感叹词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma esklamattiva li timita l-ħoss ta' tiġieġa jew ta' ċawla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咯咯，模仿鸡等禽鸟的咯咯叫声。
呱呱，模仿乌鸦的叫声。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont għat-tfal, iċ-ċawla fuq is-siġra għamlet: "Qaq, qaq!"
formal.en: In the children's story, the crow in the tree went, "Caw, caw!"
formal.zh: 在这篇儿童故事里，树上的乌鸦叫道：“呱，呱！”

colloquial.mt: Lina: Qaq, qaq! Hekk tagħmel iċ-ċawla? Marija: Iva, qed timita l-ħoss tagħha sew.
colloquial.en: Lina: Caw, caw! Is that how a crow sounds? Marija: Yes, you're imitating its sound well.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：呱，呱！乌鸦是这么叫的吗？玛丽娅：对，你学得很像。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 呱，呱！乌鸦是这么叫的吗？
messages.en: Caw, caw! Is that how a crow sounds?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed timita l-ħoss tagħha sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed timita l-ħoss tagħha sew.
messages.zh: 对，你学得很像。
messages.en: Yes, you're imitating its sound well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qaq 连说两次来模仿鸟叫，再看场景是母鸡还是乌鸦，分别联想到咯咯声或呱呱声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scratch something hard or scour a surface by rubbing it firmly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力抓挠某物，或通过使劲摩擦来擦洗表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħakk xi ħaġa bis-saħħa, jew naddaf wiċċ billi għorok sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使劲抓挠；用力刮擦。
通过用力摩擦来擦洗、刷净。

formal.mt: Wara t-tisjir, il-ħaddiem qarad il-borma biex ineħħi l-fdalijiet tal-ikel.
formal.en: After cooking, the worker scoured the pot to remove the food residue.
formal.zh: 烹饪结束后，工作人员用力擦洗锅，去除食物残渣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min naddaf din il-borma? Pawlu: Ħija qarad il-borma sakemm neħħa l-ikel maħruq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who cleaned this pot? Pawlu: My brother scoured the pot until he removed the burnt food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这口锅是谁洗的？保罗：我哥哥使劲擦洗，把烧焦的食物都清掉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这口锅是谁洗的？
messages.en: Who cleaned this pot?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija qarad il-borma sakemm neħħa l-ikel maħruq.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija qarad il-borma sakemm neħħa l-ikel maħruq.
messages.zh: 我哥哥使劲擦洗，把烧焦的食物都清掉了。
messages.en: My brother scoured the pot until he removed the burnt food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面连着记：皮肤被使劲抓挠，锅底被使劲擦洗；共同提示都是用力摩擦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a priest to hear someone confess their sins in a religious confession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指神父在宗教告解中听取某人承认自己的罪过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bħala qassis, sema' lil xi ħadd jistqarr dnubietu fil-qrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 听取某人的告解，通常指神父听取信徒忏悔罪过。

formal.mt: Qabel il-quddiesa, il-qassis qarar lill-fidil f'post kwiet fil-knisja.
formal.en: Before Mass, the priest heard the believer's confession in a quiet place in the church.
formal.zh: 弥撒开始前，神父在教堂内一处安静的地方听取了那位信徒的告解。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-qassis għadu fil-knisja? Ġużeppi: Iva, għadu kemm qarar lil wieħed mill-fidili.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the priest still in the church? Ġużeppi: Yes, he has just heard one of the believers' confessions.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：神父还在教堂里吗？朱塞佩：在，他刚听完一位信徒的告解。

messages.speaker: Marija (教友)
messages.zh: 神父还在教堂里吗？
messages.en: Is the priest still in the church?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu kemm qarar lil wieħed mill-fidili.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu kemm qarar lil wieħed mill-fidili.
messages.zh: 在，他刚听完一位信徒的告解。
messages.en: Yes, he has just heard one of the believers' confessions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象告解场景中的神父安静倾听：这个动词记在听取告解的一方，而不是陈述罪过的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being close to someone or something, in distance or relationship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空间距离上靠近某人或某物，或在关系上彼此亲近的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna jew ħaġa tkun qrib oħra fid-distanza jew fir-relazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接近、紧密或亲近的状态，可用于距离或关系。
邻近；距离某人、某物或某处很近的状态。

formal.mt: Il-qarba tal-baħar tagħmel din id-dar adattata għal min iħobb jimxi max-xatt.
formal.en: Its proximity to the sea makes this house suitable for someone who enjoys walking along the shore.
formal.zh: 这所房子靠近大海，适合喜欢沿海岸散步的人居住。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għażilt din id-dar? Mark: Minħabba l-qarba tal-baħar; nista' mmur max-xatt bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you choose this house? Mark: Because of its proximity to the sea; I can walk to the shore.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么选这所房子？马克：因为离海近，我可以走路去海边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这所房子？
messages.en: Why did you choose this house?

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-qarba tal-baħar; nista' mmur max-xatt bil-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-qarba tal-baħar; nista' mmur max-xatt bil-mixi.
messages.zh: 因为离海近，我可以走路去海边。
messages.en: Because of its proximity to the sea; I can walk to the shore.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两种近来记：房子离海近是空间接近，朋友心贴近是关系亲近；这个词表示接近的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deduction: the removal of an amount from a total, or the amount removed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从总数或总金额中扣去一部分的行为，或被扣去的数额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis ta' ammont minn total, jew l-ammont li jitnaqqas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扣除；扣减；从总额中减去的数额。

formal.mt: Id-dokument juri qard ta' għaxar ewro mit-total ta' mitt ewro.
formal.en: The document shows a deduction of ten euros from the total of one hundred euros.
formal.zh: 文件显示，从一百欧元的总额中扣除了十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex it-total issa hu disgħin ewro? Lara: Għax hemm qard ta' għaxar ewro mill-mitt ewro.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is the total now ninety euros? Lara: Because there is a deduction of ten euros from the hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 马克：总额怎么现在是九十欧元？拉拉：因为从一百欧元里扣了十欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-total issa hu disgħin ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-total issa hu disgħin ewro?
messages.zh: 总额怎么现在是九十欧元？
messages.en: Why is the total now ninety euros?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm qard ta' għaxar ewro mill-mitt ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm qard ta' għaxar ewro mill-mitt ewro.
messages.zh: 因为从一百欧元里扣了十欧元。
messages.en: Because there is a deduction of ten euros from the hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用账单上的减法记忆：总额一百减去十，扣掉的这十就是扣减额，整个动作就是扣除。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An abscess, a localized swelling containing pus, often occurring in the foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脓肿，即局部积聚脓液形成的肿块；本词常用于足部的脓肿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nefħa f'parti tal-ġisem li fiha jkun inġabar il-materja, spiss fis-sieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脓肿，即局部积脓形成的肿块，常见于足部。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, it-tabib innota qarda fis-sieq tal-pazjent.
formal.en: During the examination, the doctor noted an abscess in the patient's foot.
formal.zh: 检查时，医生发现患者足部有一处脓肿。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed izzappap? Pawlu: Għandi qarda fis-sieq u tweġġagħni meta nimxi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you limping? Pawlu: I have an abscess in my foot, and it hurts when I walk.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么一瘸一拐的？保罗：我脚上有个脓肿，走路时会疼。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么一瘸一拐的？
messages.en: Why are you limping?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi qarda fis-sieq u tweġġagħni meta nimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi qarda fis-sieq u tweġġagħni meta nimxi.
messages.zh: 我脚上有个脓肿，走路时会疼。
messages.en: I have an abscess in my foot, and it hurts when I walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词和脚部的小肿块画面连起来，重点记住肿块里面积有脓液，而不只是普通的疼痛。

gloss_zh: 梳开羊毛等纤维；梳毛工

teaching_sense.en_definition: To card wool or other textile fibres by separating and loosening them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 梳理羊毛或其他纺织纤维，使纤维分开、松散。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fired u ħoll il-fibri tas-suf jew ta' materjal ieħor biex jippreparahom għall-għażil.

sense_translations.en_definition: to separate the fibres (of wool or other thread)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳开、分离羊毛或其他纺织材料的纤维。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who cards wool, cotton etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳毛工；梳理羊毛、棉花等纤维的人。

collocations.en: works as a wool or cotton carder

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem qardax is-suf biex jifred il-fibri qabel l-għażil.
formal.en: The worker carded the wool to separate the fibres before spinning.
formal.zh: 工人在纺纱前梳理羊毛，使纤维分开。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ħejja dan is-suf għall-għażil? Toni: Missieri; hu qardax u qardax is-suf dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who prepared this wool for spinning? Toni: My father; he's a carder, and he carded the wool this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些准备纺纱的羊毛是谁整理的？托尼：我爸爸；他是梳毛工，今天早上梳好了这些羊毛。

messages.speaker: Sara (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 这些准备纺纱的羊毛是谁整理的？
messages.en: Who prepared this wool for spinning?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri; hu qardax u qardax is-suf dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri; hu qardax u qardax is-suf dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 我爸爸；他是梳毛工，今天早上梳好了这些羊毛。
messages.en: My father; he's a carder, and he carded the wool this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一团羊毛被梳开：作动词时记梳开纤维的动作，作名词时记执行这个动作的梳毛工。

gloss_zh: 抑制植物生长；使发育不良

teaching_sense.en_definition: To restrict growth or development, especially the growth of plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抑制生长或发育，尤其指使植物生长受阻、长不大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fixkel jew naqqas it-tkabbir, speċjalment tal-pjanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: to check the growth of plants
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抑制、阻碍植物的生长。
使生长或发育受阻；使长不大。

collocations.en: stunted the growth of the plants

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' ilma qarden it-tkabbir tal-pjanti fl-għalqa.
formal.en: The lack of water stunted the growth of the plants in the field.
formal.zh: 缺水抑制了田里植物的生长。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dawn il-pjanti baqgħu daqshekk żgħar? Pawlu: In-nuqqas ta' ilma qarden it-tkabbir tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why have these plants stayed so small? Pawlu: The lack of water stunted their growth.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些植物怎么一直这么小？保罗：缺水使它们的生长受阻了。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dawn il-pjanti baqgħu daqshekk żgħar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dawn il-pjanti baqgħu daqshekk żgħar?
messages.zh: 这些植物怎么一直这么小？
messages.en: Why have these plants stayed so small?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nuqqas ta' ilma qarden it-tkabbir tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: In-nuqqas ta' ilma qarden it-tkabbir tagħhom.
messages.zh: 缺水使它们的生长受阻了。
messages.en: The lack of water stunted their growth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两盆同龄幼苗，缺水的那盆始终长不大，用这个画面记住 qarden 的“抑制生长”；英语释义中的 check 在这里也表示阻碍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a very strong sour taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 酸味非常强烈的；可用“酸得像醋”帮助理解其程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma qarsa ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常酸的；酸味极重的。

formal.mt: Il-meraq kien qares ħall, għalhekk żidna ftit ilma u zokkor.
formal.en: The juice was very sour, so we added a little water and sugar.
formal.zh: 果汁非常酸，因此我们加了一点水和糖。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu l-meraq? Mark: Qares ħall! Se nżidlu ftit zokkor.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the juice? Mark: Very sour! I'm going to add a little sugar.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：果汁怎么样？马克：酸得很！我要加一点糖。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 果汁怎么样？
messages.en: How is the juice?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qares ħall! Se nżidlu ftit zokkor.
messages.mt_standard: Qares ħall! Se nżidlu ftit zokkor.
messages.zh: 酸得很！我要加一点糖。
messages.en: Very sour! I'm going to add a little sugar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上喝到酸汁后皱眉的表情，记成“酸得像醋”；重点记住它表达很强的酸味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pumpkin; also the scalp, or, insultingly, a person considered stupid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指蔬菜南瓜，也可指头皮；用于称呼人时，可表示“笨蛋”，带侮辱意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa kbira li tintuża fit-tisjir; ukoll il-ġilda tar-ras, jew kelma ta' tgħajjir għal persuna meqjusa stupida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 南瓜。
头皮；覆盖头部的皮肤。
笨蛋；蠢人，属于贬低人的说法。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla tal-lum, il-kċina ħejjiet soppa tal-qargħa bil-ħobż.
formal.en: For today's meal, the kitchen prepared pumpkin soup with bread.
formal.zh: 厨房为今天的餐食准备了南瓜汤和面包。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nsajru llejla? Omm: Għandna qargħa kbira; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What shall we cook tonight? Mum: We have a large pumpkin; we can make soup.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今晚我们做什么吃？妈妈：我们有个大南瓜，可以煮汤。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 今晚我们做什么吃？
messages.en: What shall we cook tonight?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna qargħa kbira; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna qargħa kbira; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa.
messages.zh: 我们有个大南瓜，可以煮汤。
messages.en: We have a large pumpkin; we can make soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qargħa 做三张情境卡：厨房里是“南瓜”，谈皮肤时是“头皮”，拿来骂人时是“笨蛋”；靠语境区分，不把三义混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having no hair, or very little hair, on the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头上没有头发或头发很少的；秃头的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma għandux xagħar fuq rasu, jew li għandu ftit li xejn xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秃头的；头部没有头发或头发极少的。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher raġel qargħi liebes nuċċali u ġakketta skura.
formal.en: The photograph shows a bald man wearing glasses and a dark jacket.
formal.zh: 照片中是一位戴眼镜、穿深色夹克的秃头男子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema wieħed hu zijuk? Ben: Dak ir-raġel qargħi bin-nuċċali, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which one is your uncle? Ben: That bald man with glasses, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：哪位是你叔叔？本：门旁边那个戴眼镜的秃头男子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 哪位是你叔叔？
messages.en: Which one is your uncle?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel qargħi bin-nuċċali, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel qargħi bin-nuċċali, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 门旁边那个戴眼镜的秃头男子。
messages.en: That bald man with glasses, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物识别卡上写着“戴眼镜、穿外套、秃头”，把 qargħi 放在外貌描述栏，连同 raġel qargħi 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insulting word for a person regarded as very stupid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来贬低某人非常愚蠢的名词，相当于“蠢货”；带侮辱性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' tgħajjir għal persuna meqjusa stupida ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蠢货；极愚蠢的人，属于侮辱性的称呼。

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'qargħun' hija insult u mhijiex xierqa f'diskussjoni ta' rispett.
formal.en: The word 'qargħun' is an insult and is inappropriate in a respectful discussion.
formal.zh: qargħun 一词带有侮辱性，不适合用于相互尊重的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjaħtlu qargħun? Mark: Kont irrabjat, imma ma kellix ngħid hekk. Se nitlob skuża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you call him an imbecile? Mark: I was angry, but I shouldn't have said that. I'll apologize.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么骂他蠢货？马克：我当时生气了，但不该那样说。我会道歉。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么骂他蠢货？
messages.en: Why did you call him an imbecile?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont irrabjat, imma ma kellix ngħid hekk. Se nitlob skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Kont irrabjat, imma ma kellix ngħid hekk. Se nitlob skuża.
messages.zh: 我当时生气了，但不该那样说。我会道歉。
messages.en: I was angry, but I shouldn't have said that. I'll apologize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qargħun 放进“争吵后需要道歉”的对话卡，记住它是侮辱人的“蠢货”，同时与表示外貌的 qargħi 分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of reading, or material intended to be read.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阅读这一活动，也指供人阅读的读物或材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li taqra, jew materjal maħsub biex jinqara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阅读；读书这一活动。
读物；供阅读的文字材料。

formal.mt: Il-qari ta' kuljum jgħin lill-istudenti jkabbru l-vokabularju tagħhom.
formal.en: Daily reading helps students expand their vocabulary.
formal.zh: 每日阅读有助于学生扩大词汇量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek xi qari għall-vjaġġ? Ben: Iva, ħadt ktieb qasir u żewġ rivisti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have anything to read for the journey? Ben: Yes, I brought a short book and two magazines.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你带了路上看的读物吗？本：带了，一本短篇书和两本杂志。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅伴)
messages.zh: 你带了路上看的读物吗？
messages.en: Do you have anything to read for the journey?

messages.speaker: Ben (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadt ktieb qasir u żewġ rivisti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadt ktieb qasir u żewġ rivisti.
messages.zh: 带了，一本短篇书和两本杂志。
messages.en: Yes, I brought a short book and two magazines.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅旅途读书图记双义：正在读书的动作是“阅读”，包里带着的书刊是“读物”；两处都可以联想到 qari。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Firm and crisp, making a noticeable crunch when bitten or chewed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地酥脆或爽脆、咬嚼时会发出明显脆响的，常用于食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmlu ħoss iqarmeċ meta tigdimhom jew tomgħodhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脆的；咬嚼时有脆响的。

formal.mt: Wara li jiksħu, żomm il-gallettini f'kontenitur magħluq biex jibqgħu qarmieċi.
formal.en: After they cool, keep the biscuits in a closed container so that they stay crunchy.
formal.zh: 饼干冷却后，应放在密闭容器中，以保持酥脆。
