colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn il-gallettini għadhom qarmieċi? Pawlu: Iva, ħu wieħed u ara kemm iqarmeċ!
colloquial.en: Nina: Are these biscuits still crunchy? Pawlu: Yes, take one and see how it crunches!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些饼干还脆吗？保罗：脆，拿一块尝尝，看咬起来多脆！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些饼干还脆吗？
messages.en: Are these biscuits still crunchy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu wieħed u ara kemm iqarmeċ!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu wieħed u ara kemm iqarmeċ!
messages.zh: 脆，拿一块尝尝，看咬起来多脆！
messages.en: Yes, take one and see how it crunches!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象咬饼干时清楚的“咔嚓”声，把声音与 qarmieċi 绑定；饼干的酥脆和胡萝卜的爽脆都可用这个感觉记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The European roller, a bird of the species Coracias garrulus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蓝胸佛法僧，即学名为 Coracias garrulus 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Coracias garrulus, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala European roller.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蓝胸佛法僧，学名 Coracias garrulus。

collocations.en: a photograph of a European roller
collocations.zh: 一张蓝胸佛法僧的照片

collocations.en: a sighting of a European roller
collocations.zh: 一次蓝胸佛法僧的目击记录

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratt ta' qarnanqliċ u d-data tal-osservazzjoni.
formal.en: The report includes a photograph of a European roller and the date of the sighting.
formal.zh: 报告附有一张蓝胸佛法僧的照片，并注明了目击日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Mark: Qarnanqliċ; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ European roller.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this bird in the photograph called? Mark: Qarnanqliċ; in English it is called the European roller.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？马克：马耳他语叫 qarnanqliċ，英语叫 European roller，中文叫蓝胸佛法僧。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 马耳他语叫 qarnanqliċ，英语叫 European roller，中文叫蓝胸佛法僧。
messages.en: Qarnanqliċ; in English it is called the European roller.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张鸟类识别卡，把 qarnanqliċ、European roller、蓝胸佛法僧和 Coracias garrulus 并排写下，用同一只鸟连接四个名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put up with a person or something unpleasant; also, of a bird, to grow feathers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 忍受某个人或令人不快的事物；也可指鸟长出羽毛，须根据主语和语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissaporti lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa mhux pjaċevoli; jingħad ukoll għal għasfur li jibda jkabbar ir-rix.

sense_translations.en_definition: to put up with sb. or sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍受、容忍某个人或某种事物。
长出羽毛，用于鸟类。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xogħol ta' tiswija, Pawlu qarnas l-istorbju mingħajr ma lmenta.
formal.en: During the repair work, Pawlu put up with the noise without complaining.
formal.zh: 维修期间，保罗忍受着噪声，没有抱怨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-fellus għadu bla rix? Pawlu: Le, qarnas u issa għandu r-rix.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the chick still featherless? Pawlu: No, it has grown feathers and has plumage now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只小鸡还没长毛吗？保罗：不是，它已经长出羽毛了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只小鸡还没长毛吗？
messages.en: Is the chick still featherless?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养鸡人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qarnas u issa għandu r-rix.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qarnas u issa għandu r-rix.
messages.zh: 不是，它已经长出羽毛了。
messages.en: No, it has grown feathers and has plumage now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记忆：人捂着耳朵忍受噪声，小鸡慢慢长出羽毛；看到主语先判断是哪一个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a low, rolling rumbling sound, such as the sound of a stomach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出低沉、滚动般的咕噜声或隆隆声，例如肚子发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss baxx u kontinwu jew ripetut, bħal dak li kultant jagħmel l-istonku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出低沉的咕噜声、隆隆声。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, l-istonku ta' Mark qarqar bil-ġuħ.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mark's stomach rumbled with hunger.
formal.zh: 会议期间，马克的肚子饿得咕噜作响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Mark: L-istonku tiegħi qarqar. Għadni ma kilt xejn!
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that sound? Mark: My stomach rumbled. I haven't eaten anything yet!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才是什么声音？马克：我的肚子咕噜响了。我还什么都没吃呢！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-istonku tiegħi qarqar. Għadni ma kilt xejn!
messages.mt_standard: L-istonku tiegħi qarqar. Għadni ma kilt xejn!
messages.zh: 我的肚子咕噜响了。我还什么都没吃呢！
messages.en: My stomach rumbled. I haven't eaten anything yet!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安静开会时肚子突然咕噜一声，用完整小句“l-istonku qarqar”记住这是表示发声动作的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scorch a surface slightly with heat, especially during cooking; also to become stiff and crack, for example in the sun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用热力把表面燎焦，尤其用于烹饪；也指物体变得僵硬并开裂，例如受到日晒时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħraq xi ftit il-wiċċ ta' xi ħaġa bis-sħana, speċjalment waqt it-tisjir; jew isir iebes u jinqasam, bħal fix-xemx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把表面燎焦、烤焦，例如烘烤食物时。

sense_translations.en_definition: to grow stiff and crack (e.g. in the sun)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变硬并开裂，例如在阳光下晒得发硬、裂开。

collocations.en: singed the surface of the meat
the leather grew stiff and cracked in the sun
collocations.zh: 皮革在日晒下变硬开裂

formal.mt: In-nar qawwi qarqaċ il-wiċċ tal-laħam waqt ix-xiwi.
formal.en: The intense fire singed the surface of the meat during roasting.
formal.zh: 烤肉时，猛烈的火把肉的表面燎焦了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara minn dan il-ġild? Mark: Baqa' fix-xemx u qarqaċ; issa hu iebes u mimli xquq.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to this leather? Mark: It was left in the sun and grew stiff and cracked; now it is hard and full of cracks.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块皮革怎么了？马克：它一直放在太阳下，晒得变硬开裂了，现在硬邦邦的，到处都是裂纹。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块皮革怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to this leather?

messages.speaker: Mark (皮革物品主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Baqa' fix-xemx u qarqaċ; issa hu iebes u mimli xquq.
messages.mt_standard: Baqa' fix-xemx u qarqaċ; issa hu iebes u mimli xquq.
messages.zh: 它一直放在太阳下，晒得变硬开裂了，现在硬邦邦的，到处都是裂纹。
messages.en: It was left in the sun and grew stiff and cracked; now it is hard and full of cracks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项放进受热画面：火焰使肉表面燎焦，太阳使皮革变硬开裂；分别记住表面焦和材料裂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rumbling sound from the bowels, or the low vibrating sound of purring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肠道发出的咕噜声；也指猫等动物发出的低沉呼噜声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li jagħmlu l-imsaren, jew il-ħoss baxx u jivvibra li jagħmel qattus meta jħossu komdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肠鸣，肠道发出的咕噜声。
猫等动物发出的低沉、振动般的呼噜声。

formal.mt: Fis-skiet tal-kamra, il-qarqir tal-qattus kien jinstema' ċar.
formal.en: In the quiet room, the cat's purring could be heard clearly.
formal.zh: 房间很安静，猫的呼噜声清晰可闻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' dak il-qarqir? Pawlu: Iva, ġej minn żaqqi. Wasal il-ħin li niekol!
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that rumbling? Pawlu: Yes, it's coming from my tummy. It's time for me to eat!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听到那阵咕噜声了吗？保罗：听到了，是我肚子发出来的。该吃东西了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那阵咕噜声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that rumbling?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej minn żaqqi. Wasal il-ħin li niekol!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej minn żaqqi. Wasal il-ħin li niekol!
messages.zh: 听到了，是我肚子发出来的。该吃东西了！
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from my tummy. It's time for me to eat!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把qarqir当作声音的名称来记：一边是肚子的咕噜声，一边是猫的呼噜声；声音来源决定具体意思。

gloss_zh: 煎肉的脂肪；脆肉皮；耳垂；软骨

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fat from fried meat or a piece of crisp cooked skin; in a body-related context, an ear lobe or cartilage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指煎肉中的脂肪或烹制后酥脆的肉皮；在身体部位语境中，也可指耳垂或软骨，须结合上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xaħam minn biċċa laħam moqli jew ġilda tal-laħam imsajra sakemm issir tqarmeċ; fil-kuntest tal-ġisem, il-parti ratba t'isfel tal-widna jew il-qarquċa li tinsab f'partijiet tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.en_definition: fat from a piece of fried meat
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块煎肉中的脂肪、肥油部分。
烹制后酥脆的肉皮，通常指脆猪皮。
耳垂，耳朵下端柔软的部分。
软骨，身体中较坚韧而有弹性的组织。

collocations.en: the fat from the fried meat

formal.mt: Il-qarquċa hija tessut sod iżda flessibbli li jinsab f'diversi partijiet tal-ġisem.
formal.en: Cartilage is firm but flexible tissue found in various parts of the body.
formal.zh: 软骨是一种坚韧但有弹性的组织，分布在身体的多个部位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid il-qarquċa mal-laħam? Mark: Iva, jekk tkun tqarmeċ!
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like crackling with the meat? Mark: Yes, if it's crispy!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要配肉吃的脆肉皮吗？马克：要，只要够脆就行！

messages.speaker: Maja (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 你要配肉吃的脆肉皮吗？
messages.en: Would you like crackling with the meat?

messages.speaker: Mark (来做客的朋友)
messages.zh: 要，只要够脆就行！
messages.en: Yes, if it's crispy!

cognitive_memory_aid: 画四张语境卡分别记忆：煎肉肥油、酥脆肉皮、柔软耳垂、坚韧软骨；先判断餐桌还是身体语境，再细分义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to lose their hair and become bald.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人失去头发而变秃，强调某种因素造成秃头的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef xagħru u jsir qargħi.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to go bald
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人脱发、变成秃头。

collocations.en: caused the man to go bald

collocations.zh: 使头发全部脱落而变秃

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-trattament qarra' lill-protagonist, li tilef xagħru kollu.
formal.en: In the story, the treatment caused the protagonist to go bald, and he lost all his hair.
formal.zh: 故事中，那种治疗使主人公变秃，他失去了全部头发。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-karattru hu qargħi fl-aħħar tal-istorja? Mark: Għax ix-xorb maġiku qarra' lilu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the character bald at the end of the story? Mark: Because the magic drink made him go bald.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么那个角色在故事结尾变成秃头了？马克：因为那杯魔法饮料使他变秃了。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru hu qargħi fl-aħħar tal-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru hu qargħi fl-aħħar tal-istorja?
messages.zh: 为什么那个角色在故事结尾变成秃头了？
messages.en: Why is the character bald at the end of the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 因为那杯魔法饮料使他变秃了。
messages.en: Because the magic drink made him go bald.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里的魔法饮料使角色头发掉光，记住qarra'强调“使别人变秃”的致使关系，并留意词尾撇号。

gloss_zh: 使人或物相互靠近的人；撮合者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who brings people or things closer to one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物彼此靠近的人；在人际语境中可指促成双方接近、沟通的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib nies jew affarijiet eqreb lejn xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who brings things or people closer to each other
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使事物或人彼此靠近的人，促成接近或联系的人。

collocations.en: a person who brings two families closer together
collocations.zh: 促成两个家庭关系接近的人

collocations.en: the role of someone who brings people together
collocations.zh: 促成人们接近的人的角色

formal.mt: Pawlu kellu r-rwol ta' qarrab bejn iż-żewġ gruppi u għenhom jibdew jitkellmu ma' xulxin.
formal.en: Pawlu played the role of bringing the two groups closer together and helped them start talking to each other.
formal.zh: 保罗充当了促成两个群体接近的人，帮助他们开始相互交谈。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għen liż-żewġ familji jsiru ħbieb? Mark: Pawlu kien il-qarrab; stedinhom jieklu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who helped the two families become friends? Mark: Pawlu brought them together; he invited them to eat together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁帮助那两个家庭成为朋友的？马克：保罗是牵线的人，他邀请他们一起吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għen liż-żewġ familji jsiru ħbieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min għen liż-żewġ familji jsiru ħbieb?
messages.zh: 是谁帮助那两个家庭成为朋友的？
messages.en: Who helped the two families become friends?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kien il-qarrab; stedinhom jieklu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kien il-qarrab; stedinhom jieklu flimkien.
messages.zh: 保罗是牵线的人，他邀请他们一起吃饭。
messages.en: Pawlu brought them together; he invited them to eat together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人站在两群人中间，招呼双方坐近并开始聊天；这里qarrab是称呼这个人的名词，重点记“促成靠近者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bottle or container used to hold a small quantity of liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放少量液体的小瓶，例如装香水或液体样品的小容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flixkun żgħir li jintuża biex iżomm kwantità żgħira ta' likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小瓶，通常用于盛放少量液体。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun likwidu tqiegħed f'qarraba tal-ħġieġ magħluqa b'tapp.
formal.en: The liquid sample was placed in a glass vial closed with a stopper.
formal.zh: 液体样品被装入一个用塞子封好的玻璃小瓶中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt il-fwieħa? Mark: F'dik il-qarraba żgħira ħdejn il-mera.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the perfume? Mark: In that little vial next to the mirror.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你把香水放在哪里了？马克：放在镜子旁边的那个小瓶里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把香水放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the perfume?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 放在镜子旁边的那个小瓶里。
messages.en: In that little vial next to the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜子旁装着几滴香水的玻璃小瓶，把qarraba和“小瓶”画面绑定；与上一词分开记，不凭外形推断词义。

gloss_zh: 有助于拉近距离的；促进亲近的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to bring people or things closer together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于使人或事物彼此靠近、拉近彼此距离的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jqarreb in-nies jew l-affarijiet lejn xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to bring people or things closer to each other
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有使人或事物彼此靠近的倾向的；能拉近彼此距离的。

collocations.en: a gesture that brings people closer
collocations.zh: 拉近人与人距离的举动

formal.mt: L-għalliem għażel stil qarrabi biex l-istudenti jsiru jafu lil xulxin u jaħdmu flimkien.
formal.en: The teacher chose a style that encouraged closeness so that the students would get to know one another and work together.
formal.zh: 老师采用了促进彼此亲近的方式，让学生互相认识并共同合作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-logħob tal-bieraħ? Mark: Iva, kien qarrabi; wara ftit konna lkoll nitkellmu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like yesterday's games? Mark: Yes, they brought us closer; after a while we were all talking together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢昨天的游戏吗？Mark：喜欢，很能拉近大家的距离；过了一会儿，我们就都聊起来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢昨天的游戏吗？
messages.en: Did you like yesterday's games?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien qarrabi; wara ftit konna lkoll nitkellmu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien qarrabi; wara ftit konna lkoll nitkellmu flimkien.
messages.zh: 喜欢，很能拉近大家的距离；过了一会儿，我们就都聊起来了。
messages.en: Yes, they brought us closer; after a while we were all talking together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qarrabi 配上一幅大家围桌聊天、椅子逐渐靠近的画面，记住它形容能拉近距离的事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a wound or affected tissue to produce pus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使伤口或受影响的组织产生脓液、发生化脓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel ferita jew tessut milqut jimtela bil-materja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使化脓；引起脓液形成。
致脓因素；引起脓肿或化脓的事物。

collocations.en: caused the affected tissue to suppurate
collocations.zh: 使受影响的组织化脓了

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, it-tabib kiteb li l-proċess infettiv qarrad il-ferita u wassal għall-formazzjoni tal-materja.
formal.en: In the report, the doctor wrote that the infectious process caused the wound to suppurate and led to the formation of pus.
formal.zh: 医生在报告中写道，感染过程使伤口化脓，形成了脓液。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri li l-proċess infettiv qarrad il-ferita? Pawlu: Jiġifieri li kkawża l-formazzjoni tal-materja fil-ferita.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean that the infectious process caused the wound to suppurate? Pawlu: It means that it caused pus to form in the wound.
colloquial.zh: Maja：说感染过程使伤口化脓，是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是它使伤口里形成了脓液。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri li l-proċess infettiv qarrad il-ferita?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri li l-proċess infettiv qarrad il-ferita?
messages.zh: 说感染过程使伤口化脓，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the infectious process caused the wound to suppurate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li kkawża l-formazzjoni tal-materja fil-ferita.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li kkawża l-formazzjoni tal-materja fil-ferita.
messages.zh: 意思是它使伤口里形成了脓液。
messages.en: It means that it caused pus to form in the wound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原因→伤口产生脓液”的箭头图记 qarrad；动词强调使其化脓，名词义则联想致脓因素。

gloss_zh: 摩擦皮肤的；容易刮肤的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to rub or scratch against the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易与皮肤摩擦或刮擦、使皮肤感到粗糙不适的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jħokk jew jigrif il-ġilda meta jmiss magħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to scratch against the skin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易刮擦皮肤的；与皮肤接触时有摩擦感的。

collocations.en: a collar that rubs against the skin

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur evita d-drapp qarradi u għażel materjal artab għall-partijiet tal-libsa li jmissu mal-ġilda.
formal.en: The designer avoided fabric that scratches the skin and chose a soft material for the parts of the garment that touch the skin.
formal.zh: 设计师避开了容易刮擦皮肤的布料，为衣服贴肤的部位选择了柔软的材料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex neħħejt il-ġakketta? Maja: Il-kullar qarradi; kull darba li ndur inħossu jħokkli għonqi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you take off your jacket? Maja: The collar scratches my skin; every time I turn, I feel it rubbing against my neck.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么把外套脱了？Maja：衣领磨皮肤；每次转头，我都感觉它在蹭我的脖子。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把外套脱了？
messages.en: Why did you take off your jacket?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kullar qarradi; kull darba li ndur inħossu jħokkli għonqi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kullar qarradi; kull darba li ndur inħossu jħokkli għonqi.
messages.zh: 衣领磨皮肤；每次转头，我都感觉它在蹭我的脖子。
messages.en: The collar scratches my skin; every time I turn, I feel it rubbing against my neck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象粗糙衣领随着转头不断蹭脖子，把 qarradi 和“贴肤却磨皮肤”的触感一起记住。

gloss_zh: 抢先挑走好东西；先取精华

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take the choice pieces or desirable things before others have a chance to get them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 趁别人还没机会拿取时，抢先挑走好的部分或想要的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu l-aħjar biċċiet jew affarijiet qabel ma l-oħrajn ikollhom ċans jeħduhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: to take the pickings before others can get to them
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在别人来得及拿取之前，抢先挑走可取的好东西。

collocations.en: took the best pieces before anyone else could
collocations.zh: 抢先挑走了最好的几块

collocations.en: picked out the choice bits from the plate before others could
collocations.zh: 抢在别人之前从盘里挑走了好吃的部分

formal.mt: Qabel ma waslu l-mistednin l-oħra, wieħed mill-parteċipanti qarraf l-aħjar biċċiet mill-platt tal-ħelu.
formal.en: Before the other guests arrived, one of the participants took the best pieces from the plate of sweets.
formal.zh: 其他客人还没到，一位参加者就从甜点盘里抢先挑走了最好的几块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn marru l-biċċiet biċ-ċikkulata? Mark: Pawlu qarraf l-aħjar biċċiet qabel ma wasalna aħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the chocolate pieces go? Mark: Pawlu picked out the best pieces before we arrived.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那些带巧克力的都去哪儿了？Mark：我们还没到，Pawlu 就把最好的几块挑走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那些带巧克力的都去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the chocolate pieces go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qarraf l-aħjar biċċiet qabel ma wasalna aħna.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qarraf l-aħjar biċċiet qabel ma wasalna aħna.
messages.zh: 我们还没到，Pawlu 就把最好的几块挑走了。
messages.en: Pawlu picked out the best pieces before we arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象甜点盘还没传到大家手里，就有人挑光最好吃的部分；qarraf 的重点是“抢先挑走”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bite repeatedly at something, or to bite off grass while feeding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复用牙齿啃咬某物；也指动物进食时咬下青草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jigdem xi ħaġa ripetutament, jew jaqta' l-ħaxix bi snienu waqt li jiekol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啃；反复啃咬。
啃食青草；用牙齿咬下草来吃。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-fenek qarram biċċa injama, filwaqt li l-ħaruf qarram il-ħaxix ħdejn iċ-ċint.
formal.en: During the observation, the rabbit gnawed a piece of wood, while the lamb cropped the grass beside the fence.
formal.zh: 观察期间，兔子啃咬着一块木头，而小羊在围栏边啃食青草。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm marki fuq l-injama? Mark: Il-fenek qarram dik il-biċċa; ara l-marki żgħar ta' snienu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there marks on the wood? Mark: The rabbit gnawed that piece; look at its little tooth marks.
colloquial.zh: Maja：木头上为什么有痕迹？Mark：兔子啃过那一块；你看那些小牙印。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 木头上为什么有痕迹？
messages.en: Why are there marks on the wood?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fenek qarram dik il-biċċa; ara l-marki żgħar ta' snienu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fenek qarram dik il-biċċa; ara l-marki żgħar ta' snienu.
messages.zh: 兔子啃过那一块；你看那些小牙印。
messages.en: The rabbit gnawed that piece; look at its little tooth marks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qarram 记成两个用牙齿的画面：兔子反复啃木头，小羊一口口咬青草，对应两个动词义。

gloss_zh: 给某人装上角；对伴侣不忠

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put horns on someone, or to be unfaithful to a spouse or partner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人装上角；也指背叛配偶或伴侣，对其不忠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqiegħed qrun fuq xi ħadd, jew li ma jkunx fidil lejn il-konjuġi jew is-sieħeb tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人装上角；使某人带有角。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be unfaithful (to a spouse or partner)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对配偶或伴侣不忠；背叛配偶或伴侣。

collocations.en: put horns on the actor as part of the costume
collocations.zh: 为配合戏服给演员装上了角

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-raġel qarran lil martu, u l-istorja tesplora l-effett ta' dan it-tradiment fuq ir-relazzjoni tagħhom.
formal.en: In the novel, the husband was unfaithful to his wife, and the story explores the effect of this betrayal on their relationship.
formal.zh: 小说中的丈夫对妻子不忠，故事探讨了这次背叛对两人关系的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min qarran lill-attur għall-kostum? Mark: Pawlu; waħħallu żewġ qrun żgħar mal-kappell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who put horns on the actor for the costume? Mark: Pawlu did; he attached two small horns to his hat.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁为配合戏服给演员装上了角？Mark：Pawlu；他在演员的帽子上装了两只小角。

messages.speaker: Maja (剧组同事)
messages.zh: 谁为配合戏服给演员装上了角？
messages.en: Who put horns on the actor for the costume?

messages.speaker: Mark (剧组同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu; waħħallu żewġ qrun żgħar mal-kappell.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu; waħħallu żewġ qrun żgħar mal-kappell.
messages.zh: Pawlu；他在演员的帽子上装了两只小角。
messages.en: Pawlu did; he attached two small horns to his hat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qarran 做两张情境卡：戏服上装角，以及伴侣关系中的不忠；分别记义，靠上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A priest who hears a person's confession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聆听信徒告解的神父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saċerdot li jisma' l-qrar ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 听取信徒告解的神父；听告解司铎。

formal.mt: Wara l-quddiesa, il-qarrar baqa' fil-knisja biex jisma' l-qrar ta' dawk li xtaqu jqerru.
formal.en: After Mass, the confessor remained in the church to hear the confessions of those who wished to confess.
formal.zh: 弥撒结束后，听告解的神父留在教堂里，聆听希望告解者的告解。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qarrar għadu fil-knisja? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn il-konfessjonarju; tista' tkellmu hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the confessor still in the church? Pawlu: Yes, he is beside the confessional; you can speak to him there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：听告解的神父还在教堂里吗？Pawlu：在，他就在告解亭旁边；你可以去那里跟他交谈。

messages.speaker: Maja (教友)
messages.zh: 听告解的神父还在教堂里吗？
messages.en: Is the confessor still in the church?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn il-konfessjonarju; tista' tkellmu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn il-konfessjonarju; tista' tkellmu hemm.
messages.zh: 在，他就在告解亭旁边；你可以去那里跟他交谈。
messages.en: Yes, he is beside the confessional; you can speak to him there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qarrar 放进教堂告解亭的画面，给聆听告解的神父贴上这个词，记住它是表示人物的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to make other things sour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使其他东西变酸的倾向的；强调造成酸化的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel affarijiet oħra qarsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于使东西变酸的。

collocations.en: an ingredient that tends to make things sour
collocations.zh: 容易使东西变酸的配料

formal.mt: Fir-riċetta, dan l-ingredjent għandu effett qarrasi: jagħmel it-taħlita aktar qarsa.
formal.en: In the recipe, this ingredient has a souring effect: it makes the mixture more sour.
formal.zh: 在这份食谱中，这种配料具有使东西变酸的作用：它会让混合物更酸。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex żidt dan l-ingredjent qarrasi? Ben: Biex it-taħlita ssir ftit aktar qarsa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you add this souring ingredient? Ben: To make the mixture a little more sour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么加这种会使东西变酸的配料？本：为了让混合物稍微酸一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么加这种会使东西变酸的配料？
messages.en: Why did you add this souring ingredient?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex it-taħlita ssir ftit aktar qarsa.
messages.mt_standard: Biex it-taħlita ssir ftit aktar qarsa.
messages.zh: 为了让混合物稍微酸一点。
messages.en: To make the mixture a little more sour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一种配料加入碗中，整碗随之变酸；把这个词记成“使别的东西变酸的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a wound that had begun to close or heal to open again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使已经开始闭合或愈合的伤口再次裂开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jerġa' jiftaħ ferita li kienet bdiet tingħalaq jew tfiq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使伤口重新裂开；再次弄开伤口。

collocations.zh: 使一处旧伤口再次裂开了

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ħabat idu mat-tarf tal-mejda u qarraħ il-ferita li kienet bdiet tfiq.
formal.en: The worker struck his hand against the edge of the table and reopened the wound that had begun to heal.
formal.zh: 工人的手撞到桌沿，使已经开始愈合的伤口再次裂开了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara f'idek? Mark: Il-bieb qarraħ il-ferita li kelli; kienet kważi fieqet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to your hand? Mark: The door reopened my wound; it had almost healed.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的手怎么了？Mark：门把我原来的伤口又碰开了；本来都快好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your hand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb qarraħ il-ferita li kelli; kienet kważi fieqet.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb qarraħ il-ferita li kelli; kienet kważi fieqet.
messages.zh: 门把我原来的伤口又碰开了；本来都快好了。
messages.en: The door reopened my wound; it had almost healed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“伤口将要合上→碰撞→再次裂开”的三格图记 qarraħ，牢牢记住其中“重新打开”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone confess or admit what they have done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人招认或坦白自己所做的事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jistqarr dak li għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人招认；促使某人坦白。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-interrogatur qarrer lir-raġel, li fl-aħħar stqarr li kien ħeba l-ittra.
formal.en: In the story, the interrogator made the man confess, and he finally admitted that he had hidden the letter.
formal.zh: 故事中，审问者使那名男子招认了；他终于承认自己藏起了信。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qarrer lil ħuh? Mark: Staqsieh dwar it-tazza miksura sakemm ħuh stqarr li kien kissirha hu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he make his brother confess? Mark: He asked him about the broken cup until his brother admitted that he had broken it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他是怎么让自己的兄弟坦白的？马克：他一直问那只打碎的杯子，直到兄弟承认是自己打碎的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 他是怎么让自己的兄弟坦白的？
messages.en: How did he make his brother confess?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsieh dwar it-tazza miksura sakemm ħuh stqarr li kien kissirha hu.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsieh dwar it-tazza miksura sakemm ħuh stqarr li kien kissirha hu.
messages.zh: 他一直问那只打碎的杯子，直到兄弟承认是自己打碎的。
messages.en: He asked him about the broken cup until his brother admitted that he had broken it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个人的画面：一个人促使，另一个人坦白；这个动词把重点放在“使人招认”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gives someone else a crew cut.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 替别人把头发剪成短平头的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqta' x-xagħar ta' ħaddieħor qasir ħafna u qrib ir-ras.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who gives another a crew cut
sense_translations.zh_definition: 替别人理短平头的人。

collocations.zh: 手艺熟练的平头理发师

collocations.en: go to the barber for a crew cut

formal.mt: Il-qarriegħ qata' x-xagħar tal-klijent qasir ħafna u ħadem b'attenzjoni madwar il-widnejn.
formal.en: The crew-cut barber cut the customer's hair very short and worked carefully around the ears.
formal.zh: 替人理平头的理发师把顾客的头发剪得很短，并仔细修剪了耳朵周围。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għand min mort biex taqta' xagħrek daqshekk qasir? Toni: Għand il-qarriegħ ta' ħdejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Who did you go to for such a short haircut? Toni: The crew-cut barber near my house.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你找谁把头发剪得这么短？托尼：找我家附近那位替人理平头的理发师。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għand min mort biex taqta' xagħrek daqshekk qasir?
messages.mt_standard: Għand min mort biex taqta' xagħrek daqshekk qasir?
messages.zh: 你找谁把头发剪得这么短？
messages.en: Who did you go to for such a short haircut?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 找我家附近那位替人理平头的理发师。
messages.en: The crew-cut barber near my house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象理发椅旁站着一位专门剪短平头的人；这个名词指的是替别人剪头发的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to cause baldness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使人秃头或导致秃发的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jikkawża l-kalvizja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易引起秃头的；具有导致秃发倾向的。

collocations.en: an effect tending to cause baldness
a product tending to cause baldness

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-prodott ġie deskritt bħala qarriegħi għax seta' jikkawża l-kalvizja.
formal.en: In the story, the product was described as tending to cause baldness because it could make people bald.
formal.zh: 故事中，这种产品被描述为容易导致秃头，因为它可能使人变秃。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-prodott fl-istorja jissejjaħ qarriegħi? Leo: Għax jista' jġiegħel lin-nies jitilfu xagħarhom u jsiru qargħin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is the product in the story called baldness-causing? Leo: Because it can make people lose their hair and become bald.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么故事里的产品被说成容易导致秃头？利奥：因为它可能使人掉头发，最后变秃。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 为什么故事里的产品被说成容易导致秃头？
messages.en: Why is the product in the story called baldness-causing?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jista' jġiegħel lin-nies jitilfu xagħarhom u jsiru qargħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jista' jġiegħel lin-nies jitilfu xagħarhom u jsiru qargħin.
messages.zh: 因为它可能使人掉头发，最后变秃。
messages.en: Because it can make people lose their hair and become bald.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用虚构故事记忆：人物用了某种东西后逐渐变秃；这个形容词描述“容易造成秃头”的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A creature or thing that gnaws; also, a rodent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行啃咬的动物或东西；也可指啮齿动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal jew ħaġa li tgerrem; jista' jfisser ukoll annimal bħal ġurdien jew far.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会啃咬的东西或动物。
啮齿动物。

formal.mt: Il-qarriem ħalla marki tas-snien fuq il-kaxxa tal-injam.
formal.en: The rodent left tooth marks on the wooden box.
formal.zh: 那只啮齿动物在木箱上留下了齿痕。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu dak il-qarriem ħdejn il-borża? Rita: Ġurdien żgħir; ara kif qed igerrem il-kartun.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's that rodent beside the bag? Rita: A little mouse; look how it's gnawing the cardboard.
colloquial.zh: 马克：袋子旁边那只啮齿动物是什么？丽塔：一只小老鼠；你看它正在啃纸板。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 袋子旁边那只啮齿动物是什么？
messages.en: What's that rodent beside the bag?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġurdien żgħir; ara kif qed igerrem il-kartun.
messages.mt_standard: Ġurdien żgħir; ara kif qed igerrem il-kartun.
messages.zh: 一只小老鼠；你看它正在啃纸板。
messages.en: A little mouse; look how it's gnawing the cardboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把纸板上的一排小齿痕与旁边的老鼠连起来：既记住“啃咬者”，也记住“啮齿动物”。

gloss_zh: 爱啃咬的；有啃咬倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to gnaw, as a rodent does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像啮齿动物那样具有啃咬倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jgerrem, bħalma jagħmel ġurdien jew far.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to gnaw, like a rodent
sense_translations.zh_definition: 像啮齿动物一样容易啃咬东西的。

collocations.en: an animal that tends to gnaw
a mouse that tends to gnaw

formal.mt: L-annimal qarriemi ħalla marki tas-snien mat-tarf tal-kaxxa.
formal.en: The animal that tended to gnaw left tooth marks along the edge of the box.
formal.zh: 那只爱啃咬东西的动物在箱子边缘留下了齿痕。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ġurdien qarriemi reġa' gerrimha l-kaxxa? Ben: Iva, ara l-marki tas-snien fuq it-tarf.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has this gnawing mouse chewed the box again? Ben: Yes, look at the tooth marks on the edge.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这只爱啃东西的老鼠又啃箱子了吗？本：是啊，你看边缘上的齿痕。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ġurdien qarriemi reġa' gerrimha l-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ġurdien qarriemi reġa' gerrimha l-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 这只爱啃东西的老鼠又啃箱子了吗？
messages.en: Has this gnawing mouse chewed the box again?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-marki tas-snien fuq it-tarf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-marki tas-snien fuq it-tarf.
messages.zh: 是啊，你看边缘上的齿痕。
messages.en: Yes, look at the tooth marks on the edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只老鼠见到纸板就开始啃；这个形容词描述的是它“总爱啃咬”的习性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing irritation to a wound, for example by rubbing against it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会刺激伤口的，例如因摩擦伤口而引起不适的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirrita ferita, pereżempju billi jogħrok magħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that causes irritation of a wound (e.g. by rubbing against it)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 会刺激伤口的东西，例如通过摩擦伤口而造成刺激的东西。

formal.mt: Drapp qarrieħ jista' jirrita ferita meta jogħrok magħha.
formal.en: Wound-irritating fabric can irritate a wound when it rubs against it.
formal.zh: 会刺激伤口的布料与伤口摩擦时，可能引起刺激。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan id-drapp qarrieħ qed jirrita l-ferita tiegħi. Maja: Dak l-ieħor jidher aktar artab.
colloquial.en: Sara: This wound-irritating fabric is irritating my wound. Maja: That other one looks softer.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块会刺激伤口的布料正磨得我的伤口不舒服。玛雅：另外那块看起来更柔软。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp qarrieħ qed jirrita l-ferita tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp qarrieħ qed jirrita l-ferita tiegħi.
messages.zh: 这块会刺激伤口的布料正磨得我的伤口不舒服。
messages.en: This wound-irritating fabric is irritating my wound.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 另外那块看起来更柔软。
messages.en: That other one looks softer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象粗布来回蹭到伤口，伤口因此受到刺激；把这个词与“摩擦伤口引起不适”的画面相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pricking with a sharp point, or the sensation this produces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尖物刺扎的动作，或由此产生的针刺感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' titqib b'ponta fina, jew is-sensazzjoni li tħalli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺扎；针刺般的感觉。

formal.mt: Il-qars tal-labra kien ħafif u dam biss mument.
formal.en: The prick of the needle was slight and lasted only a moment.
formal.zh: 针扎的感觉很轻，只持续了片刻。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'ħassejt meta messitek il-labra? Marta: Qars ħafif f'subgħajja, għal mument biss.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What did you feel when the needle touched you? Marta: A slight prick in my finger, just for a moment.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：针碰到你时，你有什么感觉？玛尔塔：手指轻轻刺了一下，就一瞬间。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 针碰到你时，你有什么感觉？
messages.en: What did you feel when the needle touched you?

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qars ħafif f'subgħajja, għal mument biss.
messages.mt_standard: Qars ħafif f'subgħajja, għal mument biss.
messages.zh: 手指轻轻刺了一下，就一瞬间。
messages.en: A slight prick in my finger, just for a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象针尖轻碰手指时那一下短促的刺感；本词条用“针尖刺一下”的触觉画面来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cape sorrel, an Oxalis plant also known in Maltese as ħaxixa Ingliża.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种酢浆草属植物，英语称 cape sorrel，马耳他语也称 ħaxixa Ingliża。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ġeneru Oxalis, magħrufa wkoll bħala ħaxixa Ingliża.

sense_translations.en_definition: (botany) also ħaxixa Ingliża, cape sorrel (Oxalis pescaprae, O. cernua)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （植物学）黄花酢浆草，也称 ħaxixa Ingliża（Oxalis pescaprae、O. cernua）。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport dwar il-pjanti tal-ġnien, il-qarsu jissemma wkoll bl-isem ħaxixa Ingliża.
formal.en: In the report on the garden's plants, cape sorrel is also mentioned by the name ħaxixa Ingliża.
formal.zh: 在关于花园植物的报告中，黄花酢浆草也以 ħaxixa Ingliża 这个名称出现。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Toni: Din qarsu. Forsi tafha bħala ħaxixa Ingliża.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this plant called? Toni: It's cape sorrel. You may know it as ħaxixa Ingliża.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是什么植物？托尼：这是黄花酢浆草。你可能听过它的另一个名字 ħaxixa Ingliża。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是什么植物？
messages.en: What's this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din qarsu. Forsi tafha bħala ħaxixa Ingliża.
messages.mt_standard: Din qarsu. Forsi tafha bħala ħaxixa Ingliża.
messages.zh: 这是黄花酢浆草。你可能听过它的另一个名字 ħaxixa Ingliża。
messages.en: It's cape sorrel. You may know it as ħaxixa Ingliża.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qarsu 写在黄花酢浆草的图片旁，再并列写上 ħaxixa Ingliża，记住两个名称指同一种植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shear or trim plants or shrubs by cutting back their growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剪去植物或灌木的一部分枝叶，对其进行修剪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' u jqassar il-friegħi jew il-weraq ta' pjanti jew arbuxxelli.

sense_translations.en_definition: to shear (used of plants or shrubs)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 剪修；修剪，指植物或灌木。

collocations.zh: 他修剪了花园里的植物

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar qartam l-arbuxxelli tul il-mogħdija biex iżommha ħielsa mill-friegħi.
formal.en: The gardener trimmed the shrubs along the path to keep it clear of branches.
formal.zh: 园丁修剪了小路两旁的灌木，使枝条不再挡住道路。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min qartam l-arbuxxelli? Paul: Il-ġardinar qartam dawn dalgħodu. Issa nistgħu ngħaddu aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who trimmed the shrubs? Paul: The gardener trimmed these this morning. We can get through more easily now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁修剪了这些灌木？保罗：园丁今天早上剪的。现在我们走过去方便多了。

messages.speaker: Marta (住户)
messages.zh: 谁修剪了这些灌木？
messages.en: Who trimmed the shrubs?

messages.speaker: Paul (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġardinar qartam dawn dalgħodu. Issa nistgħu ngħaddu aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġardinar qartam dawn dalgħodu. Issa nistgħu ngħaddu aħjar.
messages.zh: 园丁今天早上剪的。现在我们走过去方便多了。
messages.en: The gardener trimmed these this morning. We can get through more easily now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 qartam 就想象园丁拿剪刀修整灌木，把这个动词与植物枝叶的修剪动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who cuts hair very short.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人剪短发、把头发剪得很短的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqta' x-xagħar qasir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把头发剪得很短的人。

collocations.en: a skilled person who crops hair short
at the place of the person who crops hair short

formal.mt: Il-kelma qarwież tindika persuna li taqta' x-xagħar qasir ħafna.
formal.en: The word qarwież denotes a person who cuts hair very short.
formal.zh: qarwież 一词指把头发剪得很短的人。

colloquial.mt: Lia: Qed infittex qarwież; irrid xagħri qasir ħafna. Mark: Staqsi lil Pawlu. Hu qarwież tas-sengħa.
colloquial.en: Lia: I'm looking for someone who crops hair short; I want my hair very short. Mark: Ask Pawlu. He's skilled at cutting hair very short.
colloquial.zh: 莉娅：我在找会剪短发的人，我想把头发剪得很短。马克：问问保罗吧。他很擅长剪这种短发。

messages.speaker: Lia (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex qarwież; irrid xagħri qasir ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex qarwież; irrid xagħri qasir ħafna.
messages.zh: 我在找会剪短发的人，我想把头发剪得很短。
messages.en: I'm looking for someone who crops hair short; I want my hair very short.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Pawlu. Hu qarwież tas-sengħa.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Pawlu. Hu qarwież tas-sengħa.
messages.zh: 问问保罗吧。他很擅长剪这种短发。
messages.en: Ask Pawlu. He's skilled at cutting hair very short.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅理发场景记 qarwież：重点看拿剪刀、把头发剪短的那个人，记住它是人物名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To comb one's own hair to arrange it or remove tangles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用梳子整理自己的头发，使头发整齐或解开打结的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadda moxt minn xagħru biex jirranġah jew ineħħi l-għoqiedi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳理自己的头发。

collocations.en: combed his hair in front of the mirror

formal.mt: Qabel l-intervista, Daniel qarċel xagħru quddiem il-mera biex jidher pulit.
formal.en: Before the interview, Daniel combed his hair in front of the mirror to look neat.
formal.zh: 面试前，丹尼尔在镜子前梳理头发，让自己看起来整洁。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Daniel lest biex noħorġu? Rita: Iva, qarċel xagħru u issa qed jilbes iż-żarbun.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is Daniel ready for us to go out? Rita: Yes, he combed his hair and is putting on his shoes now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：丹尼尔准备好一起出门了吗？丽塔：好了，他梳完头了，现在正在穿鞋。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 丹尼尔准备好一起出门了吗？
messages.en: Is Daniel ready for us to go out?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qarċel xagħru u issa qed jilbes iż-żarbun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qarċel xagħru u issa qed jilbes iż-żarbun.
messages.zh: 好了，他梳完头了，现在正在穿鞋。
messages.en: Yes, he combed his hair and is putting on his shoes now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进出门前的动作顺序：照镜子、拿梳子、梳好自己的头发，再穿鞋出门。

gloss_zh: 以新郎新娘为主角的传统狂欢节押韵戏剧表演

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional Carnival performance, typically a play in rhyming verse with a bride and groom as its main characters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种传统狂欢节表演，通常采用押韵诗体戏剧的形式，以新娘和新郎为主要角色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wirja tradizzjonali tal-Karnival, ġeneralment reċta bil-versi bir-rima, bl-għarusa u l-għarus bħala l-karattri ewlenin.

sense_translations.en_definition: A traditional Carnival performance, usually featuring a play in rhyming verse with a bride and groom as the principal characters
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种传统狂欢节表演，通常包含以新娘和新郎为主角、用押韵诗句演出的戏剧。

collocations.en: take part in the traditional Carnival verse play
collocations.zh: 参加传统狂欢节押韵戏剧表演

formal.mt: Fil-qarċilla tal-Karnival, l-għarusa u l-għarus huma l-karattri ewlenin ta' reċta bil-versi bir-rima.
formal.en: In the traditional Carnival performance known as the qarċilla, the bride and groom are the main characters in a play written in rhyming verse.
formal.zh: 在名为 qarċilla 的传统狂欢节表演中，新娘和新郎是押韵诗体戏剧的主要角色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se naraw fil-Karnival? Toni: Il-qarċilla! Hi reċta bil-versi bir-rima, bl-għarusa u l-għarus.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are we going to watch at Carnival? Toni: The qarċilla! It's a play in rhyming verse with a bride and groom.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：狂欢节我们要看什么？托尼：看 qarċilla！就是有新娘和新郎出场的押韵诗体戏剧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 狂欢节我们要看什么？
messages.en: What are we going to watch at Carnival?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qarċilla! Hi reċta bil-versi bir-rima, bl-għarusa u l-għarus.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qarċilla! Hi reċta bil-versi bir-rima, bl-għarusa u l-għarus.
messages.zh: 看 qarċilla！就是有新娘和新郎出场的押韵诗体戏剧。
messages.en: The qarċilla! It's a play in rhyming verse with a bride and groom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个提示组成舞台画面：狂欢节、新郎新娘、押韵台词；一起记住这种传统表演。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To buff or burnish metal, making its surface smooth and shiny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打磨、擦亮金属，使其表面光滑而有光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jillustra jew jogħrok il-metall biex il-wiċċ tiegħu jsir lixx u jleqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抛光；擦亮，指金属。
磨光；把表面打磨得光亮。
从事磨光或抛光的人；抛光工。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan qasdar il-wiċċ tal-metall sakemm sar lixx u jleqq.
formal.en: The craftsperson burnished the metal surface until it became smooth and shiny.
formal.zh: 工匠打磨了金属表面，直到它变得光滑而有光泽。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min qasdar dan il-metall? Jidher ġdid! Ġanni: Il-qasdar tal-ħanut. Għamel xogħol tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who polished this metal? It looks new! Ġanni: The shop's polisher. He did a very good job.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把这块金属抛光了？看起来像新的一样！詹尼：店里的抛光工。他做得很好。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min qasdar dan il-metall? Jidher ġdid!
messages.mt_standard: Min qasdar dan il-metall? Jidher ġdid!
messages.zh: 谁把这块金属抛光了？看起来像新的一样！
messages.en: Who polished this metal? It looks new!

messages.speaker: Ġanni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qasdar tal-ħanut. Għamel xogħol tajjeb ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qasdar tal-ħanut. Għamel xogħol tajjeb ħafna.
messages.zh: 店里的抛光工。他做得很好。
messages.en: The shop's polisher. He did a very good job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qasdar 配两张学习卡：一张画抛光动作，一张画抛光工；同形词要结合句子判断动词或名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of burnishing metal to make its surface smooth and shiny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将金属表面打磨得光滑、明亮的加工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-wiċċ tal-metall jiġi llustrat biex isir lixx u jleqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金属的磨光或抛光。

formal.mt: Il-qasdir tal-metall sar bir-reqqa biex il-wiċċ ikun lixx u jleqq.
formal.en: The metal was carefully burnished to give it a smooth, shiny surface.
formal.zh: 金属经过细致的磨光处理，表面变得光滑而有光泽。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan il-metall ileqq daqshekk? Karl: Minħabba l-qasdir. Ħares kemm sar lixx il-wiċċ!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is this metal so shiny? Karl: Because of the burnishing. Look how smooth the surface has become!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这块金属怎么这么亮？卡尔：因为做了磨光处理。看看表面变得多光滑！

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 这块金属怎么这么亮？
messages.en: Why is this metal so shiny?

messages.speaker: Karl (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-qasdir. Ħares kemm sar lixx il-wiċċ!
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-qasdir. Ħares kemm sar lixx il-wiċċ!
messages.zh: 因为做了磨光处理。看看表面变得多光滑！
messages.en: Because of the burnishing. Look how smooth the surface has become!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qasdir 标在金属从粗糙变光亮的过程箭头上，提醒自己这里说的是磨光过程这个名词。

gloss_zh: 爱说闲话的；爱散布恶意谣言的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to gossip about others or spread malicious rumours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人爱议论他人私事，或容易散布恶意谣言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb iqassas fuq ħaddieħor jew ixerred xnigħat malizzjużi.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to gossip or spread nasty rumours
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱说闲话的；倾向于散布恶意谣言的。

collocations.en: a man who is prone to gossip

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar qasqasi jxerred xnigħat dwar il-familji tat-triq.
formal.en: In the story, the gossip-prone neighbour spreads rumours about the families on the street.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个爱说闲话的邻居散布有关街坊各家的谣言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tgħid lil dak il-ġar? Ben: Le, hu qasqasi wisq. Ma rridx li kulħadd ikun jaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to tell that neighbour? Ben: No, he's too prone to gossip. I don't want everyone to know.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：你要告诉那个邻居吗？本：不，他太爱说闲话了。我不想让所有人都知道。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要告诉那个邻居吗？
messages.en: Are you going to tell that neighbour?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu qasqasi wisq. Ma rridx li kulħadd ikun jaf.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu qasqasi wisq. Ma rridx li kulħadd ikun jaf.
messages.zh: 不，他太爱说闲话了。我不想让所有人都知道。
messages.en: No, he's too prone to gossip. I don't want everyone to know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qasqasi 放进“这个人太爱传闲话”的场景中记忆：它描述人的习性，带有负面评价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quarterdeck, an area of a ship's upper deck towards the stern.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船只上层甲板靠近船尾的区域，称为后甲板或船尾上甲板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-gverta ta' fuq ta' bastiment li tinsab lejn il-poppa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 后甲板；船尾上甲板。

formal.mt: Il-kaptan talab lill-ekwipaġġ jinġabar fuq il-qasru qabel it-tluq.
formal.en: The captain asked the crew to assemble on the quarterdeck before departure.
formal.zh: 船长要求船员在启航前到后甲板集合。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se niltaqgħu mal-kaptan? Luqa: Fuq il-qasru, lejn in-naħa ta' wara tal-bastiment.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are we meeting the captain? Luqa: On the quarterdeck, towards the back of the ship.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们在哪里见船长？卢卡：在后甲板，靠近船尾的地方。

messages.speaker: Anna (新船员)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见船长？
messages.en: Where are we meeting the captain?

messages.speaker: Luqa (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-qasru, lejn in-naħa ta' wara tal-bastiment.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-qasru, lejn in-naħa ta' wara tal-bastiment.
messages.zh: 在后甲板，靠近船尾的地方。
messages.en: On the quarterdeck, towards the back of the ship.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在船的侧面示意图上圈出上层甲板靠船尾的区域，标上 qasru，再想象船员在那里集合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The poop deck, a raised deck over the stern section of a ship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于船尾艉楼顶部的高起甲板，称为艉楼甲板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gverta għolja fuq il-parti tal-poppa ta' bastiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 艉楼甲板，即船尾艉楼顶部的甲板。

collocations.en: to go up onto the poop deck

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-bastiment juri t-taraġ li jwassal għall-qasru tal-poppa.
formal.en: The ship's plan shows the stairs leading to the poop deck.
formal.zh: 船只的平面图标出了通往艉楼甲板的楼梯。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif nitilgħu fuq il-qasru tal-poppa? Samwel: Minn dan it-taraġ. Ejja, nurik.
colloquial.en: Rita: How do we get up onto the poop deck? Samwel: By these stairs. Come on, I'll show you.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们怎么登上艉楼甲板？萨姆韦尔：走这段楼梯。来，我带你看。

messages.speaker: Rita (参观者)
messages.zh: 我们怎么登上艉楼甲板？
messages.en: How do we get up onto the poop deck?

messages.speaker: Samwel (导览员)
messages.zh: 走这段楼梯。来，我带你看。
messages.en: By these stairs. Come on, I'll show you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qasru tal-poppa 整组写在船尾艉楼顶部的甲板旁，用“走楼梯登上艉楼甲板”的画面记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To snip something with scissors or shear the wool from an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用剪刀剪断或剪去某物，也可指给动物剪毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' xi ħaġa bl-imqass jew ineħħi s-suf minn fuq annimal billi jaqtgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用剪刀剪断或剪去一小部分。
给羊等动物剪毛。

collocations.en: snipped the edge of the paper

formal.mt: Il-bidwi qass in-nagħaġ u ġabar is-suf f'boroż.
formal.en: The farmer sheared the sheep and collected the wool in bags.
formal.zh: 农民给羊剪了毛，并把羊毛收进袋子里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex din il-karta iqsar mill-oħra? Mark: Ħija qass it-tarf tagħha biex tidħol fil-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this sheet of paper shorter than the other one? Mark: My brother snipped its edge so it would fit in the box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张纸为什么比另一张短？马克：我哥哥剪去了它的边缘，好让它放进盒子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张纸为什么比另一张短？
messages.en: Why is this sheet of paper shorter than the other one?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija qass it-tarf tagħha biex tidħol fil-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija qass it-tarf tagħha biex tidħol fil-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 我哥哥剪去了它的边缘，好让它放进盒子里。
messages.en: My brother snipped its edge so it would fit in the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把剪纸和剪羊毛两幅画面并排记忆：对象虽然不同，核心都是用剪刀剪去一部分。

gloss_zh: 用芦苇或支架固定伤肢；筑篱笆；打桩或安装篱笆的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support a fractured limb with a reed or another support, or to build a fence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用芦苇或其他支撑物固定骨折的肢体；也指建造篱笆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaħħal qasba jew appoġġ ieħor ma' riġel jew driegħ miksur biex iżommu sod, jew jibni ċint.

sense_translations.en_definition: to dress a fractured limb with a reed or support
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用芦苇或其他支撑物包扎、固定骨折的肢体。
建造或架设篱笆。
把桩打入地里的人；打桩者。
安装篱笆的人。

collocations.en: secured the fractured arm with a support
collocations.zh: 用支撑物固定了骨折的手臂

collocations.en: put up a fence around the field
collocations.zh: 在田地周围架起了篱笆

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem qassab l-għalqa biex l-annimali ma jidħlux fiha.
formal.en: The worker put up a fence around the field to keep animals out.
formal.zh: 工人在田地周围架起篱笆，防止动物进入。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min qassab l-għalqa? Pawlu: Ħija. Issa l-mogħoż ma jistgħux jidħlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who fenced the field? Pawlu: My brother. Now the goats cannot get in.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：谁给田地围上了篱笆？保罗：我哥哥。现在山羊进不去了。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁给田地围上了篱笆？
messages.en: Who fenced the field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (田地主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. Issa l-mogħoż ma jistgħux jidħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. Issa l-mogħoż ma jistgħux jidħlu.
messages.zh: 我哥哥。现在山羊进不去了。
messages.en: My brother. Now the goats cannot get in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情境卡记忆动词：伤肢旁放支撑物，田地旁立篱笆；名词另记为打桩者或篱笆安装者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many reeds or being characterized by reed growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容地方长有许多芦苇，具有芦苇丛生的特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna qasab jew li fih jikber ħafna qasab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多芦苇的；芦苇丛生的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi wied qassabi fejn ibejtu diversi għasafar.
formal.en: The report describes a reedy valley where various birds nest.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一处芦苇丛生的山谷，多种鸟类在那里筑巢。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif kien il-wied li żort? Toni: Kien qassabi, b'ħafna qasab ħdejn l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was the valley you visited like? Toni: It was reedy, with lots of reeds beside the water.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你去的那个山谷是什么样的？托尼：那里芦苇丛生，水边长着很多芦苇。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你去的那个山谷是什么样的？
messages.en: What was the valley you visited like?

messages.speaker: Toni (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qassabi, b'ħafna qasab ħdejn l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qassabi, b'ħafna qasab ħdejn l-ilma.
messages.zh: 那里芦苇丛生，水边长着很多芦苇。
messages.en: It was reedy, with lots of reeds beside the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张水边山谷的照片，画面里到处都是芦苇；用这个词给整片多芦苇的景色贴标签。

gloss_zh: 倾向于分发的；惯于分配的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to distribute things or divide them among people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人倾向于把东西分发出去，或分配给不同的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jqassam affarijiet bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有分发或分配事物的倾向的。

collocations.en: a person inclined to distribute things
collocations.zh: 惯于把东西分发给别人的人

collocations.en: a disposition inclined toward distributing things
collocations.zh: 倾向于分发东西的性格

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-protagonist bħala bniedem qassami li spiss iqassam l-ikel fost il-ġirien.
formal.en: The author describes the protagonist as someone inclined to distribute things, who often hands out food among the neighbours.
formal.zh: 作者把主人公描写成一个惯于分发东西的人，他经常把食物分给邻居。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tiddeskrivi lil Pawlu? Rita: Hu qassami; meta jkollu l-frott, iqassmu mal-ġirien.
colloquial.en: Maja: How would you describe Pawlu? Rita: He is inclined to distribute things; when he has fruit, he shares it out among the neighbours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会怎样形容保罗？丽塔：他惯于把东西分给别人；有水果时，他会分给邻居。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会怎样形容保罗？
messages.en: How would you describe Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu qassami; meta jkollu l-frott, iqassmu mal-ġirien.
messages.mt_standard: Hu qassami; meta jkollu l-frott, iqassmu mal-ġirien.
messages.zh: 他惯于把东西分给别人；有水果时，他会分给邻居。
messages.en: He is inclined to distribute things; when he has fruit, he shares it out among the neighbours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人每次拿到一篮水果，都习惯分成几份递给大家；把这个词记作描述分发倾向的形容词。

gloss_zh: 倾向于缩写的；惯于缩短表达的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to abbreviate words or shorten expressions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或表达风格倾向于使用缩写，或把表达缩短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jqassar il-kliem jew l-espressjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于缩写词语或缩短表达的。

collocations.zh: 倾向于使用缩写的作者

formal.mt: L-istudent juża stil qassari fin-noti tiegħu, b'ħafna kliem imqassar.
formal.en: The student uses an abbreviation-prone style in his notes, with many shortened words.
formal.zh: 这名学生的笔记风格偏好缩写，其中许多词都用了缩略形式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm tant kliem imqassar fin-noti tiegħek? Mark: Għandi stil qassari meta nikteb malajr.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are there so many abbreviated words in your notes? Mark: I tend to use abbreviations when I write quickly.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你的笔记里为什么有这么多缩写词？马克：我写得快的时候，习惯用缩写。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant kliem imqassar fin-noti tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant kliem imqassar fin-noti tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的笔记里为什么有这么多缩写词？
messages.en: Why are there so many abbreviated words in your notes?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi stil qassari meta nikteb malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi stil qassari meta nikteb malajr.
messages.zh: 我写得快的时候，习惯用缩写。
messages.en: I tend to use abbreviations when I write quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象做课堂笔记时总把长词写成缩写；用这个反复出现的习惯，记住它表示倾向于缩短表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut or snip with scissors; also, to gossip about other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用剪刀剪切或剪去一小部分；也可指议论别人、说闲话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' jew iqassar xi ħaġa bl-imqass; ukoll, jitkellem fuq ħaddieħor u jgħid it-tpaċpiċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用剪刀剪切。
用剪刀剪断或剪去一小部分。
说闲话；议论别人的私事。

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-arti, l-istudent qassas il-karta bl-imqass u waħħal il-biċċiet fuq kartun.
formal.en: For the art project, the student cut the paper with scissors and stuck the pieces onto cardboard.
formal.zh: 为了完成美术作业，学生用剪刀剪了纸，再把纸片贴在硬纸板上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel Toni waqt il-waqfa? Maja: Qassas fuq il-ġirien, u jien biddilt is-suġġett.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Toni do during the break? Maja: He gossiped about the neighbours, and I changed the subject.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：托尼休息时做了什么？玛雅：他说了邻居的闲话，我就换了个话题。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 托尼休息时做了什么？
messages.en: What did Toni do during the break?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qassas fuq il-ġirien, u jien biddilt is-suġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Qassas fuq il-ġirien, u jien biddilt is-suġġett.
messages.zh: 他说了邻居的闲话，我就换了个话题。
messages.en: He gossiped about the neighbours, and I changed the subject.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别画剪纸的手和聊天的嘴两张卡片，提醒自己这个词既可表示剪切，也可表示说闲话。

gloss_zh: 把事情弄得一团糟的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes a mess of things or leaves things in disorder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事情弄糟，或把东西弄得杂乱无章的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħawwad l-affarijiet jew tħallihom f'diżordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把事情或环境弄得一团糟的人。

collocations.en: someone who makes a mess in the kitchen
collocations.zh: 在厨房里弄得一团糟的人

collocations.en: someone who makes a mess of the work
collocations.zh: 把工作弄得一团糟的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qassati jħalli l-għodod mal-art u jħallat id-dokumenti.
formal.en: In the story, the person who makes a mess leaves tools on the floor and mixes up the documents.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个把事情弄得一团糟的人把工具丢在地上，还把文件弄混了。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Min ħalla din il-kċina hekk? Ben: Jien il-qassati llum! Issa nnaddaf kollox.
colloquial.en: Mum: Who left the kitchen like this? Ben: I am the one making a mess today! I will clean everything up now.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：谁把厨房弄成这样了？本：今天我就是那个把东西弄得一团糟的人！我现在就全部收拾好。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁把厨房弄成这样了？
messages.en: Who left the kitchen like this?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien il-qassati llum! Issa nnaddaf kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Jien il-qassati llum! Issa nnaddaf kollox.
messages.zh: 今天我就是那个把东西弄得一团糟的人！我现在就全部收拾好。
messages.en: I am the one making a mess today! I will clean everything up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房里锅碗乱放、面粉洒满桌面，再把词卡贴在造成混乱的人身上，记住这里说的是人。

gloss_zh: 使成为神父；授予司铎圣职

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone a priest by ordaining them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过授予司铎圣职，使某人成为神父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd qassis billi jagħtih l-ordinazzjoni saċerdotali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人成为神父；授予某人司铎圣职。

collocations.en: ordained the candidate as a priest
the bishop ordained Pawlu as a priest
collocations.zh: 主教授予了保罗司铎圣职

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja fil-katidral, l-isqof qasses lill-kandidat quddiem il-kongregazzjoni.
formal.en: During the ceremony in the cathedral, the bishop ordained the candidate as a priest before the congregation.
formal.zh: 在主教座堂举行的仪式上，主教在会众面前授予候选人司铎圣职。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Pawlu sar qassis? Mark: Iva, l-isqof qasses lil Pawlu lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has Pawlu become a priest? Mark: Yes, the bishop ordained Pawlu yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗成为神父了吗？马克：是的，主教昨天授予了保罗司铎圣职。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗成为神父了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu become a priest?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-isqof qasses lil Pawlu lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-isqof qasses lil Pawlu lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 是的，主教昨天授予了保罗司铎圣职。
messages.en: Yes, the bishop ordained Pawlu yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主教主持授职仪式，候选人在仪式中成为神父；把这个词记为使人成为神父的动作。

gloss_zh: 爱说闲话的人；剪碎东西的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gossips, or a person who snips material into small pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指爱议论他人、传播闲话的人；也可指用剪刀剪切小块材料的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqassas fuq ħaddieħor, jew persuna li taqta' materjal f'biċċiet żgħar bl-imqass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱说闲话、议论他人私事的人。
用剪刀剪切、剪碎东西的人。

collocations.zh: 传播传言的闲话制造者

formal.mt: Il-qassies ixerred stejjer dwar ħaddieħor mingħajr ma jiċċekkja jekk humiex veri.
formal.en: The gossip spreads stories about other people without checking whether they are true.
formal.zh: 这个爱说闲话的人不核实真假，就传播关于他人的故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx tgħidlu? Pawlu: Għax hu qassies; kulma ngħidlu jgħidu lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to tell him? Pawlu: Because he's a gossip; he tells everyone everything I tell him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不想告诉他？保罗：因为他爱传闲话；我告诉他的事，他都会告诉所有人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想告诉他？
messages.en: Why don't you want to tell him?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu qassies; kulma ngħidlu jgħidu lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu qassies; kulma ngħidlu jgħidu lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他爱传闲话；我告诉他的事，他都会告诉所有人。
messages.en: Because he's a gossip; he tells everyone everything I tell him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记两个义项：一个人在传闲话，另一个人在剪纸；看到 qassies 时根据上下文判断是哪一种人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A priest who holds the highest religious office among a group of priests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一群祭司中担任最高宗教职务的人，称为大祭司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qassis li jkollu l-ogħla kariga reliġjuża fost grupp ta' qassisin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大祭司；在有关宗教体系中地位最高的祭司。

collocations.en: the role of the high priest
the appointment of the high priest

formal.mt: It-test jispjega r-rwol tal-qassis il-kbir fiċ-ċerimonja reliġjuża.
formal.en: The text explains the role of the high priest in the religious ceremony.
formal.zh: 这篇文章说明了大祭司在宗教仪式中的职责。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dan ir-raġel fl-istampa? Mark: Hu l-qassis il-kbir; it-test taħt l-istampa jispjega r-rwol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is this man in the picture? Mark: He's the high priest; the text below the picture explains his role.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：图片里的这个人是谁？马克：他是大祭司；图片下面的文字说明了他的职责。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 图片里的这个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is this man in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-qassis il-kbir; it-test taħt l-istampa jispjega r-rwol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-qassis il-kbir; it-test taħt l-istampa jispjega r-rwol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他是大祭司；图片下面的文字说明了他的职责。
messages.en: He's the high priest; the text below the picture explains his role.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与宗教仪式中主持事务的大祭司联系起来；加上定冠词时，可连同 il-qassis il-kbir 一起练习。

gloss_zh: 串在绳上的珠串，通常指念珠串

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement of beads threaded on a cord, usually referring to the beads of a rosary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将珠子依次穿在绳上形成的珠串，通常指玫瑰经念珠的串列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' żibeġ midmum fuq ħajta jew korda, normalment b'rabta mar-rużarju.

sense_translations.en_definition: arrangement of beads on a cord (usually referring to the rosary)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 珠子在绳上串成的排列或珠串，通常用于指玫瑰经念珠。

formal.mt: Il-qasta tar-rużarju tqiegħdet f'kaxxa żgħira biex iż-żibeġ u l-ħajta ma ssirilhomx ħsara.
formal.en: The string of rosary beads was placed in a small box to protect the beads and the thread from damage.
formal.zh: 这串玫瑰经念珠被放进一个小盒子，以免珠子和串线受损。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt il-qasta tar-rużarju? Rita: Fil-kaxxa ż-żgħira ħdejn is-sodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the string of rosary beads? Rita: In the little box beside the bed.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你把那串玫瑰经念珠放在哪里了？丽塔：放在床边的小盒子里了。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 你把那串玫瑰经念珠放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the string of rosary beads?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 放在床边的小盒子里了。
messages.en: In the little box beside the bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根绳把许多小珠子依次串起，用整串念珠的画面记 qasta，重点是珠子的串列而非单颗珠子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chestnuts, the edible nuts used as food, for example after roasting or boiling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可供食用的栗子，例如烤熟或煮熟后食用的栗子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott b'qoxra kannella li jittiekel, pereżempju mixwi jew mgħolli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 栗子；可供食用的栗实。

formal.mt: Wara li nkalja l-qastan, il-kok neħħa l-qoxra u qassmu fi skutelli żgħar.
formal.en: After roasting the chestnuts, the cook removed the shells and divided them among small bowls.
formal.zh: 厨师烤好栗子后，剥去外壳，再分装到小碗里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid ftit qastan mixwi? Ġorġ: Iva, grazzi. Għadu sħun?
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like some roasted chestnuts? Ġorġ: Yes, thanks. Are they still warm?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你想吃点烤栗子吗？乔治：想，谢谢。栗子还热吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃点烤栗子吗？
messages.en: Would you like some roasted chestnuts?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。栗子还热吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Are they still warm?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qastan 和一碗刚剥好的热栗子联系起来，再成组记住 qastan mixwi 是烤栗子、qastan mgħolli 是煮栗子。

gloss_zh: 马耳他圣诞环形糕点用的栗色蜂蜜面粉馅

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chestnut-coloured filling made with honey and flour, used in Maltese Christmas ring-cakes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种由蜂蜜和面粉制成、呈栗色的馅料，用于马耳他圣诞环形糕点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mili lewn il-qastan magħmul mill-għasel u d-dqiq, li jintuża fil-qagħaq Maltin tal-Milied.

sense_translations.en_definition: a chestnut-coloured filling consisting of honey and flour used in Maltese Christmas ring-cakes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由蜂蜜和面粉制成的栗色馅料，用作马耳他圣诞环形糕点的内馅。

collocations.en: a chestnut-coloured filling made with honey and flour
collocations.zh: 用蜂蜜和面粉制成的栗色馅料

collocations.en: ring-cakes filled with the honey-and-flour filling
collocations.zh: 包有栗色蜂蜜面粉馅的环形糕点

formal.mt: Għall-qagħaq tal-Milied, il-furnar ħejja l-qastanija mill-għasel u d-dqiq u użaha bħala mili.
formal.en: For the Christmas ring-cakes, the baker prepared the chestnut-coloured filling from honey and flour and used it as the filling.
formal.zh: 制作圣诞环形糕点时，面包师用蜂蜜和面粉调制栗色馅料，并将其包入糕点。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhu dan il-mili kannella? Toni: Din hi l-qastanija, magħmula mill-għasel u d-dqiq għall-qagħaq tal-Milied.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is this brown filling? Toni: This is qastanija, made with honey and flour for Christmas ring-cakes.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个棕色的馅是什么？托尼：这是 qastanija，用蜂蜜和面粉制成，供圣诞环形糕点使用。

messages.speaker: Marta (烘焙学员)
messages.zh: 这个棕色的馅是什么？
messages.en: What is this brown filling?

messages.speaker: Toni (面包师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi l-qastanija, magħmula mill-għasel u d-dqiq għall-qagħaq tal-Milied.
messages.mt_standard: Din hi l-qastanija, magħmula mill-għasel u d-dqiq għall-qagħaq tal-Milied.
messages.zh: 这是 qastanija，用蜂蜜和面粉制成，供圣诞环形糕点使用。
messages.en: This is qastanija, made with honey and flour for Christmas ring-cakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住三个线索：栗色外观、蜂蜜加面粉、圣诞环形糕点内馅；这里的栗色描述颜色，不表示馅里一定有栗子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a brown colour resembling the colour of chestnuts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色像栗子外壳一样，呈栗棕色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur kannella bħal dak tal-qastan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 栗色的；颜色类似栗子外壳的棕色的。

formal.mt: Fil-pittura, ir-raġel għandu xagħar qastni u liebes kowt skur.
formal.en: In the painting, the man has chestnut-coloured hair and is wearing a dark coat.
formal.zh: 画中的男子有一头栗色头发，穿着深色外套。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'kulur trid għax-xagħar tiegħek? Marija: Irridu qastni, bħal f'dan ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lina: What colour would you like your hair? Marija: I'd like it chestnut-coloured, like in this photo.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你想把头发染成什么颜色？玛丽亚：我想要栗色，就像这张照片里的一样。

messages.speaker: Lina (理发师)
messages.zh: 你想把头发染成什么颜色？
messages.en: What colour would you like your hair?

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.zh: 我想要栗色，就像这张照片里的一样。
messages.en: I'd like it chestnut-coloured, like in this photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qastni 当作颜色标签记忆：在一束棕色头发旁放一颗栗子，再读 xagħar qastni，建立栗色头发的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling surprised or shocked by something unexpected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因意料之外的事情而感到惊讶，或受到强烈震动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss sorpriża jew xokk minħabba xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊讶的；因事情出乎意料而感到吃惊的。
震惊的；因突发或令人不安的事情而受到强烈震动的。

collocations.en: he was left surprised or shocked

formal.mt: Meta sema' li l-proġett kien tħassar mingħajr twissija, id-direttur baqa' qatgħan.
formal.en: When he heard that the project had been cancelled without warning, the director was shocked.
formal.zh: 听说项目在毫无预告的情况下被取消，主管震惊了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ma qed tgħid xejn? Mark: Għadni qatgħan; ma stennejtx li nirbaħ il-premju.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why aren't you saying anything? Mark: I'm still surprised; I didn't expect to win the prize.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你怎么一句话也不说？马克：我还没从惊讶中缓过来；我没想到会获奖。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么一句话也不说？
messages.en: Why aren't you saying anything?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni qatgħan; ma stennejtx li nirbaħ il-premju.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni qatgħan; ma stennejtx li nirbaħ il-premju.
messages.zh: 我还没从惊讶中缓过来；我没想到会获奖。
messages.en: I'm still surprised; I didn't expect to win the prize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用听到意外消息后突然愣住的表情记 qatgħan；消息可以带来一般惊讶，也可以带来更强烈的震惊。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coating of pitch applied over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂覆在物体表面的一层沥青。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kisja ta' qatran li titqiegħed fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沥青涂层；覆盖在表面的沥青层。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi qatranata ħoxna li tgħatti l-wiċċ tal-injam.
formal.en: The report describes a thick pitch coating covering the surface of the wood.
formal.zh: 报告描述了覆盖在木材表面的一层厚厚的沥青涂层。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi din il-kisja sewda fuq l-injam? Rita: Dik qatranata. Oqgħod attent, għadha twaħħal.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's this black coating on the wood? Rita: That's a pitch coating. Be careful, it's still sticky.
colloquial.zh: 马克：木头上这层黑色的东西是什么？丽塔：那是沥青涂层。小心，还黏着呢。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din il-kisja sewda fuq l-injam?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din il-kisja sewda fuq l-injam?
messages.zh: 木头上这层黑色的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's this black coating on the wood?

messages.speaker: Rita (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik qatranata. Oqgħod attent, għadha twaħħal.
messages.mt_standard: Dik qatranata. Oqgħod attent, għadha twaħħal.
messages.zh: 那是沥青涂层。小心，还黏着呢。
messages.en: That's a pitch coating. Be careful, it's still sticky.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木板表面刷着一层黑色沥青，把 qatranata 与已经覆盖在表面的涂层联系起来，突出一层覆盖物的概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling tar in colour or character, or covered with tar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色或性质像焦油的，或表面覆有焦油的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah il-qatran fil-kulur jew fin-natura tiegħu, jew li jkun miksi bil-qatran.

sense_translations.en_definition: tarlike (resembling tar in colour or nature)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 焦油状的；颜色或性质像焦油的。
覆有焦油的；表面沾满或涂有焦油的。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab likwidu qatrani fil-qiegħ tal-kontenitur.
formal.en: During the inspection, a tarlike liquid was found at the bottom of the container.
formal.zh: 检查时，在容器底部发现了焦油状液体。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-wiċċ daqshekk iswed? Pawlu: Għax huwa qatrani; għadu miksi bil-qatran.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this surface so black? Pawlu: Because it is tar-covered; it still has tar on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个表面为什么这么黑？保罗：因为它覆着焦油，焦油还留在上面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个表面为什么这么黑？
messages.en: Why is this surface so black?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa qatrani; għadu miksi bil-qatran.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa qatrani; għadu miksi bil-qatran.
messages.zh: 因为它覆着焦油，焦油还留在上面。
messages.en: Because it is tar-covered; it still has tar on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两幅图并排记：一瓶像焦油的黑色液体，一块覆有焦油的表面；分别对应“像焦油”和“沾有焦油”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who trades in cotton, buying or selling it as a business.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以买卖棉花为业的人；棉花商。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tinnegozja fil-qoton, billi tixtrih jew tbigħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棉花商；从事棉花买卖的人。
产棉的；能够出产棉花的。

collocations.en: a cotton trader at the market
to buy from a cotton trader

formal.mt: Il-qattan xtara l-qoton mingħand il-bdiewa u biegħu lil fabbrika tat-tessuti.
formal.en: The cotton trader bought the cotton from the farmers and sold it to a textile factory.
formal.zh: 棉花商从农民手中买入棉花，再将其卖给一家纺织厂。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Minn fejn nista' nixtri l-qoton? Rita: Hemm qattan fis-suq; tista' tixtri mingħandu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where can I buy cotton? Rita: There is a cotton trader at the market; you can buy from him.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我在哪里可以买到棉花？丽塔：市场里有个棉花商，你可以向他购买。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我在哪里可以买到棉花？
messages.en: Where can I buy cotton?

messages.speaker: Rita (摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm qattan fis-suq; tista' tixtri mingħandu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm qattan fis-suq; tista' tixtri mingħandu.
messages.zh: 市场里有个棉花商，你可以向他购买。
messages.en: There is a cotton trader at the market; you can buy from him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象市场里买卖棉花的商人，记住名词义“棉花商”；再单独配一幅产出棉花的画面，区分形容词义“产棉的”。

gloss_zh: 喧闹的人群聚集；吵闹的聚会

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gathering of people making a great deal of noise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 许多人聚在一起、发出很大声响的场面或聚会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġemgħa ta' nies li jagħmlu ħafna storbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喧闹的人群聚集；许多人聚在一起吵吵嚷嚷的场面。

collocations.en: a noisy gathering in the street
a noisy gathering in front of the door

formal.mt: Il-qattanija quddiem is-sala fixklet il-laqgħa li kienet għaddejja ġewwa.
formal.en: The noisy gathering in front of the hall disrupted the meeting taking place inside.
formal.zh: 大厅门前喧闹的人群干扰了里面正在进行的会议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-qattanija quddiem il-bieb? Toni: In-nies qed jistennew jidħlu u kulħadd qed jitkellem b'leħen għoli.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that noisy gathering in front of the door? Toni: People are waiting to go in, and everyone is talking loudly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：门前那群吵吵嚷嚷的人是怎么回事？托尼：大家在等着进去，而且人人都在大声说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 门前那群吵吵嚷嚷的人是怎么回事？
messages.en: What is that noisy gathering in front of the door?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nies qed jistennew jidħlu u kulħadd qed jitkellem b'leħen għoli.
messages.mt_standard: In-nies qed jistennew jidħlu u kulħadd qed jitkellem b'leħen għoli.
messages.zh: 大家在等着进去，而且人人都在大声说话。
messages.en: People are waiting to go in, and everyone is talking loudly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门前挤着一群大声交谈的人，把“人聚在一起”和“声音很吵”同时放进画面，两个特点合起来记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gutter along a roof, or a gully, that carries rainwater away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引走雨水的屋檐排水槽，或供雨水流过的沟渠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanal mat-tarf ta' saqaf, jew kanal fl-art, li minnu jgħaddi l-ilma tax-xita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屋檐排水槽；收集并导走屋顶雨水的槽。
雨水沟；供雨水汇集和流走的沟渠。

formal.mt: Il-qattara mat-tarf tas-saqaf għandha titnaddaf biex l-ilma tax-xita jkun jista' jgħaddi.
formal.en: The gutter along the edge of the roof should be cleaned so that rainwater can flow through.
formal.zh: 应清理屋顶边缘的排水槽，使雨水能够顺利流过。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex l-ilma qed ifur minn hemm fuq? Ġanni: Il-qattara mimlija weraq; irridu nnaddfuha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is the water overflowing up there? Ġanni: The gutter is full of leaves; we need to clean it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：上面的水为什么溢出来了？詹尼：排水槽里塞满了树叶，我们得清理一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-ilma qed ifur minn hemm fuq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-ilma qed ifur minn hemm fuq?
messages.zh: 上面的水为什么溢出来了？
messages.en: Why is the water overflowing up there?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (维修工)
messages.zh: 排水槽里塞满了树叶，我们得清理一下。
messages.en: The gutter is full of leaves; we need to clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 沿着雨水的路线记：雨先进入屋檐排水槽，再沿地面的雨水沟流走；两个义项都围绕“引走雨水的沟槽”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to let liquid fall in drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易让液体一滴一滴落下的；有滴漏倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jqattar likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易滴水或滴液的；有滴漏倾向的。

collocations.en: a tap that tends to drip
a roof that tends to drip

formal.mt: Il-vit qattari ġie msewwi biex jitnaqqas il-ħela tal-ilma.
formal.en: The tap that tended to drip was repaired to reduce water waste.
formal.zh: 那个容易滴水的水龙头已修好，以减少水的浪费。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għala hemm skutella taħt il-vit? Ben: Dan il-vit qattari; anki meta nagħlqu jibqa' jqattar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there a bowl under the tap? Ben: This tap tends to drip; even when I turn it off, it keeps dripping.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：水龙头下面为什么放着一个碗？本：这个水龙头爱滴水，连我关上后也还在滴。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 水龙头下面为什么放着一个碗？
messages.en: Why is there a bowl under the tap?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-vit qattari; anki meta nagħlqu jibqa' jqattar.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-vit qattari; anki meta nagħlqu jibqa' jqattar.
messages.zh: 这个水龙头爱滴水，连我关上后也还在滴。
messages.en: This tap tends to drip; even when I turn it off, it keeps dripping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象关紧后仍滴答作响的水龙头，用“它总爱滴水”记住这个形容词，重点是容易滴漏这一特性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a person or living thing to die gradually over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或其他生物随着时间推移逐渐死亡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil persuna jew lil ħaġa ħajja tmut ftit ftit maż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐杀死；使某个生命慢慢走向死亡。

collocations.en: killed the plants gradually over time
collocations.zh: 随着时间推移使植物慢慢死亡

formal.mt: L-ilma mielaħ qattel is-siġra ftit ftit matul diversi xhur.
formal.en: The salty water gradually killed the tree over several months.
formal.zh: 含盐的水在几个月内使这棵树逐渐死亡。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Is-siġra mietet f'daqqa? Mario: Le, l-ilma mielaħ qattel is-siġra ftit ftit.
colloquial.en: Lina: Did the tree die suddenly? Mario: No, the salty water killed the tree gradually.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这棵树是突然死掉的吗？马里奥：不是，含盐的水使它慢慢死去了。

messages.speaker: Lina (园主)
messages.zh: 这棵树是突然死掉的吗？
messages.en: Did the tree die suddenly?

messages.speaker: Mario (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-ilma mielaħ qattel is-siġra ftit ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-ilma mielaħ qattel is-siġra ftit ftit.
messages.zh: 不是，含盐的水使它慢慢死去了。
messages.en: No, the salty water killed the tree gradually.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面拉长成几个月的时间轴：树叶一点点枯萎，最后整棵树死亡；用这个渐变过程记住“逐渐致死”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To collect things into bundles, especially cut crops into sheaves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西收拢成束，尤指把割下的庄稼扎成捆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbor affarijiet f'qatet, speċjalment uċuħ maqtugħa bħall-qamħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西收拢并捆成束。
把割下的谷物等庄稼收拢成捆。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, il-bidwi qattet il-qamħ u poġġa l-qatet fit-tarf tal-għalqa.
formal.en: After the harvest, the farmer gathered the wheat into sheaves and placed them at the edge of the field.
formal.zh: 收割后，农民把小麦扎成捆，放在田边。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Min qattet dawn il-friegħi? Samwel: Jien; ġbarthom flimkien u rbatt kull qatta b'ħabel.
colloquial.en: Eva: Who bundled these branches? Samwel: I did; I gathered them together and tied each bundle with rope.
colloquial.zh: 伊娃：这些树枝是谁捆起来的？萨姆韦尔：是我，我把它们收拢起来，再用绳子把每一束绑好。

messages.speaker: Eva (园主)
messages.zh: 这些树枝是谁捆起来的？
messages.en: Who bundled these branches?

messages.speaker: Samwel (帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; ġbarthom flimkien u rbatt kull qatta b'ħabel.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; ġbarthom flimkien u rbatt kull qatta b'ħabel.
messages.zh: 是我，我把它们收拢起来，再用绳子把每一束绑好。
messages.en: I did; I gathered them together and tied each bundle with rope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手先把散开的树枝或麦秆拢到一起，再整理成一束；普通物品是“成束”，收割的庄稼是“成捆”。

gloss_zh: 切割者；从事切割工作的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who cuts materials or other things, often as part of their work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切割材料或其他东西的人，常指以此为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqta' materjal jew affarijiet oħra, spiss bħala xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切割东西的人；切割者。

formal.mt: Il-qattiegħ tal-ġebel qata' kull biċċa skont il-qisien mogħtija fil-pjanta.
formal.en: The stone cutter cut each piece according to the measurements given in the plan.
formal.zh: 石材切割工按照图纸上给定的尺寸切割了每一块石料。
