colloquial.mt: Mark: Min jista' jaqtagħli dan l-injam? Rita: Il-qattiegħ qiegħed fil-ħanut tax-xogħol; mur kellmu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who can cut this wood for me? Rita: The cutter is in the workshop; go and speak to him.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁能帮我切一下这些木材？丽塔：切割工在工坊里，你去和他说吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 谁能帮我切一下这些木材？
messages.en: Who can cut this wood for me?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattiegħ qiegħed fil-ħanut tax-xogħol; mur kellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattiegħ qiegħed fil-ħanut tax-xogħol; mur kellmu.
messages.zh: 切割工在工坊里，你去和他说吧。
messages.en: The cutter is in the workshop; go and speak to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在木材或石料旁画一个正在切割的人，再给这个人贴上词卡；本条词义的中心是执行切割动作的“人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing people, intentions or actions involving murder or a readiness to kill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人、意图或行为具有杀人性质，或表现出残忍的杀人倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvu qtil jew juru intenzjoni jew ħruxija biex joqtlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凶残的；具有杀人倾向或杀人性质的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkundanna l-attakki qattieli fuq in-nies tal-post.
formal.en: The report condemns the murderous attacks on local people.
formal.zh: 报告谴责了针对当地居民的凶残袭击。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tridx tara dan il-film? Mark: Għax fih ħafna attakki qattieli u ma nħobbx dik il-vjolenza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you want to watch this film? Mark: Because it has many murderous attacks, and I don't like that violence.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不想看这部电影？马克：因为里面有很多凶残的袭击，我不喜欢那种暴力。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tara dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tara dan il-film?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想看这部电影？
messages.en: Why don't you want to watch this film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fih ħafna attakki qattieli u ma nħobbx dik il-vjolenza.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fih ħafna attakki qattieli u ma nħobbx dik il-vjolenza.
messages.zh: 因为里面有很多凶残的袭击，我不喜欢那种暴力。
messages.en: Because it has many murderous attacks, and I don't like that violence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qattieli 连同 attakki qattieli 一起记，想象新闻中受到谴责的凶残袭击，突出它与杀人暴力有关。

gloss_zh: 捆扎者；把物品扎成捆的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gathers things together and ties them into bundles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把分散的物品收集起来并扎成一捆一捆的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġbor affarijiet flimkien u torbothom f'qatet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西扎成捆的人；捆扎者。

formal.mt: Il-qattiet jiġbor it-tiben u jorbtu f'qatet biex ikun aktar faċli jinġarr.
formal.en: The bundler gathers the straw and ties it into bundles to make it easier to carry.
formal.zh: 捆扎者把麦秸收集起来扎成捆，以便搬运。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħmel dak il-qattiet? Pawlu: Jorbot it-tiben f'qatet biex inkunu nistgħu nġorruh aktar faċilment.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does that bundler do? Pawlu: He ties the straw into bundles so we can carry it more easily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个捆扎工是做什么的？保罗：他把麦秸扎成捆，这样我们搬起来更方便。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 那个捆扎工是做什么的？
messages.en: What does that bundler do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jorbot it-tiben f'qatet biex inkunu nistgħu nġorruh aktar faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Jorbot it-tiben f'qatet biex inkunu nistgħu nġorruh aktar faċilment.
messages.zh: 他把麦秸扎成捆，这样我们搬起来更方便。
messages.en: He ties the straw into bundles so we can carry it more easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把散乱麦秸整理后用绳子扎紧，把 qattiet 对应到这个做捆扎工作的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cat species Pardofelis marmorata, known in English as the marbled cat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Pardofelis marmorata 的猫科动物，中文称为纹猫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' qattus magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Pardofelis marmorata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纹猫，学名为 Pardofelis marmorata。

collocations.en: a photograph of a marbled cat
the scientific name of the marbled cat

formal.mt: Il-paġna tippreżenta ritratt tal-qattus imraħħam u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Pardofelis marmorata.
formal.en: The page presents a photograph of the marbled cat and gives its scientific name, Pardofelis marmorata.
formal.zh: 这一页展示了纹猫的照片，并注明其学名 Pardofelis marmorata。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jismu dan il-qattus fl-istampa? Leo: Dan qattus imraħħam; ejja naqraw l-isem xjentifiku taħtu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this cat in the picture called? Leo: It's a marbled cat; let's read the scientific name underneath.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：图片里的这种猫叫什么？利奥：这是纹猫，我们来读读下面的学名。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里的这种猫叫什么？
messages.en: What is this cat in the picture called?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan qattus imraħħam; ejja naqraw l-isem xjentifiku taħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan qattus imraħħam; ejja naqraw l-isem xjentifiku taħtu.
messages.zh: 这是纹猫，我们来读读下面的学名。
messages.en: It's a marbled cat; let's read the scientific name underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用带有大理石纹路的猫形学习卡联想 marbled cat，再把整组 qattus imraħħam 与中文纹猫配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cat species Prionailurus planiceps, known in English as the flat-headed cat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Prionailurus planiceps 的猫科动物，中文称为扁头豹猫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' qattus magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Prionailurus planiceps.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扁头豹猫，学名为 Prionailurus planiceps。

collocations.en: a photograph of a flat-headed cat
a page about the flat-headed cat

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi stampa tal-qattus rasu ċatta bl-isem xjentifiku Prionailurus planiceps.
formal.en: The catalogue includes an image of the flat-headed cat under the scientific name Prionailurus planiceps.
formal.zh: 图录收录了一幅扁头豹猫的图片，并标有学名 Prionailurus planiceps。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Sibt il-paġna dwar il-qattus rasu ċatta? Adam: Iva, hawn hi; hemm stampa u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you find the page about the flat-headed cat? Adam: Yes, here it is; there's a picture and its scientific name.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你找到介绍扁头豹猫的那一页了吗？亚当：找到了，就在这里，有图片和它的学名。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt il-paġna dwar il-qattus rasu ċatta?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt il-paġna dwar il-qattus rasu ċatta?
messages.zh: 你找到介绍扁头豹猫的那一页了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the page about the flat-headed cat?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hi; hemm stampa u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hi; hemm stampa u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu.
messages.zh: 找到了，就在这里，有图片和它的学名。
messages.en: Yes, here it is; there's a picture and its scientific name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上把猫的头顶画成一条平线，用这个示意图把 qattus rasu ċatta、flat-headed cat 和扁头豹猫连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cat species Felis nigripes, known in English as the black-footed cat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Felis nigripes 的猫科动物，中文称为黑足猫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' qattus magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Felis nigripes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑足猫，学名为 Felis nigripes。

collocations.en: a picture of a black-footed cat

formal.mt: Il-materjal edukattiv jippreżenta l-qattus saqajh suwed bl-isem xjentifiku Felis nigripes.
formal.en: The educational material presents the black-footed cat under the scientific name Felis nigripes.
formal.zh: 这份教学材料介绍了黑足猫，并列出其学名 Felis nigripes。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Liema karta għażilt għall-proġett? Ben: Għażilt dik tal-qattus saqajh suwed; se nikteb l-isem tiegħu taħt l-istampa.
colloquial.en: Emma: Which card did you choose for the project? Ben: I chose the black-footed cat card; I'll write its name under the picture.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：你为这个作业选了哪张卡片？本：我选了黑足猫那张，我会把它的名字写在图片下面。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 你为这个作业选了哪张卡片？
messages.en: Which card did you choose for the project?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għażilt dik tal-qattus saqajh suwed; se nikteb l-isem tiegħu taħt l-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: Għażilt dik tal-qattus saqajh suwed; se nikteb l-isem tiegħu taħt l-istampa.
messages.zh: 我选了黑足猫那张，我会把它的名字写在图片下面。
messages.en: I chose the black-footed cat card; I'll write its name under the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆用的猫形图标上把脚部涂黑，将 qattus saqajh suwed 与 black-footed cat、黑足猫作为一组记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cat species Prionailurus rubiginosus, known in English as the rusty-spotted cat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Prionailurus rubiginosus 的猫科动物，中文称为锈斑豹猫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' qattus magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Prionailurus rubiginosus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锈斑豹猫，学名为 Prionailurus rubiginosus。

collocations.mt: ritratt ta' qattus tat-tikek lewn is-sadid
collocations.en: a photograph of a rusty-spotted cat

collocations.mt: l-isem xjentifiku tal-qattus tat-tikek lewn is-sadid
collocations.en: the scientific name of the rusty-spotted cat

formal.mt: Il-gwida tagħti l-isem xjentifiku Prionailurus rubiginosus għall-qattus tat-tikek lewn is-sadid.
formal.en: The guide gives Prionailurus rubiginosus as the scientific name of the rusty-spotted cat.
formal.zh: 这本指南注明，锈斑豹猫的学名是 Prionailurus rubiginosus。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Kif jismu dan il-qattus? Sam: Qattus tat-tikek lewn is-sadid. Julia: Se nikteb l-isem fuq il-karta biex niftakru.
colloquial.en: Julia: What is this cat called? Sam: A rusty-spotted cat. Julia: I'll write the name on the card so I remember it.
colloquial.zh: 朱莉娅：这种猫叫什么？萨姆：锈斑豹猫。朱莉娅：我把名字写在卡片上，好记住它。

messages.speaker: Julia (学生)
messages.zh: 这种猫叫什么？
messages.en: What is this cat called?

messages.speaker: Sam (同学)
messages.zh: 锈斑豹猫。
messages.en: A rusty-spotted cat.

messages.speaker: Julia (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nikteb l-isem fuq il-karta biex niftakru.
messages.mt_standard: Se nikteb l-isem fuq il-karta biex niftakru.
messages.zh: 我把名字写在卡片上，好记住它。
messages.en: I'll write the name on the card so I remember it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长名称分成 qattus／tat-tikek／lewn is-sadid 三段朗读，并配上锈色斑点的学习图，整组对应锈斑豹猫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collective rising or rebellion against those in authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一群人起来反抗当权者的行动，可指起义或叛乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni kollettiva li fiha grupp ta' nies iqum kontra dawk li għandhom l-awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起义；群众起来反抗当权者的行动。
反叛；叛乱；反抗统治或既有权威的集体行动。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-kawżi tal-qawma u t-talbiet tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The study analyses the causes of the uprising and the participants' demands.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了起义的原因以及参与者的诉求。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-kapitlu? David: Dwar qawma kontra l-gvern. Anna: Mela ejja naraw għaliex in-nies ħadu sehem fiha.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is this chapter about? David: An uprising against the government. Anna: Then let's see why people took part in it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这一章讲什么？戴维：讲一场反抗政府的起义。安娜：那我们来看看人们为什么参与。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 这一章讲什么？
messages.en: What is this chapter about?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 讲一场反抗政府的起义。
messages.en: An uprising against the government.

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja naraw għaliex in-nies ħadu sehem fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja naraw għaliex in-nies ħadu sehem fiha.
messages.zh: 那我们来看看人们为什么参与。
messages.en: Then let's see why people took part in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象历史课本中一群人共同起来反抗当权者，把 qawma 与集体起事联系；中文选起义还是叛乱要看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a squatting position, with the knees bent and the body lowered close to the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以膝盖弯曲、身体降低并靠近地面的蹲姿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'ġisem baxx qrib l-art u bl-irkopptejn milwijin, f'pożizzjoni ta' min ikun qiegħed kokka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹲着地；以蹲下的姿势。

formal.mt: Biex jeżamina l-pjanta mill-qrib, l-istudent qagħad qawqbijiet ħdejn il-qsari.
formal.en: To examine the plant closely, the student squatted beside the pots.
formal.zh: 为了近距离观察植物，那名学生蹲在花盆旁边。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn waqgħet iċ-ċavetta? Toni: Taħt il-mejda. Oqgħod qawqbijiet u taraha. Marta: Iva, issa qed naraha!
colloquial.en: Marta: Where did the key fall? Toni: Under the table. Squat down and you'll see it. Marta: Yes, I can see it now!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：钥匙掉到哪里了？托尼：桌子下面。你蹲下来就能看见。玛尔塔：对，现在看见了！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 钥匙掉到哪里了？
messages.en: Where did the key fall?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt il-mejda. Oqgħod qawqbijiet u taraha.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt il-mejda. Oqgħod qawqbijiet u taraha.
messages.zh: 桌子下面。你蹲下来就能看见。
messages.en: Under the table. Squat down and you'll see it.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，现在看见了！
messages.en: Yes, I can see it now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象为了找桌下的钥匙而弯膝蹲低身体，把 qawqbijiet 记成描述姿势的副词，搭配 joqgħod 一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rhythmic sound made by hooves striking the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马等动物的蹄子连续敲击地面时发出的有节奏的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss ritmiku li jagħmlu d-dwiefer taż-żwiemel meta jolqtu l-art.

sense_translations.en_definition: sound of hooves on the ground
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹄子踏在地面上发出的声音。
得得声；模仿马蹄交替敲击地面的声音。

collocations.en: the sound of hooves on pebbles
collocations.zh: 蹄子踏在碎石上的声音

formal.mt: Il-qawqib taż-żwiemel instema' fit-triq qabel ma deher il-karru.
formal.en: The clip-clop of the horses' hooves was heard in the street before the cart came into view.
formal.zh: 马车还未进入视野，街上就已传来马蹄的得得声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' dak il-qawqib? Pawlu: Iva, hemm żiemel ġej mit-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that clip-clop? Pawlu: Yes, there's a horse coming along the street.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那得得的马蹄声了吗？保罗：听到了，有匹马正沿着街道过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那得得的马蹄声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that clip-clop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，有匹马正沿着街道过来。
messages.en: Yes, there's a horse coming along the street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词和石板路上的马蹄声配对：先想象“得得、得得”的节奏，再记住 qawqib 表示这种声音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a squatting position, with the knees bent and the body close to the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以双膝弯曲、身体贴近地面的蹲姿；用于说明动作或停留时的姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'għarkopptejk milwijin u ġismek qrib l-art, mingħajr ma tkun bilqiegħda fuq siġġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹲着；保持屈膝、身体靠近地面的姿势。

collocations.en: to stay in a squatting position

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar baqa' qawqibijiet waqt li neħħa l-ħaxix ħażin minn madwar il-pjanti.
formal.en: The gardener remained squatting while removing weeds from around the plants.
formal.zh: 园丁蹲着清除植物周围的杂草。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed taħdem qawqibijiet? Mark: Qed inħawwel dawn il-fjuri żgħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you working in a squatting position? Mark: I'm planting these little flowers.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么蹲着干活？马克：我正在种这些小花。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么蹲着干活？
messages.en: Why are you working in a squatting position?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 我正在种这些小花。
messages.en: I'm planting these little flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蹲下来给小花除草，把 qawqibijiet 整体记成“蹲着”；本词条按副词学习，用来说明姿势。

gloss_zh: 给……加光环；使成圆形；制作圆形者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something a round shape, or to place a halo around someone's head in a depiction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物做成圆形；也指在人物形象的头部周围加上光环。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti forma tonda lil xi ħaġa, jew iqiegħed qawwara madwar ras persuna fi xbieha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to put a halo on sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人加上光环，尤指在人物图像中为其头部加光环。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give sth. a round shape
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物成为圆形；把某物塑成圆形。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who gives a circular shape
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把物件制作或加工成圆形的人。

collocations.en: shaped the clay into a round form
added a halo to the image of the saint
collocations.zh: 给圣人的画像加上光环

formal.mt: L-artiġjan qawwar it-tafal biex jagħmel skutella b'forma regolari.
formal.en: The craftsperson gave the clay a round shape to make a regularly shaped bowl.
formal.zh: 工匠把黏土塑成圆形，以制作形状规整的碗。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min qawwar din il-biċċa tafal? Toni: Jien. Se nagħmel skutella żgħira.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who shaped this piece of clay into a round form? Toni: I did. I'm going to make a little bowl.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁把这块黏土塑成了圆形？托尼：是我。我打算做一个小碗。

messages.speaker: Nina (陶艺学员)
messages.zh: 谁把这块黏土塑成了圆形？
messages.en: Who shaped this piece of clay into a round form?

messages.speaker: Toni (陶艺学员)
messages.zh: 是我。我打算做一个小碗。
messages.en: I did. I'm going to make a little bowl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅圆形画面记忆：双手把黏土塑圆，画笔给人物添光环；另用“制作圆形的人”单独记住名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ring of light around a head, especially in an image of a holy person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕头部的一圈光，尤指宗教图像中圣人头部周围的光环。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċirku ta' dawl madwar ir-ras, speċjalment fix-xbieha ta' persuna qaddisa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 光环；常见于圣像中、围绕人物头部的光圈。

formal.mt: Fil-pittura, qawwara tad-deheb tidher madwar ras il-qaddis.
formal.en: In the painting, a golden halo appears around the saint's head.
formal.zh: 画中，圣人的头部周围有一道金色光环。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak iċ-ċirku madwar ras il-qaddis? Lara: Dik qawwara. Hawn tidher tad-deheb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that circle around the saint's head? Lara: That's a halo. Here it looks golden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：圣人头部周围那个圆圈是什么？拉拉：那是光环。这里画成了金色。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak iċ-ċirku madwar ras il-qaddis?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak iċ-ċirku madwar ras il-qaddis?
messages.zh: 圣人头部周围那个圆圈是什么？
messages.en: What is that circle around the saint's head?

messages.speaker: Lara (博物馆讲解员)
messages.zh: 那是光环。这里画成了金色。
messages.en: That's a halo. Here it looks golden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象圣像头部外的一圈金光，把这一个完整的光圈标上 qawwara；用“金色光环”的画面帮助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak at length or say a great deal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说很多话，或围绕某件事讲很长时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem ħafna jew fit-tul dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说很多话；长时间地讲述。

collocations.en: talked at length during the meeting
talked at length about the same subject
collocations.zh: 围绕同一个话题说了很久

formal.mt: Il-kelliem qawwel fuq l-istorja tal-proġett u ħalla ftit ħin għall-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The speaker talked at length about the project's history and left little time for questions.
formal.zh: 发言人长篇讲述项目的历史，留给提问的时间很少。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-laqgħa damet daqshekk? Nina: Toni qawwel fuq l-istess suġġett u spiċċajna tard.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did the meeting take so long? Nina: Toni talked at length about the same subject, and we finished late.
colloquial.zh: 马克：会议为什么开了这么久？妮娜：托尼围绕同一个话题说了很久，我们就结束得晚了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 会议为什么开了这么久？
messages.en: Why did the meeting take so long?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni qawwel fuq l-istess suġġett u spiċċajna tard.
messages.mt_standard: Toni qawwel fuq l-istess suġġett u spiċċajna tard.
messages.zh: 托尼围绕同一个话题说了很久，我们就结束得晚了。
messages.en: Toni talked at length about the same subject, and we finished late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议发言人的话像长长的纸带不断展开，用这个“说了很久”的动作画面记住动词 qawwel。

gloss_zh: 爱说谚语的人；说话冗长的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who speaks in proverbs, or a person who uses a great many words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 习惯用谚语说话的人；也可指说话用词很多、表达冗长的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem bil-qwiel, jew li tuża ħafna kliem meta titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 习惯用谚语表达意思的人；说话常引用谚语的人。
说话非常冗长的人；表达时使用过多词语的人。

collocations.en: a speaker who is fond of proverbs
a wordy person who prolongs the conversation
collocations.zh: 说话冗长、把谈话拖长的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-nannu jidher bħala qawwiel li jwieġeb għall-mistoqsijiet permezz tal-qwiel.
formal.en: In the story, the grandfather appears as a speaker who answers questions through proverbs.
formal.zh: 故事中的祖父是一个爱说谚语的人，常用谚语回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: In-nannu tiegħek dejjem isemmi xi qawl? Pawlu: Iva, hu qawwiel; għal kull sitwazzjoni għandu qawl.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does your grandfather always bring up a proverb? Pawlu: Yes, he's a proverb-loving speaker; he has a proverb for every situation.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你祖父总会提起某句谚语吗？保罗：是啊，他是个爱说谚语的人，遇到什么情况都有一句谚语。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu tiegħek dejjem isemmi xi qawl?
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu tiegħek dejjem isemmi xi qawl?
messages.zh: 你祖父总会提起某句谚语吗？
messages.en: Does your grandfather always bring up a proverb?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu qawwiel; għal kull sitwazzjoni għandu qawl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu qawwiel; għal kull sitwazzjoni għandu qawl.
messages.zh: 是啊，他是个爱说谚语的人，遇到什么情况都有一句谚语。
messages.en: Yes, he's a proverb-loving speaker; he has a proverb for every situation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给人物画两张记忆卡：一张是开口就引谚语的爷爷，一张是说话很冗长的人；两张都对应名词 qawwiel。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Using more words than necessary, making speech or writing excessively long.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用的词语多于表达所需，导致讲话或文章过分冗长的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża aktar kliem milli hemm bżonn u għalhekk ikun twil iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用词过多的；表达啰嗦的。
冗长繁复的；因铺陈过多而显得拖沓的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża stil qawwieli li jagħmilha diffiċli biex il-qarrej isib il-punti ewlenin.
formal.en: The report uses a prolix style that makes it difficult for the reader to find the main points.
formal.zh: 这份报告的文风冗长繁复，使读者难以找到要点。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'taħseb dwar dan it-test? Mark: Hu qawwieli wisq. Tista' tgħid l-istess ħaġa b'inqas kliem.
colloquial.en: Nina: What do you think of this text? Mark: It's too wordy. You can say the same thing in fewer words.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得这段文字怎么样？马克：太啰嗦了。同样的意思可以用更少的字表达。

messages.speaker: Nina (写作者)
messages.zh: 你觉得这段文字怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu qawwieli wisq. Tista' tgħid l-istess ħaġa b'inqas kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Hu qawwieli wisq. Tista' tgħid l-istess ħaġa b'inqas kliem.
messages.zh: 太啰嗦了。同样的意思可以用更少的字表达。
messages.en: It's too wordy. You can say the same thing in fewer words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一段本可写一行却写满整页的文字，用 qawwieli 给它贴上“用词冗多”的标签，记住这是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a hard outer crust or become hard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面形成一层硬壳，或由较软的状态变硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifforma qoxra iebsa fuq il-wiċċ jew isir iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面结出硬壳；形成一层硬皮。
变硬；由柔软或湿润的状态变得坚硬。

collocations.en: the mud hardened in the sun

formal.mt: Wara diversi sigħat fix-xemx, it-tajn qaxlef u sar diffiċli biex jitħallat mal-ilma.
formal.en: After several hours in the sun, the mud hardened and became difficult to mix with water.
formal.zh: 经过数小时的日晒，泥变硬了，难以再与水混合。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex dan it-tajn sar daqshekk iebes? Lara: Ħallejnieh fix-xemx u qaxlef. Ejja nżidu ftit ilma.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why has this mud become so hard? Lara: We left it in the sun and it hardened. Let's add a little water.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：这些泥怎么变得这么硬了？拉拉：我们把它放在太阳底下，它就变硬了。来加一点水吧。

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tajn sar daqshekk iebes?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tajn sar daqshekk iebes?
messages.zh: 这些泥怎么变得这么硬了？
messages.en: Why has this mud become so hard?

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejnieh fix-xemx u qaxlef. Ejja nżidu ftit ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejnieh fix-xemx u qaxlef. Ejja nżidu ftit ilma.
messages.zh: 我们把它放在太阳底下，它就变硬了。来加一点水吧。
messages.en: We left it in the sun and it hardened. Let's add a little water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象湿泥晒干后表面结壳、手指难以按入的过程，把“结硬壳”和“变硬”两种变化一起连到 qaxlef。

gloss_zh: 易使表面或外壳变干的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to dry the surface or outer covering of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物表面、外皮或外壳变干的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jnixxef il-wiċċ jew il-qoxra ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to make the surface or shell dry
sense_translations.zh_definition: 易使表面或外壳变干的。

collocations.en: an effect that dries the surface
wind that tends to dry outer surfaces
collocations.zh: 易使物体表面变干的风

formal.mt: Ir-riħ kellu effett qaxliefi fuq il-wiċċ tal-ħobż li tħalla mikxuf.
formal.en: The wind had a surface-drying effect on the bread that was left uncovered.
formal.zh: 风使未盖好的面包表面变干了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex għattejt il-ħobż? Pawlu: Dan ir-riħ qaxliefi; il-wiċċ tal-ħobż jinxef malajr.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you cover the bread? Pawlu: This wind dries the surface; the outside of the bread dries out quickly.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么把面包盖起来？保罗：这风容易把表面吹干，面包外面很快就会干。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 你为什么把面包盖起来？
messages.en: Why did you cover the bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-riħ qaxliefi; il-wiċċ tal-ħobż jinxef malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-riħ qaxliefi; il-wiċċ tal-ħobż jinxef malajr.
messages.zh: 这风容易把表面吹干，面包外面很快就会干。
messages.en: This wind dries the surface; the outside of the bread dries out quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包没盖好，风把外皮吹干；用这个画面记住“使表面变干的”。

gloss_zh: 使完全干燥；排干；极节俭的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dry something completely or drain liquid from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物彻底干燥，或把其中的液体排出、排干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnixxef xi ħaġa għalkollox jew tbattalha mil-likwidu li jkun fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使完全干燥；把水分彻底弄干。
排出液体；把容器等排空、排干。
非常节俭、花钱十分节省的人。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem qaxqax il-barmil u ħallieh vojt qabel ma beda jnaddfu.
formal.en: The worker drained the bucket and left it empty before beginning to clean it.
formal.zh: 工人先把桶里的水排干，待桶空了才开始清洗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħwejjeġ għadhom imxarrbin? Mark: Le, ir-riħ qaxqax kollox; nistgħu ndaħħluhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are the clothes still wet? Mark: No, the wind dried everything completely; we can bring them in.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：衣服还湿吗？马克：不湿了，风把它们全吹干了，可以收进来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 衣服还湿吗？
messages.en: Are the clothes still wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ir-riħ qaxqax kollox; nistgħu ndaħħluhom.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ir-riħ qaxqax kollox; nistgħu ndaħħluhom.
messages.zh: 不湿了，风把它们全吹干了，可以收进来了。
messages.en: No, the wind dried everything completely; we can bring them in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个小画面分开记：衣服彻底干、桶中水排空、花钱特别省的人；最后一个是名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who is miserly or takes saving money to excess.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人吝啬，或在花钱、使用资源时节省过头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joqgħod iżżejjed attent biex ma jonfoqx flus jew ma jużax riżorsi.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is miserly or excessively economical
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容某人吝啬或过分节俭的。

collocations.zh: 一个过分节省的老板或业主

formal.mt: Is-sid qaxqaxi rrifjuta li jixtri siġġijiet ġodda, għalkemm dawk qodma ma kinux għadhom tajbin għall-użu.
formal.en: The miserly owner refused to buy new chairs, although the old ones were no longer fit for use.
formal.zh: 这位吝啬的老板拒绝购买新椅子，尽管旧椅子已经不能用了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadu ma bidilx dawk iż-żraben imqattgħin? Toni: Le, huwa qaxqaxi wisq biex jixtri par ġdid.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has he still not replaced those torn shoes? Toni: No, he is too miserly to buy a new pair.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他还没换掉那双破鞋吗？托尼：没有，他太吝啬了，舍不得买双新的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu ma bidilx dawk iż-żraben imqattgħin?
messages.mt_standard: Għadu ma bidilx dawk iż-żraben imqattgħin?
messages.zh: 他还没换掉那双破鞋吗？
messages.en: Has he still not replaced those torn shoes?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa qaxqaxi wisq biex jixtri par ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa qaxqaxi wisq biex jixtri par ġdid.
messages.zh: 没有，他太吝啬了，舍不得买双新的。
messages.en: No, he is too miserly to buy a new pair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鞋子已经破了还舍不得换：这里强调“节省过头”，带有吝啬的评价。

gloss_zh: 负责剥皮、刮削或剃毛的；爱索取过高价钱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone assigned to skin, scrape, or shave; also someone inclined to charge excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容负责剥皮、刮削或剃毛的人；也形容惯于收取过高价钱的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xogħlu hu li jneħħi l-ġilda, jobrox jew iqaxxar ix-xagħar; ukoll li għandu t-tendenza li jitlob prezzijiet għoljin iżżejjed.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the task of skinning, scraping or shaving
sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责剥皮、刮削或剃毛工作的。
倾向于收取过高费用、惯于漫天要价的。

collocations.en: a worker assigned to skinning, scraping, or shaving
collocations.zh: 负责剥皮、刮削或剃毛的工人

collocations.en: a merchant who tends to overcharge
collocations.zh: 惯于索取过高价钱的商人

collocations.en: a seller inclined to charge too much

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem qaxxari kellu jneħħi l-ġilda mill-annimal qabel ma jibda l-istadju li jmiss tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The worker assigned to skinning had to remove the animal's skin before the next stage of the work began.
formal.zh: 负责剥皮的工人必须先剥去动物的皮，之后才能进入下一道工序。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma xtrajtx mingħand dak il-bejjiegħ? Ġanni: Huwa qaxxari; talabni d-doppju tal-prezz tas-soltu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you not buy from that seller? Ġanni: He tends to overcharge; he asked me for twice the usual price.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么没在那个卖家那里买？詹尼：他爱漫天要价，向我要了平常两倍的价钱。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma xtrajtx mingħand dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma xtrajtx mingħand dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 你为什么没在那个卖家那里买？
messages.en: Why did you not buy from that seller?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa qaxxari; talabni d-doppju tal-prezz tas-soltu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa qaxxari; talabni d-doppju tal-prezz tas-soltu.
messages.zh: 他爱漫天要价，向我要了平常两倍的价钱。
messages.en: He tends to overcharge; he asked me for twice the usual price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两栏记忆：工作栏是剥皮、刮削、剃毛；购物栏是收费过高。靠场景选择词义。

gloss_zh: 切断；折断；砍掉；穿短装、夏装；折枝或砍枝的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut or break something off, especially a branch or another projecting part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物切断、折断或砍掉，尤其指树枝等伸出的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' jew ikisser xi ħaġa u jaqlagħha minn fejn tkun imwaħħla, speċjalment fergħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切、割或砍，使某物断开。
折断；使某部分从原来连接的位置断开。
砍掉、截去，尤指树枝等伸出的部分。
穿短款衣服；穿短装。
穿夏季服装；穿夏装。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who breaks or cuts off tree branches
sense_translations.zh_definition: 折断或砍掉树枝的人。

collocations.en: cut or broke off a branch
collocations.zh: 砍断或折断了一根树枝

collocations.en: lopped off the top of the tree

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar qaċċat il-fergħa miksura biex ma taqax fuq il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The gardener cut off the damaged branch so that it would not fall onto the path.
formal.zh: 园丁砍掉了受损的树枝，以免它掉到小路上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min qaċċat dik il-fergħa? Toni: Il-ġardinar; kienet miksura u kienet se taqa'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who cut off that branch? Toni: The gardener; it was damaged and about to fall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁砍掉了那根树枝？托尼：园丁；那根树枝已经受损，快要掉下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 谁砍掉了那根树枝？
messages.en: Who cut off that branch?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġardinar; kienet miksura u kienet se taqa'.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġardinar; kienet miksura u kienet se taqa'.
messages.zh: 园丁；那根树枝已经受损，快要掉下来了。
messages.en: The gardener; it was damaged and about to fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“把树枝弄断并去掉”的动作记 qaċċat；另做一张“穿短装、夏装”的义项卡，名词用法则记作做折枝或砍枝动作的人。

gloss_zh: 容易折断或切断东西的；爱折爱砍的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to break things or cut them off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有折断、弄断或切断东西的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jkisser l-affarijiet jew jaqtagħhom minn fejn ikunu mwaħħlin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于折断或切断东西的；爱把东西弄断的。

collocations.en: a boy inclined to break or cut things
collocations.zh: 爱折断或切断东西的男孩

collocations.en: a man inclined to break or cut things
collocations.zh: 爱折断或切断东西的男子

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel qaċċati kien jaqta' l-friegħi żgħar tas-siġar waqt kull mixja.
formal.en: In the story, the boy, who was inclined to break or cut things, would cut small branches off the trees on every walk.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个爱折爱砍的男孩每次散步都会弄断树上的小枝。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex issejjaħlu qaċċati? Mark: Għax kull darba li joħroġ fil-ġnien, ikisser xi fergħa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why do you call him someone who is always breaking things? Mark: Because every time he goes into the garden, he breaks a branch.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么说他爱折东西？马克：因为他每次去花园都会折断一根树枝。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他爱折东西？
messages.en: Why do you call him someone who is always breaking things?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li joħroġ fil-ġnien, ikisser xi fergħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li joħroġ fil-ġnien, ikisser xi fergħa.
messages.zh: 因为他每次去花园都会折断一根树枝。
messages.en: Because every time he goes into the garden, he breaks a branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这个人老爱把东西弄断”记 qaċċati：它描述人的行为倾向，重点是爱折爱切，而不是物品本身容易碎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual act of prostitution, expressed with a vulgar term.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一次具体的卖淫行为，属于粗俗用语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att wieħed ta' prostituzzjoni, imsemmi b'kelma vulgari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次卖淫行为；用语粗俗。

collocations.en: an accusation of an act of prostitution
collocations.zh: 有关一次卖淫行为的指控

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rakkont, il-kelma 'qaħbata' tirreferi għal att ta' prostituzzjoni u għandha ton vulgari.
formal.en: In the analysis of the story, the word 'qaħbata' refers to an act of prostitution and has a vulgar tone.
formal.zh: 在这篇故事分析中，qaħbata 指一次卖淫行为，带有粗俗语气。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'qaħbata' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Tfisser att ta' prostituzzjoni, imma hija kelma vulgari.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'qaħbata' mean in this sentence? Mark: It means an act of prostitution, but it is a vulgar word.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个句子里的 qaħbata 是什么意思？马克：指一次卖淫行为，不过这是粗俗用语。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 qaħbata 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qaħbata' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser att ta' prostituzzjoni, imma hija kelma vulgari.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser att ta' prostituzzjoni, imma hija kelma vulgari.
messages.zh: 指一次卖淫行为，不过这是粗俗用语。
messages.en: It means an act of prostitution, but it is a vulgar word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qaħbata 记在“一次行为”的卡片上：它指卖淫这件事的一次发生，同时标记为粗俗词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar, derogatory noun for a prostitute, also used as a sexual insult against a woman.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对妓女的粗俗贬称，也可用作辱骂女性的性羞辱用语，相当于“荡妇”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom vulgari u dispreġjattiv għal prostituta, li jintuża wkoll bħala insult sesswali kontra mara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妓女，卖淫者；这里是粗俗、贬损的称呼。
荡妇；用于性羞辱女性的粗俗骂人话，并不一定指实际从事卖淫的人。

collocations.en: to call someone a slut or prostitute as an insult
collocations.zh: 辱骂某人为荡妇或妓女
把 qaħbuna 当作骂人话使用

formal.mt: Fl-istudju tad-djalogu, 'qaħbuna' hija analizzata bħala kelma vulgari li tista' tindika prostituta jew tintuża bħala insult.
formal.en: In the study of the dialogue, 'qaħbuna' is analysed as a vulgar word that can denote a prostitute or be used as an insult.
formal.zh: 在这份对话研究中，qaħbuna 被分析为一个粗俗词，既可指妓女，也可用来辱骂他人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fir-rumanz sejħilha 'qaħbuna'. Ifisser li kienet prostituta? Nina: Mhux bilfors; jista' jkun biss insult vulgari.
colloquial.en: Maja: In the novel, he called her 'qaħbuna'. Does that mean she was a prostitute? Nina: Not necessarily; it may just be a vulgar insult.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小说里他叫她 qaħbuna。这说明她是妓女吗？妮娜：不一定；也可能只是一句粗俗的骂人话。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rumanz sejħilha 'qaħbuna'. Ifisser li kienet prostituta?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rumanz sejħilha 'qaħbuna'. Ifisser li kienet prostituta?
messages.zh: 小说里他叫她 qaħbuna。这说明她是妓女吗？
messages.en: In the novel, he called her 'qaħbuna'. Does that mean she was a prostitute?

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux bilfors; jista' jkun biss insult vulgari.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux bilfors; jista' jkun biss insult vulgari.
messages.zh: 不一定；也可能只是一句粗俗的骂人话。
messages.en: Not necessarily; it may just be a vulgar insult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qaħbuna 画两张义项卡：“妓女”和“荡妇式辱骂”；遇到后者时，不把辱骂当成事实描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a dry cough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有干咳症状、正在干咳的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu sogħla xotta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有干咳的；出现干咳症状的。

collocations.en: a man with a dry cough
collocations.zh: 一个有干咳症状的男人

collocations.en: he still has a dry cough

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-pazjent huwa deskritt bħala qaħqieħi, jiġifieri għandu sogħla xotta.
formal.en: In the report, the patient is described as having a dry cough.
formal.zh: 报告中将这名患者描述为有干咳症状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek qaħqieħi llum? Mark: Iva, għad għandi sogħla xotta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you still have a dry cough today? Mark: Yes, I still have a dry cough.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天还在干咳吗？马克：是啊，我还是有干咳。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天还在干咳吗？
messages.en: Do you still have a dry cough today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我还是有干咳。
messages.en: Yes, I still have a dry cough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qaħqieħi 和 sogħla xotta 配成记忆卡：前者描述“有干咳的人”，后者直接说“干咳”。

gloss_zh: 拉皮条；使人卖淫；皮条客；使妇女卖淫者；嫖客

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act as a pimp or cause another person to engage in prostitution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 充当皮条客、拉皮条，或使他人从事卖淫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaġixxi bħala intermedjarju fil-prostituzzjoni jew iġiegħel lil persuna oħra tipprostitwixxi ruħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉皮条；充当卖淫活动的中间人。
使某人卖淫；安排某人从事卖淫。
皮条客；为卖淫活动牵线的人。
使妇女卖淫的人；安排妇女从事卖淫的人。
经常嫖妓的人；嫖客。

collocations.en: to cause someone to engage in prostitution

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel qaħħab lil mara biex jaqla' l-flus minn fuqha.
formal.en: In the story, the man caused a woman to engage in prostitution in order to make money from her.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这名男子使一名女子卖淫，以便从她身上赚钱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Qaħħab' dejjem huwa verb? Mark: Le, jista' jkun nom ukoll: intermedjarju fil-prostituzzjoni, xi ħadd li jġiegħel lin-nisa jipprostitwixxu ruħhom, jew xi ħadd li jmur spiss għand il-prostituti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is 'qaħħab' always a verb? Mark: No, it can also be a noun: a pimp, someone who makes women engage in prostitution, or someone who frequently visits prostitutes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：qaħħab 总是动词吗？马克：不是，也可以是名词，指皮条客、使妇女卖淫的人，或经常嫖妓的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: qaħħab 总是动词吗？
messages.en: Is 'qaħħab' always a verb?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jista' jkun nom ukoll: intermedjarju fil-prostituzzjoni, xi ħadd li jġiegħel lin-nisa jipprostitwixxu ruħhom, jew xi ħadd li jmur spiss għand il-prostituti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jista' jkun nom ukoll: intermedjarju fil-prostituzzjoni, xi ħadd li jġiegħel lin-nisa jipprostitwixxu ruħhom, jew xi ħadd li jmur spiss għand il-prostituti.
messages.zh: 不是，也可以是名词，指皮条客、使妇女卖淫的人，或经常嫖妓的人。
messages.en: No, it can also be a noun: a pimp, someone who makes women engage in prostitution, or someone who frequently visits prostitutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qaħħab 分成“做什么”和“是什么人”两栏来记：动词记拉皮条、使人卖淫，名词再区分组织者与嫖客。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to enjoy or seek participation in prostitution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容喜好或倾向于参与卖淫活动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jieħu sehem fil-prostituzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜好参与卖淫活动的；倾向于从事这类活动的。

collocations.en: a man inclined to engage in prostitution
collocations.zh: 一个喜好参与卖淫活动的男人

collocations.en: a character inclined to engage in prostitution
collocations.zh: 一个喜好参与卖淫活动的角色

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala raġel qaħħabi, jiġifieri wieħed li jħobb jieħu sehem fil-prostituzzjoni.
formal.en: The author describes the character as a man inclined to engage in prostitution, meaning someone who likes taking part in it.
formal.zh: 作者把这个角色描述为喜好参与卖淫活动的男人，也就是喜欢参与这类活动的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'qaħħabi' fid-deskrizzjoni ta' dan ir-raġel? Nina: Li jħobb jieħu sehem fil-prostituzzjoni; hawnhekk hija aġġettiv.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'qaħħabi' mean in this description of the man? Nina: That he likes taking part in prostitution; here it is an adjective.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：描述这个男人时用的 qaħħabi 是什么意思？妮娜：指他喜好参与卖淫活动；这里是形容词。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'qaħħabi' fid-deskrizzjoni ta' dan ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'qaħħabi' fid-deskrizzjoni ta' dan ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 描述这个男人时用的 qaħħabi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qaħħabi' mean in this description of the man?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li jħobb jieħu sehem fil-prostituzzjoni; hawnhekk hija aġġettiv.
messages.mt_standard: Li jħobb jieħu sehem fil-prostituzzjoni; hawnhekk hija aġġettiv.
messages.zh: 指他喜好参与卖淫活动；这里是形容词。
messages.en: That he likes taking part in prostitution; here it is an adjective.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qaħħabi 放在人物描述栏，配上“喜好参与这类活动”的标签，提醒自己这里学的是形容词和倾向。

gloss_zh: 使供应短缺；使变得稀缺

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something scarce or cause its supply to become insufficient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得稀缺，或使其供应不足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa skarsa jew jikkawża nuqqas fil-provvista tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成供应不足；使某物出现短缺。
使变得稀缺；使数量或供应减少至不足。

collocations.en: to make the water supply scarce
to cause a shortage of food in the market

formal.mt: It-tnaqqis fil-produzzjoni qaħħat il-provvista tal-ikel fis-suq lokali.
formal.en: The decline in production caused a shortage in the food supply in the local market.
formal.zh: 产量下降导致当地市场的食物供应短缺。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-temp ħażin qaħħat il-ħaxix fis-suq. Lara: Għalhekk illum sibna daqshekk ftit?
colloquial.en: Mark: The bad weather made vegetables scarce in the market. Lara: Is that why we found so few today?
colloquial.zh: 马克：坏天气让市场上的蔬菜变少了。拉拉：所以我们今天才只找到这么一点吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 坏天气让市场上的蔬菜变少了。
messages.en: The bad weather made vegetables scarce in the market.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 所以我们今天才只找到这么一点吗？
messages.en: Is that why we found so few today?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象市场货架因为产量下降而空了：qaħħat 要记住“某个原因使供应不足”这一因果关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a low grunting noise like the sound of a pig.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出低沉的哼哼声，声音类似猪叫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel ħoss baxx bħal dak li jagħmel ħanżir.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a grunting sound (like a pig)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出哼哼声，像猪叫一样。

formal.mt: Il-ħanżir qażqaż meta l-bidwi resaq lejn il-maqjel bil-barmil tal-ikel.
formal.en: The pig grunted when the farmer approached the pen with the bucket of food.
formal.zh: 农夫提着食桶走近猪圈时，猪哼哼叫了起来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Ben: Il-ħanżir qażqaż; naħseb li għandu l-ġuħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was that sound? Ben: The pig grunted; I think it is hungry.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：刚才是什么声音？本：是猪在哼哼叫，我想它饿了。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Ben (农场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanżir qażqaż; naħseb li għandu l-ġuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanżir qażqaż; naħseb li għandu l-ġuħ.
messages.zh: 是猪在哼哼叫，我想它饿了。
messages.en: The pig grunted; I think it is hungry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上猪在食槽旁低声哼哼的画面，记住声音是“哼”，不是尖叫。

gloss_zh: 少量地分发；吝惜地给予

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something out sparingly, allowing only small amounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分发或给予东西时很节省，每次只给少量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti xi ħaġa bil-qies ħafna, fi kwantitajiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 少量地分发某物；给予得很节省、很吝惜。

formal.mt: L-organizzatur qażwat il-kampjuni lill-viżitaturi, u ta wieħed biss lil kull persuna.
formal.en: The organizer distributed the samples sparingly to visitors, giving only one to each person.
formal.zh: 组织者少量地向访客发放样品，每人只给一个。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm tak ħelu? Samwel: Tnejn biss; qażwat il-ħelu u żamm il-bqija għal għada.
colloquial.en: Rita: How many sweets did he give you? Samwel: Only two; he handed out the sweets sparingly and kept the rest for tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：他给了你几颗糖？萨穆埃尔：只有两颗；他给糖给得很省，把其余的留到明天了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他给了你几颗糖？
messages.en: How many sweets did he give you?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnejn biss; qażwat il-ħelu u żamm il-bqija għal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Tnejn biss; qażwat il-ħelu u żamm il-bqija għal għada.
messages.zh: 只有两颗；他给糖给得很省，把其余的留到明天了。
messages.en: Only two; he handed out the sweets sparingly and kept the rest for tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一大袋糖每人只分两颗，重点记住“给出去的量很少”，而不是一般的分发。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who behaves mischievously or speaks with cheeky disrespect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱调皮捣蛋的人，或说话放肆、冒失无礼的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel il-praspar jew titkellem b'wiċċha tost u bla rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淘气鬼；爱调皮捣蛋的人。
说话放肆、冒失无礼的人。

collocations.zh: 毫不知羞、放肆无礼的人

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-qażwit ħeba ċ-ċavetta biex sħabu ma jkunux jistgħu jiftħu l-kaxxa.
formal.en: In the story, the mischief-maker hid the key so that his friends could not open the box.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个淘气鬼把钥匙藏了起来，让朋友们打不开箱子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min ħeba l-pinna tiegħi? Luqa: Dak il-qażwit ta' ħija! Qiegħda taħt il-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who hid my pen? Luqa: That rascal of a brother of mine! It is under the book.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁把我的笔藏起来了？卢卡：是我那个淘气鬼弟弟！笔在书下面。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把我的笔藏起来了？
messages.en: Who hid my pen?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-qażwit ta' ħija! Qiegħda taħt il-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-qażwit ta' ħija! Qiegħda taħt il-ktieb.
messages.zh: 是我那个淘气鬼弟弟！笔在书下面。
messages.en: That rascal of a brother of mine! It is under the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个藏笔捣蛋、又敢顶嘴的人：藏笔对应“淘气鬼”，顶嘴对应“冒失无礼的人”。

gloss_zh: 令人厌恶的人；弄脏东西的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes disgust or makes things dirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到厌恶、恶心的人，或把地方、物品弄脏的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqanqal stmerrija jew li tħammeġ xi ħaġa jew xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人感到厌恶或恶心的人。
把东西或地方弄脏、污损的人。

collocations.en: a person whose words cause disgust
a person who befouls the place

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qażżież ħalla skart u fdalijiet tal-ikel mal-art, u ħammeġ il-kamra kollha.
formal.en: In the account, the person who befouled the place left rubbish and food scraps on the floor, dirtying the entire room.
formal.zh: 叙述中，那个弄脏环境的人把垃圾和食物残渣留在地上，弄脏了整个房间。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min ħalla dan il-ħmieġ kollu fuq il-mejda? David: Dak il-qażżież li kiel hawn qabilna; lanqas ġabar il-fdalijiet.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who left all this mess on the table? David: That filthy person who ate here before us; he did not even clear away the scraps.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：谁把桌子弄得这么脏？戴维：就是在我们之前坐这里吃饭的那个邋遢鬼，连食物残渣都没收拾。

messages.speaker: Elena (食客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ħalla dan il-ħmieġ kollu fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Min ħalla dan il-ħmieġ kollu fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 谁把桌子弄得这么脏？
messages.en: Who left all this mess on the table?

messages.speaker: David (同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-qażżież li kiel hawn qabilna; lanqas ġabar il-fdalijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-qażżież li kiel hawn qabilna; lanqas ġabar il-fdalijiet.
messages.zh: 就是在我们之前坐这里吃饭的那个邋遢鬼，连食物残渣都没收拾。
messages.en: That filthy person who ate here before us; he did not even clear away the scraps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看着让人反感、做事弄脏环境”两个画面记忆；这个名词指人，并带明显贬义。

gloss_zh: 令人恶心的；令人厌恶的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing a strong feeling of disgust or revulsion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引起强烈恶心、反感或厌恶感的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqanqlu sens qawwi ta' stmerrija jew dardir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人恶心的；令人厌恶的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-irwejjaħ qażżieżi li ħarġu mill-iskart.
formal.en: The report describes the disgusting smells that came from the rubbish.
formal.zh: 报告描述了垃圾散发出的令人作呕的气味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn l-irwejjaħ qażżieżi ġejjin mill-borża? Lara: Iva, ejja noħorġuha barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these disgusting smells coming from the bag? Lara: Yes, let's take it outside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些令人作呕的气味是从袋子里出来的吗？拉拉：是啊，我们把它拿到外面去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这些令人作呕的气味是从袋子里出来的吗？
messages.en: Are these disgusting smells coming from the bag?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们把它拿到外面去吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's take it outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qażżieżi 与捂住鼻子、皱起眉头的画面相连，再用“令人作呕的气味”这一搭配记住强烈的厌恶感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small grave; the diminutive form of qabar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小坟墓；qabar（坟墓）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qabar żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qabar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small grave (the diminutive form of 'qabar')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小坟墓；qabar（坟墓）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small grave in the garden

formal.mt: L-istudent pinġa qbajjar b'żewġ fjuri fuqu biex juri t-tifsira tal-kelma.
formal.en: The student drew a small grave with two flowers on it to illustrate the meaning of the word.
formal.zh: 学生画了一座上面放着两朵花的小坟墓，以说明这个词的意思。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt il-fjuri? Mark: Fuq il-qbajjar tal-qattus, ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the flowers? Mark: On the cat's small grave, beside the tree.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把花放在哪里了？马克：放在树旁那座猫咪的小坟墓上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你把花放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the flowers?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.zh: 放在树旁那座猫咪的小坟墓上了。
messages.en: On the cat's small grave, beside the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qabar“坟墓”和 qbajjar“小坟墓”并排记忆，想象大图旁边的一张缩小图；这个指小关系只用于记住本词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small lease; the diminutive form of qbiela.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小规模的租约；qbiela（租约）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qbiela żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qbiela.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small lease (the diminutive form of 'qbiela')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小规模租约；qbiela（租约）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small lease for one year
collocations.zh: 一份为期一年的小规模租约

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jiddeskrivi qbejla ta' biċċa art żgħira għal sena.
formal.en: The agreement describes a small lease of a small plot of land for one year.
formal.zh: 协议说明了一份租用小块土地、为期一年的小规模租约。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif se tuża dik il-biċċa art? Mark: Għandi qbejla għal sena u se nkabbar il-ħaxix hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: How are you going to use that plot of land? Mark: I have a small lease for a year, and I'm going to grow vegetables there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你打算怎么使用那块地？马克：我有一份为期一年的小规模租约，打算在那里种菜。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se tuża dik il-biċċa art?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se tuża dik il-biċċa art?
messages.zh: 你打算怎么使用那块地？
messages.en: How are you going to use that plot of land?

messages.speaker: Mark (承租人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi qbejla għal sena u se nkabbar il-ħaxix hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi qbejla għal sena u se nkabbar il-ħaxix hemm.
messages.zh: 我有一份为期一年的小规模租约，打算在那里种菜。
messages.en: I have a small lease for a year, and I'm going to grow vegetables there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qbiela“租约”和 qbejla“小规模租约”配成一组，想象一小块菜地配着一份租约，记住租赁这一核心意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small jump; the diminutive form of qabża.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 幅度较小的一次跳跃；qabża（一次跳跃）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qabża żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qabża.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small jump (the diminutive form of 'qabża')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小跳；轻轻一跃；qabża（一次跳跃）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small jump on the spot

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, kull student jagħmel qbejża fuq il-post u mbagħad jieqaf.
formal.en: In the exercise, each student makes a small jump on the spot and then stops.
formal.zh: 练习中，每名学生先原地小跳一下，然后停下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irrid naqbeż 'il fuq ħafna? Lara: Le, agħmel qbejża fuq il-post biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do I need to jump very high? Lara: No, just make a small jump on the spot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我要跳得很高吗？拉拉：不用，只要原地轻轻跳一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 我要跳得很高吗？
messages.en: Do I need to jump very high?

messages.speaker: Lara (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, agħmel qbejża fuq il-post biss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, agħmel qbejża fuq il-post biss.
messages.zh: 不用，只要原地轻轻跳一下。
messages.en: No, just make a small jump on the spot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qabża“一次跳跃”缩成脚尖轻轻离地的 qbejża“小跳”，边读边做一次小跳，记住它指一次小幅动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of grasping something or catching something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手抓握某物，或接住、捕捉某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li taqbad xi ħaġa, bħal meta żżomm ħabel jew tilqa' ballun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓握；抓住并握持某物的动作。
接住；捕捉；把移动中的对象抓住或接住的动作。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tinkludi żewġ attivitajiet: il-qbid ta' ħabel b'id waħda u l-qbid ta' ballun b'żewġ idejn.
formal.en: The lesson includes two activities: grasping a rope with one hand and catching a ball with both hands.
formal.zh: 这节课包括两项活动：单手抓握绳子，以及双手接球。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'se nipprattikaw illum? Lara: Il-qbid tal-ballun. Jien nitfgħu bil-mod u int taqbdu b'żewġ idejn.
colloquial.en: Mark: What are we going to practise today? Lara: Catching the ball. I'll throw it gently, and you catch it with both hands.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们今天练什么？拉拉：接球。我轻轻把球扔过去，你用双手接住。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.zh: 我们今天练什么？
messages.en: What are we going to practise today?

messages.speaker: Lara (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qbid tal-ballun. Jien nitfgħu bil-mod u int taqbdu b'żewġ idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qbid tal-ballun. Jien nitfgħu bil-mod u int taqbdu b'żewġ idejn.
messages.zh: 接球。我轻轻把球扔过去，你用双手接住。
messages.en: Catching the ball. I'll throw it gently, and you catch it with both hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅手部画面记 qbid：手握住绳子是“抓握”，双手接住飞来的球是“接住”；共同点都是抓住对象的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods that can be seized.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以被扣押的货物或财物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti jew merkanzija li jistgħu jiġu maqbuda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可扣押的货物或财物。

collocations.en: the value of the seizable goods

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tat-taħriġ, il-lista tal-qbida tinkludi għamara u tagħmir.
formal.en: In the training example, the list of seizable goods includes furniture and equipment.
formal.zh: 在培训示例中，可扣押财物清单包括家具和设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'qbida' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Oġġetti li jistgħu jiġu maqbuda; hawn għandna nagħmlu lista tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'qbida' mean in this exercise? Mark: Goods that can be seized; here we need to make a list of them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里的 qbida 是什么意思？马克：可以被扣押的财物；这里要求我们把它们列成清单。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的 qbida 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qbida' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (培训教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Oġġetti li jistgħu jiġu maqbuda; hawn għandna nagħmlu lista tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Oġġetti li jistgħu jiġu maqbuda; hawn għandna nagħmlu lista tagħhom.
messages.zh: 可以被扣押的财物；这里要求我们把它们列成清单。
messages.en: Goods that can be seized; here we need to make a list of them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qbida 想象成一张标题写着“可扣押财物”的清单，下面列着家具和设备，帮助记住这里指的是财物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Agreement between people, or the process of reaching mutually acceptable terms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们意见一致的状态，或经过商议达成双方可接受条件的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta n-nies ikunu tal-istess fehma jew jaslu għal kundizzjonijiet aċċettabbli għal kulħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同意；一致；各方持有相同意见或接受同一安排的状态。
经协商达成共识；商定各方能够接受的条件。

collocations.zh: 就价格达成的一致意见

collocations.en: by agreement between the two sides

formal.mt: Wara diskussjoni twila, intlaħaq qbil dwar il-prezz u d-data tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: After a lengthy discussion, agreement was reached on the price and the delivery date.
formal.zh: 经过长时间讨论，各方就价格和交货日期达成了共识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm qbil li niltaqgħu fis-sitta? Mark: Iva, kulħadd qal li dak il-ħin tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is everyone agreed that we'll meet at six? Mark: Yes, everyone said that time works.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家都同意六点见面吗？马克：是啊，大家都说那个时间可以。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 大家都同意六点见面吗？
messages.en: Is everyone agreed that we'll meet at six?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd qal li dak il-ħin tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd qal li dak il-ħin tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是啊，大家都说那个时间可以。
messages.en: Yes, everyone said that time works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到两个人商量时间，最后都在“六点”旁打勾：商量后达成共识，以及最后意见一致，都能帮助记住 qbil。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of jumping or leaping, or the act or result of leaving something out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跳跃、腾跃的动作；也指跳过某项内容的行为，或由此造成的遗漏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li taqbeż, jew li tħalli barra xi ħaġa, bħal kelma waqt il-qari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳跃；身体离开支撑面后再落下的动作。
腾跃；跃起或向前跃出的动作。
跳过；省去；不把某项内容包括在内的行为。
遗漏；某项内容未被读出、写出或包括在内的情况。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-isport, 'qbiż' jirreferi għall-moviment tal-ġisem; f'eżerċizzju tal-qari, jista' jirreferi għall-qbiż ta' kliem jew linji.
formal.en: In a sports lesson, 'qbiż' refers to bodily movement; in a reading exercise, it can refer to leaving out words or lines.
formal.zh: 在体育课中，qbiż 指身体的跳跃动作；在阅读练习中，它可以指漏读词语或整行文字。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta naqra malajr, kultant ikun hemm qbiż ta' kliem. Mark: Ipprova aqra aktar bil-mod u segwi kull linja b'subgħajk.
colloquial.en: Lara: When I read quickly, I sometimes leave out words. Mark: Try reading more slowly and following each line with your finger.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我读得快的时候，有时会漏词。马克：试着读慢一点，用手指跟着每一行读。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta naqra malajr, kultant ikun hemm qbiż ta' kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Meta naqra malajr, kultant ikun hemm qbiż ta' kliem.
messages.zh: 我读得快的时候，有时会漏词。
messages.en: When I read quickly, I sometimes leave out words.

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova aqra aktar bil-mod u segwi kull linja b'subgħajk.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova aqra aktar bil-mod u segwi kull linja b'subgħajk.
messages.zh: 试着读慢一点，用手指跟着每一行读。
messages.en: Try reading more slowly and following each line with your finger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“跳”串联 qbiż 的用法：身体跳起来是跳跃，视线跳过文字会造成遗漏；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 自以为比别人更虔诚、更高尚的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who acts as though they are more holy or morally superior to others; a diminutive form of qaddis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得仿佛自己比别人更虔诚或更有道德的人，带有贬义；是 qaddis 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib ruħha bħallikieku hi aktar qaddisa jew aħjar moralment mill-oħrajn; forma diminuttiva ta' qaddis.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is holier than thou (the diminutive form of 'qaddis')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 自以为比别人更虔诚、更高尚的人，含贬义；qaddis 的指小形式。

collocations.zh: 摆出比别人更高尚的姿态

collocations.en: to speak like someone who thinks they are morally superior
collocations.zh: 像自命清高的人一样说话

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qdejdes jikkritika l-imġiba ta' kulħadd u jqis lilu nnifsu bħala eżempju ta' virtù.
formal.en: In the story, the holier-than-thou character criticizes everyone's conduct and considers himself an example of virtue.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个自命清高的人批评所有人的行为，并把自己视为美德的典范。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem jikkritika lil kulħadd? Rita: Għax iġib ruħu ta' qdejdes, bħallikieku hu qatt ma jiżbalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Pawlu always criticize everyone? Rita: Because he acts holier than thou, as if he never makes a mistake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么保罗总是批评所有人？丽塔：因为他总摆出自命清高的样子，好像自己从来不会犯错。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem jikkritika lil kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu dejjem jikkritika lil kulħadd?
messages.zh: 为什么保罗总是批评所有人？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu always criticize everyone?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax iġib ruħu ta' qdejdes, bħallikieku hu qatt ma jiżbalja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iġib ruħu ta' qdejdes, bħallikieku hu qatt ma jiżbalja.
messages.zh: 因为他总摆出自命清高的样子，好像自己从来不会犯错。
messages.en: Because he acts holier than thou, as if he never makes a mistake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人站上小凳子，声称自己比所有人都高尚；用这个夸张画面记住该词的贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large vessel used for drinking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来喝饮料的大型容器，例如大饮杯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir li jintuża għax-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何大型饮用容器。

collocations.en: a large drinking vessel full of water
to drink from a large vessel
collocations.zh: 用大型饮用容器喝东西

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda tqiegħed qdieħ mimli ilma għall-mistednin.
formal.en: A large drinking vessel filled with water was placed on the table for the guests.
formal.zh: 桌上放了一个装满水的大型饮用容器，供客人使用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-qdieħ? Għandi għatx kbir. Lara: Fuq il-mejda; imlieh bl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the large drinking vessel? I'm very thirsty. Lara: On the table; fill it with water.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那个大饮杯在哪里？我渴极了。拉拉：在桌上；你把它装满水吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-qdieħ? Għandi għatx kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-qdieħ? Għandi għatx kbir.
messages.zh: 那个大饮杯在哪里？我渴极了。
messages.en: Where is the large drinking vessel? I'm very thirsty.

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 在桌上；你把它装满水吧。
messages.en: On the table; fill it with water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一幅双手捧着大饮杯喝水的画面，重点记住容器较大而且用于饮用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of rowing; also, effort or hard work in general.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用桨推动船只的活动；也泛指付出的努力或辛劳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tmexxi dgħajsa bil-moqdief; ukoll, sforz jew xogħol iebes b'mod ġenerali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划船；用桨推动船只的活动。

sense_translations.en_definition: general term for effort or hard work
sense_translations.zh_definition: 泛指努力、辛劳或艰苦劳动。

collocations.en: after a great deal of effort

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi taħriġ tal-qdif biex il-parteċipanti jitgħallmu jmexxu dgħajsa flimkien.
formal.en: The programme includes rowing training so that participants learn to move a boat together.
formal.zh: 该课程包括划船训练，让参与者学习共同划动一条船。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Irnexxielkom tlestu x-xogħol? Toni: Iva, imma wara ħafna qdif!
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you manage to finish the work? Toni: Yes, but it took a lot of hard work!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们把工作做完了吗？托尼：做完了，不过可费了不少力气！

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你们把工作做完了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to finish the work?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 做完了，不过可费了不少力气！
messages.en: Yes, but it took a lot of hard work!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个相连的学习画面记忆：先是用力划船，再是埋头完成苦活；分别对应划船与辛劳两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Antiquity: great age or the ancient past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 古老、年代久远的性质，或久远的古代时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qedem: il-fatt li xi ħaġa hija antika ħafna, jew iż-żmien tal-qedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古老；久远年代；古代。

formal.mt: Il-qdum tal-bini jidher fil-ġebel u fid-dettalji tal-faċċata.
formal.en: The antiquity of the building is evident in its stonework and the details of its façade.
formal.zh: 从建筑的石砌部分和外立面的细节，可以看出它的古老。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif taf li dan il-bini huwa antik ħafna? Paul: Il-qdum tiegħu jidher fil-ġebel; ħares lejn dawn id-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you know this building is very old? Paul: Its antiquity shows in the stonework; look at these details.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么知道这栋建筑年代很久了？保罗：从石砌部分就能看出它的古老；看看这些细节。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif taf li dan il-bini huwa antik ħafna?
messages.mt_standard: Kif taf li dan il-bini huwa antik ħafna?
messages.zh: 你怎么知道这栋建筑年代很久了？
messages.en: How do you know this building is very old?

messages.speaker: Paul (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qdum tiegħu jidher fil-ġebel; ħares lejn dawn id-dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qdum tiegħu jidher fil-ġebel; ħares lejn dawn id-dettalji.
messages.zh: 从石砌部分就能看出它的古老；看看这些细节。
messages.en: Its antiquity shows in the stonework; look at these details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象古建筑石墙上层层留下的岁月痕迹，把 qdum 与古老、年代久远这一名词概念相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Antiquity: the quality of being ancient or belonging to the distant past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物古老、年代久远的性质，或遥远的古代。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qedem: il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa antika ħafna, jew iż-żmien imbiegħed tal-imgħoddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古老；久远年代；古代。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-qduma tal-manuskritt permezz tal-kitba u tal-materjal tiegħu.
formal.en: The study examines the antiquity of the manuscript through its handwriting and material.
formal.zh: 这项研究通过手稿的笔迹和材质，考察其年代的久远程度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ktieb għandu sinjali ta' qduma? Ben: Iva, imma biex inkunu nafu kemm hu antik irridu nistaqsu espert.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this book show signs of antiquity? Ben: Yes, but to know how old it is we need to ask an expert.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书有年代久远的迹象吗？本：有，不过要知道它究竟有多古老，我们得问问专家。

messages.speaker: Sara (藏书爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb għandu sinjali ta' qduma?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb għandu sinjali ta' qduma?
messages.zh: 这本书有年代久远的迹象吗？
messages.en: Does this book show signs of antiquity?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma biex inkunu nafu kemm hu antik irridu nistaqsu espert.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma biex inkunu nafu kemm hu antik irridu nistaqsu espert.
messages.zh: 有，不过要知道它究竟有多古老，我们得问问专家。
messages.en: Yes, but to know how old it is we need to ask an expert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qduma 配上古老手稿的学习卡片，记住它表示古老这一性质；不要仅凭词尾另造词义区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend one's body downward at the waist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从腰部向下弯曲身体，即弯腰或俯身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħawweġ ġismu 'l isfel minn qaddu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bend one's body from the waist downwards
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从腰部向下弯曲身体；弯腰，俯身。

collocations.en: he bent down to pick something up
he bent down towards the ground

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem qeba biex jiġbor l-għodda li kienet waqgħet mal-art.
formal.en: The worker bent down to pick up the tool that had fallen to the ground.
formal.zh: 工人弯下腰，捡起掉在地上的工具。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark qeba ħdejn il-mejda? Nina: Biex jiġbor iċ-ċavetta li waqgħetlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark bend down beside the table? Nina: To pick up the key he dropped.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么在桌子旁弯下腰？妮娜：为了捡起他掉落的钥匙。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么在桌子旁弯下腰？
messages.en: Why did Mark bend down beside the table?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了捡起他掉落的钥匙。
messages.en: To pick up the key he dropped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 边读 qeba 边想象自己从腰部弯下去捡钥匙，把词义固定在弯腰这个具体动作上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone shiver because of cold; the usage may be dialectal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人因寒冷而发抖；这一用法可能属于方言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitriegħed bil-bard; dan l-użu jista' jkun djalettali.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. shiver with cold (possibly dialectal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人冷得发抖，可能为方言用法。

collocations.en: the wind made the boy shiver with cold
the cold water made Mark shiver

formal.mt: Ir-riħ kiesaħ qebbex lit-tifel waqt li kien qed jistenna barra.
formal.en: The cold wind made the boy shiver while he was waiting outside.
formal.zh: 男孩在外面等候时，寒风吹得他冷得发抖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ħareġ mill-baħar daqshekk malajr? Rita: L-ilma kiesaħ qebbex lil Mark; issa għandu bżonn xugaman.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark get out of the sea so quickly? Rita: The cold water made Mark shiver; now he needs a towel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么这么快就从海里出来了？丽塔：冷水使马克冻得发抖；他现在需要一条毛巾。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ħareġ mill-baħar daqshekk malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ħareġ mill-baħar daqshekk malajr?
messages.zh: 马克为什么这么快就从海里出来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark get out of the sea so quickly?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma kiesaħ qebbex lil Mark; issa għandu bżonn xugaman.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma kiesaħ qebbex lil Mark; issa għandu bżonn xugaman.
messages.zh: 冷水使马克冻得发抖；他现在需要一条毛巾。
messages.en: The cold water made Mark shiver; now he needs a towel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一阵寒风把人吹得牙齿打战，记住这里强调使别人发抖，并保留可能为方言的提示。

gloss_zh: 把东西放到相应位置的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who puts things in their proper places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品放到各自相应位置的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed l-affarijiet fil-post tagħhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: (for qagħgħad) One who puts things in their place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西放到相应位置的人（此处作 qagħgħad 使用）。

collocations.en: a person who puts tools in their places
collocations.zh: 把工具放到相应位置的人

collocations.en: a person who puts books in their places
collocations.zh: 把书放到相应位置的人

formal.mt: F'din l-attività, il-qegħied jieħu l-oġġetti mingħand sħabu u jqiegħed kull wieħed fil-post tiegħu.
formal.en: In this activity, the person responsible for placing things takes the objects from their companions and puts each one in its place.
formal.zh: 在这项活动中，负责摆放物品的人从同伴手中接过物品，再把每一件放到相应的位置。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jkun il-qegħied illum? Mark: Jien; għaddili l-kotba u nqegħedhom fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will be the person putting things in place today? Mark: I will; pass me the books and I'll put them on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天谁来负责把东西放到相应位置？马克：我来；把书递给我，我会把它们放到书架上。

messages.speaker: Anna (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 今天谁来负责把东西放到相应位置？
messages.en: Who will be the person putting things in place today?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; għaddili l-kotba u nqegħedhom fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; għaddili l-kotba u nqegħedhom fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 我来；把书递给我，我会把它们放到书架上。
messages.en: I will; pass me the books and I'll put them on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象整理活动中专门接过书本并放回书架的那个人；用人物画面记住这是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 进行礼拜；从事敬拜活动

teaching_sense.en_definition: to perform acts of worship, such as prayer or religious devotion
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过祈祷或其他宗教行为表达敬拜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jagħmel atti ta' qima, bħal talb jew atti ta' devozzjoni reliġjuża.

sense_translations.en_definition: to engage in acts of worship
sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行礼拜或其他敬拜活动。

collocations.en: performed acts of worship through prayer

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fit-tempju, il-pellegrin qejjem permezz tat-talb fis-skiet.
formal.en: During his visit to the temple, the pilgrim performed acts of worship through silent prayer.
formal.zh: 朝圣者参访圣殿时，通过默祷进行敬拜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu fit-tempju? Pawla: Qejjem permezz tat-talb, imbagħad ħareġ magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do in the temple? Pawla: He worshipped through prayer, then came out with us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu在圣殿里做了什么？Pawla：他通过祈祷敬拜，然后和我们一起出来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu在圣殿里做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do in the temple?

messages.speaker: Pawla (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qejjem permezz tat-talb, imbagħad ħareġ magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Qejjem permezz tat-talb, imbagħad ħareġ magħna.
messages.zh: 他通过祈祷敬拜，然后和我们一起出来了。
messages.en: He worshipped through prayer, then came out with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把qejjem与圣殿中默默祈祷的动作联系起来：本词条记的是进行敬拜这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: to determine the size, length, amount, or other measurable property of something
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用工具或其他方法确定事物的长度、大小、数量等可测量的属性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed isib it-tul, id-daqs, il-kwantità jew karatteristika oħra ta' xi ħaġa permezz tal-kejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 测定事物的尺寸、数量或其他可量化的属性。

formal.mt: Qabel il-qtugħ, il-ħajjat qejjes id-drapp darbtejn biex jevita l-ħela.
formal.en: Before cutting, the tailor measured the fabric twice to avoid waste.
formal.zh: 裁剪前，裁缝量了两遍布料，以免浪费。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark diġà qejjes il-mejda? Pawlu: Iva, hi twila metru u nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark measured the table yet? Pawlu: Yes, it is one and a half metres long.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark已经量过桌子了吗？Pawlu：量过了，桌子长一米半。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: Mark已经量过桌子了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark measured the table yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hi twila metru u nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hi twila metru u nofs.
messages.zh: 量过了，桌子长一米半。
messages.en: Yes, it is one and a half metres long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裁缝把尺子放在布料上，读qejjes时就回想量长度的动作，把动词与实际操作绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: a person who takes part in worship or performs acts of religious devotion
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加礼拜或通过宗教行为表达敬拜的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel atti ta' qima jew tieħu sehem fil-qima reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行敬拜或参加礼拜的人。

formal.mt: Il-qejjiem devot baqa' fit-tempju wara ċ-ċerimonja biex jitlob fis-skiet.
formal.en: The devoted worshipper remained in the temple after the ceremony to pray in silence.
formal.zh: 仪式结束后，那位虔诚的敬拜者留在圣殿中默祷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-bieb? Pawlu: Hu qejjiem li jiġi hawn kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man by the door? Pawlu: He is a worshipper who comes here every week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：门边那个男人是谁？Pawlu：他是一位每周都来这里的敬拜者。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man by the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu qejjiem li jiġi hawn kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Hu qejjiem li jiġi hawn kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 他是一位每周都来这里的敬拜者。
messages.en: He is a worshipper who comes here every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给祈祷者画一张人物卡，卡上写qejjiem：这里指做敬拜动作的人，记忆焦点放在人物身份。

gloss_zh: 怀有敬畏的；表现崇敬的

teaching_sense.en_definition: showing a feeling of deep respect, awe, or veneration
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在态度、举止或表达中流露深切敬意、敬畏或崇敬的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri rispett profond, qima jew sens ta' riverenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现出敬畏或崇敬之情的。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem adotta ton qejjiemi waqt li ddeskriva s-sinifikat tat-tempju għall-komunità.
formal.en: The speaker adopted a reverent tone while describing the temple's significance for the community.
formal.zh: 发言者以崇敬的语气，讲述这座圣殿对社群的意义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Innutajt it-ton qejjiemi ta' Mark? Pawlu: Iva, tkellem b'rispett kbir dwar dak il-post.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you notice Mark's reverent tone? Pawlu: Yes, he spoke about that place with great respect.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你注意到Mark那种崇敬的语气了吗？Pawlu：注意到了，他谈起那个地方时十分恭敬。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你注意到Mark那种崇敬的语气了吗？
messages.en: Did you notice Mark's reverent tone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tkellem b'rispett kbir dwar dak il-post.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkellem b'rispett kbir dwar dak il-post.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他谈起那个地方时十分恭敬。
messages.en: Yes, he spoke about that place with great respect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把qejjiemi写在一张描述语气的卡片上，想象说话人轻声表达崇敬，用态度画面记住形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: an instrument or device that measures a quantity or performs calculations
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于测量某种量或进行计算的仪器、工具或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda jew apparat li jkejjel xi kwantità jew jagħmel kalkoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够测量或计算的器具或装置。

formal.mt: It-tekniku uża qejjies tal-pressjoni biex jiċċekkja s-sistema qabel it-test.
formal.en: The technician used a pressure gauge to check the system before the test.
formal.zh: 技术员在测试前用压力计检查了系统。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-qejjies tat-temperatura? Mark: Fil-kaxxa l-blu, ħdejn l-għodod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the temperature gauge? Mark: In the blue box, next to the tools.
colloquial.zh: Maja：温度测量仪在哪里？Mark：在蓝色盒子里，就在工具旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (技术员)
messages.zh: 温度测量仪在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the temperature gauge?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 在蓝色盒子里，就在工具旁边。
messages.en: In the blue box, next to the tools.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工具箱里一块会显示数值的仪表，在它上面贴qejjies标签，把这个名词记成测量或计算的器具。

gloss_zh: 能测量或计算的；行事审慎的

teaching_sense.en_definition: able to measure or calculate; also able to consider consequences before acting
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有测量或计算能力的；也指能在行动前考虑后果、做事审慎的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jkejjel jew jagħmel kalkoli; ukoll li kapaċi jqis il-konsegwenzi qabel jaġixxi.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to measure or calculate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有测量或计算能力的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having the capacity to consider the consequences before acting
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够在行动之前考虑后果的；行事审慎的。

collocations.en: a device capable of measuring or calculating
collocations.zh: 具有测量或计算能力的装置

collocations.en: a person who considers consequences before acting
collocations.zh: 行动前会考虑后果的人

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju għażel apparat qejjiesi li jista' jkejjel diversi kwantitajiet u jagħmel il-kalkoli meħtieġa.
formal.en: The laboratory selected a device capable of measuring various quantities and performing the necessary calculations.
formal.zh: 实验室选用了一台能够测量多种量并进行所需计算的装置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li Mark se jiddeċiedi malajr? Pawlu: Hu bniedem qejjiesi; l-ewwel jaħseb fil-konsegwenzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think Mark will decide quickly? Pawlu: He is a thoughtful person; he considers the consequences first.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得Mark会很快作决定吗？Pawlu：他做事审慎，会先考虑后果。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark se jiddeċiedi malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark se jiddeċiedi malajr?
messages.zh: 你觉得Mark会很快作决定吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark will decide quickly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu bniedem qejjiesi; l-ewwel jaħseb fil-konsegwenzi.
messages.mt_standard: Hu bniedem qejjiesi; l-ewwel jaħseb fil-konsegwenzi.
messages.zh: 他做事审慎，会先考虑后果。
messages.en: He is a thoughtful person; he considers the consequences first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅学习画面记qejjiesi：仪器能测量计算，人会先考虑后果；分别对应能力和审慎两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: the activity or process of measuring something
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确定事物尺寸、数量等属性的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih jitkejlu d-daqs, it-tul jew kwantitajiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 测量这一活动或过程。

formal.mt: Il-qejsien tad-drapp għandu jitlesta qabel ma jibda l-qtugħ.
formal.en: The measuring of the fabric must be completed before cutting begins.
formal.zh: 开始裁剪之前，必须完成布料的测量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lest il-qejsien tad-drapp? Mark: Għad mhux; fadalli biċċa waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the measuring of the fabric finished? Mark: Not yet; I have one piece left.
colloquial.zh: Maja：布料量完了吗？Mark：还没，还剩一块。

messages.speaker: Maja (裁缝)
messages.zh: 布料量完了吗？
messages.en: Is the measuring of the fabric finished?

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 还没，还剩一块。
messages.en: Not yet; I have one piece left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把qejsien写在工作流程的测量步骤上，想象从展开尺子到记录读数的全过程，记住它是活动名词。

gloss_zh: 躁动不安；浮躁易变；迈小步行走

teaching_sense.en_definition: to be restless or flighty, or to walk with short steps
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得躁动不安或浮躁易变；也可指迈着短小的步子行走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed ikun bla kwiet jew ibiddel ħsiebu faċilment; ukoll li jimxi b'passi qosra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躁动不安；难以安静下来。
浮躁易变；想法或兴趣容易改变。
迈着短小的步子行走。

formal.mt: Fit-triq lejn id-dar, it-tifel qeleq b'passi qosra ħdejn missieru.
formal.en: On the way home, the boy walked with short steps beside his father.
formal.zh: 回家路上，男孩在父亲身旁迈着小步走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien Leo waqt li stennejtu? Pawlu: Qeleq il-ħin kollu; ma setax joqgħod bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was Leo while you were waiting? Pawlu: He was restless the whole time; he could not stay seated.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们等候的时候，Leo怎么样？Pawlu：他一直躁动不安，坐不住。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien Leo waqt li stennejtu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien Leo waqt li stennejtu?
messages.zh: 你们等候的时候，Leo怎么样？
messages.en: How was Leo while you were waiting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qeleq il-ħin kollu; ma setax joqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Qeleq il-ħin kollu; ma setax joqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 他一直躁动不安，坐不住。
messages.en: He was restless the whole time; he could not stay seated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为qeleq画三格漫画：等候时坐不住、作选择时总变卦、走路时迈小步；用三个场景分别记住三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Destruction that seriously damages something or wipes it out completely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物受到严重破坏或完全消失的毁坏、毁灭。
