teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara kbira li tkisser xi ħaġa jew teqridha għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毁坏；破坏，指使事物遭受严重损害。
彻底毁灭；完全抹除，强调几乎不留痕迹。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-qerd tal-foresta wara n-nirien.
formal.en: The report describes the destruction of the forest after the fires.
formal.zh: 报告描述了火灾后森林遭到破坏的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt ir-ritratti tal-foresta wara n-nirien? Pawlu: Iva, x'qerd! Baqa' ftit siġar biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the photos of the forest after the fires? Pawlu: Yes, what destruction! Only a few trees remain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看过森林火灾后的照片吗？Pawlu：看过，破坏太严重了！只剩下几棵树。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过森林火灾后的照片吗？
messages.en: Did you see the photos of the forest after the fires?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, x'qerd! Baqa' ftit siġar biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, x'qerd! Baqa' ftit siġar biss.
messages.zh: 看过，破坏太严重了！只剩下几棵树。
messages.en: Yes, what destruction! Only a few trees remain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qerd 与一片被烧毁的森林画面相连：先记严重破坏，再记彻底毁灭，理解其程度可以不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deception, a false belief, or dishonest conduct intended to mislead someone or obtain an unfair benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人受误导的欺骗、与事实不符的错觉，或为牟取不正当利益而实施的欺诈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ingann, twemmin falz, jew aġir diżonest biex wieħed iqarraq b'xi ħadd jew jikseb vantaġġ mhux mistħoqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；以虚假言语、表象或行为使人受误导。
错觉；误信，指把不真实的事物当作真实的观念。
欺诈；通过不诚实手段谋取金钱或其他利益的行为。

collocations.en: to fall into a trap of deception

formal.mt: L-investigazzjoni kixfet qerq finanzjarju fil-bejgħ tal-biljetti.
formal.en: The investigation uncovered financial fraud in ticket sales.
formal.zh: 调查揭露了售票过程中的金融欺诈。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Bagħtuli messaġġ li rbaħt premju, imma jridu l-flus l-ewwel. Mark: Dan qerq. Tħallas xejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: They sent me a message saying I won a prize, but they want money first. Mark: That's a scam. Don't pay anything.
colloquial.zh: Sara：有人发消息说我中奖了，但要我先付钱。Mark：这是骗局。一分钱也别付。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bagħtuli messaġġ li rbaħt premju, imma jridu l-flus l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Bagħtuli messaġġ li rbaħt premju, imma jridu l-flus l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 有人发消息说我中奖了，但要我先付钱。
messages.en: They sent me a message saying I won a prize, but they want money first.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是骗局。一分钱也别付。
messages.en: That's a scam. Don't pay anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张假中奖短信记 qerq：别人设局是欺骗，自己误信可成错觉，借此骗钱就是欺诈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dwarf; naturally much smaller or shorter than the usual form of the same kind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 矮生的；指同类中自然长得明显较小或较矮的类型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ħafna iżgħar jew iqsar minn dak li hu normali għall-istess tip.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矮生的；矮小型的，形容同类中体型或高度明显较小的类型。

formal.mt: Għal dan il-ġnien żgħir, ġie magħżul arbuxxell qerqni li ma jeħtieġx ħafna spazju.
formal.en: A dwarf shrub that does not require much space was selected for this small garden.
formal.zh: 这座小花园选用了不需要太多空间的矮生灌木。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-arbuxxell se jikber ħafna? Toni: Le, huwa qerqni u jibqa' żgħir.
colloquial.en: Nina: Will this shrub grow very large? Toni: No, it's a dwarf variety and stays small.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这株灌木会长得很大吗？Toni：不会，它是矮生型的，会保持小巧。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这株灌木会长得很大吗？
messages.en: Will this shrub grow very large?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa qerqni u jibqa' żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa qerqni u jibqa' żgħir.
messages.zh: 不会，它是矮生型的，会保持小巧。
messages.en: No, it's a dwarf variety and stays small.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qerqni 写在矮生灌木的标签上，想象同类植物并排比较高度，记住它是描述矮小类型的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To acknowledge and confess one's sins or mistakes made in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坦白承认自己所犯的罪或过去的错误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jammetti u jistqarr id-dnubiet tiegħu jew l-iżbalji li għamel fil-passat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to confess to sins or past errors
sense_translations.zh_definition: 承认所犯的罪或过去的错误；认罪、坦白或忏悔。

formal.mt: Fl-istqarrija tiegħu, ir-raġel qerr l-iżbalji tal-passat u talab maħfra.
formal.en: In his statement, the man confessed his past mistakes and asked for forgiveness.
formal.zh: 这名男子在声明中坦白了过去的错误，并请求原谅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu qerr li kien hu li kiser it-tieqa? Ben: Iva, u talab skuża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu confess that he was the one who broke the window? Ben: Yes, and he apologized.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 承认窗户是他打破的吗？Ben：承认了，也道歉了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qerr li kien hu li kiser it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qerr li kien hu li kiser it-tieqa?
messages.zh: Pawlu 承认窗户是他打破的吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu confess that he was the one who broke the window?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 承认了，也道歉了。
messages.en: Yes, and he apologized.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“是我做错了，我愿意承认”的场景记 qerr；把坦白过错的动作与这个动词联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long, narrow piece of cloth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一条狭长的布料；布条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp twila u dejqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布条；一条狭长的布料。

formal.mt: L-istudent rabat il-biċċiet tal-kartun flimkien b'qerra twila.
formal.en: The student tied the pieces of cardboard together with a long strip of cloth.
formal.zh: 学生用一根长布条把几块纸板绑在一起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek xi ħaġa biex norbot din il-kaxxa? Rita: Iva, ħu din il-qerra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have anything I can use to tie up this box? Rita: Yes, take this strip of cloth.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有什么东西可以让我把这个盒子绑起来吗？Rita：有，拿这根布条吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi ħaġa biex norbot din il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi ħaġa biex norbot din il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 你有什么东西可以让我把这个盒子绑起来吗？
messages.en: Do you have anything I can use to tie up this box?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，拿这根布条吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this strip of cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一块布剪成长长窄窄的一条，再用它捆盒子；将这根具体的布条与 qerra 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To complain or whine persistently about things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续不断地抱怨或发牢骚，常带有令人厌烦的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilmenta l-ħin kollu, spiss b'mod li jdejjaq lil min jisimgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 老是哼哼唧唧地抱怨；不停发牢骚。

collocations.en: he kept complaining about the food

formal.mt: Matul il-vjaġġ, it-tifel qerred il-ħin kollu għax ried imur lura d-dar.
formal.en: During the journey, the boy whined the whole time because he wanted to go back home.
formal.zh: 旅途中，男孩因为想回家而一直发牢骚。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif mar il-vjaġġ ma' Ben? Lara: Qerred il-ħin kollu fuq is-sħana.
colloquial.en: Anna: How was the trip with Ben? Lara: He kept whining about the heat the whole time.
colloquial.zh: Anna：和 Ben 一起出行怎么样？Lara：他一路都在抱怨太热。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 和 Ben 一起出行怎么样？
messages.en: How was the trip with Ben?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他一路都在抱怨太热。
messages.en: He kept whining about the heat the whole time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qerred 和一段反复播放的抱怨录音联想起来，重点记住“不停地说不满意”，并看清词中双写的 rr。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually complains or whines; in another sense, someone who destroys things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常抱怨或发牢骚的人；另一个义项指毁坏事物的破坏者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tilmenta ħafna; f'tifsira oħra, persuna li teqred l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抱怨的人；经常发牢骚或哼哼唧唧的人。
破坏者；毁坏或摧毁事物的人。

collocations.en: a whiner who is always complaining

formal.mt: Fl-artiklu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi lir-raġel bħala qerried tal-ambjent minħabba l-ħsara li għamel lill-foresta.
formal.en: In the article, the author describes the man as a destroyer of the environment because of the damage he caused to the forest.
formal.zh: 作者在文章中称这名男子为环境破坏者，因为他损害了森林。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex tgħid li Ben qerried? Sam: Għax dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuq xiex jilmenta.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why do you say Ben is a whiner? Sam: Because he always finds something to complain about.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你为什么说 Ben 是个牢骚鬼？Sam：因为他总能找到事情来抱怨。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说 Ben 是个牢骚鬼？
messages.en: Why do you say Ben is a whiner?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuq xiex jilmenta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuq xiex jilmenta.
messages.zh: 因为他总能找到事情来抱怨。
messages.en: Because he always finds something to complain about.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qerried 画两张人物卡：一人不停抱怨，一人毁坏东西；读句子时借周围内容判断是哪一张卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Destruction: the damaging or ruining of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物遭到损坏、摧毁或毁灭的破坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkissir jew it-telf ta' xi ħaġa minħabba ħsara kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毁坏；毁灭，指事物受到严重破坏。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-qerrieda tal-għelieqi wara l-għargħar.
formal.en: The report describes the destruction of the fields after the flood.
formal.zh: 报告描述了洪水过后田地遭到毁坏的情况。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt l-għelieqi wara l-għargħar? Toni: Iva, kien hemm qerrieda kbira. Il-bdiewa tilfu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you see the fields after the flood? Toni: Yes, there was great destruction. The farmers lost a lot.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你看过洪水过后的田地吗？Toni：看过，毁坏很严重。农民损失很大。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看过洪水过后的田地吗？
messages.en: Did you see the fields after the flood?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien hemm qerrieda kbira. Il-bdiewa tilfu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien hemm qerrieda kbira. Il-bdiewa tilfu ħafna.
messages.zh: 看过，毁坏很严重。农民损失很大。
messages.en: Yes, there was great destruction. The farmers lost a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用洪水冲毁田地的画面记 qerrieda，把注意力放在“毁坏”这件事及其结果，并完整记住词尾的 a。

gloss_zh: 爱哼哼抱怨的；具有破坏性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to whine or complain, or inclined to cause destruction, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可形容人爱哼哼抱怨，也可形容人或事物具有破坏性；具体意思取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jeqred jew li joqgħod igerger, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱哼哼抱怨的；动不动就发牢骚的
倾向于毁坏事物的；具有破坏性的

collocations.zh: 一个爱哼哼抱怨的男孩

formal.mt: Ir-riħ qerriedi għamel ħsara kbira lis-siġar u lis-soqfa tad-djar.
formal.en: The destructive wind caused extensive damage to trees and house roofs.
formal.zh: 破坏性的风给树木和房屋屋顶造成了严重损坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħid li Pawlu hu qerriedi llum? Mark: Għax ilu jgerger minn filgħodu; xejn ma jogħġbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you saying Pawlu is whiny today? Mark: Because he has been complaining since this morning; nothing pleases him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说保罗今天爱发牢骚？马克：因为他从早上就一直抱怨，什么都不满意。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li Pawlu hu qerriedi llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li Pawlu hu qerriedi llum?
messages.zh: 你为什么说保罗今天爱发牢骚？
messages.en: Why are you saying Pawlu is whiny today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilu jgerger minn filgħodu; xejn ma jogħġbu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilu jgerger minn filgħodu; xejn ma jogħġbu.
messages.zh: 因为他从早上就一直抱怨，什么都不满意。
messages.en: Because he has been complaining since this morning; nothing pleases him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分开记忆：孩子不停抱怨，狂风摧毁屋顶。遇到这个形容词，先看它修饰的是谁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small cage; the diminutive form of qafas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积较小的笼子，是 qafas 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qafas żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qafas.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small cage (the diminutive form of 'qafas')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小笼子；qafas 的指小形式

collocations.en: the door of the small cage

formal.mt: Il-qfajjes tal-metall għandu bieba żgħira fuq quddiem.
formal.en: The small metal cage has a little door at the front.
formal.zh: 这个金属小笼子的正面有一扇小门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt il-qfajjes? Toni: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the small cage? Toni: On the table, next to the window.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你把小笼子放在哪里了？托尼：在桌子上，窗户旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你把小笼子放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the small cage?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 在桌子上，窗户旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qafas 想成普通笼子，再把画面缩小成 qfajjes；将两个词配成“大笼子与小笼子”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small basket carried by hand; the diminutive form of qoffa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手提的小篮子，是 qoffa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoffa żgħira li tinġarr bl-id; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qoffa.

sense_translations.en_definition: small hand basket (the diminutive form of 'qoffa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小手提篮；qoffa 的指小形式

collocations.en: a small basket full of fruit

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda kien hemm qfejfa tal-qasab mimlija frott frisk.
formal.en: On the table there was a small reed basket full of fresh fruit.
formal.zh: 桌上放着一个装满新鲜水果的苇编小手提篮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek qfejfa għall-frott? Rita: Iva, ħu din; għandha manku komdu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a small basket for the fruit? Rita: Yes, take this one; it has a comfortable handle.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有装水果的小手提篮吗？丽塔：有，拿这个吧，提手握着很舒服。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 你有装水果的小手提篮吗？
messages.en: Do you have a small basket for the fruit?

messages.speaker: Rita (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din; għandha manku komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din; għandha manku komdu.
messages.zh: 有，拿这个吧，提手握着很舒服。
messages.en: Yes, take this one; it has a comfortable handle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里提着一只只装几颗水果的小篮子，把 qoffa 与它的指小形式 qfejfa 配成一组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small cord used for tying things; the diminutive form of qafla.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于捆扎物品的小绳或细绳，是 qafla 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qafla żgħira li tintuża biex torbot xi ħaġa; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qafla.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small cord (the diminutive form of 'qafla')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小绳；细绳；qafla 的指小形式

collocations.en: to tie with a small cord

formal.mt: Il-pakkett kien marbut b'qfejla tal-qoton biex jibqa' magħluq.
formal.en: The parcel was tied with a small cotton cord to keep it closed.
formal.zh: 包裹用一根棉质小绳扎着，以保持封闭。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għandek qfejla biex norbot dan il-pakkett? Sara: Iva, hemm waħda fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Do you have a small cord so I can tie this parcel? Sara: Yes, there is one in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你有小绳让我扎一下这个包裹吗？萨拉：有，抽屉里有一根。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek qfejla biex norbot dan il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek qfejla biex norbot dan il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 你有小绳让我扎一下这个包裹吗？
messages.en: Do you have a small cord so I can tie this parcel?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 有，抽屉里有一根。
messages.en: Yes, there is one in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小绳扎小包裹”的动作记住 qfejla，再与 qafla 配对记忆，突出它是指小形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of locking something away, or deterrence that discourages an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把东西锁起存放的行为，也可指使人打消行动念头的威慑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għeluq ta' xi ħaġa taħt serratura, jew it-trażżin ta' azzjoni permezz ta' deterrent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西锁起存放；锁藏
威慑；使人因顾忌后果而不敢行动的阻遏作用

collocations.en: locking things away as a deterrent
collocations.zh: 以锁起存放的方式起到威慑作用

formal.mt: Il-qfil tad-dokumenti f'armarju jillimita l-aċċess għalihom u jista' jservi ta' deterrent kontra s-serq.
formal.en: Locking documents away in a cabinet limits access to them and can serve as a deterrent against theft.
formal.zh: 把文件锁在柜中可限制他人取用，也能对盗窃起到威慑作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hu importanti l-qfil ta' dawn il-fajls? Mark: Biex jibqgħu siguri; wara li tużahom, erġa' sakkarhom fl-armarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is locking these files away important? Mark: To keep them safe; after using them, lock them back in the cabinet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么把这些档案锁起来很重要？马克：为了妥善保管；用完后把它们重新锁进柜子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hu importanti l-qfil ta' dawn il-fajls?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hu importanti l-qfil ta' dawn il-fajls?
messages.zh: 为什么把这些档案锁起来很重要？
messages.en: Why is locking these files away important?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jibqgħu siguri; wara li tużahom, erġa' sakkarhom fl-armarju.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jibqgħu siguri; wara li tużahom, erġa' sakkarhom fl-armarju.
messages.zh: 为了妥善保管；用完后把它们重新锁进柜子里。
messages.en: To keep them safe; after using them, lock them back in the cabinet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“锁好文件”和“使人却步”两张学习卡分别记两个义项；前者强调锁藏动作，后者强调威慑作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Remaining in one place, or the condition of being without employment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指待在原处不移动，也可指没有工作的失业状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed jibqa' f'post wieħed, jew il-qagħda ta' min hu bla xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 待在原处；停留不动
失业；没有工作的状态

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina r-rata tal-qgħad fost iż-żgħażagħ u l-opportunitajiet ta' taħriġ disponibbli għalihom.
formal.en: The report examines the unemployment rate among young people and the training opportunities available to them.
formal.zh: 该报告研究了青年失业率以及可供他们选择的培训机会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Sibt xogħol ġdid? Toni: Iva, wara perjodu ta' qgħad, se nibda naħdem nhar it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you found a new job? Toni: Yes, after a period of unemployment, I am starting work on Monday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你找到新工作了吗？托尼：找到了，失业一段时间后，我星期一就开始上班了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你找到新工作了吗？
messages.en: Have you found a new job?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wara perjodu ta' qgħad, se nibda naħdem nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wara perjodu ta' qgħad, se nibda naħdem nhar it-Tnejn.
messages.zh: 找到了，失业一段时间后，我星期一就开始上班了。
messages.en: Yes, after a period of unemployment, I am starting work on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将两个义项分别放进“位置”和“就业”两个抽屉：位置语境记停留，工作与统计语境记失业。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The layer of muscles and supporting tissues at the base of the pelvis that helps support the pelvic organs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于骨盆底部、帮助支撑盆腔器官的肌肉及支持组织层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-saff ta' muskoli u tessuti fil-parti t'isfel tal-pelvi li jgħin biex isostni l-organi tal-pelvi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盆底；位于骨盆底部、支撑盆腔器官的肌肉及支持组织

collocations.en: the function of the pelvic floor

formal.mt: Il-qiegħ tal-pelvi jinkludi muskoli u tessuti li jgħinu biex isostnu l-organi tal-pelvi.
formal.en: The pelvic floor includes muscles and tissues that help support the pelvic organs.
formal.zh: 盆底包含帮助支撑盆腔器官的肌肉和组织。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn jinsab il-qiegħ tal-pelvi f'din l-istampa? Mark: Hawn, fil-parti t'isfel tal-pelvi; dawn huma l-muskoli tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the pelvic floor in this picture? Mark: Here, at the bottom of the pelvis; these are its muscles.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张图里的盆底在哪里？马克：这里，在骨盆底部；这些就是盆底的肌肉。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn jinsab il-qiegħ tal-pelvi f'din l-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn jinsab il-qiegħ tal-pelvi f'din l-istampa?
messages.zh: 这张图里的盆底在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the pelvic floor in this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, fil-parti t'isfel tal-pelvi; dawn huma l-muskoli tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, fil-parti t'isfel tal-pelvi; dawn huma l-muskoli tiegħu.
messages.zh: 这里，在骨盆底部；这些就是盆底的肌肉。
messages.en: Here, at the bottom of the pelvis; these are its muscles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把骨盆想象成一个盆，盆底像承托器官的柔韧底座；对着解剖图把整个短语与底部位置对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To seek a sheltered place in which to rest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻找一个有遮蔽的地方，以便停下来休息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fittex post għall-kenn biex jistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寻找遮蔽处休息。

collocations.en: sought shelter under a tree to rest
collocations.zh: 找了棵树，在树下避蔽歇息

collocations.en: sought a shady place to rest

formal.mt: Wara mixja twila fix-xemx, il-vjaġġatur qiel taħt siġra biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After a long walk in the sun, the traveller sought shelter under a tree to rest.
formal.zh: 在烈日下走了很长一段路后，旅人找了一棵树，在树下避蔽休息。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn mar Pawlu wara l-mixja? Toni: Qiel fid-dell ta' siġra; kien għajjien.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where did Pawlu go after the walk? Toni: He found shelter in the shade of a tree to rest; he was tired.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：散步后保罗去哪儿了？托尼：他找了棵树，在树荫下歇息；他累了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 散步后保罗去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go after the walk?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiel fid-dell ta' siġra; kien għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Qiel fid-dell ta' siġra; kien għajjien.
messages.zh: 他找了棵树，在树荫下歇息；他累了。
messages.en: He found shelter in the shade of a tree to rest; he was tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qiel 配成一幅画：旅人先找树荫，再坐下歇脚；同时记住“找遮蔽处”和“休息”两个要点。

gloss_zh: 谨慎的；行动前会思考的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cautious and inclined to think carefully before acting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事谨慎、倾向于在行动前先认真考虑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joqgħod attent u jaħseb sew qabel jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谨慎的；小心行事的。
倾向于先思考再行动的；行事审慎的。

formal.mt: Bħala bniedem qiesi, Mark qara l-kundizzjonijiet kollha qabel iffirma l-ftehim.
formal.en: Being a cautious person, Mark read all the conditions before signing the agreement.
formal.zh: 马克为人谨慎，在签署协议前阅读了全部条款。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark għadu ma ddeċidiex? Nina: Le, hu qiesi; irid jaħseb sew qabel jagħżel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Mark still not decided? Nina: No, he thinks before acting; he wants to consider things carefully before choosing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克还没决定吗？妮娜：还没有，他做事审慎；他想仔细考虑后再选。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还没决定吗？
messages.en: Has Mark still not decided?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu qiesi; irid jaħseb sew qabel jagħżel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu qiesi; irid jaħseb sew qabel jagħżel.
messages.zh: 还没有，他做事审慎；他想仔细考虑后再选。
messages.en: No, he thinks before acting; he wants to consider things carefully before choosing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qiesi 配上“行动前按暂停键”的画面：先想清楚，再迈步，便能一起记住谨慎和三思两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hold back from doing something or deliberately leave it undone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 克制自己而不去做某事，或有意避免采取某个行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żamm lura milli jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 克制而不做某事；避免去做。

formal.mt: Matul id-diskussjoni, Mark qiet milli jintervjeni sakemm sema' l-opinjonijiet kollha.
formal.en: During the discussion, Mark refrained from intervening until he had heard all the opinions.
formal.zh: 讨论期间，马克在听完所有意见之前一直克制自己，没有介入。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu wieġeb meta sema' l-kumment? Lara: Le, qiet milli jitkellem biex ma jibdiex argument.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu respond when he heard the comment? Lara: No, he refrained from speaking so as not to start an argument.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗听到那句评论后回应了吗？拉拉：没有，他忍住没开口，免得吵起来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗听到那句评论后回应了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu respond when he heard the comment?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qiet milli jitkellem biex ma jibdiex argument.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qiet milli jitkellem biex ma jibdiex argument.
messages.zh: 没有，他忍住没开口，免得吵起来。
messages.en: No, he refrained from speaking so as not to start an argument.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 qiet 时想象话到嘴边又收住：重点是主动忍住不做，把它和“克制行动”的画面绑定。

gloss_zh: 工间小憩；干活断断续续或懒散的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short break from work; also, a person who works intermittently or lazily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工作中的短暂休息；也可指干活断断续续或懒散的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wa qfa qasira mix-xogħol; ukoll persuna li taħdem b'intervalli jew b'għażż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作中的片刻休息；工间小憩。
干活断断续续或懒散的人。

collocations.en: took a brief break from work

collocations.zh: 那个干活断断续续或懒散的人

formal.mt: Wara sagħtejn ta' xogħol fil-ġnien, Pawlu ħa qila qasira qabel kompla.
formal.en: After two hours of work in the garden, Pawlu took a short break before continuing.
formal.zh: 在花园里干了两个小时的活后，保罗短暂休息了一会儿，然后继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu reġa' waqaf mix-xogħol? Toni: Iva, ħa qila. Marta: Mela għalhekk issejjaħlu qila? Toni: Iva, għax jaħdem ftit u jieqaf spiss.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has Pawlu stopped working again? Toni: Yes, he has taken a short break. Marta: So is that why you call him a lazy worker? Toni: Yes, because he does a little work and stops often.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗又停下工作了吗？托尼：是啊，他歇了一会儿。玛尔塔：所以你才叫他懒散的工人？托尼：对，因为他干一点活就停，经常这样。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗又停下工作了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu stopped working again?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 是啊，他歇了一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, he has taken a short break.

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 所以你才叫他懒散的工人？
messages.en: So is that why you call him a lazy worker?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax jaħdem ftit u jieqaf spiss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax jaħdem ftit u jieqaf spiss.
messages.zh: 对，因为他干一点活就停，经常这样。
messages.en: Yes, because he does a little work and stops often.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qila 画两张词义卡：一张是工间小憩，一张是干干停停的人；这是帮助区分用法的联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be restless; also, to walk with short steps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得不安定、坐立不安；也可指迈着短小的步子走路。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kien bla kwiet; ukoll mexa b'passi qosra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐立不安；处于不安定的状态。
迈小步走路；以短步行走。

collocations.en: walked along the corridor with short steps

formal.mt: Waqt li kien qed jistenna r-riżultat, it-tifel qileq u ma setax joqgħod bilqiegħda.
formal.en: While waiting for the result, the boy was restless and could not remain seated.
formal.zh: 等待结果时，男孩坐立不安，无法一直坐着。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif mexa n-nannu sal-bieb? Mark: Qileq b'passi qosra, u jien imxejt ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Grandpa walk to the door? Mark: He walked with short steps, and I walked beside him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：爷爷是怎么走到门口的？马克：他迈着小步走，我就在旁边陪着他。

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷是怎么走到门口的？
messages.en: How did Grandpa walk to the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Qileq b'passi qosra, u jien imxejt ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Qileq b'passi qosra, u jien imxejt ħdejh.
messages.zh: 他迈着小步走，我就在旁边陪着他。
messages.en: He walked with short steps, and I walked beside him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qileq 分成两个画面来记：椅子上坐不住，以及地面上一串短脚印；分别提示不安和迈小步。

gloss_zh: 直立的（见地名 Ħaġar Qim）；谷壳

teaching_sense.en_definition: Standing or upright, retained in the place-name Ħaġar Qim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示站立、直立，保留在地名 Ħaġar Qim 中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieqaf jew dritt, kif jinsab fl-isem tal-post Ħaġar Qim.

sense_translations.en_definition: standing. this adverb survives in place-name ħaġar qim, standing/upright stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 站立、直立；此副词保留于地名 Ħaġar Qim 中，表示站立或直立的石头。
谷壳；谷物脱粒后分离出的外壳。

formal.mt: Fl-isem Ħaġar Qim, il-kelma qim għandha t-tifsira ta' wieqaf jew dritt.
formal.en: In the name Ħaġar Qim, the word qim has the meaning of standing or upright.
formal.zh: 在 Ħaġar Qim 这个名称中，qim 表示站立或直立。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser qim fl-isem Ħaġar Qim? Lara: Hawn tfisser wieqaf jew dritt. Maja: Mela nimmaġina ġebla wieqfa biex niftakarha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does qim mean in the name Ħaġar Qim? Lara: Here it means standing or upright. Maja: Then I will picture an upright stone to remember it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：Ħaġar Qim 这个名称里的 qim 是什么意思？拉拉：这里表示站立或直立。玛雅：那我就想象一块直立的石头来记住它。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser qim fl-isem Ħaġar Qim?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser qim fl-isem Ħaġar Qim?
messages.zh: Ħaġar Qim 这个名称里的 qim 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does qim mean in the name Ħaġar Qim?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.zh: 这里表示站立或直立。
messages.en: Here it means standing or upright.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nimmaġina ġebla wieqfa biex niftakarha.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nimmaġina ġebla wieqfa biex niftakarha.
messages.zh: 那我就想象一块直立的石头来记住它。
messages.en: Then I will picture an upright stone to remember it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 Ħaġar Qim 旁画一块直立的石头，记住此处的“直立”；另做“谷壳”词义卡，分开复习两个义项。

gloss_zh: 毁坏；混乱；不停抱怨或哼唧

teaching_sense.en_definition: Destruction or chaos; also, persistent complaining or whining.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 毁坏、破坏或混乱的状态；也可指持续不断的抱怨或哼唧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerda jew taħwid kbir; ukoll ilment jew tgergir bla waqfien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毁坏；破坏；摧毁。
混乱；杂乱无序的状态。
持续不断的抱怨、发牢骚或哼哼唧唧。

collocations.en: left destruction or chaos behind him
collocations.zh: 在身后留下一片破坏或混乱
没完没了的抱怨或哼唧

formal.mt: Il-maltemp ħalla qirda kbira fil-ġnien: diversi siġar inkisru u l-mogħdijiet imtlew bil-friegħi.
formal.en: The storm left great destruction in the garden: several trees were broken and the paths filled with branches.
formal.zh: 暴风雨使花园遭到严重破坏：几棵树折断了，小路上堆满了树枝。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi qirda hemm fil-kamra! Ġugarelli ma' kullimkien. Toni: U t-tifel għaddej b'qirda bla waqfien għax ma jsibx il-karozza tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: What a mess in the room! Toys everywhere. Toni: And the boy keeps whining because he cannot find his toy car.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：房间里真乱！到处都是玩具。托尼：孩子还一直哼哼唧唧，因为他找不到自己的玩具车。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi qirda hemm fil-kamra! Ġugarelli ma' kullimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Xi qirda hemm fil-kamra! Ġugarelli ma' kullimkien.
messages.zh: 房间里真乱！到处都是玩具。
messages.en: What a mess in the room! Toys everywhere.

messages.speaker: Toni (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: U t-tifel għaddej b'qirda bla waqfien għax ma jsibx il-karozza tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: U t-tifel għaddej b'qirda bla waqfien għax ma jsibx il-karozza tiegħu.
messages.zh: 孩子还一直哼哼唧唧，因为他找不到自己的玩具车。
messages.en: And the boy keeps whining because he cannot find his toy car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qirda 配三个独立图标：断树表示毁坏，满地玩具表示混乱，反复冒出的抱怨气泡表示不停发牢骚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A little caulker: a person who fills and seals gaps to keep water out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小填缝工，即填塞并密封缝隙以防进水的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem żgħir li jimla u jissiġilla x-xquq biex ma jidħolx ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一名小填缝工；从事填缝防漏工作的小工匠。

collocations.zh: 一名手艺熟练的小填缝工

collocations.en: the little caulker fills the gaps

formal.mt: Il-qlajfat mela x-xquq fid-dgħajsa bir-reqqa biex ma jidħolx ilma.
formal.en: The little caulker carefully filled the gaps in the boat to keep water out.
formal.zh: 小填缝工仔细填好了船上的缝隙，以防进水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jimla x-xquq fid-dgħajsa? Mark: Il-qlajfat. Hu ċkejken, imma tas-sengħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to fill the gaps in the boat? Mark: The little caulker. He is small, but skilled.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来填船上的缝隙？马克：那个小填缝工。他个子小，手艺却很熟练。

messages.speaker: Maja (船主)
messages.zh: 谁来填船上的缝隙？
messages.en: Who is going to fill the gaps in the boat?

messages.speaker: Mark (船厂工人)
messages.zh: 那个小填缝工。他个子小，手艺却很熟练。
messages.en: The little caulker. He is small, but skilled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qlajfat 写在一位小工匠的围裙上，想象他逐条填好船缝、挡住进水，连同人物和工作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small lump of excrement; the diminutive of qallut.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小坨粪便；qallut 的小称形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira ta' ħmieġ; id-diminuttiv ta' qallut.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small turd (the diminutive form of 'qallut')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小坨粪便，qallut 的小称形式。

collocations.en: a small turd in the grass

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-bitħa, instabet qlajlet ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: While the yard was being cleaned, a small turd was found near the door.
formal.zh: 清扫院子时，人们在门旁发现了一小坨粪便。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Attent fejn tirfes! Hemm qlajlet fil-ħaxix. Mark: Rajtha. Se niġborha b'borża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Watch where you step! There's a small turd in the grass. Mark: I saw it. I'll pick it up with a bag.
colloquial.zh: Maja：小心脚下！草丛里有一小坨粪便。Mark：我看到了。我会用袋子把它捡起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Attent fejn tirfes! Hemm qlajlet fil-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Attent fejn tirfes! Hemm qlajlet fil-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 小心脚下！草丛里有一小坨粪便。
messages.en: Watch where you step! There's a small turd in the grass.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了。我会用袋子把它捡起来。
messages.en: I saw it. I'll pick it up with a bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象散步时提醒同伴小心草里的一小坨粪便，把 qlajlet 与这个具体场景一起记住。

gloss_zh: 小堡垒；混乱状态；另有释义不详项

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small fortress or fortified place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小型堡垒或设有防御工事的小据点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fortizza żgħira jew post żgħir imsaħħaħ għad-difiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未提供可用释义，具体词义不详。

sense_translations.en_definition: diminutive of a lain on a high prominent place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义指位于高处显眼位置的某物的小称；其中 lain 所指不明。

sense_translations.en_definition: diminutive of a fortress. small fortress
sense_translations.zh_definition: 堡垒的小称，即小堡垒。
东西颠倒凌乱、杂乱无章的状态。

collocations.en: a small fortress on the hill
the walls of the small fortress

formal.mt: It-tpinġija turi qlejgħa fuq għolja, b'ħitan madwarha.
formal.en: The drawing shows a small fortress on a hill, with walls around it.
formal.zh: 这幅画描绘了一座位于山丘上、四周有围墙的小堡垒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-bini fuq l-għolja? Pawlu: Dik qlejgħa. Ejja narawha mill-qrib.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that building on the hill? Pawlu: That's a small fortress. Let's take a closer look.
colloquial.zh: Lara：山丘上那座建筑是什么？Pawlu：那是一座小堡垒。我们走近看看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 山丘上那座建筑是什么？
messages.en: What's that building on the hill?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 那是一座小堡垒。我们走近看看吧。
messages.en: That's a small fortress. Let's take a closer look.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一座山丘上的小堡垒记住 qlejgħa，再用一张凌乱房间的图单独记它的混乱义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of overturning something, or of translating a text from one language into another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物翻倒的动作；也指把文本从一种语言译成另一种语言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li taqleb xi ħaġa, jew li tittraduċi test minn lingwa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻倒、倾覆，或使某物翻转的动作。
翻译，即把内容从一种语言转换成另一种语言。

collocations.en: the translation of the text into Maltese

formal.mt: Il-qlib tat-test għall-Malti għandu jżomm it-tifsira tal-oriġinal.
formal.en: The translation of the text into Maltese should preserve the meaning of the original.
formal.zh: 把文本译成马耳他语时，应保留原文的意思。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sejjer il-qlib tat-test? Mark: Kważi lest. Fadal biss l-aħħar paragrafu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How's the translation of the text going? Mark: Almost done. Only the last paragraph is left.
colloquial.zh: Sara：文本翻译得怎么样了？Mark：快完成了。只剩最后一段。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 文本翻译得怎么样了？
messages.en: How's the translation of the text going?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi lest. Fadal biss l-aħħar paragrafu.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi lest. Fadal biss l-aħħar paragrafu.
messages.zh: 快完成了。只剩最后一段。
messages.en: Almost done. Only the last paragraph is left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文的“翻”作学习联想：船会翻倒，文章可以翻译；这只是帮助区分 qlib 两个义项的记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Financial profit; also the activity of digging or excavating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经济活动中获得的利润；也指挖掘或开挖的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-profitt minn attività ekonomika; ukoll ix-xogħol ta' tħaffir jew skavar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 财务利润，即收入扣除相关成本后所得的收益。
挖掘，即挖开或挖出泥土等物的活动。
开挖、挖掘，即为形成坑穴或清出地下空间而进行的挖土作业。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri żieda fil-qligħ nett tal-ħanut matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report shows an increase in the shop's net profit during the year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，该商店本年度的净利润有所增加。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm kien il-qligħ mill-bejgħ tal-kejkijiet? Lara: Tletin ewro, wara li ħallasna għall-ingredjenti.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much profit did we make from selling the cakes? Lara: Thirty euros, after paying for the ingredients.
colloquial.zh: Anna：卖蛋糕赚了多少利润？Lara：扣掉食材费用后，是三十欧元。

messages.speaker: Anna (义卖志愿者)
messages.zh: 卖蛋糕赚了多少利润？
messages.en: How much profit did we make from selling the cakes?

messages.speaker: Lara (义卖志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tletin ewro, wara li ħallasna għall-ingredjenti.
messages.mt_standard: Tletin ewro, wara li ħallasna għall-ingredjenti.
messages.zh: 扣掉食材费用后，是三十欧元。
messages.en: Thirty euros, after paying for the ingredients.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qligħ 配两张学习卡：账本上的利润和工地上的挖掘；依靠上下文选择对应画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing courage and a willingness to face danger or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出勇气，敢于面对危险或困难的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri kuraġġ u ma jibżax jiffaċċja periklu jew diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勇敢的，有胆量的；敢于行动或面对困难的。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jippreżenta raġel qlubi li jgħin lill-oħrajn f'ħin ta' periklu.
formal.en: The story presents a courageous man who helps others in a time of danger.
formal.zh: 故事描写了一位在危险时刻帮助他人的勇敢男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu kien qlubi llum; tkellem quddiem kulħadd. Sara: Iva, għalkemm kien nervuż, xorta tkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu was brave today; he spoke in front of everyone. Sara: Yes, even though he was nervous, he still spoke.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 今天很勇敢，他在所有人面前发了言。Sara：是啊，虽然紧张，他还是开口了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kien qlubi llum; tkellem quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kien qlubi llum; tkellem quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: Pawlu 今天很勇敢，他在所有人面前发了言。
messages.en: Pawlu was brave today; he spoke in front of everyone.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalkemm kien nervuż, xorta tkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalkemm kien nervuż, xorta tkellem.
messages.zh: 是啊，虽然紧张，他还是开口了。
messages.en: Yes, even though he was nervous, he still spoke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qlubi 贴在“虽然紧张，仍举手发言”的人物画旁，用行动记住勇敢、有胆量的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A little moon; the diminutive of qamar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小月亮；qamar 的小称形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qamar żgħir; id-diminuttiv ta' qamar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small moon (the diminutive form of 'qamar')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小月亮，qamar 的小称形式。

collocations.en: a little moon in the sky
a drawing of a little moon

formal.mt: Fl-illustrazzjoni tal-ktieb, jidher qmajjar bejn żewġ sħabiet.
formal.en: In the book's illustration, a little moon appears between two small clouds.
formal.zh: 书中的插图画着一轮小月亮，位于两朵小云之间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara l-qmajjar li pinġejt! Maja: Sabiħ! Issa tista' żżid ftit stilel madwaru.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at the little moon I drew! Maja: Lovely! Now you can add a few stars around it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看我画的小月亮！Maja：真好看！现在你可以在它周围添几颗星星。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 看我画的小月亮！
messages.en: Look at the little moon I drew!

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Sabiħ! Issa tista' żżid ftit stilel madwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Sabiħ! Issa tista' żżid ftit stilel madwaru.
messages.zh: 真好看！现在你可以在它周围添几颗星星。
messages.en: Lovely! Now you can add a few stars around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一轮小月亮并写上 qmajjar，与表示月亮的 qamar 配对记忆，突出它的小称含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small kick; the diminutive of qamsa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小幅度或轻轻的一踢；qamsa 的小称形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa żgħira bis-sieq; id-diminuttiv ta' qamsa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small kick (the diminutive form of 'qamsa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小小的一踢、轻轻的一踢，qamsa 的小称形式。

collocations.en: a small kick under the table

formal.mt: Fit-taħriġ, it-tifel ta qmajsa lill-ballun u mexxieh ftit 'il quddiem.
formal.en: During practice, the boy gave the ball a small kick and moved it slightly forward.
formal.zh: 训练时，男孩轻轻踢了一下球，让球向前移动了一点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex tajtni qmajsa taħt il-mejda? Lara: Biex ngħidlek li kien imissek titkellem.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you give me a little kick under the table? Lara: To let you know it was your turn to speak.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么在桌子底下轻轻踢我一下？Lara：为了提醒你轮到你说话了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在桌子底下轻轻踢我一下？
messages.en: Why did you give me a little kick under the table?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ngħidlek li kien imissek titkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ngħidlek li kien imissek titkellem.
messages.zh: 为了提醒你轮到你说话了。
messages.en: To let you know it was your turn to speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌下轻轻踢一下提醒朋友，把这一下小动作记作 qmajsa，并与 qamsa 配对记住小称关系。

gloss_zh: 坐立不安地动来动去；踢动

teaching_sense.en_definition: Restless bodily movement or kicking with the feet or legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体因坐立不安而动来动去，或用脚、腿踢动的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment bla kwiet tal-ġisem, jew daqqiet bis-saqajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐立不安地扭动身体或不停做小动作。
用脚或腿踢动、踢蹬的动作。

formal.mt: L-għalliema nnutat il-qmas kontinwu tat-tifel u ssuġġeriet waqfa qasira.
formal.en: The teacher noticed the boy's constant fidgeting and suggested a short break.
formal.zh: 老师注意到男孩一直扭来扭去，于是提议短暂休息一下。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan il-qmas kollu? Inti skomdu? Pawlu: Iva, din is-siġġu iebsa wisq. Se noqgħod fuq l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's all this fidgeting? Are you uncomfortable? Pawlu: Yes, this chair is too hard. I'll sit on the other one.
colloquial.zh: Sara：怎么一直动来动去？你坐得不舒服吗？Pawlu：是啊，这把椅子太硬了。我换另一把坐。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan il-qmas kollu? Inti skomdu?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan il-qmas kollu? Inti skomdu?
messages.zh: 怎么一直动来动去？你坐得不舒服吗？
messages.en: What's all this fidgeting? Are you uncomfortable?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din is-siġġu iebsa wisq. Se noqgħod fuq l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din is-siġġu iebsa wisq. Se noqgħod fuq l-oħra.
messages.zh: 是啊，这把椅子太硬了。我换另一把坐。
messages.en: Yes, this chair is too hard. I'll sit on the other one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qmas 想成一段动作录像：坐着扭来扭去，双脚又在踢蹬；分别对应坐立不安和踢动两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of shackling or restraining someone, especially by physically limiting movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人加上镣铐或限制其行动的行为，侧重身体活动受到束缚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li torbot lil xi ħadd bil-ktajjen jew tillimita l-moviment tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上镣铐；用锁链束缚的行为
约束；限制行动的行为

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-qmat tal-priġunier bil-ktajjen u l-limitazzjoni tal-moviment tiegħu.
formal.en: The document describes the shackling of the prisoner with chains and the restriction of his movement.
formal.zh: 文件描述了给囚犯戴上锁链以及限制其行动的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'qmat' f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Ifisser li xi ħadd jintrabat jew jinżamm biex ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq liberament.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'qmat' mean in this text? Pawlu: It means someone being bound or held so that they cannot move freely.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的 qmat 是什么意思？保罗：指把人绑住或控制住，使他无法自由活动。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 qmat 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qmat' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħadd jintrabat jew jinżamm biex ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq liberament.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħadd jintrabat jew jinżamm biex ma jkunx jista' jiċċaqlaq liberament.
messages.zh: 指把人绑住或控制住，使他无法自由活动。
messages.en: It means someone being bound or held so that they cannot move freely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qmat 配上双手被锁链束住的画面，记住它指上铐或约束这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small louse; the diminutive form of 'qamla'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只小虱子，是 qamla 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qamla żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'qamla'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small louse (the diminutive form of 'qamla')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小虱子；qamla 的指小形式

collocations.en: a small louse in the hair

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami tax-xagħar, instabet qmejla qrib il-qorriegħa.
formal.en: During the examination of the hair, a small louse was found near the scalp.
formal.zh: 检查头发时，在靠近头皮的位置发现了一只小虱子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Omm, sibt qmejla fix-xagħar tiegħi! Rita: Ejja hawn, ħa naraha u nneħħiha bil-moxt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Mum, I found a small louse in my hair! Rita: Come here so I can look at it and remove it with the comb.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：妈妈，我在头发里发现了一只小虱子！丽塔：过来，让我看看，再用梳子把它弄掉。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 妈妈，我在头发里发现了一只小虱子！
messages.en: Mum, I found a small louse in my hair!

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja hawn, ħa naraha u nneħħiha bil-moxt.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja hawn, ħa naraha u nneħħiha bil-moxt.
messages.zh: 过来，让我看看，再用梳子把它弄掉。
messages.en: Come here so I can look at it and remove it with the comb.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qamla 与 qmejla 并排记：前者是虱子，后者像放进小框里的小虱子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small garment worn under another garment to fill in or cover an open neckline and the upper chest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在外层衣服里面、用来遮盖敞开的领口和上胸部的小件衣饰，常称胸衬或假领胸衬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies żgħira li tintlibes taħt libsa jew ġakketta biex tgħatti l-parti ta' fuq tas-sider fejn l-għonq ikun miftuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女式胸衬；穿在衣服里面、遮盖领口及上胸部的小件衣饰

collocations.en: to wear a chemisette under the dress

formal.mt: Il-qmejsa tal-bizzilla tidher fil-fetħa tal-għonq tal-libsa u tgħatti l-parti ta' fuq tas-sider.
formal.en: The lace chemisette is visible in the dress's neckline opening and covers the upper chest.
formal.zh: 蕾丝胸衬从连衣裙的领口开口处露出，遮盖住上胸部。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-libsa għandha l-għonq miftuħ wisq għalija. Marija: Tista' tilbes qmejsa taħtha; għandi waħda tal-bizzilla.
colloquial.en: Anna: This dress has a neckline that is too open for me. Marija: You can wear a chemisette underneath; I have a lace one.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这条裙子的领口对我来说太敞了。玛丽亚：你可以在里面穿件胸衬，我有一件蕾丝的。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-libsa għandha l-għonq miftuħ wisq għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-libsa għandha l-għonq miftuħ wisq għalija.
messages.zh: 这条裙子的领口对我来说太敞了。
messages.en: This dress has a neckline that is too open for me.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tilbes qmejsa taħtha; għandi waħda tal-bizzilla.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tilbes qmejsa taħtha; għandi waħda tal-bizzilla.
messages.zh: 你可以在里面穿件胸衬，我有一件蕾丝的。
messages.en: You can wear a chemisette underneath; I have a lace one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象领口里露出一小片蕾丝，把 qmejsa 记成专门遮住领口和上胸的胸衬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bell; the diminutive form of 'qanpiena'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一口小钟或一个小铃，是 qanpiena 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qanpiena żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'qanpiena'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small bell (the diminutive form of 'qanpiena')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小钟；小铃；qanpiena 的指小形式

collocations.en: the ringing of the small bell

formal.mt: Id-daqq tal-qnejpna ħabbar il-bidu tal-laqgħa, u l-parteċipanti ħadu posthom.
formal.en: The ringing of the small bell announced the start of the meeting, and the participants took their seats.
formal.zh: 小铃声宣告会议开始，与会者随即入座。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif insejjaħ lill-wejter? Sara: Doqq il-qnejpna fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Mark: How do I call the waiter? Sara: Ring the small bell on the table.
colloquial.zh: 马克：怎么叫服务员过来？萨拉：摇一下桌上的小铃。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 怎么叫服务员过来？
messages.en: How do I call the waiter?

messages.speaker: Sara (同桌朋友)
messages.zh: 摇一下桌上的小铃。
messages.en: Ring the small bell on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 qanpiena 是钟，再想象它缩成桌上一只小铃，用这个画面记 qnejpna。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rounded roof or ceiling that curves upward over a building or room.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖建筑或房间、向上呈弧形隆起的屋顶或顶棚，即穹顶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saqaf tond u mgħawweġ li jogħla fuq bini jew kamra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穹顶；圆顶

formal.mt: Il-qobba tal-ħġieġ tħalli d-dawl naturali jidħol fis-sala ċentrali.
formal.en: The glass dome allows natural light to enter the central hall.
formal.zh: 玻璃穹顶让自然光照入中央大厅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tara dik il-qobba kbira hemm fuq? Toni: Iva, dik hi l-qobba tal-knisja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see that big dome up there? Toni: Yes, that is the church's dome.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见上面那个大圆顶了吗？托尼：看见了，那是教堂的穹顶。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tara dik il-qobba kbira hemm fuq?
messages.mt_standard: Tara dik il-qobba kbira hemm fuq?
messages.zh: 你看见上面那个大圆顶了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that big dome up there?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.zh: 看见了，那是教堂的穹顶。
messages.en: Yes, that is the church's dome.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qobba 想成扣在建筑上的半个圆球，看到向上隆起的屋顶就联想穹顶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cattle or other farm animals kept as livestock, considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为一个整体来指称饲养的牛或其他农场牲畜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-baqar jew annimali oħra tar-razzett, meqjusa flimkien bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛畜；牲畜，统称饲养的农场动物

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħejja biżżejjed għalf u ilma għall-qobla tar-razzett.
formal.en: The farmer prepared enough feed and water for the farm's livestock.
formal.zh: 农民为农场的牲畜准备了充足的饲料和水。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Tajt l-ilma lill-qobla? Rita: Iva, u ħejjejt l-għalf ukoll.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Have you given the livestock water? Rita: Yes, and I have prepared the feed too.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你给牲畜喂水了吗？丽塔：喂了，饲料也准备好了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 你给牲畜喂水了吗？
messages.en: Have you given the livestock water?

messages.speaker: Rita (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 喂了，饲料也准备好了。
messages.en: Yes, and I have prepared the feed too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qobla 配一幅农场牲畜围着食槽的图，整群动物一起记，突出集合意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small basket woven from thin, flexible plant material such as wicker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用柳条等柔韧植物材料编成的小篮子，用来盛放或携带物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoffa żgħira magħmula minn friegħi rqaq u flessibbli minsuġin flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小柳条篮；以柔韧植物枝条编成的小篮子

collocations.en: a small wicker basket full of fruit
to carry a small wicker basket

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda tqiegħdet qoffina mimlija frott frisk għall-mistednin.
formal.en: A small wicker basket full of fresh fruit was placed on the table for the guests.
formal.zh: 桌上放了一只装满新鲜水果的小柳条篮，供客人享用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi t-tuffieħ? Marija: Poġġih fil-qoffina ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where should I put the apples? Marija: Put them in the small wicker basket beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：苹果放在哪里？玛丽亚：放进窗边那个小柳条篮里。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 苹果放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the apples?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 放进窗边那个小柳条篮里。
messages.en: Put them in the small wicker basket beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里提着装了几个苹果的编织小篮，把 qoffina 与小巧的柳条篮联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a shape like a hill, with a raised middle and sloping sides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像小山一样，中部隆起、两侧倾斜的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għamla ta' għolja, b'nofs ogħla u ġnub imżerżqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形似小山的；呈丘状的。

formal.mt: Il-mudell għandu profil qolli, b'nofs għoli u ġnub li jinżlu gradwalment.
formal.en: The model has a hill-shaped profile, with a high middle and sides that slope down gradually.
formal.zh: 这个模型的轮廓呈小山状，中部较高，两侧逐渐向下倾斜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tridni nagħmel il-munzell tar-ramel? Pawlu: Agħmlu qolli, għoli fin-nofs u aktar baxx fil-ġnub.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do you want me to shape the pile of sand? Pawlu: Make it hill-shaped, high in the middle and lower at the sides.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想让我把沙堆做成什么形状？保罗：做成小山状，中间高、两边低。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想让我把沙堆做成什么形状？
messages.en: How do you want me to shape the pile of sand?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħmlu qolli, għoli fin-nofs u aktar baxx fil-ġnub.
messages.mt_standard: Agħmlu qolli, għoli fin-nofs u aktar baxx fil-ġnub.
messages.zh: 做成小山状，中间高、两边低。
messages.en: Make it hill-shaped, high in the middle and lower at the sides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 qolli 时画一条中间隆起、两边下滑的轮廓线，把词义固定为形状像小山。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rock or a solid piece of natural stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天然形成的坚硬岩石或石块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Blata jew biċċa ġebel naturali u iebsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块岩石；石块。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ idur ma' qolliegħa kbira qabel jinżel lejn il-bajja.
formal.en: The path goes around a large rock before descending towards the bay.
formal.zh: 这条小路绕过一块大岩石，然后向下通往海湾。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Toni: Ħdejn dik il-qolliegħa kbira, fil-bidu tal-passaġġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we meet? Toni: Beside that large rock at the start of the path.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们在哪里碰面？托尼：在小路起点的那块大岩石旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn dik il-qolliegħa kbira, fil-bidu tal-passaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn dik il-qolliegħa kbira, fil-bidu tal-passaġġ.
messages.zh: 在小路起点的那块大岩石旁边。
messages.en: Beside that large rock at the start of the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qolliegħa 想成步道旁用来约定见面的石块；看到坚硬岩石的画面，就回忆这个词。

gloss_zh: 不耐烦地动；坐立不安；踢

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move restlessly or impatiently, including fidgeting or kicking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不耐烦或不安而动来动去，也可指踢动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq bla sabar jew bla kwiet, jew jagħti daqqa b'siequ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不耐烦地移动身体；因等不及而动来动去。
不停做小动作；扭动身体、坐不安稳。
躁动不安；无法安静待着。
踢；用脚踢动或踢击。

formal.mt: Waqt l-istennija twila, it-tifel qomos fis-siġġu u ħares lejn il-bieb diversi drabi.
formal.en: During the long wait, the boy fidgeted in his chair and looked towards the door several times.
formal.zh: 长时间等待时，男孩在椅子上扭来扭去，还几次望向门口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tifel qomos fis-siġġu waqt il-film. Mark: Iva, wara ftit ried iqum u joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: The boy fidgeted in his chair during the film. Mark: Yes, after a while he wanted to get up and go outside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看电影时，那个男孩在椅子上扭来扭去。马克：是啊，过了一会儿他就想站起来出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.zh: 看电影时，那个男孩在椅子上扭来扭去。
messages.en: The boy fidgeted in his chair during the film.

messages.speaker: Mark (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wara ftit ried iqum u joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wara ftit ried iqum u joħroġ.
messages.zh: 是啊，过了一会儿他就想站起来出去。
messages.en: Yes, after a while he wanted to get up and go outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用等待太久时扭身、动脚的动作记 qomos；再单独配一张踢腿图，兼顾它的踢动义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who continually grumbles and complains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常嘟囔不满、不断抱怨这抱怨那的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li kontinwament tgerger u tilmenta.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who grumbles and complains constantly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 总是不满地嘟囔、不断抱怨的人。

collocations.en: a grumbler who is always complaining

formal.mt: Il-kittieb jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala qomqma li qatt ma tkun kuntenta b'dak li jiġri.
formal.en: The writer describes the character as a constant complainer who is never satisfied with what happens.
formal.zh: 作者把这个角色描写成一个总爱抱怨的人，无论发生什么都不满意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed isejħuli qomqma? Lara: Għax dejjem issib xi ħaġa fuq xiex tilmenta!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are they calling me a constant complainer? Lara: Because you always find something to complain about!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们为什么说我是个总爱抱怨的人？拉拉：因为你总能找到事情来抱怨！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么说我是个总爱抱怨的人？
messages.en: Why are they calling me a constant complainer?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem issib xi ħaġa fuq xiex tilmenta!
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem issib xi ħaġa fuq xiex tilmenta!
messages.zh: 因为你总能找到事情来抱怨！
messages.en: Because you always find something to complain about!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qomqma 配上一个嘴边不断冒出抱怨气泡的人物，记住它指爱抱怨的人，而不是一次抱怨。

gloss_zh: 绳索；角向下弯至嘴边的公牛或公羊

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rope; also an ox or ram with horns twisted down towards its mouth, as described in the supplied proverb sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指绳索；另一个义项指角扭曲向下、伸至嘴边的公牛或公羊，见所给谚语释义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal gendus jew muntun bi qrun milwijin 'l isfel lejn ħalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绳索；绳子。

sense_translations.en_definition: Ox or ram with horns twisted down to his mouth occurring in proverd given by De Soldanis 'qomqom u l-qmqam tfittex kemm iqum lanqas kemm qam, bil-lejl jaħdem lilu u bin nhar lis-sultan', as for the ox and the cow don't bother about the price (i.e. they are always worth the money you spend on them), during the nigh work for him (i.e. plough his fields) and during the day work for the king
sense_translations.zh_definition: 角扭曲向下、伸至嘴边的公牛或公羊。此义见于 De Soldanis 所载的一则谚语；所给释义说明，购买牛只不必计较价钱或原来花了多少钱，因为总是物有所值：夜间为主人劳作，即耕种主人的田地，白天则为国王劳作。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rabat it-tagħbija b'qomqom oħxon biex iżommha f'postha matul il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The worker tied the load with a thick rope to keep it in place during the journey.
formal.zh: 工人用一根粗绳捆住货物，使其在运输途中保持固定。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għandek qomqom biex norbot dawn il-kaxxi? Pawlu: Iva, hemm wieħed oħxon ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Toni: Do you have a rope so I can tie these boxes together? Pawlu: Yes, there's a thick one beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：你有绳子吗？我想把这些箱子捆在一起。保罗：有，门旁边有一根粗的。

messages.speaker: Toni (搬运工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek qomqom biex norbot dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek qomqom biex norbot dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 你有绳子吗？我想把这些箱子捆在一起。
messages.en: Do you have a rope so I can tie these boxes together?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed oħxon ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed oħxon ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 有，门旁边有一根粗的。
messages.en: Yes, there's a thick one beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qomqom 做两张义项卡：一张画捆箱子的绳索，一张画角弯向嘴边的牛羊；分开记忆两个含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who becomes angry easily or is difficult to deal with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易发怒，或在交往、合作中很难相处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirrabja malajr jew li jkun diffiċli tittratta magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 易怒的人；动不动就发脾气的人。
难相处、难应付的人。

collocations.en: to be an irritable or difficult person
collocations.zh: 做一个易怒或难相处的人

collocations.en: a difficult person who gets angry quickly
collocations.zh: 一个很容易发火的难相处的人

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni huwa deskritt bħala qonqla għax jirrabja malajr meta xi ħadd ma jaqbilx miegħu.
formal.en: The main character is described as an irascible person because he gets angry quickly when someone disagrees with him.
formal.zh: 主要角色被描写成一个易怒的人，因为只要有人不同意他，他就很快发火。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Illum Mark sar qonqla; kollox qed idejqu. Lara: Aħjar nagħtuh ftit ħin biex jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Nina: Mark has become really irritable today; everything is bothering him. Lara: We'd better give him a little time to calm down.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克今天变得特别暴躁，什么都让他烦。拉拉：我们最好给他一点时间，让他平静下来。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum Mark sar qonqla; kollox qed idejqu.
messages.mt_standard: Illum Mark sar qonqla; kollox qed idejqu.
messages.zh: 马克今天变得特别暴躁，什么都让他烦。
messages.en: Mark has become really irritable today; everything is bothering him.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nagħtuh ftit ħin biex jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nagħtuh ftit ħin biex jikkalma.
messages.zh: 我们最好给他一点时间，让他平静下来。
messages.en: We'd better give him a little time to calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个一听不同意见就冒火的人，用这个画面记 qonqla 的易怒义，再连到难相处义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Eucharist or Holy Communion, the Christian sacrament involving the consecrated bread and wine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督宗教中涉及祝圣饼酒的圣体圣事，也可指领受圣体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-Ewkaristija jew it-tqarbin, is-sagrament Nisrani marbut mal-ħobż u l-inbid ikkonsagrati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣体圣事；圣餐；领圣体。

formal.mt: Il-ktejjeb jispjega t-tifsira tal-qorbien u kif il-fidili jistgħu jitħejjew biex jirċevuh.
formal.en: The booklet explains the meaning of Holy Communion and how the faithful can prepare to receive it.
formal.zh: 这本小册子解释了领圣体的意义，以及信徒可以如何为领受圣体作准备。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed taqra dwar il-qorbien? Pawlu: Għada se nirċevih, u rrid nifhem aħjar it-tifsira tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you reading about Holy Communion? Pawlu: I'm going to receive it tomorrow, and I want to understand its meaning better.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么在读关于领圣体的内容？保罗：我明天要领圣体，想更好地理解它的意义。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在读关于领圣体的内容？
messages.en: Why are you reading about Holy Communion?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada se nirċevih, u rrid nifhem aħjar it-tifsira tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għada se nirċevih, u rrid nifhem aħjar it-tifsira tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我明天要领圣体，想更好地理解它的意义。
messages.en: I'm going to receive it tomorrow, and I want to understand its meaning better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qorbien 与教堂里领受圣体的场景相连，再用 jirċievi l-qorbien 整组记住领圣体的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small parasite that attaches to an animal's skin among its fur and feeds on blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种附着在动物毛发间皮肤上、以吸血为生的小型寄生虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parassita żgħir li jeħel mal-ġilda tal-annimali qalb is-suf u jerdagħlhom id-demm.

sense_translations.en_definition: a tick (parasite found in animal fur)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜱虫；寄生在动物毛发间的吸血小虫。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami tal-kelb, il-veterinarju sab qordiena mwaħħla mal-ġilda.
formal.en: During the dog's examination, the vet found a tick attached to its skin.
formal.zh: 给狗检查时，兽医发现一只附着在它皮肤上的蜱虫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm qordiena fuq il-kelb! Mark: Rajtha. Se nċempel lill-veterinarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a tick on the dog! Mark: I saw it. I'll call the vet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：狗身上有只蜱虫！马克：我看见了。我来给兽医打电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (狗主人)
messages.zh: 狗身上有只蜱虫！
messages.en: There's a tick on the dog!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见了。我来给兽医打电话。
messages.en: I saw it. I'll call the vet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qordiena 和拨开狗毛发现蜱虫的画面一起记，再用“去除蜱虫”的搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The pod of a cotton plant, containing seeds surrounded by cotton fibres.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 棉花植株结出的果荚，内部有种子和包围种子的棉纤维，通常称为棉桃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frotta tal-pjanta tal-qoton li fiha ż-żerriegħa mdawra bil-fibri tal-qoton.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棉桃；棉花植株含有种子与棉纤维的果荚。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw qotna miftuħa u raw il-fibri bojod madwar iż-żerriegħa.
formal.en: The students observed an open cotton pod and saw the white fibres around the seeds.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一颗开裂的棉桃，看到了种子周围的白色纤维。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din fuq il-pjanta? Pawlu: Din qotna. Ara l-qoton abjad ġewwa!
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this on the plant? Pawlu: It's a cotton pod. Look at the white cotton inside!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：植株上这个是什么？保罗：这是棉桃。看，里面有白色的棉花！

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 植株上这个是什么？
messages.en: What's this on the plant?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din qotna. Ara l-qoton abjad ġewwa!
messages.mt_standard: Din qotna. Ara l-qoton abjad ġewwa!
messages.zh: 这是棉桃。看，里面有白色的棉花！
messages.en: It's a cotton pod. Look at the white cotton inside!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qotna 贴在棉桃开裂、露出白色棉絮的图片上，记住它指植株上的果荚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cloth made from cotton fibres, used for sewing or other fabric work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由棉纤维制成的布料，可用于缝纫或其他布艺用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp magħmul mill-fibri tal-qoton, użat għall-ħjata jew għal xogħol ieħor bid-drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棉布；用棉纤维织成的布料。

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-ħjata, kull student irċieva biċċa qotnina bajda.
formal.en: For the sewing project, each student received a piece of white cotton cloth.
formal.zh: 为了完成缝纫项目，每名学生都领到了一块白色棉布。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek biċċa qotnina għal din il-ħjata? Anna: Iva, għandi waħda bajda. Biżżejjed għalik?
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you have a piece of cotton cloth for this sewing? Anna: Yes, I have a white piece. Is it enough for you?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你有块棉布可以做这次缝纫用吗？安娜：有，我有块白色的。够你用吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (缝纫学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek biċċa qotnina għal din il-ħjata?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek biċċa qotnina għal din il-ħjata?
messages.zh: 你有块棉布可以做这次缝纫用吗？
messages.en: Do you have a piece of cotton cloth for this sewing?

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi waħda bajda. Biżżejjed għalik?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi waħda bajda. Biżżejjed għalik?
messages.zh: 有，我有块白色的。够你用吗？
messages.en: Yes, I have a white piece. Is it enough for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图对照记忆：qotna 配棉桃，qotnina 配裁开的棉布；这是词义区分练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Completely dry, with no moisture left.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完全干燥、已经干透的，用来强调没有剩余水分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Niexef għalkollox, mingħajr ebda umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完全干燥的；干透的。

formal.mt: Qabel ma jinħażen, id-drapp għandu jkun qoxqox.
formal.en: Before being stored, the cloth should be completely dry.
formal.zh: 布料收存之前应当完全干透。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħatab għadu mxarrab? Lara: Le, issa qoxqox. Ilu fix-xemx il-ġurnata kollha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this firewood still wet? Lara: No, it's completely dry now. It's been in the sun all day.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些柴火还湿着吗？拉拉：不，现在已经干透了。它们晒了一整天太阳。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 这些柴火还湿着吗？
messages.en: Is this firewood still wet?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa qoxqox. Ilu fix-xemx il-ġurnata kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa qoxqox. Ilu fix-xemx il-ġurnata kollha.
messages.zh: 不，现在已经干透了。它们晒了一整天太阳。
messages.en: No, it's completely dry now. It's been in the sun all day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 qoxqox 时想象晒了一整天、摸起来毫无湿气的柴火，把“完全干透”一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of prostitution; in another sense, intrigues or secret schemes involving other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一次卖淫行为；另一个义项指人与人之间的阴谋活动或秘密算计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' prostituzzjoni; f'sens ieħor, manuvri sigrieti bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次卖淫行为
阴谋活动；暗中策划的算计或勾当

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, il-kelma 'qoħba' tirreferi għal manuvri sigrieti bejn il-karattri li jridu jiksbu l-poter.
formal.en: In this story, the word 'qoħba' refers to intrigues among characters seeking to gain power.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，qoħba 一词指那些试图夺取权力的人物之间的阴谋活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk 'qoħba' tfisser att ta' prostituzzjoni? Pawlu: Le, f'din is-sentenza tfisser manuvri sigrieti bejn in-nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'qoħba' mean an act of prostitution here? Pawlu: No, in this sentence it means intrigues among people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 qoħba 是指一次卖淫行为吗？保罗：不是，在这句话里，它指人与人之间的阴谋活动。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 qoħba 是指一次卖淫行为吗？
messages.en: Does 'qoħba' mean an act of prostitution here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din is-sentenza tfisser manuvri sigrieti bejn in-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din is-sentenza tfisser manuvri sigrieti bejn in-nies.
messages.zh: 不是，在这句话里，它指人与人之间的阴谋活动。
messages.en: No, in this sentence it means intrigues among people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张语境卡记 qoħba：一张写卖淫行为，一张写暗中设局，读句子时先判断对应哪张卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extreme poverty in which a person lacks basic necessities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连食物、衣物或住所等基本生活必需品都难以获得的极端贫困状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faqar kbir ħafna li fih persuna ma jkollhiex il-ħtiġijiet bażiċi tal-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤贫；缺乏基本生活必需品的境况。
贫困；经济拮据、难以维持基本生活的状态。
严重匮乏；生活所需之物极度不足。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-qoħot tal-familja, li ma kellhiex biżżejjed flus għall-ikel u għall-kera.
formal.en: The report describes the family's destitution: they did not have enough money for food and rent.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这个家庭的赤贫处境：他们连购买食物和支付房租的钱都不够。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-familja qed tgħix fil-qoħot. Mark: Ejja ngħinuhom jiksbu l-ikel u l-ħwejjeġ li għandhom bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: This family is living in destitution. Mark: Let's help them get the food and clothes they need.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个家庭正生活在赤贫之中。马克：我们帮他们获得所需的食物和衣服吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.zh: 这个家庭正生活在赤贫之中。
messages.en: This family is living in destitution.

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ngħinuhom jiksbu l-ikel u l-ħwejjeġ li għandhom bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ngħinuhom jiksbu l-ikel u l-ħwejjeġ li għandhom bżonn.
messages.zh: 我们帮他们获得所需的食物和衣服吧。
messages.en: Let's help them get the food and clothes they need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qoħot 和空碗、破衣、无处栖身的画面相连，记住它表示基本生活都难以维持的赤贫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The low grunting sound made by pigs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猪发出的低沉哼哼声，指这种叫声本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss baxx li jagħmlu l-ħnieżer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猪发出的哼哼声。

formal.mt: Fir-reġistrazzjoni tar-razzett, jinstema' l-qożqoż tal-ħnieżer.
formal.en: The grunting of pigs can be heard in the farm recording.
formal.zh: 在这段农场录音中，可以听见猪的哼哼声。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'inhu dak il-ħoss minn hemm? Rita: Dak il-qożqoż tal-ħnieżer. Ejja narawhom!
colloquial.en: Ben: What's that sound coming from over there? Rita: That's the pigs grunting. Let's go and see them!
colloquial.zh: 本：那边传来的是什么声音？丽塔：那是猪的哼哼声。我们去看看它们吧！

messages.speaker: Ben (农场游客)
messages.zh: 那边传来的是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound coming from over there?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是猪的哼哼声。我们去看看它们吧！
messages.en: That's the pigs grunting. Let's go and see them!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qożqoż 的重复字形配上猪连续哼哼的声音来记；这里只是学习联想，不说明词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gambling game called qożża.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为 qożża 的一种赌博游戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba tal-ażżard li tissejjaħ qożża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种赌博游戏，名称为 qożża。

collocations.zh: 名为 qożża 的赌博游戏
玩 qożża 这种赌博游戏

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-qożża hija deskritta bħala logħba tal-ażżard.
formal.en: In the text, qożża is described as a gambling game.
formal.zh: 文中将 qożża 描述为一种赌博游戏。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser il-kelma qożża? Pawlu: Hija l-isem ta' logħba tal-ażżard.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does the word qożża mean? Pawlu: It's the name of a gambling game.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：qożża 这个词是什么意思？保罗：它是一种赌博游戏的名称。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: qożża 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word qożża mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 它是一种赌博游戏的名称。
messages.en: It's the name of a gambling game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qożża 写在“赌博游戏名称”的词卡上，连同 logħba tal-ażżard 一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 爱闹脾气的（用于戏称老人的固定短语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used jocularly in the phrase in-nannu qożżu to describe a petulant old man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于戏谑性固定短语 in-nannu qożżu，形容爱闹脾气、动辄不高兴的老头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biċ-ċajt fil-frażi in-nannu qożżu għal raġel xiħ li malajr jiddejjaq jew igerger.

sense_translations.en_definition: (jocular) occuring in the phrase in-nannu qożżu, petulant old man
sense_translations.zh_definition: （戏谑）见于短语 in-nannu qożżu，指爱闹脾气的老头。

collocations.en: the petulant old man, said jocularly
like a petulant old man, said jocularly
collocations.zh: 像个爱闹脾气的老头，戏谑说法

formal.mt: Fil-kitba umoristika, il-frażi 'in-nannu qożżu' tintuża għal raġel xiħ li malajr igerger.
formal.en: In humorous writing, the phrase 'in-nannu qożżu' is used for an old man who is quick to grumble.
formal.zh: 在幽默文字中，短语 in-nannu qożżu 用来指动不动就抱怨的老头。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum qisek in-nannu qożżu! Mark: Għax il-kafè kiesaħ! Agħtini ieħor u ma ngergirx aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: You're like a petulant old man today! Mark: Because the coffee's cold! Give me another one and I'll stop grumbling.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天像个爱闹脾气的老头！马克：还不是因为咖啡凉了！再给我一杯，我就不抱怨了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天像个爱闹脾气的老头！
messages.en: You're like a petulant old man today!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kafè kiesaħ! Agħtini ieħor u ma ngergirx aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kafè kiesaħ! Agħtini ieħor u ma ngergirx aktar.
messages.zh: 还不是因为咖啡凉了！再给我一杯，我就不抱怨了。
messages.en: Because the coffee's cold! Give me another one and I'll stop grumbling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 in-nannu qożżu 整句记成朋友打趣“又闹脾气啦”的画面，连同戏谑语气一起掌握。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move nearer to a person, place, or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某个人、地方或事物靠近，使彼此之间的距离缩短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur aktar viċin ta' persuna, post jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接近；靠近；走近。

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur qrab lejn il-mejda biex jiffirma r-reġistru.
formal.en: The visitor approached the table to sign the register.
formal.zh: 访客走近桌子，在登记簿上签名。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark qrab lejn il-bieb? Ben: Sema' lil xi ħadd iħabbat u mar jiftaħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark approach the door? Ben: He heard someone knocking and went to open it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么走到门边去了？本：他听见有人敲门，就去开门了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么走到门边去了？
messages.en: Why did Mark approach the door?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sema' lil xi ħadd iħabbat u mar jiftaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Sema' lil xi ħadd iħabbat u mar jiftaħ.
messages.zh: 他听见有人敲门，就去开门了。
messages.en: He heard someone knocking and went to open it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qrab 配上一支朝门口移动的箭头，默念“走近、距离缩短”，再连同 lejn 练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pumpkin; the diminutive form of 'qargħa'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小南瓜；是 qargħa（南瓜）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qargħa żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'qargħa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小南瓜（qargħa 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small pumpkin in the garden
soup made with a small pumpkin

formal.mt: Għal din is-soppa, agħżel qrajgħa friska u aħsilha sew qabel taqtagħha.
formal.en: For this soup, choose a fresh small pumpkin and wash it thoroughly before cutting it.
formal.zh: 做这道汤时，选一颗新鲜的小南瓜，切开前先彻底洗净。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nsajru llum? Toni: Għandna qrajgħa; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa biha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we cook today? Toni: We have a small pumpkin; we can make soup with it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今天做什么吃？托尼：我们有一颗小南瓜，可以拿它做汤。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我们今天做什么吃？
messages.en: What shall we cook today?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna qrajgħa; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa biha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna qrajgħa; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa biha.
messages.zh: 我们有一颗小南瓜，可以拿它做汤。
messages.en: We have a small pumpkin; we can make soup with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qargħa 想成普通南瓜，把 qrajgħa 配上一颗掌心大小的南瓜图；用大小对照记住指小义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small horn; the diminutive form of 'qarn'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小角或小犄角；是 qarn（角）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qarn żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'qarn'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小角；小犄角（qarn 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small horn on the head
the tip of the small horn

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija jidher qrajjen fuq ras l-annimal.
formal.en: The drawing shows a small horn on the animal's head.
formal.zh: 图画中可以看到动物头上的一只小角。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu dak fuq ras l-annimal? Mark: Dak qrajjen; ħares lejn il-ponta tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lina: What is that on the animal's head? Mark: That is a small horn; look at its tip.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：动物头上那个是什么？马克：那是一只小角，看看它的尖端。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 动物头上那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that on the animal's head?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak qrajjen; ħares lejn il-ponta tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak qrajjen; ħares lejn il-ponta tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那是一只小角，看看它的尖端。
messages.en: That is a small horn; look at its tip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一只动物，再把头上的角缩小，旁边写 qrajjen；让“小犄角”的图像帮助记住整个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small horn; a diminutive form of 'qarn'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小角或小犄角；是 qarn（角）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qarn żgħir; forma diminuttiva ta' 'qarn'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小角；小犄角（qarn 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small horn on the forehead
the shape of the small horn

formal.mt: L-illustrazzjoni turi qrajna fuq ras il-kreatura immaġinarja.
formal.en: The illustration shows a small horn on the imaginary creature's head.
formal.zh: 插图展示了这只虚构生物头上的一只小角。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se żżid mat-tpinġija? Pawlu: Se nżid qrajna fuq ras il-kreatura.
colloquial.en: Sara: What will you add to the drawing? Pawlu: I will add a small horn to the creature's head.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你要往画里加什么？保罗：我要在这只生物头上加一只小角。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你要往画里加什么？
messages.en: What will you add to the drawing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nżid qrajna fuq ras il-kreatura.
messages.mt_standard: Se nżid qrajna fuq ras il-kreatura.
messages.zh: 我要在这只生物头上加一只小角。
messages.en: I will add a small horn to the creature's head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qrajna 写在虚构小动物头上的小角旁边，并与 qrajjen 并排复习：本条两词都用“小角”图像记忆。

gloss_zh: 鸟类名称 buqrajq／buqarraq 中出现的构词成分

teaching_sense.en_definition: An element occurring in the ornithological compound buqrajq/buqarraq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出现在鸟类名称 buqrajq／buqarraq 中的成分；学习时应结合完整词辨认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element li jidher fil-kelma komposta tal-ornitoloġija buqrajq/buqarraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现在鸟类学复合词 buqrajq／buqarraq 中的成分。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, identifika l-element 'qrajq' fil-kelma 'buqrajq'.
formal.en: In this exercise, identify the element 'qrajq' in the word 'buqrajq'.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，请辨认 buqrajq 一词中的 qrajq 成分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif niftakar 'qrajq'? Toni: Ikteb 'buqrajq' u agħmel sinjal taħt 'qrajq'.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I remember 'qrajq'? Toni: Write 'buqrajq' and underline 'qrajq'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎么记住 qrajq？托尼：写下 buqrajq，再在 qrajq 下面画线。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我怎么记住 qrajq？
messages.en: How can I remember 'qrajq'?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.zh: 写下 buqrajq，再在 qrajq 下面画线。
messages.en: Write 'buqrajq' and underline 'qrajq'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 采用整词定位法：先写 buqrajq，再圈出其中的 qrajq；把它作为鸟名中的成分记忆，不另编独立词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A quick, small pinch or bite.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短促而轻微的一夹或一咬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għafsa żgħira jew gidma ħafifa u qasira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻轻一夹；轻咬一下。

collocations.zh: 胳膊上被轻夹或轻咬一下

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħob, il-ġeru tah qrajsa ħafifa f'idu.
formal.en: During play, the puppy gave him a light nip on the hand.
formal.zh: 玩耍时，小狗在他手上轻咬了一下。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex ġbidt idek lura? Mark: Il-ġeru tani qrajsa, imma ma weġġajtx.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did you pull your hand back? Mark: The puppy gave me a nip, but I wasn't hurt.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你为什么把手缩回来了？马克：小狗轻咬了我一下，不过我没受伤。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把手缩回来了？
messages.en: Why did you pull your hand back?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġeru tani qrajsa, imma ma weġġajtx.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġeru tani qrajsa, imma ma weġġajtx.
messages.zh: 小狗轻咬了我一下，不过我没受伤。
messages.en: The puppy gave me a nip, but I wasn't hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗玩耍时轻咬一下，你马上缩手；把这个短促动作定格为 qrajsa，记住它表示“一下轻咬或轻夹”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An admission of wrongdoing or sins, including confession in a religious setting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承认过错或罪过的行为或陈述，也可指宗教语境中的告解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stqarrija ta' żbalji jew dnubiet, ukoll f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坦白；认罪；告解。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur għamel qrar sinċier tal-iżbalji tiegħu.
formal.en: In his letter, the author made a sincere confession of his mistakes.
formal.zh: 作者在信中真诚地坦白了自己的过错。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer wara x-xogħol? Pawlu: Se mmur il-knisja għall-qrar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going after work? Pawlu: I'm going to church for confession.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你下班后要去哪里？保罗：我要去教堂告解。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你下班后要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going after work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我要去教堂告解。
messages.en: I'm going to church for confession.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qrar 配两幅情境图：写信承认过错、到教堂告解；共同核心都是把自己的过错说出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn sour; also, of a person, to become irritable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物等变酸；也可指人变得烦躁、容易生气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir qares; jew, meta jingħad għal persuna, isir nervuż u jirrabja malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变酸；发酸。
变得烦躁；变得容易生气。

formal.mt: Il-ħalib qras wara li tħalla barra mill-friġġ għal żmien twil.
formal.en: The milk went sour after being left out of the refrigerator for a long time.
formal.zh: 牛奶放在冰箱外太久后变酸了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu qed jirrabja daqshekk malajr illum? Toni: Qras minħabba l-għeja; għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
