colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu getting angry so quickly today? Toni: He became irritable because of tiredness; he needs to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天怎么这么容易生气？托尼：他累得烦躁了，需要休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu qed jirrabja daqshekk malajr illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu qed jirrabja daqshekk malajr illum?
messages.zh: 保罗今天怎么这么容易生气？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu getting angry so quickly today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qras minħabba l-għeja; għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Qras minħabba l-għeja; għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他累得烦躁了，需要休息。
messages.en: He became irritable because of tiredness; he needs to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡记 qras：一张画牛奶变酸，一张画疲倦的人发脾气；并列记住“变酸”和“变烦躁”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small rusk: a small piece of dry, crisp bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小块烤面包干，即经过烘烤、口感干脆的小块面包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira ta' ħobż niexef u tqarmeċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小块烤面包干。

collocations.zh: 配茶吃的小块烤面包干

formal.mt: Mal-kolazzjon ġie servut qrejmeċ flimkien ma' kikkra te.
formal.en: A small rusk was served at breakfast alongside a cup of tea.
formal.zh: 早餐供应了一小块烤面包干，搭配一杯茶。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Trid xi ħaġa mat-te? Mark: Iva, nixtieq qrejmeċ, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lina: Would you like something with your tea? Mark: Yes, I'd like a small rusk, please.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你想吃点什么配茶吗？马克：想，请给我一小块烤面包干。

messages.speaker: Lina (主人)
messages.zh: 你想吃点什么配茶吗？
messages.en: Would you like something with your tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.zh: 想，请给我一小块烤面包干。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like a small rusk, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qrejmeċ 写在茶杯旁的一小块面包干下面，想象轻咬时的干脆口感；用“配茶的小面包干”场景记忆。

gloss_zh: 仅见于圣母节相关地名中的指小形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A diminutive form used only in the place name Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa in Ħal Qormi, associated with a legend about sharing small slices of a slaughtered pig on the feast of Santa Marija.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仅用于 Ħal Qormi 的 Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa 这一地名中的指小形式；相关传说讲述圣母节宰猪后，每人分得一小片猪肉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma diminuttiva li tintuża biss fl-isem Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa f'Ħal Qormi, marbuta ma' leġġenda dwar qżieqeż maqtul fil-festa ta' Santa Marija u mqassam f'biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: This diminutive form occurs only in (toponymy) 'Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa Ħal Qormi', so called because according to a legend of the feast day of Santa Marija a pig was slaughtered and everyone was given a small slice of it
sense_translations.zh_definition: 这一指小形式仅见于地名 Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa Ħal Qormi；据相关传说，圣母节当天宰了一头猪，每人都分到一小片猪肉，因而得名。

collocations.en: the name Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa
collocations.zh: Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa 这一名称

collocations.mt: il-leġġenda ta' Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa
collocations.en: the legend of Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa
collocations.zh: Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa 的相关传说

formal.mt: L-isem Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa f'Ħal Qormi huwa marbut ma' leġġenda li fiha, fil-festa ta' Santa Marija, kull persuna ngħatat biċċa żgħira minn qżieqeż maqtul.
formal.en: The name Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa in Ħal Qormi is associated with a legend in which, on the feast of Santa Marija, each person received a small piece of a slaughtered pig.
formal.zh: Ħal Qormi 的 Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa 这一名称与一则传说有关：圣母节当天，每人都分到了一小块宰杀后的猪肉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jintuża l-isem Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa? Pawlu: F'Ħal Qormi. Hemm leġġenda marbuta ma' dan l-isem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the name Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa used? Pawlu: In Ħal Qormi. There is a legend associated with that name.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa 这个名称用于哪里？Pawlu：用于 Ħal Qormi。这个名称还关联着一则传说。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn jintuża l-isem Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn jintuża l-isem Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa?
messages.zh: Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa 这个名称用于哪里？
messages.en: Where is the name Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa used?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: F'Ħal Qormi. Hemm leġġenda marbuta ma' dan l-isem.
messages.mt_standard: F'Ħal Qormi. Hemm leġġenda marbuta ma' dan l-isem.
messages.zh: 用于 Ħal Qormi。这个名称还关联着一则传说。
messages.en: In Ħal Qormi. There is a legend associated with that name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qrejqċa 放在完整地名 Santa Marija ta' Qrejqċa 中记忆，再联想传说中人人分到一小片猪肉的画面；不要把它当作日常“小片”的通用词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mischievous person, or an imp appearing in an imaginary story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指爱恶作剧、调皮捣蛋的人，也可指故事中的小妖精。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb tagħmel il-praspar, jew ħlejqa żgħira u mqarba f'rakkont immaġinarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淘气鬼；爱恶作剧、调皮捣蛋的人。
小妖精；小恶魔。

collocations.en: the tricks of a mischievous person

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, qrejweż ċkejken jaħbi ċ-ċwievet u jidħak meta n-nies jibdew ifittxuhom.
formal.en: In the story, a little imp hides the keys and laughs when people start looking for them.
formal.zh: 故事里，一个小妖精把钥匙藏起来，看到人们开始寻找便笑了起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħeba l-pinna tiegħi? Mark: Jien! Maja: Ja qrejweż! Agħtihieli lura.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who hid my pen? Mark: I did! Maja: You little rascal! Give it back to me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把我的笔藏起来了？Mark：是我！Maja：你这个淘气鬼！快还给我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把我的笔藏起来了？
messages.en: Who hid my pen?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我！
messages.en: I did!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你这个淘气鬼！快还给我。
messages.en: You little rascal! Give it back to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个把笔藏起来偷笑的“淘气鬼”，再把同一角色画进童话成为“小妖精”；用这两幅画记住 qrejweż 的两个名词义。

gloss_zh: 一种以玻璃弹珠靠近目标为玩法的儿童游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a children's game in which players try to get glass marbles near the ġakkijiet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种儿童游戏的名称，玩法是设法让玻璃弹珠靠近称为 ġakkijiet 的目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' logħba tat-tfal li fiha jippruvaw iqarrbu l-boċċi tal-ħġieġ lejn il-ġakkijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: the name of a children's game - so called because it consists of children getting the glass balls near the ġakkijiet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种儿童游戏的名称；因玩法是让玻璃弹珠靠近 ġakkijiet 这一目标而得名。

collocations.zh: 我们玩 qriba 弹珠游戏

formal.mt: Fil-logħba tal-qriba, it-tfal jippruvaw iqarrbu l-boċċi tal-ħġieġ lejn il-ġakkijiet.
formal.en: In the game of qriba, children try to get glass marbles near the ġakkijiet.
formal.zh: 在 qriba 游戏中，孩子们设法让玻璃弹珠靠近称为 ġakkijiet 的目标。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nilagħbu l-qriba? Toni: Iva, imma kif tintlagħab? Lara: Trid tressaq il-boċċa tal-ħġieġ qrib il-ġakkijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we play qriba? Toni: Yes, but how do you play it? Lara: You have to get the glass marble near the ġakkijiet.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们玩 qriba 吧？Toni：好啊，不过怎么玩？Lara：要让玻璃弹珠靠近 ġakkijiet 那些目标。

messages.speaker: Lara (玩伴)
messages.zh: 我们玩 qriba 吧？
messages.en: Shall we play qriba?

messages.speaker: Toni (玩伴)
messages.zh: 好啊，不过怎么玩？
messages.en: Yes, but how do you play it?

messages.speaker: Lara (玩伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tressaq il-boċċa tal-ħġieġ qrib il-ġakkijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Trid tressaq il-boċċa tal-ħġieġ qrib il-ġakkijiet.
messages.zh: 要让玻璃弹珠靠近 ġakkijiet 那些目标。
messages.en: You have to get the glass marble near the ġakkijiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“弹珠朝目标靠近”的动态图记住 qriba：本词条是儿童游戏的名字，看到名词用法时就想起这套玩法。

gloss_zh: 擦除污渍；刮擦；抱怨；哼唧；毁坏

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of scouring stains or scratching; also complaint, whining, or destruction, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指擦除污渍或刮擦的行为，也可指抱怨、哼唧，以及毁坏；具体意义由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għorik biex jitneħħew it-tbajja', jew il-grif; jista' jfisser ukoll tgergir, ilmenti jew qerda, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力擦洗、擦除污渍。
刮擦；抓挠。
抱怨；表示不满。
哼唧；以拖长、令人厌烦的声音诉苦或抱怨。
毁坏；破坏；摧毁。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-qrid tal-foresti u t-telf ta' postijiet fejn jgħixu l-annimali.
formal.en: The report describes the destruction of forests and the loss of places where animals live.
formal.zh: 报告描述了森林的毁坏以及动物栖息地的丧失。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-qrid kollu għax qed nistennew ħames minuti? Lara: Għandi l-ġuħ! Mark: Nifhem, imma dalwaqt nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Mark: All this whining because we're waiting five minutes? Lara: I'm hungry! Mark: I understand, but we'll be going in soon.
colloquial.zh: Mark：才等五分钟，你就这样抱怨个不停？Lara：我饿了！Mark：我知道，不过我们很快就能进去了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-qrid kollu għax qed nistennew ħames minuti?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-qrid kollu għax qed nistennew ħames minuti?
messages.zh: 才等五分钟，你就这样抱怨个不停？
messages.en: All this whining because we're waiting five minutes?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我饿了！
messages.en: I'm hungry!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我知道，不过我们很快就能进去了。
messages.en: I understand, but we'll be going in soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 qrid 画五格提示图：擦污渍、抓挠、提出不满、哼唧诉苦、森林被毁。把它们作为五个语境分别记忆，不强行编造共同词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the same age as another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人年龄相同的；同龄的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-istess età bħal persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同龄的；年龄相同的。

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa qrin tiegħi; it-tnejn għandna għoxrin sena.
formal.en: Pawlu is the same age as me; we are both twenty years old.
formal.zh: Pawlu 与我同龄；我们都是二十岁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandu żmien Mark? Lara: Għandu tmintax-il sena, bħalek. Maja: Mela huwa qrin tiegħi!
colloquial.en: Maja: How old is Mark? Lara: He's eighteen, like you. Maja: So he's the same age as me!
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 多大了？Lara：他十八岁，跟你一样。Maja：原来他和我同龄啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 多大了？
messages.en: How old is Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他十八岁，跟你一样。
messages.en: He's eighteen, like you.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 原来他和我同龄啊！
messages.en: So he's the same age as me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人的年龄牌上都写着“18”，把 qrin tiegħi 整块记成“与我同龄”；记忆重点是年龄相同，不是生日相同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The irritation of a wound; also a very cold wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指对伤口的刺激，也可指非常寒冷、凛冽的风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-irritazzjoni ta' ferita; jista' jfisser ukoll riħ kiesaħ ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺激伤口；使伤口受到刺激。
非常寒冷的风；凛冽寒风。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, qriħ qawwi laqat il-kosta u t-temperatura niżlet.
formal.en: During the night, a strong, bitterly cold wind hit the coast and the temperature fell.
formal.zh: 夜间，强劲的凛冽寒风袭击海岸，气温随之下降。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qriħ hawn barra! Pawlu: Iva, ejja nidħlu ġewwa. Nina: Idea tajba, qed niksaħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: What a bitterly cold wind out here! Pawlu: Yes, let's go inside. Nina: Good idea, I'm getting cold.
colloquial.zh: Nina：外面的风真冷啊！Pawlu：是啊，我们进去吧。Nina：好主意，我开始觉得冷了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 外面的风真冷啊！
messages.en: What a bitterly cold wind out here!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go inside.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 好主意，我开始觉得冷了。
messages.en: Good idea, I'm getting cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qriħ 配两张独立卡片：一张写“伤口受刺激”，另一张画“寒风吹得人发抖”；注意末尾是 ħ，与 qrid 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to coral or having the colour of coral.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与珊瑚有关的，或呈珊瑚色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-qroll jew li għandu l-kulur tal-qroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珊瑚的；珊瑚色的。

formal.mt: Għad-disinn tal-kartolina ntgħażel lewn qrolli fuq sfond abjad.
formal.en: A coral hue against a white background was chosen for the postcard design.
formal.zh: 明信片的设计选用了白色背景上的珊瑚色调。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema kulur trid għall-kartolina? Mark: Kulur qrolli, jekk jogħġbok. Lara: Sewwa, nużah fuq sfond abjad.
colloquial.en: Lara: What colour do you want for the postcard? Mark: A coral colour, please. Lara: All right, I'll use it against a white background.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想给明信片用什么颜色？Mark：请用珊瑚色。Lara：好的，我把它配在白色背景上。

messages.speaker: Lara (设计师)
messages.zh: 你想给明信片用什么颜色？
messages.en: What colour do you want for the postcard?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请用珊瑚色。
messages.en: A coral colour, please.

messages.speaker: Lara (设计师)
messages.zh: 好的，我把它配在白色背景上。
messages.en: All right, I'll use it against a white background.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在色卡上涂一块珊瑚色并标注 kulur qrolli，把“颜色名词加形容词”的搭配一起记住，看到 qrolli 就联想珊瑚及其色调。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sweet william, the flowering plant Dianthus barbatus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 须苞石竹，也称美国石竹，学名为 Dianthus barbatus 的开花植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Dianthus barbatus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 须苞石竹，又称美国石竹，学名 Dianthus barbatus。

formal.mt: Il-qronfol tal-bukketti, magħruf xjentifikament bħala Dianthus barbatus, huwa wieħed mill-pjanti magħżula għal dan il-ġnien.
formal.en: Sweet william, known scientifically as Dianthus barbatus, is one of the plants selected for this garden.
formal.zh: 须苞石竹的学名是 Dianthus barbatus，是为这座花园选定的植物之一。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimhom dawn il-fjuri? Toni: Qronfol tal-bukketti. Maja: Nixtieq nixtri ftit għall-ġnien tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are these flowers called? Toni: Sweet william. Maja: I'd like to buy some for my garden.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些花叫什么？Toni：须苞石竹。Maja：我想买一些种在自己的花园里。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些花叫什么？
messages.en: What are these flowers called?

messages.speaker: Toni (花店店员)
messages.zh: 须苞石竹。
messages.en: Sweet william.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 我想买一些种在自己的花园里。
messages.en: I'd like to buy some for my garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张花园植物标签，把 qronfol tal-bukketti、须苞石竹、sweet william 和 Dianthus barbatus 写在一起；将整个马耳他语词组作为一个植物名称记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: China pink, the flowering plant Dianthus chinensis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指石竹这一开花植物，学名为 Dianthus chinensis。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Dianthus chinensis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石竹（学名 Dianthus chinensis）。

formal.mt: Il-lista tal-pjanti tinkludi l-qronfol tal-Kina bl-isem xjentifiku Dianthus chinensis.
formal.en: The plant list includes China pink under the scientific name Dianthus chinensis.
formal.zh: 植物名录收录了石竹，并列出了其学名 Dianthus chinensis。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se npoġġu din il-borma bil-qronfol tal-Kina? Mark: Ħdejn il-bieb, biex narawha kull darba li nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we put this pot of China pinks? Mark: By the door, so we see it whenever we come in.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这盆石竹放在哪里？马克：放在门边吧，这样每次进门都能看见。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se npoġġu din il-borma bil-qronfol tal-Kina?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se npoġġu din il-borma bil-qronfol tal-Kina?
messages.zh: 这盆石竹放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put this pot of China pinks?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb, biex narawha kull darba li nidħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb, biex narawha kull darba li nidħlu.
messages.zh: 放在门边吧，这样每次进门都能看见。
messages.en: By the door, so we see it whenever we come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作石竹双面卡：正面写 qronfol tal-Kina，背面写石竹与学名；再与 tal-Ċina 词条并排复习，记住两条都对应同一植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feathered pink, the flowering plant Dianthus plumarius.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指羽瓣石竹这一开花植物，学名为 Dianthus plumarius。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Dianthus plumarius.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羽瓣石竹（学名 Dianthus plumarius）。

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju tat-tpinġija, l-istudenti għażlu l-fjuri tal-qronfol tal-pjuma.
formal.en: For the drawing exercise, the students chose feathered pink flowers.
formal.zh: 学生们选择羽瓣石竹的花作为绘画练习的对象。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-qronfol tal-pjuma jogħġobni. Nixtru borma? Toni: Iva, u npoġġuha ħdejn il-pjanti l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: I like this feathered pink. Shall we buy a pot? Toni: Yes, and we can put it beside the other plants.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我喜欢这株羽瓣石竹。我们买一盆好吗？托尼：好呀，可以把它放在其他植物旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-qronfol tal-pjuma jogħġobni. Nixtru borma?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-qronfol tal-pjuma jogħġobni. Nixtru borma?
messages.zh: 我喜欢这株羽瓣石竹。我们买一盆好吗？
messages.en: I like this feathered pink. Shall we buy a pot?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u npoġġuha ħdejn il-pjanti l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u npoġġuha ħdejn il-pjanti l-oħra.
messages.zh: 好呀，可以把它放在其他植物旁边。
messages.en: Yes, and we can put it beside the other plants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qronfol tal-pjuma 与英文 feathered pink、中文羽瓣石竹放在同一张图卡上，朗读完整词组，避免与其他 qronfol 花名混记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: China pink, the flowering plant Dianthus chinensis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指石竹这一开花植物，学名为 Dianthus chinensis。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Dianthus chinensis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石竹（学名 Dianthus chinensis）。

formal.mt: Fit-tikketta tal-pjanta hemm miktub: qronfol tal-Ċina, Dianthus chinensis.
formal.en: The plant label reads: China pink, Dianthus chinensis.
formal.zh: 植物标签上写着：石竹，Dianthus chinensis。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Qronfol tal-Ċina. Trid waħda għall-gallarija?
colloquial.en: Marta: What is this plant called? Pawlu: China pink. Would you like one for the balcony?
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这株植物叫什么？保罗：石竹。你想买一株放在阳台上吗？

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (花店店员)
messages.zh: 石竹。你想买一株放在阳台上吗？
messages.en: China pink. Would you like one for the balcony?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条词组写在石竹图片下，并与学名 Dianthus chinensis 配对；认出 tal-Ċina 后仍要记住完整花名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mexican marigold, the flowering plant Tagetes erecta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指万寿菊这一开花植物，学名为 Tagetes erecta。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Tagetes erecta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 万寿菊（学名 Tagetes erecta）。

formal.mt: Fil-pjan tal-ġnien, hemm ringiela qronfol tat-Tork ħdejn il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The garden plan shows a row of Mexican marigolds beside the path.
formal.zh: 花园规划图中，小路旁有一排万寿菊。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandkom żerriegħa tal-qronfol tat-Tork? Ġużeppi: Iva, hawn pakkett. Trid wieħed?
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have Mexican marigold seeds? Ġużeppi: Yes, here is a packet. Would you like one?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你们有万寿菊种子吗？朱塞佩：有，这里有一包。你要一包吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有万寿菊种子吗？
messages.en: Do you have Mexican marigold seeds?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园艺店店员)
messages.zh: 有，这里有一包。你要一包吗？
messages.en: Yes, here is a packet. Would you like one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园小路旁的一排万寿菊，给它挂上 qronfol tat-Tork 标签；用整幅场景记词，并用 Tagetes erecta 核对植物身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mexican marigold, the flowering plant Tagetes erecta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指万寿菊这一开花植物，学名为 Tagetes erecta。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Tagetes erecta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 万寿菊（学名 Tagetes erecta）。

formal.mt: Il-klassi poġġiet borma bil-qronfol Tork fuq il-mejda tal-wirja.
formal.en: The class placed a pot of Mexican marigolds on the exhibition table.
formal.zh: 全班在展台上摆放了一盆万寿菊。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-borma bil-qronfol Tork hi għalik. David: Grazzi! Se npoġġiha fil-bitħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: This pot of Mexican marigolds is for you. David: Thank you! I'll put it in the courtyard.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这盆万寿菊送给你。戴维：谢谢！我要把它放在院子里。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-borma bil-qronfol Tork hi għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-borma bil-qronfol Tork hi għalik.
messages.zh: 这盆万寿菊送给你。
messages.en: This pot of Mexican marigolds is for you.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢！我要把它放在院子里。
messages.en: Thank you! I'll put it in the courtyard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qronfol Tork 写在赠送万寿菊的情景卡上，练习说出整条花名；再与 qronfol tat-Tork 对照，两条都配同一学名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mexican marigold, the flowering plant Tagetes erecta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指万寿菊这一开花植物，学名为 Tagetes erecta。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Tagetes erecta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 万寿菊（学名 Tagetes erecta）。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħawlu l-qronfol Torki u kitbu l-isem Tagetes erecta fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: The students planted Mexican marigolds and wrote the name Tagetes erecta on the label.
formal.zh: 学生们栽种了万寿菊，并在标签上写下 Tagetes erecta。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'għandna niktbu fuq it-tikketta? Ben: Qronfol Torki. Ikteb ukoll Tagetes erecta.
colloquial.en: Marija: What should we write on the label? Ben: Mexican marigold. Write Tagetes erecta as well.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：标签上该写什么？本：万寿菊。也写上 Tagetes erecta。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 标签上该写什么？
messages.en: What should we write on the label?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qronfol Torki. Ikteb ukoll Tagetes erecta.
messages.mt_standard: Qronfol Torki. Ikteb ukoll Tagetes erecta.
messages.zh: 万寿菊。也写上 Tagetes erecta。
messages.en: Mexican marigold. Write Tagetes erecta as well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 Torki 结尾还有一个 i，把完整词组抄在万寿菊标签上；与 Tork、tat-Tork 两种条目并列朗读，三条均对应 Tagetes erecta。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The time or period when fish eggs hatch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鱼卵孵化、幼鱼出卵的时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żmien meta jfaqqas il-bajd tal-ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鱼卵孵化、幼鱼出卵的时期。

collocations.en: the start of the fish hatching period

formal.mt: Waqt il-qroqq, ir-riċerkaturi rreġistraw l-osservazzjonijiet tagħhom kuljum.
formal.en: During the fish hatching period, the researchers recorded their observations every day.
formal.zh: 在鱼卵孵化期，研究人员每天记录观察结果。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser qroqq f'dan il-ktieb? Samwel: Iż-żmien meta jfaqqas il-bajd tal-ħut.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does qroqq mean in this book? Samwel: The time when fish eggs hatch.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这本书里的 qroqq 是什么意思？萨缪尔：就是鱼卵孵化的时期。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这本书里的 qroqq 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does qroqq mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Samwel (教师)
messages.zh: 就是鱼卵孵化的时期。
messages.en: The time when fish eggs hatch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条鱼卵到幼鱼的时间线，在孵化阶段标上 qroqq；把它记成一个时期，并连读 waqt il-qroqq，表示在孵化期。

gloss_zh: 外角；外侧角部（如袋子或建筑的角）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outside corner, such as a corner of a sack or a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体外侧的角或角部，例如袋子的角部或建筑的外角。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rokna ta' barra ta' oġġett, bħal xkora jew bini.

sense_translations.en_definition: external corner (e.g. of a sack, of a building)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 外角；物体外侧的角部，例如袋子的角部或建筑的外角。

collocations.en: the outside corner of the building

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ħsara fil-qruna tal-bini ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: The report describes damage to the outside corner of the building near the entrance.
formal.zh: 报告描述了建筑入口附近外角的损坏情况。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Minn fejn qed joħroġ ir-ross? Karl: Hemm toqba fil-qruna tal-ixkora. Ġib kontenitur.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where is the rice spilling out from? Karl: There is a hole in the corner of the sack. Bring a container.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：米是从哪里漏出来的？卡尔：袋子角上有个洞。拿个容器来。

messages.speaker: Lina (室友)
messages.zh: 米是从哪里漏出来的？
messages.en: Where is the rice spilling out from?

messages.speaker: Karl (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm toqba fil-qruna tal-ixkora. Ġib kontenitur.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm toqba fil-qruna tal-ixkora. Ġib kontenitur.
messages.zh: 袋子角上有个洞。拿个容器来。
messages.en: There is a hole in the corner of the sack. Bring a container.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指摸到袋子的外角，再指向建筑的外角；两幅图都标 qruna，用共同的外侧角部形象记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small rod; the diminutive form of qasba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小杆或小棍，是 qasba 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qasba żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qasba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小杆；小棍，为 qasba 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, uża qsajba tal-injam biex tagħmel linja fir-ramel.
formal.en: For this exercise, use a small wooden rod to draw a line in the sand.
formal.zh: 做这个练习时，用一根木制小杆在沙上画一条线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek qsajba biex inħawwad iż-żebgħa? Mark: Iva, ħu din. Hija nadifa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a small rod I can stir the paint with? Mark: Yes, take this one. It's clean.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有小杆可以让我搅拌颜料吗？马克：有，拿这根吧。它是干净的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有小杆可以让我搅拌颜料吗？
messages.en: Do you have a small rod I can stir the paint with?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，拿这根吧。它是干净的。
messages.en: Yes, take this one. It's clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qsajba 和一根搅拌颜料的小杆配图记忆，突出“小巧的杆子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small estate or farm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规模较小的庄园或农场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proprjetà żgħira tal-art jew razzett żgħir.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small estate/farm. (toponymy) tal-qsajjem, name of fields in the area of munxar, gozo; name of a heath north of għajn żerriegħa on the road of mtaħleb leading to rabat, malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小庄园或小农场。地名用法：Tal-Qsajjem 指戈佐岛 Munxar 一带的田地；也指马耳他岛 Għajn Żerriegħa 以北、从 Mtaħleb 通往 Rabat 的道路沿线的一片荒野。

collocations.en: a small estate in the countryside
a small farm with one field

formal.mt: Il-proprjetà deskritta fir-rapport hija qsajjam b'dar żgħira u għalqa waħda.
formal.en: The property described in the report is a small estate with a little house and one field.
formal.zh: 报告中描述的地产是一处小庄园，包含一栋小房子和一块田。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu qsajjam? Pawlu: Razzett żgħir jew proprjetà żgħira tal-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a qsajjam? Pawlu: A small farm or a small estate.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：qsajjam 是什么意思？保罗：小农场或小庄园。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: qsajjam 是什么意思？
messages.en: What is a qsajjam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Razzett żgħir jew proprjetà żgħira tal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Razzett żgħir jew proprjetà żgħira tal-art.
messages.zh: 小农场或小庄园。
messages.en: A small farm or a small estate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一栋小房子旁只有一块田，把 qsajjam 记成规模不大的农场或庄园。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rather short in length or duration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长度或持续时间比较短的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun kemxejn qasir fit-tul jew fil-ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比较短的；较为短小的。

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jikteb test qsajjar dwar il-ħajja fil-kampanja.
formal.en: The student should write a rather short text about life in the countryside.
formal.zh: 学生应写一篇介绍乡村生活的短文。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif kien id-diskors? Adam: Kien qsajjar, imma ċar ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: How was the speech? Adam: It was rather short, but very clear.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：讲话怎么样？亚当：比较简短，不过讲得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 讲话怎么样？
messages.en: How was the speech?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 比较简短，不过讲得很清楚。
messages.en: It was rather short, but very clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一篇几行就读完的短文，用 test qsajjar 整组记住“比较短”的程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or condition of being short in length or duration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长度或持续时间较短这一性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-kundizzjoni ta' xi ħaġa li tkun qasira fit-tul jew fil-ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短小；简短；长度或时间短这一性质。

formal.mt: Il-qsara tat-test tagħmilha possibbli li jinqara fi ftit minuti.
formal.en: The shortness of the text makes it possible to read it in a few minutes.
formal.zh: 这篇文字篇幅简短，几分钟就能读完。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għoġbok fid-diskors? Ben: Il-qsara tiegħu. Qal kollox fi ftit minuti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did you like about the speech? Ben: Its shortness. He said everything in a few minutes.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你喜欢这场讲话的哪一点？本：它很简短。他几分钟就把内容都讲完了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这场讲话的哪一点？
messages.en: What did you like about the speech?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qsara tiegħu. Qal kollox fi ftit minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qsara tiegħu. Qal kollox fi ftit minuti.
messages.zh: 它很简短。他几分钟就把内容都讲完了。
messages.en: Its shortness. He said everything in a few minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qsara 当作“简短这件事”来记：它是名词，指文字或讲话具有的短这一性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Retaliation that matches the harm originally inflicted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照原先所受伤害给予相应程度报复的做法或原则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tpattija li tikkorrispondi għall-ħsara li tkun saret.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同态报复；以相等程度的伤害进行报复。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-qsas bħala tpattija li tkun daqs il-ħsara oriġinali.
formal.en: The text describes talion as retaliation equal to the original harm.
formal.zh: 这篇文字把同态报复描述为与原先伤害程度相等的报复。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser qsas f'dan it-test? David: Tpattija daqs il-ħsara li tkun saret.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does qsas mean in this text? David: Retaliation equal to the harm that was done.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这篇文字里的 qsas 是什么意思？戴维：就是按所受伤害的同等程度进行报复。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文字里的 qsas 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does qsas mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tpattija daqs il-ħsara li tkun saret.
messages.mt_standard: Tpattija daqs il-ħsara li tkun saret.
messages.zh: 就是按所受伤害的同等程度进行报复。
messages.en: Retaliation equal to the harm that was done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天平两边分别放着原来的伤害和等量的报复，用“程度相等”记住 qsas。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of dividing something into parts or separating things from one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物划分成若干部分，或使事物彼此分开的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinqasam f'partijiet jew affarijiet jinfirdu minn xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划分；分割；把整体分成若干部分。
分离；分开；使原本相连或相聚的事物彼此分离。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi kif għandu jsir il-qsim tal-art bejn iż-żewġ sidien.
formal.en: The agreement sets out how the land is to be divided between the two owners.
formal.zh: 协议规定了这片土地应如何在两位所有者之间分割。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif se nagħmlu l-qsim fi gruppi? Tom: Inkunu erbgħa f'kull grupp.
colloquial.en: Lina: How are we going to divide up into groups? Tom: There will be four of us in each group.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我们怎么分组？汤姆：每组四个人。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nagħmlu l-qsim fi gruppi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nagħmlu l-qsim fi gruppi?
messages.zh: 我们怎么分组？
messages.en: How are we going to divide up into groups?

messages.speaker: Tom (同学)
messages.zh: 每组四个人。
messages.en: There will be four of us in each group.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 qsim：一块土地划成几份表示“分割”，一家人分处两地表示“分离”。

gloss_zh: 一又四分之一 rotolo 的重量

teaching_sense.en_definition: A weight equal to one and a quarter rotolos.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相当于一又四分之一 rotolo 的重量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Piż ta' ratal u kwart.

sense_translations.en_definition: weight consisting of a rotolo and a quarter
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一又四分之一 rotolo 的重量。

collocations.en: one and a quarter rotolos of flour
collocations.zh: 一又四分之一 rotolo 重的面粉

collocations.en: one and a quarter rotolos of sugar
collocations.zh: 一又四分之一 rotolo 重的糖

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, qsima dqiq tfisser ammont ta' dqiq li jiżen ratal u kwart.
formal.en: In this exercise, a qsima of flour means an amount of flour weighing one and a quarter rotolos.
formal.zh: 在这个练习中，一 qsima 面粉指重量为一又四分之一 rotolo 的面粉。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm hi qsima zokkor? Ġużeppi: Ratal u kwart zokkor.
colloquial.en: Rita: How much is a qsima of sugar? Ġużeppi: One and a quarter rotolos of sugar.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：一 qsima 糖是多少？朱塞佩：一又四分之一 rotolo 重的糖。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 一 qsima 糖是多少？
messages.en: How much is a qsima of sugar?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.zh: 一又四分之一 rotolo 重的糖。
messages.en: One and a quarter rotolos of sugar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 qsima 画一张重量卡：一个完整 rotolo 再加四分之一个，牢记数值是一又四分之一。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of fingering beads threaded on a cord, or of reciting the rosary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手指拨弄穿在绳上的珠子这一动作，也指诵念玫瑰经。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed imexxi bejn subgħajh żibeġ fuq ħajta, jew li jgħid ir-rużarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手指拨弄或捻动穿在绳上的珠子。
诵念玫瑰经。

formal.mt: Il-kelma qsit tista' tirreferi għall-moviment taż-żibeġ bejn is-swaba' jew għar-reċita tar-rużarju.
formal.en: The word qsit can refer to moving beads between the fingers or to reciting the rosary.
formal.zh: qsit 一词可以指在手指间拨动珠子，也可以指诵念玫瑰经。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Il-kelma qsit tfisser biss li tgħid ir-rużarju? Marija: Le, tista' tfisser ukoll li tmexxi ż-żibeġ bejn subgħajk.
colloquial.en: Elena: Does qsit only mean reciting the rosary? Marija: No, it can also mean moving beads between your fingers.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：qsit 只表示诵念玫瑰经吗？玛丽亚：不是，它也可以表示用手指拨动珠子。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelma qsit tfisser biss li tgħid ir-rużarju?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelma qsit tfisser biss li tgħid ir-rużarju?
messages.zh: qsit 只表示诵念玫瑰经吗？
messages.en: Does qsit only mean reciting the rosary?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' tfisser ukoll li tmexxi ż-żibeġ bejn subgħajk.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' tfisser ukoll li tmexxi ż-żibeġ bejn subgħajk.
messages.zh: 不是，它也可以表示用手指拨动珠子。
messages.en: No, it can also mean moving beads between your fingers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“手拨珠、口念经”两个画面记住 qsit 的两个义项：拨弄串珠与诵念玫瑰经。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being short in length or duration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长度短或持续时间短的性质；简短性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun qasira fit-tul jew fiż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短；长度或持续时间上的简短性。

collocations.en: the shortness of the time available

formal.mt: Minkejja l-qsurija tat-test, l-awtur jispjega l-idea b'mod ċar.
formal.en: Despite the shortness of the text, the author explains the idea clearly.
formal.zh: 尽管文本简短，作者仍清楚地解释了这个想法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-test jidher qasir wisq. Mark: Il-qsurija tiegħu ma tfixkilx; l-idea hija ċara.
colloquial.en: Lara: The text seems too short. Mark: Its shortness is not a problem; the idea is clear.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章看起来太短了。马克：简短不碍事，意思很清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章看起来太短了。
messages.en: The text seems too short.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qsurija tiegħu ma tfixkilx; l-idea hija ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qsurija tiegħu ma tfixkilx; l-idea hija ċara.
messages.zh: 简短不碍事，意思很清楚。
messages.en: Its shortness is not a problem; the idea is clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一篇很短却意思完整的文章作为画面，记住 qsurija 表示“短这种性质”，而不是某一件短物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small cut, such as a minor cut in the skin; the diminutive of qatgħa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小切口，例如皮肤上的轻微割伤；是 qatgħa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qatgħa żgħira, bħal ferita żgħira fil-ġilda; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qatgħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small cut (the diminutive form of 'qatgħa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小切口；小割伤，是 qatgħa 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small cut on your finger

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kellu qtajgħa f'subgħajh u għattiha b'faxxa żgħira.
formal.en: The worker had a small cut on his finger and covered it with a small bandage.
formal.zh: 工人的手指上有一道小伤口，他用小绷带把它包住了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi qtajgħa f'subgħajja. Pawlu: Trid faxxa żgħira? Maja: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have a small cut on my finger. Pawlu: Would you like a small bandage? Maja: Yes, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的手指上有一道小伤口。保罗：要一条小绷带吗？玛雅：要，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的手指上有一道小伤口。
messages.en: I have a small cut on my finger.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 要一条小绷带吗？
messages.en: Would you like a small bandage?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指上只有一道小小的割痕：qatgħa 是切口，qtajgħa 把画面缩小，记成“小切口”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small drop of liquid; the diminutive of qatra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体的一小滴；是 qatra 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qatra żgħira ta' likwidu; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qatra.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small drop (the diminutive form of 'qatra')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小滴，是 qatra 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Żid qtajra żejt mat-taħlita u ħawwad bil-mod.
formal.en: Add a small drop of oil to the mixture and stir gently.
formal.zh: 往混合物中加入一小滴油，然后轻轻搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm żejt inżid? Toni: Qtajra biss; il-pan diġà fih ftit żejt.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much oil should I add? Toni: Just a small drop; there is already some oil in the pan.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我要加多少油？托尼：一小滴就够了，锅里已经有一点油。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我要加多少油？
messages.en: How much oil should I add?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qtajra biss; il-pan diġà fih ftit żejt.
messages.mt_standard: Qtajra biss; il-pan diġà fih ftit żejt.
messages.zh: 一小滴就够了，锅里已经有一点油。
messages.en: Just a small drop; there is already some oil in the pan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象滴管尖端挂着一颗很小的水珠：qatra 是一滴，qtajra 是缩小后的“一小滴”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sheaf of gathered stalks, such as wheat; the diminutive of qatta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收拢成束的一小捆禾秆，例如麦秆；是 qatta 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qatta żgħira ta' zkuk miġbura flimkien, bħal dawk tal-qamħ; il-forma diminuttiva ta' qatta.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small sheaf (the diminutive form of 'qatta')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小捆禾秆；小禾束，是 qatta 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi rabat qtajta qamħ bi spaga u poġġieha ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The farmer tied a small sheaf of wheat with string and placed it beside the door.
formal.zh: 农民用细绳扎起一小捆麦子，把它放在门旁。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi din il-qtajta qamħ? Ġużeppi: Poġġiha ħdejn il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where should I put this small sheaf of wheat? Ġużeppi: Put it beside the door, please.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这小捆麦子放在哪里？朱塞佩：请把它放在门旁。

messages.speaker: Nina (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 这小捆麦子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this small sheaf of wheat?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.zh: 请把它放在门旁。
messages.en: Put it beside the door, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把几根麦秆用细绳扎成迷你禾束：qatta 的指小形式 qtajta，记住重点是“一小捆”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of cutting something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切、剪或割某物的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li taqta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切割；剪切这一动作或过程。

formal.mt: Qabel il-qtigħ tad-drapp, immarka l-linja b'mod ċar.
formal.en: Before cutting the fabric, mark the line clearly.
formal.zh: 裁剪布料之前，要把线标清楚。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nibda l-qtigħ tad-drapp? Rita: Stenna ftit, għad irridu nkejlu din in-naħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Shall I start cutting the fabric? Rita: Wait a moment; we still need to measure this side.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我开始裁布吗？丽塔：等一下，我们还得量这一边。

messages.speaker: Marija (裁缝学徒)
messages.zh: 我开始裁布吗？
messages.en: Shall I start cutting the fabric?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit, għad irridu nkejlu din in-naħa.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit, għad irridu nkejlu din in-naħa.
messages.zh: 等一下，我们还得量这一边。
messages.en: Wait a moment; we still need to measure this side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象剪刀沿线持续前进，把 qtigħ 记成“切割这个过程”；与表示小切口的 qtajgħa 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of liquid falling in drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体一滴一滴落下的动作或现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' likwidu li jinżel qatra qatra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滴落；液体一滴一滴落下的现象。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġie osservat qtir ta' ilma mill-pajp.
formal.en: During the inspection, water was observed dripping from the pipe.
formal.zh: 检查期间，发现水正从管道中一滴滴落下。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Tisma' dak il-qtir? Anna: Iva, ġej mill-vit tal-kċina.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Can you hear that dripping? Anna: Yes, it is coming from the kitchen tap.
colloquial.zh: 丹尼尔：你听见那滴水声了吗？安娜：听见了，是厨房水龙头传来的。

messages.speaker: Daniel (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那滴水声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that dripping?

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，是厨房水龙头传来的。
messages.en: Yes, it is coming from the kitchen tap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放水龙头“滴、滴、滴”的连续画面：qtir 是滴落的过程，qtajra 则是一小滴液体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of being cut off or separated by cutting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够通过切割而被切断或分离的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinqata' jew jiġi separat permezz tal-qtigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可以被切断的；能够被割下或剪下的。

collocations.en: material that can be cut off
an end that can be cut off

formal.mt: It-tarf żejjed huwa qtugħi u jista' jitneħħa b'imqass.
formal.en: The excess end can be cut off and can be removed with scissors.
formal.zh: 多余的末端可以剪掉，用剪刀即可去除。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Dan it-tarf huwa qtugħi? Elena: Iva, tista' taqtgħu b'imqass.
colloquial.en: Luca: Can this end be cut off? Elena: Yes, you can cut it off with scissors.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：这个末端可以剪掉吗？埃莱娜：可以，你可以用剪刀把它剪掉。

messages.speaker: Luca (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 这个末端可以剪掉吗？
messages.en: Can this end be cut off?

messages.speaker: Elena (手工课教师)
messages.zh: 可以，你可以用剪刀把它剪掉。
messages.en: Yes, you can cut it off with scissors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象材料末端贴着“可以剪掉”的标签，把 qtugħi 记成描述可切断性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ticks: small parasites that attach to animals or people and feed on blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜱虫的复数形式，指附着在人或动物身上吸血的小型寄生虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parassiti żgħar li jeħlu mal-ġilda tal-annimali jew tal-bnedmin u jerdgħu d-demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜱虫；吸血寄生虫，复数。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, il-veterinarju sab qurdien fil-pil tal-kelb.
formal.en: During the examination, the vet found ticks in the dog's fur.
formal.zh: 检查时，兽医在狗的毛发里发现了蜱虫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt qurdien fuq il-kelb. Mark: Ċempel lill-veterinarju biex jista' jgħinek.
colloquial.en: Maja: I found ticks on the dog. Mark: Call the vet so they can help you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我在狗身上发现了蜱虫。Mark：给兽医打电话，让兽医帮你。

messages.speaker: Maja (养狗人)
messages.zh: 我在狗身上发现了蜱虫。
messages.en: I found ticks on the dog.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 给兽医打电话，让兽医帮你。
messages.en: Call the vet so they can help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qurdien 配上一只狗毛发里藏着多只蜱虫的画面，重点记住这里表示复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tick: a small blood-feeding parasite that may be found in an animal's fur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只蜱虫，指可能藏在动物毛发中、附着在皮肤上吸血的寄生虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parassita żgħir li jista' jinstab fil-pil ta' annimal u jeħel mal-ġilda biex jerdagħlu d-demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜱虫；可见于动物毛发中的吸血寄生虫。

collocations.en: a tick in the cat's fur

formal.mt: Il-veterinarju sab qurdiena waħda wara widnet il-qattus.
formal.en: The vet found one tick behind the cat's ear.
formal.zh: 兽医在猫的耳朵后面发现了一只蜱虫。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dik qurdiena fil-pil tiegħu? Pawlu: Iva, se nieħdu għand il-veterinarju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that a tick in his fur? Pawlu: Yes, I'm going to take him to the vet.
colloquial.zh: Lara：它毛发里的那个是蜱虫吗？Pawlu：是的，我要带它去看兽医。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 它毛发里的那个是蜱虫吗？
messages.en: Is that a tick in his fur?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养猫人)
messages.zh: 是的，我要带它去看兽医。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to take him to the vet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qurdiena 和 qurdien 对照着记：前者画一只蜱虫，后者画多只蜱虫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mountain top, as represented in the place name Għajn Quċċat, a spring in Żebbuġ, Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 山顶；见于地名 Għajn Quċċat，该名称指戈佐岛 Żebbuġ 的一处泉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Quċċata ta' muntanja; il-kelma tidher fl-isem Għajn Quċċat, għajn fiż-Żebbuġ, Għawdex.

sense_translations.en_definition: top of a mountain occurring in (toponymy) għajn quċċat, name of a spring in żebbuġ, gozo
sense_translations.zh_definition: 山顶；见于地名 għajn quċċat，它是戈佐岛 żebbuġ 一处泉的名称。

collocations.zh: 名为 Għajn Quċċat 的泉

formal.mt: Il-kelma quċċat tfisser quċċata ta' muntanja u tidher fl-isem Għajn Quċċat, għajn fiż-Żebbuġ, Għawdex.
formal.en: The word quċċat means a mountain top and appears in the name Għajn Quċċat, a spring in Żebbuġ, Gozo.
formal.zh: quċċat 一词表示山顶，见于地名 Għajn Quċċat；这是戈佐岛 Żebbuġ 一处泉的名称。

colloquial.mt: Mei: Xi tfisser quċċat fl-isem Għajn Quċċat? David: Tfisser quċċata ta' muntanja. L-isem sħiħ huwa ta' għajn fiż-Żebbuġ, Għawdex.
colloquial.en: Mei: What does quċċat mean in the name Għajn Quċċat? David: It means a mountain top. The full name belongs to a spring in Żebbuġ, Gozo.
colloquial.zh: 小梅：Għajn Quċċat 这个名称里的 quċċat 是什么意思？戴维：意思是山顶。整个名称指的是戈佐岛 Żebbuġ 的一处泉。

messages.speaker: Mei (马耳他语学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser quċċat fl-isem Għajn Quċċat?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser quċċat fl-isem Għajn Quċċat?
messages.zh: Għajn Quċċat 这个名称里的 quċċat 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does quċċat mean in the name Għajn Quċċat?

messages.speaker: David (马耳他语教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser quċċata ta' muntanja. L-isem sħiħ huwa ta' għajn fiż-Żebbuġ, Għawdex.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser quċċata ta' muntanja. L-isem sħiħ huwa ta' għajn fiż-Żebbuġ, Għawdex.
messages.zh: 意思是山顶。整个名称指的是戈佐岛 Żebbuġ 的一处泉。
messages.en: It means a mountain top. The full name belongs to a spring in Żebbuġ, Gozo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张记忆卡配对：“quċċat＝山顶”和“Għajn Quċċat＝泉名”，区分词义与整个地名所指的地点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bow, expressed by the diminutive form of 'qaws'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小弓；qaws 的指小形式，用来表示尺寸较小的弓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qaws żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'qaws'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小弓；qaws 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small bow and an arrow

formal.mt: L-istudent għamel qwajjes tal-injam bħala parti minn proġett dwar il-ġugarelli tradizzjonali.
formal.en: The student made a small wooden bow as part of a project about traditional toys.
formal.zh: 这名学生制作了一把木制小弓，作为传统玩具课题的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għamilt qwajjes daqshekk żgħir? Toni: Biex ikun tajjeb għall-pupa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you make such a tiny bow? Toni: So it would be the right size for the doll.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么把这把小弓做得这么小？Toni：这样大小就适合娃娃了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么把这把小弓做得这么小？
messages.en: Why did you make such a tiny bow?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 这样大小就适合娃娃了。
messages.en: So it would be the right size for the doll.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qaws 想成普通弓，把 qwajjes 想成娃娃手里的小弓，用大小对照记住指小义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a shell or scales as an outer covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有壳或有鳞的，形容外部覆盖着壳或鳞片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu qoxra jew qxur fuq barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有壳的；有鳞片的。

collocations.en: an animal with a shell or scales

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jagħżlu stampa ta' annimal qxajri u jiddeskrivu l-kisja ta' barra tiegħu.
formal.en: In the exercise, students should choose a picture of an animal with a shell or scales and describe its outer covering.
formal.zh: 练习要求学生选择一张有壳或有鳞的动物图片，并描述它的外部覆盖物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'qxajri'? Ben: Li għandu qoxra jew qxur, bħal dan il-ħut.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'qxajri' mean? Ben: Having a shell or scales, like these fish.
colloquial.zh: Sara：qxajri 是什么意思？Ben：就是有壳或有鳞的，比如这些鱼。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: qxajri 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'qxajri' mean?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li għandu qoxra jew qxur, bħal dan il-ħut.
messages.mt_standard: Li għandu qoxra jew qxur, bħal dan il-ħut.
messages.zh: 就是有壳或有鳞的，比如这些鱼。
messages.en: Having a shell or scales, like these fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 qxajri 时想象动物外面穿着壳或鳞片做的护甲；它是描述外表的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small shell, expressed by the diminutive form of 'qoxra'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小壳；qoxra 的指小形式，可指一枚小小的贝壳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoxra żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'qoxra'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small shell (the diminutive form of 'qoxra')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个小壳；qoxra 的指小形式。

formal.mt: L-istudenta poġġiet qxejra tal-baħar taħt il-lenti biex tosserva d-dettalji tagħha.
formal.en: The student placed a small seashell under the magnifying glass to observe its details.
formal.zh: 这名学生把一枚小海贝壳放在放大镜下，观察它的细节。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Ara x'qxejra sabiħa sibt fir-ramel! Luka: Vera sabiħa; ħalliha hawn biex naraha aħjar.
colloquial.en: Ella: Look what a pretty little shell I found in the sand! Luka: It really is pretty; leave it here so I can see it better.
colloquial.zh: Ella：看，我在沙子里找到一枚多漂亮的小贝壳！Luka：真漂亮；把它放在这里，让我看清楚些。

messages.speaker: Ella (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，我在沙子里找到一枚多漂亮的小贝壳！
messages.en: Look what a pretty little shell I found in the sand!

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Vera sabiħa; ħalliha hawn biex naraha aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Vera sabiħa; ħalliha hawn biex naraha aħjar.
messages.zh: 真漂亮；把它放在这里，让我看清楚些。
messages.en: It really is pretty; leave it here so I can see it better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qxejra 和掌心里的一枚小贝壳配对，再与 qoxra 对照，记住这里强调小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dry crust that forms over a wound as it heals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 痂，指伤口愈合过程中表面形成的干硬覆盖层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saff niexef li jifforma fuq ferita waqt li tkun qed tfiq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痂；伤口表面形成的干硬层。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tidher qxura niexfa fuq il-ferita.
formal.en: The picture shows a dry scab on the wound.
formal.zh: 图片中可以看到伤口上的一层干痂。

colloquial.mt: Mia: X'inhi dik fuq irkoppti? Rita: Dik qxura fuq il-ferita li kellek.
colloquial.en: Mia: What's that on my knee? Rita: That's a scab over the wound you had.
colloquial.zh: Mia：我膝盖上那个是什么？Rita：那是你之前的伤口上结的痂。

messages.speaker: Mia (女儿)
messages.zh: 我膝盖上那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that on my knee?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik qxura fuq il-ferita li kellek.
messages.mt_standard: Dik qxura fuq il-ferita li kellek.
messages.zh: 那是你之前的伤口上结的痂。
messages.en: That's a scab over the wound you had.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qxura 放进膝盖擦伤后结痂的画面来记，并用“伤口上的干硬层”锁定本条词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of providing sexual services in exchange for payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以收取报酬为交换提供性服务的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha persuna tipprovdi servizzi sesswali bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖淫；以报酬为交换提供性服务的活动

collocations.zh: 一项关于卖淫现象的研究

formal.mt: L-istudju dwar il-qħib jiddiskuti l-kundizzjonijiet soċjali u l-esperjenzi tal-persuni involuti.
formal.en: The study on prostitution discusses social conditions and the experiences of the people involved.
formal.zh: 这项关于卖淫现象的研究讨论了相关社会状况及参与者的经历。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser il-kelma qħib f'dan l-artiklu? Pawlu: Tfisser l-attività li tipprovdi servizzi sesswali bi ħlas.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the word qħib mean in this article? Pawlu: It means the activity of providing sexual services for payment.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这篇文章里的 qħib 是什么意思？保罗：它指的是收取报酬、提供性服务的活动。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma qħib f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma qħib f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 qħib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word qħib mean in this article?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser l-attività li tipprovdi servizzi sesswali bi ħlas.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser l-attività li tipprovdi servizzi sesswali bi ħlas.
messages.zh: 它指的是收取报酬、提供性服务的活动。
messages.en: It means the activity of providing sexual services for payment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在社会研究文章的词汇卡上，记住它命名的是一种有偿性服务活动，不是对某个人的称呼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A little piglet, expressed by the diminutive form of 'qażquż'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小猪仔；qażquż 的指小形式，用来称呼小小的猪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qażquż żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'qażquż'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小猪仔；qażquż 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a little piglet on the farm
a little piglet beside its mother
collocations.zh: 依偎在妈妈身旁的小猪仔

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fir-razzett, it-tfal osservaw qżejqeż miexi ħdejn ommu.
formal.en: During the farm visit, the children observed a little piglet walking beside its mother.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，孩子们观察到一只小猪仔走在妈妈身旁。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ara dak il-qżejqeż ħdejn ommu! Ġanni: Iva, kemm hu ħelu meta jiġri warajha!
colloquial.en: Anna: Look at that little piglet beside its mother! Ġanni: Yes, he's so cute when he runs after her!
colloquial.zh: Anna：看妈妈身旁的那只小猪仔！Ġanni：是啊，它跟在妈妈后面跑的时候真可爱！

messages.speaker: Anna (农场访客)
messages.zh: 看妈妈身旁的那只小猪仔！
messages.en: Look at that little piglet beside its mother!

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kemm hu ħelu meta jiġri warajha!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kemm hu ħelu meta jiġri warajha!
messages.zh: 是啊，它跟在妈妈后面跑的时候真可爱！
messages.en: Yes, he's so cute when he runs after her!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qżejqeż 配上一只紧跟猪妈妈的小猪仔，再与 qażquż 对照记忆它的指小义。

gloss_zh: 令人恶心的事物；矫揉造作的行为；恶心的；做作烦人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that provokes disgust; also ostentatious or affected behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人厌恶或恶心的事物；也可指炫耀、矫揉造作的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tqanqal stmerrija; ukoll imġiba ta' ftaħir jew ta' affettazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人恶心或厌恶的东西、事情。
炫耀卖弄或矫揉造作的行为。
令人恶心的；令人厌恶的。
矫揉造作而令人厌烦的。

collocations.zh: 那一大套矫揉造作的举动

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-narratur jikkritika l-qżież tal-mistieden, li jipprova jimpressjona lil kulħadd bi ftaħir bla waqfien.
formal.en: In the story, the narrator criticizes the guest's affected behaviour as he tries to impress everyone with constant boasting.
formal.zh: 故事中，叙述者批评那位客人的做作行为：他不停地吹嘘，试图给所有人留下深刻印象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Ma felaħx għal dak il-qżież kollu; kulħadd jiftaħar b'dak li xtara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he leave so early? Mark: He couldn't stand all that showing off; everyone was boasting about what they'd bought.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么那么早就走了？Mark：他受不了那一大套炫耀做派；每个人都在吹嘘自己买了什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么那么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did he leave so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (聚会参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma felaħx għal dak il-qżież kollu; kulħadd jiftaħar b'dak li xtara.
messages.mt_standard: Ma felaħx għal dak il-qżież kollu; kulħadd jiftaħar b'dak li xtara.
messages.zh: 他受不了那一大套炫耀做派；每个人都在吹嘘自己买了什么。
messages.en: He couldn't stand all that showing off; everyone was boasting about what they'd bought.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 qżież：一盘令人恶心的食物，一个不停炫耀的人；再区分名词所指的事物或行为与形容词表达的性质。

gloss_zh: 讨厌鬼；举止装腔作势的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is very irritating or whose manners are showy and affected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常惹人厌烦的人，也可指举止夸张、装腔作势的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddejjaq ħafna lil ħaddieħor jew li għandha manjieri affettwati u esaġerati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常烦人、令人厌烦的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: a person whose manners are ostentatious or affected
sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止炫耀、装腔作势的人。

collocations.en: an irritating person who annoys everyone
collocations.zh: 让所有人都烦的讨厌鬼

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qżieżu jinterrompi lil kulħadd u jitkellem b'manjieri affettwati biex jiġbed l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: In the story, the irritating, affected character interrupts everyone and speaks in an affected manner to attract attention.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个令人讨厌、装腔作势的人不断打断别人，还故作姿态地说话以吸引注意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejn Karl? Lara: Għax hu qżieżu; dejjem jinterrompini meta nitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to sit next to Karl? Lara: Because he's so irritating; he always interrupts me when I speak.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不想坐在卡尔旁边？拉拉：因为他是个讨厌鬼，我说话时他总打断我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejn Karl?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejn Karl?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想坐在卡尔旁边？
messages.en: Why don't you want to sit next to Karl?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu qżieżu; dejjem jinterrompini meta nitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu qżieżu; dejjem jinterrompini meta nitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为他是个讨厌鬼，我说话时他总打断我。
messages.en: Because he's so irritating; he always interrupts me when I speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个不断插嘴又故作姿态的人，把 qżieżu 与这个令人皱眉的人物绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action that causes disgust or strong revulsion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让人感到恶心、厌恶或强烈反感的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni li tqanqal stmerrija jew sens qawwi ta' diżgust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人恶心或厌恶的行为。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-għalliem iddeskriva l-bżiq fl-ikel ta' ħaddieħor bħala qżiżata li ma kellhiex terġa' sseħħ.
formal.en: In the report, the teacher described spitting in another person's food as a disgusting action that must not happen again.
formal.zh: 老师在报告中把往别人食物里吐口水描述为令人恶心的行为，并指出这种事不得再次发生。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajtu jobżoq fl-ikel ta' sieħbu? Mark: Iva, dik qżiżata! Irridu ngħidu lill-għalliem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see him spit in his classmate's food? Mark: Yes, that's disgusting! We need to tell the teacher.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见他往同学的食物里吐口水了吗？马克：看见了，那种行为真恶心！我们得告诉老师。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你看见他往同学的食物里吐口水了吗？
messages.en: Did you see him spit in his classmate's food?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik qżiżata! Irridu ngħidu lill-għalliem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik qżiżata! Irridu ngħidu lill-għalliem.
messages.zh: 看见了，那种行为真恶心！我们得告诉老师。
messages.en: Yes, that's disgusting! We need to tell the teacher.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qżiżata 记成一件让人立刻皱眉的恶心事；重点记住它指行为本身。

gloss_zh: 容易感到恶心的；易生厌恶的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who easily feels disgust, especially at unpleasant sights, smells, or substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人容易因难看的东西、难闻的气味或其他不适刺激而感到恶心或厌恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li faċilment iħoss stmerrija jew diżgust minħabba dak li jara, ixomm jew imiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容容易感到恶心或产生厌恶的人。

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa qżużi ħafna u jevita li jħares lejn stampi ta' feriti waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: Pawlu is very squeamish and avoids looking at pictures of wounds during the lesson.
formal.zh: 保罗很容易感到恶心，上课时会避开伤口图片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tara r-ritratt tal-ferita? Pawlu: Le, grazzi. Jien qżużi ħafna u ma niflaħx nara affarijiet bħal dawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to see the photo of the wound? Pawlu: No, thanks. I'm very squeamish and can't bear looking at things like that.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想看那张伤口照片吗？保罗：不了，谢谢。我很容易觉得恶心，看不了这种东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想看那张伤口照片吗？
messages.en: Do you want to see the photo of the wound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Jien qżużi ħafna u ma niflaħx nara affarijiet bħal dawn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Jien qżużi ħafna u ma niflaħx nara affarijiet bħal dawn.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。我很容易觉得恶心，看不了这种东西。
messages.en: No, thanks. I'm very squeamish and can't bear looking at things like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人一见伤口图片就转开脸，用 qżużi 描述这个容易恶心的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of disgust, or a feeling of nausea as if one might vomit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事产生的厌恶感，也可指身体上恶心、想吐的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' stmerrija jew diżgust, jew dardir li jġiegħlek tħoss li se tirremetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对人、事物或行为产生的厌恶、反感。
身体上感到恶心、想要呕吐的感觉。

collocations.en: a feeling of disgust or nausea

formal.mt: Fl-esej tagħha, l-istudenta esprimiet qżużija għall-moħqrija lejn l-annimali u talbet li jiġu protetti.
formal.en: In her essay, the student expressed disgust at cruelty to animals and called for their protection.
formal.zh: 这名学生在作文中表达了对虐待动物的厌恶，并呼吁保护动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ftaħt it-tieqa? Pawlu: Dik ir-riħa qed tqanqalli qżużija; inħoss li se nirremetti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you open the window? Pawlu: That smell is making me nauseous; I feel like I'm going to vomit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么打开窗户？保罗：那股味道让我恶心，我觉得快要吐了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么打开窗户？
messages.en: Why did you open the window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ir-riħa qed tqanqalli qżużija; inħoss li se nirremetti.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ir-riħa qed tqanqalli qżużija; inħoss li se nirremetti.
messages.zh: 那股味道让我恶心，我觉得快要吐了。
messages.en: That smell is making me nauseous; I feel like I'm going to vomit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 qżużija 配两幅画：心里厌恶地皱眉，以及胃里恶心得想吐，分别记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 演奏 rabbaba 传统乐器

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play the traditional musical instrument called the rabbaba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 演奏名为 rabbaba 的传统乐器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idoqqu l-istrument mużikali tradizzjonali msejjaħ rabbaba.

sense_translations.en_definition: to play the rabbaba (a traditional musical instrument)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 演奏 rabbaba 这种传统乐器。

collocations.en: played the rabbaba during the celebration
collocations.zh: 在庆典期间演奏了 rabbaba

collocations.en: played the rabbaba in front of the audience
collocations.zh: 在观众面前演奏了 rabbaba

formal.mt: Waqt il-wirja ta' strumenti tradizzjonali, il-mużiċist rabbab quddiem l-udjenza u mbagħad wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tagħha.
formal.en: During the exhibition of traditional instruments, the musician played the rabbaba for the audience and then answered their questions.
formal.zh: 在传统乐器展演中，乐师为观众演奏了 rabbaba，随后回答了观众的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Toni waqt il-festa? Mark: Rabbab quddiem kulħadd, u n-nies ħadu gost jisimgħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Toni do during the celebration? Mark: He played the rabbaba in front of everyone, and people enjoyed listening to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼在庆典上做了什么？马克：他在大家面前演奏了 rabbaba，大家都听得很开心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼在庆典上做了什么？
messages.en: What did Toni do during the celebration?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rabbab quddiem kulħadd, u n-nies ħadu gost jisimgħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Rabbab quddiem kulħadd, u n-nies ħadu gost jisimgħuh.
messages.zh: 他在大家面前演奏了 rabbaba，大家都听得很开心。
messages.en: He played the rabbaba in front of everyone, and people enjoyed listening to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rabbab 放进乐师正在表演的画面，记它表示演奏动作；再用 rabbaba 记乐器名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional musical instrument made from a hollow container covered with lambskin, with a reed attached.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种传统乐器，由蒙有羔羊皮的中空容器及附接的芦苇杆构成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tradizzjonali magħmul minn kontenitur vojt miksi b'ġilda ta' ħaruf, b'qasba mwaħħla miegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: a traditional musical instrument consisting of a hollow container covered with lambskin to which a reed is attached
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种传统乐器，由蒙有羔羊皮的中空容器和附接的芦苇杆构成。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-wirja tispjega li r-rabbaba hija strument tradizzjonali magħmul minn kontenitur vojt miksi b'ġilda ta' ħaruf, b'qasba mwaħħla miegħu.
formal.en: The exhibition label explains that the rabbaba is a traditional instrument made from a hollow container covered with lambskin, with a reed attached.
formal.zh: 展览标签说明，rabbaba 是一种传统乐器，由蒙有羔羊皮的中空容器及附接的芦苇杆构成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan l-istrument? Toni: Din rabbaba. Trid tisma' l-ħoss tagħha?
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this instrument? Toni: This is a rabbaba. Would you like to hear what it sounds like?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是什么乐器？托尼：这是 rabbaba。你想听听它的声音吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这是什么乐器？
messages.en: What is this instrument?

messages.speaker: Toni (乐师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din rabbaba. Trid tisma' l-ħoss tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Din rabbaba. Trid tisma' l-ħoss tagħha?
messages.zh: 这是 rabbaba。你想听听它的声音吗？
messages.en: This is a rabbaba. Would you like to hear what it sounds like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个可见部件记 rabbaba：中空容器、覆盖的羔羊皮、附接的芦苇杆，拼成一幅乐器图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone or something to be tied, for example by arranging for another person to tie it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物被绑住，例如安排别人将其绑好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel jew iqabbad lil xi ħadd jorbot persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使被绑住或系住；促成捆绑这一动作。

formal.mt: Qabel it-trasport, il-bidwi rabbat il-bhejjem billi qabbad lill-ħaddiem jorbothom sew.
formal.en: Before transport, the farmer had the livestock tied by instructing the worker to secure them properly.
formal.zh: 运输前，农夫吩咐工人把牲畜牢牢拴好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min rabbat il-kaxxi qabel it-trasport? Mark: Is-sid; talab lil Pawlu jorbothom sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who arranged for the boxes to be tied before transport? Mark: The owner; he asked Pawlu to tie them securely.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：运输前是谁安排把箱子捆好的？马克：是老板，他让保罗把它们捆牢。

messages.speaker: Maja (仓库同事)
messages.zh: 运输前是谁安排把箱子捆好的？
messages.en: Who arranged for the boxes to be tied before transport?

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sid; talab lil Pawlu jorbothom sew.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sid; talab lil Pawlu jorbothom sew.
messages.zh: 是老板，他让保罗把它们捆牢。
messages.en: The owner; he asked Pawlu to tie them securely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象负责人指示工人捆箱子，用 rabbat 记住使东西被绑好的使役意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a suburb or to the residential areas around a town or city.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与郊区或城镇外围住宅区域有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-subborgi jew maż-żoni residenzjali madwar belt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 郊区的；与城市外围住宅区域有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ambjent rabti b'ħafna djar, ġonna u toroq residenzjali.
formal.en: The report describes a suburban environment with many houses, gardens, and residential streets.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一处郊区环境，那里有许多住宅、花园和居民区街道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-post fejn mort toqgħod? Mark: Għandu karattru rabti, b'ħafna djar u ġonna, u hemm xarabank lejn iċ-ċentru.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the place you've moved to like? Mark: It has a suburban character, with lots of houses and gardens, and there's a bus to the centre.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你搬去的地方怎么样？马克：那里有郊区的特色，住宅和花园很多，还有公交车通往市中心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu l-post fejn mort toqgħod?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu l-post fejn mort toqgħod?
messages.zh: 你搬去的地方怎么样？
messages.en: What's the place you've moved to like?

messages.speaker: Mark (新搬家的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu karattru rabti, b'ħafna djar u ġonna, u hemm xarabank lejn iċ-ċentru.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu karattru rabti, b'ħafna djar u ġonna, u hemm xarabank lejn iċ-ċentru.
messages.zh: 那里有郊区的特色，住宅和花园很多，还有公交车通往市中心。
messages.en: It has a suburban character, with lots of houses and gardens, and there's a bus to the centre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rabti 放在城市外围住宅与花园的画面旁，记住它是描述郊区环境的形容词。

gloss_zh: 吸吮；（粗俗口语）被捉弄、倒霉吃亏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw milk or another liquid into the mouth by sucking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过嘴部的吸吮动作吸入奶或其他液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed il-ħalib jew likwidu ieħor fil-ħalq billi jerdgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸吮；用嘴吸取。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be the victim of a prank or a bad situation (colloquial; vulgar)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为恶作剧的受害者，或在糟糕的处境中倒霉吃亏；属于粗俗口语。

formal.mt: It-tifel rada' l-ħalib u mbagħad raqad.
formal.en: The boy sucked milk and then fell asleep.
formal.zh: 男婴吸了奶，然后睡着了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tifel rada' biżżejjed? Pawlu: Iva, issa jidher kalm u kuntent.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the baby boy had enough milk? Pawlu: Yes, he looks calm and content now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：宝宝吸够奶了吗？Pawlu：是的，他现在看起来安静又满足。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝吸够奶了吗？
messages.en: Has the baby boy had enough milk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jidher kalm u kuntent.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jidher kalm u kuntent.
messages.zh: 是的，他现在看起来安静又满足。
messages.en: Yes, he looks calm and content now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rada' 放进“宝宝吸奶”的画面中记忆；与 radda' 对照时，前者突出宝宝自己吸，后者突出给宝宝喂奶。粗俗引申义另记为“倒霉吃亏”。

gloss_zh: 归还、返还；犁沟；船行留下的水面航迹

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long, narrow trench cut into the soil, especially during ploughing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在土壤中开出的狭长沟槽，尤指耕地时犁出的沟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanal twil u dejjaq fil-ħamrija, speċjalment wieħed magħmul bil-moħriet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 归还或返还；把某物交还的行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: furrow (a trench cut in the soil)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 犁沟；在土壤中开出的沟槽。

sense_translations.en_definition: wake (the path left behind a ship on the surface of the water)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 船行航迹；船驶过后在水面留下的尾流痕迹。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għamel radda dritta fil-ħamrija qabel iż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The farmer made a straight furrow in the soil before sowing.
formal.zh: 农民在播种前，在土里犁出了一道笔直的沟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara r-radda li ħalla l-vapur! Mark: Iva, għadha tidher fuq wiċċ l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at the wake the ship left! Mark: Yes, you can still see it on the surface of the water.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看，那艘船留下的航迹！Mark：是啊，水面上还看得见。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，那艘船留下的航迹！
messages.en: Look at the wake the ship left!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadha tidher fuq wiċċ l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadha tidher fuq wiċċ l-ilma.
messages.zh: 是啊，水面上还看得见。
messages.en: Yes, you can still see it on the surface of the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张独立小图记 radda：归还的钱、田里的沟、水面的船迹。后两义可借“留下一道痕迹”联想，返还义单独记；这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feed a baby or young animal with milk from the breast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用乳汁哺育婴儿或幼兽，让其吮吸乳汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitma' tarbija jew ferħ ta' annimal bil-ħalib minn sidru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哺乳；给婴儿或幼兽喂奶。

formal.mt: L-omm raddgħet lit-tarbija qabel ma poġġietha fis-sodda.
formal.en: The mother breastfed the baby before putting her to bed.
formal.zh: 母亲给女婴喂了奶，然后把她放到床上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadek kif raddgħet lit-tarbija? Marija: Iva, u issa raqdet.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you just breastfed the baby? Marija: Yes, and now she's asleep.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你刚给宝宝喂完奶吗？Marija：是的，她现在睡着了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你刚给宝宝喂完奶吗？
messages.en: Have you just breastfed the baby?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 是的，她现在睡着了。
messages.en: Yes, and now she's asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 radda' 与“照料者给宝宝喂奶”的画面绑定。和 rada' 成对练习：宝宝吸奶，照料者哺乳；注意双写 d 和词尾撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something or render something, such as an expression of honour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某物，或致以某种表达，例如表达敬意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti xi ħaġa jew juri xi ħaġa, bħall-ġieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予；把某物给出。
给予、致以或作出某种表达；具体译法取决于所搭配的宾语。

formal.mt: Fid-diskors tiegħu, il-kelliem raddad ġieħ lill-għalliema.
formal.en: In his speech, the speaker paid tribute to the teachers.
formal.zh: 发言者在讲话中向教师们致以敬意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex raddad ġieħ lil dik l-għalliema? Mark: Għax għenitu ħafna meta kien student.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did he pay tribute to that teacher? Mark: Because she helped him a lot when he was a student.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他为什么向那位老师致敬？Mark：因为他读书时，她给过他很多帮助。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex raddad ġieħ lil dik l-għalliema?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex raddad ġieħ lil dik l-għalliema?
messages.zh: 他为什么向那位老师致敬？
messages.en: Why did he pay tribute to that teacher?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għenitu ħafna meta kien student.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għenitu ħafna meta kien student.
messages.zh: 因为他读书时，她给过他很多帮助。
messages.en: Because she helped him a lot when he was a student.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 raddad 时一起记宾语：给出问候、致以敬意。先理解“给予”，再根据宾语选自然的中文动词，不把英文 render 的所有义项都搬过来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin strand of fibre used for sewing or similar work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由纤维构成、用于缝纫等工作的细线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajt irqiq magħmul minn fibri u użat għall-ħjata jew xogħol simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线；用于缝纫等工作的细线。

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata għażlet raden tal-qoton biex issewwi l-qmis.
formal.en: The seamstress chose cotton thread to mend the shirt.
formal.zh: 女裁缝选用了棉线来修补衬衫。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek ftit raden abjad? Rita: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-labra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have some white thread? Rita: Yes, it's in the box next to the needle.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你有一点白线吗？Rita：有，在盒子里，就在针旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有一点白线吗？
messages.en: Do you have some white thread?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，在盒子里，就在针旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the box next to the needle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raden 写在线轴旁，想象从线轴拉出细线、穿针、补衬衫的连续动作。用“棉线”和“白线”两组搭配固定它的实物含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The distance from the centre of a circle to its edge, or a line segment joining those points.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圆心到圆周的距离，也指连接圆心与圆周上一点的线段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-distanza miċ-ċentru ta' ċirku sat-tarf tiegħu, jew is-segment li jgħaqqad dawn iż-żewġ punti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半径；圆心到圆周的距离或相应线段。

formal.mt: Pinġi ċirku b'radjus ta' ħames ċentimetri u mmarka ċ-ċentru tiegħu.
formal.en: Draw a circle with a radius of five centimetres and mark its centre.
formal.zh: 画一个半径为五厘米的圆，并标出圆心。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm hu r-radjus ta' dan iċ-ċirku? Leo: Tliet ċentimetri, miċ-ċentru sat-tarf.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the radius of this circle? Leo: Three centimetres, from the centre to the edge.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个圆的半径是多少？Leo：三厘米，从圆心量到圆周。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu r-radjus ta' dan iċ-ċirku?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu r-radjus ta' dan iċ-ċirku?
messages.zh: 这个圆的半径是多少？
messages.en: What is the radius of this circle?

messages.speaker: Leo (同学)
messages.zh: 三厘米，从圆心量到圆周。
messages.en: Three centimetres, from the centre to the edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 radjus 就画一个圆，再从圆心画一条线到圆周，并写上“半径”。可用英文 radius 的相似拼写辅助认词，但以图形理解含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a chemical element, used when identifying or discussing that element.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素“氡”的名称，用于指认或讨论这种元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' element kimiku, użat biex jiġi identifikat jew diskuss dak l-element.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氡；一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jinkludi r-riżultati tal-kejl tar-radon.
formal.en: The laboratory report includes the results of the radon measurement.
formal.zh: 实验室报告包括氡的测量结果。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser radon f'dan ir-rapport? David: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does radon mean in this report? David: It is the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这份报告里的 radon 是什么意思？David：它是一种化学元素的名称。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 radon 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does radon mean in this report?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: It is the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 radon 和中文“氡”写在同一张元素词卡上，再配上“实验室报告”的场景。先牢牢记住它是元素名称，避免与 radjus“半径”混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making a material purer or improving it through further treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过进一步加工，使材料更加纯净或提高其品质的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih materjal isir aktar pur jew jitjieb permezz ta' aktar ipproċessar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精炼、提炼；通过加工提高材料纯度或品质的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istadji tar-raffinament taż-żejt.
formal.en: The report describes the stages of oil refining.
formal.zh: 报告描述了油的精炼过程中的各个阶段。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu r-raffinament? Toni: Huwa proċess biex materjal isir aktar pur.
colloquial.en: Lina: What is refining? Toni: It is a process for making a material purer.
colloquial.zh: Lina：什么是精炼？Toni：就是让材料变得更加纯净的加工过程。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是精炼？
messages.en: What is refining?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa proċess biex materjal isir aktar pur.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa proċess biex materjal isir aktar pur.
messages.zh: 就是让材料变得更加纯净的加工过程。
messages.en: It is a process for making a material purer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raffinament 想成一张加工流程图：原材料经过处理，变得更加纯净。配合“精炼过程”整组记忆，突出它表示一个过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being elegant, polished, or sophisticated in appearance, taste, or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观、品味或举止所体现的精致、优雅或文雅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' dak li hu eleganti u fin fid-dehra, fil-gosti jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精致；优雅；举止或品味上的文雅。

formal.mt: Id-disinn tas-sala juri raffinatezza fl-għażla tal-kuluri u tal-materjali.
formal.en: The design of the hall shows refinement in the choice of colours and materials.
formal.zh: 大厅的设计通过色彩与材料的选择体现出精致品味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-kamra għandha ċerta raffinatezza. Lara: Iva, il-kuluri huma sempliċi, imma kollox magħżul tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: This room has a certain refinement. Lara: Yes, the colours are simple, but everything is well chosen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个房间有一种精致感。拉拉：是啊，颜色很简单，但每样东西都选得很好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个房间有一种精致感。
messages.en: This room has a certain refinement.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kuluri huma sempliċi, imma kollox magħżul tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kuluri huma sempliċi, imma kollox magħżul tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是啊，颜色很简单，但每样东西都选得很好。
messages.en: Yes, the colours are simple, but everything is well chosen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一间配色克制、摆设讲究的房间，记住它表示精致与优雅。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An industrial plant where a raw substance, such as crude oil, is processed and purified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对原油等原料进行加工、提纯的工业设施；谈及石油时指炼油厂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Impjant industrijali fejn materja prima, bħaż-żejt mhux raffinat, tiġi pproċessata u ppurifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精炼厂；用于加工原油时指炼油厂。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif ir-raffinerija tipproċessa ż-żejt mhux raffinat biex tipproduċi diversi tipi ta' fjuwil.
formal.en: The report describes how the refinery processes crude oil to produce several types of fuel.
formal.zh: 报告说明了这家炼油厂如何加工原油，生产多种燃料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn jaħdem ħuk? Lara: Jaħdem f'raffinerija taż-żejt ħdejn il-port.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where does your brother work? Lara: He works at an oil refinery near the port.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你哥哥在哪里工作？拉拉：他在港口附近的一家炼油厂工作。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where does your brother work?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在港口附近的一家炼油厂工作。
messages.en: He works at an oil refinery near the port.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原油进入工厂、燃料从另一端出来，把整个加工场所记作精炼厂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing or covered with many small bubbles that form foam or froth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有许多细小气泡，或表面覆盖着泡沫的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ħafna bżieżaq żgħar jew li hu miksi bir-ragħwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起泡的；多泡沫的；表面覆有泡沫的。

formal.mt: Wara li jitħabbat, il-ħalib isir ragħwi u jintuża biex jitħejja l-kapuċċino.
formal.en: After being whisked, the milk becomes frothy and is used to prepare cappuccino.
formal.zh: 牛奶经过搅打后会产生泡沫，可用于制作卡布奇诺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħalib sar daqshekk ragħwi? Mark: Għax ħabbattu sew qabel ferragħtu fil-kafè.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has the milk become so frothy? Mark: Because I whisked it well before pouring it into the coffee.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：牛奶怎么起了这么多泡沫？马克：因为我倒进咖啡之前，先把它充分搅打了一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 牛奶怎么起了这么多泡沫？
messages.en: Why has the milk become so frothy?

messages.speaker: Mark (咖啡师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħabbattu sew qabel ferragħtu fil-kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħabbattu sew qabel ferragħtu fil-kafè.
messages.zh: 因为我倒进咖啡之前，先把它充分搅打了一下。
messages.en: Because I whisked it well before pouring it into the coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用卡布奇诺上厚厚的奶泡作画面，记住这个形容词描述多泡沫的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become a member of a religious order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加入宗教修会，成为其中的一员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħal f'ordni reliġjuż u sar membru tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加入修会；成为宗教修会的成员。

collocations.en: joined a religious order after years of reflection
collocations.zh: 经过多年思考后加入了修会

formal.mt: Skont il-bijografija, Ġużeppi rahab wara snin ta' ħsieb dwar il-ħajja spiritwali.
formal.en: According to the biography, Ġużeppi joined a religious order after years of reflection on spiritual life.
formal.zh: 根据这本传记，朱泽皮在对灵性生活思考多年后加入了修会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fil-ktieb jgħid li Ġużeppi rahab. Xi jfisser? Pawlu: Ifisser li daħal f'ordni reliġjuż.
colloquial.en: Lara: The book says that Ġużeppi 'rahab'. What does that mean? Pawlu: It means that he joined a religious order.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：书里说朱泽皮 rahab，这是什么意思？保罗：意思是他加入了一个修会。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ktieb jgħid li Ġużeppi rahab. Xi jfisser?
