messages.mt_standard: Fil-ktieb jgħid li Ġużeppi rahab. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 书里说朱泽皮 rahab，这是什么意思？
messages.en: The book says that Ġużeppi 'rahab'. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 意思是他加入了一个修会。
messages.en: It means that he joined a religious order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个人亲自走进修会的画面记忆：这里的主语就是加入修会的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause another person to become a member of a religious order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使另一个人加入宗教修会，成为其中的一员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wassal lil xi ħadd biex jidħol f'ordni reliġjuż.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause to join a religious order
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人加入修会；促成某人成为宗教修会的成员。

collocations.en: caused his son to join a religious order
collocations.zh: 使自己的儿子加入了修会

collocations.en: caused a young man to join a religious order
collocations.zh: 使一名青年加入了修会

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier rahhab lil ibnu wara diversi taħditiet miegħu dwar il-ħajja reliġjuża.
formal.en: In the story, the father caused his son to join a religious order after several conversations with him about religious life.
formal.zh: 故事中，父亲与儿子多次谈论宗教生活，最终促成儿子加入修会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn jgħid li l-missier rahhab lil ibnu. Min daħal fl-ordni? Pawlu: L-iben. Il-missier wasslu biex jidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: It says here that the father 'rahhab' his son. Who joined the order? Pawlu: The son. The father caused him to join.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里说父亲 rahhab 了儿子，到底是谁加入修会？保罗：儿子。父亲促成了他加入修会。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn jgħid li l-missier rahhab lil ibnu. Min daħal fl-ordni?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn jgħid li l-missier rahhab lil ibnu. Min daħal fl-ordni?
messages.zh: 这里说父亲 rahhab 了儿子，到底是谁加入修会？
messages.en: It says here that the father 'rahhab' his son. Who joined the order?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 儿子。父亲促成了他加入修会。
messages.en: The son. The father caused him to join.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它与两个人的画面绑定：一人促成，另一人加入修会；特别留意拼写中的两个h。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force someone to pledge possessions as security for a loan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 迫使某人把财物交作借款担保，也就是迫使其典当财物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħalli xi ħaġa tiegħu bħala garanzija għal self.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迫使某人典当；逼迫某人以财物作抵押取得借款。

collocations.en: forced the debtor to pawn possessions

collocations.mt: rahhan lil xi ħadd biex iħallas id-dejn
collocations.en: forced someone to pawn possessions to pay a debt
collocations.zh: 迫使某人典当财物以偿还债务

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kreditur rahhan lir-raġel, li kellu jħalli l-arloġġ tiegħu bħala garanzija għal self biex iħallas id-dejn.
formal.en: In the story, the creditor forced the man to pawn possessions: he had to pledge his watch as security for a loan to pay the debt.
formal.zh: 故事中，债权人迫使这名男子典当财物；他不得不用自己的手表作担保借款，以偿还债务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser li l-kreditur rahhan lil Pawlu? Mark: Ġiegħlu jħalli xi ħaġa tiegħu bħala garanzija għal self. Pawlu kellu juża l-arloġġ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does it mean that the creditor 'rahhan' Pawlu? Mark: He forced him to pledge something he owned as security for a loan. Pawlu had to use his watch.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：说债权人 rahhan 了保罗，是什么意思？马克：就是逼他拿自己的东西作担保借款。保罗只好拿出自己的手表。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li l-kreditur rahhan lil Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li l-kreditur rahhan lil Pawlu?
messages.zh: 说债权人 rahhan 了保罗，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the creditor 'rahhan' Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġiegħlu jħalli xi ħaġa tiegħu bħala garanzija għal self. Pawlu kellu juża l-arloġġ tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ġiegħlu jħalli xi ħaġa tiegħu bħala garanzija għal self. Pawlu kellu juża l-arloġġ tiegħu.
messages.zh: 就是逼他拿自己的东西作担保借款。保罗只好拿出自己的手表。
messages.en: He forced him to pledge something he owned as security for a loan. Pawlu had to use his watch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象债权人催逼、欠债者交出手表换借款的场景，牢牢记住迫使典当这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's opinion or judgment; also their own will, intention, or choice to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人对事情的意见或判断；也可指个人自主的意愿、意图或行动意愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fehma jew ġudizzju ta' persuna; ukoll ir-rieda jew l-intenzjoni tagħha li tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意见；看法；对某件事情的个人判断。
个人的自由意志、自主意愿或意图。

collocations.zh: 出于他自己的意愿；他主动地

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-awtur esprima r-raj tiegħu dwar il-proposta. Hu offra wkoll li jgħin minn rajh.
formal.en: In the report, the author expressed his opinion on the proposal. He also offered to help of his own accord.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中表达了自己对该提案的看法。他还主动提出帮忙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu r-raj tiegħek dwar il-pjan? Pawlu: Naħseb li hu tajjeb. Maja: U Mark għaliex ġie jgħin? Pawlu: Ġie minn rajh; ħadd ma talbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's your opinion of the plan? Pawlu: I think it's good. Maja: And why did Mark come to help? Pawlu: He came of his own accord; nobody asked him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你对这个计划有什么看法？保罗：我觉得很好。玛雅：那马克为什么来帮忙？保罗：他是主动来的，没有人请他来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你对这个计划有什么看法？
messages.en: What's your opinion of the plan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我觉得很好。
messages.en: I think it's good.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 那马克为什么来帮忙？
messages.en: And why did Mark come to help?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġie minn rajh; ħadd ma talbu.
messages.mt_standard: Ġie minn rajh; ħadd ma talbu.
messages.zh: 他是主动来的，没有人请他来。
messages.en: He came of his own accord; nobody asked him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“自己怎么看、自己愿不愿”记住两个义项：ir-raj tiegħi 是我的看法，minn rajh 是他主动地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To economise by spending less money or using resources more carefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过减少花费或更谨慎地使用资源来节省。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tonfoq inqas flus jew tuża r-riżorsi b'aktar għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节省；节约开支或资源。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill rakas fl-infiq billi naqqas l-ispejjeż li ma kinux meħtieġa.
formal.en: The council economised by reducing unnecessary expenses.
formal.zh: 议会通过削减不必要的费用节约了开支。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irnexxielu Mark ifaddal għall-vjaġġ? Nina: Rakas fl-infiq u beda jsajjar id-dar. Lara: Hekk seta' jwarrab ftit flus kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark manage to save for the trip? Nina: He economised and started cooking at home. Lara: That way he could put some money aside every week.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克是怎么攒够旅行的钱的？妮娜：他节约开支，开始在家做饭。拉拉：这样他每周就能存下一点钱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是怎么攒够旅行的钱的？
messages.en: How did Mark manage to save for the trip?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rakas fl-infiq u beda jsajjar id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Rakas fl-infiq u beda jsajjar id-dar.
messages.zh: 他节约开支，开始在家做饭。
messages.en: He economised and started cooking at home.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk seta' jwarrab ftit flus kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk seta' jwarrab ftit flus kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 这样他每周就能存下一点钱。
messages.en: That way he could put some money aside every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把每周省下的钱放进旅行储蓄罐，用 rakas fl-infiq 把“节约开支”连成一组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slow down; also, of material in a liquid, to settle at the bottom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低移动或进行的速度；也指液体中的物质沉到底部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timxi jew tkompli b'inqas ħeffa; ukoll, fil-każ ta' materjal f'likwidu, tinżel u toqgħod fil-qiegħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减速；放慢移动或进行的速度。
沉到底部；沉降并停留在底部。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq rakat qabel il-liwja. Fl-esperiment tax-xjenza, it-tajn rakat fil-qiegħ tal-vażett wara ftit ħin.
formal.en: The driver slowed down before the bend. In the science experiment, the mud settled at the bottom of the jar after a short time.
formal.zh: 司机在弯道前减速了。在科学实验中，过了一会儿，泥沉到了罐子底部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ix-xarabank rakat? Mark: Għax kien hemm liwja quddiemna. Maja: Ħares lejn il-vażett tal-esperiment ukoll: it-tajn rakat fil-qiegħ. Mark: Iva, u l-ilma ta' fuq sar aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the bus slow down? Mark: Because there was a bend ahead of us. Maja: Look at the experiment jar too: the mud has settled at the bottom. Mark: Yes, and the water above has become clearer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：公交车为什么减速了？马克：因为前面有个弯道。玛雅：也看看实验用的罐子，泥已经沉到底部了。马克：是啊，上面的水也变清了一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (参加科学考察的学生)
messages.zh: 公交车为什么减速了？
messages.en: Why did the bus slow down?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为前面有个弯道。
messages.en: Because there was a bend ahead of us.

messages.speaker: Maja (参加科学考察的学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn il-vażett tal-esperiment ukoll: it-tajn rakat fil-qiegħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn il-vażett tal-esperiment ukoll: it-tajn rakat fil-qiegħ.
messages.zh: 也看看实验用的罐子，泥已经沉到底部了。
messages.en: Look at the experiment jar too: the mud has settled at the bottom.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-ilma ta' fuq sar aktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-ilma ta' fuq sar aktar ċar.
messages.zh: 是啊，上面的水也变清了一些。
messages.en: Yes, and the water above has become clearer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 rakat 配两张学习图卡：弯道前车辆减速，罐子里泥沙沉底；分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hook with several prongs, used to catch or grip an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有多个钩爪、用来钩住或抓牢物体的钩具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ganċ b'diversi ponot li jintuża biex jaqbad jew iżomm oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有多个钩爪的钩具；多爪钩。

collocations.en: to tie a rope to the grappling hook

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem rabat ħabel mar-rampil u użah biex jiġbed il-biċċa injam mill-ilma.
formal.en: The worker tied a rope to the grappling hook and used it to pull the piece of wood out of the water.
formal.zh: 工人把绳子系在多爪钩上，用它将那块木头从水里拉出来。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek rampil biex naqbdu dik il-biċċa injam? Pawlu: Iva, hawn wieħed. Orbot il-ħabel miegħu l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a grappling hook so we can catch that piece of wood? Pawlu: Yes, here's one. Tie the rope to it first.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你有多爪钩吗？我们可以用它钩住那块木头。Pawlu：有，这里有一个。先把绳子系在上面。

messages.speaker: Mark (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek rampil biex naqbdu dik il-biċċa injam?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek rampil biex naqbdu dik il-biċċa injam?
messages.zh: 你有多爪钩吗？我们可以用它钩住那块木头。
messages.en: Do you have a grappling hook so we can catch that piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed. Orbot il-ħabel miegħu l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed. Orbot il-ħabel miegħu l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一个。先把绳子系在上面。
messages.en: Yes, here's one. Tie the rope to it first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rampil 想成伸出多个手指的铁钩；画出几个钩爪一起抓木头的画面，帮助记住“多爪钩”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grapnel with several prongs, used to catch and retrieve objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有多个钩爪、用于钩住并拉回物体的抓钩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ganċ b'diversi ponot li jintuża biex jaqbad oġġetti u jiġbidhom lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有多个钩爪的抓钩；多爪抓钩。

collocations.en: a grapnel attached to a rope

formal.mt: Il-baħri uża rampila marbuta ma' ħabel biex jiġbed ix-xibka lejn id-dgħajsa.
formal.en: The sailor used a grapnel attached to a rope to pull the net toward the boat.
formal.zh: 水手用系着绳子的多爪抓钩，把渔网拉向小船。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif se niġbdu x-xibka lura? Ġorġ: Għaddili r-rampila u nipprova naqbadha.
colloquial.en: Marija: How are we going to pull the net back? Ġorġ: Pass me the grapnel and I'll try to catch it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们怎么把渔网拉回来？Ġorġ：把多爪抓钩递给我，我试着钩住它。

messages.speaker: Marija (船员)
messages.zh: 我们怎么把渔网拉回来？
messages.en: How are we going to pull the net back?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (水手)
messages.zh: 把多爪抓钩递给我，我试着钩住它。
messages.en: Pass me the grapnel and I'll try to catch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rampila 时想象船边垂下一根绳，末端几个钩爪一起钩住渔网；用“绳子加抓钩”的画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin singing with joy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因心情喜悦而开始唱歌；欢快地唱起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beda jkanta bil-ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欢快地开始唱歌；高兴地唱起来。

collocations.en: started singing joyfully as soon as he heard the news
collocations.zh: 一听到消息就欢快地唱起来

formal.mt: Malli sema' l-aħbar it-tajba, Pawlu ran bil-ferħ quddiem il-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: As soon as he heard the good news, Pawlu began singing joyfully in front of his family.
formal.zh: Pawlu 一听到好消息，就在家人面前欢快地唱起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel Mark meta għedtlu li għadda mill-eżami? Nina: Ran bil-ferħ! Anki aħna bdejna nkantaw miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mark do when you told him he had passed the exam? Nina: He burst into joyful song! We started singing along with him too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你告诉 Mark 他考试通过了，他有什么反应？Nina：他高兴地唱起来了！我们也跟着他一起唱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Mark meta għedtlu li għadda mill-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Mark meta għedtlu li għadda mill-eżami?
messages.zh: 你告诉 Mark 他考试通过了，他有什么反应？
messages.en: What did Mark do when you told him he had passed the exam?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ran bil-ferħ! Anki aħna bdejna nkantaw miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ran bil-ferħ! Anki aħna bdejna nkantaw miegħu.
messages.zh: 他高兴地唱起来了！我们也跟着他一起唱。
messages.en: He burst into joyful song! We started singing along with him too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ran 和“收到好消息，立刻唱起来”的情景绑定；记住这里既有开始唱歌的动作，也有喜悦的心情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Laurel (Laurus nobilis), a tree whose aromatic leaves are used in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 月桂，一种叶片具有香气、可用作烹饪香料的树木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra b'weraq ifuħ li jintuża biex jagħti togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 月桂（Laurus nobilis）。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob żewġ werqiet tar-rand, li jitneħħew qabel ma tiġi servuta s-soppa.
formal.en: The recipe calls for two bay leaves, which are removed before the soup is served.
formal.zh: 食谱要求放入两片月桂叶，并在上汤之前将它们取出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna weraq tar-rand għas-soppa? Marija: Iva, fil-vażett ħdejn il-melħ. Ħu żewġ werqiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have bay leaves for the soup? Marija: Yes, in the jar beside the salt. Take two leaves.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们有煮汤用的月桂叶吗？Marija：有，在盐旁边的罐子里。拿两片吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我们有煮汤用的月桂叶吗？
messages.en: Do we have bay leaves for the soup?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fil-vażett ħdejn il-melħ. Ħu żewġ werqiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fil-vażett ħdejn il-melħ. Ħu żewġ werqiet.
messages.zh: 有，在盐旁边的罐子里。拿两片吧。
messages.en: Yes, in the jar beside the salt. Take two leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 rand 时想象往汤锅里放两片月桂叶；把 weraq tar-rand 整组记成“月桂叶”，再联想到月桂树。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way things are organized, positioned, or prepared for a purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某种目的对事物所作的安排、布置或编排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif affarijiet jitqiegħdu jew jiġu organizzati għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安排；布置；编排。

formal.mt: Ir-ranġament tal-imwejjed fis-sala jħalli passaġġ wiesa' għad-dħul u l-ħruġ tal-mistednin.
formal.en: The arrangement of the tables in the hall leaves a wide passage for guests to enter and leave.
formal.zh: 大厅里的桌子布置留出了一条宽敞的通道，方便宾客进出。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Jogħġbok dan ir-ranġament tal-għamara? Mark: Iva, hekk għandna aktar spazju ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you like this arrangement of the furniture? Mark: Yes, this way we have more space beside the window.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你喜欢家具这样布置吗？Mark：喜欢，这样窗边的空间更大。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢家具这样布置吗？
messages.en: Do you like this arrangement of the furniture?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk għandna aktar spazju ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk għandna aktar spazju ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 喜欢，这样窗边的空间更大。
messages.en: Yes, this way we have more space beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ranġament 配上一张家具摆放图：桌椅各有位置，整体就是“布置”；换成音符的排列，就能联想到音乐编配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause oil or fat to become rancid and develop an unpleasant smell or taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使油或脂肪酸败，产生难闻的气味或不良的味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel żejt jew xaħam jieħu riħa jew togħma ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使酸败；使油脂产生哈喇味。

formal.mt: Il-ħżin f'post sħun għal żmien twil ranġat iż-żejt, li żviluppa riħa ħażina.
formal.en: Prolonged storage in a warm place made the oil rancid, causing it to develop an unpleasant smell.
formal.zh: 长时间存放在温暖的地方使油发生酸败，产生了难闻的气味。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-post sħun ranġat iż-żejt? Toni: Iva, issa għandu riħa ħażina. Se narmih.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did this warm place make the oil rancid? Toni: Yes, it smells bad now. I'm going to throw it away.
colloquial.zh: Rita：放在这个温暖的地方，把油放得酸败了吗？Toni：是的，现在闻起来有股怪味。我准备把它倒掉。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 放在这个温暖的地方，把油放得酸败了吗？
messages.en: Did this warm place make the oil rancid?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandu riħa ħażina. Se narmih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandu riħa ħażina. Se narmih.
messages.zh: 是的，现在闻起来有股怪味。我准备把它倒掉。
messages.en: Yes, it smells bad now. I'm going to throw it away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本条把 ranġat 当作动词记：想象一瓶油久放后出现哈喇味，牢牢记住“某种条件使油脂酸败”的因果关系。

gloss_zh: 修理者；解决实际问题的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who fixes things or finds practical solutions to problems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修理物品或设法解决实际问题的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssewwi affarijiet jew issib soluzzjonijiet għal problemi prattiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修理者；能够把事情处理妥当、解决问题的人。

formal.mt: Ir-ranġatur tal-għamara eżamina s-siġġu u saħħaħ il-partijiet li kienu laxki.
formal.en: The furniture repairer examined the chair and reinforced the parts that were loose.
formal.zh: 家具修理者检查了椅子，并加固了松动的部件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-mejda tiċċaqlaq ħafna. Taf lil xi ranġatur? Pawlu: Iva, naf wieħed tas-sengħa. Nagħtik in-numru tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: This table wobbles a lot. Do you know a repairer? Pawlu: Yes, I know a skilled one. I'll give you his number.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这张桌子晃得很厉害。你认识修理的人吗？Pawlu：认识，我知道一位手艺很好的。我把他的号码给你。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-mejda tiċċaqlaq ħafna. Taf lil xi ranġatur?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-mejda tiċċaqlaq ħafna. Taf lil xi ranġatur?
messages.zh: 这张桌子晃得很厉害。你认识修理的人吗？
messages.en: This table wobbles a lot. Do you know a repairer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naf wieħed tas-sengħa. Nagħtik in-numru tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naf wieħed tas-sengħa. Nagħtik in-numru tiegħu.
messages.zh: 认识，我知道一位手艺很好的。我把他的号码给你。
messages.en: Yes, I know a skilled one. I'll give you his number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ranġatur 配一个拎工具箱的人物形象：桌子晃了就找他，事情卡住也请他想办法；重点记住这是“人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of mending something; also, an awkward situation that is difficult to handle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对物品进行的一次修补；也指令人尴尬、难以处理的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiswija ta' xi ħaġa; ukoll sitwazzjoni skomda li tkun diffiċli biex wieħed joħroġ minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次修补；修补工作。
尴尬、棘手或难以应付的处境。

collocations.en: to find yourself in an awkward situation
collocations.zh: 发现自己陷入尴尬处境

formal.mt: Il-ġakketta kellha bżonn ranġatura żgħira fil-kmiem qabel ma setgħet terġa' tintlibes.
formal.en: The jacket needed a small repair to the sleeves before it could be worn again.
formal.zh: 这件夹克的袖子需要稍作修补，才能再次穿着。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Wegħedt li mmur għal żewġ ikliet fl-istess ħin! Sara: Dħalt f'ranġatura! Ċempel lil wieħed minnhom u spjega x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Nina: I promised to attend two meals at the same time! Sara: You've got yourself into an awkward situation! Call one of them and explain what happened.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我答应了两场饭局，可时间撞在一起了！Sara：你这下尴尬了！给其中一方打个电话，解释一下情况。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wegħedt li mmur għal żewġ ikliet fl-istess ħin!
messages.mt_standard: Wegħedt li mmur għal żewġ ikliet fl-istess ħin!
messages.zh: 我答应了两场饭局，可时间撞在一起了！
messages.en: I promised to attend two meals at the same time!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dħalt f'ranġatura! Ċempel lil wieħed minnhom u spjega x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Dħalt f'ranġatura! Ċempel lil wieħed minnhom u spjega x'ġara.
messages.zh: 你这下尴尬了！给其中一方打个电话，解释一下情况。
messages.en: You've got yourself into an awkward situation! Call one of them and explain what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面分别记 ranġatura：一张是补好破袖子的“修补”，另一张是饭局撞期的“尴尬处境”；两义分开练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man whose faith and conduct show devotion to God and concern for spiritual life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信仰与行为体现出对神的虔敬，并重视灵性生活的男子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li juri devozzjoni lejn Alla u jagħti importanza lill-ħajja spiritwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虔诚敬神、重视灵性生活的男子。

collocations.en: a godly man devoted to prayer
collocations.zh: 虔诚且勤于祈祷的男子

collocations.en: to live as a godly man

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta lill-karattru bħala raġel tar-ruħ li jqatta' ħin fit-talb u jgħin lil min hu fil-bżonn.
formal.en: The author presents the character as a godly man who spends time in prayer and helps those in need.
formal.zh: 作者将这个人物塑造成一位虔诚的男子：他花时间祈祷，也帮助有需要的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tiddeskrivih lil Ġużeppi? Pawlu: Hu raġel tar-ruħ; jitlob kuljum u dejjem isib ħin biex jgħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How would you describe Ġużeppi? Pawlu: He is a godly man; he prays every day and always finds time to help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会怎样形容朱泽皮？保罗：他是个虔诚的人，每天祈祷，也总能抽出时间帮助别人。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你会怎样形容朱泽皮？
messages.en: How would you describe Ġużeppi?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu raġel tar-ruħ; jitlob kuljum u dejjem isib ħin biex jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Hu raġel tar-ruħ; jitlob kuljum u dejjem isib ħin biex jgħin.
messages.zh: 他是个虔诚的人，每天祈祷，也总能抽出时间帮助别人。
messages.en: He is a godly man; he prays every day and always finds time to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与每天祈祷、热心助人的男子联系起来，整体记作虔诚之人。

gloss_zh: 神像头部周围的光环；光轮

teaching_sense.en_definition: A circle or radiating halo of light shown around the head of a deity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现神祇时，绘制或设置在其头部周围的圆形或放射状光环。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċirku jew raġġi ta' dawl li jidhru madwar ras figura divina.

sense_translations.en_definition: halo, aureole (a circle of light or halo around the head of a deity)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 光环；光轮，指神祇头部周围的一圈光或光晕。

formal.mt: Fil-pittura, raġġiera tad-deheb ddawwar ras il-figura divina u tenfasizza l-qdusija tagħha.
formal.en: In the painting, a golden halo surrounds the head of the divine figure and emphasizes its holiness.
formal.zh: 画中，一圈金色光环围绕着神祇的头部，突出其神圣性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak iċ-ċirku tad-deheb madwar ras il-figura? Mark: Dik hi raġġiera; turi l-qdusija tal-figura.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that golden circle around the figure's head? Mark: That is a halo; it shows the figure's holiness.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个人物头部周围的金色圆圈是什么？马克：那是光环，用来表现这个人物的神圣性。

messages.speaker: Lara (博物馆访客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak iċ-ċirku tad-deheb madwar ras il-figura?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak iċ-ċirku tad-deheb madwar ras il-figura?
messages.zh: 那个人物头部周围的金色圆圈是什么？
messages.en: What is that golden circle around the figure's head?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi raġġiera; turi l-qdusija tal-figura.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi raġġiera; turi l-qdusija tal-figura.
messages.zh: 那是光环，用来表现这个人物的神圣性。
messages.en: That is a halo; it shows the figure's holiness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象宗教画里神像头后的一圈金光，把这个清晰画面与光环一义绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave a place or depart from where one has been.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开原来所在的地方；离去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlaq minn post fejn tkun kont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 离开；从某个地方离去。

formal.mt: Wara li ntemmet il-laqgħa, Mark raħ mill-uffiċċju.
formal.en: After the meeting ended, Mark left the office.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，马克离开了办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Mark? Pawlu: Raħ mid-dar ftit ilu. Maja: Mela nċempillu aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Mark? Pawlu: He left the house a little while ago. Maja: Then I'll call him later.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在哪儿？保罗：他刚离开家不久。玛雅：那我晚一点给他打电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他刚离开家不久。
messages.en: He left the house a little while ago.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我晚一点给他打电话。
messages.en: Then I'll call him later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raħ 配上一个人走出家门的画面，连着 raħ mid-dar 记住“离开了家”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become cheaper than before, so that less money is needed to buy something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价格比原来降低，购买时需要花的钱变少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir jiswa inqas minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得更便宜；价格下降。

formal.mt: Dan il-mudell raħas b'għaxra fil-mija meta ħareġ mudell ġdid.
formal.en: This model became ten percent cheaper when a new model came out.
formal.zh: 新型号推出时，这个型号的价格下降了百分之十。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek trid tixtri dak it-telefon? Mark: Iva, issa raħas ħafna. Lara: Mela ejja naraw kemm jiswa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you still want to buy that phone? Mark: Yes, it's become much cheaper now. Lara: Then let's see how much it costs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你还想买那部手机吗？马克：想，现在便宜了很多。拉拉：那我们看看现在多少钱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还想买那部手机吗？
messages.en: Do you still want to buy that phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，现在便宜了很多。
messages.en: Yes, it's become much cheaper now.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们看看现在多少钱。
messages.en: Then let's see how much it costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一件商品的价签从高价换成低价，用 raħas 记住“变便宜”这个变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing compassion and a willingness to forgive or spare someone from harsh treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 富有同情心，愿意宽恕别人或使人免受严厉对待的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ħniena u jkun lest li jaħfer jew ma jittrattax lil xi ħadd bl-aħrax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仁慈的；有怜悯之心、愿意宽恕的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-re kien raħim u ħafer lill-priġunier.
formal.en: In the story, the king was merciful and forgave the prisoner.
formal.zh: 在故事中，国王心怀仁慈，宽恕了囚犯。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ir-re ħeles lill-priġunier? Pawlu: Għax kien raħim u ried jagħtih ċans ieħor. Nina: Issa nifhem it-tmiem tar-rakkont.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the king release the prisoner? Pawlu: Because he was merciful and wanted to give him another chance. Nina: Now I understand the ending of the story.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：国王为什么释放了囚犯？保罗：因为他很仁慈，想再给囚犯一次机会。妮娜：现在我明白故事的结尾了。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 国王为什么释放了囚犯？
messages.en: Why did the king release the prisoner?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien raħim u ried jagħtih ċans ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien raħim u ried jagħtih ċans ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为他很仁慈，想再给囚犯一次机会。
messages.en: Because he was merciful and wanted to give him another chance.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 现在我明白故事的结尾了。
messages.en: Now I understand the ending of the story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事中的国王愿意宽恕犯错的人，用 raħim 描写他“仁慈的”性情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Compassion shown toward someone, especially through forgiveness or relief from harsh treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人表现出的怜悯或仁慈，尤其体现为宽恕或减轻严厉的对待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħniena li tintwera lejn xi ħadd, speċjalment bil-maħfra jew billi tittaffielu t-tbatija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怜悯；仁慈；慈悲的品质或表现。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-priġunier talab raħma, u r-re ddeċieda li jaħfirlu.
formal.en: In the story, the prisoner asked for mercy, and the king decided to forgive him.
formal.zh: 在故事中，囚犯请求怜悯，国王决定宽恕他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'talab il-priġunier lir-re? Lara: Talab raħma. Maja: U r-re ħafirlu? Lara: Iva, tah ċans ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the prisoner ask the king for? Lara: He asked for mercy. Maja: And did the king forgive him? Lara: Yes, he gave him another chance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：囚犯向国王请求什么？拉拉：他请求怜悯。玛雅：那国王宽恕他了吗？拉拉：是的，国王又给了他一次机会。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 囚犯向国王请求什么？
messages.en: What did the prisoner ask the king for?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 他请求怜悯。
messages.en: He asked for mercy.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 那国王宽恕他了吗？
messages.en: And did the king forgive him?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，国王又给了他一次机会。
messages.en: Yes, he gave him another chance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raħma 放进“请求怜悯、表现仁慈”两个动作里记忆，它指所请求或表现出的慈悲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in the price of something or in the prices of several things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某件商品或多种商品的价格降低；一次价格下调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-prezz ta' xi ħaġa jew fil-prezzijiet ta' diversi affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价格的降低；降价或价格下调。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut ħabbar raħsa ta' għaxra fil-mija fuq il-kotba kollha għal ġimgħa.
formal.en: The shop announced a ten percent price reduction on all books for one week.
formal.zh: 商店宣布，所有图书降价百分之十，为期一周。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hemm xi raħsa fuq dan il-ktieb? Rita: Iva, illum jiswa żewġ ewro inqas. Mark: Tajjeb, nieħu wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is there a price reduction on this book? Rita: Yes, today it costs two euros less. Mark: Good, I'll take one.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书有降价吗？丽塔：有，今天便宜两欧元。马克：好，我买一本。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi raħsa fuq dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi raħsa fuq dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书有降价吗？
messages.en: Is there a price reduction on this book?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum jiswa żewġ ewro inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum jiswa żewġ ewro inqas.
messages.zh: 有，今天便宜两欧元。
messages.en: Yes, today it costs two euros less.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我买一本。
messages.en: Good, I'll take one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 raħsa 想成商店公告上的“一次降价”，配合百分比记住它是表示价格下调的名词。
